vocab: DINKs, couples who choose to have no children
to lose face, to be shameful
to carry on the family line
old people whose children have left home
grammar: only for …, not …
只 + 为 + person narrows the purpose to one person. 不想着 adds the other side: not thinking of anyone else.
只为自己，不想着别人。
Zhǐ wèi zìjǐ, bù xiǎngzhe biérén.
Only thinking of yourself, not of others.
他只为孩子活着，不想着自己。
Tā zhǐ wèi háizi huózhe, bù xiǎngzhe zìjǐ.
He lives only for his child and never thinks of himself.
不再 + V
no longer
不再 puts an end to something that used to happen. It goes right before the verb.
两个人决定不再做夫妻。
Liǎng ge rén juédìng bú zài zuò fūqī.
Two people decide to stop being husband and wife.
他们结婚以后，不再常常参加聚会了。
Tāmen jié hūn yǐhòu, bú zài chángcháng cānjiā jùhuì le.
After they married, they no longer went to parties often.
比 + 别人 + 更 + adj
better/more than others
A 比 B 更 + adjective compares two things. 更 means "even more".
和别人比赛，希望自己比别人更好。
Hé biérén bǐsài, xīwàng zìjǐ bǐ biérén gèng hǎo.
Competing with others, hoping to do better than them.
他希望自己的孩子比别人的孩子更聪明。
Tā xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi bǐ biérén de háizi gèng cōngmíng.
He hopes his child will be even cleverer than other people's children.

grammar: V + 不上 / 得上 · 顾不上
can't manage to (no time)
顾不上 means you're too busy to attend to something. The positive form is 顾得上.

Too busy to visit your parents at New Year.

V + 得 + 顾不上……
so … that there's no time to …
忙得 + result describes how busy someone is: so busy that something else gets left out.
忙得顾不上吃饭。
Máng de gù bu shàng chī fàn.
So busy there's no time to eat.
她忙得顾不上给父母打电话。
Tā máng de gù bu shàng gěi fùmǔ dǎ diànhuà.
She's so busy she has no time to call her parents.
have to …, and also have to …
还要 adds a second duty to the first, stressing how much there is to do.
要照顾生病的父母，还要养孩子。
Yào zhàogù shēng bìng de fùmǔ, hái yào yǎng háizi.
Having to look after sick parents and raise children too.
他要上班，还要照顾孩子。
Tā yào shàng bān, hái yào zhàogù háizi.
He has to go to work and look after the kids as well.
在……面前
in front of …
在 + person + 面前 means in front of or in the presence of someone.
天天在别人面前抬不起头。
Tiāntiān zài biérén miànqián tái bu qǐ tóu.
Feeling ashamed in front of others every day.
他在老师面前很紧张。
Tā zài lǎoshī miànqián hěn jǐnzhāng.
He gets nervous in front of the teacher.
gaps: 生病的父母，还要养孩子。
承受不了生活花销，经济

grammar: 想要……，就需要……
if you want …, you need …
The first clause states a goal and 就 introduces what it takes.
想要在事业上取得成功，就需要付出辛苦。
Xiǎng yào zài shìyè shang qǔdé chénggōng, jiù xūyào fùchū xīnkǔ.
If you want to succeed in your career, you have to put in hard work.
想要学好汉语，就需要每天练习。
Xiǎng yào xué hǎo Hànyǔ, jiù xūyào měitiān liànxí.
If you want to learn Chinese well, you need to practise every day.
A 是 A，就是……
it's A all right, but …
Repeating the adjective around 是 admits a good point, and 就是 brings in the problem.
这家商店的东西便宜是便宜，就是质量太差了。
Zhè jiā shāngdiàn de dōngxi piányi shì piányi, jiùshì zhìliàng tài chà le.
This shop's things are cheap all right, but the quality is terrible.
这件衣服好看是好看，就是太贵了。
Zhè jiàn yīfu hǎokàn shì hǎokàn, jiùshì tài guì le.
This piece of clothing is nice all right, but it's too expensive.
根本 + 不/没/顾不上
simply not, not at all
根本 before a negative makes it absolute: not at all.
大刘整天在外地忙工作，根本顾不上回家看父母。
Dà Liú zhěngtiān zài wàidì máng gōngzuò, gēnběn gù bu shàng huí jiā kàn fùmǔ.
Da Liu is always away working in other cities and simply has no time to go home and see his parents.
我根本不知道这件事。
Wǒ gēnběn bù zhīdao zhè jiàn shì.
I knew nothing at all about it.
正在……呢
be in the middle of …ing
正在 marks an action in progress, and 呢 at the end softens it.
小丁的孩子下个月就不上幼儿园了，他正在给孩子找合适的小学呢。
Xiǎo Dīng de háizi xià ge yuè jiù bú shàng yòu'éryuán le, tā zhèngzài gěi háizi zhǎo héshì de xiǎoxué ne.
Xiao Ding's child is leaving kindergarten next month, and he's looking for a suitable primary school.
妈妈正在做饭呢。
Māma zhèngzài zuò fàn ne.
Mum is cooking right now.
把 + O + 都 + V + 了起来
to put … aside, to save up
把 brings the object forward. 起来 after 攒 means collecting something and keeping it.
老王把自己退休金中的一大半都攒了起来，准备留给孙子用。
Lǎo Wáng bǎ zìjǐ tuìxiūjīn zhōng de yí dàbàn dōu zǎn le qǐlái, zhǔnbèi liú gěi sūnzi yòng.
Lao Wang has saved up more than half of his pension to leave to his grandson.
他把每个月的工资都攒了起来。
Tā bǎ měi ge yuè de gōngzī dōu zǎn le qǐlái.
He saved up all of his monthly pay.
为了 + goal，……
in order to …
为了 states the purpose first, and the main clause says what someone does for it.
为了照顾好孩子，小张放弃了去北京工作的好机会。
Wèile zhàogù hǎo háizi, Xiǎo Zhāng fàngqì le qù Běijīng gōngzuò de hǎo jīhuì.
To take good care of her child, Xiao Zhang gave up a good chance to work in Beijing.
为了学好汉语，她来到了北京。
Wèile xué hǎo Hànyǔ, tā láidào le Běijīng.
To learn Chinese well, she came to Beijing.

vocab: to carry on the family line
having a boy or a girl

grammar: 唯一的 + N
the only …
唯一 works like an adjective with 的 before a noun: the one and only.
刘刚是他家唯一的男孩。
Liú Gāng shì tā jiā wéiyī de nánhái.
Liu Gang is the only boy in his family.
这是我唯一的机会。
Zhè shì wǒ wéiyī de jīhuì.
This is my only chance.
得到……的理解
to win …'s understanding
得到 + someone's + noun: to receive support, help or understanding from them.
丁克这一类群体应该得到大家的理解。
Dīngkè zhè yí lèi qúntǐ yīnggāi dédào dàjiā de lǐjiě.
DINKs as a group deserve everyone's understanding.
他的想法得到了父母的支持。
Tā de xiǎngfǎ dédào le fùmǔ de zhīchí.
His idea won his parents' support.
……都一样
it's all the same
After two options, 都一样 says there's no difference between them.
传宗接代的观念已经过时了，生男生女都一样。
Chuánzōng-jiēdài de guānniàn yǐjīng guòshí le, shēng nán shēng nǚ dōu yíyàng.
The idea of carrying on the family line is out of date. A boy or a girl, it's all the same.
坐车去还是走路去都一样。
Zuò chē qù háishi zǒu lù qù dōu yíyàng.
Going by bus or on foot, it's all the same.
可 + V + 不了
really can't …
可 before a verb phrase adds strong emphasis, often with a negative.
每个月这么大的花销，我家可承受不了。
Měi ge yuè zhème dà de huāxiao, wǒ jiā kě chéngshòu bu liǎo.

这么多作业，我可做不完。
Zhème duō zuòyè, wǒ kě zuò bù wán.
With this much homework I really can't finish it.
only just … and already …
刚 marks something that only just happened, and 就 shows the next thing came surprisingly soon.
儿子刚结婚一年就离婚，全家都觉得很丢脸。
Érzi gāng jié hūn yì nián jiù líhūn, quán jiā dōu juéde hěn diū liǎn.

把 + 父母 + 送进 + place
to put (someone) into …
把 brings the people forward, and 送进 says where they're taken.
很多人认为，把父母送进养老院是件很丢脸的事情。

lines: 孙红生了个女孩，她总在婆婆面前抬不起头。

A

vocab: to have to, to have no choice but to
grammar: 不得不 + V
to have no choice but to …
不得不 is a double negative: you can't not do it, so you must.
想给孩子一个好的生活，自己就不得不做出一些牺牲。
Xiǎng gěi háizi yí ge hǎo de shēnghuó, zìjǐ jiù bùdébù zuòchū yìxiē xīshēng.
If you want to give your child a good life, you have to make some sacrifices yourself.
下雨了，我们不得不回家。
Xià yǔ le, wǒmen bùdébù huí jiā.
It started raining, so we had to go home.
得 (děi) + V
must, have to
Before a verb, 得 is read děi and means "have to". It's common in speech.
为了孩子，父母得放弃一些自己喜欢的事情。
Wèile háizi, fùmǔ děi fàngqì yìxiē zìjǐ xǐhuan de shìqing.
For their children's sake, parents have to give up some things they enjoy.
太晚了，我得走了。
Tài wǎn le, wǒ de zǒu le.
It's late. I have to go.
因为……而……
because of … (and so) …
因为 gives the cause and 而 links it to the result, in a written style.
很多人为了事业成功，决定不生孩子，他们不想因为生孩子而影响自己的工作。
Hěn duō rén wèile shìyè chénggōng, juédìng bù shēng háizi, tāmen bù xiǎng yīnwèi shēng háizi ér yǐngxiǎng zìjǐ de gōngzuò.
Many people decide not to have children so they can succeed in their careers. They don't want children to affect their work.
他因为工作太忙而顾不上家里的事。
Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng ér gù bu shàng jiā li de shì.
He has no time for family matters because work is so busy.
离 + place + 比较近
quite close to …
离 measures distance from a place. The place comes after 离, then 近 or 远.
我们马上就要搬家了，要搬到离我婆婆家比较近的地方。
Wǒmen mǎshàng jiù yào bān jiā le, yào bān dào lí wǒ pópo jiā bǐjiào jìn de dìfang.
We're moving soon, to a place quite close to my mother-in-law's.
我家离学校很近。
Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.
My home is very close to the school.
……，那是在做梦
that's just wishful thinking
做梦 here means hoping for something that won't happen.
你想靠他们给你养老，那是在做梦。
Nǐ xiǎng kào tāmen gěi nǐ yǎnglǎo, nà shì zài zuò mèng.
You want them to look after you in old age? Dream on.
你想不努力就考上大学，那是在做梦。
Nǐ xiǎng bù nǔlì jiù kǎoshang dàxué, nà shì zài zuò mèng.
You want to get into university without working hard? Dream on.
gaps: 想给孩子一个好的生活，自己就
他们不想因为生孩子而
他们给你养老，那是在做梦。
say: If you want to give your child a good life, you have to make some sacrifices yourself.
We're moving soon, to a place quite close to my mother-in-law's.
Many people think work matters more than children, and they're willing to go without children for their work.
You want them to look after you in old age? Dream on.
Sun Hong had a girl, and she always feels ashamed in front of her mother-in-law.

007.title: For or against being DINK?
007.sub: Xiao Wu doesn't want children: 10 people's reactions
007.transcriptNote: Xiao Wu and her husband have decided not to have children. Ten people react. Decide whether each one is for or against their choice, then turn on Answers. Items 2 and 4 aren't numbered aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断说话人的意思 · What does the speaker think?
lines: 判断说话人的意思。
Pànduàn shuōhuàrén de yìsi.
Work out what the speaker means.
小吴和她老公结婚很多年了，他们加入了丁克一族，一直不想生小孩。
Xiǎo Wú hé tā lǎogōng jié hūn hěn duō nián le, tāmen jiārù le dīngkè yì zú, yìzhí bù xiǎng shēng xiǎohái.
Xiao Wu and her husband have been married for many years. They've joined the DINKs and have never wanted children.
下面是一些人对此的看法。你觉得他们的态度是什么？
Xiàmiàn shì yìxiē rén duì cǐ de kànfǎ. Nǐ juéde tāmen de tàidu shì shénme?
Here are some people's views on this. What do you think their attitude is?
还是二人世界的生活才自由。
Háishi èr rén shìjiè de shēnghuó cái zìyóu.
Life as a couple is the only truly free life.
到老了，你们多孤独呀，你们会后悔的。
Dào lǎo le, nǐmen duō gūdú ya, nǐmen huì hòuhuǐ de.
When you're old, you'll be so lonely. You'll regret it.
这样做与咱们传宗接代的观念不符。
Zhèyàng zuò yǔ zánmen chuánzōng-jiēdài de guānniàn bù fú.
Doing this goes against our idea of carrying on the family line.
你们太自私了，也不为父母想想。
Nǐmen tài zìsī le, yě bú wèi fùmǔ xiǎngxiang.
You're too selfish. You don't think about your parents at all.
其实你看，人家有小孩的家庭不是也挺幸福的吗？
Qíshí nǐ kàn, rénjia yǒu xiǎohái de jiātíng bú shì yě tǐng xìngfú de ma?
Actually, look: aren't families with children pretty happy too?
现在的孩子都靠父母，根本谈不上养儿防老。
Xiànzài de háizi dōu kào fùmǔ, gēnběn tán bu shàng yǎng ér fáng lǎo.
Children these days all depend on their parents. Raising kids to look after you in old age? Forget it.
你看看老李，帮儿媳妇照顾孙子多累呀，连和我们聚会的时间都没有。
Nǐ kànkan Lǎo Lǐ, bāng érxífu zhàogù sūnzi duō lèi ya, lián hé wǒmen jùhuì de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
Look at Lao Li. Helping his daughter-in-law look after the grandchild is so tiring, he doesn't even have time to get together with us.
要是你能给家里传宗接代，那家里的老人一定都能不怕辛苦，帮你们照顾小孩的。
Yàoshì nǐ néng gěi jiā li chuánzōng-jiēdài, nà jiā li de lǎorén yídìng dōu néng bú pà xīnkǔ, bāng nǐmen zhàogù xiǎohái de.
If you carried on the family line, the old folks at home would gladly put up with the hard work and help you look after the child.
不能因为想自己自由就不生孩子吧？如果你们的父母也这么想，这个世界上根本不会有你们。
Bù néng yīnwèi xiǎng zìjǐ zìyóu jiù bù shēng háizi ba? Rúguǒ nǐmen de fùmǔ yě zhème xiǎng, zhège shìjiè shang gēnběn bú huì yǒu nǐmen.
You can't skip having children just because you want to be free, can you? If your parents had thought like that, you wouldn't be here at all.
现在什么都贵，光孩子上学的花销就承受不起。有了小孩，你们的经济负担会很大的。
Xiànzài shénme dōu guì, guāng háizi shàng xué de huāxiao jiù chéngshòu bu qǐ. Yǒu le xiǎohái, nǐmen de jīngjì fùdān huì hěn dà de.
Everything's expensive now. Just the cost of a child's schooling is more than you can afford. With a child, your financial burden would be huge.

vocab: raising children for one's old age
grammar: 还是……才……
after all, only … is really …
还是 here means "on reflection", and 才 marks the one thing that truly qualifies.
还是二人世界的生活才自由。
Háishi èr rén shìjiè de shēnghuó cái zìyóu.
Life as a couple is the only truly free life.
还是在家吃饭才舒服。
Háishi zài jiā chī fàn cái shūfu.
After all, eating at home is the most comfortable.
多 + adj + 呀
how …!
多 + adjective + 呀/啊 makes an exclamation.
到老了，你们多孤独呀，你们会后悔的。
Dào lǎo le, nǐmen duō gūdú ya, nǐmen huì hòuhuǐ de.
When you're old, you'll be so lonely. You'll regret it.
你看，今天的天气多好呀！
Nǐ kàn, jīntiān de tiānqì duō hǎo ya!
Look, what lovely weather today!
不是……吗？
isn't it …?
A rhetorical question: the speaker is sure the answer is yes.
其实你看，人家有小孩的家庭不是也挺幸福的吗？
Qíshí nǐ kàn, rénjia yǒu xiǎohái de jiātíng bú shì yě tǐng xìngfú de ma?
Actually, look: aren't families with children pretty happy too?
你不是说今天不上班吗？
Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān bú shàng bān ma?
Didn't you say you weren't working today?
even …
连 picks out an extreme case, and 都 or 也 follows.
你看看老李，帮儿媳妇照顾孙子多累呀，连和我们聚会的时间都没有。
Nǐ kànkan Lǎo Lǐ, bāng érxífu zhàogù sūnzi duō lèi ya, lián hé wǒmen jùhuì de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
Look at Lao Li. Helping his daughter-in-law look after the grandchild is so tiring, he doesn't even have time to get together with us.
他忙得连吃饭的时间都没有。
Tā máng de lián chī fàn de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
He's so busy he doesn't even have time to eat.
… alone already …
光 picks out one part, and 就 says that part alone is already too much.
现在什么都贵，光孩子上学的花销就承受不起。有了小孩，你们的经济负担会很大的。
Xiànzài shénme dōu guì, guāng háizi shàng xué de huāxiao jiù chéngshòu bu qǐ. Yǒu le xiǎohái, nǐmen de jīngjì fùdān huì hěn dà de.

光房租就要三千块。
Guāng fángzū jiù yào sān qiān kuài.
The rent alone costs three thousand.
if …, then …
要是 is a spoken "if". 那 introduces the result.
要是你能给家里传宗接代，那家里的老人一定都能不怕辛苦，帮你们照顾小孩的。
Yàoshì nǐ néng gěi jiā li chuánzōng-jiēdài, nà jiā li de lǎorén yídìng dōu néng bú pà xīnkǔ, bāng nǐmen zhàogù xiǎohái de.
If you carried on the family line, the old folks at home would gladly put up with the hard work and help you look after the child.
要是明天下雨，那我们就不去了。

If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

到老了，你们多孤独呀，你们会

say: Life as a couple is the only truly free life.

008.title: Being DINK: the upside and the problems
008.sub: Eight statements to note down in a few words
008.transcriptNote: Each statement is either a benefit of being DINK or a problem DINKs run into. Note down the main idea, then compare with the Answers, which are my own short summaries. Items 2, 3, 6 and 8 aren't numbered aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
下面是当丁克的好处或遇到的问题，请记下每个句子的主要意思。
Xiàmiàn shì dāng dīngkè de hǎochù huò yùdào de wèntí, qǐng jì xià měi ge jùzi de zhǔyào yìsi.
Here are some benefits of being DINK, or problems DINKs face. Note down the main idea of each sentence.
丁克们一生没有儿女，也许有一天会觉得很遗憾。
Dīngkèmen yìshēng méiyǒu érnǚ, yěxǔ yǒu yì tiān huì juéde hěn yíhàn.
DINKs have no children all their lives, and one day they may deeply regret it.

ans: 问题：以后可能会觉得遗憾。
Wèntí: yǐhòu kěnéng huì juéde yíhàn.
A problem: they may regret it later.

lines: 丁克们不用像其他父母那样，付出那么大的辛苦。
Dīngkèmen búyòng xiàng qítā fùmǔ nàyàng, fùchū nàme dà de xīnkǔ.
DINKs don't have to work as hard as other parents do.

ans: A benefit: life isn't as hard.

lines: 有很多丁克觉得自己很丢脸，很抬不起头。
Yǒu hěn duō dīngkè juéde zìjǐ hěn diū liǎn, hěn tái bu qǐ tóu.
Many DINKs feel ashamed and can't hold their heads up.
丁克这类群体常常会被别人议论，因为他们不符合中国人传宗接代的传统观念。
Dīngkè zhè lèi qúntǐ chángcháng huì bèi biérén yìlùn, yīnwèi tāmen bù fúhé Zhōngguórén chuánzōng-jiēdài de chuántǒng guānniàn.
DINKs as a group are often talked about, because they don't fit the traditional Chinese idea of carrying on the family line.

ans: A problem: people gossip about them.

lines: 不生小孩的夫妻生活质量往往很高，他们很自由。
Bù shēng xiǎohái de fūqī shēnghuó zhìliàng wǎngwǎng hěn gāo, tāmen hěn zìyóu.
Couples without children often have a high quality of life, and they're free.

ans: 好处：生活质量高，很自由。
Hǎochù: shēnghuó zhìliàng gāo, hěn zìyóu.
A benefit: a good quality of life and freedom.

lines: 丁克一族往往不被家里老人理解和接受，被认为太自私。
Dīngkè yì zú wǎngwǎng bú bèi jiā li lǎorén lǐjiě hé jiēshòu, bèi rènwéi tài zìsī.
DINKs are often not understood or accepted by the older people in the family, and they're seen as too selfish.

ans: 问题：老人不理解，觉得他们自私。
Wèntí: lǎorén bù lǐjiě, juéde tāmen zìsī.
A problem: the older generation doesn't understand and calls them selfish.

lines: 丁克们不用因为孩子放弃自己喜欢做的事情，可以在事业上更努力，更专心。
Dīngkèmen búyòng yīnwèi háizi fàngqì zìjǐ xǐhuan zuò de shìqing, kěyǐ zài shìyè shang gèng nǔlì, gèng zhuānxīn.
DINKs don't have to give up things they love because of children. They can work harder at their careers and focus more.

ans: 好处：可以专心做自己的事业。
Hǎochù: kěyǐ zhuānxīn zuò zìjǐ de shìyè.
A benefit: they can concentrate on their careers.

lines: 老丁克们没有儿女，有些人会觉得很孤独，生病没有人照顾。
Lǎo dīngkèmen méiyǒu érnǚ, yǒuxiē rén huì juéde hěn gūdú, shēng bìng méiyǒu rén zhàogù.
Older DINKs have no children. Some feel very lonely, and when they're ill nobody looks after them.

ans: 问题：老了孤独，没人照顾。
Wèntí: lǎo le gūdú, méi rén zhàogù.
A problem: loneliness and no one to care for them in old age.

vocab: to talk about, to gossip about
grammar: 像……那样
like …
像 + person + 那样 compares a way of doing things. With 不用 it means "don't have to do it the way … do".
丁克们不用像其他父母那样，付出那么大的辛苦。
Dīngkèmen búyòng xiàng qítā fùmǔ nàyàng, fùchū nàme dà de xīnkǔ.
DINKs don't have to work as hard as other parents do.
我想像他那样说一口地道的汉语。
Wǒ xiǎng xiàng tā nàyàng shuō yì kǒu dìdao de Hànyǔ.
I want to speak authentic Chinese the way he does.
被 + (person) + V
passive
被 marks the passive. The doer can be named (被别人议论) or left out (被认为).
丁克这类群体常常会被别人议论，因为他们不符合中国人传宗接代的传统观念。
Dīngkè zhè lèi qúntǐ chángcháng huì bèi biérén yìlùn, yīnwèi tāmen bù fúhé Zhōngguórén chuánzōng-jiēdài de chuántǒng guānniàn.
DINKs as a group are often talked about, because they don't fit the traditional Chinese idea of carrying on the family line.
他的想法被大家接受了。
Tā de xiǎngfǎ bèi dàjiā jiēshòu le.
His idea was accepted by everyone.
不被……理解和接受
not understood or accepted by …
The negative 不 goes before 被, not before the verb.
丁克一族往往不被家里老人理解和接受，被认为太自私。
Dīngkè yì zú wǎngwǎng bú bèi jiā li lǎorén lǐjiě hé jiēshòu, bèi rènwéi tài zìsī.
DINKs are often not understood or accepted by the older people in the family, and they're seen as too selfish.
他的决定不被父母理解。
Tā de juédìng bú bèi fùmǔ lǐjiě.
His decision isn't understood by his parents.
往往
usually, tends to
往往 describes what tends to happen in general, based on experience.
不生小孩的夫妻生活质量往往很高，他们很自由。
Bù shēng xiǎohái de fūqī shēnghuó zhìliàng wǎngwǎng hěn gāo, tāmen hěn zìyóu.
Couples without children often have a high quality of life, and they're free.
年轻人往往不喜欢早起。
Niánqīngrén wǎngwǎng bù xǐhuan zǎoqǐ.
Young people tend not to like getting up early.
不用因为……放弃……
don't need to give up … because of …
不用 means there's no need. 因为 + reason sits before the verb.
丁克们不用因为孩子放弃自己喜欢做的事情，可以在事业上更努力，更专心。
Dīngkèmen búyòng yīnwèi háizi fàngqì zìjǐ xǐhuan zuò de shìqing, kěyǐ zài shìyè shang gèng nǔlì, gèng zhuānxīn.
DINKs don't have to give up things they love because of children. They can work harder at their careers and focus more.
你不用因为工作放弃学习。
Nǐ búyòng yīnwèi gōngzuò fàngqì xuéxí.
You don't need to give up studying because of work.
gaps: 丁克们一生没有儿女，也许有一天会觉得很
丁克们不用像其他父母那样，
丁克这类群体常常会被别人

丁克一族往往不被家里老人理解和
可以在事业上更努力，更

say: DINKs have no children all their lives, and one day they may deeply regret it.

009.title: DINK families
009.sub: Two questions, then a short passage giving four reasons
009.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the passage. The answers to the questions are my own summary of the passage.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

ans: 丁克家庭就是夫妻不愿意生孩子的家庭。
Dīngkè jiātíng jiùshì fūqī bú yuànyì shēng háizi de jiātíng.
A family where the couple doesn't want to have children.

q: 丁克一族为什么不想生孩子？文章介绍了几点？请总结每一点的内容。
Dīngkè yì zú wèishénme bù xiǎng shēng háizi? Wénzhāng jièshào le jǐ diǎn? Qǐng zǒngjié měi yìdiǎn de nèiróng.
Why don't DINKs want children? How many reasons does the passage give? Sum up each one.
ans: 四点：二人世界更自由；不想让孩子影响工作；养孩子花销太大；怕孩子将来压力太大。
Sì diǎn: èr rén shìjiè gèng zìyóu; bù xiǎng ràng háizi yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò; yǎng háizi huāxiao tài dà; pà háizi jiānglái yālì tài dà.
Four: life as a couple is freer; they don't want children to affect their work; raising a child costs too much; they fear their child will face too much pressure later on.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 丁克家庭
Dīngkè jiātíng
DINK families
丁克家庭就是夫妻不愿意生孩子的家庭。
Dīngkè jiātíng jiùshì fūqī bú yuànyì shēng háizi de jiātíng.
A DINK family is one where the couple doesn't want to have children.
以前这个群体会被别人议论，因为他们与中国人传宗接代的传统观念不符。
Yǐqián zhège qúntǐ huì bèi biérén yìlùn, yīnwèi tāmen yǔ Zhōngguórén chuánzōng-jiēdài de chuántǒng guānniàn bù fú.
In the past, people gossiped about this group, because they went against the traditional Chinese idea of carrying on the family line.
而现在，这种家庭已经开始被人们理解和接受，
Ér xiànzài, zhè zhǒng jiātíng yǐjīng kāishǐ bèi rénmen lǐjiě hé jiēshòu,
Now, though, families like this are starting to be understood and accepted,
也有越来越多的夫妻加入了丁克一族。
yě yǒu yuèláiyuè duō de fūqī jiārù le dīngkè yì zú.
and more and more couples are joining the DINKs.
那么，为什么丁克们不想生小孩呢？
Nàme, wèishénme dīngkèmen bù xiǎng shēng xiǎohái ne?
So why don't DINKs want children?
我们认为，原因主要有以下几个方面。
Wǒmen rènwéi, yuányīn zhǔyào yǒu yǐxià jǐ ge fāngmiàn.
In our view, the reasons fall mainly into the following areas.
首先，一部分人认为，养孩子是一件非常辛苦的事情，
Shǒuxiān, yí bùfen rén rènwéi, yǎng háizi shì yí jiàn fēicháng xīnkǔ de shìqing,
First, some people think raising children is very hard work,
二人世界的生活才自由，两个人想去哪儿玩就去哪儿玩，活得更舒服。
èr rén shìjiè de shēnghuó cái zìyóu, liǎng ge rén xiǎng qù nǎr wán jiù qù nǎr wán, huó de gèng shūfu.
and only life as a couple is free: the two of them can go wherever they like and live more comfortably.
其次，还有一部分人不愿意让孩子影响自己的工作。
Qícì, hái yǒu yí bùfen rén bú yuànyì ràng háizi yǐngxiǎng zìjǐ de gōngzuò.
Second, some people don't want children to affect their work.
而有了小孩以后，就不得不做一些牺牲，放弃自己喜欢做的事情，
Ér yǒu le xiǎohái yǐhòu, jiù bùdébù zuò yìxiē xīshēng, fàngqì zìjǐ xǐhuan zuò de shìqing,
Once you have a child, you have to make some sacrifices and give up things you enjoy,
这样，给自己留下很多遗憾。
zhèyàng, gěi zìjǐ liúxia hěn duō yíhàn.
and that leaves you with a lot of regrets.
第三，也有人认为，生小孩花销很大，经济负担太大。
Dì-sān, yě yǒu rén rènwéi, shēng xiǎohái huāxiao hěn dà, jīngjì fùdān tài dà.
Third, some think having a child costs a lot and is too heavy a financial burden.
他们觉得，如果自己没有好的生活条件，
Tāmen juéde, rúguǒ zìjǐ méiyǒu hǎo de shēnghuó tiáojiàn,
They feel that if they don't have good living conditions themselves,
不能保证给孩子一个舒适稳定的生活环境，这样，还不如不生。
bù néng bǎozhèng gěi háizi yí ge shūshì wěndìng de shēnghuó huánjìng, zhèyàng, hái bùrú bù shēng.
and can't guarantee their child a comfortable, stable home, then it's better not to have one.
最后，一些人觉得现在的生活压力太大，
Zuìhòu, yìxiē rén juéde xiànzài de shēnghuó yālì tài dà,
Finally, some feel that life today is too stressful,
害怕自己的孩子将来会太辛苦，承受不住竞争的压力。
hàipà zìjǐ de háizi jiānglái huì tài xīnkǔ, chéngshòu bu zhù jìngzhēng de yālì.
and they're afraid their children will have too hard a time in future and won't be able to bear the pressure of competition.

vocab: to talk about, to gossip about
might as well, would be better to
grammar: 首先……，其次……，第三……，最后……
first …, second …, third …, finally …
These words list points in order in a talk or piece of writing.
首先，一部分人认为，养孩子是一件非常辛苦的事情，
Shǒuxiān, yí bùfen rén rènwéi, yǎng háizi shì yí jiàn fēicháng xīnkǔ de shìqing,
First, some people think raising children is very hard work,
首先要努力学习，其次要多练习。
Shǒuxiān yào nǔlì xuéxí, qícì yào duō liànxí.
First you need to study hard, and second you need to practise a lot.
想 + V + 哪儿 + 就 + V + 哪儿
wherever you like
The same question word appears twice: whatever you want in the first half, you do in the second.
二人世界的生活才自由，两个人想去哪儿玩就去哪儿玩，活得更舒服。
èr rén shìjiè de shēnghuó cái zìyóu, liǎng ge rén xiǎng qù nǎr wán jiù qù nǎr wán, huó de gèng shūfu.
and only life as a couple is free: the two of them can go wherever they like and live more comfortably.
你想吃什么就吃什么。
Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.
Eat whatever you like.
被人们理解和接受
to be understood and accepted by people
被 makes the passive. 已经开始被 means it's begun to happen.
而现在，这种家庭已经开始被人们理解和接受，
Ér xiànzài, zhè zhǒng jiātíng yǐjīng kāishǐ bèi rénmen lǐjiě hé jiēshòu,
Now, though, families like this are starting to be understood and accepted,
他的意见被大家接受了。
Tā de yìjiàn bèi dàjiā jiēshòu le.
His suggestion was accepted by everyone.
… then it's better to …
After a bad option, 还不如 offers something that would be better.
不能保证给孩子一个舒适稳定的生活环境，这样，还不如不生。
bù néng bǎozhèng gěi háizi yí ge shūshì wěndìng de shēnghuó huánjìng, zhèyàng, hái bùrú bù shēng.
and can't guarantee their child a comfortable, stable home, then it's better not to have one.
这么贵，还不如自己做。
Zhème guì, hái bùrú zìjǐ zuò.
It's so expensive, you might as well make it yourself.
越来越多的 + N
more and more …
越来越 + adjective means something keeps increasing.
也有越来越多的夫妻加入了丁克一族。
yě yǒu yuèláiyuè duō de fūqī jiārù le dīngkè yì zú.
and more and more couples are joining the DINKs.
越来越多的人喜欢在网上买东西。
Yuèláiyuè duō de rén xǐhuan zài wǎng shang mǎi dōngxi.
More and more people like shopping online.
害怕 + clause
to be afraid that …
害怕 can take a whole clause as its object.
害怕自己的孩子将来会太辛苦，承受不住竞争的压力。
hàipà zìjǐ de háizi jiānglái huì tài xīnkǔ, chéngshòu bu zhù jìngzhēng de yālì.
and they're afraid their children will have too hard a time in future and won't be able to bear the pressure of competition.
我害怕他不同意。
Wǒ hàipà tā bùtóng yì.
I'm afraid he won't agree.
gaps: 丁克家庭就是夫妻不愿意生孩子的
以前这个群体会被别人
因为他们与中国人传宗接代的传统观念
这种家庭已经开始被人们理解和
其次，还有一部分人不愿意让孩子
给孩子一个舒适稳定的生活环境
害怕自己的孩子将来会太辛苦，承受不住
say: A DINK family is one where the couple doesn't want to have children.
So why don't DINKs want children?
and only life as a couple is free: the two of them can go wherever they like and live more comfortably.
Third, some think having a child costs a lot and is too heavy a financial burden.
and they're afraid their children will have too hard a time in future and won't be able to bear the pressure of competition.

010.title: Why don't you want a child?
010.sub: Wu Danhong and Sun Xingxing talk on the way home, in two parts
010.transcriptNote: 孙 is Sun Xingxing, who is single, and 吴 is Wu Danhong, who has been DINK for five years. The answers to the questions are my own summaries. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context. 纯属做梦 (just a pipe dream) is my best reading of a phrase both models struggled with.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
吴丹红是丁克一族，结婚五年了，一直都不想生小孩儿。
Wú Dānhóng shì dīngkè yì zú, jié hūn wǔ nián le, yìzhí dōu bù xiǎng shēng xiǎoháir.
Wu Danhong is DINK. She's been married for five years and has never wanted a child.
有一天，她去好朋友刘思家给刘思四岁的儿子小小过生日。
Yǒu yì tiān, tā qù hǎo péngyou Liú Sī jiā gěi Liú Sī sì suì de érzi Xiǎoxiǎo guò shēngrì.
One day she went to her good friend Liu Si's home for the fourth birthday of Liu Si's son, Xiaoxiao.
聚会结束后，吴丹红和一直单身的孙星星一起坐车回家，两个人聊了起来。
Jùhuì jiéshù hòu, Wú Dānhóng hé yìzhí dānshēn de Sūn Xīngxing yìqǐ zuò chē huí jiā, liǎng ge rén liáo le qǐlái.
After the party, Wu Danhong rode home with Sun Xingxing, who has always been single, and the two of them got talking.

blocks.label: 问题一
blocks.h: 第一部分的问题 · Questions on part 1
lines: 请听他们谈话的第一部分，然后回答下面的问题。
Qǐng tīng tāmen tánhuà de dì-yī bùfen, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to the first part of their conversation, then answer the questions below.

q: 吴丹红为什么不想生小孩？
Wú Dānhóng wèishénme bù xiǎng shēng xiǎohái?
Why doesn't Wu Danhong want a child?
ans: 他们现在的生活很舒适，两个人都有自己的事业和爱好，也习惯了没孩子的安静生活。
Tāmen xiànzài de shēnghuó hěn shūshì, liǎng ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de shìyè hé àihào, yě xíguàn le méi háizi de ānjìng shēnghuó.
Their life now is comfortable, they both have their own careers and hobbies, and they're used to a quiet life without children.

q: 吴丹红遇到了哪些方面的压力？为什么有这样的压力？
Wú Dānhóng yùdào le nǎxiē fāngmiàn de yālì? Wèishénme yǒu zhèyàng de yālì?
What pressure has Wu Danhong faced? Why?
ans: 家里老人的压力。她老公是爷爷唯一的孙子，老人等着他们传宗接代。
Jiā li lǎorén de yālì. Tā lǎogōng shì yéye wéiyī de sūnzi, lǎorén děngzhe tāmen chuánzōng-jiēdài.
Pressure from the older generation. Her husband is his grandfather's only grandson, so the family is waiting for them to carry on the line.

blocks.label: 对话一
lines: 第一部分。
Dì-yī bùfen.
Part 1.
今天的聚会还挺不错的。
Jīntiān de jùhuì hái tǐng búcuò de.
Today's party was really nice.
孙
你看刘思的儿子多了不起呀，英文歌唱得多好！
Nǐ kàn Liú Sī de érzi duō liǎobuqǐ ya, Yīngwén gē chàng de duō hǎo!
Look how amazing Liu Si's son is. He sings English songs so well!
孙
是挺棒的。看来刘思也没白辛苦。
Shì tǐng bàng de. Kànlái Liú Sī yě méi bái xīnkǔ.
He's great. Looks like all Liu Si's hard work paid off.
吴
诶，丹红，说真的，你为什么不想要小孩？
Éi, Dānhóng, shuō zhēn de, nǐ wèishénme bù xiǎng yào xiǎohái?
Hey, Danhong, seriously, why don't you want a child?
孙
我们现在的生活很舒适，生活质量算是高的了。
Wǒmen xiànzài de shēnghuó hěn shūshì, shēnghuó zhìliàng suànshì gāo de le.
Our life now is comfortable. Our quality of life is pretty high.
吴
而且我们两个都有自己的事业和爱好，
Érqiě wǒmen liǎng ge dōu yǒu zìjǐ de shìyè hé àihào,
And we both have our own careers and hobbies,
吴
也习惯了没孩子的安静生活，真的没有什么不好的。
yě xíguàn le méi háizi de ānjìng shēnghuó, zhēn de méiyǒu shénme bù hǎo de.
and we're used to a quiet life without children. Honestly, there's nothing wrong with it.
吴
你们的父母没有给过你们压力吗？
Nǐmen de fùmǔ méiyǒu gěi guo nǐmen yālì ma?
Haven't your parents put pressure on you?
孙
当然给过了。你知道我老公是他爷爷唯一的孙子，等着我们传宗接代呢。
Dāngrán gěi guo le. Nǐ zhīdao wǒ lǎogōng shì tā yéye wéiyī de sūnzi, děngzhe wǒmen chuánzōng-jiēdài ne.
Of course they have. You know my husband is his grandfather's only grandson. They're waiting for us to carry on the family line.
吴
所以开始的时候，家里的老人都觉得我自私，
Suǒyǐ kāishǐ de shíhou, jiā li de lǎorén dōu juéde wǒ zìsī,
So at first the older people in the family all thought I was selfish.
吴
连我爸妈都为这事儿和我不高兴，觉得特丢脸，特抬不起头。
lián wǒ bà mā dōu wèi zhè shìr hé wǒ bù gāoxìng, juéde tè diū liǎn, tè tái bu qǐ tóu.
Even my own parents were upset with me about it. They felt really ashamed and couldn't hold their heads up.
吴
还说，如果我不生小孩，我婆婆一定会让我老公和我离婚。
Hái shuō, rúguǒ wǒ bù shēng xiǎohái, wǒ pópo yídìng huì ràng wǒ lǎogōng hé wǒ líhūn.
They even said that if I didn't have a child, my mother-in-law would make my husband divorce me.
吴
那个时候我们压力非常大，我每天都很烦。
Nàge shíhou wǒmen yālì fēicháng dà, wǒ měitiān dōu hěn fán.
We were under huge pressure then. I was fed up every single day.
吴
现在呢，我们结婚已经五年了，他们早已经说破了嘴皮，拿我们没办法了。
Xiànzài ne, wǒmen jié hūn yǐjīng wǔ nián le, tāmen zǎo yǐjīng shuōpò le zuǐpí, ná wǒmen méi bànfǎ le.
Now we've been married five years. They've talked till they're blue in the face and there's nothing more they can do with us.
吴

blocks.label: 问题二
blocks.h: 第二部分的问题 · Questions on part 2
lines: 请听他们谈话的第二部分，然后回答下面的问题。
Qǐng tīng tāmen tánhuà de dì-èr bùfen, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to the second part of their conversation, then answer the questions below.

q: 吴丹红将来有什么打算？
Wú Dānhóng jiānglái yǒu shénme dǎsuan?
What are Wu Danhong's plans for the future?
ans: 她打算继续丁克下去，不打算靠孩子养老。
Tā dǎsuan jìxù dīngkè xiaqu, bù dǎsuan kào háizi yǎnglǎo.
She plans to stay DINK and won't rely on children in her old age.

q: 他们怎么评论养儿防老这个传统观念？
Tāmen zěnme pínglùn yǎng ér fáng lǎo zhège chuántǒng guānniàn?
What do they say about the traditional idea of raising children to look after you in old age?
ans: 他们觉得已经谈不上养儿防老了：有孩子的老人也一样孤独，也被送进养老院；孩子忙自己的事业，还要靠父母。
Tāmen juéde yǐjīng tán bu shàng yǎng ér fáng lǎo le: yǒu háizi de lǎorén yě yíyàng gūdú, yě bèi sòngjìn yǎnglǎoyuàn; háizi máng zìjǐ de shìyè, hái yào kào fùmǔ.
They think it no longer works: old people with children are just as lonely and also end up in homes, and children are busy with their careers and still depend on their parents.

q: What does Wu Danhong say about Xiaoxiao?
ans: 她觉得小小很棒，可是刘思为了这个孩子付出了很多。
Tā juéde Xiǎoxiǎo hěn bàng, kěshì Liú Sī wèile zhège háizi fùchū le hěn duō.
She thinks Xiaoxiao is great, but Liu Si has given up a lot for this child.

blocks.label: 对话二
lines: 第二部分。
Dì-èr bùfen.
Part 2.
那你打算继续丁下去吗？到老了不会觉得孤独吗？不会后悔吗？
Nà nǐ dǎsuan jìxù dīng xiaqu ma? Dào lǎo le bú huì juéde gūdú ma? Bú huì hòuhuǐ ma?
So are you going to stay DINK? Won't you feel lonely when you're old? Won't you regret it?
孙
现在社会上那么多空巢老人、孤独老人，
Xiànzài shèhuì shang nàme duō kōngcháo lǎorén, gūdú lǎorén,
There are so many empty-nesters and lonely old people around these days,
吴
他们可都生了不止一个孩子呢。
tāmen kě dōu shēng le bùzhǐ yí ge háizi ne.
and every one of them had more than one child.
吴
老了还不是一样被送进养老院，还谈什么养儿防老呀？
Lǎo le hái bú shì yíyàng bèi sòngjìn yǎnglǎoyuàn, hái tán shénme yǎng ér fáng lǎo ya?
They still end up in old people's homes when they're old. So what's all this about raising children for your old age?
吴
可不是嘛！现在的孩子，
Kě bú shì ma! Xiànzài de háizi,
Exactly! Kids these days,
孙
不让你拿退休金给他养媳妇儿、养孙子就不错了。
bú ràng nǐ ná tuìxiūjīn gěi tā yǎng xífur, yǎng sūnzi jiù búcuò le.
if they don't make you spend your pension on their wife and kids, you're doing well.
孙
老了还想靠孩子，纯属做梦。
Lǎo le hái xiǎng kào háizi, chúnshǔ zuò mèng.
Counting on your children in old age is just a pipe dream.
孙
再说了，孩子都忙着自己的事业，谁顾得上天天守在父母身边？
Zàishuō le, háizi dōu mángzhe zìjǐ de shìyè, shéi gù de shàng tiāntiān shǒu zài fùmǔ shēnbiān?
Besides, children are all busy with their own careers. Who has time to be by their parents' side every day?
吴
不过你看刘思，现在也很幸福呀。
Búguò nǐ kàn Liú Sī, xiànzài yě hěn xìngfú ya.
Still, look at Liu Si. She's very happy now.
孙
人家付出也大呀。你知道吗？为了这个孩子，
Rénjia fùchū yě dà ya. Nǐ zhīdao ma? Wèile zhège háizi,
She's given up a lot too. Did you know? For this child,
吴
刘思曾经放弃了去美国学习的机会。
Liú Sī céngjīng fàngqì le qù Měiguó xuéxí de jīhuì.
Liu Si once gave up a chance to study in America.
吴
而且为了能让儿子进到最好的幼儿园，她和老公搬了好几回家呢。
Érqiě wèile néng ràng érzi jìndào zuì hǎo de yòu'éryuán, tā hé lǎogōng bān le hǎo jǐ huí jiā ne.
And to get her son into the best kindergarten, she and her husband moved house several times.
吴

vocab: to carry on the family line
to talk till one is blue in the face
raising children for one's old age
to put in, to give up
grammar: 没白 + V
not … for nothing
白 means "in vain". 没白辛苦 says the effort paid off.
是挺棒的。看来刘思也没白辛苦。
Shì tǐng bàng de. Kànlái Liú Sī yě méi bái xīnkǔ.
He's great. Looks like all Liu Si's hard work paid off.
这次考得不错，没白努力。
Zhè cì kǎo de búcuò, méi bái nǔlì.
The exam went well. The hard work wasn't for nothing.
算是……的了
can be counted as …
算是 gives a modest judgement: on the whole, it qualifies.
我们现在的生活很舒适，生活质量算是高的了。
Wǒmen xiànzài de shēnghuó hěn shūshì, shēnghuó zhìliàng suànshì gāo de le.
Our life now is comfortable. Our quality of life is pretty high.
他的汉语在我们班算是好的了。
Tā de Hànyǔ zài wǒmen bān suànshì hǎo de le.
His Chinese counts as good in our class.
even …
连 points to the most surprising case, and 都 follows.
连我爸妈都为这事儿和我不高兴，觉得特丢脸，特抬不起头。
lián wǒ bà mā dōu wèi zhè shìr hé wǒ bù gāoxìng, juéde tè diū liǎn, tè tái bu qǐ tóu.
Even my own parents were upset with me about it. They felt really ashamed and couldn't hold their heads up.
这个问题连老师都不知道。
Zhège wèntí lián lǎoshī dōu bù zhīdao.
Even the teacher doesn't know the answer to this.
拿 + person + 没办法
can't do anything with someone
拿 introduces the person you can't manage.
现在呢，我们结婚已经五年了，他们早已经说破了嘴皮，拿我们没办法了。
Xiànzài ne, wǒmen jié hūn yǐjīng wǔ nián le, tāmen zǎo yǐjīng shuōpò le zuǐpí, ná wǒmen méi bànfǎ le.
Now we've been married five years. They've talked till they're blue in the face and there's nothing more they can do with us.
这孩子太调皮了，妈妈拿他没办法。
Zhè háizi tài tiáopí le, māma ná tā méi bànfǎ.
This child is so naughty that his mum can't do a thing with him.
还不是一样……
it's still the same … anyway
A rhetorical question: things turn out the same in the end.
老了还不是一样被送进养老院，还谈什么养儿防老呀？
Lǎo le hái bú shì yíyàng bèi sòngjìn yǎnglǎoyuàn, hái tán shénme yǎng ér fáng lǎo ya?
They still end up in old people's homes when they're old. So what's all this about raising children for your old age?
你现在不学，以后还不是一样要学？
Nǐ xiànzài bù xué, yǐhòu hái bú shì yíyàng yào xué?
If you don't learn it now, won't you still have to learn it later?
还谈什么……
what's the point of talking about …
还谈什么 dismisses an idea as no longer relevant.
老了还不是一样被送进养老院，还谈什么养儿防老呀？
Lǎo le hái bú shì yíyàng bèi sòngjìn yǎnglǎoyuàn, hái tán shénme yǎng ér fáng lǎo ya?
They still end up in old people's homes when they're old. So what's all this about raising children for your old age?
连饭都吃不上，还谈什么旅游？
Lián fàn dōu chī bu shàng, hái tán shénme lǚyóu?
You can't even afford to eat. What's the point of talking about travel?
……就不错了
it's good enough if …
就不错了 sets a low bar: just this much is already fine.
不让你拿退休金给他养媳妇儿、养孙子就不错了。
bú ràng nǐ ná tuìxiūjīn gěi tā yǎng xífur, yǎng sūnzi jiù búcuò le.
if they don't make you spend your pension on their wife and kids, you're doing well.
他能来就不错了。
Tā néng lái jiù búcuò le.
It's good enough that he can come at all.
gaps: 的孙星星一起坐车回家
你知道我老公是他爷爷
他们早已经说破了嘴皮，
给他养媳妇儿、养孙子就不错了。
放弃了去美国学习的机会。

Our life now is comfortable. Our quality of life is pretty high.
Haven't your parents put pressure on you?
They still end up in old people's homes when they're old. So what's all this about raising children for your old age?
Besides, children are all busy with their own careers. Who has time to be by their parents' side every day?

011.title: My DINK colleague
011.sub: An unscripted interview about a DINK couple and their two dogs
011.transcriptNote: 记 is the reporter and 娟 is Xiaojuan. This is natural speech, with false starts and fillers such as 呃 and 嗯 left out of the transcript. The instructions call the speaker 小军, but the reporter seems to say 小娟; both are written as heard. The answer is my own summary.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the question.
小军在和记者谈他的一个丁克同事。
Xiǎo Jūn zài hé jìzhě tán tā de yí ge dīngkè tóngshì.
Xiaojun is talking to a reporter about a DINK colleague.

q: 请你介绍这个同事的生活情况。
Qǐng nǐ jièshào zhège tóngshì de shēnghuó qíngkuàng.
ans: 他和妻子都主张丁克，没有孩子，家里养了两条狗。他们过得很滋润：下班累了可以去洗脚店，周末活动很多，很丰富。他们管狗叫宝宝。
Tā hé qīzi dōu zhǔzhāng dīngkè, méiyǒu háizi, jiā li yǎng le liǎng tiáo gǒu. Tāmen guò de hěn zīrùn: xià bān lèi le kěyǐ qù xǐjiǎodiàn, zhōumò huódòng hěn duō, hěn fēngfù. Tāmen guǎn gǒu jiào bǎobao.

He and his wife both believe in being DINK and have no children, but they keep two dogs. They live very well: when they're tired after work they go for a foot massage, and their weekends are full of activities. They call the dogs their babies.

blocks.label: 采访
lines: 小娟，你周围有没有丁克的朋友呢？
Xiǎo Juān, nǐ zhōuwéi yǒu méiyǒu dīngkè de péngyou ne?
Xiaojuan, do you know anyone who's DINK?
记
啊，我周围有。就是我原来在北京工作的时候，有同事是丁克家庭，是一位男同事。
A, wǒ zhōuwéi yǒu. Jiùshì wǒ yuánlái zài Běijīng gōngzuò de shíhou, yǒu tóngshì shì dīngkè jiātíng, shì yí wèi nán tóngshì.
Yes, I do. When I used to work in Beijing, a colleague of mine had a DINK family. It was a man.
娟
然后他的妻子呢，也是那个主张丁克的，所以他们两个就决定不要孩子。
Ránhòu tā de qīzi ne, yě shì nàge zhǔzhāng dīngkè de, suǒyǐ tāmen liǎng ge jiù juédìng bú yào háizi.
And his wife was also in favour of being DINK, so the two of them decided not to have children.
娟
但他们家里呢，是养两条狗。
Dàn tāmen jiā li ne, shì yǎng liǎng tiáo gǒu.
But they keep two dogs at home.
娟
然后我跟他们关系很好，所以有时候周末去他们家玩，你就发现他们过得特别滋润。
Ránhòu wǒ gēn tāmen guānxi hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ yǒushíhou zhōumò qù tāmen jiā wán, nǐ jiù fāxiàn tāmen guò de tèbié zīrùn.
I got on really well with them, so sometimes I'd visit them at the weekend, and you could see they had a really good life.
娟
就他们下班以后，有时候累啦，回家去，
Jiù tāmen xià bān yǐhòu, yǒushíhou lèi la, huí jiā qù,
Like, after work, when they were tired, they'd go home,
娟
那种……中国有很多那种洗脚店啊什么的，他们去那个，也不用管孩子。
nà zhǒng…… Zhōngguó yǒu hěn duō nà zhǒng xǐjiǎodiàn a shénme de, tāmen qù nàge, yě búyòng guǎn háizi.
or … China has lots of those foot-massage places and so on. They'd go to one of those, and they didn't have kids to worry about.
娟
然后周末就活动很多，很丰富。
Ránhòu zhōumò jiù huódòng hěn duō, hěn fēngfù.
And at weekends they did lots of things. Their life was very full.
娟
啊，他们管狗是不是叫孩子呀？
A, tāmen guǎn gǒu shì bu shì jiào háizi ya?
Ah, do they call the dogs their kids?
记
叫。对，他们叫宝宝。
Jiào. Duì, tāmen jiào bǎobao.
They do. Yes, they call them "baby".
娟
那狗……让狗管他们叫爸爸妈妈，是这个意思吗？
Nà gǒu…… ràng gǒu guǎn tāmen jiào bàba māma, shì zhège yìsi ma?
And the dogs … they have the dogs call them Mum and Dad, is that it?
记
是的，是的。
Shì de, shì de.
Yes, exactly.
娟

vocab: to advocate, to be in favour of
measure word for dogs, fish, etc.
to look after; (管 A 叫 B) to call A B
grammar: 周围有没有……？
is there … around you?
有没有 makes a yes/no question. 周围 means the people around you.
小娟，你周围有没有丁克的朋友呢？
Xiǎo Juān, nǐ zhōuwéi yǒu méiyǒu dīngkè de péngyou ne?
Xiaojuan, do you know anyone who's DINK?
你周围有没有会说法语的人？
Nǐ zhōuwéi yǒu méiyǒu huì shuō Fǎyǔ de rén?
Do you know anyone who speaks French?
主张 + idea
to advocate, to be in favour of
主张 takes an idea or a way of doing things as its object.
然后他的妻子呢，也是那个主张丁克的，所以他们两个就决定不要孩子。
Ránhòu tā de qīzi ne, yě shì nàge zhǔzhāng dīngkè de, suǒyǐ tāmen liǎng ge jiù juédìng bú yào háizi.
And his wife was also in favour of being DINK, so the two of them decided not to have children.
他主张孩子应该多运动。
Tā zhǔzhāng háizi yīnggāi duō yùndòng.
He believes children should get more exercise.
过得 + 很/特别 + adj
to live a … life
过 + 得 + adjective describes how someone's life is going.
然后我跟他们关系很好，所以有时候周末去他们家玩，你就发现他们过得特别滋润。
Ránhòu wǒ gēn tāmen guānxi hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ yǒushíhou zhōumò qù tāmen jiā wán, nǐ jiù fāxiàn tāmen guò de tèbié zīrùn.
I got on really well with them, so sometimes I'd visit them at the weekend, and you could see they had a really good life.
退休以后，他们过得很开心。
Tuìxiū yǐhòu, tāmen guò de hěn kāixīn.
They've been very happy since they retired.
不用 + V
don't have to …
不用 means there's no need. It's the negative of 要 or 得 (děi).
那种……中国有很多那种洗脚店啊什么的，他们去那个，也不用管孩子。
nà zhǒng…… Zhōngguó yǒu hěn duō nà zhǒng xǐjiǎodiàn a shénme de, tāmen qù nàge, yě búyòng guǎn háizi.
or … China has lots of those foot-massage places and so on. They'd go to one of those, and they didn't have kids to worry about.
明天是周末，不用上班。
Míngtiān shì zhōumò, búyòng shàng bān.
Tomorrow's the weekend, so there's no need to go to work.
管 A 叫 B
to call A B
A spoken pattern for naming someone or something.
啊，他们管狗是不是叫孩子呀？
A, tāmen guǎn gǒu shì bu shì jiào háizi ya?
Ah, do they call the dogs their kids?
我们管他叫老王。
Wǒmen guǎn tā jiào Lǎo Wáng.
We call him Lao Wang.

然后他的妻子呢，也是那个
你就发现他们过得特别
然后周末就活动很多，很

I got on really well with them, so sometimes I'd visit them at the weekend, and you could see they had a really good life.
And at weekends they did lots of things. Their life was very full.
Ah, do they call the dogs their kids?
They do. Yes, they call them "baby".

012.title: Traditional family values?
012.sub: Five views: in line with tradition or not?
012.transcriptNote: Decide whether each view fits traditional Chinese ideas about the family, then turn on Answers. The reasons are my own. Item 1 isn't numbered aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
判断所听到的观点是否符合中国传统的家庭观念。
Pànduàn suǒ tīngdào de guāndiǎn shìfǒu fúhé Zhōngguó chuántǒng de jiātíng guānniàn.
Decide whether each view you hear fits traditional Chinese family values.
结了婚以后，就该开始准备生孩子了，这是为了传宗接代，养儿防老。
Jié le hūn yǐhòu, jiù gāi kāishǐ zhǔnbèi shēng háizi le, zhè shì wèile chuánzōng-jiēdài, yǎng ér fáng lǎo.
Once you're married, you should start preparing to have a baby. That's how you carry on the family line and make sure you're looked after in old age.

qs.why: Carrying on the line and raising children for old age are both traditional ideas.

lines: 为了给孩子一个舒适稳定的生活，家长们愿意放弃很多自己喜欢的东西。
Wèile gěi háizi yí ge shūshì wěndìng de shēnghuó, jiāzhǎng men yuànyì fàngqì hěn duō zìjǐ xǐhuan de dōngxi.
To give their children a comfortable, stable life, parents are willing to give up many things they love.

qs.why: Parents sacrificing for their children is a traditional value.

lines: 人老了应该去养老院，不该给儿女太多的负担。
Rén lǎo le yīnggāi qù yǎnglǎoyuàn, bù gāi gěi érnǚ tài duō de fùdān.
When people get old they should go into an old people's home and not be too much of a burden on their children.

qs.why: Traditionally, children look after their parents at home. An old people's home is the modern view.

lines: 儿子和儿媳妇儿决定当丁克，婆婆会觉得他们很自私。
Érzi hé érxífur juédìng dāng dīngkè, pópo huì juéde tāmen hěn zìsī.
When a son and daughter-in-law decide to be DINK, the mother-in-law will think they're very selfish.

qs.why: Seeing DINKs as selfish comes from the traditional view.

lines: 想不想生小孩是自己的事情，和老人的想法没有关系。
Xiǎng bù xiǎng shēng xiǎohái shì zìjǐ de shìqing, hé lǎorén de xiǎngfǎ méiyǒu guānxi.
Whether to have children is your own business. It has nothing to do with what the older generation thinks.

qs.why: This is a modern view. Traditionally the older generation has a big say.

vocab: to carry on the family line
raising children for one's old age
grammar: V + 了 + O + 以后，就……
once …, then …
The first action finishes, and 就 shows what follows straight after.
结了婚以后，就该开始准备生孩子了，这是为了传宗接代，养儿防老。
Jié le hūn yǐhòu, jiù gāi kāishǐ zhǔnbèi shēng háizi le, zhè shì wèile chuánzōng-jiēdài, yǎng ér fáng lǎo.
Once you're married, you should start preparing to have a baby. That's how you carry on the family line and make sure you're looked after in old age.
下了课以后，我就去图书馆。
Xià le kè yǐhòu, wǒ jiù qù túshūguǎn.
After class I go straight to the library.
应该……，不该……
should …, shouldn't …
应该 and 该 give advice. 不该 is the negative.
人老了应该去养老院，不该给儿女太多的负担。
Rén lǎo le yīnggāi qù yǎnglǎoyuàn, bù gāi gěi érnǚ tài duō de fùdān.
When people get old they should go into an old people's home and not be too much of a burden on their children.
你应该多休息，不该天天加班。
Nǐ yīnggāi duō xiūxi, bù gāi tiāntiān jiā bān.
You should rest more, not work overtime every day.
想不想 + V
whether or not to …
The yes/no question form 想不想 acts as a noun phrase: whether one wants to.
想不想生小孩是自己的事情，和老人的想法没有关系。
Xiǎng bù xiǎng shēng xiǎohái shì zìjǐ de shìqing, hé lǎorén de xiǎngfǎ méiyǒu guānxi.
Whether to have children is your own business. It has nothing to do with what the older generation thinks.
去不去是你自己的事。
Qù bú qù shì nǐ zìjǐ de shì.
Whether you go or not is up to you.
和……没有关系
has nothing to do with …
和 + something + 没有关系 says two things aren't connected.
想不想生小孩是自己的事情，和老人的想法没有关系。
Xiǎng bù xiǎng shēng xiǎohái shì zìjǐ de shìqing, hé lǎorén de xiǎngfǎ méiyǒu guānxi.
Whether to have children is your own business. It has nothing to do with what the older generation thinks.
这件事和我没有关系。
Zhè jiàn shì hé wǒ méiyǒu guānxi.
This has nothing to do with me.
gaps: 结了婚以后，就该开始准备生孩子了，这是为了
儿子和儿媳妇儿决定当丁克，婆婆会觉得他们很
想不想生小孩是自己的事情，和老人的想法没有
say: Once you're married, you should start preparing to have a baby. That's how you carry on the family line and make sure you're looked after in old age.
To give their children a comfortable, stable life, parents are willing to give up many things they love.
When people get old they should go into an old people's home and not be too much of a burden on their children.
When a son and daughter-in-law decide to be DINK, the mother-in-law will think they're very selfish.
Whether to have children is your own business. It has nothing to do with what the older generation thinks.

013.title: Two views on being DINK
013.sub: A woman who has stayed DINK, and a critic
013.transcriptNote: Two speakers give their views on being DINK, one from her own experience. Decide each speaker's attitude, then turn on Answers. The instructions warn that a few words are new, such as the saying 不孝有三，无后为大 ("of the three unfilial acts, having no heir is the worst").

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断说话人的意思 · What does the speaker think?
lines: 判断说话人的意思。
Pànduàn shuōhuàrén de yìsi.
Work out what the speakers mean.
两个人在讲对丁克的看法，或者自己的亲身经历。你觉得他们的态度是什么？
Liǎng ge rén zài jiǎng duì dīngkè de kànfǎ, huòzhě zìjǐ de qīnshēn jīnglì. Nǐ juéde tāmen de tàidu shì shénme?
Two people talk about their views on being DINK, or their own experience of it. What do you think their attitudes are?
你将会听到一些生词，但是它们不影响对主要意思的理解。
Nǐ jiāng huì tīngdào yìxiē shēngcí, dànshì tāmen bù yǐngxiǎng duì zhǔyào yìsi de lǐjiě.
You'll hear some new words, but they won't stop you understanding the main idea.
我们中国人不是总说“不孝有三，无后为大”吗？那我也算是不孝的。
Wǒmen Zhōngguórén bú shì zǒng shuō "bú xiào yǒu sān, wú hòu wéi dà" ma? Nà wǒ yě suànshì búxiào de.
Don't we Chinese always say "Of the three unfilial acts, having no heir is the worst"? Then I suppose I count as unfilial.
结婚五年，坚持不想要孩子，我妈妈和婆婆已经拿我没办法了。
Jié hūn wǔ nián, jiānchí bù xiǎng yào háizi, wǒ māma hé pópo yǐjīng ná wǒ méi bànfǎ le.
Five years married and I still insist on not having children. My mother and mother-in-law have given up on me.
记得我刚结婚时，我妈妈就把小孩的被子做好了，一直放到现在。
Jìde wǒ gāng jié hūn shí, wǒ māma jiù bǎ xiǎohái de bèizi zuò hǎo le, yìzhí fàng dào xiànzài.
I remember that when I'd just got married, my mother made a baby quilt, and she's kept it to this day.
现在我也决定丁克到底了。
Xiànzài wǒ yě juédìng dīngkè dàodǐ le.
Now I've decided to stay DINK for good.
我已经为别人活了二十几年，我要为自己而活。
Wǒ yǐjīng wèi biérén huó le èrshí jǐ nián, wǒ yào wèi zìjǐ ér huó.
I've lived for other people for more than twenty years. I want to live for myself.
我可不想老的时候叹息，自己的一生是为别人而活的。
Wǒ kě bù xiǎng lǎo de shíhou tànxī, zìjǐ de yìshēng shì wèi biérén ér huó de.
I really don't want to sigh when I'm old that I lived my whole life for others.
丁克们也许年轻时潇洒，
Dīngkèmen yěxǔ niánqīng shí xiāosǎ,
DINKs may live a carefree life when they're young,
可是，万一将来想要一个孩子，却没有的时候，该怎么去面对这样的遗憾？
kěshì, wànyī jiānglái xiǎng yào yí ge háizi, què méiyǒu de shíhou, gāi zěnme qù miànduì zhèyàng de yíhàn?
but if one day they want a child and don't have one, how will they face that regret?
老了，再看看他们是否后悔。
Lǎo le, zài kànkan tāmen shìfǒu hòuhuǐ.
Wait till they're old and see whether they regret it.
以后病了，遇到困难了，老无所依，没人陪伴，
Yǐhòu bìng le, yùdào kùnnan le, lǎo wú suǒ yī, méi rén péibàn,
Later on, when they're ill or in trouble, with nobody to rely on and no one to keep them company in old age,
给你养老是很凄惨的。
gěi nǐ yǎnglǎo shì hěn qīcǎn de.
it's a miserable way to grow old.

vocab: bú xiào yǒu sān, wú hòu wéi dà
of the three unfilial acts, having no heir is the worst
unfilial, not dutiful to one's parents
in case, if by any chance
to have no one to rely on in old age
grammar: 不是……吗？
isn't it true that …?
A rhetorical question that reminds the listener of something everyone knows.
我们中国人不是总说“不孝有三，无后为大”吗？那我也算是不孝的。
Wǒmen Zhōngguórén bú shì zǒng shuō "bú xiào yǒu sān, wú hòu wéi dà" ma? Nà wǒ yě suànshì búxiào de.
Don't we Chinese always say "Of the three unfilial acts, having no heir is the worst"? Then I suppose I count as unfilial.
你不是说今天要早点回家吗？
Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān yào zǎo diǎn huí jiā ma?
Didn't you say you'd go home early today?
V + 到底
to … to the end
到底 after a verb means carrying on with it all the way.
现在我也决定丁克到底了。
Xiànzài wǒ yě juédìng dīngkè dàodǐ le.
Now I've decided to stay DINK for good.
这件事我一定要做到底。
Zhè jiàn shì wǒ yídìng yào zuò dàodǐ.
I'm going to see this through to the end.
为 + person + 而 + V
to … for someone
为 gives who it's for, and 而 links it to the verb, in a slightly written style.
我已经为别人活了二十几年，我要为自己而活。
Wǒ yǐjīng wèi biérén huó le èrshí jǐ nián, wǒ yào wèi zìjǐ ér huó.
I've lived for other people for more than twenty years. I want to live for myself.
他为家人而努力工作。
Tā wèi jiārén ér nǔlì gōngzuò.
He works hard for his family.
万一……
in case, if by any chance …
万一 introduces an unlikely but unwelcome possibility.

015.transcriptNote: 妈 is the mother and 丽 is her daughter Xiao Li. Listen and copy their tone. 丁什么克 is the mother's dismissive echo of 丁克: "DINK, what DINK?"

lines: 小丽呀，你们结婚都两年多了，怎么还不要孩子呀？
Xiǎo Lì ya, nǐmen jié hūn dōu liǎng nián duō le, zěnme hái bú yào háizi ya?

妈

丽
丁什么克？你们年轻人就是不懂老人的心。

妈

妈

016.title: Come home often
016.sub: The lesson text: Wen Yu on looking after her parents
016.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. Wen Yu, an only child working in Beijing, wonders how she'll look after her ageing parents. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

lines: 常回家看看
Cháng huí jiā kànkan
Come home often
我叫文玉，来自南方一座美丽的小城。
Wǒ jiào Wén Yù, láizì nánfāng yí zuò měilì de xiǎo chéng.
My name is Wen Yu. I come from a pretty little town in the south.
我父亲在市政府工作，母亲是银行职员，
Wǒ fùqin zài shì zhèngfǔ gōngzuò, mǔqin shì yínháng zhíyuán,
My father works for the city government, and my mother works at a bank.
家庭条件在我们家乡算是不错的。
jiātíng tiáojiàn zài wǒmen jiāxiāng suànshì búcuò de.
By the standards of our hometown, my family is quite well off.
我是在北京上的大学。
Wǒ shì zài Běijīng shàng de dàxué.
I went to university in Beijing.
毕业时，父母特别希望我能回到他们身边去。
Bìyè shí, fùmǔ tèbié xīwàng wǒ néng huídào tāmen shēnbiān qù.
When I graduated, my parents really hoped I'd come back to live near them.
在他们的观念里，女孩子找个既稳定又轻松的工作就行了。
Zài tāmen de guānniàn li, nǚháizi zhǎo ge jì wěndìng yòu qīngsōng de gōngzuò jiù xíng le.
In their view, a girl only needs a job that's stable and not too demanding.
北京竞争那么激烈，一个女孩子会很辛苦。
Běijīng jìngzhēng nàme jīliè, yí ge nǚháizi huì hěn xīnkǔ.
Competition in Beijing is so fierce that a girl would have a hard time.
但我的观念跟他们的完全不同。
Dàn wǒ de guānniàn gēn tāmen de wánquán bùtóng.
But my views are completely different from theirs.
我不想放弃留在北京的机会，
Wǒ bù xiǎng fàngqì liú zài Běijīng de jīhuì,
I didn't want to give up the chance to stay in Beijing.
很希望能有自己的事业，有更高的生活质量。
hěn xīwàng néng yǒu zìjǐ de shìyè, yǒu gèng gāo de shēnghuó zhìliàng.
I really wanted a career of my own and a better quality of life.
看到我坚持要留下来，父母后来也不再反对了。
Kàndào wǒ jiānchí yào liú xialai, fùmǔ hòulái yě bú zài fǎnduì le.
When they saw I was set on staying, my parents eventually stopped objecting.
我刚参加工作时，父母还没退休。
Wǒ gāng cānjiā gōngzuò shí, fùmǔ hái méi tuìxiū.
When I first started work, my parents hadn't retired yet.
平时我们各忙各的，晚上或者周末的时候，互相通个电话。
Píngshí wǒmen gè máng gè de, wǎnshang huòzhě zhōumò de shíhou, hùxiāng tōng ge diànhuà.
Normally we were each busy with our own lives and would call each other in the evenings or at weekends.
春节、五一、十一假期，我就回家去陪陪他们。
Chūn Jié, Wǔ-Yī, Shí-Yī jiàqī, wǒ jiù huí jiā qù péipei tāmen.
At Spring Festival and the May Day and National Day holidays I'd go home and spend time with them.
有时候忙起来，放假也顾不上回家。
Yǒushíhou máng qilai, fàng jià yě gù bu shàng huí jiā.
Sometimes, when I got busy, I couldn't go home even in the holidays.
他们退休以后，生活很丰富。
Tāmen tuìxiū yǐhòu, shēnghuó hěn fēngfù.
After they retired, their lives were very full.
除了每天早上和晚上都去公园做运动以外，
Chúle měitiān zǎoshang hé wǎnshang dōu qù gōngyuán zuò yùndòng yǐwài,
Besides exercising in the park every morning and evening,
我爸还喜欢在家里练书法、种花，我妈开始养狗、学电脑。
wǒ bà hái xǐhuan zài jiā li liàn shūfǎ, zhòng huā, wǒ mā kāishǐ yǎng gǒu, xué diànnǎo.
my dad likes to practise calligraphy and grow flowers at home, and my mum started keeping a dog and learning to use the computer.
两人有时也来北京看我。
Liǎng rén yǒushí yě lái Běijīng kàn wǒ.
Sometimes the two of them come to Beijing to visit me.
看到他们退休后的生活安排得这么好，我也就放心了，
Kàndào tāmen tuìxiū hòu de shēnghuó ānpái de zhème hǎo, wǒ yě jiù fàng xīn le,
Seeing how well they've arranged their retired life put my mind at ease,
至少不用担心他们会感到孤独。
zhìshǎo búyòng dānxīn tāmen huì gǎndào gūdú.
at least I don't have to worry about them feeling lonely.
没想到，去年爸爸突然生了一场重病，打破了原来安静的生活。
Méi xiǎngdào, qùnián bàba tūrán shēng le yì cháng zhòngbìng, dǎpò le yuánlái ānjìng de shēnghuó.
Then, unexpectedly, last year my dad suddenly fell seriously ill, which shattered their quiet life.
我请了两周假回去陪他。
Wǒ qǐng le liǎng zhōu jià huíqu péi tā.
I took two weeks off to go back and be with him.
假期结束时，我不得不回到北京继续工作。
Jiàqī jiéshù shí, wǒ bùdébù huídào Běijīng jìxù gōngzuò.
When my leave was over, I had to go back to Beijing to carry on working.
看病的花销很大，幸好他有医疗保险，大部分都可以报销，
Kàn bìng de huāxiao hěn dà, xìnghǎo tā yǒu yīliáo bǎoxiǎn, dà bùfen dōu kěyǐ bàoxiāo,
Medical treatment was very expensive. Luckily he had health insurance, and most of it could be claimed back,
我家才没有背上沉重的经济负担。
wǒ jiā cái méiyǒu bēi shang chénzhòng de jīngjì fùdān.
so my family didn't end up with a heavy financial burden.
从那时起，我才第一次开始考虑怎么给父母养老这个问题。
Cóng nà shí qǐ, wǒ cái dì-yī cì kāishǐ kǎolǜ zěnme gěi fùmǔ yǎnglǎo zhège wèntí.
It was only from then on that I first started thinking about how I'd look after my parents in their old age.
我有个男朋友，我们的感情很稳定，准备今年十一结婚。
Wǒ yǒu ge nánpéngyou, wǒmen de gǎnqíng hěn wěndìng, zhǔnbèi jīnnián Shí-Yī jié hūn.
I have a boyfriend. Our relationship is solid, and we plan to marry this National Day holiday.
他跟我一样是外地人，而且也是家里唯一的孩子。
Tā gēn wǒ yíyàng shì wàidìrén, érqiě yě shì jiā li wéiyī de háizi.
Like me, he's not from Beijing, and he's also an only child.
将来他父母肯定也是要靠他养老的。
Jiānglái tā fùmǔ kěndìng yě shì yào kào tā yǎnglǎo de.
In future his parents will certainly rely on him in their old age too.
我们曾经讨论过这个问题，觉得压力很大。
Wǒmen céngjīng tǎolùn guo zhège wèntí, juéde yālì hěn dà.
We've talked about this, and it feels like a lot of pressure.
两个人一共要养四个老人，将来有了孩子，压力会更大。
Liǎng ge rén yígòng yào yǎng sì ge lǎorén, jiānglái yǒu le háizi, yālì huì gèng dà.
Between the two of us we'll have four old people to support, and once we have a child the pressure will be even greater.
我们商量好了，结婚以后，老人身体还可以的时候，一定要分开住，
Wǒmen shāngliang hǎo le, jié hūn yǐhòu, lǎorén shēntǐ hái kěyǐ de shíhou, yídìng yào fēnkāi zhù,
We've agreed that after we marry, while the old folks are still in reasonable health, we'll definitely live separately,
等他们需要照顾的时候，再跟我们一起住。
děng tāmen xūyào zhàogù de shíhou, zài gēn wǒmen yìqǐ zhù.
and when they need looking after, they'll come and live with us.
说老实话，我有点害怕跟婆婆住。
Shuō lǎoshi huà, wǒ yǒudiǎn hàipà gēn pópo zhù.
To be honest, I'm a bit scared of living with my mother-in-law.
听说有不少人就是因为婆媳关系不好而离婚的。
Tīngshuō yǒu bù shǎo rén jiùshì yīnwèi pó-xí guānxi bù hǎo ér líhūn de.
I've heard that quite a few people get divorced precisely because of bad relations between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law.
其实，最好的解决办法是在我们家的附近，给双方父母各买一套房子。
Qíshí, zuì hǎo de jiějué bànfǎ shì zài wǒmen jiā de fùjìn, gěi shuāngfāng fùmǔ gè mǎi yí tào fángzi.
Actually, the best solution would be to buy a flat for each set of parents near our home.
可这是在做梦，谁都知道在北京买房太难了。
Kě zhè shì zài zuò mèng, shéi dōu zhīdao zài Běijīng mǎi fáng tài nán le.
But that's a pipe dream. Everyone knows how hard it is to buy property in Beijing.
我父母很理解我。
Wǒ fùmǔ hěn lǐjiě wǒ.
My parents are very understanding.
有一次在电话里聊到养老的问题，
Yǒu yí cì zài diànhuà li liáodào yǎnglǎo de wèntí,
Once, when we got onto the subject of old age on the phone,
妈妈说她跟爸爸从来没有养儿防老的想法，
māma shuō tā gēn bàba cónglái méiyǒu yǎng ér fáng lǎo de xiǎngfǎ,
my mum said she and my dad had never thought of raising a child to look after them in old age.
老了以后就去养老院，不给孩子增加负担。
lǎo le yǐhòu jiù qù yǎnglǎoyuàn, bù gěi háizi zēngjiā fùdān.
When they're old they'll go into a home, so as not to be a burden on their child.
我听了以后觉得很难受。
Wǒ tīng le yǐhòu juéde hěn nánshòu.
I felt awful when I heard that.
父母为我付出了很多，牺牲了他们自己的生活，
Fùmǔ wèi wǒ fùchū le hěn duō, xīshēng le tāmen zìjǐ de shēnghuó,
My parents gave so much for me and sacrificed their own lives,
好不容易把我养大了，
hǎobù róngyì bǎ wǒ yǎngdà le,
and it wasn't easy for them to bring me up.
如果让他们晚年住养老院，那我不是太自私了吗？
rúguǒ ràng tāmen wǎnnián zhù yǎnglǎoyuàn, nà wǒ bú shì tài zìsī le ma?
If I let them spend their last years in an old people's home, wouldn't that be terribly selfish of me?
怎么解决给父母养老这个问题呢？
Zěnme jiějué gěi fùmǔ yǎnglǎo zhège wèntí ne?
So how do I solve the problem of caring for my parents in old age?
我直到现在也没有找到满意的答案。
Wǒ zhídào xiànzài yě méiyǒu zhǎodào mǎnyì de dá'àn.
I still haven't found a satisfying answer.
我遇到的这种情况其实很普遍。
Wǒ yùdào de zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng qíshí hěn pǔbiàn.
My situation is actually very common.
跟朋友聚会时，我们常常讨论这个话题。
Gēn péngyou jùhuì shí, wǒmen chángcháng tǎolùn zhège huàtí.
When I get together with friends, we often discuss this topic.
他们当中不少人跟我一样，也是独生子女。
Tāmen dāngzhōng bù shǎo rén gēn wǒ yíyàng, yě shì dúshēng zǐnǚ.
Many of them, like me, are only children.
一方面，因为工作的原因，我们不能常常守在父母身边；
Yì fāngmiàn, yīnwèi gōngzuò de yuányīn, wǒmen bù néng chángcháng shǒu zài fùmǔ shēnbiān;
On the one hand, because of our jobs, we can't often be by our parents' side;
另一方面，把父母接到身边，又有各种困难，
lìng yì fāngmiàn, bǎ fùmǔ jiēdào shēnbiān, yòu yǒu gè zhǒng kùnnan,
on the other hand, bringing our parents to live with us brings all sorts of difficulties,
例如住房紧张、经济压力大、家庭关系不好。
lìrú zhùfáng jǐnzhāng, jīngjì yālì dà, jiātíng guānxi bù hǎo.
such as a lack of space, financial pressure and family friction.
送父母去养老院是一定不行的，
Sòng fùmǔ qù yǎnglǎoyuàn shì yídìng bù xíng de,
Sending my parents to an old people's home is absolutely out of the question.
不是担心别人怎么看我，而是我自己接受不了。
bú shì dānxīn biérén zěnme kàn wǒ, érshì wǒ zìjǐ jiēshòu bu liǎo.
It's not that I'm worried what others will think of me. I just couldn't accept it myself.
左也为难，右也为难。
Zuǒ yě wéinán, yòu yě wéinán.
Whichever way I turn, it's hard.
在这种情况下，漂在外地的我们，只好先走一步看一步。
Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, piāo zài wàidì de wǒmen, zhǐhǎo xiān zǒu yí bù kàn yí bù.
In this situation, those of us drifting far from home can only take things one step at a time.
至少现在能做的，是常回家看看吧。
Zhìshǎo xiànzài néng zuò de, shì cháng huí jiā kànkan ba.
At least what I can do now is come home often.

vocab: each busy with their own things
raising children for one's old age
zǒu yí bù kàn yí bù
to take one step at a time
grammar: 是……的
stressing where, when or how
是……的 highlights a detail of something that already happened. Here it stresses where she went to university.
我是在北京上的大学。
Wǒ shì zài Běijīng shàng de dàxué.
I went to university in Beijing.
我是坐飞机来的北京。
Wǒ shì zuò fēijī lái de Běijīng.
I came to Beijing by plane.
both … and …
既 and 又 go before two adjectives or verbs that are both true.
在他们的观念里，女孩子找个既稳定又轻松的工作就行了。
Zài tāmen de guānniàn li, nǚháizi zhǎo ge jì wěndìng yòu qīngsōng de gōngzuò jiù xíng le.
In their view, a girl only needs a job that's stable and not too demanding.
这个房子既大又便宜。
Zhège fángzi jì dà yòu piányi.
This flat is both big and cheap.
各 + V + 各的
each does their own …
Repeating 各 shows that everyone gets on with their own business.
平时我们各忙各的，晚上或者周末的时候，互相通个电话。
Píngshí wǒmen gè máng gè de, wǎnshang huòzhě zhōumò de shíhou, hùxiāng tōng ge diànhuà.
Normally we were each busy with our own lives and would call each other in the evenings or at weekends.
下课以后，大家各回各的家。
Xià kè yǐhòu, dàjiā gè huí gè de jiā.
After class everyone goes off to their own homes.
除了……以外，还……
besides …, also …
除了……以外 sets one thing aside, and 还 adds more.
除了每天早上和晚上都去公园做运动以外，
Chúle měitiān zǎoshang hé wǎnshang dōu qù gōngyuán zuò yùndòng yǐwài,
Besides exercising in the park every morning and evening,
除了汉语以外，他还会说法语。
Chúle Hànyǔ yǐwài, tā hái huì shuō Fǎyǔ.
Besides Chinese, he also speaks French.
从那时起
from then on
从……起 marks the starting point in time.
从那时起，我才第一次开始考虑怎么给父母养老这个问题。
Cóng nà shí qǐ, wǒ cái dì-yī cì kāishǐ kǎolǜ zěnme gěi fùmǔ yǎnglǎo zhège wèntí.
It was only from then on that I first started thinking about how I'd look after my parents in their old age.
从明天起，我每天跑步。
Cóng míngtiān qǐ, wǒ měitiān pǎo bù.
From tomorrow on, I'm going running every day.
等……的时候，再……
when …, then …
等 + a future moment. 再 says what will happen only then.
等他们需要照顾的时候，再跟我们一起住。
děng tāmen xūyào zhàogù de shíhou, zài gēn wǒmen yìqǐ zhù.
and when they need looking after, they'll come and live with us.
等你毕业的时候，再找工作吧。
Děng nǐ bìyè de shíhou, zài zhǎo gōngzuò ba.
Look for a job when you graduate.
因为……而……
because … (and so) …
A written way to link a cause to its result.
听说有不少人就是因为婆媳关系不好而离婚的。
Tīngshuō yǒu bù shǎo rén jiùshì yīnwèi pó-xí guānxi bù hǎo ér líhūn de.
I've heard that quite a few people get divorced precisely because of bad relations between mother-in-law and daughter-in-law.
他因为生病而没来上课。
Tā yīnwèi shēng bìng ér méi lái shàng kè.
He missed class because he was ill.
不是……，而是……
it's not …, it's …
Rejects one reason and gives the real one.
不是担心别人怎么看我，而是我自己接受不了。
bú shì dānxīn biérén zěnme kàn wǒ, érshì wǒ zìjǐ jiēshòu bu liǎo.
It's not that I'm worried what others will think of me. I just couldn't accept it myself.
不是我不想去，而是没有时间。
Bú shì wǒ bù xiǎng qù, érshì méiyǒu shíjiān.
It's not that I don't want to go. I just don't have time.
一方面……，另一方面……
on the one hand …, on the other hand …
Gives two sides of a situation.
一方面，因为工作的原因，我们不能常常守在父母身边；
Yì fāngmiàn, yīnwèi gōngzuò de yuányīn, wǒmen bù néng chángcháng shǒu zài fùmǔ shēnbiān;
On the one hand, because of our jobs, we can't often be by our parents' side;
一方面我想出国，另一方面又不想离开家。
Yì fāngmiàn wǒ xiǎng chū guó, lìng yì fāngmiàn yòu bù xiǎng líkāi jiā.
On the one hand I want to go abroad, and on the other I don't want to leave home.
gaps: 我父亲在市政府工作，母亲是银行
那么激烈，一个女孩子会很辛苦。
要留下来，父母后来也不再反对了。
平时我们各忙各的，晚上或者周末的时候，
看到他们退休后的生活
得这么好，我也就放心了
幸好他有医疗保险，大部分都可以
讨论过这个问题，觉得压力很大。
办法是在我们家的附近，给双方父母各买一套房子。
我遇到的这种情况其实很
不是担心别人怎么看我，而是我自己
say: I went to university in Beijing.
When they saw I was set on staying, my parents eventually stopped objecting.
Sometimes, when I got busy, I couldn't go home even in the holidays.
We've talked about this, and it feels like a lot of pressure.
To be honest, I'm a bit scared of living with my mother-in-law.
At least what I can do now is come home often.

017.title: A big world and small families
017.sub: Reading B: how Chinese families have changed
017.transcriptNote: The second lesson text, read as a news-style report and split into paragraphs.

lines: 大世界与小家庭
Dà shìjiè yǔ xiǎo jiātíng
A big world and small families
中国人看到的世界越来越大，中国人的家庭却越变越小。
Zhōngguórén kàndào de shìjiè yuèláiyuè dà, Zhōngguórén de jiātíng què yuè biàn yuè xiǎo.
The world Chinese people see keeps getting bigger, but Chinese families keep getting smaller.
中国传统家庭一般至少包括父母和子女两代人，
Zhōngguó chuántǒng jiātíng yìbān zhìshǎo bāokuò fùmǔ hé zǐnǚ liǎng dài rén,
A traditional Chinese family usually includes at least two generations, parents and children,
而且普遍存在三世甚至四世同堂的现象。
érqiě pǔbiàn cúnzài sān shì shènzhì sì shì tóng táng de xiànxiàng.
and three or even four generations living under one roof was common.
然而，自上世纪七八十年代起，随着经济与社会的发展，
Rán'ér, zì shàng shìjì qī-bāshí niándài qǐ, suízhe jīngjì yǔ shèhuì de fāzhǎn,
However, since the 1970s and 80s, as the economy and society developed,
传统的、结构复杂的大家庭，渐渐被结构简单的小家庭所取代。
chuántǒng de, jiégòu fùzá de dà jiātíng, jiànjiàn bèi jiégòu jiǎndān de xiǎo jiātíng suǒ qǔdài.
the traditional large family with its complicated structure has gradually been replaced by the small family with a simple structure.
北京东城区居民孙先生说：
Běijīng Dōngchéng Qū jūmín Sūn xiānsheng shuō:
Mr Sun, a resident of Beijing's Dongcheng District, says:
“我父母都出生在大家庭里，各有四个兄弟姐妹。
"Wǒ fùmǔ dōu chūshēng zài dà jiātíng li, gè yǒu sì ge xiōngdì jiěmèi.
"My parents were both born into big families, and each had four brothers and sisters.
我小时候，还有父母和爷爷奶奶，全家七口人。
Wǒ xiǎoshíhou, hái yǒu fùmǔ hé yéye nǎinai, quán jiā qī kǒu rén.
When I was little, along with my parents there were my grandparents too: seven of us in the family.
我现在就一个孩子，是三口之家。”
Wǒ xiànzài jiù yí ge háizi, shì sān kǒu zhī jiā."
Now I have just one child. We're a family of three."
专家们认为，使中国家庭结构发生变化的原因主要有两个：
Zhuānjiāmen rènwéi, shǐ Zhōngguó jiātíng jiégòu fāshēng biànhuà de yuányīn zhǔyào yǒu liǎng ge:
Experts believe there are two main reasons why the structure of Chinese families has changed:
一是社会流动人口的增加，二是家庭观念的改变。
Yī shì shèhuì liúdòng rénkǒu de zēngjiā, èr shì jiātíng guānniàn de gǎibiàn.
one is the increase in people moving around the country, and the other is the change in ideas about the family.
首先，在市场经济条件下，中国的人口从农村向城市流动，
Shǒuxiān, zài shìchǎng jīngjì tiáojiàn xià, Zhōngguó de rénkǒu cóng nóngcūn xiàng chéngshì liúdòng,
First, under the market economy, people in China have been moving from the countryside to the cities,
去海外的人也不少。
qù hǎiwài de rén yě bù shǎo.
and quite a few have gone abroad too.
结构简单的小家庭，更适合这种流动。
Jiégòu jiǎndān de xiǎo jiātíng, gèng shìhé zhè zhǒng liúdòng.
Small families with a simple structure are better suited to this kind of movement.
人口的流动也带来了新的群体：
Rénkǒu de liúdòng yě dàilái le xīn de qúntǐ:
The movement of people has also created new groups:
漂一代，住在外地并且没有稳定生活的人；
Piāo yí dài, zhù zài wàidì bìngqiě méiyǒu wěndìng shēnghuó de rén;
the "drifting generation", people living away from home without a settled life;
留守儿童，被外出打工的父母留在家乡的孩子；
liúshǒu értóng, bèi wàichū dǎ gōng de fùmǔ liú zài jiāxiāng de háizi;
"left-behind children", children left in their hometowns by parents who've gone away to work;
空巢老人，子女不在身边的老人；
kōngcháo lǎorén, zǐnǚ bú zài shēnbiān de lǎorén;
"empty-nesters", old people whose children don't live nearby;
海归，留学后回国的人，等等。
hǎiguī, liú xué hòu huí guó de rén, děngděng.
"sea turtles", people who come back to China after studying abroad, and so on.
其次，随着社会的发展，选择不婚或者未婚生子的人数增多。
Qícì, suízhe shèhuì de fāzhǎn, xuǎnzé bù hūn huòzhě wèihūn shēng zǐ de rénshù zēngduō.
Second, as society develops, more and more people are choosing not to marry, or to have children without marrying.
虽然单亲家庭跟传统的家庭观念不符，但也渐渐被社会所接受。
Suīrán dānqīn jiātíng gēn chuántǒng de jiātíng guānniàn bù fú, dàn yě jiànjiàn bèi shèhuì suǒ jiēshòu.
Although single-parent families go against traditional ideas about the family, they are gradually being accepted by society.
在大城市，原来只能生一个，现在不少人只想生一个，
Zài dà chéngshì, yuánlái zhǐ néng shēng yí ge, xiànzài bù shǎo rén zhǐ xiǎng shēng yí ge,
In big cities, people used to be allowed only one child. Now many people only want one,
甚至有人一个都不要。
shènzhì yǒu rén yí ge dōu bú yào.
and some don't want any at all.
当然，现在生第二个孩子的情况也很常见。
Dāngrán, xiànzài shēng dì-èr ge háizi de qíngkuàng yě hěn chángjiàn.
Of course, it's also very common now to have a second child.
中国家庭的结构发生了变化，这也带来了一些新的社会问题，
Zhōngguó jiātíng de jiégòu fāshēng le biànhuà, zhè yě dàilái le yìxiē xīn de shèhuì wèntí,
The structure of Chinese families has changed, and this has brought some new social problems too.
老龄化就是其中一个。
lǎolínghuà jiùshì qízhōng yí ge.
An ageing population is one of them.
今天，养老不仅是每个家庭要面对的问题，而且是整个社会都要面对的问题。
Jīntiān, yǎnglǎo bùjǐn shì měi ge jiātíng yào miànduì de wèntí, érqiě shì zhěnggè shèhuì dōu yào miànduì de wèntí.
Today, caring for the elderly isn't just a problem every family has to face. It's a problem the whole of society has to face.

vocab: to have a child without marrying
grammar: 越来越 + adj / 越 + V + 越 + adj
more and more …
越来越 shows steady change. 越变越小 means "the more it changes, the smaller it gets".
中国人看到的世界越来越大，中国人的家庭却越变越小。
Zhōngguórén kàndào de shìjiè yuèláiyuè dà, Zhōngguórén de jiātíng què yuè biàn yuè xiǎo.
The world Chinese people see keeps getting bigger, but Chinese families keep getting smaller.
天气越来越冷了。
Tiānqì yuèláiyuè lěng le.
It's getting colder and colder.
自……起
since …, starting from …
A written form of 从……起, marking a starting point in time.
然而，自上世纪七八十年代起，随着经济与社会的发展，

随着……
along with …, as …
随着 + a change introduces something that changes alongside it.
然而，自上世纪七八十年代起，随着经济与社会的发展，
Rán'ér, zì shàng shìjì qī-bāshí niándài qǐ, suízhe jīngjì yǔ shèhuì de fāzhǎn,

As he gets older, he likes quiet more and more.
被……所 + V
to be …ed by … (written)
所 before the verb makes a 被 passive more formal.
传统的、结构复杂的大家庭，渐渐被结构简单的小家庭所取代。
chuántǒng de, jiégòu fùzá de dà jiātíng, jiànjiàn bèi jiégòu jiǎndān de xiǎo jiātíng suǒ qǔdài.

Zhè zhǒng guānniàn yǐjīng bèi hěn duō rén suǒ jiēshòu.
This idea has been accepted by many people.
使 + O + V
to make … happen, to cause …
使 means "to cause". Here the whole phrase 使……发生变化 describes the reasons.
专家们认为，使中国家庭结构发生变化的原因主要有两个：
Zhuānjiāmen rènwéi, shǐ Zhōngguó jiātíng jiégòu fāshēng biànhuà de yuányīn zhǔyào yǒu liǎng ge:

这件事使他很难过。
Zhè jiàn shì shǐ tā hěn nánguò.
This made him very sad.
一是……，二是……
one is …, the other is …
A neat way to list reasons.
一是社会流动人口的增加，二是家庭观念的改变。
Yī shì shèhuì liúdòng rénkǒu de zēngjiā, èr shì jiātíng guānniàn de gǎibiàn.
one is the increase in people moving around the country, and the other is the change in ideas about the family.

I'm not going for two reasons: one, it's too far; two, it's too expensive.
although …, …
虽然 admits one point, and 但(是) brings in the contrast.
虽然单亲家庭跟传统的家庭观念不符，但也渐渐被社会所接受。

不仅……，而且……

不仅 gives one point, and 而且 adds a bigger one.
今天，养老不仅是每个家庭要面对的问题，而且是整个社会都要面对的问题。
Jīntiān, yǎnglǎo bùjǐn shì měi ge jiātíng yào miànduì de wèntí, érqiě shì zhěnggè shèhuì dōu yào miànduì de wèntí.

他不仅会说汉语，而且会写汉字。

Now I have just one child. We're a family of three."
Small families with a simple structure are better suited to this kind of movement.

为了……而……
for the sake of …

不起 after a verb means you don't have the money (or standing) to do it. 买得起 is the positive.
