Nǐ jiūjìng xiǎng qù nǎr?
Where on earth do you want to go?
gaps: 当房奴虽然辛苦，可是总算有了属于自己的
最近这家商店的很多东西在
第一次领工资，心里有一种说不出来的
say: House prices keep going up, so the "ant tribe" have to squeeze into tiny rooms.
The first thing after payday is, of course, paying the bills. I'm under a lot of pressure.
Lots of things in this shop are on sale lately. It's worth a look.
You've borrowed so much from the bank. When on earth will you pay it all back?
Getting my first pay packet, I had a feeling I can't put into words.

023.title: Do they mean the same?
023.sub: Five pairs of sentences about buying a home
023.transcriptNote: Each item reads sentence A, then sentence B. Decide whether they mean the same thing, then turn on Answers.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断两个句子的意思是否相符 · Same meaning or not?
lines: 听录音，判断两个句子的意思是否相符。
Tīng lùyīn, pànduàn liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu xiāngfú.
Listen and decide whether the two sentences mean the same.
能有一套属于自己的房子，是每个中国老百姓心中的梦想。
Néng yǒu yí tào shǔyú zìjǐ de fángzi, shì měi ge Zhōngguó lǎobǎixìng xīnzhōng de mèngxiǎng.
Having a home of one's own is the dream of every ordinary Chinese person.
A
每个中国人都希望能有一套属于自己的房子。
Měi ge Zhōngguórén dōu xīwàng néng yǒu yí tào shǔyú zìjǐ de fángzi.
Every Chinese person hopes to have a home of their own.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say everyone dreams of owning a home.

lines: 为了这套房子，我好不容易弄来了首付三十五万，剩下的就靠贷款了。
Wèile zhè tào fángzi, wǒ hǎobù róngyì nòng lái le shǒufù sānshí wǔ wàn, shèngxia de jiù kào dàikuǎn le.
For this flat I scraped together a 350,000 down payment, and the rest will be a loan.
A
这套房子不到四十万，可是我还得贷款。
Zhè tào fángzi bú dào sì shí wàn, kěshì wǒ hái de dàikuǎn.
This flat costs less than 400,000, but I still have to take out a loan.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A never gives the price, only the 350,000 down payment.

lines: 买了房不只是买了房，你还得买保险，付各种账单。
Mǎi le fáng bù zhǐshì mǎi le fáng, nǐ hái de mǎi bǎoxiǎn, fù gè zhǒng zhàngdān.
Buying a flat isn't just buying a flat. You also have to buy insurance and pay all sorts of bills.
A
买了房以后，你还会有很大的压力。
Mǎi le fáng yǐhòu, nǐ hái huì yǒu hěn dà de yālì.
After buying a flat you'll be under a lot of pressure.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say buying a home brings more costs and pressure.

lines: 虽然很辛苦，但是一想到我将有自己的房子，还是觉得非常值得的。
Suīrán hěn xīnkǔ, dànshì yì xiǎngdào wǒ jiāng yǒu zìjǐ de fángzi, háishi juéde fēicháng zhíde de.
It's hard, but when I think I'll have a home of my own, it feels well worth it.
A
辛苦一点儿也值得了，至少有了一个自己的窝嘛。
Xīnkǔ yì diǎnr yě zhíde le, zhìshǎo yǒu le yí ge zìjǐ de wō ma.
A bit of hardship is worth it. At least I've got a nest of my own.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say the hardship is worth it for a home.

lines: 我们通过贷款的方式买房子，然后每个月用自己收入的百分之五十或者更高来还贷。
Wǒmen tōngguò dàikuǎn de fāngshì mǎi fáng zi, ránhòu měi ge yuè yòng zìjǐ shōurù de bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí huòzhě gèng gāo lái huán dài.
We buy a home with a loan, then every month use 50% or more of our income to pay it back.
A
如果我们和银行借钱买房子，以后就要每个月从工资中拿出一半或者更多的钱还给银行。
Rúguǒ wǒmen hé yínháng jiè qián mǎi fáng zi, yǐhòu jiù yào měi ge yuè cóng gōngzī zhōng ná chū yíbàn huòzhě gèng duō de qián huán gěi yínháng.
If we borrow from the bank to buy a home, we'll have to give half or more of our wages back to the bank every month.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: 50% of income is half of your wages.

vocab: to get hold of, to scrape together
loan; to take out a loan
grammar: 好不容易 + V
to manage with great difficulty
好不容易 means it was very hard, but it happened.
为了这套房子，我好不容易弄来了首付三十五万，剩下的就靠贷款了。
Wèile zhè tào fángzi, wǒ hǎobù róngyì nòng lái le shǒufù sānshí wǔ wàn, shèngxia de jiù kào dàikuǎn le.
For this flat I scraped together a 350,000 down payment, and the rest will be a loan.
我好不容易才找到他的家。
Wǒ hǎobù róngyì cái zhǎodào tā de jiā.
I had a hard time finding his house.
不只是……，还……
not just …, also …
不只是 says there's more to it, and 还 adds what.
买了房不只是买了房，你还得买保险，付各种账单。
Mǎi le fáng bù zhǐshì mǎi le fáng, nǐ hái de mǎi bǎoxiǎn, fù gè zhǒng zhàngdān.
Buying a flat isn't just buying a flat. You also have to buy insurance and pay all sorts of bills.
学汉语不只是学说话，还要学写字。
Xué Hànyǔ bù zhǐshì xué shuōhuà, hái yào xué xiě zì.
Learning Chinese isn't just learning to speak; you have to learn to write too.
一想到……，就/还是……
whenever (I) think of …
一 + 想到 gives the trigger, and the second half gives the reaction.
虽然很辛苦，但是一想到我将有自己的房子，还是觉得非常值得的。
Suīrán hěn xīnkǔ, dànshì yì xiǎngdào wǒ jiāng yǒu zìjǐ de fángzi, háishi juéde fēicháng zhíde de.
It's hard, but when I think I'll have a home of my own, it feels well worth it.
一想到考试，我就紧张。
Yì xiǎngdào kǎoshì, wǒ jiù jǐnzhāng.
Whenever I think about the exam, I get nervous.
通过……的方式
by way of …
通过 + a method + 的方式 says how something is done.
我们通过贷款的方式买房子，然后每个月用自己收入的百分之五十或者更高来还贷。
Wǒmen tōngguò dàikuǎn de fāngshì mǎi fáng zi, ránhòu měi ge yuè yòng zìjǐ shōurù de bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí huòzhě gèng gāo lái huán dài.
We buy a home with a loan, then every month use 50% or more of our income to pay it back.
他们通过网上的方式交房租。
Tāmen tōngguò wǎng shang de fāngshì jiāo fángzū.
They pay their rent online.
从……中拿出
to take out of …
从 + source + 中 marks where something is taken from.
如果我们和银行借钱买房子，以后就要每个月从工资中拿出一半或者更多的钱还给银行。
Rúguǒ wǒmen hé yínháng jiè qián mǎi fáng zi, yǐhòu jiù yào měi ge yuè cóng gōngzī zhōng ná chū yíbàn huòzhě gèng duō de qián huán gěi yínháng.
If we borrow from the bank to buy a home, we'll have to give half or more of our wages back to the bank every month.
他从工资中拿出一部分给父母。
Tā cóng gōngzī zhōng ná chū yí bùfen gěi fùmǔ.
He gives part of his wages to his parents.
gaps: 自己的房子，是每个中国老百姓心中的梦想。
买了房不只是买了房，你还得买
了，至少有了一个自己的窝嘛。
的百分之五十或者更高来还贷。
say: Having a home of one's own is the dream of every ordinary Chinese person.
For this flat I scraped together a 350,000 down payment, and the rest will be a loan.
Buying a flat isn't just buying a flat. You also have to buy insurance and pay all sorts of bills.
A bit of hardship is worth it. At least I've got a nest of my own.
If we borrow from the bank to buy a home, we'll have to give half or more of our wages back to the bank every month.

024.title: Should he become a mortgage slave?
024.sub: Gu Zhengzheng wonders whether to buy: 8 people's advice
024.transcriptNote: Gu Zhengzheng has found a stable job in a big city and isn't sure whether to take out a loan and buy a flat. Eight people give their views. Decide whether each one is for or against buying, then turn on Answers. Items 2, 3, 6 and 8 aren't numbered aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断说话人的意思 · What does the speaker think?
lines: 判断说话人的意思。
Pànduàn shuōhuàrén de yìsi.
Work out what the speaker means.
顾铮铮在一个大城市找到了稳定的工作，他不知道是否应该贷款买房做房奴。
Gù Zhēngzhēng zài yí ge dà chéngshì zhǎodào le wěndìng de gōngzuò, tā bù zhīdao shìfǒu yīnggāi dàikuǎn mǎi fáng zuò fángnú.
Gu Zhengzheng has found a stable job in a big city. He doesn't know whether he should take out a loan, buy a flat and become a mortgage slave.
下面是一些人对此的看法，你觉得他们的态度是什么？
Xiàmiàn shì yìxiē rén duì cǐ de kànfǎ, nǐ juéde tāmen de tàidu shì shénme?
Here are some people's views on this. What do you think their attitudes are?
现在不一样了，人们对房子的观念都变了。
Xiànzài bù yíyàng le, rénmen duì fángzi de guānniàn dōu biàn le.
Things are different now. People's ideas about homes have changed.
农村的房子再大都不算房子，而城市里的房子再小也算有房。
Nóngcūn de fángzi zài dàdōu búsuàn fángzi, ér chéngshì li de fángzi zài xiǎo yě suàn yǒu fáng.
A house in the countryside, however big, doesn't count, while a flat in the city, however small, means you own a home.
孩子，我们愿意拿出三十万帮你把首付付了。
Háizi, wǒmen yuànyì ná chū sānshí wàn bāng nǐ bǎ shǒufù fù le.
Son, we're willing to put up 300,000 to help you pay the deposit.
现在房价是最高的时候，以后会降的，先别太急。
Xiànzài fángjià shì zuìgāo de shíhou, yǐhòu huì jiàng de, xiān bié tài jí.
House prices are at their peak now. They'll come down later. Don't rush.
一个很大的问题就是这个社会认为谁有房谁就成功，你没有房，你就没出息。
Yí ge hěn dà de wèntí jiùshì zhège shèhuì rènwéi shéi yǒu fáng shéi jiù chénggōng, nǐ méiyǒu fáng, nǐ jiù méi chūxi.
One big problem is that society thinks whoever owns a home is a success. If you don't have one, you're a nobody.
现在社会上独生子女很多，再过十年算一算：
Xiànzài shèhuì shang dúshēng zǐnǚ hěn duō, zài guo shí nián suàn yí suàn:
There are lots of only children these days. Work it out ten years from now:
自己父母一套房，爱人父母一套房，夫妻双方还有一套房。
Zìjǐ fùmǔ yí tào fáng, àiren fùmǔ yí tào fáng, fūqī shuāngfāng hái yǒu yí tào fáng.
your parents have a flat, your spouse's parents have a flat, and the couple have one too.
再过十年，双方父母都不在了，这样一家就有三套房。
Zài guo shí nián, shuāngfāng fùmǔ dōu bú zài le, zhèyàng yì jiā jiù yǒu sān tào fáng.
Another ten years on, both sets of parents are gone, so one family has three flats.
再过十年，父母还会为孩子再买房吗？到时候房子还会永远上涨吗？
Zài guo shí nián, fùmǔ hái huì wèi háizi zài mǎi fáng ma? Dào shíhou fángzi hái huì yǒngyuǎn shàngzhǎng ma?
Ten years after that, will parents still buy flats for their children? Will prices keep going up forever?
大家有房子住了，买房子的人少了，房价就不会涨了。
Dàjiā yǒu fángzi zhù le, mǎi fáng zi de rén shǎo le, fángjià jiù bú huì zhǎng le.
When everyone has somewhere to live, fewer people will buy, and prices will stop rising.
所以房子是不会永远上涨的。现在花那么多钱，不值得。
Suǒyǐ fángzi shì bú huì yǒngyuǎn shàngzhǎng de. Xiànzài huā nàme duō qián, bù zhíde.
So prices won't go up forever. Spending that much now isn't worth it.
听说有人当上了房奴后，不旅游，不逛街，不去饭馆吃饭，只买便宜的菜，
Tīngshuō yǒu rén dāngshang le fángnú hòu, bù lǚyóu, bú guàng jiē, bú qù fànguǎn chī fàn, zhǐ mǎi piányi de cài,
I've heard that once some people become mortgage slaves, they stop travelling, stop shopping, never eat out and only buy cheap food.
还有人几个月吃不上肉，天天吃土豆。
hái yǒu rén jǐ ge yuè chī bu shàng ròu, tiāntiān chī tǔdòu.
Some go months without meat and eat potatoes every day.
你看他们的房子是有了，可是没有睡过一个好觉。
Nǐ kàn tāmen de fángzi shì yǒu le, kěshì méiyǒu shuì guo yí ge hǎo jiào.
They've got their flat, all right, but they've never had a good night's sleep.
说买房稳定，那我问你：你买房还贷，每个月还钱后，你工资剩多少？
Shuō mǎi fáng wěndìng, nà wǒ wèn nǐ: nǐ mǎi fáng huán dài, měi ge yuè huán qián hòu, nǐ gōngzī shèng duōshǎo?
You say buying gives you stability? Then let me ask you: once you've paid your mortgage each month, how much of your salary is left?
你把所有的钱都交了首付，等你有急事用钱的时候怎么办？
Nǐ bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu jiāo le shǒufù, děng nǐ yǒu jíshì yòng qián de shíhou zěnmebàn?
If you put all your money into the deposit, what will you do when you need money urgently?
新的商品房买不起就买二手的。
Xīn de shāngpǐnfáng mǎi bu qǐ jiù mǎi èr shǒu de.
If you can't afford a new flat, buy a second-hand one.
再说了，有了房子，你结婚找女朋友也容易得多了。
Zàishuō le, yǒu le fángzi, nǐ jié hūn zhǎo nǚpéngyou yě róngyì de duō le.
Besides, with a flat it's much easier to find a girlfriend and get married.

vocab: to be a nobody, to get nowhere
grammar: 再 + adj + 都/也……
however …
再 + adjective + 也/都 means "no matter how …".
农村的房子再大都不算房子，而城市里的房子再小也算有房。
Nóngcūn de fángzi zài dàdōu búsuàn fángzi, ér chéngshì li de fángzi zài xiǎo yě suàn yǒu fáng.
A house in the countryside, however big, doesn't count, while a flat in the city, however small, means you own a home.
再忙也要吃饭。
Zài máng yě yào chī fàn.
However busy you are, you still have to eat.
谁……谁就……
whoever …
The same question word in both halves links them: whoever does A, that person is B.
一个很大的问题就是这个社会认为谁有房谁就成功，你没有房，你就没出息。
Yí ge hěn dà de wèntí jiùshì zhège shèhuì rènwéi shéi yǒu fáng shéi jiù chénggōng, nǐ méiyǒu fáng, nǐ jiù méi chūxi.
One big problem is that society thinks whoever owns a home is a success. If you don't have one, you're a nobody.
谁先到谁买票。
Shéi xiān dào shéi mǎi piào.
Whoever gets there first buys the tickets.
把 + O + V + 了
to get … done
把 brings the object forward, and the verb shows what happens to it.
孩子，我们愿意拿出三十万帮你把首付付了。
Háizi, wǒmen yuànyì ná chū sānshí wàn bāng nǐ bǎ shǒufù fù le.
Son, we're willing to put up 300,000 to help you pay the deposit.
我已经把房租交了。
Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ fángzū jiāo le.
I've already paid the rent.
再过 + time
in another …
再过 + a length of time looks ahead from now.
再过十年，双方父母都不在了，这样一家就有三套房。
Zài guo shí nián, shuāngfāng fùmǔ dōu bú zài le, zhèyàng yì jiā jiù yǒu sān tào fáng.
Another ten years on, both sets of parents are gone, so one family has three flats.
再过两个月，我就毕业了。
Zài guo liǎng ge yuè, wǒ jiù bìyè le.
In two more months I'll graduate.
it's … all right, but …
是 admits one point, and 可是 brings in the problem.
你看他们的房子是有了，可是没有睡过一个好觉。
Nǐ kàn tāmen de fángzi shì yǒu le, kěshì méiyǒu shuì guo yí ge hǎo jiào.
They've got their flat, all right, but they've never had a good night's sleep.
房子是大，可是离公司太远。
Fángzi shì dà, kěshì lí gōngsī tài yuǎn.
The flat is big all right, but it's too far from work.
V + 得多
much more …
得多 after an adjective means "much more".
再说了，有了房子，你结婚找女朋友也容易得多了。
Zàishuō le, yǒu le fángzi, nǐ jié hūn zhǎo nǚpéngyou yě róngyì de duō le.
Besides, with a flat it's much easier to find a girlfriend and get married.
今天比昨天冷得多。
Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng de duō.
Today is much colder than yesterday.
gaps: 的房子再大都不算房子
我们愿意拿出三十万帮你把
现在房价是最高的时候，以后会
还有人几个月吃不上肉，天天吃
新的商品房买不起就买
say: Things are different now. People's ideas about homes have changed.
House prices are at their peak now. They'll come down later. Don't rush.
They've got their flat, all right, but they've never had a good night's sleep.
If you can't afford a new flat, buy a second-hand one.
Besides, with a flat it's much easier to find a girlfriend and get married.

025.title: Being a mortgage slave: upsides and problems
025.sub: Ten speakers on life with a mortgage
025.transcriptNote: Each statement is either a good side of being a mortgage slave or a problem with it. Note down the key point, then compare with the Answers, which are my own short summaries. Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
下面是当房奴的好处或遇到的问题，请记下每个句子的要点。
Xiàmiàn shì dāng fángnú de hǎochù huò yùdào de wèntí, qǐng jì xià měi ge jùzi de yàodiǎn.
Here are some upsides of being a mortgage slave, or problems they meet. Note down the key point of each.
自从我住进新房后，天天为应付账单而睡不好觉，差点病倒了。
Zìcóng wǒ zhù jìn xīnfáng hòu, tiāntiān wèi yìngfu zhàngdān ér shuì bù hǎo jiào, chàdiǎn bìngdǎo le.
Since I moved into my new flat, I can't sleep for worrying about the bills, and I nearly fell ill.

ans: 问题：账单太多，压力大得睡不好觉。
Wèntí: zhàngdān tài duō, yālì dà de shuì bù hǎo jiào.
A problem: so many bills that the stress keeps him awake.

lines: 还房贷压力是很大，可是总比每个月给别人几千块房租好，因为最后你有了自己的家。
Huán fángdài yālì shì hěn dà, kěshì zǒng bǐ měi ge yuè gěi biérén jǐ qiān kuài fángzū hǎo, yīnwèi zuìhòu nǐ yǒu le zìjǐ de jiā.
Mortgage payments are stressful, sure, but it beats paying someone thousands in rent every month, because in the end you have your own home.

ans: 好处：最后有了自己的家，比交房租好。
Hǎochù: zuìhòu yǒu le zìjǐ de jiā, bǐ jiāo fángzū hǎo.
An upside: in the end you own a home, which beats paying rent.

lines: 现在不当房奴，以后房价涨得更高，你想当也当不上了。
Xiànzài bù dāng fángnú, yǐhòu fángjià zhǎng de gèng gāo, nǐ xiǎng dāng yě dāng bú shàng le.
If you don't become a mortgage slave now, prices will rise even higher, and later you won't be able to even if you want to.

ans: 好处：早买房，不怕以后房价更高。
Hǎochù: zǎo mǎi fáng, bú pà yǐhòu fángjià gèng gāo.
An upside: buy early and you won't be caught by higher prices later.

lines: 很多人羡慕我成功地加入了房奴一族，其实他们不知道，
Hěn duō rén xiànmù wǒ chénggōng de jiārù le fángnú yì zú, qíshí tāmen bù zhīdao,
Lots of people envy me for joining the mortgage slaves, but what they don't know is that
我成了房奴后，生活质量大大下降，比租房时的日子苦多了。
wǒ chéng le fángnú hòu, shēnghuó zhìliàng dàdà xiàjiàng, bǐ zū fáng shí de rìzi kǔ duō le.
since becoming one my quality of life has dropped sharply. It's much harder than when I rented.

ans: 问题：生活质量大大下降。
A problem: quality of life has dropped sharply.

lines: 房奴再累再苦，也比蚁族好，因为梦想终于实现了。
Fángnú zài lèi zài kǔ, yě bǐ yǐzú hǎo, yīnwèi mèngxiǎng zhōngyú shíxiàn le.
However tired and hard up a mortgage slave is, it's better than being in the "ant tribe", because the dream has finally come true.

ans: An upside: the dream has come true.

lines: 我好不容易东借西借加入了房奴这个群体，后来才发现，
Wǒ hǎobù róngyì dōng jiè xī jiè jiārù le fángnú zhège qúntǐ, hòulái cái fāxiàn,
I borrowed from everyone to scrape my way into the mortgage slaves, and only later did I realise
装修、家具、账单、保险，样样都需要钱，我实在承受不起了。
zhuāngxiū, jiājù, zhàngdān, bǎoxiǎn, yàngyàng dōu xūyào qián, wǒ shízài chéngshòu bu qǐ le.
decoration, furniture, bills, insurance: everything costs money. I really can't afford it.

ans: 问题：样样都需要钱，承受不起。
Wèntí: yàngyàng dōu xūyào qián, chéngshòu bu qǐ.
A problem: everything costs money and he can't afford it.

lines: 其实我的工资还不错，可是当了房奴后，每个月一发工资，一半就因为还贷不见了。
Qíshí wǒ de gōngzī hái búcuò, kěshì dāng le fángnú hòu, měi ge yuè yì fā gōngzī, yíbàn jiù yīnwèi huán dài bú jiàn le.
My salary is actually pretty good, but since I got a mortgage, half of it disappears into repayments as soon as I'm paid.
剩下那点钱根本不够我和朋友出去吃饭唱歌，我真不知道值不值得当房奴。
Shèngxia nà diǎn qián gēnběn bú gòu wǒ hé péngyou chūqu chī fàn chàng gē, wǒ zhēn bù zhī dào zhí bù zhíde dāng fángnú.
What's left isn't nearly enough to go out eating and singing with friends. I really don't know if it's worth it.

ans: 问题：工资一半还贷，没钱玩了。
Wèntí: gōngzī yíbàn huán dài, méi qián wán le.
A problem: half the salary goes on the loan, leaving nothing for fun.

lines: 当了房奴后，还贷让我学会了不乱花钱了，这倒也是件好事。
Dāng le fángnú hòu, huán dài ràng wǒ xué huì le bú luàn huā qián le, zhè dào yě shì jiàn hǎo shì.
Since getting a mortgage, the repayments have taught me not to waste money. That's actually a good thing.

ans: Hǎochù: xuéhuì le bú luàn huā qián.
An upside: learning not to waste money.

lines: 我是五年前买的这个房子，要还贷二十年。
Wǒ shì wǔ nián qián mǎi de zhège fángzi, yào huán dài èr shí nián.
I bought this flat five years ago, with twenty years of repayments.
现在这房子已经涨了十万，而且还会涨。
Xiànzài zhè fángzi yǐjīng zhǎng le shí wàn, érqiě hái huì zhǎng.
It's already gone up by 100,000, and it'll go up more.
我要是早买就好了，会涨得更多。
Wǒ yàoshì zǎo mǎi jiù hǎo le, huì zhǎng de gèng duō.
If only I'd bought earlier, it would have gone up even more.

ans: 好处：房子会涨价，是好投资。
Hǎochù: fángzi huì zhǎng jià, shì hǎo tóuzī.
An upside: the flat gains value, so it's a good investment.

lines: 终于可以让朋友到家里来玩了，现在我觉得自己很有面子，不像以前了。
Zhōngyú kěyǐ ràng péngyou dào jiā li lái wán le, xiànzài wǒ juéde zìjǐ hěn yǒu miànzi, bú xiàng yǐqián le.
At last I can invite friends round. I feel I've got face now, not like before.

ans: An upside: it gives you face.

grammar: 自从……后
ever since …
自从 marks a starting point in the past, and what follows has been true since then.
自从我住进新房后，天天为应付账单而睡不好觉，差点病倒了。
Zìcóng wǒ zhù jìn xīnfáng hòu, tiāntiān wèi yìngfu zhàngdān ér shuì bù hǎo jiào, chàdiǎn bìngdǎo le.
Since I moved into my new flat, I can't sleep for worrying about the bills, and I nearly fell ill.
自从他工作以后，就很少回家了。
Zìcóng tā gōngzuò yǐhòu, jiù hěn shǎo huí jiā le.
Since he started working, he hardly ever comes home.
because of …
为 gives the cause, 而 links it to the result.
自从我住进新房后，天天为应付账单而睡不好觉，差点病倒了。
Zìcóng wǒ zhù jìn xīnfáng hòu, tiāntiān wèi yìngfu zhàngdān ér shuì bù hǎo jiào, chàdiǎn bìngdǎo le.
Since I moved into my new flat, I can't sleep for worrying about the bills, and I nearly fell ill.
他为这件事而烦恼。
Tā wèi zhè jiàn shì ér fánnǎo.
He's worried about this.
总比……好
it's still better than …
Admits a downside, then says it still beats the alternative.
还房贷压力是很大，可是总比每个月给别人几千块房租好，因为最后你有了自己的家。
Huán fángdài yālì shì hěn dà, kěshì zǒng bǐ měi ge yuè gěi biérén jǐ qiān kuài fángzū hǎo, yīnwèi zuìhòu nǐ yǒu le zìjǐ de jiā.
Mortgage payments are stressful, sure, but it beats paying someone thousands in rent every month, because in the end you have your own home.
贵是贵，总比没有好。
Guì shì guì, zǒng bǐ méiyǒu hǎo.
It's expensive, but it's better than nothing.
V + 也 + V + 不上
even if you want to, you can't
想 V 也 V 不上 says the chance will be gone.
现在不当房奴，以后房价涨得更高，你想当也当不上了。
Xiànzài bù dāng fángnú, yǐhòu fángjià zhǎng de gèng gāo, nǐ xiǎng dāng yě dāng bú shàng le.
If you don't become a mortgage slave now, prices will rise even higher, and later you won't be able to even if you want to.
现在不报名，以后想去也去不上了。
Xiànzài bú bàomíng, yǐhòu xiǎng qù yě qù bú shàng le.
If you don't sign up now, you won't get in later even if you want to.
as soon as …
一 + first action, 就 + what happens right after.
其实我的工资还不错，可是当了房奴后，每个月一发工资，一半就因为还贷不见了。
Qíshí wǒ de gōngzī hái búcuò, kěshì dāng le fángnú hòu, měi ge yuè yì fā gōngzī, yíbàn jiù yīnwèi huán dài bú jiàn le.
My salary is actually pretty good, but since I got a mortgage, half of it disappears into repayments as soon as I'm paid.
他一回家就睡觉。
Tā yì huí jiā jiù shuì jiào.
He goes to sleep as soon as he gets home.
要是……就好了
if only …
A wish about something that didn't happen.
我要是早买就好了，会涨得更多。
Wǒ yàoshì zǎo mǎi jiù hǎo le, huì zhǎng de gèng duō.
If only I'd bought earlier, it would have gone up even more.
要是我会说汉语就好了。
Yàoshì wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ jiù hǎo le.
If only I could speak Chinese.
gaps: 而睡不好觉，差点病倒了。
可是总比每个月给别人几千块
我成功地加入了房奴一族
我成了房奴后，生活质量大大
当了房奴后，还贷让我学会了不
say: Mortgage payments are stressful, sure, but it beats paying someone thousands in rent every month, because in the end you have your own home.
If you don't become a mortgage slave now, prices will rise even higher, and later you won't be able to even if you want to.
However tired and hard up a mortgage slave is, it's better than being in the "ant tribe", because the dream has finally come true.
Since getting a mortgage, the repayments have taught me not to waste money. That's actually a good thing.

026.title: Mortgage slaves
026.sub: Three questions, then a short passage on the new housing words
026.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the passage. The answers are my own summaries. The passage names 蜗居, 蚁族 and 鼠族 without explaining them, so the definitions in answer 3 are mine.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

ans: 通过银行贷款买房子，然后二三十年里每个月用一半或者更多的收入还贷款的人。
Tōngguò yínháng dàikuǎn mǎi fáng zi, ránhòu èr sānshí nián li měi ge yuè yòng yíbàn huòzhě gèng duō de shōurù huán dàikuǎn de rén.
Someone who buys a home with a bank loan and then spends half or more of their income every month for 20–30 years paying it back.

q: 为什么中国老百姓买房的梦想越来越难实现？
Wèishénme Zhōngguó lǎobǎixìng mǎi fáng de mèngxiǎng yuèláiyuè nán shíxiàn?
Why is it getting harder for ordinary Chinese people to make their dream of buying a home come true?
除了房奴外，文章还提到了哪几个和住房有关的群体？这些群体指的是哪些人？
Chúle fángnú wài, wénzhāng hái tídào le nǎ jǐ ge hé zhùfáng yǒuguān de qúntǐ? Zhèxiē qúntǐ zhǐ de shì nǎxiē rén?
Apart from mortgage slaves, which other housing-related groups does the passage mention? Who are they?
ans: 蜗居（住在很小的房子里的人）、蚁族（住得很挤的低收入大学毕业生）、鼠族（住地下室的人）。
Wōjū(zhù zài hěn xiǎo de fángzi li de rén), yǐzú(zhù de hěn jǐ de dī shōurù dàxué bìyèshēng), shǔzú(zhù dìxiàshì de rén).
Wōjū (people in tiny homes), the "ant tribe" (low-paid graduates living crammed together) and the "rat tribe" (people living in basements).

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 房奴
Fángnú
Mortgage slaves
古话说得好：“安居乐业。”
Gǔ huà shuō de hǎo: "Ānjū-lèyè."
As the old saying goes: "Live in peace and work happily."
有一套属于自己的房子，是每个人心中的梦想。
Yǒu yí tào shǔyú zìjǐ de fángzi, shì měi ge rén xīnzhōng de mèngxiǎng.
Having a home of one's own is everyone's dream.
无数人为了这个梦想努力着，付出了很多辛苦。
Wúshù rén wèile zhège mèngxiǎng nǔlì zhe, fùchū le hěn duō xīnkǔ.
Countless people work hard and put in a great deal for this dream.
从一开始的社会福利分房，
Cóng yì kāishǐ de shèhuì fúlì fēn fáng,
From the welfare housing handed out at first,
到后来，几千块钱一平米的商品房，
dào hòulái, jǐ qiān kuài qián yì píngmǐ de shāngpǐnfáng,
to later, commercial flats at a few thousand yuan per square metre,
再到后来，一线城市一两万一平米的商品房，
zài dào hòulái, yīxiàn chéngshì yì liǎng wànyī píngmǐ de shāngpǐnfáng,
and later still, flats in first-tier cities at ten or twenty thousand per square metre,
不断上涨的房价，使中国老百姓买房的梦想越来越难实现。
búduàn shàngzhǎng de fángjià, shǐ Zhōngguó lǎobǎixìng mǎi fáng de mèngxiǎng yuèláiyuè nán shíxiàn.
ever-rising prices have made it harder and harder for ordinary Chinese people to buy a home.
最近几年，几个和住房问题有关的新词也跟着出现了，
Zuìjìn jǐ nián, jǐ ge hé zhùfáng wèntí yǒuguān de xīncí yě gēnzhe chūxiàn le,
In recent years, several new words to do with housing have appeared along with this,
如房奴、蜗居、蚁族、鼠族等等。
rú fángnú, wōjū, yǐzú, shǔzú děngděng.
such as mortgage slave, wōjū, the ant tribe, the rat tribe and so on.
其中，房奴一词涉及的社会群体人数最多。
Qízhōng, fángnú yì cí shèjí de shèhuì qúntǐ rénshù zuì duō.
Of these, 房奴 covers the largest group of people.
那么究竟什么是房奴呢？
Nàme jiūjìng shénme shì fángnú ne?
So what exactly is a 房奴?
房奴是指一些人通过银行贷款的方式买房子，
Fángnú shì zhǐ yìxiē rén tōngguò yínháng dàikuǎn de fāngshì mǎi fáng zi,
A 房奴 is someone who buys a home with a bank loan,
然后在二十到三十年之间，
ránhòu zài èrshí dào sān shí nián zhījiān,
and then, for twenty to thirty years,
每个月用自己收入的百分之五十甚至更高的比例还贷款。
měi ge yuè yòng zìjǐ shōurù de bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí shènzhì gèng gāo de bǐlì huán dàikuǎn.
uses 50% or even more of their monthly income to repay it.
也就是说，每个月要把工资的一半或者更高交给银行。
Yě jiù shì shuō, měi ge yuè yào bǎ gōngzī de yíbàn huòzhě gèng gāo jiāogěi yínháng.
In other words, half or more of their wages goes to the bank every month.
很多家庭因为还贷而造成长期生活在巨大的压力下，生活质量下降。
Hěn duō jiātíng yīnwèi huán dài ér zàochéng chángqī shēnghuó zài jùdà de yālì xià, shēnghuó zhìliàng xiàjiàng.
Because of their repayments, many families live under huge pressure for years, and their quality of life drops.

vocab: to live in peace and work happily
to live in a cramped home
grammar: from … to …, and then to …
Traces a change through stages.
从一开始的社会福利分房，
Cóng yì kāishǐ de shèhuì fúlì fēn fáng,
From the welfare housing handed out at first,
从一个人，到两个人，再到一家三口。
Cóng yí ge rén, dào liǎng ge rén, zài dào yì jiā sān kǒu.
From one person, to two, to a family of three.
使 + O + V
to make …
使 means "to cause". The cause is the subject.
不断上涨的房价，使中国老百姓买房的梦想越来越难实现。
búduàn shàngzhǎng de fángjià, shǐ Zhōngguó lǎobǎixìng mǎi fáng de mèngxiǎng yuèláiyuè nán shíxiàn.
ever-rising prices have made it harder and harder for ordinary Chinese people to buy a home.
这件事使他很难过。
Zhè jiàn shì shǐ tā hěn nánguò.
This made him very sad.
和……有关
related to …
和 + topic + 有关 means connected with it.
最近几年，几个和住房问题有关的新词也跟着出现了，
Zuìjìn jǐ nián, jǐ ge hé zhùfáng wèntí yǒuguān de xīncí yě gēnzhe chūxiàn le,
In recent years, several new words to do with housing have appeared along with this,
这本书和中国历史有关。
Zhè běn shū hé Zhōngguó lìshǐ yǒuguān.
This book is about Chinese history.
A 是指 B
A refers to B
Used to define a term.
房奴是指一些人通过银行贷款的方式买房子，
Fángnú shì zhǐ yìxiē rén tōngguò yínháng dàikuǎn de fāngshì mǎi fáng zi,
A 房奴 is someone who buys a home with a bank loan,
空巢老人是指子女不在身边的老人。
Kōngcháo lǎorén shì zhǐ zǐnǚ bú zài shēnbiān de lǎorén.
Empty-nesters means old people whose children don't live nearby.
也就是说
in other words
Restates the previous point more simply.
也就是说，每个月要把工资的一半或者更高交给银行。
Yě jiù shì shuō, měi ge yuè yào bǎ gōngzī de yíbàn huòzhě gèng gāo jiāogěi yínháng.
In other words, half or more of their wages goes to the bank every month.
他是我妈妈的妹妹，也就是说，是我的阿姨。
Tā shì wǒ māma de mèimei, yě jiù shì shuō, shì wǒ de āyí.
She's my mum's younger sister; in other words, my aunt.
因为……而造成……
… causes … because of …
因为 gives the cause, 而造成 brings in a bad result.
很多家庭因为还贷而造成长期生活在巨大的压力下，生活质量下降。
Hěn duō jiātíng yīnwèi huán dài ér zàochéng chángqī shēnghuó zài jùdà de yālì xià, shēnghuó zhìliàng xiàjiàng.
Because of their repayments, many families live under huge pressure for years, and their quality of life drops.
他因为工作太忙而造成身体不好。
Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng ér zàochéng shēntǐ bù hǎo.
Being too busy at work has made him unwell.

，使中国老百姓买房的梦想越来越难实现。
房奴是指一些人通过银行
每个月用自己收入的百分之五十甚至更高的
很多家庭因为还贷而造成

ever-rising prices have made it harder and harder for ordinary Chinese people to buy a home.
So what exactly is a 房奴?

027.title: I've got the flat, but …
027.sub: University student Yu Fu has bought a flat; his classmate envies him
027.transcriptNote: 王 is Wang Junnan and 于 is Yu Fu. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
大学生于福成了房奴，同学们都很羡慕他，可是于福的烦恼也很多。
Dàxuéshēng Yú Fú chéng le fángnú, tóngxué men dōu hěn xiànmù tā, kěshì Yú Fú de fánnǎo yě hěn duō.
University student Yu Fu has become a mortgage slave. His classmates all envy him, but Yu Fu has plenty of worries.
请听于福和他的同学王军楠的对话，然后回答下面的问题。
Qǐng tīng Yú Fú hé tā de tóngxué Wáng Jūnnán de duìhuà, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to Yu Fu and his classmate Wang Junnan, then answer the questions below.

q: Yú Fú de fángzi zhí duōshǎo qián?
How much is Yu Fu's flat worth?

ans: 首付是借来的，剩下的靠贷款；装修的钱也是借的；现在还要买家具，可是再也借不来钱了，家里什么家具都没有。
Shǒufù shì jiè lái de, shèngxia de kào dàikuǎn; zhuāngxiū de qián yě shì jiè de; xiànzài hái yào mǎi jiājù, kěshì zài yě jiè bù lái qián le, jiā li shénme jiājù dōu méiyǒu.
He borrowed for the deposit and the rest is a loan; he borrowed for the decorating too; now he needs furniture but can't borrow any more, so the flat has no furniture at all.

blocks.label: 对话
blocks.h: 于福和王军楠 · The conversation
lines: 你看看你，房子都有了，毕业就能结婚了，
Nǐ kànkan nǐ, fángzi dōu yǒu le, bìyè jiù néng jié hūn le,
Look at you. You've already got a flat, so you can marry as soon as you graduate.
王
几件人生大事都快解决了，多令人羡慕！
jǐ jiàn rénshēng dàshì dōu kuài jiějué le, duō lìng rén xiànmù!
Your big life events are nearly all sorted. How enviable!
王
有什么可羡慕的呀？说老实话，我压力大着呢。
Yǒu shénme kě xiànmù de ya? Shuō lǎoshi huà, wǒ yālì dà zhe ne.
What's there to envy? To be honest, I'm under a lot of pressure.
于
这房子八十多万可不是小数。
Zhè fángzi bā shí duō wàn kě bú shì xiǎoshù.
This flat cost over 800,000. That's no small sum.
于
我好不容易弄来了三十几万交了首付，剩下的就只有靠贷款。
Wǒ hǎobù róngyì nòng lái le sānshí jǐ wàn jiāo le shǒufù, shèngxia de jiù zhǐyǒu kào dàikuǎn.
I scraped together over 300,000 for the deposit, and the rest has to be a loan.
于
现在不是都这样吗？你能弄来首付就已经很不错了，剩下的慢慢还呗。
Xiànzài bú shì dōu zhèyàng ma? Nǐ néng nòng lái shǒufù jiù yǐjīng hěn búcuò le, shèngxia de mànmàn hái bei.
Isn't that how everyone does it now? Getting the deposit together is already great. Pay off the rest slowly.
王
你说得倒是容易。你以为交了首付就行了呀？
Nǐ shuō de dàoshì róngyì. Nǐ yǐwéi jiāo le shǒufù jiù xíng le ya?
That's easy for you to say. You think paying the deposit is the end of it?
于
房子是有了，可是不装修也不能住啊。装修谁肯给你贷款啊？
Fángzi shì yǒu le, kěshì bù zhuāngxiū yě bù néng zhù a. Zhuāngxiū shéi kěn gěi nǐ dàikuǎn a?
I've got the flat, but I can't live in it without decorating. And who'll lend you money for that?
于
那你怎么弄来的钱呀？
Nà nǐ zěnme nòng lái de qián ya?
So how did you get the money?
王
借呗。东借西借弄来了装修的几万块。
Jiè bei. Dōng jiè xī jiè nòng lái le zhuāngxiū de jǐ wàn kuài.
Borrowed it, of course. I borrowed here and there and got together a few tens of thousands for the decorating.
于
可是装修完了，又发现里面啥也没有，你还得买家具，各种花销都来了。
Kěshì zhuāngxiū wán le, yòu fāxiàn lǐmiàn shá yě méiyǒu, nǐ hái de mǎi jiājù, gè zhǒng huāxiao dōu lái le.
But once it was decorated I found there was nothing in it. You still have to buy furniture, and all sorts of costs come up.
于
我可是再也借不来钱了。
Wǒ kěshì zài yě jiè bù lái qián le.
And I really can't borrow any more.
于
那你的房子现在什么家具都没有啊？
Nà nǐ de fángzi xiànzài shénme jiājù dōu méiyǒu a?
So your flat has no furniture at all now?
王
可不是吗？家里乱七八糟的，我还住地上呢。
Kě bú shì ma? Jiā li luànqībāzāo de, wǒ hái zhù dì shang ne.
Exactly. The place is a mess. I'm still sleeping on the floor.
于

grammar: 都……了
already …
都 + verb + 了 stresses that something has already happened.
你看看你，房子都有了，毕业就能结婚了，
Nǐ kànkan nǐ, fángzi dōu yǒu le, bìyè jiù néng jié hūn le,
Look at you. You've already got a flat, so you can marry as soon as you graduate.
他都毕业了。
Tā dōu bìyè le.
He's already graduated.
有什么可 + V + 的？
what is there to …?
A rhetorical question: there's nothing to envy.
有什么可羡慕的呀？说老实话，我压力大着呢。
Yǒu shénme kě xiànmù de ya? Shuō lǎoshi huà, wǒ yālì dà zhe ne.
What's there to envy? To be honest, I'm under a lot of pressure.
这有什么可怕的？
Zhè yǒu shénme kěpà de?
What's there to be afraid of?
adj + 着呢
really …
着呢 after an adjective adds emphasis in speech.
有什么可羡慕的呀？说老实话，我压力大着呢。
Yǒu shénme kě xiànmù de ya? Shuō lǎoshi huà, wǒ yālì dà zhe ne.
What's there to envy? To be honest, I'm under a lot of pressure.
他忙着呢。
Tā mángzhe ne.
He's really busy.
V + 呗
just …, of course
呗 at the end makes it sound obvious and casual.
现在不是都这样吗？你能弄来首付就已经很不错了，剩下的慢慢还呗。
Xiànzài bú shì dōu zhèyàng ma? Nǐ néng nòng lái shǒufù jiù yǐjīng hěn búcuò le, shèngxia de mànmàn hái bei.
Isn't that how everyone does it now? Getting the deposit together is already great. Pay off the rest slowly.
不会就学呗。
Bú huì jiù xué bei.
If you can't do it, just learn.
说得倒是容易
that's easy for you to say
倒是 grants a point with a hint of disagreement.
你说得倒是容易。你以为交了首付就行了呀？
Nǐ shuō de dàoshì róngyì. Nǐ yǐwéi jiāo le shǒufù jiù xíng le ya?
That's easy for you to say. You think paying the deposit is the end of it?
你说得倒是好听。
Nǐ shuō de dàoshì hǎotīng.
That sounds nice, the way you say it.
再也 + V + 不来 + 了
can't … any more
再也 + negative means never again.
我可是再也借不来钱了。
Wǒ kěshì zài yě jiè bù lái qián le.
And I really can't borrow any more.
他再也不来了。
Tā zài yě bù lái le.
He'll never come again.
gaps: 这房子八十多万可不是
我好不容易弄来了三十几万交了
say: Look at you. You've already got a flat, so you can marry as soon as you graduate.
What's there to envy? To be honest, I'm under a lot of pressure.
Isn't that how everyone does it now? Getting the deposit together is already great. Pay off the rest slowly.
That's easy for you to say. You think paying the deposit is the end of it?
Exactly. The place is a mess. I'm still sleeping on the floor.

028.title: Wang Dong's birthday
028.sub: A short report: 29 and drifting in Beijing
028.transcriptNote: A short report about Wang Dong on his 29th birthday, ending with his own words to a reporter. The answers are my own summaries, and the last one is up to you. Item numbers 2 and 4 aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
王东来北京生活快三年了，听听他的感受，然后回答下面的问题。
Wáng Dōng lái Běijīng shēnghuó kuài sān nián le, tīng tīng tā de gǎnshòu, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Wang Dong has lived in Beijing for nearly three years. Listen to how he feels, then answer the questions below.

ans: Wáng Dōng èrshí jiǔ suì de shēngrì.

q: Wáng Dōng de fángjiān li yǒu shénme?
ans: 几个家具、一张床、墙上他和父母的照片，桌子上一个插着二十九根蜡烛的生日蛋糕。
Jǐ ge jiājù, yì zhāng chuáng, qiáng shang tā hé fùmǔ de zhàopiān, zhuōzi shàng yí ge chā zhe èr shí jiǔ gēn làzhú de shēngrì dàngāo.
A few pieces of furniture, a bed, a photo of him and his parents on the wall, and a birthday cake with 29 candles on the table.
不是，他租房住，买不起房。
Bú shì, tā zū fáng zhù, mǎi bu qǐ fáng.
No. He rents; he can't afford to buy.

q: Tā zài Běijīng de shēnghuó hǎo ma?
Is his life in Beijing good?
ans: 不太好：房间很小，房租不停地涨，工资都交房租了，没有女朋友，也很少回家。
Bú tài hǎo: fángjiān hěn xiǎo, fángzū bù tíng de zhǎng, gōngzī dōu jiāo fángzū le, méiyǒu nǚpéngyou, yě hěn shǎo huí jiā.
Not really: his room is tiny, the rent keeps rising, his pay goes on rent, he has no girlfriend and seldom goes home.

q: 他问了自己两个什么问题？你怎样回答他的问题？
Tā wèn le zìjǐ liǎng ge shénme wèntí? Nǐ zěnyàng huídá tā de wèntí?
What two questions does he ask himself? How would you answer them?
ans: 每天这么努力工作究竟是为了啥？这样漂下去到底值不值？（第二个问题你自己回答。）
Měitiān zhème nǔlì gōngzuò jiūjìng shì wèile shá? Zhèyàng piāo xiaqu dàodǐ zhí bù zhí?(dì-èr ge wèntí nǐ zìjǐ huídá.)
What is all this hard work actually for? Is it worth carrying on drifting like this? (The answer is yours to give.)

lines: 王东的房间只有十五平米。
Wáng Dōng de fángjiān zhǐyǒu shí wǔ píngmǐ.
Wang Dong's room is only fifteen square metres.
暗暗的房间里，密密麻麻地摆着几个家具和一张床，
Àn'àn de fángjiān li, mìmimámá de bǎi zhe jǐ ge jiājù hé yì zhāng chuáng,
In the dim room, a few pieces of furniture and a bed are crammed together,
墙上挂着他和父母的照片。
qiáng shang guà zhe tā hé fùmǔ de zhàopiān.
and on the wall hangs a photo of him with his parents.
今天是一个特别的日子。今天，是他二十九岁的生日。
Jīntiān shì yí ge tèbié de rìzi. Jīntiān, shì tā èrshí jiǔ suì de shēngrì.
Today is a special day. Today is his 29th birthday.
桌子上摆着一个生日蛋糕，蛋糕上面插着二十九根蜡烛。
Zhuōzi shàng bǎi zhe yí ge shēngrì dàngāo, dàngāo shàngmian chā zhe èr shí jiǔ gēn làzhú.
There's a birthday cake on the table with 29 candles stuck in it.
可是，只有他一个人。
Kěshì, zhǐyǒu tā yí ge rén.
But he's all alone.
他先卷了一根烟，使劲儿地抽了一口，
Tā xiān juǎn le yì gēn yān, shǐjìnr de chōu le yì kǒu,
First he rolls a cigarette and takes a hard drag on it,
然后一下子把蜡烛都吹灭了。
ránhòu yíxiàzi bǎ làzhú dōu chuīmiè le.
then blows out all the candles in one go.
虽然今天是他的生日，可是他好像不是特别高兴。
Suīrán jīntiān shì tā de shēngrì, kěshì tā hǎoxiàng bú shì tèbié gāoxìng.
Although it's his birthday, he doesn't seem very happy.
为什么呢？听听他对记者说的话吧。
Wèishénme ne? Tīng tīng tā duì jìzhě shuō dehuà ba.
Why? Listen to what he told a reporter.
在北京漂着也好多年了，可是没有一个自己的家。
Zài Běijīng piāo zhe yěhǎo duō nián le, kěshì méiyǒu yí ge zìjǐ de jiā.
I've been drifting in Beijing for years now, but I don't have a home of my own.
房价实在是让人承受不了。
Fángjià shízài shì ràng rén chéngshòu bu liǎo.
House prices are just more than anyone can bear.
其实我把工资都存到银行，不吃不喝二十年，也买不起一套四十平的房子。
Qíshí wǒ bǎ gōngzī dōu cún dào yínháng, bù chī bù hē èr shí nián, yě mǎi bu qǐ yí tào sìshí píng de fángzi.
Even if I put all my pay in the bank and went without food and drink for twenty years, I still couldn't afford a forty-square-metre flat.
租房呢，房租又不停地涨，
Zū fáng ne, fángzū yòu bù tíng de zhǎng,
And renting? The rent keeps going up.
三年里，我都搬了六次家了，再涨我可能就得住地下室了。
sān nián li, wǒ dōu bān le liù cì jiā le, zài zhǎng wǒ kěnéng jiù de zhù dìxiàshì le.
In three years I've moved six times. If it goes up again I might have to live in a basement.
北京好倒是好，大公司多，工作机会也不少，
Běijīng hǎo dàoshì hǎo, dà gōngsī duō, gōngzuò jīhuì yě bù shǎo,
Beijing is great, sure: lots of big companies and plenty of jobs,
可是我挣的钱都交房租了。
kěshì wǒ zhēng de qián dōu jiāo fángzū le.
but all I earn goes on rent.
自己每天这么努力工作，究竟是为了啥？
Zìjǐ měitiān zhème nǔlì gōngzuò, jiūjìng shì wèile shá?
What am I working so hard every day for, really?
我现在快三十的人了，连女朋友都没有，
Wǒ xiànzài kuài sānshí de rén le, lián nǚpéngyou dōu méiyǒu,
I'm nearly thirty and I don't even have a girlfriend.
好几年过春节，都没回家看父母了。
hǎo jǐ nián guo Chūn Jié, dōu méi huí jiā kàn fùmǔ le.
I haven't been home to see my parents at Spring Festival for years.
这样漂下去到底值不值？
Zhèyàng piāo xiaqu dàodǐ zhí bù zhí?
Is drifting on like this really worth it?
一想到这些，我心里就有一种说不出来的感觉。
Yì xiǎngdào zhèxiē, wǒ xīn li jiù yǒu yì zhǒng shuō bu chūlái de gǎnjué.
Whenever I think about all this, I get a feeling I can't put into words.

vocab: measure word for long, thin things
grammar: V + 着 (存在句)
place + V着 + thing
Describes what is in a place: place first, then verb + 着, then the thing.
墙上挂着他和父母的照片。
qiáng shang guà zhe tā hé fùmǔ de zhàopiān.
and on the wall hangs a photo of him with his parents.
桌子上放着一本书。
Zhuōzi shàng fàng zhe yì běn shū.
There's a book on the table.
一下子
all at once
一下子 before a verb says it happens suddenly or in one go.
然后一下子把蜡烛都吹灭了。
ránhòu yíxiàzi bǎ làzhú dōu chuīmiè le.
then blows out all the candles in one go.
他一下子就明白了。
Tā yíxiàzi jiù míngbai le.
He understood straight away.
即使 / 也 (不吃不喝……也……)
even if … still …
The first half gives an extreme case; 也 says the result still holds.
其实我把工资都存到银行，不吃不喝二十年，也买不起一套四十平的房子。
Qíshí wǒ bǎ gōngzī dōu cún dào yínháng, bù chī bù hē èr shí nián, yě mǎi bu qǐ yí tào sìshí píng de fángzi.
Even if I put all my pay in the bank and went without food and drink for twenty years, I still couldn't afford a forty-square-metre flat.
我不睡觉也做不完。
Wǒ bú shuì jiào yě zuò bù wán.
Even if I don't sleep I can't finish.
adj + 倒是 + adj，可是……
it's … all right, but …
Repeating the adjective around 倒是 grants a point before the "but".
北京好倒是好，大公司多，工作机会也不少，
Běijīng hǎo dàoshì hǎo, dà gōngsī duō, gōngzuò jīhuì yě bù shǎo,
Beijing is great, sure: lots of big companies and plenty of jobs,
这个工作好倒是好，就是太累。
Zhège gōngzuò hǎo dàoshì hǎo, jiùshì tài lèi.
This job is good all right, but it's exhausting.
V + 下去
to carry on …ing
下去 after a verb means continuing into the future.
这样漂下去到底值不值？
Zhèyàng piāo xiaqu dàodǐ zhí bù zhí?
Is drifting on like this really worth it?
你再这样忙下去，身体会出问题的。
Nǐ zài zhèyàng máng xiaqu, shēntǐ huì chū wèntí de.
If you keep being this busy, your health will suffer.
一想到……，就……
whenever (I) think of …
一 gives the trigger, 就 the reaction.
一想到这些，我心里就有一种说不出来的感觉。
Yì xiǎngdào zhèxiē, wǒ xīn li jiù yǒu yì zhǒng shuō bu chūlái de gǎnjué.
Whenever I think about all this, I get a feeling I can't put into words.
一想到回家，他就很高兴。
Yì xiǎngdào huí jiā, tā jiù hěn gāoxìng.
Whenever he thinks of going home, he's happy.

蛋糕上面插着二十九根

But he's all alone.

Is drifting on like this really worth it?

029.title: Li Mengfang's life with a mortgage
029.sub: A year after buying: the hardship and why it's worth it
029.transcriptNote: Li Mengfang and her husband have been mortgage slaves for a year. She describes how it feels. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
李梦芳和她老公当了一年的房奴，听听她对自己当房奴的感受，然后回答下面的问题。
Lǐ Mèngfāng hé tā lǎogōng dāng le yì nián de fángnú, tīng tīng tā duì zìjǐ dāng fángnú de gǎnshòu, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Li Mengfang and her husband have been mortgage slaves for a year. Listen to how she feels about it, then answer the questions below.

q: 李梦芳当房奴以前的日子怎么样？
Lǐ Mèngfāng dāng fángnú yǐqián de rìzi zěnmeyàng?
What was Li Mengfang's life like before she had a mortgage?
ans: 她和老公租房，房租不高，常常逛街、跟朋友聚会吃饭，活得很好。
Tā hé lǎogōng zū fáng, fángzū bù gāo, chángcháng guàng jiē, gēn péngyou jùhuì chī fàn, huó de hěn hǎo.
She and her husband rented cheaply and often went shopping and out with friends. Life was good.

q: 李梦芳现在有什么烦恼？
Lǐ Mèngfāng xiànzài yǒu shénme fánnǎo?
What worries does Li Mengfang have now?
ans: 工资一半还房贷，还要买保险、付各种账单，没心思出去玩。
Gōngzī yíbàn huán fángdài, hái yào mǎi bǎoxiǎn, fù gè zhǒng zhàngdān, méi xīnsi chūqu wán.
Half her pay goes on the mortgage, there's insurance and bills to pay, and she's in no mood to go out.

q: Lǐ Mèngfāng hòuhuǐ dāng fángnú ma?
ans: 不后悔。虽然辛苦，可是将来有自己的房子，她觉得很值得。
Bú hòuhuǐ. Suīrán xīnkǔ, kěshì jiānglái yǒu zìjǐ de fángzi, tā juéde hěn zhíde.
No. It's hard, but she'll have her own home in the end, so she thinks it's worth it.

blocks.label: 感受
blocks.h: 李梦芳的感受 · How she feels
lines: 还记得刚住进新房的那段时间，我们每天心里都美滋滋的。
Hái jìde gāng zhù jìn xīnfáng de nà duàn shíjiān, wǒmen měitiān xīn li dōu měizīzī de.
I remember when we'd just moved into the new flat, we were delighted every day.
可是没过多少天就发现，原来当房奴实在是太苦了。
Kěshì méi guo duōshǎo tiān jiù fāxiàn, yuánlái dāng fángnú shízài shì tài kǔ le.
But before long we found out that being a mortgage slave is really tough.
举个例子吧，我每次刚一发工资，几乎一半就不见了，都还房贷去了。
Jǔ ge lìzi ba, wǒ měicì gāng yī fā gōngzī, jīhū yíbàn jiù bú jiàn le, dōu huán fángdài qù le.
For example, every time I get paid, almost half of it disappears straight away on the mortgage.
以前跟老公在一起租房的时候，活得多好呀！
Yǐqián gēn lǎogōng zài yìqǐ zū fáng de shíhou, huó de duō hǎo ya!
When my husband and I were renting, life was so good!
今天出去逛个街，明天出去跟朋友聚个会，吃个饭。
Jīntiān chūqu guàng ge jiē, míngtiān chūqu gēn péngyou jù ge huì, chī ge fàn.
One day we'd go shopping, the next we'd get together with friends for a meal.
反正房租也不是很高，所以能剩下一点钱让我们吃喝玩乐。
Fǎnzhèng fángzū yě bú shì hěn gāo, suǒyǐ néng shèngxia yìdiǎn qián ràng wǒmen chī-hē-wán-lè.
The rent wasn't high anyway, so we had a bit left over to eat, drink and have fun.
可是现在倒好，买了房，不只是买了房，
Kěshì xiànzài dào hǎo, mǎi le fáng, bù zhǐshì mǎi le fáng,
But now, look at us: we've bought a flat, and it's not just the flat.
买了房还要买保险，还要付各种账单。
mǎi le fáng hái yào mǎi bǎoxiǎn, hái yào fù gè zhǒng zhàngdān.
After buying it there's insurance to buy and all sorts of bills to pay.
成天看着这些账单，我们哪里还有心思出去吃喝玩乐呀？
Chéngtiān kàn zhe zhèxiē zhàngdān, wǒmen nǎli hái yǒu xīnsi chūqu chī-hē-wán-lè ya?
Staring at these bills all day, how could we be in the mood to go out and have fun?
每天都想着怎么应付账单去了。
Měitiān dōu xiǎngzhe zěnme yìngfu zhàngdān qù le.
Every day all we think about is how to deal with the bills.
不过呢，虽然很辛苦，但是一想到几十年后，我们将有自己的房子，
Búguò ne, suīrán hěn xīnkǔ, dànshì yì xiǎngdào jǐ shí nián hòu, wǒmen jiāng yǒu zìjǐ de fángzi,
Still, although it's hard, when I think that in a few decades we'll own our home,
倒还是觉得非常值得、非常充实的。
dào háishi juéde fēicháng zhíde, fēicháng chōngshí de.
I actually feel it's very worthwhile and fulfilling.
所以辛苦一点儿也值得了，至少自己有了一个固定的家嘛。
Suǒyǐ xīnkǔ yì diǎnr yě zhíde le, zhìshǎo zìjǐ yǒu le yí ge gùdìng de jiā ma.
So a bit of hardship is worth it. At least we have a permanent home.

vocab: to eat, drink and be merry
grammar: 没过多少天就……
before long …
没过多少天 says only a short time passed before something happened.
可是没过多少天就发现，原来当房奴实在是太苦了。
Kěshì méi guo duōshǎo tiān jiù fāxiàn, yuánlái dāng fángnú shízài shì tài kǔ le.
But before long we found out that being a mortgage slave is really tough.
他买的手机没过多少天就坏了。
Tā mǎi de shǒujī méi guo duōshǎo tiān jiù huài le.
The phone he bought broke before long.
原来……
so it turns out …
原来 introduces a discovery.
可是没过多少天就发现，原来当房奴实在是太苦了。
Kěshì méi guo duōshǎo tiān jiù fāxiàn, yuánlái dāng fángnú shízài shì tài kǔ le.
But before long we found out that being a mortgage slave is really tough.
原来你也在这儿！
Yuánlái nǐ yě zài zhèr!
So you're here too!
V + 个 + O
do a bit of …
个 between verb and object makes the activity sound light and casual.
今天出去逛个街，明天出去跟朋友聚个会，吃个饭。
Jīntiān chūqu guàng ge jiē, míngtiān chūqu gēn péngyou jù ge huì, chī ge fàn.
One day we'd go shopping, the next we'd get together with friends for a meal.
周末我们去看个电影吧。
Zhōumò wǒmen qù kàn ge diànyǐng ba.
Let's catch a film this weekend.
反正
anyway
反正 gives a reason that makes the rest not matter much.
反正房租也不是很高，所以能剩下一点钱让我们吃喝玩乐。
Fǎnzhèng fángzū yě bú shì hěn gāo, suǒyǐ néng shèngxia yìdiǎn qián ràng wǒmen chī-hē-wán-lè.
The rent wasn't high anyway, so we had a bit left over to eat, drink and have fun.
反正没事，我陪你去吧。
Fǎnzhèng méi shì, wǒ péi nǐ qù ba.
I've got nothing on anyway, so I'll go with you.
现在倒好
now look (ironic)
倒好 introduces a disappointing turn of events.
可是现在倒好，买了房，不只是买了房，
Kěshì xiànzài dào hǎo, mǎi le fáng, bù zhǐshì mǎi le fáng,
But now, look at us: we've bought a flat, and it's not just the flat.
本来想早点到，现在倒好，迟到了。
Běnlái xiǎng zǎo diǎn dào, xiànzài dào hǎo, chídào le.
I wanted to get there early, and now look: I'm late.
哪里还有……？
how could there still be …?
A rhetorical question: there's none at all.
成天看着这些账单，我们哪里还有心思出去吃喝玩乐呀？
Chéngtiān kàn zhe zhèxiē zhàngdān, wǒmen nǎli hái yǒu xīnsi chūqu chī-hē-wán-lè ya?
Staring at these bills all day, how could we be in the mood to go out and have fun?
这么忙，哪里还有时间休息？
Zhème máng, nǎli hái yǒu shíjiān xiūxi?
With this much work, how could I have time to rest?
gaps: 举个例子吧，我每次刚一发工资，
倒还是觉得非常值得、非常
say: I remember when we'd just moved into the new flat, we were delighted every day.
When my husband and I were renting, life was so good!
One day we'd go shopping, the next we'd get together with friends for a meal.
Staring at these bills all day, how could we be in the mood to go out and have fun?
So a bit of hardship is worth it. At least we have a permanent home.

030.title: Copy the tone of voice
030.sub: Ten short housing lines to imitate
030.transcriptNote: Pre-speaking practice: listen to each line and copy the speaker's tone: surprised, firm, worried, annoyed or wheedling. Several item numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 口语课前练习 · Pre-speaking practice
lines: 口语课前练习。
Kǒuyǔ kè qián liànxí.
Pre-speaking exercises.
听句子，并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng jùzi, bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the sentences and copy the speakers' tone.
租房不是挺好吗？
Zū fáng bú shì tǐng hǎo ma?
Isn't renting perfectly fine?
啊？两万五一平？我没听错吧？
A? Liǎng wàn wǔ yì píng? Wǒ méi tīngcuò ba?

没有房，我就不同意你们结婚！
Méiyǒu fáng, wǒ jiù bùtóng yì nǐmen jié hūn!
No flat, no wedding. I won't agree to it!
我妈说了，没有房，咱们就不能结婚。你看怎么办呀？
Wǒ mā shuō le, méiyǒu fáng, zánmen jiù bù néng jié hūn. Nǐ kàn zěnmebàn ya?
My mum said if we don't have a flat, we can't get married. What are we going to do?
听说了吗？中山小区的房子三万一平了。早就说让你买，你就是不买！
Tīngshuō le ma? Zhōngshān xiǎoqū de fángzi sān wàn yì píng le. Zǎojiù shuō ràng nǐ mǎi, nǐ jiùshì bù mǎi!
Have you heard? Flats on the Zhongshan estate are 30,000 a square metre now. I told you to buy ages ago, but you just wouldn't!
买买买，拿什么买？
Mǎi mǎi mǎi, ná shénme mǎi?
Buy, buy, buy! With what?
我家的房租又涨了，今年都涨了三回了。
Wǒ jiā de fángzū yòu zhǎng le, jīnnián dōu zhǎng le sān huí le.
Our rent's gone up again. That's three times this year.
房贷、装修费、电话费、保险费、孩子学费，你以为房奴是那么好当的吗？
Fángdài, zhuāngxiū fèi, diànhuà fèi, bǎoxiǎnfèi, háizi xuéfèi, nǐ yǐwéi fángnú shì nàme hǎo dāng de ma?
Mortgage, decorating, phone bill, insurance, the kids' school fees: you think being a mortgage slave is easy?
想在这个小区买房？那是在做梦！
Xiǎng zài zhège xiǎoqū mǎi fáng? Nà shì zài zuò mèng!
You want to buy a flat on this estate? Dream on!
妈，我装修还差点儿，能不能再借我五万？我一定还。
Mā, wǒ zhuāngxiū hái chà diǎnr, néng bù néng zài jiè wǒ wǔ wàn? Wǒ yídìng hái.
Mum, I'm a bit short for the decorating. Could you lend me another 50,000? I'll definitely pay you back.

grammar: 不是挺好吗？
isn't it fine?
A rhetorical question that pushes back gently.
租房不是挺好吗？
Zū fáng bú shì tǐng hǎo ma?
Isn't renting perfectly fine?
在家吃不是挺好吗？
Zài jiā chī bú shì tǐng hǎo ma?
Isn't eating at home just fine?
没有……，就不……
without …, no …
States a firm condition.
没有房，我就不同意你们结婚！
Méiyǒu fáng, wǒ jiù bùtóng yì nǐmen jié hūn!
No flat, no wedding. I won't agree to it!
没有票，就不能进去。
Méiyǒu piào, jiù bù néng jìnqù.
No ticket, no entry.
早就说……，你就是不……
I told you long ago, but you just wouldn't …
就是 + negative stresses stubbornness.
听说了吗？中山小区的房子三万一平了。早就说让你买，你就是不买！
Tīngshuō le ma? Zhōngshān xiǎoqū de fángzi sān wàn yì píng le. Zǎojiù shuō ràng nǐ mǎi, nǐ jiùshì bù mǎi!
Have you heard? Flats on the Zhongshan estate are 30,000 a square metre now. I told you to buy ages ago, but you just wouldn't!
早就让你早点睡，你就是不听。
Zǎojiù ràng nǐ zǎo diǎn shuì, nǐ jiùshì bù tīng.
I told you to go to bed early, but you just wouldn't listen.
V + V + V，拿什么 + V？
…, …, …! With what?
Repeating the verb three times mocks the suggestion.
买买买，拿什么买？
Mǎi mǎi mǎi, ná shénme mǎi?
Buy, buy, buy! With what?
吃吃吃，就知道吃！
Chī chī chī, jiù zhīdao chī!
Eat, eat, eat! That's all you think about!
你以为……吗？
you think …?
Challenges a mistaken assumption.
房贷、装修费、电话费、保险费、孩子学费，你以为房奴是那么好当的吗？
Fángdài, zhuāngxiū fèi, diànhuà fèi, bǎoxiǎnfèi, háizi xuéfèi, nǐ yǐwéi fángnú shì nàme hǎo dāng de ma?
Mortgage, decorating, phone bill, insurance, the kids' school fees: you think being a mortgage slave is easy?
你以为学汉语很容易吗？
Nǐ yǐwéi xué Hànyǔ hěn róngyì ma?
You think learning Chinese is easy?
都……了
already …
都 + number + 了 stresses that it's already a lot.
我家的房租又涨了，今年都涨了三回了。
Wǒ jiā de fángzū yòu zhǎng le, jīnnián dōu zhǎng le sān huí le.
Our rent's gone up again. That's three times this year.
我都等了一个小时了！
Wǒ dōu děng le yí ge xiǎoshí le!
I've already waited an hour!

费、电话费、保险费、孩子学费

What? 25,000 a square metre? Did I hear that right?
Buy, buy, buy! With what?
Mortgage, decorating, phone bill, insurance, the kids' school fees: you think being a mortgage slave is easy?
Mum, I'm a bit short for the decorating. Could you lend me another 50,000? I'll definitely pay you back.

031.title: "Can't be long now"
031.sub: A father asks his son when the wedding will be
031.transcriptNote: 爸 is the father and 儿 is his son. Listen and copy their tone. Near the end, the son's 我不能再要了 ("I can't take any more") is my best reading of a phrase both models heard as 再行.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听对话并模仿 · Listen and imitate
lines: 听对话并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng duìhuà bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone.

blocks.label: 对话
blocks.h: 爸爸和儿子 · Father and son
lines: 儿子，你和月月的事儿啥时候办啊？
Érzi, nǐ hé yuè yuè de shìr shá shíhou bàn a?
Son, when are you and Yueyue going to tie the knot?
爸
啊，这不是等着咱们家的房子吗？

你不是交完首付了吗？

爸

儿

我和你妈想早点抱孙子，我们留那么多钱有什么用？最后还不都是你们的？
Wǒ hé nǐ mā xiǎng zǎo diǎn bào sūnzi, wǒmen liú nàme duō qián yǒu shénme yòng? Zuìhòu hái bù dōu shì nǐmen de?

grammar: 这不是……吗？
isn't it that …?
A rhetorical question giving an obvious reason.
啊，这不是等着咱们家的房子吗？

Well, aren't we waiting for our flat?
这不是你的书吗？
Zhè bú shì nǐ de shū ma?
Isn't this your book?
不是……了吗？
haven't you already …?

Nǐ bú shì jiāo wán shǒufù le ma?

你不是吃过饭了吗？
Nǐ bú shì chī guo fàn le ma?

哪儿能那么 + adj

哪儿能那么容易？

有什么用？

Wǒ hé nǐ mā xiǎng zǎo diǎn bào sūnzi, wǒmen liú nàme duō qián yǒu shénme yòng? Zuìhòu hái bù dōu shì nǐmen de?
Your mum and I want a grandchild soon. What's the use of us keeping all that money? It'll all be yours in the end anyway.
现在后悔有什么用？
Xiànzài hòuhuǐ yǒu shénme yòng?

还不都是……？
isn't it all …?

032.title: Drifting in Beijing
032.sub: The lesson text: Xie Nan's eight years in the capital
032.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. Xie Nan came to Beijing after university and is still trying to buy a home of his own.

lines: 漂在北京
Piāo zài Běijīng
Drifting in Beijing
俗话说：“人往高处走，水往低处流。”
Súhuà shuō: "Rén wǎng gāochù zǒu, shuǐ wǎng dī chù liú."
As the saying goes: "People strive upward, water flows downward."
八年前的夏天，年轻的谢楠带着梦想离开了熟悉的城市，
Bā nián qián de xiàtiān, niánqīng de Xiè Nán dài zhe mèngxiǎng líkāi le shúxī de chéngshì,
Eight years ago one summer, young Xie Nan left his familiar city with a dream in his heart
坐上了开往北京的火车，去寻找更好的发展机会。
zuò shàng le kāiwǎng Běijīng de huǒchē, qù xúnzhǎo gèng hǎo de fāzhǎn jīhuì.
and boarded a train to Beijing to look for better opportunities.
刚到首都时，谢楠十分兴奋，觉得离人生梦想更近了。
Gāng dào shǒudū shí, Xiè Nán shífēn xīngfèn, juéde lí rénshēng mèngxiǎng gèng jìn le.
When he first arrived in the capital, Xie Nan was very excited. He felt closer to his dream.
但他很快就发现，工作并不容易。
Dàn tā hěn kuài jiù fāxiàn, gōngzuò bìng bù róngyì.
But he soon found that work wasn't easy to come by.
刚刚大学毕业的他，既没有工作经验，在北京也没有熟人。
Gānggāng dàxué bìyè de tā, jì méiyǒu gōngzuò jīngyàn, zài Běijīng yě méiyǒu shúrén.
Fresh out of university, he had no work experience and knew nobody in Beijing.
除了一堆证书，他什么都没有，甚至连一个固定的住处也没有。
Chúle yì duī zhèngshū, tā shénme dōu méiyǒu, shènzhì lián yí ge gùdìng de zhùchù yě méiyǒu.
Apart from a pile of certificates he had nothing, not even a fixed place to live.
以前总是听说“北漂”，结果没想到自己也成了其中的一员。
Yǐqián zǒngshì tīngshuō "běipiāo", jiéguǒ méi xiǎngdào zìjǐ yě chéng le qízhōng de yì yuán.
He'd always heard of the "Beijing drifters", and never imagined he'd become one himself.
那段时间，根本没有心思做别的事儿，
Nà duàn shíjiān, gēnběn méiyǒu xīnsi zuò biéde shìr,
During that time he had no mind for anything else.
成天就是到处询问工作的事儿，
chéngtiān jiùshì dàochù xúnwèn gōngzuò de shìr,
All day long he went around asking about jobs,
不停地投简历，然后参加面试，面试失败以后，又重新开始。
bù tíng de tóu jiǎnlì, ránhòu cānjiā miànshì, miànshì shībài yǐhòu, yòu chóngxīn kāishǐ.
sending out CV after CV, going to interviews, and starting all over again when they failed.
这段经历，至今都令他难忘。
Zhè duàn jīnglì, zhìjīn dōu lìng tā nánwàng.
He still can't forget that time.
幸运的是，几个月后，有一家IT公司跟他签了工作合同。
Xìngyùn de shì, jǐ ge yuè hòu, yǒu yì jiāITgōngsī gēn tā qiān le gōngzuò hétóng.
Luckily, a few months later an IT company signed a work contract with him.
这让跟他一起挤地下室的兄弟们十分羡慕。
Zhè ràng gēn tā yìqǐ jǐ dìxiàshì de xiōngdì men shífēn xiànmù.
The guys he shared a cramped basement with were very envious.
为了给他庆祝，一群年轻人喝得大醉。
Wèile gěi tā qìngzhù, yì qún niánqīngrén hē de dà zuì.
To celebrate, the whole group of young men got very drunk.
谢楠工作得非常努力，每天早出晚归。
Xiè Nán gōngzuò de fēicháng nǔlì, měitiān zǎo chū wǎn guī.
Xie Nan worked very hard, leaving early and coming home late every day.
离他的办公室不远，就是这个国家最著名的两所大学：清华和北大。
Lí tā de bàngōngshì bù yuǎn, jiùshì zhège guójiā zuì zhùmíng de liǎng suǒ dàxué: Qīnghuá hé Běidà.
Not far from his office are the country's two most famous universities: Tsinghua and Peking University.
北京有一百多所大学，大企业多得数不清。
Běijīng yǒu yì bǎi duō suǒ dàxué, dà qǐyè duō de shǔ bu qīng.
Beijing has more than a hundred universities, and countless big companies.
谢楠觉得，这大概是无数年轻人愿意来北京的原因之一。
Xiè Nán juéde, zhè dàgài shì wúshù niánqīngrén yuànyì lái Běijīng de yuányīn zhīyī.
Xie Nan thinks this is probably one of the reasons so many young people want to come to Beijing.
在这里，社会资源很丰富，优秀的人非常多，
Zài zhèli, shèhuì zīyuán hěn fēngfù, yōuxiù de rén fēicháng duō,
Here, social resources are rich and there are lots of outstanding people,
跟自己有共同语言的人也很多。
gēn zìjǐ yǒu gòngtóng yǔyán de rén yě hěn duō.
and plenty of people who speak your language.
每个月末发工资以后，谢楠的第一件事儿就是计划下个月的花销。
Měi ge yuèmò fā gōngzī yǐhòu, Xiè Nán de dì-yī jiàn shìr jiùshì jìhuà xià ge yuè de huāxiao.
At the end of every month, after payday, the first thing Xie Nan does is plan next month's spending.
他的手机上有一个软件，每天都会仔细地记录这一天花的钱。
Tā de shǒujī shàng yǒu yí ge ruǎnjiàn, měitiān dōu huì zǐxì de jìlù zhè yì tiān huā de qián.
He has an app on his phone and carefully records what he spends every day.
工作以后，为了省钱，谢楠和几个同事一起租了一套房。
Gōngzuò yǐhòu, wèile shěng qián, Xiè Nán hé jǐ ge tóngshì yìqǐ zū le yí tào fáng.
Since he started work, he has shared a rented flat with a few colleagues to save money.
他也很少逛街。即使这样，他每个月也存不下钱，还是月光族。
Tā yě hěn shǎo guàng jiē. Jíshǐ zhèyàng, tā měi ge yuè yě cún bu xià qián, háishi yuèguāngzú.
He rarely goes shopping either. Even so, he can't save anything each month; he still spends it all.
账单永远太多，花钱的速度永远比挣钱快。
Zhàngdān yǒngyuǎn tài duō, huā qián de sùdù yǒngyuǎn bǐ zhèng qián kuài.
There are always too many bills, and money always goes out faster than it comes in.
谢楠租的房间不到十平方米，无任何装修。
Xiè Nán zū de fángjiān bú dào shí píngfāngmǐ, wú rènhé zhuāngxiū.
The room Xie Nan rents is under ten square metres, with no decoration at all.
在这里暂时住一下还行，
Zài zhèli zànshí zhù yíxià hái xíng,
It's all right to stay here for a while,
想要长期在北京生活，结婚生子，还是得买房。
xiǎng yào chángqī zài Běijīng shēnghuó, jié hūn shēng zǐ, háishi de mǎi fáng.
but to live in Beijing long term, marry and have children, he'll have to buy.
但付完房租，剩余的钱就不多了。
Dàn fù wán fángzū, shèngyú de qián jiù bù duō le.
But after paying the rent there's not much left.
他的工资只够应付生活，
Tā de gōngzī zhǐ gòu yìngfu shēnghuó,
His salary only just covers his living costs.
即使父母可以帮他付首付，他也根本还不起每个月的贷款。
jíshǐ fùmǔ kěyǐ bāng tā fù shǒufù, tā yě gēnběn hái bù qǐ měi ge yuè de dàikuǎn.
Even if his parents could help with the deposit, he could never afford the monthly repayments.
每次想到这个，他就感到有巨大的压力，
Měicì xiǎngdào zhège, tā jiù gǎndào yǒu jùdà de yālì,
Every time he thinks about it he feels enormous pressure,
觉得没房子这事儿，阻碍了他过上幸福的生活。
juéde méi fángzi zhè shìr, zǔ'ài le tā guo shàng xìngfú de shēnghuó.
as if not having a home is standing between him and a happy life.
什么时候才能拥有属于自己的窝呢？
Shénme shíhou cái néng yōngyǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de wō ne?
When will he ever have a nest of his own?
今年是在北京的第八年，过三年，谢楠就要三十岁了。
Jīnnián shì zài Běijīng de dì bā nián, guò sān nián, Xiè Nán jiù yào sān shí suì le.
This is his eighth year in Beijing. In three years Xie Nan will be thirty.
他已经渐渐适应了北京的生活节奏，
Tā yǐjīng jiànjiàn shìyìng le Běijīng de shēnghuó jiézòu,
He has gradually got used to the pace of life in Beijing,
还是觉得自己像一片漂浮在水面上的树叶。
háishi juéde zìjǐ xiàng yí piàn piāofú zài shuǐmiàn shàng de shùyè.
but he still feels like a leaf floating on the water.
这座城市给了他一份工作和一间出租屋，却没有给他安全感。
Zhè zuò chéngshì gěi le tā yí fèn gōngzuò hé yì jiān chūzū wū, què méiyǒu gěi tā ānquángǎn.
The city has given him a job and a rented room, but not a sense of security.
工资涨了，现在，他每个月可以存一部分，再寄一点给家里。
Gōngzī zhǎng le, xiànzài, tā měi ge yuè kěyǐ cún yí bùfen, zài jì yìdiǎn gěi jiā li.
His salary has gone up. Now he can save some each month and send a little home.
他也有了一辆小车，但仍然没有实现买房的梦想。
Tā yě yǒu le yí liàng xiǎochē, dàn réngrán méiyǒu shíxiàn mǎi fáng de mèngxiǎng.
He has a small car too, but he still hasn't achieved his dream of buying a home.
这几年，房价不但没有下降，反而不断地上涨。
Zhè jǐ nián, fángjià búdàn méiyǒu xiàjiàng, fǎn'ér búduàn de shàngzhǎng.
In recent years house prices haven't fallen; on the contrary, they've kept rising.
不少朋友被迫离开了北京，但谢楠舍不得走。
Bù shǎo péngyou bèipò líkāi le Běijīng, dàn Xiè Nán shěbude zǒu.
Quite a few friends have been forced to leave Beijing, but Xie Nan can't bear to go.
这里是他奋斗了八年的地方。
Zhèli shì tā fèndòu le bā nián de dìfang.
This is where he has struggled for eight years.
他觉得，这种为梦想努力奋斗的感觉很充实。
Tā juéde, zhè zhǒng wèi mèngxiǎng nǔlì fèndòu de gǎnjué hěn chōngshí.
He feels that striving hard for a dream is fulfilling.
更重要的是，在这里，他已经找到了一份幸福的爱情。
Gèng zhòngyào de shì, zài zhèli, tā yǐjīng zhǎodào le yí fèn xìngfú de àiqíng.
More importantly, he has found happy love here.

vocab: to leave early and return late
people who spend their whole pay each month
not only not …, but on the contrary …
grammar: 离……更近了
closer to …
离 + goal + 近 says how close something is.
刚到首都时，谢楠十分兴奋，觉得离人生梦想更近了。
Gāng dào shǒudū shí, Xiè Nán shífēn xīngfèn, juéde lí rénshēng mèngxiǎng gèng jìn le.
When he first arrived in the capital, Xie Nan was very excited. He felt closer to his dream.
我们离目标越来越近了。
Wǒmen lí mùbiāo yuèláiyuè jìn le.
We're getting closer and closer to our goal.
既没有……，也没有……
neither … nor …
既 + 也 joins two negatives.
刚刚大学毕业的他，既没有工作经验，在北京也没有熟人。
Gānggāng dàxué bìyè de tā, jì méiyǒu gōngzuò jīngyàn, zài Běijīng yě méiyǒu shúrén.
Fresh out of university, he had no work experience and knew nobody in Beijing.
他既没有钱，也没有时间。
Tā jì méiyǒu qián, yě méiyǒu shíjiān.
He has neither money nor time.
除了……，什么都没有
apart from …, nothing
除了 sets aside the one thing; everything else is missing.
除了一堆证书，他什么都没有，甚至连一个固定的住处也没有。
Chúle yì duī zhèngshū, tā shénme dōu méiyǒu, shènzhì lián yí ge gùdìng de zhùchù yě méiyǒu.
Apart from a pile of certificates he had nothing, not even a fixed place to live.
除了一张床，房间里什么都没有。
Chúle yì zhāng chuáng, fángjiān li shénme dōu méiyǒu.
There's nothing in the room apart from a bed.
甚至连……也……
not even …
甚至 adds an extreme case, and 连……也 marks it.
除了一堆证书，他什么都没有，甚至连一个固定的住处也没有。
Chúle yì duī zhèngshū, tā shénme dōu méiyǒu, shènzhì lián yí ge gùdìng de zhùchù yě méiyǒu.
Apart from a pile of certificates he had nothing, not even a fixed place to live.
他太忙了，甚至连饭也顾不上吃。
Tā tài máng le, shènzhì lián fàn yě gù bu shàng chī.
He's so busy he doesn't even have time to eat.
even if …, still …
即使 gives a condition, and 也 says the result holds anyway.
他也很少逛街。即使这样，他每个月也存不下钱，还是月光族。
Tā yě hěn shǎo guàng jiē. Jíshǐ zhèyàng, tā měi ge yuè yě cún bu xià qián, háishi yuèguāngzú.
He rarely goes shopping either. Even so, he can't save anything each month; he still spends it all.
即使下雨，我也要去。
Jíshǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
Even if it rains, I'm going.
V + 不起
can't afford to …
不起 after a verb means lacking money for it.
即使父母可以帮他付首付，他也根本还不起每个月的贷款。
jíshǐ fùmǔ kěyǐ bāng tā fù shǒufù, tā yě gēnběn hái bù qǐ měi ge yuè de dàikuǎn.
Even if his parents could help with the deposit, he could never afford the monthly repayments.
这么贵的房子，我买不起。
Zhème guì de fángzi, wǒ mǎi bu qǐ.
I can't afford such an expensive flat.
不但没有……，反而……
not only didn't …, but on the contrary …
The second half is the opposite of what was expected.
这几年，房价不但没有下降，反而不断地上涨。
Zhè jǐ nián, fángjià búdàn méiyǒu xiàjiàng, fǎn'ér búduàn de shàngzhǎng.
In recent years house prices haven't fallen; on the contrary, they've kept rising.
吃了药，病不但没好，反而更重了。
Chī le yào, bìng búdàn méi hǎo, fǎn'ér gèng zhòng le.
After taking the medicine, he didn't get better; he got worse.
舍不得 + V
can't bear to …
舍不得 means reluctant to give something up or leave.
不少朋友被迫离开了北京，但谢楠舍不得走。
Bù shǎo péngyou bèipò líkāi le Běijīng, dàn Xiè Nán shěbude zǒu.
Quite a few friends have been forced to leave Beijing, but Xie Nan can't bear to go.
这件衣服太贵了，我舍不得买。
Zhè jiàn yīfu tài guì le, wǒ shěbude mǎi.
This is too expensive; I can't bring myself to buy it.
gaps: 年轻的谢楠带着梦想离开了
刚刚大学毕业的他，既没有工作
不停地投简历，然后参加
幸运的是，几个月后，有一家IT公司跟他签了工作
他也很少逛街。即使这样，他每个月也存不下钱，还是
这座城市给了他一份工作和一间出租屋，却没有给他
不少朋友被迫离开了北京，但谢楠
say: As the saying goes: "People strive upward, water flows downward."
But he soon found that work wasn't easy to come by.
He still can't forget that time.
There are always too many bills, and money always goes out faster than it comes in.
In recent years house prices haven't fallen; on the contrary, they've kept rising.
More importantly, he has found happy love here.

033.title: Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou: leave or stay?
033.sub: Reading B: why young people leave the big cities, and why some come back
033.transcriptNote: The second lesson text, read as a report and split into paragraphs. The reader repeats three sentences in paragraph 3; the repeat is kept as a separate line so the timings still match the audio.

lines: 北上广：逃离还是坚持
Běi-Shàng-Guǎng: táolí háishi jiānchí
Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou: leave or stay?
北京、上海、广州这样的一线城市是很多老百姓心中的高处，
Běijīng, Shànghǎi, Guǎngzhōu zhèyàng de yīxiàn chéngshì shì hěn duō lǎobǎixìng xīnzhōng de gāochù,
First-tier cities like Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou are the "high ground" in many ordinary people's minds.
年轻人希望通过奋斗在这里得到一片属于自己的天地。
niánqīngrén xīwàng tōngguò fèndòu zài zhèli dédào yí piàn shǔyú zìjǐ de tiāndì.
Young people hope to win a place of their own there through hard work.
然而，不少年轻人在这些城市奋斗数年后，选择重新回到二三线城市发展。
Rán'ér, bù shǎo niánqīngrén zài zhèxiē chéngshì fèndòu shùnián hòu, xuǎnzé chóngxīn huídào èr sān xiàn chéngshì fāzhǎn.
Yet many young people, after years of struggle in these cities, choose to go back to second- and third-tier cities.
这种现象被称为“逃离北上广”。
Zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng bèi chēngwéi "táolí Běi-Shàng-Guǎng".
This is called "fleeing Bei-Shang-Guang".
哪些原因造成了他们的逃离呢？
Nǎxiē yuányīn zàochéng le tāmen de táolí ne?
What makes them leave?
一方面，外地人在大城市越过越难。
Yì fāngmiàn, wàidìrén zài dà chéngshì yuèguò yuè nán.
On the one hand, life in the big cities is getting harder and harder for people from elsewhere.
越来越多的外地人进入一线城市，
Yuèláiyuè duō de wàidìrén jìnrù yīxiàn chéngshì,
More and more outsiders are coming into first-tier cities,
但城市的公共服务却没有同时得到发展，
dàn chéngshì de gōnggòng fúwù què méiyǒu tóngshí dédào fāzhǎn,
but public services haven't developed at the same pace.
教育、医疗等公共资源提供不足，
jiàoyù, yīliáo děng gōnggòng zīyuán tígōng bùzú,
There's too little education, healthcare and other public provision,
尤其是向中低收入群体和流动人口提供不足。
yóuqí shì xiàng zhōng dī shōurù qúntǐ hé liúdòng rénkǒu tígōng bùzú.
especially for low- and middle-income groups and migrants.
根据一份来自网络的统计，百分之五十四点七的八零后选择逃离北上广，
Gēnjù yí fèn láizì wǎngluò de tǒngjì, bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí sì diǎn qī de bā-líng hòu xuǎnzé táolí Běi-Shàng-Guǎng,
According to an online survey, 54.7% of people born in the 1980s chose to leave Bei-Shang-Guang.
最直接的原因是飞涨的房价，
zuì zhíjiē de yuányīn shì fēizhǎng de fángjià,
The most direct reason is soaring house prices,
使年轻人在一线城市安居乐业变得越来越难。
shǐ niánqīngrén zài yīxiàn chéngshì ānjū-lèyè biàn de yuèláiyuè nán.
which make it ever harder for young people to settle down in first-tier cities.
百分之三十一的逃离者认为，受户口影响，一线城市存在社会福利不公平的现象。
Bǎi fēn zhī sānshí yī de táolí zhě rènwéi, shòu hùkǒu yǐngxiǎng, yīxiàn chéngshì cúnzài shèhuì fúlì bù gōngpíng de xiànxiàng.
31% of those who left think that, because of the household registration system, social welfare in first-tier cities is unfair.
另外，一些人认为，大城市竞争激烈，工作压力大、消费高，不值得留下来。
Lìngwài, yìxiē rén rènwéi, dà chéngshì jìngzhēng jīliè, gōngzuò yālì dà, xiāofèi gāo, bù zhíde liú xialai.
Others think big cities are fiercely competitive, with high work pressure and high costs, so it isn't worth staying.
另一方面，二三线城市对年轻人的吸引力增强。
Lìng yì fāngmiàn, èr sān xiàn chéngshì duì niánqīngrén de xīyǐnlì zēngqiáng.
On the other hand, second- and third-tier cities are becoming more attractive to young people.
随着城市的发展，中小城市提供越来越多的社会资源、就业机会和公共服务。
Suízhe chéngshì de fāzhǎn, zhōng xiǎo chéng shì tígōng yuèláiyuè duō de shèhuì zīyuán, jiùyè jīhuì hé gōnggòng fúwù.
As they develop, small and medium-sized cities offer more and more social resources, jobs and public services.
同时，在这里工作竞争压力相对小，
Tóngshí, zài zhèli gōngzuò jìngzhēng yālì xiāngduì xiǎo,
At the same time, competition at work there is relatively low,
购买商品房相对容易实现，
gòumǎi shāngpǐnfáng xiāngduì róngyì shíxiàn,
buying a flat is relatively achievable,
户口问题也相对容易解决。
hùkǒu wèntí yě xiāngduì róngyì jiějué.
and household registration is relatively easy to sort out.
同时，在这里，工作竞争压力相对小，
Tóngshí, zài zhèli, gōngzuò jìngzhēng yālì xiāngduì xiǎo,
(repeated) At the same time, competition at work there is relatively low,
购买商品房相对容易实现，
gòumǎi shāngpǐnfáng xiāngduì róngyì shíxiàn,
(repeated) buying a flat is relatively achievable,
户口问题也相对容易解决。
hùkǒu wèntí yě xiāngduì róngyì jiějué.
(repeated) and household registration is relatively easy to sort out.
究竟应该走还是留？这个选择并不容易。
Jiūjìng yīnggāi zǒu háishi liú? Zhège xuǎnzé bìng bù róngyì.
Should you go or stay? It's not an easy choice.
于东是公司白领，他认为，
Yú Dōng shì gōngsī báilǐng, tā rènwéi,
Yu Dong is an office worker. He believes
离开了大城市，就意味着放弃了出人头地的机会。
líkāi le dà chéngshì, jiù yìwèizhe fàngqì le chūréntóudì de jīhuì.
leaving the big city means giving up the chance to get ahead.
这使他内心很矛盾。
Zhè shǐ tā nèixīn hěn máodùn.
This leaves him torn.
即使这个城市让他感到有巨大的压力，他也没有说走就走的勇气。
Jíshǐ zhège chéngshì ràng tā gǎndào yǒu jùdà de yālì, tā yě méiyǒu shuō zǒu jiù zǒu de yǒngqì.
Even though the city puts him under enormous pressure, he doesn't have the nerve to just up and leave.
当然，大城市有大的难处，小城市也有小的烦恼。
Dāngrán, dà chéngshì yǒu dà de nánchu, xiǎo chéngshì yě yǒu xiǎo de fánnǎo.
Of course, big cities have big problems, and small cities have their own worries.
也有的人逃离了北上广，几年后又逃回来了。
Yě yǒu de rén táolí le Běi-Shàng-Guǎng, jǐ nián hòu yòu táo huílai le.
Some people who fled Bei-Shang-Guang fled back a few years later.
原因是他们回到小城市后，却发现自己并不适应。
Yuányīn shì tāmen huídào xiǎo chéngshì hòu, què fāxiàn zìjǐ bìng bú shìyìng.
The reason is that after going back to a small city, they found they didn't fit in.
因为越小的地方越是一个熟人社会，做事情更要讲关系，论人情，

grammar: 比别人更 + adj

被别人 + V
to be …ed by others

in order to …

adj + 地 + V
-ly
地 links a manner word to the verb.

Hěn chīlì, bú yuànyì, bù gāoxìng de zuò mǒushì.

Tā gāoxìng de shuō.

blocks.h: 判断两个句子的意思是否相符 · Same meaning or not?
lines: 听录音，判断两个句子的意思是否相符。
Tīng lùyīn, pànduàn liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu xiāngfú.
Listen and decide whether the two sentences mean the same.
社会竞争很激烈，不努力就要被淘汰。
Shèhuì jìngzhēng hěn jīliè, bù nǔlì jiù yào bèi táotài.
Competition in society is fierce. If you don't work hard, you'll be weeded out.
A
必须要好好努力，要不然就会被别人淘汰。
Bìxū yào hǎohǎo nǔlì, yào bùrán jiù huì bèi biérén táotài.
You must work hard, otherwise others will push you out.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say you must work hard or be eliminated.

lines: 很多家长都望子成龙。
Hěn duō jiāzhǎng dōu wàng zǐ chéng lóng.
Many parents hope their children will be great successes.
A
很多父母都希望自己的孩子在学业和事业上取得成就。
Hěn duō fùmǔ dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi zài xuéyè hé shìyè shang qǔdé chéngjiù.
Many parents hope their children will succeed in their studies and careers.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: 望子成龙 means exactly this.

lines: 刘奶奶很怕孩子玩电脑，耽误学习。
Liú nǎinai hěn pà háizi wán diànnǎo, dānwu xuéxí.
Granny Liu is afraid the child's computer games will hold back his studies.
A
刘奶奶很怕孩子只玩电脑，不好好学习。
Liú nǎinai hěn pà háizi zhǐ wán diànnǎo, bù hǎohǎo xuéxí.
Granny Liu is afraid the child will only play on the computer and not study properly.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say she fears the computer will get in the way of studying.

lines: 妈妈掀开了被子，看见儿子睡得正香，一动也不动。
Māma xiānkāi le bèizi, kànjiàn érzi shuì de zhèng xiāng, yí dòng yě búdòng.
Mum threw back the quilt and saw her son fast asleep, not moving at all.
A
儿子翻了翻身，打了个哈欠，头缩进了被窝，又睡了过去。
Érzi fān le fānshēn, dǎ le ge hāqian, tóu suōjìn le bèiwō, yòu shuì le guòqu.
The son rolled over, yawned, pulled his head under the quilt and fell asleep again.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: In A he doesn't move at all; in B he rolls over and yawns.

lines: 不让孩子小时候多学习，我怕孩子长大以后什么本事都没有，他会跟我抱怨。
Bú ràng háizi xiǎoshíhou duō xuéxí, wǒ pà háizi zhǎngdà yǐhòu shénme běnshi dōu méiyǒu, tā huì gēn wǒ bàoyuàn.
If I don't make my child study more while he's young, I'm afraid he'll grow up with no skills and complain to me.
A
现在让他多学点本事，以后长大了，他就不会是个爱抱怨的人。
Xiànzài ràng tā duō xué diǎn běnshi, yǐhòu zhǎngdà le, tā jiù bú huì shì ge ài bàoyuàn de rén.
If he learns more skills now, he won't grow up to be someone who's always complaining.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A fears he'll blame the parent; B says he won't become a complainer in general.

vocab: to hope one's child will succeed
grammar: 要不然
otherwise
Introduces what happens if the first part isn't done.
必须要好好努力，要不然就会被别人淘汰。
Bìxū yào hǎohǎo nǔlì, yào bùrán jiù huì bèi biérén táotài.
You must work hard, otherwise others will push you out.
快走吧，要不然就迟到了。
Kuài zǒu ba, yào bùrán jiù chídào le.
Let's go, or we'll be late.
怕 + clause
to be afraid that …
怕 can take a whole clause.
刘奶奶很怕孩子玩电脑，耽误学习。
Liú nǎinai hěn pà háizi wán diànnǎo, dānwu xuéxí.
Granny Liu is afraid the child's computer games will hold back his studies.
我怕他不来。
Wǒ pà tā bù lái.
I'm afraid he won't come.
一 + V + 也不 + V
not … at all
一 + verb + 也不/都不 + same verb is a strong negative.
妈妈掀开了被子，看见儿子睡得正香，一动也不动。
Māma xiānkāi le bèizi, kànjiàn érzi shuì de zhèng xiāng, yí dòng yě búdòng.
Mum threw back the quilt and saw her son fast asleep, not moving at all.
他一句话也不说。
Tā yí jù huà yě bù shuō.
He doesn't say a word.
V + 了 + V (翻了翻身)
to … a bit
Repeating a one-syllable verb around 了 shows a short action.
儿子翻了翻身，打了个哈欠，头缩进了被窝，又睡了过去。
Érzi fān le fānshēn, dǎ le ge hāqian, tóu suōjìn le bèiwō, yòu shuì le guòqu.
The son rolled over, yawned, pulled his head under the quilt and fell asleep again.
他看了看表。
Tā kàn le kàn biǎo.
He glanced at his watch.
什么 + O + 都没有
no … at all
什么 + 都 + negative means none whatsoever.
不让孩子小时候多学习，我怕孩子长大以后什么本事都没有，他会跟我抱怨。
Bú ràng háizi xiǎoshíhou duō xuéxí, wǒ pà háizi zhǎngdà yǐhòu shénme běnshi dōu méiyǒu, tā huì gēn wǒ bàoyuàn.
If I don't make my child study more while he's young, I'm afraid he'll grow up with no skills and complain to me.
冰箱里什么吃的都没有。
Bīngxiāng li shénme chī de dōu méiyǒu.
There's nothing to eat in the fridge.

刘奶奶很怕孩子玩电脑，
我怕孩子长大以后什么
