040.title: Should he go to cram school?
040.transcriptNote: The holidays are coming, and Lao Zhou can't decide whether to send his ten-year-old son to cram school or a special-skills class. Ten people give their views. Decide whether each one is for or against, then turn on Answers. Several item numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断说话人的意思 · What does the speaker think?
lines: 判断说话人的意思。
Pànduàn shuōhuàrén de yìsi.
Work out what the speaker means.
马上就要放假了，老周不知道该不该送十岁的儿子参加补习班、特长班。
Mǎshàng jiù yào fàng jià le, Lǎo Zhōu bù zhīdao gāi bù gāi sòng shí suì de érzi cānjiā bǔxíbān, tècháng bān.
The holidays are almost here, and Lao Zhou doesn't know whether to send his ten-year-old son to cram school or a special-skills class.
下面是一些人对此的看法，你觉得他们的态度是什么？
Xiàmiàn shì yìxiē rén duì cǐ de kànfǎ, nǐ juéde tāmen de tàidu shì shénme?
Here are some people's views on this. What do you think their attitudes are?
现在的孩子压力多大呀！
Xiànzài de háizi yālì duō dà ya!
Kids today are under so much pressure!
你看看那些特长班、补习班里的小孩，有几个是开开心心、快快乐乐的？
Nǐ kànkan nàxiē tècháng bān, bǔxíbān li de xiǎohái, yǒu jǐ ge shì kāi kāixīn xīn, kuài kuàilè lè de?
Look at the kids in those special-skills and cram classes. How many of them are happy and cheerful?
现在不学，以后想学就晚了。你家又不是没有这个条件，千万别耽误了孩子呀。
Xiànzài bù xué, yǐhòu xiǎng xué jiù wǎn le. Nǐ jiā yòu bú shì méiyǒu zhège tiáojiàn, qiānwàn bié dānwu le háizi ya.
If he doesn't learn now, it'll be too late later. It's not as if your family can't afford it. Whatever you do, don't hold your child back.
你看看人家小刘的儿子，五岁开始学小提琴，现在九岁半，出国表演好几回了。
Nǐ kànkan rénjia Xiǎo Liú de érzi, wǔ suì kāishǐ xué xiǎotíqín, xiànzài jiǔ suì bàn, chū guó biǎoyǎn hǎo jǐ huí le.
Look at Xiao Liu's son. He started the violin at five, and now at nine and a half he's already performed abroad several times.
小刘让儿子学琴就对了。
Xiǎo Liú ràng érzi xué qín jiù duìle.
Xiao Liu was right to make his son learn.
我也是不想让咱家孩子那么累，本来课就够多了。
Wǒ yě shì bù xiǎng ràng zán jiā háizi nàme lèi, běnlái kè jiù gòu duō le.
I don't want our kid to be so worn out either. He already has enough lessons.
可是没有办法呀，他同学全报班了，你也好好想想吧。
Kěshì méiyǒu bànfǎ ya, tā tóngxué quán bào bān le, nǐ yě hǎohǎo xiǎngxiang ba.
But what can you do? All his classmates have signed up. You should think it over.
现在不赶快学，开学后，看见别的孩子都学会了，就你还不会，
Xiànzài bù gǎnkuài xué, kāi xué hòu, kànjiàn biéde háizi dōu xuéhuì le, jiù nǐ hái bú huì,
If he doesn't hurry up and learn now, once term starts he'll see the other kids have all learned it and he's the only one who hasn't.
那时候，孩子和大人就会着急了。
nà shíhou, háizi hé dàrén jiù huì zháojí le.
Then both the child and the parents will start to panic.
上数学班每天要家长接送，而且学费很贵，一千五呢。
Shàng shùxué bān měitiān yào jiāzhǎng jiēsòng, érqiě xuéfèi hěn guì, yì qiān wǔ ne.
A maths class means a parent has to take him and pick him up every day, and the fees are steep: 1,500.
你儿子数学不差，我看上这个班不值。
Nǐ érzi shùxué bú chà, wǒ kàn shàng zhège bān bù zhí.
Your son isn't bad at maths. I don't think the class is worth it.
现在这个社会就是这样，谁不学，谁就被淘汰，适者生存嘛。
Xiànzài zhège shèhuì jiùshì zhèyàng, shéi bù xué, shéi jiù bèi táotài, shì zhě shēng cún ma.
That's just how society is now. Whoever doesn't learn gets left behind. Survival of the fittest.
咱当家长的就应该不惜一切给孩子创造好的环境和学习条件。
Zán dāng jiāzhǎng de jiù yīnggāi bùxī yíqiè gěi háizi chuàngzào hǎo de huánjìng hé xuéxí tiáojiàn.
As parents, we should spare nothing to give our kids a good environment and good conditions to study.
不能不管孩子是否有兴趣学。你儿子如果不想学，就不要成天逼他嘛。
Bù néng bùguǎn háizi shìfǒu yǒu xìngqù xué. Nǐ érzi rúguǒ bù xiǎng xué, jiù bú yào chéngtiān bī tā ma.
You can't ignore whether the child is interested. If your son doesn't want to learn, don't keep forcing him.
再说了，谁能保证上补习班就一定能有出息？
Zàishuō le, shéi néng bǎozhèng shàng bǔxíbān jiù yídìng néng yǒu chūxi?
Besides, who can promise that cram school will make him a success?
我小时候也是不爱上什么特长班，总偷懒儿，也总跟我爸抱怨。
Wǒ xiǎoshíhou yě shì bú ài shàng shénme tècháng bān, zǒng tōulǎnr, yě zǒng gēn wǒ bà bàoyuàn.
When I was little I didn't like going to special-skills classes either. I was always slacking and always complaining to my dad.
现在想想，那时候学就对了。
Xiànzài xiǎngxiang, nà shíhou xué jiù duìle.
Thinking about it now, it was right to learn back then.
你什么都懂点儿，到哪儿去，自信心也强啊。
Nǐ shénme dōu dǒng diǎnr, dào nǎr qù, zìxìnxīn yě qiáng a.
If you know a bit about everything, you feel confident wherever you go.
所以，我还真得感谢我爸。
Suǒyǐ, wǒ hái zhēn de gǎnxiè wǒ bà.
So I really have my dad to thank.
孩子作业这么多，做都做不完，你还让他参加什么外面的特长班？你不可怜儿子啊？
Háizi zuòyè zhème duō, zuò dōu zuò bù wán, nǐ hái ràng tā cānjiā shénme wàimian de tècháng bān? Nǐ bù kělián érzi a?
The child has so much homework he can't even finish it, and you want him in some outside class as well? Don't you feel sorry for your son?

vocab: to sign up for a class
to drop off and pick up
grammar: 有几个是……？
how many of them are …?
A rhetorical question meaning hardly any.
你看看那些特长班、补习班里的小孩，有几个是开开心心、快快乐乐的？
Nǐ kànkan nàxiē tècháng bān, bǔxíbān li de xiǎohái, yǒu jǐ ge shì kāi kāixīn xīn, kuài kuàilè lè de?
Look at the kids in those special-skills and cram classes. How many of them are happy and cheerful?
现在有几个人还写信？
Xiànzài yǒu jǐ ge rén hái xiě xìn?
How many people still write letters these days?
又不是没有……
it's not as if … don't have …
A double negative that means they do have it.
现在不学，以后想学就晚了。你家又不是没有这个条件，千万别耽误了孩子呀。
Xiànzài bù xué, yǐhòu xiǎng xué jiù wǎn le. Nǐ jiā yòu bú shì méiyǒu zhège tiáojiàn, qiānwàn bié dānwu le háizi ya.
If he doesn't learn now, it'll be too late later. It's not as if your family can't afford it. Whatever you do, don't hold your child back.
你又不是没有钱。
Nǐ yòu bú shì méiyǒu qián.
It's not as if you don't have money.
千万别……
whatever you do, don't …
千万 makes a warning very strong.
现在不学，以后想学就晚了。你家又不是没有这个条件，千万别耽误了孩子呀。
Xiànzài bù xué, yǐhòu xiǎng xué jiù wǎn le. Nǐ jiā yòu bú shì méiyǒu zhège tiáojiàn, qiānwàn bié dānwu le háizi ya.
If he doesn't learn now, it'll be too late later. It's not as if your family can't afford it. Whatever you do, don't hold your child back.
千万别忘了！
Qiānwàn bié wàng le!
Don't forget, whatever you do!
就你还不会
you're the only one who still can't
就 + person singles someone out.
现在不赶快学，开学后，看见别的孩子都学会了，就你还不会，
Xiànzài bù gǎnkuài xué, kāi xué hòu, kànjiàn biéde háizi dōu xuéhuì le, jiù nǐ hái bú huì,
If he doesn't hurry up and learn now, once term starts he'll see the other kids have all learned it and he's the only one who hasn't.
大家都来了，就他还没来。
Dàjiā dōu lái le, jiù tā hái méi lái.
Everyone's here except him.
不能不管……
you can't ignore …
不管 here means "not caring about".
不能不管孩子是否有兴趣学。你儿子如果不想学，就不要成天逼他嘛。
Bù néng bùguǎn háizi shìfǒu yǒu xìngqù xué. Nǐ érzi rúguǒ bù xiǎng xué, jiù bú yào chéngtiān bī tā ma.
You can't ignore whether the child is interested. If your son doesn't want to learn, don't keep forcing him.
你不能不管他。
Nǐ bù néng bùguǎn tā.
You can't just ignore him.
V + 都 + V + 不完
can't even finish …ing
Repeating the verb around 都 stresses it's already too much.
孩子作业这么多，做都做不完，你还让他参加什么外面的特长班？你不可怜儿子啊？
Háizi zuòyè zhème duō, zuò dōu zuò bù wán, nǐ hái ràng tā cānjiā shénme wàimian de tècháng bān? Nǐ bù kělián érzi a?
The child has so much homework he can't even finish it, and you want him in some outside class as well? Don't you feel sorry for your son?
东西太多了，吃都吃不完。
Dōngxi tài duō le, chī dōu chī bù wán.
There's so much food we can't even finish it.
gaps: 五岁开始学小提琴，现在九岁半，出国
那时候，孩子和大人就会
上补习班就一定能有出息？
你什么都懂点儿，到哪儿去，
say: Kids today are under so much pressure!
If he doesn't learn now, it'll be too late later. It's not as if your family can't afford it. Whatever you do, don't hold your child back.
Your son isn't bad at maths. I don't think the class is worth it.
Besides, who can promise that cram school will make him a success?
Thinking about it now, it was right to learn back then.

041.title: Hoping for a dragon (part 1)
041.sub: Five questions, then the story of Dalong's first Saturday of the holidays
041.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then part 1 of the story. 妈 is Dalong's mother, 爸 his father and 龙 is Dalong. The answers are my own summaries. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

q: Shénme shì wàng zǐ chéng lóng?
What does 望子成龙 mean?
ans: 父母希望自己的子女在学业上和事业上有成就。
Fùmǔ xīwàng zìjǐ de zǐnǚ zài xuéyè shàng hé shìyè shang yǒu chéngjiù.
Parents hoping their children will achieve success in their studies and careers.

q: When does the story take place?
ans: 放假后的第一个星期六早上。
Fàng jià hòu de dì-yī ge xīngqīliù zǎoshang.
On the first Saturday morning of the holidays.

q: 这天，大龙一家有什么活动？
Zhè tiān, Dàlóng yì jiā yǒu shénme huódòng?
What is Dalong's family doing that day?
ans: 上午妈妈陪大龙去文化宫上数学课和外语课，下午爸爸陪他去学小提琴。
Shàngwǔ māma péi Dàlóng qù wénhuàgōng shàng shùxué kè hé wàiyǔ kè, xiàwǔ bàba péi tā qù xué xiǎotíqín.
In the morning Mum takes Dalong to maths and language classes at the cultural centre; in the afternoon Dad takes him to violin.
他不想去，想睡觉，可是没有办法，只好乖乖地跟着妈妈。
Tā bù xiǎng qù, xiǎng shuì jiào, kěshì méiyǒu bànfǎ, zhǐhǎo guāiguāi de gēnzhe māma.
He doesn't want to go and wants to sleep, but has no choice and goes along obediently.

q: 妈妈进到大龙房间后，文章用了很多动词词组来描写大龙的样子，如：睡得正香、翻了翻身、又睡了过去、皱了皱眉头、眼睛勉强地睁开了、乖乖地跟着妈妈来到厨房。请你重听这一部分。

Māma jìndào Dàlóng fángjiān hòu, wénzhāng yòng le hěn duō dòngcí cízǔ lái miáoxiě Dàlóng de yàngzi, rú: shuì de zhèng xiāng, fān le fānshēn, yòu shuì le guòqu, zhòu le zhòu méitóu, yǎnjing miǎnqiǎng de zhēngkāi le, guāiguāi de gēnzhe māma láidào chúfáng. Qǐng nǐ chóng tīng zhè yí bùfen.

After Mum goes into Dalong's room, the story uses many verb phrases to describe him, such as: fast asleep, rolled over, fell asleep again, frowned, forced his eyes open, obediently followed Mum to the kitchen. Listen to this part again.
ans: 重听第一部分，注意这些动词词组。
Chóng tīng dì-yī bùfen, zhùyì zhèxiē dòngcí cízǔ.
Replay part 1 and listen for these verb phrases.

blocks.label: 第一部分
lines: 望子成龙 第一部分
Wàng zǐ chéng lóng dì-yī bùfen
Hoping for a dragon, part 1
望子成龙是指父母希望自己的子女在学业上和事业上有成就。
Wàng zǐ chéng lóng shì zhǐ fùmǔ xīwàng zìjǐ de zǐnǚ zài xuéyè shàng hé shìyè shang yǒu chéngjiù.
望子成龙 means parents hoping their children will succeed in their studies and careers.
为了孩子，家长们不惜一切为孩子提供好的教育环境和学习条件。
Wèile háizi, jiāzhǎng men bùxī yíqiè wèi háizi tígōng hǎo de jiàoyù huánjìng hé xuéxí tiáojiàn.
For their children's sake, parents spare nothing to provide a good educational environment and good conditions for study.
放假后的第一个星期六早上，大龙的妈妈早早地起来了。
Fàng jià hòu de dì-yī ge xīngqīliù zǎoshang, Dàlóng de māma zǎo zǎo de qǐlái le.
On the first Saturday morning of the holidays, Dalong's mother got up early.
她先洗了把脸，然后到厨房把昨晚准备好的大米粥和包子放在锅里热。
Tā xiān xǐ le bǎ liǎn, ránhòu dào chúfáng bǎ zuówǎn zhǔnbèi hǎo de dàmǐ zhōu hé bāozi fàng zài guō li rè.
She washed her face, then went to the kitchen and heated up the rice porridge and buns she'd made the night before.
过了一会儿，大龙的爸爸也起来了，进到了厨房，一边打着哈欠，一边说：
Guò le yíhuìr, Dàlóng de bàba yě qǐlái le, jìndào le chúfáng, yì biān dǎ zhe hāqian, yì biān shuō:
A while later Dalong's father got up too, came into the kitchen and said, yawning:
今天先学什么？
Jīntiān xiān xué shénme?
What's he doing first today?
爸
大龙的妈妈回答说：
Dàlóng de māma huídá shuō:
Dalong's mother replied:
数学，就在文化宫旁边，然后直接上外语课，在同一个地方。
Shùxué, jiù zài wénhuàgōng pángbiān, ránhòu zhíjiē shàng wàiyǔ kè, zài tóngyī ge dìfang.
Maths, right next to the cultural centre, then straight on to his language class in the same place.
妈
那小提琴班呢？下午吗？
Nà xiǎotíqín bān ne? Xiàwǔ ma?
And the violin class? Afternoon?
爸
对，你上午，我下午。这样我在家把饭做好，你们俩回来有饭吃。
Duì, nǐ shàngwǔ, wǒ xiàwǔ. Zhèyàng wǒ zài jiā bǎ fàn zuò hǎo, nǐmen liǎ huílai yǒu fàn chī.
Yes. You take the morning, I'll do the afternoon. That way I can cook at home and you two will have something to eat when you get back.
妈
嗯，行。
N, xíng.
Mm, OK.
爸
大龙的妈妈看了看表：
Dàlóng de māma kàn le kàn biǎo:
Dalong's mother looked at her watch:
哟，七点了，得叫他起来了。
Yō, qī diǎn le, de jiào tā qǐlái le.
Oh, seven o'clock. I'd better wake him.
妈
妈妈轻手轻脚地来到了大龙的房间。
Māma qīng shǒu qīng jiǎo de láidào le Dàlóng de fángjiān.
Mum tiptoed into Dalong's room.
大龙在被窝里睡得正香。
Dàlóng zài bèiwō li shuì de zhèng xiāng.
Dalong was fast asleep under the covers.
妈妈轻轻地叫了大龙一声：
Māma qīngqīng de jiào le Dàlóng yì shēng:
Mum called his name softly:
大龙，起来，时间到了。
Dàlóng, qǐlái, shíjiān dào le.
Dalong, get up. It's time.
妈
大龙翻了翻身，又睡了过去。
Dàlóng fān le fānshēn, yòu shuì le guòqu.
Dalong rolled over and fell asleep again.
妈妈推了推大龙：
Māma tuī le tuī Dàlóng:
Mum gave him a nudge:
别睡啦，再睡就迟到了，还得去补习班呢。
Bié shuì la, zài shuì jiù chídào le, hái de qù bǔxíbān ne.
Stop sleeping! Any longer and you'll be late. You've got cram school.
妈
大龙皱了皱眉头，眼睛勉强地睁开了。
Dàlóng zhòu le zhòu méitóu, yǎnjing miǎnqiǎng de zhēngkāi le.
Dalong frowned and forced his eyes open.
妈，我想睡觉。好不容易放假了，让我再睡一会儿。
Mā, wǒ xiǎng shuì jiào. Hǎobù róngyì fàng jià le, ràng wǒ zài shuì yíhuìr.
Mum, I want to sleep. It's finally the holidays. Let me sleep a bit longer.
龙
不行，你快给我起来！第一天就迟到，太不认真了。
Bù xíng, nǐ kuài gěi wǒ qǐlái! Dì-yī tiān jiù chídào, tài bú rènzhēn le.
No. Get up right now! Being late on the first day is far too careless.
妈
妈妈一下子把大龙的被子掀开了。
Māma yíxiàzi bǎ Dàlóng de bèizi xiānkāi le.
Mum threw back Dalong's quilt in one go.
大龙没有办法，只好乖乖地跟着妈妈来到厨房。
Dàlóng méiyǒu bànfǎ, zhǐhǎo guāiguāi de gēnzhe māma láidào chúfáng.
Dalong had no choice but to follow Mum obediently to the kitchen.
在饭桌上，妈妈一边给大龙夹包子，一边说：
Zài fànzhuō shàng, māma yì biān gěi Dàlóng jiā bāozi, yì biān shuō:
At the table, Mum put buns on Dalong's plate and said:
大龙呀，你可要好好利用放假的时间，把数学和外语补上去。
Dàlóng ya, nǐ kě yào hǎohǎo lìyòng fàng jià de shíjiān, bǎ shùxué hé wàiyǔ bǔ shangqu.
Dalong, you must make good use of the holidays and bring your maths and languages up to standard.
妈
你知道吗？我费了好大的劲儿才给你报上名，好多孩子想进都没进去。
Nǐ zhīdao ma? Wǒ fèi le hǎo dà de jìnr cái gěi nǐ bào shang míng, hǎo duō háizi xiǎng jìn dōu méi jìnqù.
Do you know how hard it was to get you a place? Lots of children wanted to get in and couldn't.
妈
大龙只是吃着饭，一言不发。
Dàlóng zhǐshì chī zhe fàn, yì yán bù fā.
Dalong just ate and didn't say a word.
爸爸看见大龙不高兴，就劝他说：
Bàba kànjiàn Dàlóng bù gāoxìng, jiù quàn tā shuō:
Seeing that Dalong was unhappy, Dad tried to persuade him:
我知道你辛苦，觉得自己可怜，放假了还要学习。
Wǒ zhīdao nǐ xīnkǔ, juéde zìjǐ kělián, fàng jià le hái yào xuéxí.
I know it's hard, and you feel sorry for yourself having to study in the holidays.
爸
可是我们也是为了你呀。你长大了就能理解我们了。
Kěshì wǒmen yě shì wèile nǐ ya. Nǐ zhǎngdà le jiù néng lǐjiě wǒmen le.
But we're doing it for you. You'll understand us when you grow up.
爸

vocab: to hope one's child will succeed
grammar: 一边……，一边……
while …
Two actions at the same time.
过了一会儿，大龙的爸爸也起来了，进到了厨房，一边打着哈欠，一边说：
Guò le yíhuìr, Dàlóng de bàba yě qǐlái le, jìndào le chúfáng, yì biān dǎ zhe hāqian, yì biān shuō:
A while later Dalong's father got up too, came into the kitchen and said, yawning:
他一边吃饭，一边看手机。
Tā yì biān chī fàn, yì biān kàn shǒujī.
He eats and looks at his phone at the same time.
V + 了 + V (看了看, 推了推)
to … briefly
Repeating a one-syllable verb around 了 makes it a short action.
大龙的妈妈看了看表：
Dàlóng de māma kàn le kàn biǎo:
Dalong's mother looked at her watch:
他想了想，说："好吧。"
Tā xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō:"hǎo ba."
He thought for a moment and said: "OK."
再 + V + 就……
if you … any more, then …
再 here means "any longer"; 就 gives the result.
别睡啦，再睡就迟到了，还得去补习班呢。
Bié shuì la, zài shuì jiù chídào le, hái de qù bǔxíbān ne.
Stop sleeping! Any longer and you'll be late. You've got cram school.
再不走就晚了。
Zài bù zǒu jiù wǎn le.
If we don't go now we'll be late.
你快给我 + V！
(you) get … right now!
给我 in a command adds force: do it, for my sake.
不行，你快给我起来！第一天就迟到，太不认真了。
Bù xíng, nǐ kuài gěi wǒ qǐlái! Dì-yī tiān jiù chídào, tài bú rènzhēn le.
No. Get up right now! Being late on the first day is far too careless.
你快给我回来！
Nǐ kuài gěi wǒ huílai!
Get back here right now!
费了好大的劲儿才……
only managed … after a huge effort
才 shows it came late or with difficulty.
你知道吗？我费了好大的劲儿才给你报上名，好多孩子想进都没进去。
Nǐ zhīdao ma? Wǒ fèi le hǎo dà de jìnr cái gěi nǐ bào shang míng, hǎo duō háizi xiǎng jìn dōu méi jìnqù.
Do you know how hard it was to get you a place? Lots of children wanted to get in and couldn't.
他费了好大的劲儿才找到工作。
Tā fèi le hǎo dà de jìnr cái zhǎodào gōngzuò.
It took him a huge effort to find a job.
想 + V + 都没 + V + 进去
even wanting to … couldn't
都 stresses that even wanting it wasn't enough.
你知道吗？我费了好大的劲儿才给你报上名，好多孩子想进都没进去。

Do you know how hard it was to get you a place? Lots of children wanted to get in and couldn't.
这个大学，很多人想进都进不去。
Zhège dàxué, hěn duō rén xiǎng jìn dōu jìn bú qù.
Lots of people want to get into this university and can't.

042.title: Hoping for a dragon (part 2)
042.sub: Five true-or-false statements, then Dalong's mother talks to a colleague
042.transcriptNote: First five statements to judge, then part 2 of the story. 妈 is Dalong's mother and 周 is her colleague Lao Zhou. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context. Turn on Answers for the true-or-false key.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，并判断句子的正误。请先听五个句子。
Tīng lùyīn, bìng pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù. Qǐng xiān tīng wǔ ge jùzi.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false. First listen to five sentences.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 五个句子 · True or false

q: 大龙的学习很差，所以他的父母很担心。
Dàlóng de xuéxí hěn chà, suǒyǐ tā de fùmǔ hěn dānxīn.
Dalong is bad at school, so his parents are worried.
qs.why: Lao Zhou says he loves learning and his grades are very good.

q: 老周的孩子也参加过补习班。
Lǎo Zhōu de háizi yě cānjiā guo bǔxíbān.
Lao Zhou's child has also been to cram school.
qs.why: The story never says so. Lao Zhou says that as children they never went to cram school.

q: 大龙的妈妈认为，必须努力学习，才不会被社会淘汰。
Dàlóng de māma rènwéi, bìxū nǔlì xuéxí, cái bú huì bèi shèhuì táotài.
Dalong's mother thinks you must study hard or society will leave you behind.
qs.why: She says not studying means being eliminated later.

q: 老周最后也能理解大龙妈妈的做法。
Lǎo Zhōu zuìhòu yě néng lǐjiě Dàlóng māma de zuòfǎ.
In the end Lao Zhou understands what Dalong's mother is doing.
qs.why: He ends by saying 你说的也是.

q: 大龙的妈妈其实也是没有办法。
Dàlóng de māma qíshí yě shì méiyǒu bànfǎ.
Dalong's mother actually feels she has no choice either.
qs.why: She says 没有办法: children are tired, parents even more so.

blocks.label: 第二部分
lines: 下面请听文章。
Xiàmiàn qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
望子成龙 第二部分
Wàng zǐ chéng lóng dì-èr bùfen
Hoping for a dragon, part 2
星期一，大龙的妈妈去上班，在办公室和同事老周闲聊。
Xīngqīyī, Dàlóng de māma qù shàng bān, zài bàngōngshì hé tóngshì Lǎo Zhōu xiánliáo.
On Monday Dalong's mother went to work and chatted with her colleague Lao Zhou in the office.
这个周末累死我了。星期六孩子补习班开课，下午又送他学小提琴，星期天又陪他……
Zhège zhōumò lèi sǐ wǒ le. Xīngqīliù háizi bǔxíbān kāikè, xiàwǔ yòu sòng tā xué xiǎotíqín, xīngqītiān yòu péi tā……
This weekend wore me out. On Saturday his cram class started, in the afternoon I took him to violin, and on Sunday I took him to …
妈
还让孩子上补习班呀？他那么好学，而且学习成绩又那么好。
Hái ràng háizi shàng bǔxíbān ya? Tā nàme hàoxué, érqiě xuéxí chéngjì yòu nàme hǎo.
You're still sending him to cram school? He loves learning and his grades are so good.
周
现在是不差，可是别人都补，你不补，人家就超过你了，你就落后了。我是想让他保持住水平。
Xiànzài shì bú chà, kěshì biérén dōu bǔ, nǐ bù bǔ, rénjia jiù chāoguò nǐ le, nǐ jiù luòhòu le. Wǒ shì xiǎng ràng tā bǎochí zhù shuǐpíng.
They're fine now, but everyone else is getting extra lessons. If you don't, they'll overtake you and you'll fall behind. I just want him to keep his level.
妈
现在的孩子可比以前累多了。我们小的时候也没参加过什么补习班、特长班，不是也都过来了吗？
Xiànzài de háizi kěbǐ yǐqián lèi duō le. Wǒmen xiǎo de shíhou yě méi cānjiā guo shénme bǔxíbān, tècháng bān, bú shì yě dōu guòlái le ma?
Kids today have it much harder than we did. We never went to cram school or special-skills classes, and we turned out fine, didn't we?
周
现在什么时代了？社会竞争多激烈呀。你看看他们初一的孩子做的数学题，比我们那时候难多了。
Xiànzài shénme shídài le? Shèhuì jìngzhēng duō jīliè ya. Nǐ kànkan tāmen chū-yī de háizi zuò de shùxué tí, bǐ wǒmen nà shíhou nán duō le.
What era are we in now? Competition is so fierce. Look at the maths problems first-year junior high kids do. They're much harder than ours were.
妈
不补不学，就意味着将来要被淘汰。敢让他偷懒吗？
Bù bǔ bù xué, jiù yìwèizhe jiānglái yào bèi táotài. Gǎn ràng tā tōulǎn ma?
No extra lessons, no study, and he'll be left behind in future. How could I dare let him slack off?
妈
你说的也是。
Nǐ shuō de yě shì.
You've got a point.
周
没有办法，现在的孩子累，家长更累呀。
Méiyǒu bànfǎ, xiànzài de háizi lèi, jiāzhǎng gèng lèi ya.
There's nothing to be done. Kids are tired these days, and parents are even more tired.
妈

Zhège zhōumò lèi sǐ wǒ le. Xīngqīliù háizi bǔxíbān kāikè, xiàwǔ yòu sòng tā xué xiǎotíqín, xīngqītiān yòu péi tā……

今天热死我了。
Jīntiān rè sǐ wǒ le.

你还在工作呀？
Nǐ hái zài gōngzuò ya?
You're still working?

Kids today have it much harder than we did. We never went to cram school or special-skills classes, and we turned out fine, didn't we?
今年可比去年热多了。
Jīnnián kěbǐ qùnián rè duō le.
This year is much hotter than last.
不是也……吗？

043.title: Listen again
043.sub: Two questions on the whole 望子成龙 story (parts 041–042)
043.transcriptNote: This short track only gives the questions. Listen to parts 041 and 042 again to answer them. The answers are my own.

blocks.label: 问题
lines: 请再听一遍录音，然后回答问题。
Qǐng zài tīng yí biàn lùyīn, ránhòu huídá wèntí.
Listen to the recording again, then answer the questions.

q: 现在的学生和以前的学生有什么不同？
Xiànzài de xuésheng hé yǐqián de xuésheng yǒu shénme bùtóng?
How are students today different from students in the past?
ans: 现在的学生比以前累多了：要上各种补习班、特长班，学的东西也难多了；以前的孩子没上过什么补习班。
Xiànzài de xuésheng bǐ yǐqián lèi duō le: yào shàng gè zhǒng bǔxíbān, tècháng bān, xué de dōngxi yě nán duō le; yǐqián de háizi méi shàng guo shénme bǔxíbān.
Students today are far more tired: they go to all sorts of cram and special-skills classes and what they learn is much harder; children in the past didn't go to such classes.

q: 你觉得大龙是否理解他的父母？请用文章中的话说明。
Nǐ juéde Dàlóng shìfǒu lǐjiě tā de fùmǔ? Qǐng yòng wénzhāng zhōng dehuà shuōmíng.
Do you think Dalong understands his parents? Explain using words from the story.
ans: 不太理解。他“皱了皱眉头”，说“好不容易放假了，让我再睡一会儿”，吃饭时“一言不发”；爸爸也说“你长大了就能理解我们了”。
Bú tài lǐjiě. Tā "zhòu le zhòu méitóu", shuō "hǎobù róngyì fàng jià le, ràng wǒ zài shuì yíhuìr", chī fàn shí "yì yán bù fā"; bàba yě shuō "nǐ zhǎngdà le jiù néng lǐjiě wǒmen le".
Not really. He "frowns", says "it's finally the holidays, let me sleep a bit longer", and "doesn't say a word" at breakfast; his father even says "you'll understand us when you grow up".

044.title: Two mothers (1)
044.sub: Three questions, then the first mother: "we have no choice"
044.transcriptNote: Two mothers are interviewed about cram schools and special-skills classes. This track has the questions and the first mother; the second mother is in part 045. 记 is the reporter and 妈 the mother. This is natural speech: false starts and fillers such as 呃 and 嗯 are left out of the transcript. The answers are my own summaries.

Two mothers talk about their views on cram schools and special-skills classes. Answer the questions below.
你将会听到一些生词，但是它们不影响对主要意思的理解。
Nǐ jiāng huì tīngdào yìxiē shēngcí, dànshì tāmen bù yǐngxiǎng duì zhǔyào yìsi de lǐjiě.
You'll hear some new words, but they won't stop you understanding the main idea.

q: 哪位妈妈不支持孩子参加补习班或特长班？
Nǎ wèi māma bù zhīchí háizi cānjiā bǔxíbān huò tècháng bān?
Which mother doesn't support sending children to cram school or special-skills classes?
第一位妈妈的主要观点是什么？
Dì-yī wèi māma de zhǔyào guāndiǎn shì shénme?
What is the first mother's main view?
ans: 她理解也支持：在中国不送孩子去，孩子就跟不上学校的课程，最后还得家长在家里辅导。她觉得是被迫的，没有办法。
Tā lǐjiě yě zhīchí: zài Zhōngguó bú sòng háizi qù, háizi jiù gēn bu shàng xuéxiào de kèchéng, zuìhòu hái de jiāzhǎng zài jiā li fǔdǎo. Tā juéde shì bèipò de, méiyǒu bànfǎ.
She understands and supports it: in China, if you don't send your child, they can't keep up at school and the parents end up tutoring them at home. She feels forced into it.

q: 第二位妈妈的主要观点是什么？
Dì-èr wèi māma de zhǔyào guāndiǎn shì shénme?
What is the second mother's main view?
ans: 她不送孩子去任何班，希望孩子假期好好放松；她提倡自学，觉得填鸭式的补课会给孩子造成压力，让孩子厌学。
Tā bú sòng háizi qù rènhé bān, xīwàng háizi jiàqī hǎohǎo fàngsōng; tā tíchàng zìxué, juéde tiányāshì de bǔkè huì gěi háizi zàochéng yālì, ràng háizi yànxué.
She sends her child to no classes and wants him to relax in the holidays; she favours self-study and thinks force-fed cramming puts pressure on children and makes them hate learning.

Gāozhōng hòu fāxiàn tóngbān tóngxué dōu duōcáiduōyì, yòu huì xiǎotíqín, yòu huì huà huà, jiù zìjǐ shá yě bú huì,
In high school he found his classmates were all multi-talented, playing the violin and painting, and he was the only one who couldn't do anything.
什么活动都轮不到他。我同事说，孩子都跟他抱怨了，说都是大人的错。
shénme huódòng dōu lún bú dào tā. Wǒ tóngshì shuō, háizi dōu gēn tā bàoyuàn le, shuō dōu shì dàrén de cuò.
He never got picked for anything. My colleague says the boy complained that it was all the grown-ups' fault.
父母不要逼孩子去学一些他不喜欢的东西。
Fùmǔ bú yào bī háizi qù xué yìxiē tā bù xǐhuan de dōngxi.
Parents shouldn't force children to learn things they don't like.
孩子好不容易有周末两天假，也想好好玩玩，放松放松。
Háizi hǎobù róngyì yǒu zhōumò liǎng tiān jiǎ, yě xiǎng hǎohǎo wán wán, fàngsōng fàngsōng.
Children finally get two days off at the weekend and want to play and relax.
别让他们那么小就承受压力。童年，就是应该好好地玩。
Bié ràng tāmen nàme xiǎo jiù chéngshòu yālì. Tóngnián, jiùshì yīnggāi hǎohǎo de wán.
Don't make them bear pressure at such a young age. Childhood is for playing.

vocab: to have a son and a daughter
not one's turn, to miss out
grammar: 除了……，就是……
if not …, then …
Says someone only does these two things.
不喜欢中国人的这种教育方式，除了学习，就是上特长班，学这学那。
Bù xǐhuan Zhōngguórén de zhè zhǒng jiàoyù fāngshì, chúle xuéxí, jiùshì shàng tècháng bān, xué zhè xué nà.
I don't like this Chinese way of educating children: if they're not studying, they're at special-skills classes learning this and that.
他除了吃饭，就是睡觉。
Tā chúle chī fàn, jiùshì shuì jiào.
All he does is eat and sleep.
只要……就……
as long as …, then …
只要 gives a sufficient condition.
我觉得只要孩子们努力了就可以了，不用非得上什么好的大学，会好几门外语。
Wǒ juéde zhǐyào háizi men nǔlì le jiù kěyǐ le, búyòng fēiděi shàng shénme hǎo de dàxué, huì hǎo jǐ mén wàiyǔ.
I think as long as children try hard, that's enough. They don't have to get into a top university or speak several foreign languages.
只要你喜欢就好。
Zhǐyào nǐ xǐhuan jiù hǎo.
As long as you like it, that's fine.
不用非得……
there's no need to …
非得 means "must"; 不用 cancels the need.
我觉得只要孩子们努力了就可以了，不用非得上什么好的大学，会好几门外语。
Wǒ juéde zhǐyào háizi men nǔlì le jiù kěyǐ le, búyòng fēiděi shàng shénme hǎo de dàxué, huì hǎo jǐ mén wàiyǔ.
I think as long as children try hard, that's enough. They don't have to get into a top university or speak several foreign languages.
你不用非得今天去。
Nǐ búyòng fēiděi jīntiān qù.
You don't have to go today.
想怎么 + V + 就怎么 + V
however you like
The question word repeats: do it whatever way you want.
想怎么玩就怎么玩，周末还常常到乡下捉鱼。
xiǎng zěnme wán jiù zěnme wán, zhōumò hái chángcháng dào xiāngxia zhuō yú.
He plays however he likes, and at weekends we often go to the countryside to catch fish.
你想怎么做就怎么做。
Nǐ xiǎng zěnme zuò jiù zěnme zuò.
Do it however you like.
both … and …
Joins two abilities or qualities.
高中后发现同班同学都多才多艺，又会小提琴，又会画画，就自己啥也不会，
Gāozhōng hòu fāxiàn tóngbān tóngxué dōu duōcáiduōyì, yòu huì xiǎotíqín, yòu huì huà huà, jiù zìjǐ shá yě bú huì,
In high school he found his classmates were all multi-talented, playing the violin and painting, and he was the only one who couldn't do anything.
她又会唱歌又会跳舞。
Tā yòu huì chàng gē yòu huì tiàowǔ.
She can sing and dance.
轮不到 + person
it never comes to …
轮 means a turn; 轮不到 means missing out.
什么活动都轮不到他。我同事说，孩子都跟他抱怨了，说都是大人的错。
shénme huódòng dōu lún bú dào tā. Wǒ tóngshì shuō, háizi dōu gēn tā bàoyuàn le, shuō dōu shì dàrén de cuò.
He never got picked for anything. My colleague says the boy complained that it was all the grown-ups' fault.
好事儿从来轮不到我。
Hǎo shìr cónglái lún bú dào wǒ.
Good things never come my way.
gaps: 孩子们努力了就可以了
上什么好的大学，会好几门外语。
我的小孩四岁了，没有参加
说我们没有好好培养他
高中后发现同班同学都
孩子去学一些他不喜欢的东西。
say: I think as long as children try hard, that's enough. They don't have to get into a top university or speak several foreign languages.
I don't think I can let him carry on like this.
He never got picked for anything. My colleague says the boy complained that it was all the grown-ups' fault.
Parents shouldn't force children to learn things they don't like.
Don't make them bear pressure at such a young age. Childhood is for playing.

047.title: Copy the tone of voice
047.sub: Ten lines about study pressure to imitate
047.transcriptNote: Pre-speaking practice: copy each speaker's tone, whether worn out, pleading, scolding or resentful. Several item numbers aren't read aloud. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 口语课前练习 · Pre-speaking practice
lines: 口语课前练习。
Kǒuyǔ kè qián liànxí.
Pre-speaking exercises.
听句子，并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng jùzi, bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the sentences and copy the speakers' tone.
昨天陪儿子上了一天的课，可累死我了。
Zuótiān péi érzi shàng le yì tiān de kè, kě lèi sǐ wǒ le.
I spent all day yesterday taking my son to classes. I'm absolutely worn out.
妈，这么早就把我叫醒了啊，让我再睡会儿吧。
Mā, zhème zǎojiù bǎ wǒ jiàoxǐng le a, ràng wǒ zài shuì huì ér ba.
Mum, you're waking me up this early? Let me sleep a bit longer.
你不好好学，能对得起我和你爸吗？你知道为了报上这个班，我花了多少钱吗？
Nǐ bù hǎo hàoxué, néng duìdeqǐ wǒ hé nǐ bà ma? Nǐ zhīdao wèile bàoshàng zhège bān, wǒ huā le duōshǎo qián ma?
If you don't study properly, how can you face your dad and me? Do you know how much I paid to get you into this class?
小丽，我看儿子对小提琴不感兴趣，还是别让他学了。
Xiǎo Lì, wǒ kàn érzi duì xiǎotíqín bù gǎn xìngqù, háishi bié ràng tā xué le.
Xiao Li, I don't think our son is interested in the violin. Let's not make him learn it.
你现在不学，以后再想学就晚了。我跟你说过多少回了？竞争社会，不学就被淘汰！
Nǐ xiànzài bù xué, yǐhòu zài xiǎng xué jiù wǎn le. Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guo duōshǎo huí le? Jìngzhēng shèhuì, bù xué jiù bèi táotài!
If you don't learn now, it'll be too late later. How many times have I told you? It's a competitive society. If you don't learn, you get left behind!
我能不生气吗？你们俩一起气我！不乖乖学琴，你爸还劝我不让你学。我一天到晚这么累，是为了谁呀？
Wǒ néng bù shēng qì ma? Nǐmen liǎ yìqǐ qì wǒ! Bù guāiguāi xué qín, nǐ bà hái quàn wǒ bú ràng nǐ xué. Wǒ yì tiān dào wǎn zhème lèi, shì wèile shéi ya?
How can I not be angry? You're both ganging up on me! You won't practise the violin, and your dad tries to talk me out of it. Who do you think I'm working myself to the bone for?
刘小龙母亲，你家孩子各方面都不错，就是数学差了一点儿，给他好好补补吧。
Liú Xiǎolóng mǔqin, nǐ jiā háizi gè fāngmiàn dōu búcuò, jiùshì shùxué chà le yì diǎnr, gěi tā hǎohǎo bǔ bǔ ba.
Mrs Liu, your son is doing well in every area. It's just his maths that's a bit weak. Get him some extra help.
哪个家长不是望子成龙啊？你们以后当了父母，就能理解我们现在的做法了。
Nǎge jiāzhǎng bú shì wàng zǐ chéng lóng a? Nǐmen yǐhòu dāng le fùmǔ, jiù néng lǐjiě wǒmen xiànzài de zuòfǎ le.
What parent doesn't want their child to be a success? When you're parents yourselves, you'll understand what we're doing now.
你看看月月，数学、外语、语文，门门考试都是第一，你得跟人家好好学学。
Nǐ kànkan Yuèyue, shùxué, wàiyǔ, yǔwén, ménmén kǎoshì dōu shì dì-yī, nǐ de gēn rénjia hǎohǎo xué xué.
Look at Yueyue. Maths, languages, Chinese: she's top in every exam. You should learn from her.
我最讨厌月月了！我妈老是拿我跟她比，真让我受不了。
Wǒ zuì tǎoyàn Yuèyue le! Wǒ mā lǎo shì ná wǒ gēn tā bǐ, zhēn ràng wǒ shòu bu liǎo.
I hate Yueyue! Mum's always comparing me with her. I can't stand it.

vocab: to do right by, to live up to
to make up, to catch up
to hope one's child will succeed
grammar: 能对得起……吗？
how can you face …?
A rhetorical question: you'd be letting them down.
你不好好学，能对得起我和你爸吗？你知道为了报上这个班，我花了多少钱吗？
Nǐ bù hǎo hàoxué, néng duìdeqǐ wǒ hé nǐ bà ma? Nǐ zhīdao wèile bàoshàng zhège bān, wǒ huā le duōshǎo qián ma?
If you don't study properly, how can you face your dad and me? Do you know how much I paid to get you into this class?
你这样做，对得起你父母吗？
Nǐ zhèyàng zuò, duìdeqǐ nǐ fùmǔ ma?
How can you face your parents, doing this?
对……(不)感兴趣
(not) interested in …
对 + thing + 感兴趣.
小丽，我看儿子对小提琴不感兴趣，还是别让他学了。
Xiǎo Lì, wǒ kàn érzi duì xiǎotíqín bù gǎn xìngqù, háishi bié ràng tā xué le.
Xiao Li, I don't think our son is interested in the violin. Let's not make him learn it.
我对历史很感兴趣。
Wǒ duì lìshǐ hěn gǎn xìngqù.
I'm very interested in history.
说过多少回了？
how many times have I said …?
A rhetorical complaint about repeating oneself.
你现在不学，以后再想学就晚了。我跟你说过多少回了？竞争社会，不学就被淘汰！
Nǐ xiànzài bù xué, yǐhòu zài xiǎng xué jiù wǎn le. Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guo duōshǎo huí le? Jìngzhēng shèhuì, bù xué jiù bèi táotài!
If you don't learn now, it'll be too late later. How many times have I told you? It's a competitive society. If you don't learn, you get left behind!
我告诉过你多少次了？
Wǒ gàosu guo nǐ duōshǎo cì le?
How many times have I told you?
能不 + V + 吗？
how can I not …?
A double negative meaning "of course I …".
我能不生气吗？你们俩一起气我！不乖乖学琴，你爸还劝我不让你学。我一天到晚这么累，是为了谁呀？
Wǒ néng bù shēng qì ma? Nǐmen liǎ yìqǐ qì wǒ! Bù guāiguāi xué qín, nǐ bà hái quàn wǒ bú ràng nǐ xué. Wǒ yì tiān dào wǎn zhème lèi, shì wèile shéi ya?
How can I not be angry? You're both ganging up on me! You won't practise the violin, and your dad tries to talk me out of it. Who do you think I'm working myself to the bone for?
这么好的消息，我能不高兴吗？
Zhème hǎo de xiāoxī, wǒ néng bù gāoxìng ma?
With news this good, how could I not be happy?
就是……差了一点儿
it's just … that's a bit weak
就是 introduces the one problem.
刘小龙母亲，你家孩子各方面都不错，就是数学差了一点儿，给他好好补补吧。
Liú Xiǎolóng mǔqin, nǐ jiā háizi gè fāngmiàn dōu búcuò, jiùshì shùxué chà le yì diǎnr, gěi tā hǎohǎo bǔ bǔ ba.
Mrs Liu, your son is doing well in every area. It's just his maths that's a bit weak. Get him some extra help.
这件衣服挺好的，就是贵了一点儿。
Zhè jiàn yīfu tǐng hǎo de, jiùshì guì le yì diǎnr.
This is nice; it's just a bit expensive.
拿 A 跟 B 比
to compare A with B
拿 introduces what's being compared.
我最讨厌月月了！我妈老是拿我跟她比，真让我受不了。
Wǒ zuì tǎoyàn Yuèyue le! Wǒ mā lǎo shì ná wǒ gēn tā bǐ, zhēn ràng wǒ shòu bu liǎo.
I hate Yueyue! Mum's always comparing me with her. I can't stand it.
别拿自己跟别人比。
Bié ná zìjǐ gēn biérén bǐ.
Don't compare yourself with others.
gaps: 昨天陪儿子上了一天的课，可
小丽，我看儿子对小提琴不
你家孩子各方面都不错，就是数学差了一点儿，给他好好
say: I spent all day yesterday taking my son to classes. I'm absolutely worn out.
If you don't learn now, it'll be too late later. How many times have I told you? It's a competitive society. If you don't learn, you get left behind!
What parent doesn't want their child to be a success? When you're parents yourselves, you'll understand what we're doing now.
Look at Yueyue. Maths, languages, Chinese: she's top in every exam. You should learn from her.
I hate Yueyue! Mum's always comparing me with her. I can't stand it.

048.title: "Just for a little while"
048.sub: A child begs to go out and play
048.transcriptNote: 孩 is the child and 妈 the mother. Listen and copy their tone.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听对话并模仿 · Listen and imitate
lines: 听对话并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng duìhuà bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone.

blocks.label: 对话
blocks.h: 妈妈和孩子 · Mother and child
lines: 妈，我想出去玩一会儿。
Mā, wǒ xiǎng chūqu wán yíhuìr.
Mum, I want to go out and play for a bit.
孩
作业写完了吗？
Zuòyè xiě wán le ma?
Have you finished your homework?
妈
还差一点就写完了。
Hái chà yìdiǎn jiù xiě wán le.
Almost.
孩
不行，写完作业再去。你就知道玩儿！
Bù xíng, xiě wán zuòyè zài qù. Nǐ jiù zhīdao wánr!
No. Finish your homework first. All you think about is playing!
妈
你看看人家丁丁，就在家里学习，不去玩，那才是好孩子呢。
Nǐ kànkan rénjia Dīngding, jiù zài jiā li xuéxí, bú qù wán, nà cái shì hǎo háizi ne.
Look at Dingding. She stays home studying and doesn't go out to play. That's a good child.
妈
我就玩一会儿。
Wǒ jiù wán yíhuìr.
Just for a little while.
孩
我说不行就不行！快给我回房间写作业去！
Wǒ shuō bù xíng jiù bù xíng! Kuài gěi wǒ huí fángjiān xiě zuòyè qù!
I said no, and no means no! Get back to your room and do your homework!
妈
妈，求求你了，让我玩一会儿吧。
Mā, qiú qiú nǐ le, ràng wǒ wán yíhuìr ba.
Mum, please, let me play for a bit.
孩
一会儿外面天就黑了，他们都回家了，就没人和我玩了。
Yíhuìr wàimian tiān jiù hēi le, tāmen dōu huí jiā le, jiù méi rén hé wǒ wán le.
It'll be dark outside soon, and everyone will go home, and there'll be no one to play with.
孩
这孩子！我让你写作业，你听见没有？我发现你越来越不听话了。
Zhè háizi! Wǒ ràng nǐ xiě zuòyè, nǐ tīngjiàn méiyǒu? Wǒ fāxiàn nǐ yuèláiyuè bù tīnghuà le.
This child! I told you to do your homework, did you hear me? You're getting more and more disobedient.
妈

grammar: 写完……再去
finish … first, then go
再 means "only after that".
不行，写完作业再去。你就知道玩儿！
Bù xíng, xiě wán zuòyè zài qù. Nǐ jiù zhīdao wánr!
No. Finish your homework first. All you think about is playing!
吃完饭再走吧。
Chīwán fàn zài zǒu ba.
Eat first, then go.
你就知道 + V！
all you ever do is …!
A scolding pattern.
不行，写完作业再去。你就知道玩儿！
Bù xíng, xiě wán zuòyè zài qù. Nǐ jiù zhīdao wánr!
No. Finish your homework first. All you think about is playing!
你就知道看电视！
Nǐ jiù zhīdao kàn diànshì!
All you do is watch TV!
那才是……呢
now that's a real …
才 stresses that this is the true example.
你看看人家丁丁，就在家里学习，不去玩，那才是好孩子呢。
Nǐ kànkan rénjia Dīngding, jiù zài jiā li xuéxí, bú qù wán, nà cái shì hǎo háizi ne.
Look at Dingding. She stays home studying and doesn't go out to play. That's a good child.
那才是好朋友呢。
Nà cái shì hǎo péngyou ne.
Now that's a true friend.
说不行就不行
when I say no, it's no
The repetition shows the decision is final.
我说不行就不行！快给我回房间写作业去！
Wǒ shuō bù xíng jiù bù xíng! Kuài gěi wǒ huí fángjiān xiě zuòyè qù!
I said no, and no means no! Get back to your room and do your homework!
说去就去。
Shuō qù jiù qù.
If we say we're going, we go.
一会儿……就……
soon …, then …
一会儿 means in a short while; 就 shows it will happen soon.
一会儿外面天就黑了，他们都回家了，就没人和我玩了。
Yíhuìr wàimian tiān jiù hēi le, tāmen dōu huí jiā le, jiù méi rén hé wǒ wán le.
It'll be dark outside soon, and everyone will go home, and there'll be no one to play with.
他一会儿就回来。
Tā yíhuìr jiù huílai.
He'll be back in a minute.

rp.title: Can I go out to play?

say: Mum, I want to go out and play for a bit.
No. Finish your homework first. All you think about is playing!
I said no, and no means no! Get back to your room and do your homework!
Mum, please, let me play for a bit.
This child! I told you to do your homework, did you hear me? You're getting more and more disobedient.

049.title: Hoping for a dragon
049.sub: The lesson text: a top student remembers his own childhood
049.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. The narrator got into a famous university and is asked to share his "secret" with a neighbour's son. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

lines: 望子成龙
Wàng zǐ chéng lóng
Hoping for a dragon
大年初一的早晨，我还在睡懒觉，邻居就来我家拜年了。
Dànián chū-yī de zǎochén, wǒ hái zài shuì lǎn jiào, línjū jiù lái wǒ jiā bài nián le.
On the morning of Chinese New Year's Day, I was still having a lie-in when the neighbours came round to wish us a happy new year.
爸爸赶快叫醒我，说人家是专门带着孩子来找我的。
Bàba gǎnkuài jiàoxǐng wǒ, shuō rénjia shì zhuānmén dài zhe háizi lái zhǎo wǒ de.
Dad hurried to wake me up and said they'd brought their son specially to see me.
邻居的儿子暑假后就念高中了，
Línjū de érzi shǔjià hòu jiù niàn gāozhōng le,
The neighbour's son is starting high school after the summer,
他父母想让我跟他分享一下成功的经验。
tā fùmǔ xiǎng ràng wǒ gēn tā fēnxiǎng yíxià chénggōng de jīngyàn.
and his parents wanted me to share the secret of my success with him.
几年前，我考上了北京的一所名牌大学。
Jǐ nián qián, wǒ kǎoshang le Běijīng de yì suǒ míngpái dàxué.
A few years ago I got into a famous university in Beijing.
从那时起，我就成了大人们口中的榜样。
Cóng nà shí qǐ, wǒ jiù chéng le dà rénmen kǒu zhōng de bǎngyàng.
Since then, I've been the role model grown-ups talk about.
每次放假回家，都有不少人来请教学习经验。
Měicì fàng jià huí jiā, dōu yǒu bù shǎo rén lái qǐngjiào xuéxí jīngyàn.
Every time I'm home for the holidays, lots of people come to ask me how to study.
可我哪有什么经验呢？
Kě wǒ nǎ yǒu shénme jīngyàn ne?
But what secret do I have?
我小时候很贪玩，常常被父母罚站，
Wǒ xiǎoshíhou hěn tānwán, chángcháng bèi fùmǔ fázhàn,
As a child I loved playing and was often made to stand in the corner,
考试成绩不好时，还会挨打，被尺子打得直掉眼泪。
kǎoshì chéngjì bù hǎo shí, hái huì ái dǎ, bèi chǐzi dǎ de zhí diào yǎnlèi.
and when my exam results were bad I'd get a beating with a ruler that left me in tears.
那时我父母也常跟我说：“人家老王的儿子学习多好，你要向他学习。”
Nà shí wǒ fùmǔ yě cháng gēn wǒ shuō: "Rénjia Lǎo Wáng de érzi xuéxí duō hǎo, nǐ yào xiàng tā xuéxí."
Back then my parents would often say: "Look how well Lao Wang's son does at school. You should learn from him."
就让我觉得很烦。
Jiù ràng wǒ juéde hěn fán.
That really annoyed me.
所以我知道，其实孩子并不喜欢被拿来跟别人比较，
Suǒyǐ wǒ zhīdao, qíshí háizi bìng bù xǐhuan bèi nálái gēn biérén bǐjiào,
So I know that children don't actually like being compared with others.
这太伤害他们的自尊心和自信心了。
zhè tài shānghài tāmen de zìzūnxīn hé zìxìnxīn le.
It hurts their self-esteem and confidence too much.
说老实话，每次有人来请教经验，我都觉得很勉强，但又不好意思拒绝别人。
Shuō lǎoshi huà, měicì yǒu rén lái qǐngjiào jīngyàn, wǒ dōu juéde hěn miǎnqiǎng, dàn yòu bù hǎoyìsi jùjué biérén.
To be honest, every time someone comes for advice I feel reluctant, but I'm too embarrassed to say no.
我翻身起床，换好衣服走进客厅。
Wǒ fānshēn qǐ chuáng, huàn hǎo yīfu zǒujìn kètīng.
I rolled out of bed, got dressed and went into the living room.
大人们正闲聊着。
Dà rénmen zhèng xiánliáo zhe.
The grown-ups were chatting.
那男孩看起来性格很内向，乖乖地坐在旁边，一言不发。
Nà nánhái kàn qilai xìnggé hěn nèixiàng, guāiguāi de zuò zài pángbiān, yì yán bù fā.
The boy seemed very shy. He sat quietly to one side and didn't say a word.
我简单地跟他谈了谈我的看法，
Wǒ jiǎndān de gēn tā tán le tán wǒ de kànfǎ,
I talked briefly with him about what I think.
比如，学习不应该死记硬背，要找到适合自己的方法，
bǐrú, xuéxí bù yīnggāi sǐ jì yìng bèi, yào zhǎodào shìhé zìjǐ de fāngfǎ,
For example, you shouldn't just learn by rote; you need to find a method that suits you,
最好把做错的题专门抄下来等等。
zuì hǎo bǎ zuò cuò de tí zhuānmén chāo xialai děngděng.
and it's best to copy out the questions you get wrong, and so on.
趁着大人们去厨房准备饭菜的功夫，男孩悄悄地跟我抱怨：
Chèn zhe dà rénmen qù chúfáng zhǔnbèi fàncài de gōngfu, nánhái qiāoqiāo de gēn wǒ bàoyuàn:
While the grown-ups went to the kitchen to make lunch, the boy quietly complained to me:
“太累了，成天在上各种补习班。”
"Tài lèi le, chéngtiān zài shàng gè zhǒng bǔxíbān."
"I'm so tired. I'm at one cram class or another all the time."
我听了不知道应该说什么才好。
Wǒ tīng le bù zhīdao yīnggāi shuō shénme cái hǎo.
I didn't know what to say.
我小的时候，父母也说，社会竞争那么激烈，
Wǒ xiǎo de shíhou, fùmǔ yě shuō, shèhuì jìngzhēng nàme jīliè,
When I was little, my parents also said that competition in society was so fierce
不希望我输在起跑线上，
bù xīwàng wǒ shū zài qǐpǎoxiàn shàng,
that they didn't want me to lose at the starting line,
所以尽量给我提供最好的学习条件、物质条件。
suǒyǐ jǐnliàng gěi wǒ tígōng zuì hǎo de xuéxí tiáojiàn, wùzhì tiáojiàn.
so they tried their best to give me the best conditions for study and the best material conditions.
他们给我报了各种兴趣班，英语、数学，
Tāmen gěi wǒ bào le gè zhǒng xìngqù bān, Yīngyǔ, shùxué,
They signed me up for all kinds of classes, English and maths,
还给我请了本地最好的小提琴老师。
huán gěi wǒ qǐng le běndì zuì hǎo de xiǎotíqín lǎoshī.
and even hired the best violin teacher in town.
每次我不愿意练琴的时候，妈妈都劝我说：
Měicì wǒ bú yuànyì liàn qín de shíhou, māma dōu quàn wǒ shuō:
Every time I didn't want to practise, Mum would try to persuade me:
“不努力就会落后，只有多练才能保持水平。
"Bù nǔlì jiù huì luòhòu, zhǐyǒu duō liàn cái néng bǎochí shuǐpíng.
"If you don't work hard you'll fall behind. Only by practising more can you keep up your level.
多学一样本事，就多一个机会。你长大了就会明白了。”
Duō xué yí yàng běnshi, jiù duō yí ge jīhuì. Nǐ zhǎngdà le jiù huì míngbai le."
Every extra skill is an extra opportunity. You'll understand when you grow up."
那时，我对这样的说法很反感，
Nà shí, wǒ duì zhèyàng de shuōfǎ hěn fǎngǎn,
Back then I hated hearing that,
但是现在，我却非常感谢她。
dànshì xiànzài, wǒ què fēicháng gǎnxiè tā.
but now I'm very grateful to her.
幸好她那时候逼我学琴、学英语，
Xìnghǎo tā nà shíhou bī wǒ xué qín, xué Yīngyǔ,
Luckily she made me learn the violin and English back then.
成年以后，学乐器和外语多费劲啊！
chéngnián yǐhòu, xué yuèqì hé wàiyǔ duō fèijìn a!
Learning an instrument or a foreign language as an adult is so much harder!
如果我把这些告诉邻居的孩子，他会理解吗？不一定。
Rúguǒ wǒ bǎ zhèxiē gàosu línjū de háizi, tā huì lǐjiě ma? Bù yídìng.
If I told the neighbour's boy all this, would he understand? Not necessarily.
我想，现在的他跟小时候的我一样，谁的话都听不进去。
Wǒ xiǎng, xiànzài de tā gēn xiǎoshíhou de wǒ yíyàng, shéi dehuà dōu tīng bu jìnqu.
I think he's just like I was as a child: he won't listen to anyone.
我小时候想偷懒，不想去上补习班，还装过病。
Wǒ xiǎoshíhou xiǎng tōulǎn, bù xiǎng qù shàng bǔxíbān, hái zhuāng guo bìng.
As a child I wanted to slack off. I didn't want to go to cram school and even pretended to be ill.
这可把奶奶气坏了，她觉得都是因为妈妈给了我太大的压力。
Zhè kě bǎ nǎinai qìhuài le, tā juéde dōu shì yīnwèi māma gěi le wǒ tài dà de yālì.
That made Grandma furious. She thought it was all because Mum was putting too much pressure on me.
奶奶着急地跟妈妈说：
Nǎinai zháojí de gēn māma shuō:
Grandma said anxiously to Mum:
“期望越高，失望越大。孩子年龄还小，
"Qīwàng yuè gāo, shīwàng yuè dà. Háizi niánlíng hái xiǎo,
"The higher your hopes, the bigger the disappointment. The child is still young.
要是把身体累坏了，一切期望都成空了。
yàoshì bǎ shēntǐ lèihuài le, yíqiè qīwàng dōu chéng kōng le.
If he wears himself out and gets ill, all your hopes will come to nothing.
还是顺其自然吧，别勉强孩子。”
Háishi shùn qí zìrán ba, bié miǎnqiǎng háizi."
Let nature take its course. Don't force him."
可妈妈反对说：
Kě māma fǎnduì shuō:
But Mum objected:
“我和他爸小时候就是因为家里没条件多念书，
"Wǒ hé tā bà xiǎoshíhou jiùshì yīnwèi jiā li méi tiáojiàn duō niàn shū,
"His dad and I couldn't study much as children because our families didn't have the means,
现在想竞争好一点的职位都不行。
xiànzài xiǎng jìngzhēng hǎo yìdiǎn de zhíwèi dōu bù xíng.
and now we can't even compete for better jobs.
无论怎么样，都要让孩子多学点，要不然将来会后悔的。”
Wúlùn zěnmeyàng, dōu yào ràng háizi duō xué diǎn, yào bùrán jiānglái huì hòuhuǐ de."
Whatever happens, he has to learn more, or he'll regret it later."
俩人谁也不能说服谁，有时候还会吵起来。
Liǎ rén shéi yě bù néng shuōfú shéi, yǒushíhou hái huì chǎo qǐlái.
Neither could convince the other, and sometimes they ended up arguing.
不过，后来学习真的变成了我的兴趣，
Búguò, hòulái xuéxí zhēn de biànchéng le wǒ de xìngqù,
Later, though, studying really did become my passion.
即使父母不逼我，我也愿意学了。
jíshǐ fùmǔ bù bī wǒ, wǒ yě yuànyì xué le.
Even when my parents didn't push me, I wanted to learn.
这就是我唯一的学习经验：兴趣是最好的老师。
Zhè jiùshì wǒ wéiyī de xuéxí jīngyàn: xìngqù shì zuì hǎo de lǎoshī.
That's my only secret to learning: interest is the best teacher.
人的看法会随着年龄的增长而改变。
Rén de kànfǎ huì suízhe niánlíng de zēngzhǎng ér gǎibiàn.
People's views change as they get older.
小时候，我也跟父母争吵过，说他们管得太多了，
Xiǎoshíhou, wǒ yě gēn fùmǔ zhēngchǎo guo, shuō tāmen guǎn de tài duō le,
As a child I argued with my parents too, saying they were too controlling:
不许我晚上出去玩，不许看电视，不许玩电脑，不准谈恋爱，
bù xǔ wǒ wǎnshang chūqu wán, bù xǔ kàn diànshì, bù xǔ wán diànnǎo, bù zhǔn tán liàn'ài,
I wasn't allowed out at night, wasn't allowed to watch TV or play on the computer, wasn't allowed a girlfriend.
说他们不理解我，让我的童年没有自由。
shuō tāmen bù lǐjiě wǒ, ràng wǒ de tóngnián méiyǒu zìyóu.
I said they didn't understand me and that they'd taken away the freedom of my childhood.
其实，我只说对了一半：父母不理解我，我也不理解他们。
Qíshí, wǒ zhǐ shuō duìle yíbàn: fùmǔ bù lǐjiě wǒ, wǒ yě bù lǐjiě tāmen.
Actually, I was only half right: my parents didn't understand me, and I didn't understand them either.
我觉得，从小养成良好的学习和生活习惯很重要。
Wǒ juéde, cóng xiǎo yǎngchéng liánghǎo de xuéxí hé shēnghuó xíguàn hěn zhòngyào.
I think it's very important to develop good study and living habits from an early age.
特别是我参加工作以后，才知道生活不易，
Tèbié shì wǒ cānjiā gōngzuò yǐhòu, cái zhīdao shēnghuó bú yì,
Especially since I started work, I've realised life isn't easy,
也越来越理解父母，他们的愿望都是良好的，
yě yuèláiyuè lǐjiě fùmǔ, tāmen de yuànwàng dōu shì liánghǎo de,
and I understand my parents more and more. They always meant well,
虽然他们的教育方式不一定都是正确的。
suīrán tāmen de jiàoyù fāngshì bù yídìng dōu shì zhèngquè de.
even if their way of bringing me up wasn't always right.
将来我也会结婚生子，可能到了那个时候，
Jiānglái wǒ yě huì jié hūn shēng zǐ, kěnéng dào le nàge shíhou,
One day I'll marry and have children too, and maybe only then
我才能够真正理解“可怜天下父母心”这句话吧。
wǒ cái néng gòu zhēnzhèng lǐjiě "kělián tiānxià fùmǔ xīn" zhè jù huà ba.
will I truly understand the saying "how much parents everywhere give for their children".

vocab: to pay a New Year visit
to be made to stand (as punishment)
to dislike, to be put off
to let nature take its course
parents everywhere give their all for their children
grammar: 趁着……的功夫
while … (taking the chance)
趁 means making use of a moment.
趁着大人们去厨房准备饭菜的功夫，男孩悄悄地跟我抱怨：
Chèn zhe dà rénmen qù chúfáng zhǔnbèi fàncài de gōngfu, nánhái qiāoqiāo de gēn wǒ bàoyuàn:
While the grown-ups went to the kitchen to make lunch, the boy quietly complained to me:
趁着周末，我们去爬山吧。
Chèn zhe zhōumò, wǒmen qù páshān ba.
Let's go hiking while it's the weekend.
被……V + 得直……
… so much that …
直 + verb shows something happening uncontrollably.
考试成绩不好时，还会挨打，被尺子打得直掉眼泪。
kǎoshì chéngjì bù hǎo shí, hái huì ái dǎ, bèi chǐzi dǎ de zhí diào yǎnlèi.
and when my exam results were bad I'd get a beating with a ruler that left me in tears.
他笑得直流眼泪。
Tā xiào de zhí liú yǎnlèi.
He laughed till tears ran down his face.
不希望……输在起跑线上
not wanting … to lose at the starting line
A common saying about giving children an early head start.
不希望我输在起跑线上，
bù xīwàng wǒ shū zài qǐpǎoxiàn shàng,
that they didn't want me to lose at the starting line,
很多家长不想让孩子输在起跑线上。
Hěn duō jiāzhǎng bù xiǎng ràng háizi shū zài qǐpǎoxiàn shàng.
Many parents don't want their children to fall behind from the start.
只有……才……
only if …, then …
只有 gives the necessary condition, and 才 the result.
“不努力就会落后，只有多练才能保持水平。
"Bù nǔlì jiù huì luòhòu, zhǐyǒu duō liàn cái néng bǎochí shuǐpíng.
"If you don't work hard you'll fall behind. Only by practising more can you keep up your level.
只有努力，才能成功。
Zhǐyǒu nǔlì, cái néng chénggōng.
Only by working hard can you succeed.
多……一……，就多一……
one more …, one more …
Parallel structure: each extra A brings an extra B.
多学一样本事，就多一个机会。你长大了就会明白了。”
Duō xué yí yàng běnshi, jiù duō yí ge jīhuì. Nǐ zhǎngdà le jiù huì míngbai le."
Every extra skill is an extra opportunity. You'll understand when you grow up."
多一个朋友，就多一条路。
Duō yí ge péngyou, jiù duō yì tiáo lù.
One more friend is one more road.
the more …, the more …
Two things rise together.
“期望越高，失望越大。孩子年龄还小，
"Qīwàng yuè gāo, shīwàng yuè dà. Háizi niánlíng hái xiǎo,
"The higher your hopes, the bigger the disappointment. The child is still young.
你越着急，越做不好。
Nǐ yuè zháojí, yuè zuò bù hǎo.
The more anxious you are, the worse you do.
谁也不能 + V + 谁
neither can … the other
谁 used twice means each other.
俩人谁也不能说服谁，有时候还会吵起来。
Liǎ rén shéi yě bù néng shuōfú shéi, yǒushíhou hái huì chǎo qǐlái.
Neither could convince the other, and sometimes they ended up arguing.
他们谁也不理谁。
Tāmen shéi yě bù lǐ shéi.

… as …

Rén de kànfǎ huì suízhe niánlíng de zēngzhǎng ér gǎibiàn.
People's views change as they get older.
随着经济的发展，人们的生活越来越好。
Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó yuèláiyuè hǎo.
As the economy grows, life keeps getting better.

050.title: On reducing the burden
050.sub: Reading B: why Chinese pupils are overloaded, and what the BBC found
050.transcriptNote: The second lesson text, read as a report and split into paragraphs. 减负 means "reducing the (study) burden" on pupils.

lines: 谈谈减负
Tántán jiǎn fù
On reducing the burden
有人说，今天这个时代的中国中小学生过得并不轻松。
Yǒu rén shuō, jīntiān zhège shídài de Zhōngguó zhōng-xiǎoxuéshēng guò de bìng bù qīngsōng.
Some say that Chinese primary and secondary pupils today don't have an easy life.
他们除了有正常的学业以外，还要参加各种兴趣班和补习班，负担很重。
Tāmen chúle yǒu zhèngcháng de xuéyè yǐwài, hái yào cānjiā gè zhǒng xìngqù bān hé bǔxíbān, fùdān hěn zhòng.
Besides their normal schoolwork, they have to go to all sorts of hobby and cram classes, so their load is heavy.
减负成了社会关注的话题。
Jiǎn fù chéng le shèhuì guānzhù de huàtí.
Reducing the burden has become a topic of public concern.
许多人希望能够减轻学生的学业负担，还给孩子自由。
Xǔduō rén xīwàng nénggòu jiǎnqīng xuésheng de xuéyè fùdān, huán gěi háizi zìyóu.
Many people hope to lighten pupils' study load and give children back their freedom.
中国学生学业负担过重，大概有学校和家庭这两方面的原因。
Zhōngguó xuésheng xuéyè fùdān guòzhòng, dàgài yǒu xuéxiào hé jiātíng zhè liǎng fāngmiàn de yuányīn.
There are probably two reasons why Chinese pupils' study load is too heavy: schools and families.
在学校方面，看一所学校的质量主要看升学率，
Zài xuéxiào fāngmiàn, kàn yì suǒ xuéxiào de zhìliàng zhǔyào kàn shēngxué lǜ,
As for schools, a school's quality is judged mainly by its rate of progression,
特别是进入重点大学的升学率。
tèbié shì jìnrù zhòngdiǎn dàxué de shēngxué lǜ.
especially how many pupils get into top universities.
在这种压力下，学校变得以分数为中心。
Zài zhè zhǒng yālì xià, xuéxiào biàn de yǐ fēnshù wèi zhōngxīn.
Under this pressure, schools have become centred on marks.
不少学校增加了英语课和数学课，减少了音乐课和体育课的上课时间。
Bù shǎo xuéxiào zēngjiā le Yīngyǔ kè hé shùxué kè, jiǎnshǎo le yīnyuè kè hé tǐyù kè de shàng kè shíjiān.
Many schools have added English and maths lessons and cut time for music and PE.
另外，在制度上，学生的成绩跟老师的工资、奖金也有一定关系。
Lìngwài, zài zhìdù shàng, xuésheng de chéngjì gēn lǎoshī de gōngzī, jiǎngjīn yě yǒu yídìng guānxi.
Also, under the system, pupils' results are linked to some extent to teachers' pay and bonuses.
在家庭方面，很多家长望子成龙，望女成凤，
Zài jiātíng fāngmiàn, hěn duō jiāzhǎng wàng zǐ chéng lóng, wàng nǚ chéng fèng,
As for families, many parents dream of their sons becoming dragons and their daughters phoenixes,
尤其是对独生子女的期望相当高。
yóuqí shì duì dúshēng zǐnǚ de qīwàng xiāngdāng gāo.
and expectations of only children are especially high.
