originally …, but it turned out the opposite
本来 gives the plan; 结果 the real outcome.
她给儿子报补习班，本来是希望他能把成绩提高上来，结果正相反，这次考试，儿子的学习成绩都下降了。
Tā gěi érzi bào bǔxíbān, běnlái shì xīwàng tā néng bǎ chéngjì tígāo shanglai, jiéguǒ zhèng xiāngfǎn, zhè cì kǎoshì, érzi de xuéxí chéngjì dōu xiàjiàng le.
She signed her son up for cram school hoping to raise his grades, but the result was the opposite: his grades all dropped in this exam.
本来想早点到，结果迟到了。
Běnlái xiǎng zǎo diǎn dào, jiéguǒ chídào le.
I meant to arrive early but ended up late.
为了解决……等后顾之忧
to settle worries such as …
等 ends a list: and so on.
为了解决养老、看病等后顾之忧，大多数中国人都攒钱。
Wèile jiějué yǎnglǎo, kàn bìng děng hòugù zhī yōu, dàduōshù Zhōngguórén dōu zǎn qián.
Most Chinese people save to take care of future worries such as old age and medical bills.
他学了汉语、日语等外语。
Tā xué le Hànyǔ, Rìyǔ děng wàiyǔ.
He has learned Chinese, Japanese and other languages.
gaps: 小城市的房价虽然和一线城市比有一定的
为了给儿子买房子，他十分
我和我妈长得很像，但是
say: These two spend very differently: one would split every cent in two, the other spends money like water.
The "moonlight clan" really know how to enjoy life and never deny themselves anything.
There's no need to scrimp and save all the time like Xiaoyue. When you need to spend, you should spend.
I look just like my mum, but our personalities are complete opposites.
Most Chinese people save to take care of future worries such as old age and medical bills.

056.title: Do they mean the same?
056.sub: Five pairs of sentences about money
056.transcriptNote: Each item reads sentence A, then sentence B. Decide whether they mean the same thing, then turn on Answers. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断两个句子的意思是否相符 · Same meaning or not?
lines: 听录音，判断两个句子的意思是否相符。
Tīng lùyīn, pànduàn liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu xiāngfú.
Listen and decide whether the two sentences mean the same.
现在多攒一些钱，将来就不会有太多的后顾之忧。
Xiànzài duō zǎn yìxiē qián, jiānglái jiù bú huì yǒu tài duō de hòugù zhī yōu.
Save a bit more now, and you won't have too many worries later.
A
现在不把钱存起来，以后有需要的时候，就会觉得问题很多。
Xiànzài bù bǎ qián cún qǐlái, yǐhòu yǒu xūyào de shíhou, jiù huì juéde wèntí hěn duō.
If you don't put money aside now, you'll run into lots of problems when you need it later.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say saving now prevents problems later.

lines: 我们消费要有一个度，既不能过度节俭，也不能过度消费。
Wǒmen xiāofèi yào yǒu yí ge dù, jì bù néng guòdù jiéjiǎn, yě bù néng guòdù xiāofèi.
Our spending needs limits: neither too thrifty nor overspending.
A
既不能当守财奴，也不能当败家子儿。
Jì bù néng dāng shǒucáinú, yě bù néng dāng bàijiāzǐr.
Be neither a miser nor a spendthrift.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A miser is too thrifty and a spendthrift overspends.

lines: 他们两个都是典型的月光族，很有共同语言。
Tāmen liǎng ge dōu shì diǎnxíng de yuèguāngzú, hěn yǒu gòngtóng yǔyán.
They're both typical "moonlight clan" spenders and have a lot in common.
A
他们两个都很节俭，绝不轻易花钱。
Tāmen liǎng ge dōu hěn jiéjiǎn, jué bù qīngyì huā qián.
They're both very thrifty and never spend lightly.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: The moonlight clan spend all their pay; they're not thrifty.

lines: 我妈嫌我买的东西贵，所以在我家基本上都是她去购物。
Wǒ mā xián wǒ mǎi de dōngxi guì, suǒyǐ zài wǒ jiā jīběn shang dōu shì tā qù gòuwù.
My mum thinks the things I buy are too expensive, so she does almost all the shopping in our family.
A
我妈不太愿意让我去买东西，因为她觉得我太爱买处理品。
Wǒ mā bú tài yuànyì ràng wǒ qù mǎi dōngxi, yīnwèi tā juéde wǒ tài ài mǎi chǔlǐ pǐn.
My mum doesn't like me doing the shopping because she thinks I buy too many clearance goods.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: In A the problem is buying expensive things; in B it's buying cheap clearance goods.

lines: 这孩子经常和父母争吵，真是不懂事儿啊。
Zhè háizi jīngcháng hé fùmǔ zhēngchǎo, zhēn shì bù dǒngshìr a.
This child is always arguing with his parents. He really has no sense.
A
这孩子太小了，听不懂父母说的话。
Zhè háizi tài xiǎo le, tīng bù dǒng fùmǔ shuō dehuà.
This child is too young to understand what his parents say.
B

q: 两个句子的意思一样吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi yíyàng ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: 不懂事儿 means thoughtless, not unable to understand words.

vocab: people who spend all their pay each month
grammar: 现在……，将来就……
… now, then later …
Sets a present action against a future result.
现在多攒一些钱，将来就不会有太多的后顾之忧。
Xiànzài duō zǎn yìxiē qián, jiānglái jiù bú huì yǒu tài duō de hòugù zhī yōu.
Save a bit more now, and you won't have too many worries later.
现在多练习，将来就容易了。
Xiànzài duō liànxí, jiānglái jiù róngyì le.
Practise more now and it'll be easy later.
要有一个度
must have limits
度 here means a proper degree or limit.
我们消费要有一个度，既不能过度节俭，也不能过度消费。
Wǒmen xiāofèi yào yǒu yí ge dù, jì bù néng guòdù jiéjiǎn, yě bù néng guòdù xiāofèi.
Our spending needs limits: neither too thrifty nor overspending.
吃东西要有一个度。
Chī dōngxi yào yǒu yí ge dù.
You should eat in moderation.
既不能……，也不能……
neither … nor …
Two negatives joined by 既 and 也.
既不能当守财奴，也不能当败家子儿。
Jì bù néng dāng shǒucáinú, yě bù néng dāng bàijiāzǐr.
Be neither a miser nor a spendthrift.
既不能太快，也不能太慢。
Jì bù néng tài kuài, yě bù néng tài màn.
It can't be too fast or too slow.
嫌 + O + adj
to find … too …
嫌 expresses dissatisfaction.
我妈嫌我买的东西贵，所以在我家基本上都是她去购物。
Wǒ mā xián wǒ mǎi de dōngxi guì, suǒyǐ zài wǒ jiā jīběn shang dōu shì tā qù gòuwù.
My mum thinks the things I buy are too expensive, so she does almost all the shopping in our family.
他嫌房子太小。
Tā xián fángzi tài xiǎo.
He thinks the flat is too small.
V + 不懂
can't understand
不懂 after a verb of perception means failing to understand.
这孩子太小了，听不懂父母说的话。
Zhè háizi tài xiǎo le, tīng bù dǒng fùmǔ shuō dehuà.
This child is too young to understand what his parents say.
这本书我看不懂。
Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn bù dǒng.
I can't understand this book.
gaps: 现在多攒一些钱，将来就不会有太多的
say: Save a bit more now, and you won't have too many worries later.
Our spending needs limits: neither too thrifty nor overspending.
Be neither a miser nor a spendthrift.
They're both typical "moonlight clan" spenders and have a lot in common.
This child is always arguing with his parents. He really has no sense.

057.title: Should they go abroad?
057.sub: Gao Pancai's family wants a holiday: 8 people's opinions
057.transcriptNote: Gao Pancai, 42, and his wife have never travelled far. For the National Day holiday they'd like to take their child abroad for a few days. Eight people react. Decide whether each one is for or against the trip, then turn on Answers. Several item numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断说话人的意思 · What does the speaker think?
lines: 判断说话人的意思。
Pànduàn shuōhuàrén de yìsi.
Work out what the speaker means.
高盼才今年四十二岁，他和妻子从来没出过远门。
Gāo Pàncái jīnnián sìshí èr suì, tā hé qīzi cónglái méi chū guo yuǎnmén.
Gao Pancai is 42 this year. He and his wife have never travelled far from home.
十一放假，他们很想带孩子出国旅游几天。
Shí-Yī fàng jià, tāmen hěn xiǎng dài háizi chū guó lǚyóu jǐ tiān.
For the National Day holiday they'd love to take their child abroad for a few days.
下面是一些人对此的看法，你觉得他们的态度是什么？
Xiàmiàn shì yìxiē rén duì cǐ de kànfǎ, nǐ juéde tāmen de tàidu shì shénme?
Here are some people's views on this. What do you think their attitudes are?
人活一辈子不容易，趁能走能动的时候，还是多去看看好啊。
Rén huó yíbèizi bù róngyì, chèn néng zǒu néng dòng de shíhou, háishi duō qù kànkan hǎo a.
Life isn't easy. While you can still get about, it's better to go and see more.
你家房贷还没还完呢，你还有心思去玩啊？早点还完多好。
Nǐ jiā fángdài hái méi hái wán ne, nǐ hái yǒu xīnsi qù wán a? Zǎo diǎn hái wán duō hǎo.
You haven't even paid off your mortgage, and you're thinking about holidays? Better to pay it off early.
有啥好玩的？外国那几个国家地方都一样，人长得都一样，吃的东西也都一样。
Yǒu shá hǎowánr de? Wàiguó nà jǐ ge guójiā dìfang dōu yíyàng, rén cháng de dōu yíyàng, chī de dōngxi yě dōu yíyàng.
What's so fun about it? All those foreign countries are the same, the people look the same and the food's the same.
人家说话你又听不懂，花好几万块钱没啥意思。
Rénjia shuōhuà nǐ yòu tīng bù dǒng, huā hǎo jǐ wàn kuài qián méi shá yìsi.
You can't understand what they say anyway. Spending tens of thousands on it is pointless.
还考虑什么呀？现在条件好了，也该享受享受了。
Hái kǎolǜ shénme ya? Xiànzài tiáojiàn hǎo le, yě gāi xiǎngshòu xiǎngshòu le.
What is there to think about? You're better off now. It's time you enjoyed yourselves.
我们公司去欧洲的旅游团都在打折呢，七日游都打九折。
Wǒmen gōngsī qù Ōuzhōu de lǚyóutuán dōu zài dǎzhé ne, qī rì yóu dōu dǎ jiǔ zhé.
Our company's tours to Europe are all on offer. Even the seven-day trip is 10% off.
出去就得花钱，你们又出国，还不得好几万？
Chūqu jiù de huā qián, nǐmen yòu chū guó, hái bù děi hǎo jǐ wàn?
Going away means spending money, and you'd be going abroad. Won't that cost tens of thousands?
再买点东西，一家三口十万都有了。要是我，我可舍不得。
Zài mǎi diǎn dōngxi, yì jiā sān kǒu shí wàn dōu yǒu le. Yàoshì wǒ, wǒ kě shěbude.
Add some shopping, and for a family of three it'll come to a hundred thousand. If it were me, I couldn't bring myself to.
现在家家都能吃饱穿暖了，时不时奢侈一下，也没啥不好的，又不是天天出国旅游。
Xiànzài jiā jiā dōu néng chī bǎo chuān nuǎn le, shíbùshí shēchǐ yíxià, yě méi shá bù hǎo de, yòu bú shì tiāntiān chū guó lǚyóu.
Every family has enough to eat and wear now. A bit of luxury now and then does no harm. It's not as if you go abroad every day.
盼才，不是我说你，孩子明年高考，你当家长的不好好陪陪孩子学习，
Pàncái, bú shì wǒ shuō nǐ, háizi míngnián gāokǎo, nǐ dāng jiāzhǎng de bù hǎohǎo péipei háizi xuéxí,
Pancai, I don't mean to criticise, but your child has the university entrance exam next year, and instead of helping him study,
倒是成天想着怎么玩，怎么乐，你这样他能学好习吗？
dàoshì chéngtiān xiǎngzhe zěnme wán, zěnme lè, nǐ zhèyàng tā néng xué hǎo xí ma?
you spend all your time thinking about having fun. How can he study properly like that?

grammar: 趁……的时候
while (one still can) …
趁 means taking advantage of a time.
人活一辈子不容易，趁能走能动的时候，还是多去看看好啊。
Rén huó yíbèizi bù róngyì, chèn néng zǒu néng dòng de shíhou, háishi duō qù kànkan hǎo a.
Life isn't easy. While you can still get about, it's better to go and see more.
趁年轻，多学点东西。
Chèn niánqīng, duō xué diǎn dōngxi.
Learn as much as you can while you're young.
还有心思 + V + 啊？
you're still in the mood to …?
A rhetorical question criticising misplaced priorities.
你家房贷还没还完呢，你还有心思去玩啊？早点还完多好。
Nǐ jiā fángdài hái méi hái wán ne, nǐ hái yǒu xīnsi qù wán a? Zǎo diǎn hái wán duō hǎo.
You haven't even paid off your mortgage, and you're thinking about holidays? Better to pay it off early.
明天考试，你还有心思看电视？
Míngtiān kǎoshì, nǐ hái yǒu xīnsi kàn diànshì?
You've got an exam tomorrow and you're watching TV?
有啥 + adj + 的？
what's so … about it?
A rhetorical question meaning "nothing".
有啥好玩的？外国那几个国家地方都一样，人长得都一样，吃的东西也都一样。
Yǒu shá hǎowánr de? Wàiguó nà jǐ ge guójiā dìfang dōu yíyàng, rén cháng de dōu yíyàng, chī de dōngxi yě dōu yíyàng.
What's so fun about it? All those foreign countries are the same, the people look the same and the food's the same.
有啥好看的？
Yǒu shá hǎokàn de?
What's there to see?
还不得……？
won't that take …?
A rhetorical question meaning it certainly will.
出去就得花钱，你们又出国，还不得好几万？
Chūqu jiù de huā qián, nǐmen yòu chū guó, hái bù děi hǎo jǐ wàn?
Going away means spending money, and you'd be going abroad. Won't that cost tens of thousands?
去那么远，还不得一天？
Qù nàme yuǎn, hái bù děi yì tiān?
Going that far, won't it take a whole day?
又不是……
it's not as if …
Dismisses an objection.
现在家家都能吃饱穿暖了，时不时奢侈一下，也没啥不好的，又不是天天出国旅游。
Xiànzài jiā jiā dōu néng chī bǎo chuān nuǎn le, shíbùshí shēchǐ yíxià, yě méi shá bù hǎo de, yòu bú shì tiāntiān chū guó lǚyóu.
Every family has enough to eat and wear now. A bit of luxury now and then does no harm. It's not as if you go abroad every day.
又不是第一次，别紧张。
Yòu bú shì dì-yī cì, bié jǐnzhāng.
It's not the first time. Don't be nervous.
不是我说你
I don't mean to criticise, but …
A softener before criticism.
盼才，不是我说你，孩子明年高考，你当家长的不好好陪陪孩子学习，
Pàncái, bú shì wǒ shuō nǐ, háizi míngnián gāokǎo, nǐ dāng jiāzhǎng de bù hǎohǎo péipei háizi xuéxí,
Pancai, I don't mean to criticise, but your child has the university entrance exam next year, and instead of helping him study,
不是我说你，你也太懒了。
Bú shì wǒ shuō nǐ, nǐ yě tài lǎn le.
I don't mean to criticise, but you're really lazy.
gaps: 高盼才今年四十二岁，他和妻子从来没出过
能走能动的时候，还是多去看看好啊。
人家说话你又听不懂，花好几万块钱没啥
say: Life isn't easy. While you can still get about, it's better to go and see more.
You haven't even paid off your mortgage, and you're thinking about holidays? Better to pay it off early.
What is there to think about? You're better off now. It's time you enjoyed yourselves.
Add some shopping, and for a family of three it'll come to a hundred thousand. If it were me, I couldn't bring myself to.
Every family has enough to eat and wear now. A bit of luxury now and then does no harm. It's not as if you go abroad every day.

058.title: How Chinese people spend
058.sub: Three questions, then a short passage on three spending types
058.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the passage. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

q: 中国人的消费方式可以分为哪些类型？
Zhōngguórén de xiāofèi fāngshì kěyǐ fēnwéi nǎxiē lèixíng?
What types can Chinese people's spending habits be divided into?
ans: 三种：过度节俭型、普通消费型、奢侈消费型。
Sān zhǒng: guòdù jiéjiǎn xíng, pǔtōng xiāofèi xíng, shēchǐ xiāofèi xíng.
Three: the over-thrifty type, the ordinary type and the extravagant type.

q: 中国老人属于哪种类型？
Zhōngguó lǎorén shǔyú nǎ zhǒng lèixíng?
Which type do older Chinese people belong to?
哪两种消费方式差距最大？
Nǎ liǎng zhǒng xiāofèi fāngshì chājù zuì dà?
Which two types differ the most?
ans: 过度节俭型和奢侈消费型。
Guòdù jiéjiǎn xíng hé shēchǐ xiāofèi xíng.
The over-thrifty type and the extravagant type.

blocks.label: 短文
blocks.h: 中国人的消费方式 · The passage
lines: 中国人的消费方式
Zhōngguórén de xiāofèi fāngshì
How Chinese people spend
有人说，中国人的消费方式可以分为三种类型。
Yǒu rén shuō, Zhōngguórén de xiāofèi fāngshì kěyǐ fēnwéi sān zhǒng lèixíng.
Some say Chinese people's spending habits fall into three types.
第一种是过度节俭型，老人基本上都属于这种类型。
Dì-yī zhǒng shì guòdù jiéjiǎn xíng, lǎorén jīběn shang dōu shǔyú zhè zhǒng lèixíng.
The first is the over-thrifty type. Older people almost all belong to this type.
这类人觉得，应该尽可能地把钱攒起来，
Zhè lèi rén juéde, yīnggāi jǐnkěnéng de bǎ qián zǎn qǐlái,
People like this feel they should save as much money as they can.
即使自己有一定的经济能力，也绝不轻易花钱。
jíshǐ zìjǐ yǒu yídìng de jīngjì nénglì, yě jué bù qīngyì huā qián.
Even when they have some financial means, they never spend lightly.
他们喜欢买打折品、处理品，一切以经济、廉价为第一条件。
Tāmen xǐhuan mǎi dǎzhé pǐn, chǔlǐ pǐn, yíqiè yǐ jīngjì, liánjià wèi dì-yī tiáojiàn.
They like to buy discounted and clearance goods; everything comes down to being economical and cheap.
第二种是普通消费型。
Dì-èr zhǒng shì pǔtōng xiāofèi xíng.
The second is the ordinary type.
这一类型的人会为解决后顾之忧而攒钱，但是不会为攒钱而委屈自己。
Zhè yí lèi xíng de rén huì wèi jiějué hòugù zhī yōu ér zǎn qián, dànshì bú huì wèi zǎn qián ér wěiqu zìjǐ.
People of this type save to settle future worries, but they don't deny themselves just to save.
他们有一定的消费原则，在保证能吃饱穿暖的情况下，
Tāmen yǒu yídìng de xiāofèi yuánzé, zài bǎozhèng néng chī bǎo chuān nuǎn de qíngkuàng xià,
They have certain spending principles: once they're sure of food and clothing,
他们会不断改善自己的生活条件。
tāmen huì búduàn gǎishàn zìjǐ de shēnghuó tiáojiàn.
they keep improving their living conditions.
第三种是奢侈消费型，这一类型的群体主要是年轻人。
Dì-sān zhǒng shì shēchǐ xiāofèi xíng, zhè yí lèi xíng de qúntǐ zhǔyào shì niánqīngrén.
The third is the extravagant type, and this group is mainly young people.
他们只在乎享受现在，不愿意考虑以后会出现的经济问题。
Tāmen zhǐ zàihu xiǎngshòu xiànzài, bú yuànyì kǎolǜ yǐhòu huì chūxiàn de jīngjì wèntí.
They only care about enjoying the present and don't want to think about money problems later on.
这类人群喜欢购物，买名牌，买奢侈品，他们很少攒钱。
Zhè lèi rénqún xǐhuan gòuwù, mǎi míngpái, mǎi shēchǐpǐn, tāmen hěn shǎo zǎn qián.
They love shopping, buying brand names and luxury goods, and they rarely save.

grammar: 分为……类型
to be divided into … types
分为 + number + 种类型.
有人说，中国人的消费方式可以分为三种类型。
Yǒu rén shuō, Zhōngguórén de xiāofèi fāngshì kěyǐ fēnwéi sān zhǒng lèixíng.
Some say Chinese people's spending habits fall into three types.
学生可以分为两种类型。
Xuésheng kěyǐ fēnwéi liǎng zhǒng lèixíng.
Students can be divided into two types.
即使……，也绝不……
even if …, still never …
即使 gives a condition; 也 + 绝不 says it still doesn't happen.
即使自己有一定的经济能力，也绝不轻易花钱。
jíshǐ zìjǐ yǒu yídìng de jīngjì nénglì, yě jué bù qīngyì huā qián.
Even when they have some financial means, they never spend lightly.
即使很累，他也绝不休息。
Jíshǐ hěn lèi, tā yě jué bù xiūxi.
Even when he's tired, he never rests.
一切以……为第一条件
everything comes down to …
以 A 为 B: take A as the top requirement.
他们喜欢买打折品、处理品，一切以经济、廉价为第一条件。
Tāmen xǐhuan mǎi dǎzhé pǐn, chǔlǐ pǐn, yíqiè yǐ jīngjì, liánjià wèi dì-yī tiáojiàn.
They like to buy discounted and clearance goods; everything comes down to being economical and cheap.
一切以孩子为中心。
Yíqiè yǐ háizi wèi zhōngxīn.
Everything revolves around the child.
为……而……，不会为……而……
to … for …, but not to … for …
Parallel 为……而 clauses contrast two purposes.
这一类型的人会为解决后顾之忧而攒钱，但是不会为攒钱而委屈自己。
Zhè yí lèi xíng de rén huì wèi jiějué hòugù zhī yōu ér zǎn qián, dànshì bú huì wèi zǎn qián ér wěiqu zìjǐ.
People of this type save to settle future worries, but they don't deny themselves just to save.
他为工作而活，不为钱而活。
Tā wèi gōngzuò ér huó, bú wèi qián ér huó.
He lives for his work, not for money.
在……的情况下
under … conditions
Sets the condition for what follows.
他们有一定的消费原则，在保证能吃饱穿暖的情况下，
Tāmen yǒu yídìng de xiāofèi yuánzé, zài bǎozhèng néng chī bǎo chuān nuǎn de qíngkuàng xià,
They have certain spending principles: once they're sure of food and clothing,
在没有钱的情况下，他还是帮了我。
Zài méiyǒu qián de qíngkuàng xià, tā háishi bāng le wǒ.
Even without money, he still helped me.
只在乎……
only cares about …
在乎 means to care about or mind.
他们只在乎享受现在，不愿意考虑以后会出现的经济问题。
Tāmen zhǐ zàihu xiǎngshòu xiànzài, bú yuànyì kǎolǜ yǐhòu huì chūxiàn de jīngjì wèntí.
They only care about enjoying the present and don't want to think about money problems later on.
他只在乎钱。
Tā zhǐ zàihu qián.
All he cares about is money.
gaps: 型，老人基本上都属于这种类型。
say: Some say Chinese people's spending habits fall into three types.
The first is the over-thrifty type. Older people almost all belong to this type.
The second is the ordinary type.
The third is the extravagant type, and this group is mainly young people.
They love shopping, buying brand names and luxury goods, and they rarely save.

059.title: The miser and the big spender
059.sub: Five true-or-false statements, then the story of two very different sisters
059.transcriptNote: First five statements to judge, then the passage. The narrator's older sister is a miser and the younger, Yueyue, spends everything she earns. The questions on this passage are in part 060. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，判断句子的正误。请先听五个句子。
Tīng lùyīn, pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù. Qǐng xiān tīng wǔ ge jùzi.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false. First listen to five sentences.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 五个句子 · True or false

q: 姐姐月薪不高，所以十分节俭，什么都舍不得买。
Jiějie yuèxīn bù gāo, suǒyǐ shífēn jiéjiǎn, shénme dōu shěbude mǎi.
The older sister's salary is low, so she's very thrifty and won't buy anything.
qs.why: Both sisters' salaries are 还可以 (decent); she's thrifty by nature.

q: 妹妹很会享受生活，绝不委屈自己。
Mèimei hěn huì xiǎngshòu shēnghuó, jué bù wěiqu zìjǐ.
The younger sister knows how to enjoy life and never denies herself.
qs.why: She's a typical "moonlight clan" spender.

q: 姐姐很能理解妹妹，觉得现在的年轻人都是这样。
Jiějie hěn néng lǐjiě mèimei, juéde xiànzài de niánqīngrén dōu shì zhèyàng.
The older sister understands the younger and thinks all young people are like that.
qs.why: She calls her a spendthrift and says young people are out of line.

q: 姐姐的孩子结婚了，可是没有房子。
Jiějie de háizi jié hūn le, kěshì méiyǒu fángzi.
The older sister's child is married but has no flat.
qs.why: She's saving to buy a flat for her child's future wedding.

q: 我更喜欢妹妹，不喜欢姐姐。
Wǒ gèng xǐhuan mèimei, bù xǐhuan jiějie.
The narrator prefers the younger sister to the older one.
qs.why: The narrator never says so.

blocks.label: 短文
blocks.h: 守财奴和月光族 · The passage
lines: 下面请听文章。
Xiàmiàn qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
守财奴和月光族
Shǒucáinú hé yuèguāngzú
The miser and the big spender
我有一个姐姐，一个妹妹。姐姐今年四十，妹妹三十。
Wǒ yǒu yí ge jiějie, yí ge mèimei. Jiějie jīnnián sìshí, mèimei sānshí.
I have an older sister and a younger sister. My older sister is forty this year and my younger sister thirty.
两个人都在办公室工作，薪水也还可以，
Liǎng ge rén dōu zài bàngōngshì gōngzuò, xīnshui yě hái kěyǐ,
Both work in offices and earn decent salaries,
但在花钱方面差距特别大，没有共同语言。
dàn zài huā qián fāngmiàn chājù tèbié dà, méiyǒu gòngtóng yǔyán.
but when it comes to spending they're worlds apart and have nothing in common.
姐姐舍不得花钱，恨不得一分钱掰成两半花，总是嫌这贵嫌那贵。
Jiějie shěbude huā qián, hènbude yì fēn qián bāi chéng liǎng bàn huā, zǒngshì xián zhè guì xián nà guì.
My older sister can't bear to spend money. She'd split every cent in two if she could, and she always complains that everything is too expensive.
即使遇见自己喜欢的东西，也会因为价格太高而放弃。
Jíshǐ yùjiàn zìjǐ xǐhuan de dōngxi, yě huì yīnwèi jiàgé tài gāo ér fàngqì.
Even when she sees something she likes, she gives it up because the price is too high.
妹妹则正相反，她属于典型的月光族，
Mèimei zé zhèng xiāngfǎn, tā shǔyú diǎnxíng de yuèguāngzú,
My younger sister is the exact opposite. She's a typical "moonlight clan" spender:
不仅喜欢逛街购物，而且花钱如流水。
bùjǐn xǐhuan guàng jiē gòuwù, érqiě huā qián rú liúshuǐ.
she not only loves shopping but spends money like water.
拿着四千块的月薪，敢买三千五百块的包，
Ná zhe sì qiān kuài de yuèxīn, gǎn mǎi sān qiān wǔ bǎi kuài de bāo,
On a monthly salary of 4,000 she'll buy a 3,500 handbag,
一年换至少四部几千块的新款手机。
yì nián huàn zhìshǎo sì bù jǐ qiān kuài de xīnkuǎn shǒujī.
and she changes her phone at least four times a year, each a new model costing thousands.
这样，她每个月的工资不仅全部花光，有时还会超前消费。
Zhèyàng, tā měi ge yuè de gōngzī bùjǐn quánbù huāguāng, yǒushí hái huì chāoqiánxiāofèi.
So every month she not only spends her whole salary but sometimes spends ahead of it.
姐姐说妹妹是个败家子儿，妹妹说姐姐是个守财奴。
Jiějie shuō mèimei shì ge bàijiāzǐr, mèimei shuō jiějie shì ge shǒucáinú.
My older sister says the younger one is a spendthrift; the younger says the older one is a miser.
两个人根本不能一起出去买东西，否则一定会吵嘴。
Liǎng ge rén gēnběn bù néng yìqǐ chūqu mǎi dōngxi, fǒuzé yídìng huì chǎozuǐ.
The two of them can't go shopping together at all, or they'll definitely quarrel.
我姐在我面前评论我妹妹时会说：
Wǒ jiě zài wǒ miànqián pínglùn wǒ mèimei shí huì shuō:
When my older sister talks about my younger sister to me, she says:
“月月她太不懂事了，太浪费了。
"Yuèyue tā tài bù dǒngshì le, tài làngfèi le.
"Yueyue is so thoughtless, so wasteful.
你看看她买的那些东西，有一半是根本用不着的。
Nǐ kànkan tā mǎi de nàxiē dōngxi, yǒu yíbàn shì gēnběn yòng bu zháo de.
Look at the things she buys. Half of them she doesn't need at all.
什么名牌不名牌，新款不新款的，能吃饱穿暖就行呗。
Shénme míngpái bù míngpái, xīnkuǎn bù xīnkuǎn de, néng chī bǎo chuān nuǎn jiù xíng bei.
Brand names, latest models, who cares? As long as you're fed and clothed, that's enough.
现在的年轻人太不像话了。”
Xiànzài de niánqīngrén tài bú xiànghuà le."
Young people today are really out of line."
妹妹在我面前评论姐姐时则会说：
Mèimei zài wǒ miànqián pínglùn jiějie shí zé huì shuō:
When my younger sister talks about the older one, she says:
“我姐其实没必要这么省吧？
"Wǒ jiě qíshí méi bìyào zhème shěng ba?
"My sister really doesn't need to be so tight, does she?
总说什么攒钱让孩子上学，什么买套房子将来留给孩子结婚用，
Zǒng shuō shénme zǎn qián ràng háizi shàng xué, shénme mǎi tào fángzi jiānglái liú gěi háizi jié hūn yòng,
She's always on about saving for her child's schooling, buying a flat for her child's wedding one day,
什么攒钱将来养老看病，累不累呀？
shénme zǎn qián jiānglái yǎnglǎo kàn bìng, lèi bú lèi ya?
saving for her old age and medical bills. Isn't that exhausting?
你看她这么省吃俭用的，连套高档一点的衣服都没有。
Nǐ kàn tā zhème shěng chī jiǎn yòng de, lián tào gāodàng yìdiǎn de yīfu dōu méiyǒu.
Look how she scrimps and saves. She doesn't even have one decent outfit.
像她这样太对不起自己了，我可受不了。”
Xiàng tā zhèyàng tài duìbuqǐ zìjǐ le, wǒ kě shòu bu liǎo."
Living like her is really unfair to yourself. I couldn't stand it."

vocab: people who spend all their pay each month
yì fēn qián bāi chéng liǎng bàn huā
grammar: 在……方面
when it comes to …
Introduces the area being compared.
但在花钱方面差距特别大，没有共同语言。
dàn zài huā qián fāngmiàn chājù tèbié dà, méiyǒu gòngtóng yǔyán.
but when it comes to spending they're worlds apart and have nothing in common.
在学习方面，他很努力。
Zài xuéxí fāngmiàn, tā hěn nǔlì.
When it comes to studying, he works hard.
嫌这……嫌那……
complains about this and that
Repeating 嫌 with 这/那 shows constant complaining.
姐姐舍不得花钱，恨不得一分钱掰成两半花，总是嫌这贵嫌那贵。
Jiějie shěbude huā qián, hènbude yì fēn qián bāi chéng liǎng bàn huā, zǒngshì xián zhè guì xián nà guì.
My older sister can't bear to spend money. She'd split every cent in two if she could, and she always complains that everything is too expensive.
他总是嫌这嫌那的。
Tā zǒngshì xián zhè xián nà de.
He's always finding fault with something.
A 则正相反
A, on the other hand, is the opposite
则 marks a contrast in writing.
妹妹则正相反，她属于典型的月光族，
Mèimei zé zhèng xiāngfǎn, tā shǔyú diǎnxíng de yuèguāngzú,
My younger sister is the exact opposite. She's a typical "moonlight clan" spender:
哥哥很安静，弟弟则正相反。
Gēge hěn ānjìng, dìdi zé zhèng xiāngfǎn.
The older brother is quiet; the younger is the opposite.
不仅……，而且……
not only …, but also …
不仅 gives one point and 而且 adds a stronger one.
不仅喜欢逛街购物，而且花钱如流水。
bùjǐn xǐhuan guàng jiē gòuwù, érqiě huā qián rú liúshuǐ.
she not only loves shopping but spends money like water.
他不仅会说汉语，而且说得很好。
Tā bùjǐn huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě shuō de hěn hǎo.
He not only speaks Chinese, he speaks it well.
……，否则一定会……
…, otherwise … will definitely …
否则 introduces what happens if not.
两个人根本不能一起出去买东西，否则一定会吵嘴。
Liǎng ge rén gēnběn bù néng yìqǐ chūqu mǎi dōngxi, fǒuzé yídìng huì chǎozuǐ.
The two of them can't go shopping together at all, or they'll definitely quarrel.
快点走，否则就迟到了。
Kuài diǎn zǒu, fǒuzé jiù chídào le.
Hurry, or we'll be late.
什么 A 不 A 的
A or not A, who cares
Dismisses something as unimportant.
什么名牌不名牌，新款不新款的，能吃饱穿暖就行呗。
Shénme míngpái bù míngpái, xīnkuǎn bù xīnkuǎn de, néng chī bǎo chuān nuǎn jiù xíng bei.
Brand names, latest models, who cares? As long as you're fed and clothed, that's enough.
什么贵不贵的，喜欢就买。
Shénme guì bú guì de, xǐhuan jiù mǎi.
Never mind whether it's expensive; if you like it, buy it.
连……都没有
doesn't even have …
连 + 都 + negative stresses how little there is.
你看她这么省吃俭用的，连套高档一点的衣服都没有。
Nǐ kàn tā zhème shěng chī jiǎn yòng de, lián tào gāodàng yìdiǎn de yīfu dōu méiyǒu.
Look how she scrimps and saves. She doesn't even have one decent outfit.
他连一块钱都没有。
Tā lián yí kuài qián dōu méiyǒu.
He doesn't even have one yuan.

的，连套高档一点的衣服都没有。

060.title: Listen again
060.sub: Five questions on 守财奴和月光族 (part 059)
060.transcriptNote: This short track only gives the questions. Listen to part 059 again to answer them. The answers are my own; the last question is for you.

blocks.label: 问题
lines: 请再听一遍录音，然后回答问题。
Qǐng zài tīng yí biàn lùyīn, ránhòu huídá wèntí.
Listen to the recording again, then answer the questions.

q: 妹妹为什么说姐姐是守财奴？她用了哪些词语评论姐姐？
Mèimei wèishénme shuō jiějie shì shǒucáinú? Tā yòng le nǎxiē cíyǔ pínglùn jiějie?
Why does the younger sister call the older one a miser? What words does she use about her?
ans: 姐姐舍不得花钱，总想着攒钱让孩子上学、给孩子买房、养老看病。她说姐姐“没必要这么省”“省吃俭用”“连套高档一点的衣服都没有”“太对不起自己了”。

Jiějie shěbude huā qián, zǒng xiǎngzhe zǎn qián ràng háizi shàng xué, gěi háizi mǎi fáng, yǎnglǎo kàn bìng. Tā shuō jiějie "méi bìyào zhème shěng" "shěng chī jiǎn yòng" "lián tào gāodàng yìdiǎn de yīfu dōu méiyǒu" "tài duìbuqǐ zìjǐ le".

The older sister won't spend; she's always saving for schooling, a flat for her child, old age and medical bills. The younger says she "doesn't need to be so tight", "scrimps and saves", "doesn't even have one decent outfit", "is unfair to herself".

q: 姐姐为什么说妹妹是败家子儿？她用了哪些词语评论妹妹？
Jiějie wèishénme shuō mèimei shì bàijiāzǐr? Tā yòng le nǎxiē cíyǔ pínglùn mèimei?
Why does the older sister call the younger one a spendthrift? What words does she use about her?
ans: 妹妹花钱如流水，每个月都花光工资，还超前消费。姐姐说她“太不懂事了”“太浪费了”“有一半是根本用不着的”“太不像话了”。
Mèimei huā qián rú liúshuǐ, měi ge yuè dōu huāguāng gōngzī, hái chāoqiánxiāofèi. Jiějie shuō tā "tài bù dǒngshì le" "tài làngfèi le" "yǒu yíbàn shì gēnběn yòng bu zháo de" "tài bú xiànghuà le".

The younger spends like water, uses up her whole salary every month and spends ahead of it. The older says she's "so thoughtless", "so wasteful", "half of what she buys she doesn't need", "out of line".

q: 你更同意姐姐的做法还是妹妹的做法？为什么？
Nǐ gèng tóngyì jiějie de zuòfǎ háishi mèimei de zuòfǎ? Wèishénme?
Do you agree more with the older sister or the younger sister? Why?

grammar: 用了哪些词语
which words did … use
哪些 asks about several items.
妹妹为什么说姐姐是守财奴？她用了哪些词语评论姐姐？
Mèimei wèishénme shuō jiějie shì shǒucáinú? Tā yòng le nǎxiē cíyǔ pínglùn jiějie?
Why does the younger sister call the older one a miser? What words does she use about her?
你用了哪些方法？
Nǐ yòng le nǎxiē fāngfǎ?
Which methods did you use?
更同意 A 还是 B？
do you agree more with A or B?

你更同意姐姐的做法还是妹妹的做法？为什么？
Nǐ gèng tóngyì jiějie de zuòfǎ háishi mèimei de zuòfǎ? Wèishénme?
Do you agree more with the older sister or the younger sister? Why?
你更喜欢茶还是咖啡？
Nǐ gèng xǐhuan chá háishi kāfēi?
Do you prefer tea or coffee?

061.title: "Let's eat out this Spring Festival"
061.sub: Four questions, then a couple argue about New Year's Eve dinner
061.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then part 1 of the lesson 4 story. 夫 is the husband (Xiaoyu'er's father) and 妻 his wife. The answers are my own summaries. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
快要过春节了。一天，小鱼儿的父亲从单位回到家，和妻子商量去饭馆吃年夜饭的事儿。
Kuàiyào guò Chūn Jié le. Yì tiān, Xiǎoyú'ér de fùqin cóng dānwèi huídào jiā, hé qīzi shāngliang qù fànguǎn chī niányèfàn de shìr.
The Spring Festival is coming. One day Xiaoyu'er's father comes home from work and talks with his wife about eating New Year's Eve dinner at a restaurant.
请听录音，然后回答下面的问题。
Qǐng tīng lùyīn, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to the recording, then answer the questions below.

q: 妻子为什么不同意去饭馆吃年夜饭？你能总结出几条原因？
Qīzi wèishénme bù tóngyì qù fànguǎn chī niányèfàn? Nǐ néng zǒngjié chū jǐ tiáo yuányīn?
Why doesn't the wife want to have New Year's Eve dinner at a restaurant? How many reasons can you list?
ans: 在家吃又便宜又干净；外面的东西脏；高档饭店一千多一桌，不一定好吃，不值；上个月刚给小鱼儿两千块换手机，再去饭馆这个月又攒不下钱了。

Zài jiā chī yòu piányi yòu gānjìng; wàimian de dōngxi zāng; gāodàng fàndiàn yì qiān duō yì zhuō, bù yídìng hǎochī, bù zhí; shàng ge yuè gāng gěi Xiǎoyú'ér liǎng qiān kuài huàn shǒujī, zài qù fànguǎn zhège yuè yòu zǎn bu xià qián le.

Eating at home is cheaper and cleaner; restaurant food is dirty; a good restaurant costs over 1,000 a table and may not even taste good, so it isn't worth it; they just gave Xiaoyu'er 2,000 for a new phone, so she won't be able to save anything this month.

q: 他们在对话中吵嘴了吗？
Tāmen zài duìhuà zhōng chǎozuǐ le ma?
Do they quarrel in the conversation?
ans: 没有真的吵嘴。妻子只是装作不高兴，丈夫有些失望，最后妻子说“我不和你吵了”。
Méiyǒu zhēn de chǎozuǐ. Qīzi zhǐshì zhuāngzuò bù gāoxìng, zhàngfū yǒuxiē shīwàng, zuìhòu qīzi shuō "wǒ bù hé nǐ chǎo le".
Not really. The wife only pretends to be cross and the husband is a little disappointed; in the end she says "I won't argue with you."

q: 小鱼儿是不是学生？为什么？
Xiǎoyú'ér shì bu shì xuésheng? Wèishénme?
ans: 不是。他在单位工作，快过节了，单位忙，他又加班了。
Bú shì. Tā zài dānwèi gōngzuò, kuài guòjié le, dānwèi máng, tā yòu jiā bān le.
No. He has a job, and with the holiday coming his workplace is busy, so he's working overtime again.

q: 他们今年春节会不会去饭馆吃年夜饭？
Tāmen jīnnián Chūn Jié huì bú huì qù fànguǎn chī niányèfàn?
Will they eat out for New Year's Eve dinner this Spring Festival?
ans: 会。妻子同意了，条件是这个月家里的活儿都由丈夫干。
Huì. Qīzi tóngyì le, tiáojiàn shì zhège yuè jiā li de huór dōu yóu zhàngfū gàn.
Yes. The wife agrees, on condition that the husband does all the housework this month.

blocks.label: 第一部分
blocks.h: 今年春节去饭馆吃吧 · Part 1
lines: 今年春节去饭馆吃吧
Jīnnián Chūn Jié qù fànguǎn chī ba
Let's eat out this Spring Festival
第一部分
Dì-yī bùfen
Part 1
春节快到了。一天晚上，小鱼儿的爸爸下班回家，
Chūn Jié kuài dào le. Yì tiān wǎnshang, Xiǎoyú'ér de bàba xià bān huí jiā,
The Spring Festival was nearly here. One evening Xiaoyu'er's father came home from work.
一进门儿，看见妻子正在打扫客厅。
yí jìn ménr, kànjiàn qīzi zhèngzài dǎsǎo kètīng.
As he came in, he saw his wife cleaning the living room.
回来了？
Huílai le?
You're back?
妻
妻子问道。
Qīzi wèn dào.
his wife asked.
回来了。外面真冷，可把我冻坏了。
Huílai le. Wàimian zhēn lěng, kě bǎ wǒ dòng huài le.
I'm back. It's freezing out there. I'm frozen stiff.
夫
丈夫先把帽子摘了下来，挂在了墙上，
Zhàngfū xiān bǎ màozi zhāi le xialai, guà zài le qiáng shang,
The husband first took off his hat and hung it on the wall,
接着又把大衣脱了下来，挂在了帽子的旁边，然后问道：
jiēzhe yòu bǎ dàyī tuō le xialai, guà zài le màozi de pángbiān, ránhòu wèn dào:
then took off his coat and hung it next to the hat, and asked:
小鱼儿回来了吗？
Xiǎoyú'ér huílai le ma?
Is Xiaoyu'er home?
夫
妻子把桌子摆好，回答说：
Qīzi bǎ zhuōzi bǎi hǎo, huídá shuō:
His wife set the table and answered:
他又加班了，不在家吃了，刚来的电话。
Tā yòu jiā bān le, bú zài jiā chī le, gāng lái de diànhuà.
He's working late again. He won't be eating at home. He just called.
妻
哦，快过节了，单位都挺忙的。我们单位小年轻的也都开始加班了。
Ó, kuài guòjié le, dānwèi dōu tǐng máng de. Wǒmen dānwèi xiǎo niánqīng de yě dōu kāishǐ jiā bān le.
Oh, the holiday's coming, everywhere's busy. The youngsters at my work have started doing overtime too.
夫
丈夫走到妻子身边，在客厅的桌子旁边坐下。
Zhàngfū zǒu dào qīzi shēnbiān, zài kètīng de zhuōzi pángbiān zuòxià.
The husband walked over to his wife and sat down at the living-room table.
哎，我说，今年春节，我们去外面吃吧，找一家高档一点的饭馆。
Āi, wǒ shuō, jīnnián Chūn Jié, wǒmen qù wàimian chī ba, zhǎo yì jiā gāodàng yìdiǎn de fànguǎn.
Hey, listen. This Spring Festival, let's eat out. Let's find a nice upmarket restaurant.
夫
妻子马上变得很不高兴。
Qīzi mǎshàng biàn de hěn bù gāoxìng.
His wife immediately looked unhappy.
我看还是在家吃吧，又便宜又干净。外面的东西脏。
Wǒ kàn háishi zài jiā chī ba, yòu piányi yòu gānjìng. Wàimian de dōngxi zāng.
I think we should eat at home. It's cheaper and cleaner. Restaurant food is dirty.
妻
好一点的饭店没事儿。
Hǎo yìdiǎn de fàndiàn méishìr.
A decent restaurant is fine.
夫
丈夫给妻子倒了一杯热水。
Zhàngfū gěi qīzi dào le yì bēi rèshuǐ.
The husband poured his wife a glass of hot water.
妻子也坐了下来，接过热水，觉得水太烫，把杯子搁在了桌子上。
Qīzi yě zuò le xialai, jiē guo rèshuǐ, juéde shuǐ tài tàng, bǎ bēizi gē zài le zhuōzi shàng.
His wife sat down too and took the water, but it was too hot, so she put the glass down on the table.
高档饭店要一千多一桌呢，但又不一定好吃，我看不值，还是在家吃好。
Gāodàng fàndiàn yào yì qiān duō yì zhuō ne, dàn yòu bù yídìng hǎochī, wǒ kàn bù zhí, háishi zài jiā chī hǎo.
An upmarket restaurant costs over a thousand a table, and the food isn't necessarily good. I don't think it's worth it. Eating at home is better.
妻
过年了，咱们也享受享受，奢侈一回嘛。
Guò nián le, zánmen yě xiǎngshòu xiǎngshòu, shēchǐ yì huí ma.
It's New Year. Let's enjoy ourselves and splash out for once.
夫
上个月刚给小鱼儿拿了两千块钱换新款手机，要是还去高档饭馆吃饭，这个月我又攒不下钱了。
Shàng ge yuè gāng gěi Xiǎoyú'ér ná le liǎng qiān kuài qián huàn xīnkuǎn shǒujī, yàoshì hái qù gāodàng fànguǎn chī fàn, zhège yuè wǒ yòu zǎn bu xià qián le.
Last month we just gave Xiaoyu'er two thousand for a new phone. If we go to an expensive restaurant as well, I won't be able to save anything this month again.
妻
丈夫见妻子不愿意去饭馆吃饭，就继续劝妻子：
Zhàngfū jiàn qīzi bú yuànyì qù fànguǎn chī fàn, jiù jìxù quàn qīzi:
Seeing that his wife didn't want to eat out, the husband kept trying to persuade her:
那咱去一家打折的还不行吗？
Nà zán qù yì jiā dǎzhé de hái bù xíng ma?
Then how about we go somewhere with a discount?
夫
我知道得节俭，我也知道你攒钱是为了咱家好，
Wǒ zhīdào děi jiéjiǎn, wǒ yě zhīdao nǐ zǎn qián shì wèile zán jiā hǎo,
I know we have to be thrifty, and I know you save for the good of the family,
夫
可是你看咱们都五十岁的人了，一辈子总是省呀省的，过年一直都是在家里吃。
kěshì nǐ kàn zánmen dōu wǔ shí suì de rén le, yíbèizi zǒngshì shěng ya shěng de, guò nián yìzhí dōu shì zài jiā li chī.
but look, we're both fifty. We've scrimped and saved all our lives, and we've always had New Year at home.
夫
妻子装作不高兴的样子，大声说：
Qīzi zhuāngzuò bù gāoxìng de yàngzi, dàshēng shuō:
His wife pretended to be upset and said loudly:
是不是嫌我做菜做得不好了？不爱吃了？
Shì bu shì xián wǒ zuòcài zuò de bù hǎo le? Bú ài chī le?
Is it that you think my cooking's no good now? You don't like it any more?
妻
我哪儿敢啊！你做得不好，那谁还能做得好？
Wǒ nǎr gǎn a! Nǐ zuò de bù hǎo, nà shéi hái néng zuò de hǎo?
I wouldn't dare! If your cooking's no good, whose is?
夫
我不是怕你挨累吗？不是想让你少干一点活吗？
Wǒ bú shì pà nǐ ái lèi ma? Bú shì xiǎng ràng nǐ shǎo gàn yìdiǎn huó ma?
I'm just worried about you wearing yourself out. I just want you to do a bit less work.
夫
妻子笑了一下，马上又严肃起来。
Qīzi xiào le yíxià, mǎshàng yòu yánsù qǐlái.
His wife smiled, then turned serious again at once.
不累，不就是做一桌菜吗？有什么累的？
Bú lèi, bú jiùshì zuò yì zhuō cài ma? Yǒu shénme lèi de?
It's not tiring. It's only cooking one meal. What's tiring about that?
妻
丈夫看妻子还是不同意，有些失望。
Zhàngfū kàn qīzi háishi bù tóngyì, yǒuxiē shīwàng.
Seeing that his wife still didn't agree, the husband was a little disappointed.
老婆，现在什么时代了！别人过年都出去吃，谁还在家自己做饭呀？都会享受生活了。
Lǎopó, xiànzài shénme shídài le! Biérén guò nián dōu chūqu chī, shéi hái zài jiā zìjǐ zuò fàn ya? Dōu huì xiǎngshòu shēnghuó le.
Honey, what era do you think this is? Everyone eats out at New Year. Who still cooks at home? Everyone knows how to enjoy life now.
夫
我们单位老王、老马都去饭店，都说好了。
Wǒmen dānwèi Lǎo Wáng, Lǎo Mǎ dōu qù fàndiàn, dōu shuōhǎo le.
Lao Wang and Lao Ma from my work are all going to restaurants. It's all arranged.
夫
妻子看见丈夫真的不高兴了，赶快改变态度。
Qīzi kànjiàn zhàngfū zhēn de bù gāoxìng le, gǎnkuài gǎibiàn tàidu.
Seeing that her husband was really upset, the wife quickly changed her tune.
我不和你吵了。那咱们先说好，如果去饭馆吃，这个月咱家你干活，我可什么都不管了。
Wǒ bù hé nǐ chǎo le. Nà zánmen xiān shuōhǎo, rúguǒ qù fànguǎn chī, zhège yuè zán jiā nǐ gànhuó, wǒ kě shénme dōu bùguǎn le.
I won't argue with you. But let's agree first: if we eat out, you do the housework this month and I won't lift a finger.
妻
太好了！
Tài hǎo le!
Great!
夫
丈夫兴奋地站了起来。
Zhàngfū xīngfèn de zhàn le qǐlái.
The husband jumped up excitedly.
到时候把你爸你妈、我爸我妈都带上，人多热闹。我现在就上网找饭店去。
Dào shíhou bǎ nǐ bà nǐ mā, wǒ bà wǒ mā dōu dàishang, rén duō rènào. Wǒ xiànzài jiù shàngwǎng zhǎo fàndiàn qù.
We'll bring your parents and mine. The more the merrier. I'll go online and find a restaurant right now.
夫

grammar: 可把我 + V坏了
it really … me
可 stresses the feeling; 坏了 shows a strong degree.
回来了。外面真冷，可把我冻坏了。
Huílai le. Wàimian zhēn lěng, kě bǎ wǒ dòng huài le.
I'm back. It's freezing out there. I'm frozen stiff.
这件事可把我急坏了。
Zhè jiàn shì kě bǎ wǒ jí huài le.
This really got me worried.
把 + N + V了下来
to take N off
下来 shows removing something.
丈夫先把帽子摘了下来，挂在了墙上，
Zhàngfū xiān bǎ màozi zhāi le xialai, guà zài le qiáng shang,
The husband first took off his hat and hung it on the wall,
他把眼镜摘了下来。
Tā bǎ yǎnjìng zhāi le xialai.
He took his glasses off.
V + 不下 + N
can't manage to …
A potential complement: the action can't be completed.
上个月刚给小鱼儿拿了两千块钱换新款手机，要是还去高档饭馆吃饭，这个月我又攒不下钱了。
Shàng ge yuè gāng gěi Xiǎoyú'ér ná le liǎng qiān kuài qián huàn xīnkuǎn shǒujī, yàoshì hái qù gāodàng fànguǎn chī fàn, zhège yuè wǒ yòu zǎn bu xià qián le.
Last month we just gave Xiaoyu'er two thousand for a new phone. If we go to an expensive restaurant as well, I won't be able to save anything this month again.
房间太小，放不下床。
Fángjiān tài xiǎo, fàngbùxià chuáng.
The room's too small to fit a bed.
……还不行吗？
isn't … good enough?
A rhetorical question offering a compromise.
那咱去一家打折的还不行吗？
Nà zán qù yì jiā dǎzhé de hái bù xíng ma?
Then how about we go somewhere with a discount?
我就看一会儿还不行吗？
Wǒ jiù kàn yíhuìr hái bù xíng ma?
Can't I just watch for a bit?
是不是嫌……了？
is it that you think … ?
嫌 shows dissatisfaction.
是不是嫌我做菜做得不好了？不爱吃了？
Shì bu shì xián wǒ zuòcài zuò de bù hǎo le? Bú ài chī le?
Is it that you think my cooking's no good now? You don't like it any more?
你是不是嫌这儿太远了？
Nǐ shì bu shì xián zhèr tài yuǎn le?
Do you think it's too far?
不就是……吗？
it's only …, isn't it?
Plays something down.
不累，不就是做一桌菜吗？有什么累的？
Bú lèi, bú jiùshì zuò yì zhuō cài ma? Yǒu shénme lèi de?
It's not tiring. It's only cooking one meal. What's tiring about that?
不就是一百块钱吗？
Bú jiùshì yì bǎi kuài qián ma?
It's only a hundred yuan.
gaps: 过年了，咱们也享受享受，

roles.夫: 夫 = the husband, who wants to eat out
roles.妻: 妻 = the wife, who'd rather cook at home

say: I'm back. It's freezing out there. I'm frozen stiff.
I think we should eat at home. It's cheaper and cleaner. Restaurant food is dirty.
Then how about we go somewhere with a discount?
It's not tiring. It's only cooking one meal. What's tiring about that?

062.title: Three "moonlight clan" spenders
062.sub: Three young people explain why they don't save
062.transcriptNote: Three young people who spend their whole salary every month ("moonlight clan", 月光族) explain why they don't save. Note down each speaker's main point, then turn on Answers. You'll hear some new words, but they don't stop you understanding the main idea.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
三个月光族在解释自己不攒钱的原因，请记下每个人谈话的主要意思。
Sān ge yuèguāngzú zài jiěshì zìjǐ bù zǎn qián de yuányīn, qǐng jì xià měi ge rén tánhuà de zhǔyào yìsi.
Three "moonlight clan" spenders explain why they don't save. Note down the main point of each person's talk.

blocks.label: 小A
lines: 小A，男，二十五岁，在北京工作四年，存款不到一万。
Xiǎo A, nán, èrshí wǔ suì, zài Běijīng gōngzuò sì nián, cúnkuǎn bú dào yí wàn.
Xiao A, male, 25, has worked in Beijing for four years, savings under 10,000.
生活在北京挺迷茫的，不知道未来在哪里，
Shēnghuó zài Běijīng tǐng mímáng de, bù zhīdao wèilái zài nǎli,
Life in Beijing feels pretty aimless. I don't know where my future is,
也没有想过太多关于以后的事儿。
yě méiyǒu xiǎng guo tài duō guānyú yǐhòu de shìr.
and I haven't thought much about what comes later.
想多存点钱吧，可是现在这么点钱放银行里没有什么利息，
Xiǎng duō cún diǎn qián ba, kěshì xiànzài zhème diǎn qián fàng yínháng li méiyǒu shénme lìxī,
I'd like to save more, but this little bit of money earns hardly any interest in the bank,
房价增长速度还这么快，钱不值钱。
fángjià zēngzhǎng sùdù hái zhème kuài, qián bù zhí qián.
and house prices are rising so fast that money isn't worth anything.
交完房租，买点这买点那就没了，想攒也攒不下。
Jiāo wán fángzū, mǎi diǎn zhè mǎi diǎn nà jiù méi le, xiǎng zǎn yě zǎn bu xià.
Once I've paid the rent and bought this and that, it's gone. Even if I wanted to save, I couldn't.

q: 小A不攒钱的主要原因是什么？
Xiǎo A bù zǎn qián de zhǔyào yuányīn shì shénme?
What is Xiao A's main reason for not saving?
ans: 对未来很迷茫；存钱没有利息，房价涨得快，钱不值钱；交完房租买点东西就没了，攒不下。
Duì wèilái hěn mímáng; cún qián méiyǒu lìxī, fángjià zhǎng de kuài, qián bù zhí qián; jiāo wán fángzū mǎi diǎn dōngxi jiù méi le, zǎn bu xià.
He feels lost about the future; savings earn no interest, house prices rise fast and money loses value; after rent and shopping there's nothing left to save.

blocks.label: 小B
lines: 小B，女，二十八岁，在上海工作五年，存款基本上等于没有。
Xiǎo B, nǚ, èrshí bā suì, zài Shànghǎi gōngzuò wǔ nián, cúnkuǎn jīběn shang děngyú méiyǒu.
Xiao B, female, 28, has worked in Shanghai for five years, savings basically zero.
我是女孩子，攒钱干嘛？
Wǒ shì nǚháizi, zǎn qián gànmá?
I'm a girl. Why would I save?
吃好喝好，保养好，把自己打扮得漂亮点儿，
Chī hǎo hē hǎo, bǎoyǎng hǎo, bǎ zìjǐ dǎbàn de piàoliang diǎnr,
Eat well, drink well, look after myself and make myself pretty,
自然将来会有白马王子为我来买单的。
zìrán jiānglái huì yǒu báimǎ wángzǐ wèi wǒ lái mǎidān de.
and naturally Prince Charming will come along and pay for me one day.
我干嘛要那么辛苦存钱呢？我才二十八，也不算老吧。
Wǒ gànmá yào nàme xīnkǔ cún qián ne? Wǒ cái èr shí bā, yě búsuàn lǎo ba.
Why should I work so hard to save? I'm only 28, that's not old.
找个能挣钱的老公，问题就自然解决了。
Zhǎo ge néng zhèng qián de lǎogōng, wèntí jiù zìrán jiějué le.
Find a husband who earns good money and the problem solves itself.

q: 小B不攒钱的主要原因是什么？
Xiǎo B bù zǎn qián de zhǔyào yuányīn shì shénme?
What is Xiao B's main reason for not saving?
ans: 她觉得女孩子不用攒钱，把自己打扮漂亮，将来找个能挣钱的老公就行了。
Tā juéde nǚháizi búyòng zǎn qián, bǎ zìjǐ dǎbàn piàoliang, jiānglái zhǎo ge néng zhèng qián de lǎogōng jiù xíng le.
She thinks girls don't need to save: make yourself pretty and marry a husband who earns well.

blocks.label: 小C
lines: 小C，女，二十七岁，在深圳一家保险公司做秘书工作。
Xiǎo C, nǚ, èrshí qī suì, zài Shēnzhèn yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī zuò mìshū gōngzuò.
Xiao C, female, 27, works as a secretary at an insurance company in Shenzhen.
有人说，人们需要花钱，花了才是你的，否则就不是你的，而是中国银行的。
Yǒu rén shuō, rénmen xūyào huā qián, huā le cái shì nǐ de, fǒuzé jiù bú shì nǐ de, érshì Zhōngguó Yínháng de.
Some people say you need to spend money: only what you spend is yours; otherwise it's not yours, it's the Bank of China's.
我觉得挣钱就是要花的。
Wǒ juéde zhèng qián jiùshì yào huā de.
I think money is for spending.
我每月在化妆品上的花销有两万吧，别的花销也不少。
Wǒ měiyuè zài huàzhuāngpǐn shàng de huāxiao yǒu liǎng wàn ba, biéde huāxiao yě bù shǎo.
I spend about 20,000 a month on cosmetics, and quite a lot on other things too.
但是我自己也记不住每月买了些什么或花了多少钱，
Dànshì wǒ zìjǐ yě jì bu zhù měiyuè mǎi le xiē shénme huò huā le duōshǎo qián,
But I can't remember what I bought each month or how much I spent.
反正看了喜欢就买嘛。
fǎnzhèng kàn le xǐhuan jiù mǎi ma.
Anyway, if I see something I like, I buy it.

q: 小C不攒钱的主要原因是什么？
Xiǎo C bù zǎn qián de zhǔyào yuányīn shì shénme?
What is Xiao C's main reason for not saving?
ans: 她认为挣钱就是为了花，花了才是自己的；看了喜欢就买。
Tā rènwéi zhèng qián jiùshì wèile huā, huā le cái shì zìjǐ de; kàn le xǐhuan jiù mǎi.
She believes money is earned to be spent, and only what you spend is really yours; she buys whatever she likes.

vocab: people who spend all their pay each month
grammar: 想……吧，可是……
I'd like to …, but …
吧 here marks a concession before a "but".
想多存点钱吧，可是现在这么点钱放银行里没有什么利息，
Xiǎng duō cún diǎn qián ba, kěshì xiànzài zhème diǎn qián fàng yínháng li méiyǒu shénme lìxī,
I'd like to save more, but this little bit of money earns hardly any interest in the bank,
想买吧，可是太贵了。
Xiǎng mǎi ba, kěshì tài guì le.
I'd like to buy it, but it's too expensive.
想V也V不下
even if I wanted to …, I couldn't
想……也…… stresses impossibility.
交完房租，买点这买点那就没了，想攒也攒不下。
Jiāo wán fángzū, mǎi diǎn zhè mǎi diǎn nà jiù méi le, xiǎng zǎn yě zǎn bu xià.
Once I've paid the rent and bought this and that, it's gone. Even if I wanted to save, I couldn't.
想睡也睡不着。
Xiǎng shuì yě shuì bu zháo.
Even if I want to sleep, I can't.
干嘛
why on earth
Colloquial "why", often rhetorical.
我干嘛要那么辛苦存钱呢？我才二十八，也不算老吧。
Wǒ gànmá yào nàme xīnkǔ cún qián ne? Wǒ cái èr shí bā, yě búsuàn lǎo ba.
Why should I work so hard to save? I'm only 28, that's not old.
你干嘛不早说？
Nǐ gànmá bù zǎo shuō?
Why didn't you say so earlier?
不是……，而是……
not …, but …
Corrects one idea with another.
有人说，人们需要花钱，花了才是你的，否则就不是你的，而是中国银行的。
Yǒu rén shuō, rénmen xūyào huā qián, huā le cái shì nǐ de, fǒuzé jiù bú shì nǐ de, érshì Zhōngguó Yínháng de.
Some people say you need to spend money: only what you spend is yours; otherwise it's not yours, it's the Bank of China's.
他不是老师，而是学生。
Tā bú shì lǎoshī, érshì xuésheng.
He's not a teacher but a student.
反正
anyway
Means the outcome is the same whatever happens.
反正看了喜欢就买嘛。
fǎnzhèng kàn le xǐhuan jiù mǎi ma.
Anyway, if I see something I like, I buy it.
反正没事，我陪你去。
Fǎnzhèng méi shì, wǒ péi nǐ qù.
I'm free anyway, I'll go with you.
say: I think money is for spending.
Anyway, if I see something I like, I buy it.

063.title: Listen and discuss
063.sub: How do Chinese couples greet each other?
063.transcriptNote: A discussion task: replay part 1 of lesson 3's 望子成龙 (part 041) and part 1 of lesson 4's 今年春节去饭馆吃吧 (part 061), then think about how the couples greet each other. The answer is my own summary.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音讨论 · Listen and discuss
lines: 听录音讨论。
Tīng lùyīn tǎolùn.
Listen and discuss.
再听一遍第三课“望子成龙”第一部分和第四课“今年春节去饭馆吃吧”。
Zài tīng yí biàn dì-sān kè "wàng zǐ chéng lóng" dì-yī bùfen hé dì-sì kè "jīnnián Chūn Jié qù fànguǎn chī ba".
Listen again to part 1 of lesson 3, "Hoping for a dragon", and lesson 4, "Let's eat out this Spring Festival".

q: 录音中，丈夫和妻子见面时怎么打招呼？他们用“你好”这样的词语了吗？
Lùyīn zhōng, zhàngfū hé qīzi jiàn miàn shí zěnme dǎzhāohū? Tāmen yòng "nǐhǎo" zhèyàng de cíyǔ le ma?
In the recordings, how do the husbands and wives greet each other? Do they use words like 你好?
ans: 他们没有用“你好”。夫妻之间一般直接说话：妻子问“回来了？”，丈夫答“回来了”；大龙的爸爸一进厨房就问“今天先学什么？”。家人之间常用这种方式打招呼。

Tāmen méiyǒu yòng "nǐhǎo". Fūqī zhījiān yìbān zhíjiē shuōhuà: qīzi wèn "huílai le?", zhàngfū dá "huílai le"; dà lóng de bàba yí jìn chúfáng jiù wèn "jīntiān xiān xué shénme?". Jiārén zhījiān chángyòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì dǎzhāohū.

No. Couples speak directly: the wife asks "You're back?" and the husband replies "I'm back"; Dalong's father walks into the kitchen and asks "What's he doing first today?". Family members usually greet each other like this rather than with 你好.

grammar: 再V一遍
to do … once more
一遍 counts a complete run-through.
再听一遍第三课“望子成龙”第一部分和第四课“今年春节去饭馆吃吧”。
Zài tīng yí biàn dì-sān kè "wàng zǐ chéng lóng" dì-yī bùfen hé dì-sì kè "jīnnián Chūn Jié qù fànguǎn chī ba".
Listen again to part 1 of lesson 3, "Hoping for a dragon", and lesson 4, "Let's eat out this Spring Festival".
请再说一遍。
Qǐng zàishuō yí biàn.
Please say it again.
gaps: 丈夫和妻子见面时怎么

064.title: Copy the tone of voice
064.sub: Ten short spending lines to imitate
064.transcriptNote: Pre-speaking practice: listen to each line and copy the speaker's tone: annoyed, soothing, scornful, defensive or pleading. Several item numbers aren't read aloud. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 口语课前练习 · Pre-speaking practice
lines: 口语课前练习。
Kǒuyǔ kè qián liànxí.
Pre-speaking exercises.
听句子并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng jùzi bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the sentences and copy the speakers' tone.
买买买，就知道买，都是没用的。
Mǎi mǎi mǎi, jiù zhīdao mǎi, dōu shì méiyòng de.
Buy, buy, buy! That's all you know how to do, and it's all useless stuff.
我家孩子可不懂事儿了，成天乱花钱，把我气死了。
Wǒ jiā háizi kě bù dǒngshìr le, chéngtiān luàn huā qián, bǎ wǒ qì sǐ le.
My kid is so thoughtless. Wastes money all day long. Drives me mad.
别生气了，现在的年轻人都这样，我儿子也是。
Bié shēngqì le, xiànzài de niánqīngrén dōu zhèyàng, wǒ érzi yě shì.
Don't be cross. Young people are all like that now. My son too.
这个也太过时了吧？有没有新款呀？
Zhège yě tài guòshí le ba? Yǒu méiyǒu xīnkuǎn ya?
This one's way out of date, isn't it? Have you got any new models?
房贷、学费、手机费、网费、车费，我哪儿乱花钱了？都是该交的。
Fángdài, xuéfèi, shǒujī fèi, wǎng fèi, chēfèi, wǒ nǎr luàn huā qián le? Dōu shì gāi jiāo de.
Mortgage, school fees, phone bill, internet, transport. Where am I wasting money? These all have to be paid.
不是我想跟你吵嘴，是你先不高兴的。
Bú shì wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ chǎozuǐ, shì nǐ xiān bù gāoxìng de.
It's not that I want to argue with you. You're the one who got upset first.
谁不想享受啊？谁不知道买高档的好呀？可你要是没那个条件，别那么奢侈。
Shéi bù xiǎng xiǎngshòu a? Shéi bù zhīdao mǎi gāodàng de hǎo ya? Kě nǐ yàoshì méi nàge tiáojiàn, bié nàme shēchǐ.
Who doesn't want to enjoy life? Who doesn't know high-end stuff is better? But if you can't afford it, don't be so extravagant.
什么？他说我是败家子儿？我还说他是守财奴呢！
Shénme? Tā shuō wǒ shì bàijiāzǐr? Wǒ hái shuō tā shì shǒucáinú ne!
What? He says I'm a spendthrift? Well, I say he's a miser!
小孩儿，你妈你爸赚钱不容易呀，你可不能对不起他们呀。
Xiǎoháir, nǐ mā nǐ bà zhuànqián bù róngyì ya, nǐ kě bù néng duìbuqǐ tāmen ya.
Kid, it's not easy for your mum and dad to earn money. You mustn't let them down.
我妈总买那些过时的廉价处理品，她买的衣服我根本不能穿。
Wǒ mā zǒng mǎi nàxiē guòshí de liánjià chǔlǐpǐn, tā mǎi de yīfu wǒ gēnběn bù néng chuān.
My mum always buys those cheap, out-of-date clearance goods. I can't wear any of the clothes she buys.

grammar: 就知道 + V
all you do is …
A complaint about someone's one-track behaviour.
买买买，就知道买，都是没用的。
Mǎi mǎi mǎi, jiù zhīdao mǎi, dōu shì méiyòng de.
Buy, buy, buy! That's all you know how to do, and it's all useless stuff.
你就知道玩手机。
Nǐ jiù zhīdao wán shǒujī.
All you do is play on your phone.
可 + adj + 了
really …
可 adds emphasis in speech.
我家孩子可不懂事儿了，成天乱花钱，把我气死了。
Wǒ jiā háizi kě bù dǒngshìr le, chéngtiān luàn huā qián, bǎ wǒ qì sǐ le.
My kid is so thoughtless. Wastes money all day long. Drives me mad.
今天可冷了。
Jīntiān kě lěng le.
It's really cold today.
把我气死了
it drives me mad
把 + person + V死了 shows an extreme feeling.
我家孩子可不懂事儿了，成天乱花钱，把我气死了。
Wǒ jiā háizi kě bù dǒngshìr le, chéngtiān luàn huā qián, bǎ wǒ qì sǐ le.
My kid is so thoughtless. Wastes money all day long. Drives me mad.
这孩子把我急死了。
Zhè háizi bǎ wǒ jí sǐ le.
This child is driving me frantic.
我哪儿……了？
when did I ever …?
A rhetorical denial.
房贷、学费、手机费、网费、车费，我哪儿乱花钱了？都是该交的。
Fángdài, xuéfèi, shǒujī fèi, wǎng fèi, chēfèi, wǒ nǎr luàn huā qián le? Dōu shì gāi jiāo de.
Mortgage, school fees, phone bill, internet, transport. Where am I wasting money? These all have to be paid.
我哪儿说过这话了？
Wǒ nǎr shuō guo zhè huà le?
When did I ever say that?
it's not that …, it's that …
Shifts the blame or the reason.
不是我想跟你吵嘴，是你先不高兴的。
Bú shì wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ chǎozuǐ, shì nǐ xiān bù gāoxìng de.
It's not that I want to argue with you. You're the one who got upset first.
不是我不想去，是没时间。
Bú shì wǒ bù xiǎng qù, shì méi shíjiān.
It's not that I don't want to go; I don't have time.
谁不……啊？
who doesn't …?
Rhetorical: everyone does.
谁不想享受啊？谁不知道买高档的好呀？可你要是没那个条件，别那么奢侈。
Shéi bù xiǎng xiǎngshòu a? Shéi bù zhīdao mǎi gāodàng de hǎo ya? Kě nǐ yàoshì méi nàge tiáojiàn, bié nàme shēchǐ.
Who doesn't want to enjoy life? Who doesn't know high-end stuff is better? But if you can't afford it, don't be so extravagant.
谁不想多挣钱啊？
Shéi bù xiǎng duō zhèng qián a?
Who doesn't want to earn more?
gaps: 可你要是没那个条件，别那么
say: Buy, buy, buy! That's all you know how to do, and it's all useless stuff.
Don't be cross. Young people are all like that now. My son too.
It's not that I want to argue with you. You're the one who got upset first.
What? He says I'm a spendthrift? Well, I say he's a miser!

065.title: The designer bag
065.sub: A husband tries to drag his wife away from the handbags
065.transcriptNote: 夫 is the husband and 妻 the wife. Listen and copy their tone.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听对话并模仿 · Listen and imitate
lines: 听对话并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng duìhuà bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 老婆啊，快走吧，别看了，你的包已经够多了。
Lǎopó a, kuài zǒu ba, bié kàn le, nǐ de bāo yǐjīng gòu duō le.
Come on, honey, let's go. Stop looking. You've got enough bags already.
夫
你懂什么？这是今年夏天刚出的新款。
Nǐ dǒng shénme? Zhè shì jīnnián xiàtiān gāng chū de xīnkuǎn.
What do you know? This is the new model that just came out this summer.
妻
什么新款啊？和我妈那个旧包不是一样吗？市场上到处都是，十块一个。
Shénme xīnkuǎn a? Hé wǒ mā nàge jiù bāo bú shì yíyàng ma? Shìchǎng shàng dàochù dōu shì, shí kuài yí ge.
New model? Isn't it just like my mum's old bag? They're all over the market, ten yuan each.
夫
那些廉价包和这包能比吗？人家这是名牌。
Nàxiē liánjià bāo hé zhè bāo néng bǐ ma? Rénjia zhè shì míngpái.
How can those cheap bags compare with this one? This is a designer brand.
妻
老公，你看这个，好不好看？
Lǎogōng, nǐ kàn zhège, hǎo bu hǎokàn?
Honey, look at this one. Is it nice?
妻
还行吧。多少钱啊？
Hái xíng ba. Duōshǎo qián a?
It's all right, I guess. How much?
夫
打完折二百五十八。
Dǎ wán zhé èrbǎi wǔshíbā.
258 after the discount.
妻
卡里不是没多少钱了吗？
Kǎ li bú shì méi duōshǎo qián le ma?
Isn't there hardly any money left on the card?
夫
我就买一个还不行吗？
Wǒ jiù mǎi yí ge hái bù xíng ma?
Can't I buy just one?
妻

grammar: 你懂什么？
what do you know?
A rhetorical put-down.
你懂什么？这是今年夏天刚出的新款。
Nǐ dǒng shénme? Zhè shì jīnnián xiàtiān gāng chū de xīnkuǎn.
What do you know? This is the new model that just came out this summer.
你懂什么？这是最好的。
Nǐ dǒng shénme? Zhè shì zuì hǎo de.
What do you know? This is the best.
……不是一样吗？
isn't … the same?
A rhetorical question meaning "it's the same".
什么新款啊？和我妈那个旧包不是一样吗？市场上到处都是，十块一个。
Shénme xīnkuǎn a? Hé wǒ mā nàge jiù bāo bú shì yíyàng ma? Shìchǎng shàng dàochù dōu shì, shí kuài yí ge.
New model? Isn't it just like my mum's old bag? They're all over the market, ten yuan each.
这两个不是一样吗？
Zhè liǎng ge bú shì yíyàng ma?
Aren't these two the same?
……能比吗？
how can … compare?
Rhetorical: they can't compare.
那些廉价包和这包能比吗？人家这是名牌。
Nàxiē liánjià bāo hé zhè bāo néng bǐ ma? Rénjia zhè shì míngpái.
How can those cheap bags compare with this one? This is a designer brand.
你和他能比吗？
Nǐ hé tā néng bǐ ma?
How can you compare yourself with him?
打完折 + price
… after the discount
打折 is a separable verb.
打完折二百五十八。
Dǎ wán zhé èrbǎi wǔshíbā.
258 after the discount.
打完折才一百块。
Dǎ wán zhé cái yì bǎi kuài.
Only 100 after the discount.
不是……了吗？
isn't it …?
Reminds someone of a known fact.
卡里不是没多少钱了吗？
Kǎ li bú shì méi duōshǎo qián le ma?
Isn't there hardly any money left on the card?
你不是吃过饭了吗？
Nǐ bú shì chī guo fàn le ma?
Haven't you already eaten?

roles.夫: 夫 = the husband, who wants to leave
roles.妻: 妻 = the wife, who wants the bag

say: Come on, honey, let's go. Stop looking. You've got enough bags already.
What do you know? This is the new model that just came out this summer.
Can't I buy just one?

066.title: Taking my parents travelling
066.sub: Lesson 4 text: a daughter takes her thrifty parents to see the sea
066.transcriptNote: The second lesson 4 text, read as a story. 于思雨 is a woman (the text calls her and her mother 母女俩), so she is 她 throughout. 子欲养而亲不待 is a classical saying: "the child wants to care for their parents, but the parents don't wait".

blocks.label: 课文
blocks.h: 带着父母去旅行 · Taking my parents travelling
lines: 带着父母去旅行
Dài zhe fùmǔ qù lǚxíng
Taking my parents travelling
带着父母去旅行，而且是坐飞机去，这是于思雨很早以前就有的一个愿望。
Dài zhe fùmǔ qù lǚxíng, érqiě shì zuò fēijī qù, zhè shì Yú Sīyǔ hěn zǎo yǐqián jiù yǒu de yí ge yuànwàng.
Taking her parents on a trip, and by plane at that, was something Yu Siyu had wanted for a long time.
她母亲出生于五十年代，是典型的家庭妇女。
Tā mǔqin chūshēng yú wǔshí niándài, shì diǎnxíng de jiātíng fùnǚ.
Her mother was born in the 1950s and is a typical housewife.
小地方生活很辛苦，只靠父亲一份薪水，能吃饱穿暖已经很不容易了，
Xiǎo dìfang shēnghuó hěn xīnkǔ, zhǐ kào fùqin yí fèn xīnshui, néng chī bǎo chuān nuǎn yǐjīng hěn bù róngyì le,
Life in a small town was hard. With only her father's wages to live on, having enough to eat and wear was already an achievement,
加上还要供他们兄妹两个念书。
jiāshàng hái yào gōng tāmen xiōngmèi liǎng ge niàn shū.
and on top of that they had to pay for her and her brother's schooling.
因此，母亲非常节俭，恨不得一分钱掰成两半花，从来没有出过远门。
Yīncǐ, mǔqin fēicháng jiéjiǎn, hènbude yì fēn qián bāi chéng liǎng bàn huā, cónglái méiyǒu chū guo yuǎnmén.
So her mother was extremely thrifty, making every cent count, and had never travelled far from home.
在去年冬天的一次闲聊中，父亲说：
Zài qùnián dōngtiān de yí cì xiánliáo zhōng, fùqin shuō:
During a chat last winter, her father said:
“有机会带你妈去看看大海吧，你妈一辈子也没见过海。”
"Yǒu jīhuì dài nǐ mā qù kànkan dàhǎi ba, nǐ mā yíbèizi yě méi jiàn guo hǎi."
"If you get the chance, take your mum to see the sea. She's never seen it in her life."
尽管现在母亲年纪大了，但是她身体一直很好。
Jǐnguǎn xiànzài mǔqin niánjì dà le, dànshì tā shēntǐ yìzhí hěn hǎo.
Although her mother is getting on, she has always been healthy.
相反，父亲几年前却生过一场大病。
Xiāngfǎn, fùqin jǐ nián qián què shēng guo yì cháng dàbìng.
Her father, on the other hand, was seriously ill a few years ago.
带着父母去旅行的愿望在于思雨心里越来越强烈。
Dài zhe fùmǔ qù lǚxíng de yuànwàng zài Yú Sīyǔ xīn li yuèláiyuè qiángliè.
The wish to take her parents travelling grew stronger and stronger in Yu Siyu's heart.
古人说：子欲养而亲不待。
Gǔrén shuō: zǐ yù yǎng ér qīn bú dài.
The ancients said: the child wishes to care for their parents, but the parents do not wait.
这个世界上最不能等的事情，就是孝顺父母。
Zhège shìjiè shang zuì bù néng děng de shìqing, jiùshì xiàoshùn fùmǔ.
The one thing in this world that can't wait is looking after your parents.
趁他们现在身体还行，于思雨想陪着他们到处走走、看看。
Chèn tāmen xiànzài shēntǐ hái xíng, Yú Sīyǔ xiǎng péi zhe tāmen dàochù zǒu zǒu, kànkan.
While they're still in good health, Yu Siyu wants to take them around to see things.

blocks.label: 计划
blocks.h: 避开高峰期 · Avoiding the peak season
lines: 由于工作时间上的限制，于思雨基本上只有在长假里才有机会出趟远门。
Yóuyú gōngzuò shíjiān shàng de xiànzhì, Yú Sīyǔ jīběn shang zhǐyǒu zài chángjià li cái yǒu jīhuì chū tàng yuǎnmén.
Because of her working hours, Yu Siyu basically only gets the chance to travel far during the long holidays.
但春节、十一又是全国人民出行的高峰期，
Dàn Chūn Jié, Shí-Yī yòu shì quánguó rénmín chūxíng de gāofēngqī,
But the Spring Festival and National Day are peak travel periods for the whole country,
要是在这期间出门的话，吃住行、参观都不方便。
yàoshì zài zhè qījiān chūmén dehuà, chī zhù xíng, cānguān dōu bù fāngbiàn.
and if you travel then, food, lodging, transport and sightseeing are all a hassle.
毕竟父母老了，于思雨不想看到父母跟着她旅行时不但不能够放松，反而更累，
Bìjìng fùmǔ lǎo le, Yú Sīyǔ bù xiǎng kàndào fùmǔ gēnzhe tā lǚxíng shí búdàn bù nénggòu fàngsōng, fǎn'ér gèng lèi,
After all, her parents are old, and Yu Siyu didn't want them to end up more tired instead of relaxed when travelling with her,
所以专门在三月请了假，避开高峰期带他们出去玩。
suǒyǐ zhuānmén zài sān yuè qǐng le jiǎ, bìkāi gāofēngqī dài tāmen chūqu wán.
so she took leave in March specially, to avoid the peak season.
旅行的目的地是海南。
Lǚxíng de mùdìdì shì Hǎinán.
The destination was Hainan.
于思雨把一切都准备得差不多的时候，才告诉父母。
Yú Sīyǔ bǎ yíqiè dōu zhǔnbèi de chàbuduō de shíhou, cái gàosu fùmǔ.
Only when everything was almost ready did Yu Siyu tell her parents.

blocks.label: 争论
lines: 果然，她母亲强烈反对：
Guǒrán, tā mǔqin qiángliè fǎnduì:
Sure enough, her mother strongly objected:
“我跟你爸从小家里就穷，手里有几个钱也不敢随便花，总要想办法存一点。
"Wǒ gēn nǐ bà cóng xiǎo jiā li jiù qióng, shǒu li yǒu jǐ ge qián yě bù gǎn suíbiàn huā, zǒngyào xiǎng bànfǎ cún yìdiǎn.
"Your dad and I grew up poor. Even with a bit of money we never dared spend it freely; we always found a way to save some.
否则，以后需要用钱的时候，没钱怎么办？
Fǒuzé, yǐhòu xūyào yòng qián de shíhou, méi qián zěnme bàn?
Otherwise, what would we do when we needed money later?
你们年轻人花钱如流水，从来不为将来考虑。
Nǐmen niánqīngrén huā qián rú liúshuǐ, cónglái bù wèi jiānglái kǎolǜ.
You young people spend money like water and never think about the future.
再说旅行只能看看，有什么意思？既不能吃又不能穿，没有必要花这个钱。”
Zàishuō lǚxíng zhǐ néng kànkan, yǒu shénme yìsi? Jì bù néng chī yòu bù néng chuān, méiyǒu bìyào huā zhège qián."
Besides, travelling is only looking at things. What's the point? You can't eat it or wear it. There's no need to spend the money."
于思雨早就猜到了母亲会这样说，她笑着回答：
Yú Sīyǔ zǎojiù cāi dào le mǔqin huì zhèyàng shuō, tā xiào zhe huídá:
Yu Siyu had guessed her mother would say this, and replied with a smile:
“钱就是用来花的，不是用来存的。挣了钱却不改善生活，工作有什么意义？
"Qián jiùshì yònglái huā de, bú shì yònglái cún de. Zhèng le qián què bù gǎishàn shēnghuó, gōngzuò yǒu shénme yìyì?
"Money is for spending, not for saving. If you earn money but don't make life better, what's the point of working?
再说，现在家里又不缺钱。你们辛苦了一辈子了，也应该享受一下生活了。”
Zàishuō, xiànzài jiā li yòu bù quēqián. Nǐmen xīnkǔ le yíbèizi le, yě yīnggāi xiǎngshòu yíxià shēnghuó le."
Besides, we're not short of money now. You've worked hard all your lives. You should enjoy life a bit."
母亲长长地叹了一口气，说：
Mǔqin cháng cháng de tàn le yì kǒuqì, shuō:
Her mother sighed deeply and said:
“我知道你孝顺。虽然现在你已经独立了，但是你的那些钱也是辛苦挣来的。
"Wǒ zhīdao nǐ xiàoshùn. Suīrán xiànzài nǐ yǐjīng dúlì le, dànshì nǐ de nàxiē qián yě shì xīnkǔ zhèng lái de.
"I know you're a good daughter. You're independent now, but that money of yours was hard-earned too.
你天天加班，那么辛苦挣的钱，为什么要那么随便地花掉呢？
Nǐ tiāntiān jiā bān, nàme xīnkǔ zhèng de qián, wèishénme yào nàme suíbiàn de huādiào ne?
You work overtime every day. Why spend money you worked so hard for so casually?
钱，要用在更有意义的事情上面。”
Qián, yào yòng zài gèng yǒu yìyì de shìqing shàngmian."
Money should be spent on more meaningful things."

blocks.label: 两代人
blocks.h: 两代人的消费观念 · Two generations
lines: 什么才是更有意义的事呢？
Shénme cái shì gèng yǒu yìyì de shì ne?
So what are the more meaningful things?
也许对于母亲那代人来说，念书、买房、结婚、生子，才不算是乱花钱吧。
Yěxǔ duìyú mǔqin nà dài rén lái shuō, niàn shū, mǎi fáng, jié hūn, shēng zǐ, cái bú suànshì luàn huā qián ba.
Perhaps for her mother's generation, only schooling, buying a home, marriage and children don't count as wasting money.
他们那代人考虑的是如何满足温饱。
Tāmen nà dài rén kǎolǜ de shì rúhé mǎnzú wēnbǎo.
Their generation thought about how to get enough food and clothing.
即使现在温饱问题已经解决了，他们也保持着过去的消费习惯：
Jíshǐ xiànzài wēnbǎo wèntí yǐjīng jiějué le, tāmen yě bǎochí zhe guòqu de xiāofèi xíguàn:
Even now that problem has been solved, they keep their old spending habits:
喜欢买打折的廉价商品，钱只花在吃穿住行上面，舍不得在玩上面花钱。
Xǐhuan mǎi dǎzhé de liánjià shāngpǐn, qián zhǐ huā zài chī chuān zhù xíng shàngmian, shěbude zài wán shàngmian huā qián.
they like buying cheap discounted goods, spend money only on food, clothes, housing and transport, and can't bear to spend it on fun.
而于思雨属于八零后，她更重视生活质量。
Ér Yú Sīyǔ shǔyú bā líng hòu, tā gèng zhòngshì shēnghuó zhìliàng.
Yu Siyu, on the other hand, was born in the 1980s and values quality of life more.
于思雨知道，两代人的生活水平差距实在太大，
Yú Sīyǔ zhīdao, liǎng dài rén de shēnghuó shuǐpíng chājù shízài tài dà,
Yu Siyu knows the gap between the two generations' living standards is huge,
要说服老人改变他们的消费观念几乎不可能。
yào shuōfú lǎorén gǎibiàn tāmen de xiāofèi guānniàn jīhū bù kěnéng.
and persuading the older generation to change their attitude to spending is almost impossible.
有时候母女俩也会因为这个原因吵嘴。
Yǒushíhou mǔ nǚ liǎ yě huì yīnwèi zhège yuányīn chǎozuǐ.
Sometimes mother and daughter even argue over it.
于思雨可以花几千块钱买个最新款的手机，
Yú Sīyǔ kěyǐ huā jǐ qiān kuài qián mǎi ge zuìxīn kuǎn de shǒujī,
Yu Siyu will spend several thousand on the latest phone,
但她母亲还用着那种连个照相功能都没有的老手机。
dàn tā mǔqin hái yòng zhe nà zhǒng lián ge zhàoxiàng gōngnéng dōu méiyǒu de lǎo shǒujī.
but her mother still uses an old phone without even a camera.
于思雨出门就打车，而她的父母只肯坐公交车。
Yú Sīyǔ chūmén jiù dǎchē, ér tā de fùmǔ zhǐ kěn zuò gōngjiāochē.
Yu Siyu takes a taxi whenever she goes out, while her parents will only take the bus.
跟朋友去饭馆聚会，对于思雨来说是再普通不过的事儿，
Gēn péngyou qù fànguǎn jùhuì, duì Yú Sīyǔ lái shuō shì zài pǔtōng búguò de shìr,
Eating out with friends is the most ordinary thing in the world for Yu Siyu,
但她父母更愿意在家里吃饭。
dàn tā fùmǔ gèng yuànyì zài jiā li chī fàn.
but her parents prefer to eat at home.
她父母攒够了一定的钱后才会去买东西，要是钱不够，就继续攒。
Tā fùmǔ zǎn gòu le yídìng de qián hòu cái huì qù mǎi dōngxi, yàoshì qián bú gòu, jiù jìxù zǎn.
Her parents only buy something once they've saved enough; if there isn't enough, they keep saving.
向银行贷款、分期付款这种消费方式，他们根本就接受不了。
Xiàng yínháng dàikuǎn, fēnqī fùkuǎn zhè zhǒng xiāofèi fāngshì, tāmen gēnběn jiù jiēshòu bu liǎo.
Borrowing from the bank or paying in instalments is something they simply can't accept.

blocks.label: 海南
lines: 在于思雨的坚持下，加上父亲的劝说，她母亲最后勉强同意了。
Zài Yú Sīyǔ de jiānchí xià, jiāshàng fùqin de quànshuō, tā mǔqin zuìhòu miǎnqiǎng tóngyì le.
With Yu Siyu insisting and her father persuading, her mother finally agreed reluctantly.
旅行的时候，母亲一路上不停地抱怨她乱花钱，嫌什么都贵，什么都舍不得吃，
Lǚxíng de shíhou, mǔqin yí lùshàng bù tíng de bàoyuàn tā luàn huā qián, xián shénme dōu guì, shénme dōu shěbude chī,
During the trip her mother complained all the way that she was wasting money, said everything was too expensive, couldn't bear to eat anything,
也绝不轻易买东西。
yě jué bù qīngyì mǎi dōngxi.
and never bought anything without a lot of thought.
但到了海边，从来没见过大海的母亲十分兴奋，
Dàn dào le hǎibiān, cónglái méi jiàn guo dàhǎi de mǔqin shífēn xīngfèn,
But at the seaside, her mother, who had never seen the sea, was thrilled.
像个孩子一样，光着脚在海水里走来走去，还捡了好多贝壳做纪念。
xiàng ge háizi yíyàng, guāng zhe jiǎo zài hǎishuǐ li zǒu lái zǒu qù, hái jiǎn le hǎo duō bèiké zuò jìniàn.
Like a child, she walked barefoot back and forth in the water and picked up lots of shells as souvenirs.
在海南的那七天，于思雨觉得特别幸福。
Zài Hǎinán de nà qī tiān, Yú Sīyǔ juéde tèbié xìngfú.
During those seven days in Hainan, Yu Siyu felt especially happy.
她紧紧地牵着父母的手散步，给父母照相，一起自拍。
Tā jǐnjǐn de qiān zhe fùmǔ de shǒu sànbù, gěi fùmǔ zhàoxiàng, yìqǐ zìpāi.
She walked holding her parents' hands tightly, took photos of them, and took selfies together.
她希望这样的时刻多些、再多些。
Tā xīwàng zhèyàng de shíkè duō xiē, zài duō xiē.
She hoped for more moments like this, many more.
她暗自决定：陪父母旅行不是最后一次，而只是刚刚开始。
Tā ànzì juédìng: péi fùmǔ lǚxíng bú shì zuìhòu yí cì, ér zhǐshì gānggāng kāishǐ.
She privately decided: travelling with her parents wasn't the last time; it was only the beginning.

vocab: to be good to one's parents
grammar: 出生于 + time
to be born in …
于 is a formal "in/at".
她母亲出生于五十年代，是典型的家庭妇女。
Tā mǔqin chūshēng yú wǔshí niándài, shì diǎnxíng de jiātíng fùnǚ.
Her mother was born in the 1950s and is a typical housewife.
他出生于北京。
Tā chūshēng yú Běijīng.
He was born in Beijing.
只靠……
to rely only on …
靠 = depend on.
小地方生活很辛苦，只靠父亲一份薪水，能吃饱穿暖已经很不容易了，
Xiǎo dìfang shēnghuó hěn xīnkǔ, zhǐ kào fùqin yí fèn xīnshui, néng chī bǎo chuān nuǎn yǐjīng hěn bù róngyì le,
Life in a small town was hard. With only her father's wages to live on, having enough to eat and wear was already an achievement,
他只靠自己。
Tā zhǐ kào zìjǐ.
He relies only on himself.
恨不得
to wish one could
Shows a strong (often exaggerated) wish.
因此，母亲非常节俭，恨不得一分钱掰成两半花，从来没有出过远门。
Yīncǐ, mǔqin fēicháng jiéjiǎn, hènbude yì fēn qián bāi chéng liǎng bàn huā, cónglái méiyǒu chū guo yuǎnmén.
So her mother was extremely thrifty, making every cent count, and had never travelled far from home.
我恨不得马上回家。
Wǒ hènbude mǎshàng huí jiā.
I wish I could go home right now.
尽管……，但是……
although …, …
A concessive pair.
尽管现在母亲年纪大了，但是她身体一直很好。
Jǐnguǎn xiànzài mǔqin niánjì dà le, dànshì tā shēntǐ yìzhí hěn hǎo.
Although her mother is getting on, she has always been healthy.
尽管很累，但是他很高兴。
Jǐnguǎn hěn lèi, dànshì tā hěn gāoxìng.
Although tired, he was happy.
趁 + situation
while …, take the chance
Do something while conditions allow.
趁他们现在身体还行，于思雨想陪着他们到处走走、看看。
Chèn tāmen xiànzài shēntǐ hái xíng, Yú Sīyǔ xiǎng péi zhe tāmen dàochù zǒu zǒu, kànkan.
While they're still in good health, Yu Siyu wants to take them around to see things.
趁热吃吧。
Chèn rè chī ba.
Eat it while it's hot.
不但不……，反而……
not only not …, but on the contrary …
The result is the opposite of what's expected.
毕竟父母老了，于思雨不想看到父母跟着她旅行时不但不能够放松，反而更累，
Bìjìng fùmǔ lǎo le, Yú Sīyǔ bù xiǎng kàndào fùmǔ gēnzhe tā lǚxíng shí búdàn bù nénggòu fàngsōng, fǎn'ér gèng lèi,
After all, her parents are old, and Yu Siyu didn't want them to end up more tired instead of relaxed when travelling with her,
他不但不生气，反而笑了。
Tā búdàn bù shēng qì, fǎn'ér xiào le.
Instead of getting angry, he laughed.
既不……又不……
neither … nor …
Lists two negatives.
再说旅行只能看看，有什么意思？既不能吃又不能穿，没有必要花这个钱。”
Zàishuō lǚxíng zhǐ néng kànkan, yǒu shénme yìsi? Jì bù néng chī yòu bù néng chuān, méiyǒu bìyào huā zhège qián."
Besides, travelling is only looking at things. What's the point? You can't eat it or wear it. There's no need to spend the money."
这儿既不安静又不干净。
Zhèr jì bù ānjìng yòu bù gānjìng.
It's neither quiet nor clean here.
对于……来说
for …
Gives the point of view.
也许对于母亲那代人来说，念书、买房、结婚、生子，才不算是乱花钱吧。
Yěxǔ duìyú mǔqin nà dài rén lái shuō, niàn shū, mǎi fáng, jié hūn, shēng zǐ, cái bú suànshì luàn huā qián ba.
Perhaps for her mother's generation, only schooling, buying a home, marriage and children don't count as wasting money.
对于我来说，这很难。
Duìyú wǒ lái shuō, zhè hěn nán.
For me, this is hard.
再 + adj + 不过
couldn't be more …
A superlative pattern.
跟朋友去饭馆聚会，对于思雨来说是再普通不过的事儿，
Gēn péngyou qù fànguǎn jùhuì, duì Yú Sīyǔ lái shuō shì zài pǔtōng búguò de shìr,
Eating out with friends is the most ordinary thing in the world for Yu Siyu,
这再好不过了。
Zhè zàihǎobùguò le.
Nothing could be better.
在……下
under, with …
Gives the circumstance.
在于思雨的坚持下，加上父亲的劝说，她母亲最后勉强同意了。
Zài Yú Sīyǔ de jiānchí xià, jiāshàng fùqin de quànshuō, tā mǔqin zuìhòu miǎnqiǎng tóngyì le.
With Yu Siyu insisting and her father persuading, her mother finally agreed reluctantly.
在老师的帮助下，他进步了。
Zài lǎoshī de bāngzhù xià, tā jìnbù le.
With the teacher's help, he improved.
gaps: 这是于思雨很早以前就有的一个
这个世界上最不能等的事情，就是
所以专门在三月请了假，
老人改变他们的消费观念几乎不可能。
say: "Money is for spending, not for saving. If you earn money but don't make life better, what's the point of working?
The one thing in this world that can't wait is looking after your parents.
She hoped for more moments like this, many more.

067.title: Thrift in an age of consumption
067.sub: Lesson 4 reading: is thrift still a virtue?
067.transcriptNote: A short essay from lesson 4. 谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦 ("who knows that every grain on the plate came from hard toil") is a line from a Tang poem; 由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难 means "it's easy to go from thrift to luxury, hard to go back".

blocks.label: 课文
blocks.h: 消费时代谈节俭 · The essay
lines: 消费时代谈节俭
Xiāofèi shídài tán jiéjiǎn
Thrift in an age of consumption
节俭是中国人的传统美德。
Jiéjiǎn shì Zhōngguórén de chuántǒng měidé.
Thrift is a traditional Chinese virtue.
父母会告诉孩子：谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦。
Fùmǔ huì gàosu háizi: shéi zhī pán zhōng cān, lì lì jiē xīnkǔ.
Parents tell their children: who knows that every grain on the plate came from hard toil?
老人们会劝年轻人：由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难。
Lǎo rénmen huì quàn niánqīngrén: yóu jiǎn rù shē yì, yóu shē rù jiǎn nán.
The old advise the young: it's easy to go from thrift to luxury, but hard to go back.
这不难理解。
Zhè bù nán lǐjiě.
This isn't hard to understand.
在生活困难的年代，收入水平较低，大多数中国人重视积累，
Zài shēnghuó kùnnan de niándài, shōurù shuǐpíng jiào dī, dàduōshù Zhōngguórén zhòngshì jīlěi,
In hard times, when incomes were low, most Chinese people focused on putting money by;
物质上舍不得消费，更顾不上精神消费。
wùzhì shàng shěbude xiāofèi, gèng gù bu shàng jīngshén xiāofèi.
they couldn't bear to spend on material things, let alone on things for the mind.
但现在的情况已有所不同。
Dàn xiànzài de qíngkuàng yǐ yǒu suǒ bù tóng.
But things are different now.
今天，中国人的消费方式分为生存型、发展型和享受型这三种类型。
Jīntiān, Zhōngguórén de xiāofèi fāngshì fēnwéi shēngcún xíng, fāzhǎn xíng hé xiǎngshòu xíng zhè sān zhǒng lèixíng.
Today, Chinese spending falls into three types: survival, development and enjoyment.
打个比方，身上有十块钱，用来买馒头是生存型消费，
Dǎ ge bǐfang, shēnshàng yǒu shí kuài qián, yònglái mǎi mántou shì shēngcún xíng xiāofèi,
For example, if you have ten yuan on you, spending it on steamed buns is survival spending,
买书是发展型消费，喝咖啡就是享受型消费。
mǎi shū shì fāzhǎn xíng xiāofèi, hē kāfēi jiùshì xiǎngshòu xíng xiāofèi.
buying a book is development spending, and drinking coffee is enjoyment spending.
享受型消费，自然包括在海外购买奢侈品。
Xiǎngshòu xíng xiāofèi, zìrán bāokuò zài hǎiwài gòumǎi shēchǐpǐn.
Enjoyment spending naturally includes buying luxury goods abroad.
中国人有很强的购买力，这让许多国家十分欢迎中国游客。
Zhōngguórén yǒu hěn qiáng de gòumǎilì, zhè ràng xǔduō guójiā shífēn huānyíng Zhōngguó yóukè.
Chinese people have great purchasing power, which makes many countries welcome Chinese tourists.
为了吸引更多的中国人，一些国家甚至简化了签证手续。
Wèile xīyǐn gèng duō de Zhōngguórén, yìxiē guójiā shènzhì jiǎnhuà le qiānzhèng shǒuxù.
To attract more of them, some countries have even simplified visa procedures.
因此，有人说，中国已进入了消费时代。
Yīncǐ, yǒu rén shuō, Zhōngguó yǐ jìnrù le xiāofèi shídài.
So some people say China has entered an age of consumption.
消费的目的不是为了满足生活的需要，
Xiāofèi de mùdì bú shì wèile mǎnzú shēnghuó de xūyào,
The purpose of spending is no longer to meet the needs of life,
而是为了满足被刺激起来的各种欲望。
érshì wèile mǎnzú bèi cìjī qǐlái de gè zhǒng yùwàng.
but to satisfy all kinds of stimulated desires:
比如，将购买名车、大房子视为成功的人生。
Bǐrú, jiāng gòumǎi míng chē, dà fángzi shì wéi chénggōng de rénshēng.
for example, seeing buying a luxury car and a big house as a successful life.
从经济学角度讲，只有消费了，经济才能发展。
Cóng jīngjìxué jiǎodù jiǎng, zhǐyǒu xiāofèi le, jīngjì cái néng fāzhǎn.
From an economic point of view, the economy can only grow if people spend.
随着服务业的发展，各种各样的广告、新产品不断刺激着人们产生新的消费需求。
Suízhe fúwùyè de fāzhǎn, gè zhǒng gè yàng de guǎnggào, xīn chǎnpǐn búduàn cìjī zhe rénmen chǎnshēng xīn de xiāofèi xūqiú.
As the service industry develops, all sorts of adverts and new products constantly stimulate new consumer demand.
在衣食住行方面的需求已经被满足的基础上，
Zài yī shí zhù xíng fāngmiàn de xūqiú yǐjīng bèi mǎnzú de jīchǔ shàng,
Once the basic needs of clothing, food, housing and transport are met,
消费者们当然有理由追求质量更高的生活。
xiāofèizhě men dāngrán yǒu lǐyóu zhuīqiú zhìliàng gèng gāo de shēnghuó.
consumers naturally have every reason to pursue a better quality of life.
但遗憾的是，今天，资源浪费的现象非常严重。
Dàn yíhàn de shì, jīntiān, zīyuán làngfèi de xiànxiàng fēicháng yánzhòng.
Unfortunately, though, waste of resources is very serious today.
人们为了自己方便，大量地使用一次性产品。
Rénmen wèile zìjǐ fāngbiàn, dàliàng de shǐyòng yícìxìng chǎnpǐn.
For their own convenience, people use huge amounts of disposable products.
有的年轻人将节俭视为落后，认为这种观念已经过时了。
Yǒu de niánqīngrén jiāng jiéjiǎn shì wéi luòhòu, rènwéi zhè zhǒng guānniàn yǐjīng guòshí le.
Some young people see thrift as backward and think the idea is out of date.
他们认为，赚钱的目的就是消费，生活的目的就是享受。
Tāmen rènwéi, zhuànqián de mùdì jiùshì xiāofèi, shēnghuó de mùdì jiùshì xiǎngshòu.
They believe the purpose of earning money is to spend it, and the purpose of life is to enjoy it.
其实这是一种误解。
Qíshí zhè shì yì zhǒng wùjiě.
In fact this is a misunderstanding.
今天这个时代，谈节俭是非常有必要的。
Jīntiān zhège shídài, tán jiéjiǎn shì fēicháng yǒu bìyào de.
In this day and age, talking about thrift is very necessary.
节俭不是说不消费、不享受，
Jiéjiǎn bú shì shuō bù xiāofèi, bù xiǎngshòu,
Thrift doesn't mean not spending or not enjoying;
而是说应该节约资源，保护环境，反对过度消费。
érshì shuō yīnggāi jiéyuē zīyuán, bǎohù huánjìng, fǎnduì guòdù xiāofèi.
it means saving resources, protecting the environment and opposing excessive consumption.
年轻人更应该有社会责任感，
Niánqīngrén gèng yīnggāi yǒu shèhuì zérèngǎn,
Young people in particular should have a sense of social responsibility,
应该根据自己的能力来合理消费、健康消费、绿色消费。
yīnggāi gēnjù zìjǐ de nénglì lái hélǐ xiāofèi, jiànkāng xiāofèi, lǜsè xiāofèi.
and spend sensibly, healthily and greenly, according to their means.
只有在这样的原则下，生活才会少一点后顾之忧。
Zhǐyǒu zài zhèyàng de yuánzé xià, shēnghuó cái huì shǎo yìdiǎn hòugù zhī yōu.
Only on this principle will life hold fewer worries for the future.

grammar: 虽然……，但是也……
although …, still …
A concessive pair.
虽然没有得真正的疾病，但是也不是十分健康。
Suīrán méiyǒu dé zhēnzhèng de jíbìng, dànshì yě bú shì shífēn jiànkāng.

尽……最大的努力
to do one's very best
尽 = to exhaust, to use fully.
尽自己最大的努力去做，有些过度。

不与……交流
not to communicate with …
与 is a formal 和.

grammar: 买了台 + N
bought a …
一 is often dropped before a measure word in speech.
买了台打折彩电。
Mǎi le tái dǎzhé cǎidiàn.
Bought a colour TV on discount.

Tā mǎi le tái xīn diànnǎo.

不能轻易 + V
mustn't … lightly
轻易 = easily, casually.

Bù néng qīngyì kāi kōngtiáo.

Bù néng qīngyì xiāngxìn biérén.

一……就…… / 出门就坐车
as soon as …

Chūmén jiù zuò chē, zhǐ mǎi gāodàng shāngpǐn.

恨不得

高科技产品给我们的生活带来了极大的方便，加快了我们的生活节奏。

érqiě shēnghuó méiyǒu guīlǜ, cónglái bù dào wàimian huódòng huódòng, huànhuan kōngqì.
and his life is irregular. He never goes outside to move about and get some fresh air.
速冻食品没有什么营养，还是去市场买新鲜的菜好。

那些快餐更要少吃，对身体没有什么好处。

人们不能使用手机，也不能上网，这样专门用来治疗现代生活病。
rénmen bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī, yě bù néng shàngwǎng, zhèyàng zhuānmén yònglái zhìliáo xiàndài shēnghuó bìng.
so people can't use phones or go online. It's specially meant for treating modern lifestyle illnesses.

grammar: 人家给他打了八折
they gave her 20% off
打八折 = pay 80% of the price.
听说是在同一家商店买的，人家给她打了八折。
tīngshuō shì zài tóng yì jiā shāngdiàn mǎi de, rénjia gěi tā dǎ le bā zhé.

在……面前抬不起头
to be ashamed in front of …
Lit. "can't raise one's head".
八十岁的顾爷爷去了养老院，这让他的孩子在邻居面前很抬不起头。

给……带来……
to bring … to …
Common with 方便, 好处, 麻烦.

Gāokējì chǎnpǐn gěi wǒmen de shēnghuó dàilái le jídà de fāngbiàn, jiākuài le wǒmen de shēnghuó jiézòu.

这件事给我带来了很多麻烦。

V + V (活动活动, 换换)

而且生活没有规律，从来不到外面活动活动，换换空气。
érqiě shēnghuó méiyǒu guīlǜ, cónglái bù dào wàimian huódòng huódòng, huànhuan kōngqì.
and his life is irregular. He never goes outside to move about and get some fresh air.
