A
自从和女朋友分手后，小光觉得每天都很烦，经常一个人在家里喝酒、叹气。
Zìcóng hé nǚpéngyou fēnshǒu hòu, Xiǎoguāng juéde měitiān dōu hěn fán, jīngcháng yí ge rén zài jiā li hējiǔ, tànqì.
Since breaking up with his girlfriend, Xiaoguang has felt fed up every day, often drinking and sighing at home alone.
B

grammar: 取得成功
to achieve success
取得 goes with 成功, 成绩, 进步.
发展科技是我们取得成功的一个重要保证。
Fāzhǎn kējì shì wǒmen qǔdé chénggōng de yí ge zhòngyào bǎozhèng.
Developing technology is an important guarantee of our success.
他取得了很好的成绩。
Tā qǔdé le hěn hǎo de chéngjì.
He got very good results.
处于……状态
to be in a state of …
处于 = to be situated in.
由于生活压力太大，很多人处于一种亚健康状态。
Yóuyú shēnghuó yālì tài dà, hěn duō rén chǔyú yì zhǒng yàjiànkāng zhuàngtài.
Because of the pressures of life, many people are in a state of sub-health.
公司处于困难状态。
Gōngsī chǔyú kùnnan zhuàngtài.
The company is in difficulty.
会造成……
can cause …
造成 usually takes a bad result.
过度使用电脑会造成眼睛疲劳。
Guòdù shǐyòng diànnǎo huì zàochéng yǎnjing píláo.
Using a computer too much causes eye strain.
熬夜会造成失眠。
Áoyè huì zàochéng shīmián.
Staying up late can cause insomnia.
从没 + V + 过
have never …
从没 = 从来没有.
我还从没接触过一个像他这么健忘的人呢。
Wǒ hái cóngméi jiēchù guo yí ge xiàng tā zhème jiànwàng de rén ne.
I've never come across anyone as forgetful as him.
我从没去过上海。
Wǒ cóngméi qù guo Shànghǎi.
I've never been to Shanghai.
自从……后
ever since …
Marks a starting point in the past.
自从和女朋友分手后，小光觉得每天都很烦，经常一个人在家里喝酒、叹气。
Zìcóng hé nǚpéngyou fēnshǒu hòu, Xiǎoguāng juéde měitiān dōu hěn fán, jīngcháng yí ge rén zài jiā li hējiǔ, tànqì.
Since breaking up with his girlfriend, Xiaoguang has felt fed up every day, often drinking and sighing at home alone.
自从来了中国后，他胖了。
Zì cónglái le Zhōngguó hòu, tā pàng le.
He's put on weight since coming to China.
gaps: 我还从没接触过一个像他这么

073.title: Do the two sentences match?
073.sub: Five pairs: same meaning or not?
073.transcriptNote: Each item has two sentences, A and B. Decide whether they mean the same thing, then turn on Answers. The letter B isn't read aloud. The answers are my own judgement.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断意思是否相符 · Same meaning?
lines: 听录音，判断两个句子的意思是否相符。
Tīng lùyīn, pànduàn liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu xiāngfú.
Listen and decide whether the two sentences mean the same.
最近收到了好多账单，压得我喘不过气来。
Zuìjìn shōudào le hǎo duō zhàngdān, yā de wǒ chuǎn bu guò qì lai.
I've had so many bills lately, they're crushing me.
A
最近我要应付各种账单，有些承受不了了。
Zuìjìn wǒ yào yìngfu gè zhǒng zhàngdān, yǒuxiē chéngshòu bu liǎo le.
Lately I've had to deal with all sorts of bills, and it's getting too much for me.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say the bills are more than the speaker can cope with.

lines: 现在大多数年轻人都是夜猫子，生活没有什么规律。
Xiànzài dàduōshù niánqīngrén dōu shì yèmāozi, shēnghuó méiyǒu shénme guīlǜ.
Most young people now are night owls and lead irregular lives.
A
现在大多数年轻人都常常熬夜，生活习惯很不好。
Xiànzài dàduōshù niánqīngrén dōu chángcháng áoyè, shēnghuó xíguàn hěn bù hǎo.
Most young people now often stay up late and have bad habits.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A night owl is someone who stays up late.

lines: 由于缺少户外活动，人们抵抗疾病的能力越来越差。
Yóuyú quēshǎo hùwài huódòng, rénmen dǐkàng jíbìng de nénglì yuèláiyuè chà.
Because of a lack of outdoor activity, people's resistance to disease is getting weaker.
A
因为人们很少到外面活动，所以变得很爱得病。
Yīnwèi rénmen hěn shǎo dào wàimian huódòng, suǒyǐ biàn de hěn ài dé bìng.
Because people rarely go out and move about, they get ill easily.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both link little outdoor activity with falling ill more.

lines: 他们虽然住在一个小区里，但是从来不来往。
Tāmen suīrán zhù zài yí ge xiǎoqū li, dànshì cónglái bù láiwǎng.
Although they live on the same estate, they never have anything to do with each other.
A
这个小区里的人都不喜欢进行户外活动。
Zhège xiǎoqū li de rén dōu bù xǐhuan jìnxíng hùwài huódòng.
Nobody on this estate likes outdoor activities.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A is about neighbours never seeing each other; B is about outdoor activities.

lines: 为了交上首付，他和妻子拼命赚钱，连电影都不舍得去看。
Wèile jiāo shàng shǒufù, tā hé qīzi pīnmìng zhuànqián, lián diànyǐng dōu bù shěde qù kàn.
To pay the deposit, he and his wife are earning all they can and won't even spend money on a film.
A
为了交首付，他和妻子拼命攒钱，生活上十分节俭。
Wèile jiāo shǒufù, tā hé qīzi pīnmìng zǎn qián, shēnghuó shàng shífēn jiéjiǎn.
To pay the deposit, he and his wife are saving all they can and live very frugally.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both describe the couple working hard and cutting back to pay the deposit; not even going to the cinema is being thrifty.

grammar: 压得我喘不过气来
crushes me so I can't breathe
V + 得 + result shows the degree.
最近收到了好多账单，压得我喘不过气来。
Zuìjìn shōudào le hǎo duō zhàngdān, yā de wǒ chuǎn bu guò qì lai.
I've had so many bills lately, they're crushing me.
工作压得他喘不过气来。
Gōngzuò yā de tā chuǎn bu guò qì lai.
Work is crushing him.
有些……不了了
can't quite … any more
V + 不了 = unable to; 了 shows a change.
最近我要应付各种账单，有些承受不了了。
Zuìjìn wǒ yào yìngfu gè zhǒng zhàngdān, yǒuxiē chéngshòu bu liǎo le.
Lately I've had to deal with all sorts of bills, and it's getting too much for me.
我有点儿吃不了了。
Wǒ yǒudiǎn'ér chī bu liǎo le.
I can't eat any more.
owing to …
Formal "because".
由于缺少户外活动，人们抵抗疾病的能力越来越差。
Yóuyú quēshǎo hùwài huódòng, rénmen dǐkàng jíbìng de nénglì yuèláiyuè chà.
Because of a lack of outdoor activity, people's resistance to disease is getting weaker.
由于下雨，比赛取消了。
Yóuyú xià yǔ, bǐsài qǔxiāo le.
The match was cancelled because of rain.
连……都不……
not even …
Stresses an extreme case.
为了交上首付，他和妻子拼命赚钱，连电影都不舍得去看。
Wèile jiāo shàng shǒufù, tā hé qīzi pīnmìng zhuànqián, lián diànyǐng dōu bù shěde qù kàn.
To pay the deposit, he and his wife are earning all they can and won't even spend money on a film.
他忙得连饭都不吃。
Tā máng de lián fàn dōu bù chī.
He's so busy he doesn't even eat.

074.title: For or against overtime?
074.sub: Eight people advise a new employee who's been asked to work late
074.transcriptNote: Tian Tian has just started at an advertising company and after a week her manager is already making her work overtime. Eight people give their views. Decide whether each one thinks she should put up with the overtime or not, then turn on Answers. Several item numbers aren't read aloud. The answers are my own judgement.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断说话人的意思 · What does the speaker think?
lines: 判断说话人的意思。
Pànduàn shuōhuàrén de yìsi.
Work out what the speakers mean.
田甜在一家广告公司找到了工作，刚上班一个星期，公司经理就开始让她加班。
Tián Tián zài yì jiā guǎnggào gōngsī zhǎodào le gōngzuò, gāng shàng bān yí ge xīngqī, gōngsī jīnglǐ jiù kāishǐ ràng tā jiā bān.
Tian Tian found a job at an advertising company. She'd only been there a week when the manager started making her work overtime.
下面是一些人对此的看法，你觉得他们的态度是什么？
Xiàmiàn shì yìxiē rén duì cǐ de kànfǎ, nǐ juéde tāmen de tàidu shì shénme?
Here's what some people think about it. What do you think their attitudes are?
小田，你这样想是早晚要被社会淘汰的。
Xiǎo Tián, nǐ zhèyàng xiǎng shì zǎowǎn yào bèi shèhuì táotài de.
Xiao Tian, if you think like that, society will leave you behind sooner or later.
你不想付出，辛苦，没什么，可是你周围的人都在努力加班，
Nǐ bù xiǎng fùchū, xīnkǔ, méi shénme, kěshì nǐ zhōuwéi de rén dōu zài nǔlì jiā bān,
Not wanting to make an effort or work hard is fine, but everyone around you is working overtime,
甚至比你强的人也在加班，这样你慢慢就被所有人淘汰了。
shènzhì bǐ nǐ qiáng de rén yě zài jiā bān, zhèyàng nǐ mànmàn jiù bèi suǒyǒu rén táotài le.
even people better than you. That way you'll slowly fall behind everyone.

q: 说话人觉得田甜应该加班吗？
Shuōhuàrén juéde Tián Tián yīnggāi jiā bān ma?
Does the speaker think Tian Tian should work overtime?

lines: 要我说，你到我们这儿来吧。我们很少加班，要是加的话，一定会给加班费。
Yào wǒ shuō, nǐ dào wǒmen zhèr lái ba. Wǒmen hěn shǎo jiā bān, yàoshì jiā dehuà, yídìng huì gěi jiābānfèi.
If you ask me, come and work with us. We rarely do overtime, and if we do, we always get paid for it.

q: 说话人觉得田甜应该加班吗？
Shuōhuàrén juéde Tián Tián yīnggāi jiā bān ma?
Does the speaker think Tian Tian should work overtime?

lines: 你不是经常头晕吗？就是因为休息不好。我看你得好好养养了，病倒了就晚了。

Don't you often get dizzy? That's because you don't rest enough. I think you need to take care of yourself. Once you fall ill it'll be too late.

q: 说话人觉得田甜应该加班吗？
Shuōhuàrén juéde Tián Tián yīnggāi jiā bān ma?
Does the speaker think Tian Tian should work overtime?

Nǐ gāng shàng bān bù zhīdao, xiànzài zhèyàng de qǐyè tài duō le.

If you move, the new place might be worse than this one. Some places only give you half an hour off at lunch.

q: 说话人觉得田甜应该加班吗？
Shuōhuàrén juéde Tián Tián yīnggāi jiā bān ma?
Does the speaker think Tian Tian should work overtime?

lines: 刚来的就该多干点儿，特别是经理给的工作。让你加班儿，那是让你多学点儿。
Gāng lái de jiù gāi duō gàn diǎnr, tèbié shì jīnglǐ gěi de gōngzuò. Ràng nǐ jiā bānr, nà shì ràng nǐ duō xué diǎnr.
New people should do a bit more, especially work the manager gives you. Asking you to do overtime is a way of letting you learn more.

q: 说话人觉得田甜应该加班吗？
Shuōhuàrén juéde Tián Tián yīnggāi jiā bān ma?
Does the speaker think Tian Tian should work overtime?

lines: 我觉得如果是你的事儿还没做完，让你加班很正常。

而且如果别的同事都晚走，你怎么好意思先走？
Érqiě rúguǒ biéde tóngshì dōu wǎn zǒu, nǐ zěnme hǎoyìsi xiān zǒu?

q: 说话人觉得田甜应该加班吗？
Shuōhuàrén juéde Tián Tián yīnggāi jiā bān ma?
Does the speaker think Tian Tian should work overtime?

lines: 你看看你看看，刚来就这么拼命干，以后身体能受得了吗？小田，不能这样下去了。
Nǐ kànkan nǐ kànkan, gāng lái jiù zhème pīnmìng gàn, yǐhòu shēntǐ néng shòu de liǎo ma? Xiǎo Tián, bù néng zhèyàng xiàqu le.
Look at you, working yourself to the bone the moment you arrive. Will your health be able to take it? Xiao Tian, you can't go on like this.

q: 说话人觉得田甜应该加班吗？
Shuōhuàrén juéde Tián Tián yīnggāi jiā bān ma?

……就晚了
then it'll be too late

075.title: Modern lifestyle illnesses
075.sub: Three questions, then a passage on how modern life makes us ill
075.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the passage. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

q: 得了现代生活病的人有什么表现？
Dé le xiàndài shēnghuó bìng de rén yǒu shénme biǎoxiàn?
What are the symptoms of people with modern lifestyle illnesses?
ans: 经常失眠、健忘，总是感觉疲劳、头晕，抵抗疾病能力下降。
Jīngcháng shīmián, jiànwàng, zǒngshì gǎnjué píláo, tóu yūn, dǐkàng jíbìng nénglì xiàjiàng.
They often sleep badly and are forgetful, always feel tired and dizzy, and their resistance to disease is lower.

q: 什么原因使他们得上了这种病？
Shénme yuányīn shǐ tāmen dé shàng le zhè zhǒng bìng?
What made them get this illness?
ans: 房价高、物价高、压力大，城市生活节奏紧张，长期处于亚健康状态；生活条件改善和科技进步也改变了很多好的生活习惯。
Fángjià gāo, wùjià gāo, yālì dà, chéngshì shēnghuó jiézòu jǐnzhāng, chángqī chǔyú yàjiànkāng zhuàngtài; shēnghuó tiáojiàn gǎishàn hé kējì jìnbù yě gǎibiàn le hěn duō hǎo de shēnghuó xíguàn.
High house prices and living costs, stress and the tense pace of city life keep them in sub-health; better living conditions and technology have also changed many good habits.

q: 我们的生活习惯和以前有什么不同？请举两个例子。
Wǒmen de shēnghuó xíguàn hé yǐqián yǒu shénme bùtóng? Qǐng jǔ liǎng ge lìzi.
How are our habits different from before? Give two examples.
ans: 以前去菜市场买新鲜的菜，现在去超市买速冻食品，用微波炉一热就吃，或者天天吃快餐；以前住平房，邻居常常来往，现在住楼房，邻居很少来往，回家就看电视、上网、玩手机。

Yǐqián qù càishìchǎng mǎi xīnxiān de cài, xiànzài qù chāoshì mǎi sùdòng shípǐn, yòng wēibōlú yí rè jiù chī, huòzhě tiāntiān chī kuàicān; yǐqián zhù píngfáng, línjū chángcháng láiwǎng, xiànzài zhù lóufáng, línjū hěn shǎo láiwǎng, huí jiā jiù kàn diànshì, shàngwǎng, wán shǒujī.

We used to buy fresh food at the market; now we buy frozen food at the supermarket and microwave it, or eat fast food every day. We used to live in single-storey houses and neighbours saw each other often; now we live in apartment blocks, rarely see the neighbours, and just watch TV, go online or play on our phones.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 现代生活病
Xiàndài shēnghuó bìng
Modern lifestyle illnesses
现在有越来越多的人得上了现代生活病。
Xiànzài yǒu yuèláiyuè duō de rén dé shàng le xiàndài shēnghuó bìng.
More and more people now have modern lifestyle illnesses.
他们经常会失眠、健忘，并且总是感觉到疲劳、头晕，抵抗疾病能力下降等等。
Tāmen jīngcháng huì shīmián, jiànwàng, bìngqiě zǒngshì gǎnjué dào píláo, tóu yūn, dǐkàng jíbìng nénglì xiàjiàng děngděng.
They often sleep badly and are forgetful, always feel tired and dizzy, their resistance to disease falls, and so on.
原因是什么呢？
Yuányīn shì shénme ne?
What's the cause?
房价高，物价高，压力大，城市生活的紧张节奏压得我们喘不过气来，
Fángjià gāo, wùjià gāo, yālì dà, chéngshì shēnghuó de jǐnzhāng jiézòu yā de wǒmen chuǎn bu guò qì lai,
High house prices, high living costs and stress: the tense pace of city life crushes us,
让我们长期处于一种亚健康状态。
ràng wǒmen chángqī chǔyú yì zhǒng yàjiànkāng zhuàngtài.
keeping us in a long-term state of sub-health.
另外，生活条件的改善和科技的进步虽然让我们的生活更加舒适、便利，
Lìngwài, shēnghuó tiáojiàn de gǎishàn hé kējì de jìnbù suīrán ràng wǒmen de shēnghuó gèngjiā shūshì, biànlì,
Besides, although better living conditions and technological progress make our lives more comfortable and convenient,
同时也改变了我们以前很多好的生活习惯。
tóngshí yě gǎibiàn le wǒmen yǐqián hěn duō hǎo de shēnghuó xíguàn.
they have also changed many of our good old habits.
比如，今天人们的生活水平提高了，大多数家庭都安装了彩电、冰箱或空调，
Bǐrú, jīntiān rénmen de shēnghuó shuǐpíng tígāo le, dàduōshù jiātíng dōu ānzhuāng le cǎidiàn, bīngxiāng huò kōngtiáo,
For example, living standards are higher today, and most homes have a colour TV, a fridge or air conditioning,
大家都喜欢待在家里。
dàjiā dōu xǐhuan dài zài jiā li.
so everyone likes staying in.
如果出门，人们更愿意选择坐公交、自己开车或者叫出租车。
Rúguǒ chūmén, rénmen gèng yuànyì xuǎnzé zuò gōngjiāo, zìjǐ kāichē huòzhě jiào chūzūchē.
When they go out, people prefer to take the bus, drive or call a taxi.
对高科技产品过度依赖，与大自然的直接接触越来越少，
Duì gāokējì chǎnpǐn guòdù yīlài, yǔ dàzìrán de zhíjiē jiēchù yuèláiyuè shǎo,
We depend too much on high-tech products and have less and less direct contact with nature,
适应自然环境的能力也越来越差。
shìyìng zìrán huánjìng de nénglì yě yuèláiyuè chà.
so our ability to adapt to the natural environment is getting worse.
再比如，过去没有超市，我们去菜市场买菜，吃的东西都是新鲜的。
Zài bǐrú, guòqu méiyǒu chāoshì, wǒmen qù càishìchǎng mǎi cài, chī de dōngxi dōu shì xīnxiān de.
Another example: in the past there were no supermarkets. We bought food at the market, and everything we ate was fresh.
现在有了各种超市，越来越多的人更喜欢去超市买速冻食品，
Xiànzài yǒu le gè zhǒng chāoshì, yuèláiyuè duō de rén gèng xǐhuan qù chāoshì mǎi sùdòng shípǐn,
Now there are all kinds of supermarkets, and more and more people prefer buying frozen food there.
吃饭的时候用微波炉一热，又快又方便。
chī fàn de shíhou yòng wēibōlú yí rè, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
At mealtimes they just heat it in the microwave: quick and easy.
有的人天天去吃快餐，连饭也不做了。
Yǒu de rén tiāntiān qù chī kuàicān, lián fàn yě bú zuò le.
Some people eat fast food every day and don't even cook any more.
还有，以前我们住平房，人们没有什么电脑、手机，
Hái yǒu, yǐqián wǒmen zhù píngfáng, rénmen méiyǒu shénme diànnǎo, shǒujī,
Also, we used to live in single-storey houses, and people didn't have computers or mobile phones,
但是下班放学后，邻居们之间常常来往。
dànshì xià bān fàngxué hòu, línjū men zhījiān chángcháng láiwǎng.
but after work and school, neighbours often visited each other.
记得小时候常常能看见叔叔阿姨们在院子里喝茶聊天，孩子们在一起玩儿。
Jìde xiǎoshíhou chángcháng néng kànjiàn shūshu āyí men zài yuànzi li hēchá liáotiān, háizi men zài yìqǐ wánr.
I remember as a child often seeing the uncles and aunties drinking tea and chatting in the courtyard, while the children played together.
现在呢，大家都住进了楼房，邻居之间很少来往。
Xiànzài ne, dàjiā dōu zhù jìn le lóufáng, línjū zhījiān hěn shǎo láiwǎng.
Now everyone has moved into apartment blocks, and neighbours rarely see each other.
我们回到家，除了看电视，就是上网或者玩手机。
Wǒmen huídào jiā, chúle kàn diànshì, jiùshì shàngwǎng huòzhě wán shǒujī.
When we get home, all we do is watch TV, go online or play on our phones.
人们不仅变得越来越闭塞，而且孩子们也很少进行户外活动了。
Rénmen bùjǐn biàn de yuèláiyuè bìsè, érqiě háizi men yě hěn shǎo jìnxíng hùwài huódòng le.
Not only are people becoming more and more cut off, but children rarely do outdoor activities any more.

Tāmen jīngcháng huì shīmián, jiànwàng, bìngqiě zǒngshì gǎnjué dào píláo, tóu yūn, dǐkàng jíbìng nénglì xiàjiàng děngděng.

苹果、香蕉、橘子等等。

这让他处于很紧张的状态。
Zhè ràng tā chǔyú hěn jǐnzhāng de zhuàngtài.

同时也改变了我们以前很多好的生活习惯。

吃饭的时候用微波炉一热，又快又方便。

At mealtimes they just heat it in the microwave: quick and easy.
用水一洗就干净了。
Yòng shuǐ yì xǐ jiù gānjìng le.

连……也不……

有的人天天去吃快餐，连饭也不做了。

人们不仅变得越来越闭塞，而且孩子们也很少进行户外活动了。

076.title: "Computer neck"
076.sub: Six true-or-false statements, then two office workers compare aches
076.transcriptNote: First six statements to judge, then the story. 王 is Xiao Wang and 李 is Xiao Li, colleagues at an insurance company. 电脑脖 ("computer neck") is a made-up name for neck trouble from too much screen time. Turn on Answers for the true-or-false key.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音并判断句子的正误。请先听六个句子。
Tīng lùyīn bìng pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù. Qǐng xiān tīng liù ge jùzi.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false. First listen to six sentences.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 六个句子 · True or false

q: 小王很喜欢周末出去玩。
Xiǎo Wáng hěn xǐhuan zhōumò chūqu wán.
Xiao Wang loves going out at the weekend.
qs.why: He works fast so he won't have to do overtime at the weekend and can go out.

q: 电脑脖和长时间看电脑有关。
Diànnǎo bó hé cháng shíjiān kàn diànnǎo yǒuguān.
"Computer neck" is linked to looking at a computer for a long time.
qs.why: The doctor says it comes from spending too long at the computer.

q: 小李和父母住在一起，对父母十分依赖。
Xiǎo Lǐ hé fùmǔ zhù zài yìqǐ, duì fùmǔ shífēn yīlài.
Xiao Li lives with his parents and depends on them a lot.
qs.why: He hasn't been to see his mother for two months.

q: 小王和小李抱怨自己工作很多，经常加班。
Xiǎo Wáng hé Xiǎo Lǐ bàoyuàn zìjǐ gōngzuò hěn duō, jīngcháng jiā bān.
Xiao Wang and Xiao Li complain that they have a lot of work and often do overtime.
qs.why: Their department is the only one doing overtime all the time.

q: 经理拼命工作，而且不注意养生，累得弯腰都觉得费劲儿了。
Jīnglǐ pīnmìng gōngzuò, érqiě bú zhùyì yǎngshēng, lèi de wānyāo dōu juéde fèijìnr le.
The manager works like mad, ignores his health, and is so worn out that even bending over is hard.
qs.why: We only hear that the manager has all sorts of ailments; nothing about bending over.

q: 小李和小王很少做运动。
Xiǎo Lǐ hé Xiǎo Wáng hěn shǎo zuò yùndòng.
Xiao Li and Xiao Wang rarely exercise.
qs.why: Both decide at the end that they need to start exercising.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 下面请听文章。
Xiàmiàn qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
电脑脖
Diànnǎo bó
Computer neck
为了拼命挣钱，人们给自己的压力越来越大，
Wèile pīnmìng zhèng qián, rénmen gěi zìjǐ de yālì yuèláiyuè dà,
To earn as much as they can, people put themselves under more and more pressure.
加班熬夜的情况非常普遍，很多人都是夜猫子，结果影响了健康。
jiā bān áoyè de qíngkuàng fēicháng pǔbiàn, hěn duō rén dōu shì yèmāozi, jiéguǒ yǐngxiǎng le jiànkāng.
Working overtime and staying up late is very common; lots of people are night owls, and their health suffers.
小王和小李在一家保险公司工作。
Xiǎo Wáng hé Xiǎo Lǐ zài yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī gōngzuò.
Xiao Wang and Xiao Li work at an insurance company.
一天，小王在电脑前工作，突然觉得脖子不舒服。
Yì tiān, Xiǎo Wáng zài diànnǎo qián gōngzuò, tūrán juéde bózi bù shūfu.
One day, Xiao Wang was working at the computer when his neck suddenly felt bad.
哎哟！
Āiyō!
Ouch!
王
对面的小李看见了，赶快走了过来。
Duìmiàn de Xiǎo Lǐ kànjiàn le, gǎnkuài zǒu le guòlái.
Xiao Li, sitting opposite, saw and hurried over.
小王，怎么了？
Xiǎo Wáng, zěnme le?
Xiao Wang, what's wrong?
李
小王摸着脖子，皱着眉头说：
Xiǎo Wáng mō zhe bózi, zhòu zhe méitóu shuō:
Rubbing his neck and frowning, Xiao Wang said:
脖子动不了了，疼死我了。小李，快扶我一把。
Bózi dòng bu liǎo le, téng sǐ wǒ le. Xiǎo Lǐ, kuài fú wǒ yì bǎ.
I can't move my neck. It's killing me. Xiao Li, quick, give me a hand.
王
哟，慢点儿慢点儿，先靠这儿坐一会儿。
Yō, màn diǎnr màn diǎnr, xiān kào zhèr zuò yíhuìr.
Whoa, slowly, slowly. Lean back here and sit for a bit.
李
小李扶着小王慢慢地靠在椅子上。
Xiǎo Lǐ fú zhe Xiǎo Wáng mànmàn de kào zài yǐzi shàng.
Xiao Li helped Xiao Wang ease back in his chair.
小王休息了几分钟，感觉脖子不那么疼了。
Xiǎo Wáng xiūxi le jǐ fēnzhōng, gǎnjué bózi bú nàme téng le.
After resting for a few minutes, Xiao Wang's neck didn't hurt so much.
我好点了，其实没什么大事儿。这个月都三回了，每次都是这个地方，过一天就好了。
Wǒ hǎo diǎn le, qíshí méi shénme dà shìr. Zhège yuè dōu sān huí le, měicì dōu shì zhège dìfang, guò yì tiān jiù hǎo le.
I'm a bit better. It's nothing serious really. It's happened three times this month, always in the same place. It's fine after a day.
王
都三回了？我看你还是去医院检查检查吧，可别不在乎这个。
Dōu sān huí le? Wǒ kàn nǐ háishi qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá jiǎnchá ba, kě bié bú zàihu zhège.
Three times already? I think you should go to the hospital and get it checked. Don't brush it off.
李
检查了，中医、西医都看了。大夫说是电脑脖，看电脑时间太长了。
Jiǎnchá le, zhōngyī, xīyī dōu kàn le. Dàifu shuō shì diànnǎo bó, kàn diànnǎo shíjiān tài cháng le.
I have. I've seen both a Chinese and a Western doctor. The doctor said it's "computer neck": too much time at the computer.
王
小李从来没听说过电脑脖这种病，觉得很新鲜。
Xiǎo Lǐ cónglái méi tīngshuō guo diànnǎo bó zhè zhǒng bìng, juéde hěn xīnxiān.
Xiao Li had never heard of an illness called "computer neck" and found it a novelty.
是吗？电脑脖？还有这病？以前从没听说过。
Shì ma? Diànnǎo bó? Hái yǒu zhè bìng? Yǐqián cóng méi tīngshuō guo.
Really? Computer neck? There's such an illness? I've never heard of it.
李
你不知道，现在的怪病太多了。我去医院那天，什么样的病人都有，都是年轻人。
Nǐ bù zhīdao, xiànzài de guài bìng tài duō le. Wǒ qù yīyuàn nà tiān, shénmeyàng de bìngrén dōu yǒu, dōu shì niánqīngrén.
You've no idea. There are so many strange illnesses now. The day I went to the hospital there were all kinds of patients, all young.
王
是吗？真可怕。那你这病有什么有效的药方吗？
Shì ma? Zhēn kěpà. Nà nǐ zhè bìng yǒu shénme yǒuxiào de yàofāng ma?
Really? That's scary. So is there an effective cure for yours?
李
医生说了，休息最重要，少看电脑，否则什么药都没有用。
Yīshēng shuō le, xiūxi zuì zhòngyào, shǎo kàn diànnǎo, fǒuzé shénme yào dōu méiyǒu yòng.
The doctor said rest is most important, and less computer, or no medicine will help.
王
那你还这么拼命干？
Nà nǐ hái zhème pīnmìng gàn?
Then why are you still working like mad?
李
小王轻轻地抬了一下头，又按了按脖子，接着说道：
Xiǎo Wáng qīngqīng de tái le yí xià tóu, yòu àn le àn bózi, jiēzhe shuōdào:
Xiao Wang gently raised his head, pressed his neck, and went on:
哎，反正都是我的活儿，不快点干完，周末还得加班。我不是想周末出去玩玩嘛。
Āi, fǎnzhèng dōu shì wǒ de huór, bú kuài diǎn gàn wán, zhōumò hái děi jiā bān. Wǒ bú shì xiǎng zhōumò chūqu wánwan ma.
Well, it's all my work anyway. If I don't finish it fast, I'll have to do overtime at the weekend. And I want to go out at the weekend.
王
小李听了这话，觉得和小王很有共同语言，他也抱怨起来：
Xiǎo Lǐ tīng le zhè huà, juéde hé Xiǎo Wáng hěn yǒu gòngtóng yǔyán, tā yě bàoyuàn qǐlái:
Hearing this, Xiao Li felt they had a lot in common, and he started complaining too:
经理对我们要求太高了，全公司就咱们整天加班，我都两个月没去看我妈了。
Jīnglǐ duì wǒmen yāoqiú tài gāo le, quán gōngsī jiù zánmen zhěngtiān jiā bān, wǒ dōu liǎng ge yuè méi qù kàn wǒ mā le.
The manager expects too much of us. We're the only ones in the whole company doing overtime all the time. I haven't been to see my mum for two months.
李
听说经理也得了一身病。我打算从下个月开始，每个周末去公园跑步。
Tīngshuō jīnglǐ yě dé le yì shēn bìng. Wǒ dǎsuan cóng xià ge yuè kāishǐ, měi ge zhōumò qù gōngyuán pǎo bù.
I hear the manager's got all sorts of ailments too. I'm planning to go running in the park every weekend from next month.
李
小王慢慢地动了几下脖子，说：
Xiǎo Wáng mànmàn de dòng le jǐ xià bózi, shuō:
Xiao Wang slowly moved his neck a few times and said:
看来我也得锻炼锻炼身体了。
Kànlái wǒ yě děi duànliàn duànliàn shēntǐ le.
Looks like I need to get some exercise too.
王

grammar: in order to …
Gives a purpose.
为了拼命挣钱，人们给自己的压力越来越大，
Wèile pīnmìng zhèng qián, rénmen gěi zìjǐ de yālì yuèláiyuè dà,
To earn as much as they can, people put themselves under more and more pressure.
为了学好汉语，他每天练习。
Wèile xué hǎo Hànyǔ, tā měitiān liànxí.
To learn Chinese well, he practises every day.
V + 着 + O + V
while doing …
着 describes the manner of the second action.
小王摸着脖子，皱着眉头说：
Xiǎo Wáng mō zhe bózi, zhòu zhe méitóu shuō:
Rubbing his neck and frowning, Xiao Wang said:
他笑着说。
Tā xiào zhe shuō.
He said with a smile.
疼死我了
it's killing me
死 shows an extreme degree.
脖子动不了了，疼死我了。小李，快扶我一把。
Bózi dòng bu liǎo le, téng sǐ wǒ le. Xiǎo Lǐ, kuài fú wǒ yì bǎ.
I can't move my neck. It's killing me. Xiao Li, quick, give me a hand.
累死我了。
Lèi sǐ wǒ le.
I'm dead tired.
都……了
already …
都 stresses that it's a lot.
我好点了，其实没什么大事儿。这个月都三回了，每次都是这个地方，过一天就好了。
Wǒ hǎo diǎn le, qíshí méi shénme dà shìr. Zhège yuè dōu sān huí le, měicì dōu shì zhège dìfang, guò yì tiān jiù hǎo le.
I'm a bit better. It's nothing serious really. It's happened three times this month, always in the same place. It's fine after a day.
都十二点了，快睡吧。
Dōu shí èr diǎn le, kuài shuì ba.
It's already midnight, go to sleep.
可别……
whatever you do, don't …
可 strengthens a warning.
都三回了？我看你还是去医院检查检查吧，可别不在乎这个。
Dōu sān huí le? Wǒ kàn nǐ háishi qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá jiǎnchá ba, kě bié bú zàihu zhège.
Three times already? I think you should go to the hospital and get it checked. Don't brush it off.
你可别忘了。
Nǐ kě bié wàng le.
Don't you forget.
什么……都……
no … at all
Question word + 都 means "every / none".
医生说了，休息最重要，少看电脑，否则什么药都没有用。
Yīshēng shuō le, xiūxi zuì zhòngyào, shǎo kàn diànnǎo, fǒuzé shénme yào dōu méiyǒu yòng.
The doctor said rest is most important, and less computer, or no medicine will help.
他什么都不想吃。
Tā shénme dōu bù xiǎng chī.
He doesn't want to eat anything.
after all, you see
嘛 makes a reason sound obvious.
哎，反正都是我的活儿，不快点干完，周末还得加班。我不是想周末出去玩玩嘛。
Āi, fǎnzhèng dōu shì wǒ de huór, bú kuài diǎn gàn wán, zhōumò hái děi jiā bān. Wǒ bú shì xiǎng zhōumò chūqu wánwan ma.
Well, it's all my work anyway. If I don't finish it fast, I'll have to do overtime at the weekend. And I want to go out at the weekend.
他是孩子嘛。
Tā shì háizi ma.
He's a child, after all.
看来……
it seems …
Draws a conclusion.
看来我也得锻炼锻炼身体了。
Kànlái wǒ yě děi duànliàn duànliàn shēntǐ le.
Looks like I need to get some exercise too.
看来要下雨了。
Kànlái yào xià yǔ le.
Looks like rain.

那你这病有什么有效的

077.title: Interview with a night owl
077.sub: A mother explains why she stays up late
077.transcriptNote: An interview about night owls. 记 is the reporter and 王 is Ms Wang. This is natural speech: false starts and fillers such as 呃 and 嗯 are left out of the transcript. The answer is my own summary.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the question.
下面是一段关于夜猫子话题的采访，请你介绍王女士的情况。
Xiàmiàn shì yí duàn guānyú yèmāozi huàtí de cǎifǎng, qǐng nǐ jièshào Wáng nǚshì de qíngkuàng.
Here is an interview on the subject of night owls. Describe Ms Wang's situation.

q: 请你介绍王女士的情况。
Qǐng nǐ jièshào Wáng nǚshì de qíngkuàng.
ans: 王女士是个夜猫子。她有孩子，每天为孩子忙到很晚，孩子九点钟才睡觉，九点以后的时间才是她自己的，所以她不想早睡。生孩子以前她不是夜猫子，一般十点钟就睡了。

Wáng nǚshì shì ge yèmāozi. Tā yǒu háizi, měitiān wèi háizi máng dào hěn wǎn, háizi jiǔ diǎnzhōng cái shuì jiào, jiǔ diǎn yǐhòu de shíjiān cái shì tā zìjǐ de, suǒyǐ tā bù xiǎng zǎo shuì. Shēng háizi yǐqián tā bú shì yèmāozi, yìbān shí diǎnzhōng jiù shuì le.

Ms Wang is a night owl. She has children and is busy with them till late; they don't go to bed until nine, and only after that does she get time to herself, so she doesn't want to go to bed early. Before she had children she wasn't a night owl and usually went to bed at ten.

blocks.label: 采访
lines: 还有，再问一下，你知道什么叫夜猫子吗？
Hái yǒu, zài wèn yíxià, nǐ zhīdao shénme jiào yèmāozi ma?
One more question: do you know what a "night owl" is?
记
什么意思？
Shénme yìsi?
What does it mean?
王
夜猫子就是那种喜欢熬夜，然后很晚不睡觉的人。你是夜猫子吗？
Yèmāozi jiùshì nà zhǒng xǐhuan áoyè, ránhòu hěn wǎn bú shuì jiào de rén. Nǐ shì yèmāozi ma?
A night owl is someone who likes staying up and doesn't go to bed until very late. Are you a night owl?
记
我就是这样的人。
Wǒ jiùshì zhèyàng de rén.
That's exactly me.
王
那好，我很想了解一下，你为什么做夜猫子呢？为什么不早点儿睡觉呢？
Nà hǎo, wǒ hěn xiǎng liǎojiě yíxià, nǐ wèishénme zuò yèmāozi ne? Wèishénme bù zǎo diǎnr shuì jiào ne?
Right, I'd really like to know why you're a night owl. Why don't you go to bed earlier?
记
啊，首先呢，很多事情，比如说你看我有孩子，对吧？
A, shǒuxiān ne, hěn duō shìqing, bǐrú shuō nǐ kàn wǒ yǒu háizi, duì ba?
Well, first of all, lots of things. For example, I have children, right?
王
那我每天为孩子工作得很晚，他们九点钟才睡觉。
Nà wǒ měitiān wèi háizi gōngzuò de hěn wǎn, tāmen jiǔ diǎnzhōng cái shuì jiào.
So every day I'm busy with the children till late. They don't go to bed until nine.
王
然后九点钟以后，他们睡了觉以后，那个时间就是我的。
Ránhòu jiǔ diǎnzhōng yǐhòu, tāmen shuì le jiào yǐhòu, nàge shíjiān jiùshì wǒ de.
Then after nine, once they're asleep, that time is mine.
王
你说我要是那个时候就睡觉了，是不是很浪费？
Nǐ shuō wǒ yàoshì nàge shíhou jiù shuì jiào le, shì bu shì hěn làngfèi?
If I went to bed then, wouldn't that be a waste?
王
那好吧。在你生孩子之前，你是不是夜猫子呢？
Nà hǎo ba. Zài nǐ shēng háizi zhīqián, nǐ shì bu shì yèmāozi ne?
OK. Before you had children, were you a night owl?
记
我那个时候真不是。我很早就睡了，一般十点钟。
Wǒ nàge shíhou zhēn bú shì. Wǒ hěn zǎo jiù shuì le, yìbān shí diǎnzhōng.
Back then I really wasn't. I went to bed very early, usually at ten.
王
结果是因为孩子的？
Jiéguǒ shì yīnwèi háizi de?
So it's because of the children?
记
嗯，对对，因为他们把我那个时间拖到那么晚了。
ǹg, duì duì, yīnwèi tāmen bǎ wǒ nàge shíjiān tuō dào nàme wǎn le.
Mm, yes, yes. They've pushed my time back that late.
王

grammar: 什么叫……
what is meant by …
Asks for a definition.
还有，再问一下，你知道什么叫夜猫子吗？
Hái yǒu, zài wèn yíxià, nǐ zhīdao shénme jiào yèmāozi ma?
One more question: do you know what a "night owl" is?
什么叫亚健康？
Shénme jiào yàjiànkāng?
What is "sub-health"?
……就是那种……的人
… is the kind of person who …
Gives a definition.
夜猫子就是那种喜欢熬夜，然后很晚不睡觉的人。你是夜猫子吗？
Yèmāozi jiùshì nà zhǒng xǐhuan áoyè, ránhòu hěn wǎn bú shuì jiào de rén. Nǐ shì yèmāozi ma?
A night owl is someone who likes staying up and doesn't go to bed until very late. Are you a night owl?
守财奴就是那种舍不得花钱的人。
Shǒucáinú jiùshì nà zhǒng shěbude huā qián de rén.
A miser is someone who can't bear to spend money.
not until …
才 shows something happens late.
那我每天为孩子工作得很晚，他们九点钟才睡觉。
Nà wǒ měitiān wèi háizi gōngzuò de hěn wǎn, tāmen jiǔ diǎnzhōng cái shuì jiào.
So every day I'm busy with the children till late. They don't go to bed until nine.
他十二点才回家。
Tā shí èr diǎn cái huí jiā.
He didn't get home until twelve.
要是……就……，是不是……
if …, wouldn't it be …
A rhetorical question in a condition.
你说我要是那个时候就睡觉了，是不是很浪费？
Nǐ shuō wǒ yàoshì nàge shíhou jiù shuì jiào le, shì bu shì hěn làngfèi?
If I went to bed then, wouldn't that be a waste?
要是现在就走，是不是太早了？
Yàoshì xiànzài jiù zǒu, shì bu shì tài zǎo le?
Wouldn't it be too early to leave now?
把……拖到……
to push … back to …
把 + O + V + 到 gives the result.
嗯，对对，因为他们把我那个时间拖到那么晚了。
ǹg, duì duì, yīnwèi tāmen bǎ wǒ nàge shíjiān tuō dào nàme wǎn le.
Mm, yes, yes. They've pushed my time back that late.
他把会议拖到了下午。
Tā bǎ huìyì tuō dào le xiàwǔ.
He pushed the meeting back to the afternoon.
gaps: 你说我要是那个时候就睡觉了，是不是很
因为他们把我那个时间

roles.王: 王 = Ms Wang, a mother who stays up late

078.title: How we got our modern ailments
078.sub: Four people describe the habit they can't live without
078.transcriptNote: Four young people with "modern lifestyle illnesses" describe their situation. Note down why each one got ill, then turn on Answers. You'll hear some new words, but they don't stop you understanding the main idea.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
几个得了现代生活病的年轻人在介绍自己的情况，请记下他们得病的原因。
Jǐ ge dé le xiàndài shēnghuó bìng de niánqīngrén zài jièshào zìjǐ de qíngkuàng, qǐng jì xià tāmen débìng de yuányīn.
Several young people with modern lifestyle illnesses describe their situation. Note down the cause of each one's illness.
你将会听到一些生词，但是它们不影响对主要意思的理解。
Nǐ jiāng huì tīngdào yìxiē shēngcí, dànshì tāmen bù yǐngxiǎng duì zhǔyào yìsi de lǐjiě.
You'll hear some new words, but they won't stop you understanding the main idea.

blocks.label: 阿健
lines: 阿健，男，三十五岁。
Ā Jiàn, nán, sānshí wǔ suì.
A Jian, male, 35.
我们每个人都有点现代病吧，比如网络。
Wǒmen měi ge rén dōu yǒudiǎn xiàndài bìng ba, bǐrú wǎngluò.
We all have a bit of a modern ailment, I suppose. Take the internet.
两千年，我开始进网吧，那个时候经常和宿舍的同学一起泡吧打游戏，
Liǎng qiān nián, wǒ kāishǐ jìn wǎngba, nàge shíhou jīngcháng hé sùshè de tóngxué yìqǐ pào bā dǎ yóuxì,
In 2000 I started going to internet cafés. Back then I'd often hang out there with my roommates playing games.
现在算来也有二十年的网龄了。
xiànzài suàn lái yě yǒu èr shí nián de wǎnglíng le.
Counting it up, I've been online for twenty years now.
现在家里安装了网络，有事没事，都把电脑打开，看看信什么的。
Xiànzài jiā li ānzhuāng le wǎngluò, yǒu shì méi shì, dōu bǎ diànnǎo dǎkāi, kànkan xìn shénme de.
Now we have the internet at home, and whether I've got anything to do or not, I turn the computer on and check my email or whatever.
如果网络断了，总觉得家里缺少点什么，就是不舒服。
Rúguǒ wǎngluò duàn le, zǒng juéde jiā li quēshǎo diǎn shénme, jiùshì bù shūfu.
If the internet goes down, I feel there's something missing at home. I just feel uncomfortable.

q: 阿健得病的原因是什么？
Ā Jiàn débìng de yuányīn shì shénme?
What's the cause of A Jian's illness?
ans: 离不开网络：二十年网龄，有事没事都开电脑，网络断了就不舒服。
Lí bu kāi wǎngluò: èr shí nián wǎnglíng, yǒu shì méi shì dōu kāi diànnǎo, wǎngluò duàn le jiù bù shūfu.
He can't live without the internet: twenty years online, always turning on the computer, uncomfortable when the connection drops.

blocks.label: 小溪
lines: 小溪，女，二十八岁。
Xiǎo Xī, nǚ, èrshí bā suì.
Xiao Xi, female, 28.
手机我二十四小时离不了。
Shǒujī wǒ èr shí sì xiǎoshí lí bu liǎo.
I can't be without my phone 24 hours a day.
其实平时带在身上，不一定有人打电话过来，大多数电话都不怎么重要。
Qíshí píngshí dài zài shēnshàng, bù yídìng yǒu rén dǎ diànhuà guòlái, dàduōshù diànhuà dōu bù zěnme zhòngyào.
Actually, when I carry it, people don't necessarily call, and most calls aren't that important.
但早上上班如果没有带着，心里就发慌。
Dàn zǎoshang shàng bān rúguǒ méiyǒu dài zhe, xīn li jiù fāhuāng.
But if I go to work in the morning without it, I panic.
睡觉的时候也把它搁在枕头旁边，否则就睡不着。
Shuì jiào de shíhou yě bǎ tā gē zài zhěntou pángbiān, fǒuzé jiù shuì bu zháo.
When I sleep I put it next to my pillow, otherwise I can't get to sleep.
还有，我总怕手机没电或者忘带手机，那样的话，一天都过不好。
Hái yǒu, wǒ zǒng pà shǒujī méi diàn huòzhě wàng dài shǒujī, nàyàng dehuà, yì tiān dōu guò bu hǎo.
And I'm always afraid the battery will die or I'll forget it. If that happens, my whole day is ruined.

q: 小溪得病的原因是什么？
Xiǎo Xī débìng de yuányīn shì shénme?
What's the cause of Xiao Xi's illness?
ans: 过度依赖手机：二十四小时离不了，没带就发慌，没手机睡不着。
Guòdù yīlài shǒujī: èr shí sì xiǎoshí lí bu liǎo, méi dài jiù fāhuāng, méi shǒujī shuì bu zháo.
She depends too much on her phone: can't be without it, panics if she forgets it, can't sleep without it.

blocks.label: 大张
lines: 大张，男，四十岁。
Dà Zhāng, nán, sì shí suì.
Da Zhang, male, 40.
我吧，下班回到家，一开始做饭就得开电视机，要不然就会觉得没有那个气氛，不像家。
Wǒ ba, xià bān huídào jiā, yì kāishǐ zuò fàn jiù děi kāi diànshìjī, yào bùrán jiù huì juéde méiyǒu nàge qìfēn, bú xiàng jiā.
Me, when I get home from work, the moment I start cooking I have to turn on the TV, or it doesn't feel right. It doesn't feel like home.
吃完饭后还得看看体育节目或新闻什么的，
Chīwán fàn hòu hái děi kànkan tǐyù jiémù huò xīnwén shénme de,
After dinner I have to watch some sport or the news or whatever.
不经过这道程序，好像躺在床上就睡不着觉。
bù jīngguò zhè dào chéngxù, hǎoxiàng tǎng zài chuáng shàng jiù shuì bu zháo jiào.
If I don't go through that routine, I can't seem to sleep when I lie down.
放假的时候，除了睡觉，就是看电视；除了看电视，就是睡觉，好像生活就这两件事儿。
Fàng jià de shíhou, chúle shuì jiào, jiùshì kàn diànshì; chúle kàn diànshì, jiùshì shuì jiào, hǎoxiàng shēnghuó jiù zhè liǎng jiàn shìr.
On holiday, if I'm not sleeping I'm watching TV, and if I'm not watching TV I'm sleeping. It's as if life were just those two things.

q: 大张得病的原因是什么？
Dà Zhāng débìng de yuányīn shì shénme?
What's the cause of Da Zhang's illness?
ans: 离不开电视：回家就开电视，不看电视睡不着，放假只睡觉和看电视。
Lí bu kāi diànshì: huí jiā jiù kāi diànshì, bú kàn diànshì shuì bu zháo, fàng jià zhǐ shuì jiào hé kàn diànshì.
He can't live without TV: it goes on as soon as he's home, he can't sleep without it, and on holiday he only sleeps and watches TV.

blocks.label: 吴梦
lines: 吴梦，女，三十四岁。
Wú Mèng, nǚ, sānshí sì suì.
Wu Meng, female, 34.
我们大都跨入有车一族的行列了，生活的节奏越来越快，
Wǒmen dàdōu kuà rù yǒu chē yì zú de hángliè le, shēnghuó de jiézòu yuèláiyuè kuài,
Most of us have joined the ranks of car owners. The pace of life is getting faster and faster,
汽车也是我们必备的交通工具，而且越来越离不开。
qìchē yě shì wǒmen bìbèi de jiāotōng gōngjù, érqiě yuèláiyuè lí bu kāi.
a car is an essential means of transport for us, and we depend on it more and more.
本来呢开车是为了省时间，可是现在车多了，总堵车，
Běnlái ne kāichē shì wèile shěng shíjiān, kěshì xiànzài chē duō le, zǒng dǔchē,
Driving was meant to save time, but now there are so many cars there are always jams,
结果早上出门开车的比骑自行车的还慢。
jiéguǒ zǎoshang chūmén kāichē de bǐ qí zìxíngchē de hái màn.
so in the morning, people driving are even slower than people cycling.
还有，我们平时越来越懒，也没时间做运动，
Hái yǒu, wǒmen píngshí yuèláiyuè lǎn, yě méi shíjiān zuò yùndòng,
And we're getting lazier and lazier, with no time for exercise.
做一次运动还是开车去开车回来。
zuò yí cì yùndòng háishi kāichē qù kāichē huílai.
When we do exercise, we drive there and drive back.

q: 吴梦得病的原因是什么？
Wú Mèng débìng de yuányīn shì shénme?
What's the cause of Wu Meng's illness?
ans: 离不开汽车：到哪儿都开车，越来越懒，缺少运动。
Lí bu kāi qìchē: dào nǎr dōu kāichē, yuèláiyuè lǎn, quēshǎo yùndòng.
She can't live without the car: she drives everywhere, gets lazier and lacks exercise.

vocab: to hang out in bars/internet cafés
grammar: 现在算来
counting it up now
算来 = reckoning it.
现在算来也有二十年的网龄了。
xiànzài suàn lái yě yǒu èr shí nián de wǎnglíng le.
Counting it up, I've been online for twenty years now.
算来我们认识十年了。
Suàn lái wǒmen rènshi shí nián le.
We've known each other ten years, come to think of it.
有事没事
whether or not there's a reason
A fixed phrase meaning "all the time".
现在家里安装了网络，有事没事，都把电脑打开，看看信什么的。
Xiànzài jiā li ānzhuāng le wǎngluò, yǒu shì méi shì, dōu bǎ diànnǎo dǎkāi, kànkan xìn shénme de.
Now we have the internet at home, and whether I've got anything to do or not, I turn the computer on and check my email or whatever.
他有事没事就给我打电话。
Tā yǒu shì méi shì jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
He calls me whether he needs to or not.
否则就……
otherwise …
Gives the result if not.
睡觉的时候也把它搁在枕头旁边，否则就睡不着。
Shuì jiào de shíhou yě bǎ tā gē zài zhěntou pángbiān, fǒuzé jiù shuì bu zháo.
When I sleep I put it next to my pillow, otherwise I can't get to sleep.
快走吧，否则就迟到了。
Kuài zǒu ba, fǒuzé jiù chídào le.
Hurry up, or we'll be late.
一……就得……
as soon as …, have to …
就 links the two actions.
我吧，下班回到家，一开始做饭就得开电视机，要不然就会觉得没有那个气氛，不像家。
Wǒ ba, xià bān huídào jiā, yì kāishǐ zuò fàn jiù děi kāi diànshìjī, yào bùrán jiù huì juéde méiyǒu nàge qìfēn, bú xiàng jiā.
Me, when I get home from work, the moment I start cooking I have to turn on the TV, or it doesn't feel right. It doesn't feel like home.
他一回家就得上网。
Tā yì huí jiā jiù de shàngwǎng.
As soon as he's home he has to go online.
除了……，就是……
if not …, then …
There's nothing else.
放假的时候，除了睡觉，就是看电视；除了看电视，就是睡觉，好像生活就这两件事儿。
Fàng jià de shíhou, chúle shuì jiào, jiùshì kàn diànshì; chúle kàn diànshì, jiùshì shuì jiào, hǎoxiàng shēnghuó jiù zhè liǎng jiàn shìr.
On holiday, if I'm not sleeping I'm watching TV, and if I'm not watching TV I'm sleeping. It's as if life were just those two things.
他除了工作，就是睡觉。
Tā chúle gōngzuò, jiùshì shuì jiào.
All he does is work and sleep.
比……还 + adj
even more … than …
还 adds surprise.
结果早上出门开车的比骑自行车的还慢。
jiéguǒ zǎoshang chūmén kāichē de bǐ qí zìxíngchē de hái màn.
so in the morning, people driving are even slower than people cycling.
弟弟比哥哥还高。
Dìdi bǐ gēge hái gāo.
The younger brother is even taller than the older one.
gaps: 了，总觉得家里缺少点什么
但早上上班如果没有带着，心里就
睡觉的时候也把它搁在
要不然就会觉得没有那个

079.title: Follow the instructions
079.transcriptNote: Listen to each instruction and do the movement. Item 7 isn't numbered aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听指令，做动作。
Tīng zhǐlìng, zuò dòngzuò.
Listen to the instructions and do the movements.
把电脑关上，站起来。
Bǎ diànnǎo guānshang, zhàn qǐlái.
Turn off the computer and stand up.
闭上眼睛，深深吸一口气，呼气，做五遍。
Bì shang yǎnjing, shēnshēn xī yì kǒuqì, hūqì, zuò wǔ biàn.
Close your eyes, breathe in deeply, breathe out. Do it five times.
轻轻按按脖子，按十下。
Qīngqīng àn'an bózi, àn shí xià.
Gently press your neck. Press ten times.
把头慢慢向左转一下，转回来，再向右转一下，回来，做三遍。
Bǎ tóu mànmàn xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn yíxià, zhuǎn huílai, zài xiàng yòu zhuǎn yíxià, huílai, zuò sān biàn.
Slowly turn your head to the left, turn back, then turn to the right and back. Do it three times.
睁开眼睛，深深吸一口气，呼气，做五遍。
Zhēngkāi yǎnjing, shēnshēn xī yì kǒuqì, hūqì, zuò wǔ biàn.
Open your eyes, breathe in deeply, breathe out. Do it five times.
把左胳膊抬高，慢慢放下，再把右胳膊抬高，慢慢放下，做三遍。
Bǎ zuǒ gēbo táigāo, mànmàn fàngxià, zài bǎ yòu gēbo táigāo, mànmàn fàngxià, zuò sān biàn.
Raise your left arm, slowly lower it, then raise your right arm and slowly lower it. Do it three times.
左腿抬起来，停三秒钟，保持不动，然后放下。
Zuǒ tuǐ tái qǐlái, tíng sān miǎozhōng, bǎochí bú dòng, ránhòu fàngxià.
Raise your left leg, hold for three seconds without moving, then lower it.
把右腿抬起来，停三秒钟，保持不动，然后放下。
Bǎ yòu tuǐ tái qǐlái, tíng sān miǎozhōng, bǎochí bú dòng, ránhòu fàngxià.
Raise your right leg, hold for three seconds without moving, then lower it.
两腿站直，慢慢向前弯腰，用双手尽量去摸自己的脚。
Liǎng tuǐ zhàn zhí, mànmàn xiàngqián wānyāo, yòng shuāngshǒu jǐnliàng qù mō zìjǐ de jiǎo.
Stand with your legs straight, slowly bend forward, and try to touch your feet with both hands.
蹲下，停五秒钟，起身。
Dūnxià, tíng wǔ miǎozhōng, qǐ shēn.
Squat down, hold for five seconds, and stand up.
现在如果你觉得自己感觉很好，请微笑吧。
Xiànzài rúguǒ nǐ juéde zìjǐ gǎnjué hěn hǎo, qǐng wēixiào ba.
Now, if you feel good, please smile.

grammar: 把 + O + V上 / V高
to … (something) closed / up
把 brings the object forward; the complement shows the result.
把电脑关上，站起来。
Bǎ diànnǎo guānshang, zhàn qǐlái.
Turn off the computer and stand up.
把门关上。
Bǎmén guānshang.
Close the door.
V + 一口气
to take a breath
一口 counts breaths and mouthfuls.
闭上眼睛，深深吸一口气，呼气，做五遍。
Bì shang yǎnjing, shēnshēn xī yì kǒuqì, hūqì, zuò wǔ biàn.
Close your eyes, breathe in deeply, breathe out. Do it five times.
他叹了一口气。
Tā tàn le yì kǒuqì.
He sighed.
做 + number + 遍
do it … times
遍 counts complete repetitions.
闭上眼睛，深深吸一口气，呼气，做五遍。
Bì shang yǎnjing, shēnshēn xī yì kǒuqì, hūqì, zuò wǔ biàn.
Close your eyes, breathe in deeply, breathe out. Do it five times.
请读三遍。
Qǐng dú sān biàn.
Read it three times.
向左 / 向右 / 向前 + V
to … left / right / forward
向 gives the direction.
把头慢慢向左转一下，转回来，再向右转一下，回来，做三遍。
Bǎ tóu mànmàn xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn yíxià, zhuǎn huílai, zài xiàng yòu zhuǎn yíxià, huílai, zuò sān biàn.
Slowly turn your head to the left, turn back, then turn to the right and back. Do it three times.
向前走。
Xiàngqián zǒu.
Walk forward.
尽量 + V
to … as much as possible
Do your best to.
两腿站直，慢慢向前弯腰，用双手尽量去摸自己的脚。
Liǎng tuǐ zhàn zhí, mànmàn xiàngqián wānyāo, yòng shuāngshǒu jǐnliàng qù mō zìjǐ de jiǎo.
Stand with your legs straight, slowly bend forward, and try to touch your feet with both hands.
请尽量早点来。
Qǐng jǐnliàng zǎo diǎn lái.
Please come as early as you can.
say: Turn off the computer and stand up.
Close your eyes, breathe in deeply, breathe out. Do it five times.
Now, if you feel good, please smile.

080.zh: 八个最不健康的生活习惯
080.title: Eight of the unhealthiest habits
080.sub: Do you have any of these habits?
080.transcriptNote: Someone has listed the eight unhealthiest habits. Listen and tick the ones you have. Item 8 isn't numbered aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，选择信息 · Listen and choose
lines: 听录音，选择信息。
Tīng lùyīn, xuǎnzé xìnxī.
Listen and choose the information.
有人提出了八个最不健康的生活习惯，你是不是也有这些习惯？
Yǒu rén tíchū le bā ge zuì bú jiànkāng de shēnghuó xíguàn, nǐ shì bu shì yě yǒu zhèxiē xíguàn?
Someone has proposed eight of the unhealthiest habits. Do you have any of them?
长时间使用手机，不看手机觉得非常难受。
Cháng shíjiān shǐyòng shǒujī, bú kàn shǒujī juéde fēicháng nánshòu.
Using your phone for long periods; feeling terrible if you don't look at it.
长时间使用电脑。
Cháng shíjiān shǐyòng diànnǎo.
Using a computer for long periods.
经常熬夜，缺少睡眠，白天感到很疲倦，很困，总想去睡觉。
Jīngcháng áoyè, quēshǎo shuìmián, báitiān gǎndào hěn píjuàn, hěn kùn, zǒng xiǎng qù shuì jiào.
Often staying up late and lacking sleep; feeling tired and sleepy during the day and always wanting to sleep.
运动太少，或者基本上不做户外运动。
Yùndòng tài shǎo, huòzhě jīběn shang bú zuò hùwài yùndòng.
Too little exercise, or basically no outdoor exercise.
不注意养生，有病不治。
Bú zhùyì yǎngshēng, yǒu bìng bú zhì.
Not looking after your health; not getting treatment when ill.
经常吃快餐，并且吃太多咸的食物或甜点。
Jīngcháng chī kuàicān, bìngqiě chī tài duō xián de shíwù huò tiándiǎn.
Often eating fast food and too much salty food or sweets.
生活没有规律，不饿就不吃饭，不困就不睡觉，不累就不休息。
Shēnghuó méiyǒu guīlǜ, bú è jiù bù chī fàn, bú kùn jiù bú shuì jiào, bú lèi jiù bù xiūxi.
An irregular life: not eating unless hungry, not sleeping unless sleepy, not resting unless tired.
与家人缺少交流。
Yǔ jiārén quēshǎo jiāoliú.
Too little communication with your family.

grammar: 不 + V + 就……
if not …, then …
Shows a condition.
长时间使用手机，不看手机觉得非常难受。
Cháng shíjiān shǐyòng shǒujī, bú kàn shǒujī juéde fēicháng nánshòu.
Using your phone for long periods; feeling terrible if you don't look at it.
不吃早饭就没精神。
Bù chī zǎofàn jiù méi jīngshén.
Without breakfast I have no energy.
不……就不……
won't … unless …
A double negative condition.
生活没有规律，不饿就不吃饭，不困就不睡觉，不累就不休息。
Shēnghuó méiyǒu guīlǜ, bú è jiù bù chī fàn, bú kùn jiù bú shuì jiào, bú lèi jiù bù xiūxi.
An irregular life: not eating unless hungry, not sleeping unless sleepy, not resting unless tired.
不下雨就不带伞。
Bú xià yǔ jiù bú dài sǎn.
I don't take an umbrella unless it's raining.
有病不治
to be ill and not get treatment
Two verbs side by side: "have an illness, not treat it".
不注意养生，有病不治。
Bú zhùyì yǎngshēng, yǒu bìng bú zhì.
Not looking after your health; not getting treatment when ill.
有问题不问。
Yǒu wèntí búwèn.
Having questions but not asking.
与……缺少……
to lack … with …
与 is a formal 和.
与家人缺少交流。
Yǔ jiārén quēshǎo jiāoliú.
Too little communication with your family.
他与同事缺少沟通。
Tā yǔ tóngshì quēshǎo gōutōng.
He doesn't communicate enough with colleagues.

081.title: Copy the tone of voice
081.sub: Ten short health lines to imitate
081.transcriptNote: Pre-speaking practice: listen to each line and copy the speaker's tone: nagging, worried, complaining, soothing. Several item numbers aren't read aloud. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 口语课前练习 · Pre-speaking practice
lines: 口语课前练习。
Kǒuyǔ kè qián liànxí.
Pre-speaking exercises.
听句子并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng jùzi bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the sentences and copy the speakers' tone.
你别总在家看电视了，出去走走，活动活动。
Nǐ bié zǒng zài jiā kàn diànshì le, chūqu zǒuzou, huódòng huódòng.
Stop watching TV at home all the time. Go out for a walk and move about a bit.
看把我爸累的，都喘不过气儿来了。快坐一会儿吧，喝点水。
Kàn bǎ wǒ bà lèi de, dōu chuǎn bu guò qìr lai le. Kuài zuò yíhuìr ba, hē diǎn shuǐ.
Look how worn out Dad is. He can hardly breathe. Sit down for a bit and have some water.
小心！都几点了，还不睡觉？快把电脑给我关了。
Xiǎoxīn! Dōu jǐ diǎn le, hái bú shuì jiào? Kuài bǎ diànnǎo gěi wǒ guān le.
Hey! Look at the time, and you're still not in bed? Turn that computer off right now.
我现在总是失眠、健忘，抵抗力低下。医生，您看看有什么药能治这些病吗？
Wǒ xiànzài zǒngshì shīmián, jiànwàng, dǐkànglì dīxià. Yīshēng, nín kànkan yǒu shénme yào néng zhì zhèxiē bìng ma?
I sleep badly all the time now, I'm forgetful and my resistance is low. Doctor, is there any medicine that can treat this?
现在的年轻人一点生活规律都没有，个个是夜猫子，根本不运动。
Xiànzài de niánqīngrén yìdiǎn shēnghuó guīlǜ dōu méiyǒu, gègè shì yèmāozi, gēnběn bú yùndòng.
Young people today have no routine at all. They're all night owls and never exercise.
姐，别做饭了，我买速冻饺子了，在微波炉里热热就能吃。
Jiě, bié zuò fàn le, wǒ mǎi sùdòng jiǎozi le, zài wēibōlú li rè rè jiù néng chī.
Sis, don't cook. I've bought frozen dumplings. Just heat them in the microwave and they're ready.
现在农村生活条件也好了，家家有彩电、冰箱，有的还安空调了呢。
Xiànzài nóngcūn shēnghuó tiáojiàn yě hǎo le, jiā jiā yǒu cǎidiàn, bīngxiāng, yǒu de hái ān kōngtiáo le ne.
Living conditions in the countryside are better now too. Every home has a colour TV and a fridge, and some have even put in air conditioning.
北京挺好，交通方便，大商店又多，就是房价太高了。
Běijīng tǐng hǎo, jiāotōng fāngbiàn, dà shāngdiàn yòu duō, jiùshì fángjià tài gāo le.
Beijing's great. Transport's convenient and there are lots of big shops. It's just that housing is too expensive.
脖子动不了了，疼死我了。
Bózi dòng bu liǎo le, téng sǐ wǒ le.
I can't move my neck. It's killing me.
王阿姨，您别客气了，咱们都是老邻居了，这点小事不算什么。
Wáng āyí, nín bié kèqì le, zánmen dōu shì lǎo línjū le, zhè diǎn xiǎoshì bú suàn shénme.
Auntie Wang, don't mention it. We're old neighbours. A little thing like this is nothing.

grammar: V + V (走走, 活动活动)
to do a bit of …
Reduplication softens a suggestion.
你别总在家看电视了，出去走走，活动活动。
Nǐ bié zǒng zài jiā kàn diànshì le, chūqu zǒuzou, huódòng huódòng.
Stop watching TV at home all the time. Go out for a walk and move about a bit.
你去休息休息吧。
Nǐ qù xiūxi xiūxi ba.
Go and have a rest.
看把……V的
look how … it's made …
An exclamation about a result.
看把我爸累的，都喘不过气儿来了。快坐一会儿吧，喝点水。
Kàn bǎ wǒ bà lèi de, dōu chuǎn bu guò qìr lai le. Kuài zuò yíhuìr ba, hē diǎn shuǐ.
Look how worn out Dad is. He can hardly breathe. Sit down for a bit and have some water.
看把你高兴的！
Kàn bǎ nǐ gāoxìng de!
Look how happy you are!
都几点了，还……
look at the time, and you're still …
都 stresses lateness; 还 shows surprise.
小心！都几点了，还不睡觉？快把电脑给我关了。
Xiǎoxīn! Dōu jǐ diǎn le, hái bú shuì jiào? Kuài bǎ diànnǎo gěi wǒ guān le.
Hey! Look at the time, and you're still not in bed? Turn that computer off right now.
都十点了，还不起床？
Dōu shí diǎn le, hái bù qǐ chuáng?
It's ten already and you're still in bed?
把……给我V了
V … right now (for me)
给我 adds a strong command.
小心！都几点了，还不睡觉？快把电脑给我关了。
Xiǎoxīn! Dōu jǐ diǎn le, hái bú shuì jiào? Kuài bǎ diànnǎo gěi wǒ guān le.
Hey! Look at the time, and you're still not in bed? Turn that computer off right now.
把手机给我放下！
Bǎ shǒujī gěi wǒ fàngxià!
Put that phone down!
一点……都没有
not … at all
Total negation.
现在的年轻人一点生活规律都没有，个个是夜猫子，根本不运动。
Xiànzài de niánqīngrén yìdiǎn shēnghuó guīlǜ dōu méiyǒu, gègè shì yèmāozi, gēnběn bú yùndòng.
Young people today have no routine at all. They're all night owls and never exercise.
他一点耐心都没有。
Tā yìdiǎn nàixīn dōu méiyǒu.
He has no patience at all.
就是……太……了
it's just that … is too …
Adds a single drawback.
北京挺好，交通方便，大商店又多，就是房价太高了。
Běijīng tǐng hǎo, jiāotōng fāngbiàn, dà shāngdiàn yòu duō, jiùshì fángjià tài gāo le.
Beijing's great. Transport's convenient and there are lots of big shops. It's just that housing is too expensive.
这件衣服很好，就是太贵了。
Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn hǎo, jiùshì tài guì le.
This garment is nice, it's just too expensive.
say: Stop watching TV at home all the time. Go out for a walk and move about a bit.
Hey! Look at the time, and you're still not in bed? Turn that computer off right now.
Auntie Wang, don't mention it. We're old neighbours. A little thing like this is nothing.

082.title: "I think I've caught a cold again"
082.sub: A son, a fussing mum and a dad who never gets ill
082.transcriptNote: Listen to the family conversation and copy the speakers' tone. 儿 is the son, 妈 the mother and 爸 the father. Who says which line is my reading from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听对话并模仿 · Listen and imitate
lines: 听对话并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng duìhuà bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone.

blocks.label: 对话
blocks.h: 又感冒了 · A cold again
lines: 嗯，我好像又感冒了。
ǹg, wǒ hǎoxiàng yòu gǎnmào le.
Mm, I think I've caught a cold again.
儿
又感冒了？你这小小年纪，体质太差了。你看你老爸我，从来不得病。
Yòu gǎnmào le? Nǐ zhè xiǎoxiǎo niánjì, tǐzhì tài chà le. Nǐ kàn nǐ lǎobà wǒ, cónglái bù débìng.
A cold again? So young and so weak. Look at your old dad: I never get ill.
爸
行了行了，还不快给儿子找药去。
Xíng le xíng le, hái bú kuài gěi érzi zhǎo yào qù.
All right, all right. Go and find some medicine for your son.
妈
嗯，我不吃饭了，我回房间了。
ǹg, wǒ bù chī fàn le, wǒ huí fángjiān le.
Mm, I won't have dinner. I'm going to my room.
儿
不吃饭怎么能行呢？本来就病了，再不吃饭就更不容易好了。
Bù chī fàn zěnme néng xíng ne? Běnlái jiù bìng le, zài bù chī fàn jiù gèng bù róngyì hǎo le.
How can you skip dinner? You're already ill. If you don't eat, it'll be even harder to get better.
妈
药来了，来，快吃吧。
Yào lái le, lái, kuài chī ba.
Here's the medicine. Come on, take it.
妈
我给你做点鸡汤，好好补补。肯定是这几天学习累的。
Wǒ gěi nǐ zuò diǎn jītāng, hǎohǎo bǔbu. Kěndìng shì zhè jǐ tiān xuéxí lèi de.
I'll make you some chicken soup to build you up. It must be all that studying these last few days.
妈
什么学习累的？就是成天在房间里不出门造成的。
Shénme xuéxí lèi de? Jiùshì chéngtiān zài fángjiān li bù chūmén zàochéng de.
What studying? It's from staying in his room all day and never going out.
爸
从明天早上开始，你和我出去做运动，保证你再也不感冒。
Cóng míngtiān zǎoshang kāishǐ, nǐ hé wǒ chūqu zuò yùndòng, bǎozhèng nǐ zài yě bù gǎnmào.
From tomorrow morning, you're coming out to exercise with me. I guarantee you'll never catch a cold again.
爸
这么早我起不来。
Zhème zǎo wǒ qǐ bu lái.
I can't get up that early.
儿
你晚上早点睡觉，不熬夜，我就不信你起不来。习惯了就好了。
Nǐ wǎnshang zǎo diǎn shuì jiào, bù áoyè, wǒ jiù bú xìn nǐ qǐ bu lái. Xíguàn le jiù hǎo le.
Go to bed early and don't stay up late, and I bet you'll be able to get up. You'll get used to it.
爸
还是等下个月再说吧。
Háishi děng xià ge yuè zàishuō ba.
Let's wait till next month.
儿

grammar: 你这小小年纪
at your young age
这 + age phrase is a scolding, emotional tone.
又感冒了？你这小小年纪，体质太差了。你看你老爸我，从来不得病。
Yòu gǎnmào le? Nǐ zhè xiǎoxiǎo niánjì, tǐzhì tài chà le. Nǐ kàn nǐ lǎobà wǒ, cónglái bù débìng.
A cold again? So young and so weak. Look at your old dad: I never get ill.
你这么小小年纪就会做饭了。
Nǐ zhème xiǎoxiǎo niánjì jiù huì zuò fàn le.
You can cook at such a young age!
……怎么能行呢？
how can that be all right?
A rhetorical objection.
不吃饭怎么能行呢？本来就病了，再不吃饭就更不容易好了。
Bù chī fàn zěnme néng xíng ne? Běnlái jiù bìng le, zài bù chī fàn jiù gèng bù róngyì hǎo le.
How can you skip dinner? You're already ill. If you don't eat, it'll be even harder to get better.
不睡觉怎么能行呢？
Bú shuì jiào zěnme néng xíng ne?
How can you not sleep?
再不……就更……
if you still don't …, it'll be even more …
再不 = if … any longer.

Bù chī fàn zěnme néng xíng ne? Běnlái jiù bìng le, zài bù chī fàn jiù gèng bù róngyì hǎo le.

再不走就更晚了。
Zài bù zǒu jiù gèng wǎn le.
If we don't go now it'll be even later.
是……V的 / ……累的

Gives the cause of a state.
我给你做点鸡汤，好好补补。肯定是这几天学习累的。
Wǒ gěi nǐ zuò diǎn jītāng, hǎohǎo bǔbu. Kěndìng shì zhè jǐ tiān xuéxí lèi de.
I'll make you some chicken soup to build you up. It must be all that studying these last few days.
这是熬夜熬的。

Confident challenge.
你晚上早点睡觉，不熬夜，我就不信你起不来。习惯了就好了。

Go to bed early and don't stay up late, and I bet you'll be able to get up. You'll get used to it.
我就不信我学不会。
Wǒ jiù bú xìn wǒ xué bú huì.
I don't believe I can't learn it.
……就好了
then it'll be fine
就 shows an easy result.

Nǐ wǎnshang zǎo diǎn shuì jiào, bù áoyè, wǒ jiù bú xìn nǐ qǐ bu lái. Xíguàn le jiù hǎo le.
Go to bed early and don't stay up late, and I bet you'll be able to get up. You'll get used to it.
睡一觉就好了。
Shuì yí jiào jiù hǎo le.
A good sleep and you'll be fine.
gaps: 就是成天在房间里不出门

roles.爸: 爸 = the dad who never gets ill
roles.儿: 儿 = the son with a cold

083.title: Modern illnesses, starting with dieting
083.sub: Lesson 5 reading: how changing lifestyles made us ill
083.transcriptNote: The lesson 5 reading text. The recording reads one passage twice (from 在上班族和学生群体当中 to 过劳死), so it appears twice here. 唐代 is the Tang dynasty (618–907).

blocks.label: 课文
blocks.h: 从减肥说起 · Starting with dieting
lines: 现代病——从减肥说起
Xiàndài bìng—— cóng jiǎnféi shuōqǐ
Modern illnesses: starting with dieting
每个人都有一颗爱美之心，每个时代对美都有不同的看法。
Měi ge rén dōu yǒu yì kē ài měi zhī xīn, měi ge shídài duì měi dōu yǒu bùtóng de kànfǎ.
Everyone wants to be beautiful, and every era has its own idea of beauty.
唐代以胖为美，现代人却以瘦为美。
Tángdài yǐ pàng wéi měi, xiàndàirén què yǐ shòu wéi měi.
In the Tang dynasty plump was beautiful; people today think thin is beautiful.
今天，减肥是女人最关心的话题之一。
Jīntiān, jiǎnféi shì nǚrén zuì guānxīn de huàtí zhīyī.
Today, losing weight is one of the topics women care about most.
节食、吃减肥药、喝减肥茶、擦减肥霜，为了减肥，不惜一切。
Jiéshí, chī jiǎnféi yào, hē jiǎnféi chá, cā jiǎnféi shuāng, wèile jiǎnféi, bùxī yíqiè.
Dieting, slimming pills, slimming tea, slimming cream: they'll do anything to lose weight.
现在胖子越来越多，连儿童患肥胖症的比例也越来越高了。
Xiànzài pàngzi yuèláiyuè duō, lián értóng huàn féipàngzhèng de bǐlì yě yuèláiyuè gāo le.
There are more and more overweight people, and even the proportion of obese children is rising.
肥胖跟经济的发展和物质生活的改善确实有很大关系。
Féipàng gēn jīngjì de fāzhǎn hé wùzhì shēnghuó de gǎishàn quèshí yǒu hěn dà guānxi.
Obesity really does have a lot to do with economic growth and better material living standards.
因为在经济落后的年代，人们连饭都吃不饱，更不用说变得肥胖了。
Yīnwèi zài jīngjì luòhòu de niándài, rénmen lián fàn dōu chī bu bǎo, gèng búyòng shuō biàn de féipàng le.
In economically backward times, people couldn't even get enough to eat, let alone become fat.
然而，造成今天肥胖的原因，不是舒适的生活，
Rán'ér, zàochéng jīntiān féipàng de yuányīn, bú shì shūshì de shēnghuó,
However, what causes obesity today isn't a comfortable life;
而是跟饮食习惯和饮食结构的变化，以及不健康的生活方式都有关系。
érshì gēn yǐnshí xíguàn hé yǐnshí jiégòu de biànhuà, yǐjí bú jiànkāng de shēnghuó fāngshì dōu yǒu guānxi.
it's linked to changes in eating habits and diet, and to unhealthy lifestyles.

blocks.label: 三个阶段
blocks.h: 饮食的三个阶段 · Three stages of eating
lines: 最近几十年，中国人饮食习惯和饮食结构的变化，可以分为三个阶段。
Zuìjìn jǐ shí nián, Zhōngguórén yǐnshí xíguàn hé yǐnshí jiégòu de biànhuà, kěyǐ fēnwéi sān ge jiēduàn.
Over the last few decades, changes in Chinese eating habits and diet fall into three stages.
六七十年代，由于经济不发达，老百姓物质生活水平较低，
Liù-qīshí niándài, yóuyú jīngjì bù fādá, lǎobǎixìng wùzhì shēnghuó shuǐpíng jiào dī,
In the 1960s and 70s the economy was underdeveloped and ordinary people's living standards were low,
人们对饮食的要求是吃饱就行了。
rénmen duì yǐnshí de yāoqiú shì chī bǎo jiù xíng le.
so all people asked of food was to be full.
饭桌上主要是粗粮和素菜，鸡鸭鱼肉很少。
Fànzhuō shàng zhǔyào shì cūliáng hé sùcài, jī yā yú ròu hěn shǎo.
The table held mostly coarse grains and vegetables; chicken, duck, fish and meat were rare.
到了八九十年代，随着生活水平的提高，人们对饮食的要求也相应地提高了。
Dào le bā-jiǔshí niándài, suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tígāo, rénmen duì yǐnshí de yāoqiú yě xiāngyìng de tígāo le.
By the 1980s and 90s, as living standards rose, expectations of food rose with them.
不仅要吃饱，还要吃好，饭桌上常常是大鱼大肉。
Bùjǐn yào chī bǎo, hái yào chī hǎo, fànzhuō shàng chángcháng shì dà yú dà ròu.
Not only full, but well fed: the table was often loaded with fish and meat.
快餐也是在那时候进入中国的，并且很快受到年轻人的欢迎。
Kuàicān yě shì zài nà shíhou jìnrù Zhōngguó de, bìngqiě hěn kuài shòudào niánqīngrén de huānyíng.
Fast food also arrived in China then, and quickly became popular with young people.
而最近十多年，人们渐渐意识到了大鱼大肉、暴饮暴食的危害，
Ér zuìjìn shí duō nián, rénmen jiànjiàn yìshí dào le dà yú dà ròu, bào yǐn bào shí de wēihài,
In the last ten-odd years, people have gradually realised the harm of rich food and overeating;
食品安全和科学饮食受到重视，粗粮又重新出现在餐桌上了。
shípǐn ānquán hé kēxué yǐnshí shòudào zhòngshì, cūliáng yòu chóngxīn chūxiàn zài cānzhuō shàng le.
food safety and a scientific diet are taken seriously, and coarse grains are back on the table.

blocks.label: 生活方式
blocks.h: 不健康的生活方式 · Unhealthy lifestyles
lines: 然而，有些不健康的生活方式却很难改变，因此，一些现代病也出现了。
Rán'ér, yǒuxiē bú jiànkāng de shēnghuó fāngshì què hěn nán gǎibiàn, yīncǐ, yìxiē xiàndài bìng yě chūxiàn le.
However, some unhealthy lifestyles are hard to change, so some modern illnesses have appeared.
今天，一些不健康的生活方式，例如长期缺少运动、大量饮酒抽烟、睡眠不足、过度疲劳、饮食无规律等等，
Jīntiān, yìxiē bú jiànkāng de shēnghuó fāngshì, lìrú chángqī quēshǎo yùndòng, dàliàng yǐnjiǔ chōuyān, shuìmián bùzú, guòdù píláo, yǐnshí wú guīlǜ děngděng,
Today, unhealthy habits such as long-term lack of exercise, heavy drinking and smoking, too little sleep, overwork and irregular meals
在上班族和学生群体当中相当普遍。
zài shàngbānzú hé xuésheng qúntǐ dāngzhōng xiāngdāng pǔbiàn.
are very common among office workers and students.
许多人都处于亚健康状态，过劳死已经不是新鲜的事情了。
Xǔduō rén dōu chǔyú yàjiànkāng zhuàngtài, guòláosǐ yǐjīng bú shì xīnxiān de shìqing le.
Many people are in a state of sub-health, and death from overwork is nothing new.
在上班族和学生群体当中相当普遍。
Zài shàngbānzú hé xuésheng qúntǐ dāngzhōng xiāngdāng pǔbiàn.
(repeated) are very common among office workers and students.
许多人都处于亚健康状态，过劳死已经不是新鲜的事情了。
Xǔduō rén dōu chǔyú yàjiànkāng zhuàngtài, guòláosǐ yǐjīng bú shì xīnxiān de shìqing le.
(repeated) Many people are in a state of sub-health, and death from overwork is nothing new.
对上班族而言，早出晚归、熬夜加班是再普通不过的事儿了。
Duì shàngbānzú éryán, zǎo chū wǎn guī, áoyè jiā bān shì zài pǔtōng búguò de shìr le.
For office workers, leaving early, getting back late and working overtime into the night is perfectly ordinary.
大多数人有时间去酒吧，却没时间进健身房。
Dàduōshù rén yǒu shíjiān qù jiǔbā, què méi shíjiān jìn jiànshēnfáng.
Most people have time for the bar but not for the gym.
不到生病的时候，健康问题一般不会引起人们的重视。
Bú dào shēng bìng de shíhou, jiànkāng wèntí yìbān bú huì yǐnqǐ rénmen de zhòngshì.
Until they fall ill, people usually don't take health seriously.
等意识到健康的重要性时，常常已经太晚了。
Děng yìshí dào jiànkāng de zhòngyàoxìng shí, chángcháng yǐjīng tài wǎn le.
By the time they realise how important it is, it's often too late.
“四十岁以前用生命换钱，四十岁以后用钱换生命”，说的就是这种现象。
"Sì shí suì yǐqián yòng shēngmìng huàn qián, sì shí suì yǐhòu yòng qián huàn shēngmìng", shuō de jiùshì zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng.
"Before forty you trade your life for money; after forty you trade money for your life": that's what this saying describes.
据统计，中国人一生中，在健康方面百分之六十到百分之八十的投入，都花在临死前几个月的治疗上。
Jù tǒngjì, Zhōngguórén yìshēng zhōng, zài jiànkāng fāngmiàn bǎi fēn zhī liùshí dào bǎi fēn zhī bāshí de tóurù, dōu huā zài línsǐ qián jǐ ge yuè de zhìliáo shàng.
According to statistics, 60 to 80 per cent of what Chinese people spend on health in their lifetime goes on treatment in the last few months before death.

blocks.label: 依赖症
blocks.h: 各种依赖症 · All kinds of dependence
lines: 跟身体方面的疾病比起来，心理方面的疾病也不少。
Gēn shēntǐ fāngmiàn de jíbìng bǐ qǐlái, xīnlǐ fāngmiàn de jíbìng yě bù shǎo.
Compared with physical illnesses, there are plenty of psychological ones too.
科技的进步在给人们带来极大便利的同时，也带来了各种依赖症：
Kējì de jìnbù zài gěi rénmen dàilái jídà biànlì de tóngshí, yě dàilái le gè zhǒng yīlàizhèng:
While technological progress has brought enormous convenience, it has also brought all sorts of dependence:
过于依赖汽车，依赖电脑，依赖手机，依赖网络。
Guòyú yīlài qìchē, yīlài diànnǎo, yīlài shǒujī, yīlài wǎngluò.
too much dependence on cars, computers, phones and the internet.
现代人出门坐汽车，回家开空调，上班用电脑，下班玩手机。
Xiàndàirén chūmén zuò qìchē, huí jiā kāi kōngtiáo, shàng bān yòng diànnǎo, xià bān wán shǒujī.
People today go out by car, turn on the air conditioning at home, use a computer at work and play on their phones after work.
它们像空气一样让人离不开。
Tāmen xiàng kōngqì yíyàng ràng rén lí bu kāi.
These things are as impossible to do without as air.
如果哪天没有，人们心里就会发慌，觉得什么事儿都干不了。
Rúguǒ nǎ tiān méiyǒu, rénmen xīn li jiù huì fāhuāng, juéde shénme shìr dōu gàn bu liǎo.
If one day they're missing, people panic and feel they can't do anything.
由于习惯了以车代步，走两步就累得不得了了。
Yóuyú xíguàn le yǐ chē dài bù, zǒu liǎng bù jiù lèi de bùdéliǎo le.
Used to going everywhere by car, people are exhausted after a few steps.
由于大部分的时间都是在电脑前度过的，
Yóuyú dà bùfen de shíjiān dōu shì zài diànnǎo qián dùguò de,
Because most of their time is spent in front of a computer,
有些人根本没时间出去呼吸呼吸新鲜空气，或者好好地陪陪家人。
yǒuxiē rén gēnběn méi shíjiān chūqu hūxī hūxī xīnxiān kōngqì, huòzhě hǎohǎo de péipei jiārén.
some people have no time at all to go out for fresh air or spend time with their family.
由于习惯了打字，不少人已经不习惯用手写汉字了，后果就是提笔忘字。
Yóuyú xíguàn le dǎzì, bù shǎo rén yǐjīng bù xíguàn yòng shǒuxiě Hànzì le, hòuguǒ jiùshì tí bǐ wàng zì.
Used to typing, many people are no longer used to writing characters by hand; the result is that they pick up a pen and forget how to write.
这些情况相当普遍。
Zhèxiē qíngkuàng xiāngdāng pǔbiàn.
These situations are very common.
要是哪天没有网络，人们就会觉得信息闭塞。
Yàoshì nǎ tiān méiyǒu wǎngluò, rénmen jiù huì juéde xìnxī bìsè.
If the internet goes down one day, people feel cut off from information.
过去朋友聚会是热闹地聊天，现在出现了各自安静地玩手机这种奇怪的现象。
Guòqu péngyou jùhuì shì rènào de liáotiān, xiànzài chūxiàn le gèzì ānjìng de wán shǒujī zhè zhǒng qíguài de xiànxiàng.
Friends used to get together for a lively chat; now there's the strange sight of everyone quietly playing on their own phone.
过去，我们进了饭馆，会先问：“有什么好吃的？”
Guòqu, wǒmen jìn le fànguǎn, huì xiān wèn: "Yǒu shénme hǎochī de?"
In the past, when we went into a restaurant, we'd first ask: "What's good here?"
现在进了饭馆，第一个问题是：“Wi-Fi 密码是什么？”
Xiànzài jìn le fànguǎn, dì-yī ge wèntí shì: "Wi-Fi mìmǎ shì shénme?"
Now the first question is: "What's the Wi-Fi password?"

blocks.label: 压力
lines: 自杀率升高这种现象也需要引起全社会注意。
Zìshā lǜ shēnggāo zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng yě xūyào yǐnqǐ quán shèhuì zhùyì.
The rising suicide rate also needs the attention of society as a whole.
由于生活节奏快、竞争激烈、压力过大、环境污染，
Yóuyú shēnghuó jiézòu kuài, jìngzhēng jīliè, yālì guò dà, huánjìng wūrǎn,
Because of the fast pace of life, fierce competition, excessive pressure, pollution,
以及心理健康没有受到重视等方面的原因，
yǐjí xīnlǐ jiànkāng méiyǒu shòudào zhòngshì děng fāngmiàn de yuányīn,
and mental health not being taken seriously,
很多白领长期处于精神紧张的状态，身体和心理都过度疲劳。
hěn duō báilǐng chángqī chǔyú jīngshén jǐnzhāng de zhuàngtài, shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ dōu guòdù píláo.
many white-collar workers live in a constant state of tension, physically and mentally exhausted.
久而久之，就会产生失眠、头痛、头晕、无法集中注意力等问题，
Jiǔ ér jiǔ zhī, jiù huì chǎnshēng shīmián, tóutòng, tóuyūn, wúfǎ jízhōng zhùyìlì děng wèntí,
Over time this leads to insomnia, headaches, dizziness and difficulty concentrating,
造成记忆力和工作效率下降，对什么都不感兴趣，
zàochéng jìyìlì hé gōngzuò xiàolǜ xiàjiàng, duì shénme dōu bù gǎn xìngqù,
memory and efficiency at work decline, and people lose interest in everything;
严重的甚至产生了放弃生命的想法。
yánzhòng de shènzhì chǎnshēng le fàngqì shēngmìng de xiǎngfǎ.
in serious cases people even think of giving up on life.

blocks.label: 结论
blocks.h: 爱美更要爱健康 · Love beauty, love health more
lines: 现代病其实反映出来的是一些不健康的生活方式。
Xiàndài bìng qíshí fǎnyìng chulai de shì yìxiē bú jiànkāng de shēnghuó fāngshì.
Modern illnesses actually reflect unhealthy ways of living.
治疗这些疾病，需要从改变生活方式做起。
Zhìliáo zhèxiē jíbìng, xūyào cóng gǎibiàn shēnghuó fāngshì zuò qǐ.
Treating them has to start with changing how we live.
人们已经渐渐意识到了这一点。
Rénmen yǐjīng jiànjiàn yìshí dào le zhè yìdiǎn.
People have gradually come to realise this.
今天，越来越多的人走进健身房，也积极参加各种户外活动。
Jīntiān, yuèláiyuè duō de rén zǒujìn jiànshēnfáng, yě jījí cānjiā gè zhǒng hùwài huódòng.
Today more and more people go to the gym and take an active part in outdoor activities.
连减肥这个词，也悄悄地被瘦身取代了。
Lián jiǎnféi zhège cí, yě qiāoqiāo de bèi shòushēn qǔdài le.
Even the word 减肥 ("lose fat") has quietly been replaced by 瘦身 ("slim the body").
减肥以肥为敌，而瘦身则是以瘦为由。
Jiǎnféi yǐ féi wéi dí, ér shòushēn zé shì yǐ shòu wéi yóu.
减肥 treats fat as the enemy, while 瘦身 is about being slim.
这个小小的变化，也反映出了人们对健康的关注。
Zhège xiǎoxiǎo de biànhuà, yě fǎnyìng chū le rénmen duì jiànkāng de guānzhù.
This small change also reflects people's concern for health.
现代人爱美，更要爱健康。
Xiàndàirén àiměi, gèng yào ài jiànkāng.
People today love beauty, but they should love health even more.

grammar: 以……为美
to consider … beautiful
以 A 为 B = take A as B.
唐代以胖为美，现代人却以瘦为美。
Tángdài yǐ pàng wéi měi, xiàndàirén què yǐ shòu wéi měi.
In the Tang dynasty plump was beautiful; people today think thin is beautiful.
南方人以大米为主食。
Nánfāng rén yǐ dàmǐ wéi zhǔ shí.
Southerners take rice as their staple.
连……都……，更不用说……
not even …, let alone …
Builds from a smaller to a bigger case.
因为在经济落后的年代，人们连饭都吃不饱，更不用说变得肥胖了。
Yīnwèi zài jīngjì luòhòu de niándài, rénmen lián fàn dōu chī bu bǎo, gèng búyòng shuō biàn de féipàng le.
In economically backward times, people couldn't even get enough to eat, let alone become fat.
他连汉字都不会写，更不用说写文章了。
Tā lián Hànzì dōu bú huì xiě, gèng búyòng shuō xiě wénzhāng le.
He can't even write characters, let alone an essay.
不是……，而是……
not …, but …
Corrects one idea with another.
然而，造成今天肥胖的原因，不是舒适的生活，
Rán'ér, zàochéng jīntiān féipàng de yuányīn, bú shì shūshì de shēnghuó,
However, what causes obesity today isn't a comfortable life;
他不是不想去，而是没时间。
Tā bú shì bù xiǎng qù, érshì méi shíjiān.
It's not that he doesn't want to go; he has no time.
not only …, but also …
Adds a second point.
不仅要吃饱，还要吃好，饭桌上常常是大鱼大肉。
Bùjǐn yào chī bǎo, hái yào chī hǎo, fànzhuō shàng chángcháng shì dà yú dà ròu.
Not only full, but well fed: the table was often loaded with fish and meat.
他不仅会唱歌，还会跳舞。
Tā bùjǐn huì chàng gē, hái huì tiàowǔ.
He can not only sing but dance too.
对……而言
as far as … is concerned
Formal "for".
对上班族而言，早出晚归、熬夜加班是再普通不过的事儿了。
Duì shàngbānzú éryán, zǎo chū wǎn guī, áoyè jiā bān shì zài pǔtōng búguò de shìr le.
For office workers, leaving early, getting back late and working overtime into the night is perfectly ordinary.
对我而言，健康最重要。
Duì wǒ éryán, jiànkāng zuì zhòngyào.
For me, health matters most.
不到……的时候，……
until …
不到 + time means "not before".
不到生病的时候，健康问题一般不会引起人们的重视。
Bú dào shēng bìng de shíhou, jiànkāng wèntí yìbān bú huì yǐnqǐ rénmen de zhòngshì.
Until they fall ill, people usually don't take health seriously.
不到最后，不要放弃。
Bú dào zuìhòu, bú yào fàngqì.
Don't give up until the very end.
在……的同时，也……
while …, also …
Two simultaneous effects.
科技的进步在给人们带来极大便利的同时，也带来了各种依赖症：
Kējì de jìnbù zài gěi rénmen dàilái jídà biànlì de tóngshí, yě dàilái le gè zhǒng yīlàizhèng:
While technological progress has brought enormous convenience, it has also brought all sorts of dependence:
在学习的同时，也要注意休息。
Zài xuéxí de tóngshí, yě yào zhùyì xiūxi.
While studying, also remember to rest.
owing to …
Formal "because".
由于习惯了以车代步，走两步就累得不得了了。
Yóuyú xíguàn le yǐ chē dài bù, zǒu liǎng bù jiù lèi de bùdéliǎo le.
Used to going everywhere by car, people are exhausted after a few steps.
由于下雨，比赛取消了。
Yóuyú xià yǔ, bǐsài qǔxiāo le.
The match was called off owing to rain.
久而久之
over time
A four-character set phrase.
久而久之，就会产生失眠、头痛、头晕、无法集中注意力等问题，
Jiǔ ér jiǔ zhī, jiù huì chǎnshēng shīmián, tóutòng, tóuyūn, wúfǎ jízhōng zhùyìlì děng wèntí,
Over time this leads to insomnia, headaches, dizziness and difficulty concentrating,
久而久之，他就习惯了。
Jiǔ ér jiǔ zhī, tā jiù xíguàn le.
Over time he got used to it.
gaps: 了大鱼大肉、暴饮暴食的危害
许多人都处于亚健康状态，
已经不是新鲜的事情了。
连减肥这个词，也悄悄地被瘦身
say: People today love beauty, but they should love health even more.
Most people have time for the bar but not for the gym.

084.title: The Chinese way of keeping healthy
084.sub: Lesson 5 reading: four kinds of balance
084.transcriptNote: The second lesson 5 reading. 春生、夏长、秋收、冬藏 ("spring sprouts, summer grows, autumn harvests, winter stores") describes the farming year.

blocks.label: 课文
blocks.h: 中国人的养生之道 · The text
lines: 中国人的养生之道
Zhōngguórén de yǎngshēng zhī dào
The Chinese way of keeping healthy
传统的中国人很注重养生。
Chuántǒng de Zhōngguórén hěn zhùzhòng yǎngshēng.
Traditional Chinese people pay great attention to keeping healthy.
无论是打太极还是练琴棋书画，无论是喝白开水还是睡午觉，
Wúlùn shì dǎ tàijí háishi liàn qín qí shū huà, wúlùn shì hē báikāishuǐ háishi shuì wǔjiào,
Whether it's doing tai chi or practising music, chess, calligraphy and painting, drinking boiled water or taking a nap,
里面都有一套养生理论。
lǐmiàn dōu yǒu yí tào yǎngshēng lǐlùn.
there's a whole theory of health behind it.
这些理论中有一个相当重要的原则，那就是平衡。
Zhèxiē lǐlùn zhōng yǒu yí ge xiāngdāng zhòngyào de yuánzé, nà jiùshì pínghéng.
One very important principle in these theories is balance.
具体地说，有以下几个方面。
Jùtǐ de shuō, yǒu yǐxià jǐ ge fāngmiàn.
Specifically, it has the following aspects.

blocks.label: 第一
blocks.h: 环境平衡 · Balance with the environment
lines: 第一，环境平衡。
Dì-yī, huánjìng pínghéng.
First, balance with the environment.
人们常说，要顺其自然。意思是，在养生的时候不要违背自然规律。
Rénmen cháng shuō, yào shùn qí zìrán. Yìsi shì, zài yǎngshēng de shíhou bú yào wéibèi zìrán guīlǜ.
People often say "go with nature". It means not going against the laws of nature when looking after your health.
比方说，气候的规律是春暖、夏热、秋凉、冬寒，
Bǐfang shuō, qìhòu de guīlǜ shì chūn nuǎn, xià rè, qiū liáng, dōng hán,
For example, the pattern of the climate is warm spring, hot summer, cool autumn, cold winter;
植物的规律是春生、夏长、秋收、冬藏。
zhíwù de guīlǜ shì chūn shēng, xià zhǎng, qiū shōu, dōng cáng.
the pattern of plants is sprouting in spring, growing in summer, harvest in autumn, storing in winter.
人也一样，应该随着大自然的变化而不断地进行调整。
Rén yě yíyàng, yīnggāi suízhe dàzìrán de biànhuà ér búduàn de jìnxíng tiáozhěng.
People are the same: we should keep adjusting as nature changes.
天睡我睡，天醒我醒。
Tiān shuì wǒ shuì, tiān xǐng wǒ xǐng.
When the sky sleeps, I sleep; when the sky wakes, I wake.
该吃饭的时候吃饭，该睡觉的时候睡觉。
Gāi chī fàn de shíhou chī fàn, gāi shuì jiào de shíhou shuì jiào.
Eat when it's time to eat, sleep when it's time to sleep.
总之，到了什么时候就应该做什么事。
Zǒngzhī, dào le shénme shíhou jiù yīnggāi zuò shénme shì.
In short, do whatever the time calls for.
否则，离自然规律远了，离疾病就近了。
Fǒuzé, lí zìrán guīlǜ yuǎn le, lí jíbìng jiù jìn le.
Otherwise, the further you are from nature's laws, the closer you are to illness.

blocks.label: 第二
blocks.h: 动静平衡 · Balance of activity and rest
lines: 第二，动静平衡。
Dì-èr, dòng jìng pínghéng.
Second, balance between activity and rest.
俗话说，生命在于运动。成天躺着不动是不行的。
Súhuà shuō, shēngmìng zàiyú yùndòng. Chéngtiān tǎng zhe bú dòng shì bù xíng de.
As the saying goes, life lies in movement. Lying still all day won't do.
进行一定的户外活动，接触大自然对健康很有利。
Jìnxíng yídìng de hùwài huódòng, jiēchù dàzìrán duì jiànkāng hěn yǒulì.
Some outdoor activity and contact with nature is very good for your health.
但是，运动过量或者做不适合自己的运动，又可能对身体健康起到相反的作用。
Dànshì, yùndòng guòliàng huòzhě zuò bú shìhé zìjǐ de yùndòng, yòu kěnéng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng qǐdào xiāngfǎn de zuòyòng.
But too much exercise, or exercise that doesn't suit you, can have the opposite effect.
在生活中，把握好工作与生活之间的平衡非常重要。
Zài shēnghuó zhōng, bǎwò hǎo gōngzuò yǔ shēnghuó zhījiān de pínghéng fēicháng zhòngyào.
In daily life, getting the balance between work and life right is very important.
坐在办公室不动，长期加班，都是慢性自杀。
Zuò zài bàngōngshì bú dòng, chángqī jiā bān, dōu shì mànxìng zìshā.
Sitting still in an office and working overtime for long periods is slow suicide.

blocks.label: 第三
lines: 第三，营养平衡。
Dì-sān, yíngyǎng pínghéng.
Third, nutritional balance.
中国人很重视通过吃来对自己的身体进行保养，这被称为食补。
Zhōngguórén hěn zhòngshì tōngguò chī lái duì zìjǐ de shēntǐ jìnxíng bǎoyǎng, zhè bèi chēngwéi shíbǔ.
Chinese people value looking after their bodies through food; this is called 食补, "building up through food".
中医很早就认识到，食物不仅可以给身体带来营养，而且还可以预防和治疗疾病。
Zhōngyī hěn zǎo jiù rènshi dào, shíwù bùjǐn kěyǐ gěi shēntǐ dàilái yíngyǎng, érqiě hái kěyǐ yùfáng hé zhìliáo jíbìng.
Chinese medicine recognised long ago that food not only nourishes the body but can also prevent and treat illness.
补身体在中国人的生活中特别重要。
Bǔ shēntǐ zài Zhōngguórén de shēnghuó zhōng tèbié zhòngyào.
Building up the body is especially important in Chinese life.
儿童想要长得更高、更壮，得补；
Értóng xiǎng yào zhǎng de gèng gāo, gèng zhuàng, děi bǔ;
Children who want to grow taller and stronger need building up;
人们大病过后或者生完孩子以后，得补；
rénmen dàbìng guòhòu huòzhě shēng wán háizi yǐhòu, děi bǔ;
people need it after a serious illness or after giving birth;
老人想要健康长寿，也得补。
lǎorén xiǎng yào jiànkāng chángshòu, yě děi bǔ.
old people who want to live long, healthy lives need it too.
所以，营养品在中国特别有市场。
Suǒyǐ, yíngyǎngpǐn zài Zhōngguó tèbié yǒu shìchǎng.
So health supplements sell especially well in China.
但另一方面，营养太好，又会引起肥胖症等疾病。
Dàn lìng yì fāngmiàn, yíngyǎng tài hǎo, yòu huì yǐnqǐ féipàngzhèng děng jíbìng.
On the other hand, too much nutrition can cause illnesses like obesity.
因此，养生之道强调营养的平衡和多样。
Yīncǐ, yǎngshēng zhī dào qiángdiào yíngyǎng de pínghéng hé duōyàng.
So the way of keeping healthy stresses balanced and varied nutrition.
每天至少吃五种蔬菜和水果，鱼和肉要适量。
Měitiān zhìshǎo chī wǔ zhǒng shūcài hé shuǐguǒ, yú hé ròu yào shìliàng.
Eat at least five kinds of fruit and vegetables a day, and fish and meat in moderation.

blocks.label: 第四
lines: 第四，心理平衡。
Dì-sì, xīnlǐ pínghéng.
Fourth, mental balance.
养生之道虽然强调要让身体动起来，但同时也强调要让内心静下去。
Yǎngshēng zhī dào suīrán qiángdiào yào ràng shēntǐ dòng qǐlái, dàn tóngshí yě qiángdiào yào ràng nèixīn jìng xiaqu.
Although keeping healthy stresses getting the body moving, it also stresses calming the mind.
每个人都会遇到烦心事，学会进行有效的情绪管理很重要。
Měi ge rén dōu huì yùdào fánxīn shì, xuéhuì jìnxíng yǒuxiào de qíngxù guǎnlǐ hěn zhòngyào.
Everyone runs into things that upset them; learning to manage your emotions effectively is important.
要接受各种负面的情绪，并通过正确的方法缓解、表达出来，才能保持内心的平静。
Yào jiēshòu gè zhǒng fùmiàn de qíngxù, bìng tōngguò zhèngquè de fāngfǎ huǎnjiě, biǎodá chulai, cái néng bǎochí nèixīn de píngjìng.
You need to accept negative emotions and relieve and express them in the right way; only then can you stay calm inside.

grammar: 无论是……还是……，都……
whether … or …, …
Every case gives the same result.
无论是打太极还是练琴棋书画，无论是喝白开水还是睡午觉，
Wúlùn shì dǎ tàijí háishi liàn qín qí shū huà, wúlùn shì hē báikāishuǐ háishi shuì wǔjiào,
Whether it's doing tai chi or practising music, chess, calligraphy and painting, drinking boiled water or taking a nap,
无论是男人还是女人，都爱聊天。
Wúlùn shì nánrén háishi nǚrén, dōu ài liáotiān.
Men and women alike love chatting.
随着……而……
to … along with …
The second change follows the first.
人也一样，应该随着大自然的变化而不断地进行调整。
Rén yě yíyàng, yīnggāi suízhe dàzìrán de biànhuà ér búduàn de jìnxíng tiáozhěng.
People are the same: we should keep adjusting as nature changes.
他的想法随着年龄而改变。
Tā de xiǎngfǎ suízhe niánlíng ér gǎibiàn.
His ideas change with age.
到了什么时候就应该做什么事
do whatever the time calls for
Question word repeated: "whatever …, that …".
总之，到了什么时候就应该做什么事。
Zǒngzhī, dào le shénme shíhou jiù yīnggāi zuò shénme shì.
In short, do whatever the time calls for.
你想吃什么就吃什么。
Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.
Eat whatever you like.
离……远了，离……就近了
the further from …, the closer to …
A balanced contrast.
否则，离自然规律远了，离疾病就近了。
Fǒuzé, lí zìrán guīlǜ yuǎn le, lí jíbìng jiù jìn le.
Otherwise, the further you are from nature's laws, the closer you are to illness.
离家远了，离梦想就近了。
Lí jiā yuǎn le, lí mèngxiǎng jiù jìn le.
Further from home, closer to your dream.
对……起到……的作用
to have a … effect on …
Formal.
但是，运动过量或者做不适合自己的运动，又可能对身体健康起到相反的作用。
Dànshì, yùndòng guòliàng huòzhě zuò bú shìhé zìjǐ de yùndòng, yòu kěnéng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng qǐdào xiāngfǎn de zuòyòng.
But too much exercise, or exercise that doesn't suit you, can have the opposite effect.
运动对健康起到很好的作用。
Yùndòng duì jiànkāng qǐdào hěn hǎo de zuòyòng.
Exercise has a very good effect on health.
不仅……，而且还……
not only …, but also …
Adds a further point.
中医很早就认识到，食物不仅可以给身体带来营养，而且还可以预防和治疗疾病。
Zhōngyī hěn zǎo jiù rènshi dào, shíwù bùjǐn kěyǐ gěi shēntǐ dàilái yíngyǎng, érqiě hái kěyǐ yùfáng hé zhìliáo jíbìng.
Chinese medicine recognised long ago that food not only nourishes the body but can also prevent and treat illness.
他不仅会说，而且还会写。
Tā bùjǐn huì shuō, érqiě hái huì xiě.
He can not only speak but also write.
被称为……
to be called …
A passive naming structure.
中国人很重视通过吃来对自己的身体进行保养，这被称为食补。
Zhōngguórén hěn zhòngshì tōngguò chī lái duì zìjǐ de shēntǐ jìnxíng bǎoyǎng, zhè bèi chēngwéi shíbǔ.
Chinese people value looking after their bodies through food; this is called 食补, "building up through food".
北京被称为“首都”。
Běijīng bèi chēngwéi "shǒudū".
Beijing is called "the capital".
虽然……，但同时也……
although …, at the same time …
Two sides of one idea.
养生之道虽然强调要让身体动起来，但同时也强调要让内心静下去。
