No wonder I couldn't find this book anywhere. You had it all along.
A
原来她已经有白马王子了，怪不得别人给她介绍对象，她都不同意。
Yuánlái tā yǐjīng yǒu báimǎ wángzǐ le, guàibùdé biérén gěi tā jièshào duìxiàng, tā dōu bù tóngyì.
So she already has her Prince Charming. No wonder she turned down everyone people tried to set her up with.
B

vocab: to trust, to be at ease
grammar: 替……担心
to worry about …
替 = for, on behalf of.
听说他的心脏病又犯了，又去了医院，孩子们都很替他担心。
Tīngshuō tā de xīnzàng bìng yòu fàn le, yòu qù le yīyuàn, háizimen dōu hěn tì tā dānxīn.
I hear his heart trouble has flared up again and he's back in hospital. The children are all very worried about him.
我替你高兴。
Wǒ tì nǐ gāoxìng.
I'm happy for you.
自从……后
ever since …
Marks a starting point.
自从生了小孩后，老公表现得特别优秀，做饭、买菜、洗衣服，什么活都干。
Zìcóng shēng le xiǎohái hòu, lǎogōng biǎoxiàn de tèbié yōuxiù, zuò fàn, mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, shénme huó dōu gàn.
Since the baby was born, my husband has been brilliant: cooking, shopping, washing, he does everything.
自从搬家后，他很少来了。
Zìcóng bān jiā hòu, tā hěn shǎo lái le.
He rarely comes since he moved.
要看……
it depends on …
看 here = depend on.
能不能带你去看足球比赛，要看你的表现。如果考试考得好，就带你去。
Néng bù néng dài nǐ qù kàn zúqiú bǐsài, yào kàn nǐ de biǎoxiàn. Rúguǒ kǎoshì kǎo de hǎo, jiù dài nǐ qù.
Whether I take you to the football match depends on how you do. If you do well in the exam, I'll take you.
去不去要看天气。
Qù bú qù yào kàn tiānqì.
Whether we go depends on the weather.
怪不得……，原来……
no wonder …, so that's why …
原来 gives the explanation.
怪不得我到处找这本书都没找到，原来是在你这儿。
Guàibùdé wǒ dàochù zhǎo zhè běn shū dōu méi zhǎodào, yuánlái shì zài nǐ zhèr.

怪不得这么冷，原来下雪了。

089.title: Do the two sentences match?
089.sub: Five pairs: same meaning or not?
089.transcriptNote: Each item has two sentences, A and B. Decide whether they mean the same thing, then turn on Answers. The letter B isn't read aloud. The answers are my own judgement. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明

Listen and decide whether the two sentences mean the same.
我的女儿特别懂事，她主动让我帮她找补习班去学习。
Wǒ de nǚ'ér tèbié dǒngshì, tā zhǔdòng ràng wǒ bāng tā zhǎo bǔxíbān qù xuéxí.
My daughter is very sensible. She asked me herself to find her a tutoring class.

我的女儿自己很愿意去补习班补课。

My daughter is quite willing to go to a tutoring class.

Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?

A
我今天早上运动了，虽然时间不长，可是一天感觉都很好。

I exercised this morning. It wasn't for long, but I felt great all day.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both describe a short morning workout and feeling good all day.

lines: 怪不得小丽的妈妈这么为她的婚姻操心，原来她都三十五了，还没有找到对象呢。
Guàibùdé Xiǎo Lì de māma zhème wèi tā de hūnyīn cāoxīn, yuánlái tā dōu sānshíwǔ le, hái méi yǒu zhǎodào duìxiàng ne.
No wonder Xiao Li's mother worries so much about her getting married. She's already 35 and still hasn't found anyone.
A
小丽三十五了，还没有白马王子呢，她抱怨她的妈妈太为她操心了。
Xiǎo Lì sānshíwǔ le, hái méi yǒu báimǎ wángzǐ ne, tā bàoyuàn tā de māma tài wèi tā cāoxīn le.
Xiao Li is 35 and still has no Prince Charming. She complains that her mother worries about her too much.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A doesn't say Xiao Li complains about her mother.

lines: 他梦想着有一天能自己开一个大公司，发大财。
Tā mèngxiǎngzhe yǒu yì tiān néng zìjǐ kāi yí ge dà gōngsī, fā dà cái.

他希望自己能当上大老板，赚很多的钱。

He hopes to become a big boss and earn lots of money.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both are about his dream of running a big business and getting rich.

lines: 做了父母后，整天围着孩子转，辛苦是辛苦，可是也挺幸福的。
Zuò le fùmǔ hòu, zhěngtiān wéizhe háizi zhuàn, xīnkǔ shì xīnkǔ, kěshì yě tǐng xìngfú de.

A

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?

qs.why: Both say parenthood is hard but rewarding.

090.title: Thoughts at forty
090.sub: Three questions, then a man compares himself with his successful classmates
090.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the passage. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

q: 我为什么不愿意参加同学聚会？
Wǒ wèishénme bú yuànyì cānjiā tóngxué jùhuì?
Why don't I like going to class reunions?
ans: 我本来就不爱讲话，和大家在一起不是觉得没有共同语言，就是不知道该说什么；而且和老同学比起来差距太大。
Wǒ běnlái jiù bú ài jiǎnghuà, hé dàjiā zài yìqǐ bú shì juéde méiyǒu gòngtóng yǔyán, jiùshì bù zhīdao gāi shuō shénme; érqiě hé lǎo tóngxué bǐ qǐlái chājù tài dà.
I'm not a talker to begin with; with them I either feel we have nothing in common or don't know what to say, and the gap between me and my old classmates is huge.

q: 我的老同学现在的生活怎么样？
Wǒ de lǎo tóngxué xiànzài de shēnghuó zěnmeyàng?
What are my old classmates' lives like now?
ans: 他们很有本事：当了经理或开了公司，年薪几十万以上，用的都是高档的东西，孩子也都很有出息。但他们没时间陪父母和孩子，总加班熬夜，都得了现代生活病。

Tāmen hěn yǒu běnshi: dāng le jīnglǐ huò kāi le gōngsī, niánxīn jǐ shí wàn yǐshàng, yòng de dōu shì gāodàng de dōngxi, háizi yě dōu hěn yǒu chūxi. Dàn tāmen méi shíjiān péi fùmǔ hé háizi, zǒng jiā bān áoyè, dōu dé le xiàndài shēnghuó bìng.

They're very successful: managers or business owners earning hundreds of thousands a year, with high-end everything and high-achieving children. But they have no time for their parents or kids, work late all the time, and all have modern lifestyle illnesses.

q: 我怎么看自己今天的生活？
Wǒ zěnme kàn zìjǐ jīntiān de shēnghuó?
How do I see my own life today?
ans: 我觉得活得挺好，一点也不丢脸：我天天和儿子做户外运动，身体好，很少生病；周末还陪父母散步，这才是真正的关心和孝顺。
Wǒ juéde huó de tǐng hǎo, yìdiǎn yě bù diū liǎn: wǒ tiāntiān hé érzi zuò hùwài yùndòng, shēntǐ hǎo, hěn shǎo shēng bìng; zhōumò hái péi fùmǔ sànbù, zhè cái shì zhēnzhèng de guānxīn hé xiàoshùn.

I think my life's pretty good and nothing to be ashamed of: I exercise outdoors with my son every day, I'm healthy and rarely ill, and I walk with my parents at weekends, which is what really caring for them means.

yě yǒngyuǎn dōu zài xúnzhǎo nénggòu zhuànqián de jīhuì.

Kěshì, wǒ yì diǎnr yě bù juéde zìjǐ yǒu shénme diū liǎn de. Zhèng xiāngfǎn, wǒ juéde wǒ huó de tǐng hǎo.

我的同学虽然都很成功，不过个个都说自己没时间陪父母、陪孩子。

bú shì zhèr téng, jiùshì nàr nánshòu.
if it isn't a pain here, it's an ache there.

但是我觉得作为儿女，应该尽可能多陪陪他们。这才是真正的关心、真正的孝顺。
dànshì wǒ juéde zuòwéi érnǚ, yīnggāi jǐnkěnéng duō péipei tāmen. Zhè cái shì zhēnzhèng de guānxīn, zhēnzhèng de xiàoshùn.
I think that as their child I should spend as much time with them as I can. That is what really caring for them, and being a good son, means.

vocab: to be good to one's parents
grammar: 不是……，就是……
either … or …
One of two things is always true.
不是觉得没有共同语言，就是不知道该说什么好。
bú shì juéde méiyǒu gòngtóng yǔyán, jiùshì bù zhīdao gāi shuō shénme hǎo.
either I feel we have nothing in common, or I don't know what to say.
他不是看书，就是写字。
Tā bú shì kànshū, jiùshì xiě zì.
If he isn't reading, he's writing.
和……比起来
compared with …
Introduces a comparison.
而我呢，和他们比起来，差距太大了。
Ér wǒ ne, hé tāmen bǐ qǐlái, chājù tài dà le.
And me? Compared with them, the gap is huge.
和北京比起来，上海更热。
Hé Běijīng bǐ qǐlái, Shànghǎi gèng rè.
Shanghai is hotter compared with Beijing.
连……都没……
not even …
Stresses an extreme case.
快四十的人了，到现在住的还是结婚时的那套老房子，连家具都没换过。
Kuài sìshí de rén le, dào xiànzài zhù de háishi jié hūn shí de nà tào lǎo fángzi, lián jiājù dōu méi huàn guo.
I'm nearly forty and still live in the old flat we had when we married. We haven't even changed the furniture.
他连一句话都没说。
Tā lián yí jù huà dōu méi shuō.
He didn't say a single word.
除了……外，没有……
apart from …, no …
Excludes one exception.
我自己的孩子呢，学习成绩一般，除了足球踢得不错外，没有什么特长。
Wǒ zìjǐ de háizi ne, xuéxí chéngjì yìbān, chúle zúqiú tī de búcuò wài, méiyǒu shénme tècháng.
As for my own child, his marks are average, and apart from playing football well he has no special talents.
除了他外，没有人知道。
Chúle tā wài, méiyǒu rén zhīdao.
Nobody knows except him.
正相反
quite the opposite
Corrects an expectation.
可是，我一点儿也不觉得自己有什么丢脸的。正相反，我觉得我活得挺好。
Kěshì, wǒ yì diǎnr yě bù juéde zìjǐ yǒu shénme diū liǎn de. Zhèng xiāngfǎn, wǒ juéde wǒ huó de tǐng hǎo.
But I don't feel the least bit ashamed. Quite the opposite: I think I'm doing fine.
他不累，正相反，他很有精神。
Tā bú lèi, zhèng xiāngfǎn, tā hěn yǒu jīngshén.
He's not tired; quite the opposite.
as soon as … comes
A time trigger.
一到冬天，我们办公室的同事都感冒、咳嗽，每年冬天都要得好几场病，
Yí dào dōngtiān, wǒmen bàngōngshì de tóngshì dōu gǎnmào, késòu, měinián dōngtiān dōu yào dé hǎo jǐ chǎng bìng,
Every winter, my colleagues all catch colds and coughs; each winter they're ill several times,
一到周末，他就去爬山。
Yí dào zhōumò, tā jiù qù páshān.
Every weekend he goes hiking.
又是……，又是……
what with … and …
Lists many busy things.
又是打针，又是吃药的，只有我什么病都没有，抵抗力最好。
yòu shì dǎzhēn, yòu shì chīyào de, zhǐyǒu wǒ shénme bìng dōu méiyǒu, dǐkànglì zuì hǎo.
with injections and medicine. I'm the only one who never gets ill; my resistance is the best.
又是洗衣服，又是做饭。
Yòu shì xǐ yīfu, yòu shì zuò fàn.
What with the washing and the cooking.
作为……
as …
Gives the role.
但是我觉得作为儿女，应该尽可能多陪陪他们。这才是真正的关心、真正的孝顺。
dànshì wǒ juéde zuòwéi érnǚ, yīnggāi jǐnkěnéng duō péipei tāmen. Zhè cái shì zhēnzhèng de guānxīn, zhēnzhèng de xiàoshùn.
I think that as their child I should spend as much time with them as I can. That is what really caring for them, and being a good son, means.
作为老师，我很高兴。
Zuòwéi lǎoshī, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
As a teacher, I'm very pleased.
gaps: 他们的孩子似乎也都很有
工作方面也没有什么大
我一点儿也不觉得自己有什么
这才是真正的关心、真正的
say: What I dread most is class reunions.
But I don't feel the least bit ashamed. Quite the opposite: I think I'm doing fine.

091.title: A chat between two mothers
091.sub: Five true-or-false statements, then two mums compare notes on their sons
091.transcriptNote: First five statements to judge, then the story. 张 is Aunt Zhang (张大妈) and 乐 is Lele's mum (乐乐妈). Turn on Answers for the true-or-false key; the answers are my own reading.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音并判断句子的正误。请先听五个句子。
Tīng lùyīn bìng pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù. Qǐng xiān tīng wǔ ge jùzi.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false. First listen to five sentences.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 五个句子 · True or false

q: 乐乐考上了大学，是个很有出息的孩子。
Lèle kǎoshang le dàxué, shì ge hěn yǒu chūxi de háizi.
Lele has got into university; he's a very promising child.
qs.why: He's in his second year of senior high school, with a year to go before the university exam.

q: 乐乐很用功，学习成绩也很好，很让妈妈省心。
Lèle hěn yònggōng, xuéxí chéngjì yě hěn hǎo, hěn ràng māma shěngxīn.
Lele works hard, gets good marks and gives his mum no worries.
qs.why: He studies without being told and is usually in the top five of his class.

q: 张大妈抱怨儿子工资太低，而且还没有女朋友，觉得很丢脸。
Zhāng dàmā bàoyuàn érzi gōngzī tài dī, érqiě hái méi yǒu nǚpéngyou, juéde hěn diū liǎn.
Aunt Zhang complains her son's pay is too low and he has no girlfriend, and she's embarrassed.
qs.why: She says he has no girlfriend yet and that a girl thought he earned too little, but she doesn't say she's embarrassed or complain about his pay.

q: 邻居们主动给张大妈的儿子介绍对象。
Línjū men zhǔdòng gěi Zhāng dàmā de érzi jièshào duìxiàng.
The neighbours offer to find Aunt Zhang's son a girlfriend.
qs.why: Only Lao Zhang introduced someone; Lele's mum just suggests looking online.

q: 乐乐妈劝张大妈不要太替儿子操心了。
Lèle mā quàn Zhāng dàmā bú yào tài tì érzi cāoxīn le.
Lele's mum tells Aunt Zhang not to worry so much about her son.
qs.why: She ends by saying 你不用替他操心了.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 下面请听文章。
Xiàmiàn qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
聊天儿
Liáo tiānr
A chat
中国老人聚在一起，经常聊关于孩子的事情。
Zhōngguó lǎorén jù zài yìqǐ, jīngcháng liáo guānyú háizi de shìqing.
When older Chinese people get together, they often talk about their children.
从子女的学业到工作，再到婚姻，总有操不完的心。
Cóng zǐnǚ de xuéyè dào gōngzuò, zài dào hūnyīn, zǒng yǒu cāo bu wán de xīn.
From studies to work to marriage, there's no end of things to worry about.
一天，张大妈和乐乐妈在小区里遇见了，两个人互相打招呼。
Yì tiān, Zhāng dàmā hé Lèle mā zài xiǎoqū li yùjiàn le, liǎng ge rén hùxiāng dǎ zhāohu.
One day Aunt Zhang and Lele's mum met on their estate and said hello.
哎呀，是乐乐妈呀！挺长时间没看见你了，你怎么样啊？
Āiyā, shì Lèle mā ya! Tǐng cháng shíjiān méi kànjiàn nǐ le, nǐ zěnmeyàng a?
Oh, it's Lele's mum! I haven't seen you for ages. How are you?
张
还行吧，每天围着孩子转。
Hái xíng ba, měitiān wéizhe háizi zhuàn.
Not bad. My days revolve around the kid.
乐
乐乐上几年级了？考大学了吧？
Lèle shàng jǐ niánjí le? Kǎo dàxué le ba?
What year is Lele in now? Taking the university exam, isn't he?
张
上高二了，还有一年就考大学了。
Shàng gāo'èr le, hái yǒu yì nián jiù kǎo dàxué le.
He's in his second year of senior high. One more year till the university exam.
乐
那一定挺累的吧？
Nà yídìng tǐng lèi de ba?
That must be tiring.
张
累，不过他还挺愿意学的。我也不怎么管，他自己知道学。
Lèi, búguò tā hái tǐng yuànyì xué de. Wǒ yě bù zěnme guǎn, tā zìjǐ zhīdao xué.
It is, but he's quite keen to study. I don't really push him; he knows to study by himself.
乐
看见同学外面都有补习班，他也让我给他找一个，把数学再补补。
Kànjiàn tóngxué wàimian dōu yǒu bǔxíbān, tā yě ràng wǒ gěi tā zhǎo yí ge, bǎ shùxué zài bǔbu.
He saw his classmates all have tutoring classes, so he asked me to find him one to brush up his maths.
乐
你看，我刚给他报名回来，下星期就开课了。
Nǐ kàn, wǒ gāng gěi tā bàomíng huílai, xiàxīngqī jiù kāikè le.
See, I've just been to sign him up. Classes start next week.
乐
你儿子这么懂事呀！别人家的孩子让他学都不学，还总想着偷懒儿。你家孩子可真让人省心呀。
Nǐ érzi zhème dǒngshì ya! Biérén jiā de háizi ràng tā xué dōu bù xué, hái zǒng xiǎngzhe tōulǎnr. Nǐ jiā háizi kě zhēn ràng rén shěngxīn ya.
Your son's so sensible! Other people's kids won't study even when they're told to and are always trying to slack off. Your boy is no trouble at all.
张
还可以吧。学习方面不用劝，成绩一般都能保持在全班前五名吧。我们对他也比较满意。
Hái kěyǐ ba. Xuéxí fāngmiàn búyòng quàn, chéngjì yìbān dōu néng bǎochí zài quán bān qián wǔ míng ba. Wǒmen duì tā yě bǐjiào mǎnyì.
He's all right. We don't have to nag him about studying, and he's usually in the top five of his class. We're fairly pleased with him.
乐
你儿子呢？不是也找到工作了吗？怎么样呀？
Nǐ érzi ne? Bú shì yě zhǎodào gōngzuò le ma? Zěnmeyàng ya?
And your son? Hasn't he found a job? How's it going?
乐
上班有三个月了，领导对他也不错，挺照顾他的。
Shàng bān yǒu sān ge yuè le, lǐngdǎo duì tā yě búcuò, tǐng zhàogù tā de.
He's been working for three months. His boss is good to him and looks after him.
张
那真挺好。你这回也该放心了。
Nà zhēn tǐng hǎo. Nǐ zhè huí yě gāi fàngxīn le.
That's great. You can stop worrying now.
乐
工作是有了，可还没有对象呢。
Gōngzuò shì yǒu le, kě hái méi yǒu duìxiàng ne.
He's got a job, but he still hasn't got a girlfriend.
张
听说老张不是给他介绍了一个吗？
Tīngshuō Lǎo Zhāng bú shì gěi tā jièshào le yí ge ma?
I heard Lao Zhang introduced him to someone?
乐
不行呀，上次那个嫌我儿子赚得少。你说他刚工作，工资能高吗？
Bù xíng ya, shàngcì nàge xián wǒ érzi zhuàn de shǎo. Nǐ shuō tā gāng gōngzuò, gōngzī néng gāo ma?
It didn't work out. That girl thought my son earned too little. He's only just started; how can his pay be high?
张
现在的小年轻儿都自己在网上找，你儿子没试试？
Xiànzài de xiǎo niánqīngr dōu zìjǐ zài wǎng shang zhǎo, nǐ érzi méi shìshi?
Young people now all find someone online. Hasn't your son tried?
乐
网上那些人能跟你说真话吗？我不太愿意让他在网上找。
Wǎng shang nàxiē rén néng gēn nǐ shuō zhēn huà ma? Wǒ bú tài yuànyì ràng tā zài wǎng shang zhǎo.
Will people online tell you the truth? I'm not keen on him looking online.
张
其实你家条件也不错呀。结婚有房子，你儿子工作又不错，一定能找到合适的。你不用替他操心了。
Qíshí nǐ jiā tiáojiàn yě búcuò ya. Jié hūn yǒu fángzi, nǐ érzi gōngzuò yòu búcuò, yídìng néng zhǎodào héshì de. Nǐ búyòng tì tā cāoxīn le.
Your family's well off, really. There's a flat for when he marries and he's got a good job. He's bound to find the right person. You don't need to worry about him.
乐

vocab: to make up, to brush up
grammar: from … to … and then to …
Lists a progression.
从子女的学业到工作，再到婚姻，总有操不完的心。
Cóng zǐnǚ de xuéyè dào gōngzuò, zài dào hūnyīn, zǒng yǒu cāo bu wán de xīn.
From studies to work to marriage, there's no end of things to worry about.
从小学到中学，再到大学。
Cóng xiǎo xuédào zhōngxué, zài dào dàxué.
From primary to secondary to university.
还有……就……
only … left until …
就 shows how soon.
上高二了，还有一年就考大学了。
Shàng gāo'èr le, hái yǒu yì nián jiù kǎo dàxué le.
He's in his second year of senior high. One more year till the university exam.
还有三天就放假了。
Hái yǒu sān tiān jiù fàng jià le.
Only three days till the holidays.
让他V都不V
won't … even when told to
Shows stubbornness.
你儿子这么懂事呀！别人家的孩子让他学都不学，还总想着偷懒儿。你家孩子可真让人省心呀。
Nǐ érzi zhème dǒngshì ya! Biérén jiā de háizi ràng tā xué dōu bù xué, hái zǒng xiǎngzhe tōulǎnr. Nǐ jiā háizi kě zhēn ràng rén shěngxīn ya.
Your son's so sensible! Other people's kids won't study even when they're told to and are always trying to slack off. Your boy is no trouble at all.
让他吃都不吃。
Ràng tā chī dōu bù chī.
He won't eat even when told to.
……是有了，可……
there's … all right, but …
Concede, then object.
工作是有了，可还没有对象呢。
Gōngzuò shì yǒu le, kě hái méi yǒu duìxiàng ne.
He's got a job, but he still hasn't got a girlfriend.
钱是有了，可没时间。
Qián shì yǒu le, kě méi shíjiān.
I've got the money, but no time.
你说……能……吗？
how can … ?
A rhetorical appeal.
不行呀，上次那个嫌我儿子赚得少。你说他刚工作，工资能高吗？
Bù xíng ya, shàngcì nàge xián wǒ érzi zhuàn de shǎo. Nǐ shuō tā gāng gōngzuò, gōngzī néng gāo ma?
It didn't work out. That girl thought my son earned too little. He's only just started; how can his pay be high?
你说这么小的孩子能懂吗？
Nǐ shuō zhème xiǎo de háizi néng dǒng ma?
How could such a small child understand?
不用替……操心
no need to worry about …
替 = on behalf of.
其实你家条件也不错呀。结婚有房子，你儿子工作又不错，一定能找到合适的。你不用替他操心了。
Qíshí nǐ jiā tiáojiàn yě búcuò ya. Jié hūn yǒu fángzi, nǐ érzi gōngzuò yòu búcuò, yídìng néng zhǎodào héshì de. Nǐ búyòng tì tā cāoxīn le.
Your family's well off, really. There's a flat for when he marries and he's got a good job. He's bound to find the right person. You don't need to worry about him.
你不用替我担心。
Nǐ búyòng tì wǒ dānxīn.
Don't worry about me.

roles.张: 张 = Aunt Zhang, worried about her son

say: Oh, it's Lele's mum! I haven't seen you for ages. How are you?
He's got a job, but he still hasn't got a girlfriend.

092.title: Chatting
092.sub: Lesson 6 reading: what people talk about, and how
092.transcriptNote: The lesson 6 reading text. The recording reads one sentence twice (有的人喜欢泡杯茶), so it appears twice here.

blocks.label: 课文
lines: 聊天
Liáotiān
Chatting
在人们的印象中，女人爱聊天，而男人则比较沉默。
Zài rénmen de yìnxiàng zhōng, nǚrén ài liáotiān, ér nánrén zé bǐjiào chénmò.
People tend to think women love chatting while men are rather quiet.
但最近的一个研究却发现，在闲聊这个问题上，男性和女性几乎是一样的。
Dàn zuìjìn de yí ge yánjiū què fāxiàn, zài xiánliáo zhège wèntí shàng, nánxìng hé nǚxìng jīhū shì yíyàng de.
But a recent study found that when it comes to small talk, men and women are almost the same.
研究人员利用录音笔记录人们的对话，结果发现，
Yánjiū rényuán lìyòng lùyīn bǐ jìlù rénmen de duìhuà, jiéguǒ fāxiàn,
The researchers used voice recorders to record people's conversations and found that
无论是男人还是女人，他们每天的平均用词都达一点六万。
wúlùn shì nánrén háishi nǚrén, tāmen měitiān de píngjūn yòngcí dōu dá yī diǎn liù wàn.
men and women alike use an average of 16,000 words a day.

blocks.label: 话题
blocks.h: 聊些什么 · What people talk about
lines: 那人们都聊些什么呢？
Nà rénmen dōu liáo xiē shénme ne?
So what do people talk about?
人们聚在一起能聊的话题很多。
Rénmen jù zài yìqǐ néng liáo de huàtí hěn duō.
There are lots of topics people can chat about when they get together:
从衣食住行到星座、养生，从一日三餐到经济政治，
Cóng yī shí zhù xíng dào xīngzuò, yǎngshēng, cóng yí rì sān cān dào jīngjì zhèngzhì,
from everyday life to star signs and health, from daily meals to economics and politics,
从娱乐新闻到个人投资，从生活小事到国家大事，什么都可以聊。
cóng yúlè xīnwén dào gèrén tóuzī, cóng shēnghuó xiǎoshì dào guójiā dàshì, shénme dōu kěyǐ liáo.
from celebrity news to personal investments, from little things in life to national affairs. Anything goes.
男人们也许会聊聊工作上的事儿：机会、压力，跟领导或同事的关系什么的；
Nánrénmen yěxǔ huì liáoliao gōngzuò shàng de shìr: jīhuì, yālì, gēn lǐngdǎo huò tóngshì de guānxi shénme de;
Men might talk about work: opportunities, pressure, relations with the boss or colleagues and so on;
要么讨论一下哪支足球队踢得好，某个游戏怎么玩，要么聊聊汽车、运动或美食。
yàome tǎolùn yíxià nǎ zhī zúqiúduì tī de hǎo, mǒu ge yóuxì zěnme wán, yàome liáoliao qìchē, yùndòng huò měishí.
or discuss which football team plays well or how to play some game, or chat about cars, sport or good food.
女人们也许会谈谈自己的生活：爱情、婚姻、婆媳关系。
Nǚrénmen yěxǔ huì tántán zìjǐ de shēnghuó: àiqíng, hūnyīn, pó xí guānxì.
Women might talk about their lives: love, marriage, their mothers-in-law.
她们也喜欢聊逛街、购物、减肥之类的话题。
Tāmen yě xǐhuan liáo guàng jiē, gòuwù, jiǎnféi zhīlèi de huàtí.
They also like topics such as window-shopping, shopping and dieting.
父母们的话题常常围着孩子转：睡眠、饮食、营养、学校教育。
Fùmǔmen de huàtí chángcháng wéizhe háizi zhuàn: shuìmián, yǐnshí, yíngyǎng, xuéxiào jiàoyù.
Parents' conversation often revolves around their children: sleep, food, nutrition, school.
年轻人聚在一起，喜欢聊聊电影、电视剧、歌星、影星，
Niánqīngrén jù zài yìqǐ, xǐhuan liáoliao diànyǐng, diànshìjù, gēxīng, yǐngxīng,
When young people get together, they like to talk about films, TV series, singers and film stars,
要么讲讲有趣的故事，说说难忘的经历，或者抱怨一下生活中的烦恼。
yàome jiǎngjiang yǒuqù de gùshi, shuōshuo nánwàng de jīnglì, huòzhě bàoyuàn yíxià shēnghuó zhōng de fánnǎo.
or tell funny stories, share unforgettable experiences, or grumble about life's annoyances.
有时候也谈人生、谈理想、谈出国，或者聊聊周末的活动、兴趣爱好，
Yǒushíhou yě tán rénshēng, tán lǐxiǎng, tán chū guó, huòzhě liáoliao zhōumò de huódòng, xìngqù àihào,
Sometimes they talk about life, their dreams, going abroad, or weekend plans and hobbies,
讨论去哪儿吃喝玩乐，在哪儿买房之类的。
tǎolùn qù nǎr chī hē wán lè, zài nǎr mǎi fáng zhīlèi de.
or discuss where to go out and have fun, where to buy a flat and so on.
要是关系好，没结婚的还会催着对方替自己介绍个合适的对象。
Yàoshì guānxi hǎo, méi jié hūn de hái huì cuīzhe duìfāng tì zìjǐ jièshào ge héshì de duìxiàng.
If they're close, the single ones will even press their friends to introduce them to someone suitable.
老人们聚在一起，最喜欢聊家常：子女、养老、健康等等。
Lǎorénmen jù zài yìqǐ, zuì xǐhuan liáo jiācháng: zǐnǚ, yǎnglǎo, jiànkāng děngděng.
When old people get together, they like talking about family matters best: children, retirement, health and so on.
他们喜欢说哪家的老人有福气，孩子有出息，把父母接到一线城市去享福了；
Tāmen xǐhuan shuō nǎ jiā de lǎorén yǒu fúqi, háizi yǒu chūxi, bǎ fùmǔ jiēdào yī xiàn chéngshì qù xiǎng fú le;
They like to say whose parents are lucky, with successful children who've taken them to live in a big city;
谁家的老人很可怜，孩子不孝顺。
shéi jiā de lǎorén hěn kělián, háizi bú xiàoshùn.
or whose parents are to be pitied, with children who don't look after them.
他们很关心哪儿的商品又减价了，爱打听谁月薪有多少，怎么还没生孩子，买没买房，
Tāmen hěn guānxīn nǎr de shāngpǐn yòu jiǎnjià le, ài dǎting shéi yuèxīn yǒu duōshǎo, zěnme hái méi shēng háizi, mǎi méi mǎi fáng,
They care about where things are on sale, and like to find out who earns how much, why someone hasn't had a baby yet, whether they've bought a flat,
或者说说最近身体怎么样，犯了什么病，医疗费花了多少。
huòzhě shuōshuo zuìjìn shēntǐ zěnmeyàng, fàn le shénme bìng, yīliáofèi huā le duōshǎo.
or talk about how they've been lately, what illness has flared up, and how much they've spent on medical bills.
外国朋友跟中国朋友聚在一起时，常常会聊他们在中国的生活，或者对这个城市的印象。
Wàiguó péngyou gēn Zhōngguó péngyou jù zài yìqǐ shí, chángcháng huì liáo tāmen zài Zhōngguó de shēnghuó, huòzhě duì zhège chéngshì de yìnxiàng.
When foreign and Chinese friends get together, they often talk about life in China or their impressions of the city.
他们也常常聊假期、旅行，讨论什么才是地道的中国菜，
Tāmen yě chángcháng liáo jiàqī, lǚxíng, tǎolùn shénme cái shì dìdao de Zhōngguó cài,
They also chat about holidays and travel, discuss what real Chinese food is,
或者互相介绍几句自己国家的俗话，互相学几句外语什么的。
huòzhě hùxiāng jièshào jǐ jù zìjǐ guójiā de súhuà, hùxiāng xué jǐ jù wàiyǔ shénme de.
or teach each other a few sayings from their countries and a few words of each other's languages.

blocks.label: 方式
lines: 有的人喜欢泡杯茶，
Yǒu de rén xǐhuan pào bēi chá,
Some people like to make a pot of tea,
有的人喜欢泡杯茶，面对面地坐着聊，
yǒu de rén xǐhuan pào bēi chá, miànduìmiàn de zuò zhe liáo,
some people like to make a pot of tea and sit and chat face to face,
因为他们觉得面对面的交流更真实、更可靠。
yīnwèi tāmen juéde miànduìmiàn de jiāoliú gèng zhēnshí, gèng kěkào.
because they feel face-to-face conversation is more real and more reliable.
也有的人喜欢打开聊天软件，在网络上聊天。
Yě yǒu de rén xǐhuan dǎkāi liáotiān ruǎnjiàn, zài wǎngluò shàng liáotiān.
Others like to open a chat app and chat online.
对他们来说，对着手机、电脑聊天更轻松、更自在。
Duì tāmen lái shuō, duìzhe shǒujī, diànnǎo liáotiān gèng qīngsōng, gèng zìzài.
For them, chatting to a phone or computer screen is more relaxed and more comfortable.

blocks.label: 比较
lines: 不管是在网上还是在现实生活中聊天，都有一部分人特别喜欢比来比去。
Bùguǎn shì zài wǎng shang háishi zài xiànshí shēnghuó zhōng liáotiān, dōu yǒu yí bùfen rén tèbié xǐhuan bǐ lái bǐ qù.
Whether online or in real life, some people love comparing themselves with others.
有的比谁更穷，有的比谁更富，有的晒幸福，有的比辛苦。
Yǒu de bǐ shéi gèng qióng, yǒu de bǐ shéi gèng fù, yǒu de shài xìngfú, yǒu de bǐ xīnkǔ.
Some compete over who's poorer, some over who's richer; some show off their happiness, some compete over how hard their life is.
有的父母喜欢拿孩子来比较，哪家的孩子让父母省心，哪家的让家长操心。
Yǒu de fùmǔ xǐhuan ná háizi lái bǐjiào, nǎ jiā de háizi ràng fùmǔ shěngxīn, nǎ jiā de ràng jiāzhǎng cāoxīn.
Some parents like comparing children: whose child gives no trouble, whose is a constant worry.
有的妻子喜欢拿丈夫来跟别人比，谁很懒，谁常做家务，谁更有本事，谁更能赚钱，谁更疼老婆。
Yǒu de qīzi xǐhuan ná zhàngfū lái gēn biérén bǐ, shéi hěn lǎn, shéi cháng zuò jiāwù, shéi gèng yǒu běnshi, shéi gèng néng zhuànqián, shéi gèng téng lǎopo.
Some wives like comparing husbands: who's lazy, who does the housework, who's more capable, who earns more, who's kinder to his wife.
有的人比着比着就开始吹牛，开始自夸；
Yǒu de rén bǐzhe bǐzhe jiù kāishǐ chuīniú, kāishǐ zìkuā;
Some people compare and compare until they start bragging and blowing their own trumpet;
有的人比着比着就开始心理不平衡，觉得生活不公平。
yǒu de rén bǐzhe bǐzhe jiù kāishǐ xīnlǐ bù pínghéng, juéde shēnghuó bù gōngpíng.
others compare until they feel resentful and think life is unfair.
羡慕强者，可怜弱者，这是一种很普遍的心理。
Xiànmù qiáng zhě, kělián ruò zhě, zhè shì yì zhǒng hěn pǔbiàn de xīnlǐ.
Envying the strong and pitying the weak is a very common attitude.
怪不得有人说，别人难过时，不应该告诉对方：“放心吧，一切都会好起来的。”
Guàibùdé yǒu rén shuō, biérén nánguò shí, bù yīnggāi gàosu duìfāng: "Fàngxīn ba, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo qǐlái de."
No wonder some say that when someone's upset, you shouldn't tell them, "Don't worry, everything will be fine."
而应该苦着脸说：“哭什么，你看我还不如你呢。”
Ér yīnggāi kǔzhe liǎn shuō: "Kū shénme, nǐ kàn wǒ hái bùrú nǐ ne."
Instead you should pull a long face and say, "What are you crying for? I'm even worse off than you."

blocks.label: 话题难找
blocks.h: 聊天的难处 · When chatting is hard
lines: 看起来，聊天的话题似乎多得数不完，随便找一个就可以聊得很热闹。
Kàn qilai, liáotiān de huàtí sìhū duō de shǔ bu wán, suíbiàn zhǎo yí ge jiù kěyǐ liáo de hěn rènào.
It looks as if there are countless topics, and you can pick any one and have a lively chat.
可惜事实并不是这样。
Kěxī shìshí bìng bú shì zhèyàng.
Unfortunately that's not how it is.
有人叹气说，本来是一个很活泼、自信的人，
Yǒu rén tànqì shuō, běnlái shì yí ge hěn huópō, zìxìn de rén,
Some people sigh that they used to be lively and confident,
却因为不知道应该怎么跟不熟悉的人聊天，所以表现得很沉默。
què yīnwèi bù zhīdao yīnggāi zěnme gēn bù shúxī de rén liáotiān, suǒyǐ biǎoxiàn de hěn chénmò.
but because they don't know how to chat with people they don't know well, they come across as very quiet.
聚会时，一大堆人一起吃饭、喝茶、聊天、讲笑话，
Jùhuì shí, yí dà duī rén yìqǐ chī fàn, hēchá, liáotiān, jiǎng xiàohuà,
At gatherings, a big crowd eats, drinks tea, chats and tells jokes;
虽然热闹，但自己就是不太容易进入话题，只能一言不发，乖乖做听众。
suīrán rènào, dàn zìjǐ jiùshì bú tài róngyì jìnrù huàtí, zhǐ néng yì yán bù fā, guāiguāi zuò tīngzhòng.
it's lively, but they just can't join in, so they sit silent and listen obediently.
久而久之，连自己都开始怀疑自己不善于跟人交流。
Jiǔ ér jiǔ zhī, lián zìjǐ dōu kāishǐ huáiyí zìjǐ bú shànyú gēn rén jiāoliú.
Over time, even they start to doubt whether they're any good at talking to people.
其实聊天这事儿，对象很重要。跟有共同语言的人，自然有话题。
Qíshí liáotiān zhè shìr, duìxiàng hěn zhòngyào. Gēn yǒu gòngtóng yǔyán de rén, zìrán yǒu huàtí.
Actually, with chatting, who you're talking to matters. With people you have things in common with, there's naturally plenty to say.
但聊天也要看情绪。
Dàn liáotiān yě yào kàn qíngxù.
But chatting also depends on mood.
可能突然在某个时候，你愿意说点什么，对方又正好愿意听点什么，那么话题就自然地打开了。
Kěnéng tūrán zài mǒu ge shíhou, nǐ yuànyì shuō diǎn shénme, duìfāng yòu zhènghǎo yuànyì tīng diǎn shénme, nàme huàtí jiù zìrán de dǎkāi le.
Maybe suddenly, at some moment, you feel like saying something and the other person happens to feel like listening, and the conversation opens up naturally.
聊天应该是一件有意思的事情。
Liáotiān yīnggāi shì yí jiàn yǒuyìsi de shìqing.
Chatting should be fun.
如果你是一个积极主动的人，那么可以不停地换话题，寻找双方都感兴趣的那个。
Rúguǒ nǐ shì yí ge jījí zhǔdòng de rén, nàme kěyǐ bù tíng de huàn huàtí, xúnzhǎo shuāngfāng dōu gǎn xìngqù de nàge.
If you're an outgoing person, you can keep changing the subject until you find one you're both interested in.
如果你是一个被动的人，不如耐心地等待合适的对象和话题。
Rúguǒ nǐ shì yí ge bèidòng de rén, bùrú nàixīn de děngdài héshì de duìxiàng hé huàtí.
If you're more passive, you might as well wait patiently for the right person and topic.
总之，多旅行、多阅读、多思考，这些都是可以提供更有营养的谈话。
Zǒngzhī, duō lǚxíng, duō yuèdú, duō sīkǎo, zhèxiē dōu shì kěyǐ tígōng gèng yǒu yíngyǎng de tánhuà.
In short, travel more, read more and think more: all of these make for more nourishing conversation.
否则，聊天就像一杯白开水，
Fǒuzé, liáotiān jiù xiàng yì bēi báikāishuǐ,
Otherwise, chatting is like a glass of plain water:
聊的只有“最近的天真蓝”“你的工作忙不忙”“冬天暖气该来了吧”之类的话题，
liáo de zhǐyǒu "zuìjìn de tiān zhēn lán" "nǐ de gōngzuò máng bu máng" "dōngtiān nuǎnqì gāi lái le ba" zhīlèi de huàtí,
all you talk about is "the sky's so blue lately", "are you busy at work?", "the heating should be on soon this winter" and the like.
好像聊了很多，却又回想不起来聊了些什么。
hǎoxiàng liáo le hěn duō, què yòu huíxiǎng bu qǐlái liáo le xiē shénme.
You seem to have talked a lot, yet you can't remember what you talked about.

vocab: to be good to one's parents
grammar: whereas …
Contrasts two subjects; formal.
在人们的印象中，女人爱聊天，而男人则比较沉默。
Zài rénmen de yìnxiàng zhōng, nǚrén ài liáotiān, ér nánrén zé bǐjiào chénmò.
People tend to think women love chatting while men are rather quiet.
他喜欢动，而我则喜欢静。
Tā xǐhuan dòng, ér wǒ zé xǐhuan jìng.
He likes being active, whereas I prefer quiet.
在……问题上
on the question of …
Limits the scope.
但最近的一个研究却发现，在闲聊这个问题上，男性和女性几乎是一样的。
Dàn zuìjìn de yí ge yánjiū què fāxiàn, zài xiánliáo zhège wèntí shàng, nánxìng hé nǚxìng jīhū shì yíyàng de.
But a recent study found that when it comes to small talk, men and women are almost the same.
在这个问题上，我们意见不同。
Zài zhège wèntí shàng, wǒmen yìjiàn bùtóng.
We disagree on this question.
从……到……，什么都……
from … to …, anything …
Lists a range.
从娱乐新闻到个人投资，从生活小事到国家大事，什么都可以聊。
cóng yúlè xīnwén dào gèrén tóuzī, cóng shēnghuó xiǎoshì dào guójiā dàshì, shénme dōu kěyǐ liáo.
from celebrity news to personal investments, from little things in life to national affairs. Anything goes.
从吃的到用的，什么都有。
Cóng chī de dào yòng de, shénme dōu yǒu.
From food to everyday goods, there's everything.
要么……，要么……
either … or …
Gives alternatives.
要么讨论一下哪支足球队踢得好，某个游戏怎么玩，要么聊聊汽车、运动或美食。
yàome tǎolùn yíxià nǎ zhī zúqiúduì tī de hǎo, mǒu ge yóuxì zěnme wán, yàome liáoliao qìchē, yùndòng huò měishí.
or discuss which football team plays well or how to play some game, or chat about cars, sport or good food.
要么你来，要么我去。
Yàome nǐ lái, yàome wǒ qù.
Either you come or I go.
……之类的
and so on, that sort of thing
Ends a list of examples.
她们也喜欢聊逛街、购物、减肥之类的话题。
Tāmen yě xǐhuan liáo guàng jiē, gòuwù, jiǎnféi zhīlèi de huàtí.
They also like topics such as window-shopping, shopping and dieting.
我喜欢苹果、香蕉之类的水果。
Wǒ xǐhuan píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo zhīlèi de shuǐguǒ.
I like fruit like apples and bananas.
V着V着就……
while … , end up …
Something gradually changes.
有的人比着比着就开始吹牛，开始自夸；
Yǒu de rén bǐzhe bǐzhe jiù kāishǐ chuīniú, kāishǐ zìkuā;
Some people compare and compare until they start bragging and blowing their own trumpet;
他看着看着就睡着了。
Tā kànzhe kànzhe jiù shuìzháo le.
He fell asleep while watching.
怪不得
no wonder
Shows sudden understanding.
怪不得有人说，别人难过时，不应该告诉对方：“放心吧，一切都会好起来的。”
Guàibùdé yǒu rén shuō, biérén nánguò shí, bù yīnggāi gàosu duìfāng: "Fàngxīn ba, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo qǐlái de."
No wonder some say that when someone's upset, you shouldn't tell them, "Don't worry, everything will be fine."
怪不得他这么高兴。
Guàibùdé tā zhème gāoxìng.
No wonder he's so happy.
多得数不完
too many to count
得 + complement shows degree.
看起来，聊天的话题似乎多得数不完，随便找一个就可以聊得很热闹。
Kàn qilai, liáotiān de huàtí sìhū duō de shǔ bu wán, suíbiàn zhǎo yí ge jiù kěyǐ liáo de hěn rènào.
It looks as if there are countless topics, and you can pick any one and have a lively chat.
星星多得数不清。
Xīngxīng duō de shǔ bu qīng.
There are too many stars to count.
不如……
might as well …
Gives the better choice.
如果你是一个被动的人，不如耐心地等待合适的对象和话题。
Rúguǒ nǐ shì yí ge bèidòng de rén, bùrú nàixīn de děngdài héshì de duìxiàng hé huàtí.
If you're more passive, you might as well wait patiently for the right person and topic.
不如我们明天再去。
Bùrú wǒmen míngtiān zài qù.
We might as well go tomorrow.
gaps: 女人们也许会谈谈自己的生活：爱情、婚姻、
老人们聚在一起，最喜欢
因为他们觉得面对面的交流更真实、更
有的人比着比着就开始
连自己都开始怀疑自己不
say: Chatting should be fun.
Actually, with chatting, who you're talking to matters. With people you have things in common with, there's naturally plenty to say.

093.title: Vocabulary and phrases
093.sub: Lesson 7 · 南北差异 North and south: 48 words, each read in short phrases
093.transcriptNote: Each word is read once, then used in a few short phrases. Item numbers that the recording swallows are filled in by order. Several short words that the models couldn't pick out (湿, 冰, 点, 顾客, 辣, 麻, 拦, 俺, 撑, 假装, 躲, 好面子, 咋, 贼, 好) have hand-set timings. 俺, 咋 and 贼 are northern colloquial words: 俺 = 我, 咋 = 怎么, 贼 = 非常. Word 19, 猪, is only read inside its phrases.

blocks.label: 课
lines: 第七课，南北差异。
Dì-qī kè, nán běi chāyì.
Lesson 7: differences between north and south.
听说部分。
Tīng-shuō bùfen.
Listening and speaking.
听读生词和词组。
Tīng dú shēngcí hé cízǔ.
Listen to and read the new words and phrases.
主食
zhǔshí
staple food (rice, noodles, bread)
我们要什么主食？
Wǒmen yào shénme zhǔshí?
what shall we have as the staple?
湿
shī
wet
地上都湿了
dì shang dōu shī le
the ground is all wet

bǎ yīfu nòng shī le

冰
bīng
ice
水冻成冰了
shuǐ dòng chéng bīng le
the water has frozen into ice
放块冰
fàng kuài bīng
put in an ice cube
冰箱
bīngxiāng
fridge

diǎn

lines: 这还不说
zhè hái bù shuō
and that's not all
这还不说，还得
zhè hái bù shuō, hái děi
not only that, but also
顾客
gùkè
customer
让顾客满意

用碗盛饭

你说我今天这个倒霉呀！碰到了一个顾客，偏偏说我家的猪肉汤面不新鲜，
Nǐ shuō wǒ jīntiān zhège dǎoméi ya! Pèngdào le yí ge gùkè, piānpiān shuō wǒ jiā de zhūròu tāngmiàn bù xīnxiān,
Talk about bad luck today! I got a customer who insisted our pork noodle soup wasn't fresh,
我想睡觉，他偏偏来了。
Wǒ xiǎng shuì jiào, tā piānpiān lái le.
Just as I wanted to sleep, he turned up.
说什么都不……
absolutely refuse to …
说什么都 = no matter what.
吃完饭后说什么都不付钱，鼻子都快被他气歪了。
chīwán fàn hòu shuō shénme dōu bú fùqián, bízi dōu kuài bèi tā qì wāi le.
and after eating he flatly refused to pay. I was absolutely fuming.
他说什么都不去。
Tā shuō shénme dōu bú qù.
He absolutely won't go.
谁知道……
who'd have thought …
Marks a surprise.
刚想出门，谁知道偏偏被我爸看见了。
Gāng xiǎng chūmén, shéi zhīdao piānpiān bèi wǒ bà kànjiàn le.
I was just about to go out when, wouldn't you know it, my dad saw me.
谁知道他也来了。
Shéi zhīdao tā yě lái le.
Who'd have thought he'd come too.
好不容易
with great difficulty
Same meaning as 好容易.
我好不容易吃完了面，付了钱，连嘴都不想擦，只想赶快离开。
Wǒ hǎobùróngyì chī wán le miàn, fù le qián, lián zuǐ dōu bù xiǎng cā, zhǐ xiǎng gǎnkuài líkāi.
I finally managed to finish the noodles and paid. I didn't even want to wipe my mouth; I just wanted to get out of there.
我好不容易才找到他。
Wǒ hǎobùróngyì cái zhǎodào tā.
I found him only after a lot of trouble.
gaps: 得我半年没敢再去找他。

097.title: Spot the repeated word
097.sub: Five pairs of sentences, one shared word in each
097.transcriptNote: Each pair repeats one of the lesson 7 words. Turn on Answers to check. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
你将听到五组句子，请找出各组句子中重复出现的词语。
Nǐ jiāng tīngdào wǔ zǔ jùzi, qǐng zhǎo chū gè zǔ jùzi zhōng chóngfù chūxiàn de cíyǔ.
You'll hear five groups of sentences. Find the word repeated in each group.
那家饭店用大盆盛饭，吓死我了。
Nà jiā fàndiàn yòng dà pén chéng fàn, xià sǐ wǒ le.
That restaurant serves rice in great big basins. It scared me to death.
A
小雨，去给你爸盛一碗饭，用大碗盛。
Xiǎoyǔ, qù gěi nǐ bà chéng yì wǎn fàn, yòng dà wǎn chéng.
Xiaoyu, go and serve your dad a bowl of rice. Use a big bowl.
B
我们那位新来的小老师可厉害了，听说她会说五种语言呢。
Wǒmen nà wèi xīn lái de xiǎo lǎoshī kě lìhài le, tīngshuō tā huì shuō wǔ zhǒng yǔyán ne.
That new young teacher of ours is amazing. I hear she speaks five languages.
A
我得去医院看医生，我的肚子疼得太厉害了。
Wǒ děi qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng, wǒ de dǔzi téng de tài lìhài le.
I need to go to the hospital and see a doctor. My stomach hurts terribly.
B
慢点吃，别撑着，还有很多面条呢。
Màn diǎn chī, bié chēngzhe, hái yǒu hěn duō miàntiáo ne.
Eat slowly, don't stuff yourself. There's plenty more noodles.
A
昨天同学聚会，吃得太多了，差点撑死我，今天我不吃饭了。
Zuótiān tóngxué jùhuì, chī de tài duō le, chàdiǎn chēng sǐ wǒ, jīntiān wǒ bù chī fàn le.
At yesterday's class reunion I ate far too much. I nearly burst. I'm not eating today.
B
你喜欢人家，就别假装说不喜欢，别以为我们看不出来。
Nǐ xǐhuan rénjia, jiù bié jiǎzhuāng shuō bù xǐhuan, bié yǐwéi wǒmen kàn bu chūlái.
If you like her, don't pretend you don't. Don't think we can't tell.
A
她假装不高兴地说：“你怎么这么长时间不给我打电话？”
Tā jiǎzhuāng bù gāoxìng de shuō: "Nǐ zěnme zhème cháng shíjiān bù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà?"
Pretending to be cross, she said: "Why haven't you phoned me for so long?"
B
什么？一碗汤面五十元？你们上了那家饭店的当了。
Shénme? Yì wǎn tāngmiàn wǔshí yuán? Nǐmen shàng le nà jiā fàndiàn de dàng le.
What? Fifty yuan for a bowl of noodle soup? That restaurant ripped you off.
A
我发现最近特别倒霉，又是买东西上当，又是感冒发烧。
Wǒ fāxiàn zuìjìn tèbié dǎoméi, yòu shì mǎi dōngxi shàng dàng, yòu shì gǎnmào fāshāo.
I've been really unlucky lately: what with getting ripped off when shopping and coming down with a cold and fever.
B

grammar: 吓死我了
it scared me to death
V + 死 + me + 了 exaggerates.
那家饭店用大盆盛饭，吓死我了。
Nà jiā fàndiàn yòng dà pén chéng fàn, xià sǐ wǒ le.
That restaurant serves rice in great big basins. It scared me to death.
你吓死我了！
Nǐ xià sǐ wǒ le!
You scared me to death!
可 + adj + 了
really …
Spoken emphasis.
我们那位新来的小老师可厉害了，听说她会说五种语言呢。
Wǒmen nà wèi xīn lái de xiǎo lǎoshī kě lìhài le, tīngshuō tā huì shuō wǔ zhǒng yǔyán ne.
That new young teacher of ours is amazing. I hear she speaks five languages.
这个菜可辣了。
Zhège cài kě là le.
This dish is really spicy.
差点 + V
nearly …
Something almost happened.
昨天同学聚会，吃得太多了，差点撑死我，今天我不吃饭了。
Zuótiān tóngxué jùhuì, chī de tài duō le, chàdiǎn chēng sǐ wǒ, jīntiān wǒ bù chī fàn le.
At yesterday's class reunion I ate far too much. I nearly burst. I'm not eating today.
我差点忘了。
Wǒ chàdiǎn wàng le.
I nearly forgot.
别以为……
don't think …
Warns against an assumption.
你喜欢人家，就别假装说不喜欢，别以为我们看不出来。
Nǐ xǐhuan rénjia, jiù bié jiǎzhuāng shuō bù xǐhuan, bié yǐwéi wǒmen kàn bu chūlái.
If you like her, don't pretend you don't. Don't think we can't tell.
别以为我不知道。
Bié yǐwéi wǒ bù zhīdao.
Don't think I don't know.
又是……，又是……
what with … and …
Lists troubles.
我发现最近特别倒霉，又是买东西上当，又是感冒发烧。
Wǒ fāxiàn zuìjìn tèbié dǎoméi, yòu shì mǎi dōngxi shàng dàng, yòu shì gǎnmào fāshāo.
I've been really unlucky lately: what with getting ripped off when shopping and coming down with a cold and fever.
又是下雨，又是刮风。
Yòu shì xià yǔ, yòu shì guāfēng.
What with the rain and the wind.

098.title: Do the two sentences match?
098.sub: Five pairs about life in the north
098.transcriptNote: Each item has two sentences, A and B. Decide whether they mean the same thing, then turn on Answers. The letter B isn't read aloud. The answers are my own judgement.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断意思是否相符 · Same meaning?
lines: 听录音，判断两个句子的意思是否相符。
Tīng lùyīn, pànduàn liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu xiāngfú.
Listen and decide whether the two sentences mean the same.
我刚搬到北方的第一年，不习惯北方人的热情。
Wǒ gāng bān dào běifāng de dì-yī nián, bù xíguàn běifāng rén de rèqíng.
In my first year after moving north, I wasn't used to how warm northerners are.
A
刚开始来北方生活的时候，我很不适应北方人的热情。
Gāng kāishǐ lái běifāng shēnghuó de shíhou, wǒ hěn bú shìyìng běifāng rén de rèqíng.
When I first came to live in the north, I had trouble adjusting to northerners' warmth.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say the speaker wasn't used to northern friendliness at first.

lines: 东北地区的主食是大米，华北地区的主食是面食。
Dōngběi dìqū de zhǔshí shì dàmǐ, Huáběi dìqū de zhǔshí shì miànshí.
The staple in the north-east is rice; the staple in north China is wheaten food.
A
东北地区的居民常常吃米饭，华北地区的居民常常吃用面做的食品。
Dōngběi dìqū de jūmín chángcháng chī mǐfàn, Huáběi dìqū de jūmín chángcháng chī yòng miàn zuò de shípǐn.
People in the north-east often eat rice; people in north China often eat food made from flour.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: 面食 means food made from flour, so both say the same.

lines: 我当时就傻了，一句话也说不出来，只好假装高兴的样子吃面。
Wǒ dāngshí jiù shǎ le, yí jù huà yě shuō bu chūlái, zhǐhǎo jiǎzhuāng gāoxìng de yàngzi chī miàn.
I was stunned and couldn't say a word, so I just pretended to be happy and ate the noodles.
A
我当时很不聪明，什么也说不出来，只是高高兴兴地吃面。
Wǒ dāngshí hěn bù cōngmíng, shénme yě shuō bu chūlái, zhǐshì gāogāoxìngxìng de chī miàn.
I wasn't very clever then; I couldn't say anything and just happily ate the noodles.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: In A, 傻了 means stunned and the speaker only pretends to be happy; B says she was not clever and really was happy.

lines: 我的鼻子差点被气歪了。
Wǒ de bízi chàdiǎn bèi qì wāi le.
I was absolutely fuming.
A
我都快被气死了。
Wǒ dōu kuài bèi qì sǐ le.
I was nearly dying of anger.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both are ways of saying the speaker was furious.

lines: 后来快到他家饭店的时候，为了躲过这位热心的老板，我都故意绕一大圈。
Hòulái kuài dào tā jiā fàndiàn de shíhou, wèile duǒ guo zhè wèi rèxīn de lǎobǎn, wǒ dōu gùyì rào yí dà quān.
Later, whenever I got near his restaurant, I deliberately went a long way round to avoid that over-friendly owner.
A
后来我很害怕遇见这位热心的老板，我总是故意躲着他。
Hòulái wǒ hěn hàipà yùjiàn zhè wèi rèxīn de lǎobǎn, wǒ zǒngshì gùyì duǒzhe tā.
Later I was scared of running into that over-friendly owner and always avoided him on purpose.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say the speaker deliberately avoided the owner.

grammar: 一句话也说不出来
couldn't say a single word
一 + measure + 也 + negative = not even one.
我当时就傻了，一句话也说不出来，只好假装高兴的样子吃面。
Wǒ dāngshí jiù shǎ le, yí jù huà yě shuō bu chūlái, zhǐhǎo jiǎzhuāng gāoxìng de yàngzi chī miàn.
I was stunned and couldn't say a word, so I just pretended to be happy and ate the noodles.
他一口饭也没吃。
Tā yì kǒu fàn yě méi chī.
He didn't eat a single mouthful.
只好……
had no choice but to …
The only option left.
我当时就傻了，一句话也说不出来，只好假装高兴的样子吃面。
Wǒ dāngshí jiù shǎ le, yí jù huà yě shuō bu chūlái, zhǐhǎo jiǎzhuāng gāoxìng de yàngzi chī miàn.
I was stunned and couldn't say a word, so I just pretended to be happy and ate the noodles.
没有车，只好走路。
Méiyǒu chē, zhǐhǎo zǒu lù.
No car, so we had to walk.
差点被……
nearly got …
差点 + passive.
我的鼻子差点被气歪了。
Wǒ de bízi chàdiǎn bèi qì wāi le.
I was absolutely fuming.
我差点被车撞了。
Wǒ chàdiǎn bèi chē zhuàng le.
I was nearly hit by a car.
为了……
in order to …
Gives a purpose.
后来快到他家饭店的时候，为了躲过这位热心的老板，我都故意绕一大圈。
Hòulái kuài dào tā jiā fàndiàn de shíhou, wèile duǒ guo zhè wèi rèxīn de lǎobǎn, wǒ dōu gùyì rào yí dà quān.
Later, whenever I got near his restaurant, I deliberately went a long way round to avoid that over-friendly owner.
为了身体健康，他每天跑步。
Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, tā měitiān pǎo bù.
He runs every day to stay healthy.

099.title: Myths about north and south
099.sub: Seven wrong ideas about Chinese north–south habits
099.transcriptNote: Each statement is a mistaken idea about life in northern and southern China. Say why it's wrong, then turn on Answers. Items 2 and 6 aren't numbered aloud. The answers are my own reasoning.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
下面是对中国南北方生活习惯的错误理解，请你说说为什么这些观点是错的。
Xiàmiàn shì duì Zhōngguó nán-běi fāng shēnghuó xíguàn de cuòwù lǐjiě, qǐng nǐ shuōshuo wèishénme zhèxiē guāndiǎn shì cuò de.
Here are some mistaken ideas about the habits of northern and southern China. Explain why each is wrong.

q: 北方的冬天特别冷，北方人都不怕冷，因为习惯了。
Běifāng de dōngtiān tèbié lěng, běifāng rén dōu bú pà lěng, yīnwèi xíguàn le.
Northern winters are very cold, but northerners aren't afraid of the cold because they're used to it.
ans: 北方人也怕冷，只是北方室内有暖气，外面冷屋里暖和。
Běifāng rén yě pà lěng, zhǐshì běifāng shìnèi yǒu nuǎnqì, wàimian lěng wū li nuǎnhuo.
Northerners feel the cold too; it's just that northern homes have central heating, so it's cold outside but warm indoors.

q: 南方的冬天没有暖气，天气也不冷，所以南方的冬天很舒服。
Nánfāng de dōngtiān méiyǒu nuǎnqì, tiānqì yě bù lěng, suǒyǐ nánfāng de dōngtiān hěn shūfu.
In the south there's no central heating in winter, and it isn't cold, so southern winters are comfortable.
ans: 南方冬天又湿又冷，屋里没有暖气，常常比北方屋里还冷，并不舒服。
Nánfāng dōngtiān yòu shī yòu lěng, wū li méiyǒu nuǎnqì, chángcháng bǐ běifāng wū li hái lěng, bìng bù shūfu.
Southern winters are damp and cold, and without heating it's often colder indoors than in the north, so it isn't comfortable at all.

q: 北方人的个子高，所以所有北方人都比南方人高，所有的南方人都比北方人矮。
Běifāng rén de gèzi gāo, suǒyǐ suǒyǒu běifāng rén dōu bǐ nánfāng rén gāo, suǒyǒu de nánfāng rén dōu bǐ běifāng rén ǎi.
Northerners are tall, so all northerners are taller than southerners and all southerners are shorter than northerners.
ans: 这只是平均来说，不能说所有人都是这样，南方也有很高的人，北方也有矮的人。
Zhè zhǐshì píngjūn lái shuō, bù néng shuō suǒyǒu rén dōu shì zhèyàng, nánfāng yě yǒu hěn gāo de rén, běifāng yě yǒu ǎi de rén.
That's only on average. You can't say it's true of everyone: there are tall southerners and short northerners.

q: 北方人以面食为主食，南方人以大米为主食，所以北方人不常吃米饭，南方人不常吃面。
Běifāng rén yǐ miànshí wéi zhǔshí, nánfāng rén yǐ dàmǐ wéi zhǔshí, suǒyǐ běifāng rén bù cháng chī mǐfàn, nánfāng rén bù cháng chī miàn.
Northerners mainly eat wheaten food and southerners mainly eat rice, so northerners rarely eat rice and southerners rarely eat noodles.
ans: 主食不同不等于不吃别的。东北人也常吃大米，南方也有很多有名的面条和小吃。
Zhǔshí bùtóng bù děngyú bù chī biéde. Dōngběi rén yě cháng chī dàmǐ, nánfāng yě yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de miàntiáo hé xiǎochī.
Different staples don't mean people never eat the other. North-easterners often eat rice, and the south has many famous noodle dishes and snacks.

q: 北方男人都是大男子主义，就是说，在家里，女人要听男人的话，男人决定的事，女人不能反对。
Běifāng nánrén dōu shì dà nánzǐ zhǔyì, jiùshì shuō, zài jiā li, nǚrén yào tīng nánrén dehuà, nánrén juédìng de shì, nǚrén bù néng fǎnduì.
Northern men are all chauvinists: at home the woman must do as the man says and can't object to his decisions.
ans: 不能说所有北方男人都这样，很多北方家庭是夫妻一起商量，也有不少家是妻子说了算。
Bù néng shuō suǒyǒu běifāng nánrén dōu zhèyàng, hěn duō běifāng jiātíng shì fūqī yìqǐ shāngliang, yě yǒu bù shǎo jiā shì qīzi shuōlesuàn.
You can't say all northern men are like that. Many northern couples decide things together, and in plenty of families the wife has the final say.

q: 南方人和北方人都是中国人，都过春节，过春节都一定要吃饺子。
Nánfāng rén hé běifāng rén dōu shì Zhōngguórén, dōu guò Chūn Jié, guò Chūn Jié dōu yídìng yào chī jiǎozi.
Southerners and northerners are all Chinese and all celebrate the Spring Festival, so they must all eat dumplings at New Year.
ans: 吃饺子主要是北方的习惯，很多南方人过春节吃年糕、汤圆或者别的菜。
Chī jiǎozi zhǔyào shì běifāng de xíguàn, hěn duō nánfāng rén guò Chūn Jié chī niángāo, tāngyuán huòzhě biéde cài.
Eating dumplings is mainly a northern custom. Many southerners eat New Year cake, sweet rice balls or other dishes instead.

q: 北方人爱喝酒，喝得比较多；南方人不喝酒，只喝茶。
Běifāng rén ài hējiǔ, hē de bǐjiào duō; nánfāng rén bù hējiǔ, zhǐ hēchá.
Northerners love drinking and drink a lot; southerners don't drink alcohol, only tea.
ans: 南方人也喝酒，比如绍兴有有名的黄酒；北方人也喝茶。只是习惯和喝法不太一样。
Nánfāng rén yě hējiǔ, bǐrú shàoxīng yǒu yǒumíng de huángjiǔ; běifāng rén yě hēchá. Zhǐshì xíguàn hé hē fǎ bú tài yíyàng.
Southerners drink alcohol too (Shaoxing is famous for its yellow wine), and northerners drink tea. It's just that the habits differ.

grammar: 以……为主食
to have … as the staple
以 A 为 B = take A as B.
北方人以面食为主食，南方人以大米为主食，所以北方人不常吃米饭，南方人不常吃面。
Běifāng rén yǐ miànshí wéi zhǔshí, nánfāng rén yǐ dàmǐ wéi zhǔshí, suǒyǐ běifāng rén bù cháng chī mǐfàn, nánfāng rén bù cháng chī miàn.
Northerners mainly eat wheaten food and southerners mainly eat rice, so northerners rarely eat rice and southerners rarely eat noodles.
他们以米饭为主食。
Tāmen yǐ mǐfàn wéi zhǔ shí.
Rice is their staple.
所有……都……
all …
所有 with 都 for every member.
北方人的个子高，所以所有北方人都比南方人高，所有的南方人都比北方人矮。
Běifāng rén de gèzi gāo, suǒyǐ suǒyǒu běifāng rén dōu bǐ nánfāng rén gāo, suǒyǒu de nánfāng rén dōu bǐ běifāng rén ǎi.
Northerners are tall, so all northerners are taller than southerners and all southerners are shorter than northerners.
所有的学生都来了。
Suǒyǒu de xuésheng dōu lái le.
All the students came.
就是说
that is to say
Explains what came before.
北方男人都是大男子主义，就是说，在家里，女人要听男人的话，男人决定的事，女人不能反对。
Běifāng nánrén dōu shì dà nánzǐ zhǔyì, jiùshì shuō, zài jiā li, nǚrén yào tīng nánrén dehuà, nánrén juédìng de shì, nǚrén bù néng fǎnduì.
Northern men are all chauvinists: at home the woman must do as the man says and can't object to his decisions.
他没来，就是说他不想去。
Tā méi lái, jiùshì shuō tā bù xiǎng qù.
He didn't come, which means he doesn't want to go.
only …, not …
Exclusive.
北方人爱喝酒，喝得比较多；南方人不喝酒，只喝茶。
Běifāng rén ài hējiǔ, hē de bǐjiào duō; nánfāng rén bù hējiǔ, zhǐ hēchá.
Northerners love drinking and drink a lot; southerners don't drink alcohol, only tea.
他只吃菜，不吃肉。
Tā zhǐ chī cài, bù chī ròu.
He only eats vegetables, not meat.
gaps: 下面是对中国南北方生活习惯的
所有的南方人都比北方人

100.title: Surprises north and south
100.sub: A southerner's first northern winter, and a northerner's first southern one
100.transcriptNote: Zhang Tian comes from Guangdong in the south and moved north; Lin Jia comes from Changchun in the north-east and went to university in Nanchang in the south. 张 is Zhang Tian and 林 is Lin Jia. The answer is my own summary.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the question.
张田是南方人，林佳是北方人。他们在北方和南方遇到了什么新鲜事或问题？
Zhāng Tián shì nánfāng rén, Lín Jiā shì běifāng rén. Tāmen zài běifāng hé nánfāng yùdào le shénme xīnxiān shì huò wèntí?
Zhang Tian is a southerner and Lin Jia is a northerner. What surprises or problems did they meet in the north and the south?

q: 他们在北方和南方遇到了什么新鲜事或问题？
Tāmen zài běifāng hé nánfāng yùdào le shénme xīnxiān shì huò wèntí?
What surprises or problems did they meet?
ans: 张田在北方：冬天竟然不下雨，地上是干的；下雪后雪能冻上，天上还出太阳；衣服两天就干了；看见小河里的水冻成冰，非常激动。林佳在南方：她以为南方不冷，只带了一件大衣，结果南昌冬天下大雪，没有暖气，她冻得躲在被窝里；南方同学看见雪很兴奋，她却很生气。

Zhāng Tián zài běifāng: dōngtiān jìngrán bú xià yǔ, dì shang shì gān de; xiàxuě hòu xuě néng dòng shang, tiān shang hái chū tàiyáng; yīfu liǎng tiān jiù gān le; kànjiàn xiǎohé li de shuǐ dòng chéng bīng, fēicháng jīdòng. Lín Jiā zài nánfāng: tā yǐwéi nánfāng bù lěng, zhǐ dài le yí jiàn dàyī, jiéguǒ Nánchāng dōngtiān xià dàxuě, méiyǒu nuǎnqì, tā dòng de duǒ zài bèiwō li; nánfāng tóngxué kànjiàn xuě hěn xīngfèn, tā què hěn shēngqì.

Zhang Tian in the north: amazed that winter brings no rain and the ground is dry, snow freezes and the sun still shines, washing dries in two days, and thrilled to see the river frozen. Lin Jia in the south: she thought it wouldn't be cold and brought only one coat, but it snowed heavily in Nanchang and with no heating she huddled under the covers freezing; her southern classmates were excited about the snow, while she was furious.

blocks.label: 张田
lines: 张田来自广东。
Zhāng Tián láizì Guǎngdōng.
Zhang Tian is from Guangdong.
作为一个地地道道的南方人，到北方后的新鲜事太多了，尤其是冬天。
Zuòwéi yí ge dìdìdàodào de nánfāng rén, dào běifāng hòu de xīnxiān shì tài duō le, yóuqí shì dōngtiān.
As a true southerner, Zhang Tian found plenty of surprises in the north, especially in winter.
北方的冬天竟然不下雨，地上居然是干的，一点也不湿。
Běifāng de dōngtiān jìngrán bú xià yǔ, dì shang jūrán shì gān de, yìdiǎn yě bù shī.
Northern winters actually have no rain; the ground is dry, not wet at all.
下雪后，雪竟然能冻上，而且下雪后，天上还能出太阳。
Xiàxuě hòu, xuě jìngrán néng dòng shang, érqiě xiàxuě hòu, tiān shang hái néng chū tàiyáng.
After snow, the snow actually freezes, and the sun can still come out.
洗完衣服竟然两天就干了。
Xǐ wán yīfu jìngrán liǎng tiān jiù gān le.
Washing actually dries in two days.
刚来北方的时候啊，冬天我看着太阳心想，它那么大，什么时候天气才能开始变冷啊？
Gāng lái běifāng de shíhou a, dōngtiān wǒ kànzhe tàiyáng xīnxiǎng, tā nàme dà, shénme shíhou tiānqì cái néng kāishǐ biàn lěng a?
When I first came north, I'd look at the winter sun and think: it's so big, when will it ever get cold?
张
忽然有一天，我发现学校旁边小河里的水冻成冰了，我倒是好高兴、好激动啊！
Hūrán yǒu yì tiān, wǒ fāxiàn xuéxiào pángbiān xiǎohé li de shuǐ dòng chéng bīng le, wǒ dàoshì hǎo gāoxìng, hǎo jīdòng a!
Then one day I found the little river next to school had frozen. I was so happy, so excited!
张

blocks.label: 林佳
lines: 林佳来自长春。
Lín Jiā láizì Chángchūn.
Lin Jia is from Changchun.
哎，那时候我还是个啥也不懂的东北小女孩儿。那年我要去南昌上大学。
Āi, nà shíhou wǒ háishi ge shá yě bù dǒng de dōngběi xiǎo nǚháir. Nà nián wǒ yào qù Nánchāng shàng dàxué.
Ah, back then I was a little north-eastern girl who knew nothing. That year I was going to university in Nanchang.
林
去南昌前，我妈告我，南方没暖气，天气不冷。我就带了一件儿大衣，高高兴兴地来到了南昌。
Qù Nánchāng qián, wǒ mā gào wǒ, nánfāng méi nuǎnqì, tiānqì bù lěng. Wǒ jiù dài le yí jiànr dàyī, gāogāoxìngxìng de láidào le Nánchāng.
Before I went, my mum told me the south had no heating and it wasn't cold. So I took just one coat and came to Nanchang all happy.
林
谁想到第一个冬天就给我冻傻了。
Shéi xiǎngdào dì-yī ge dōngtiān jiù gěi wǒ dòng shǎ le.
Who'd have thought the very first winter would freeze me stiff?
林
那年冬天，南昌竟然下大雪了，我躲在被窝里冻得像狗一样。
Nà nián dōngtiān, Nánchāng jìngrán xià dàxuě le, wǒ duǒ zài bèiwō li dòng de xiàng gǒu yíyàng.
That winter it actually snowed heavily in Nanchang. I hid under the covers, freezing like a dog.
林
一群南方同学在外面高兴地又唱又跳，一个同学跑到我房间里，一下子掀开我的被子，激动地对我喊：
Yì qún nánfāng tóngxué zài wàimian gāoxìng de yòu chàng yòu tiào, yí ge tóngxué pǎo dào wǒ fángjiān li, yíxiàzi xiānkāi wǒ de bèizi, jīdòng de duì wǒ hǎn:
A crowd of southern classmates were singing and dancing outside. One of them ran into my room, pulled off my quilt and shouted at me excitedly:
林
“别睡了，下雪了！真的，你看，是真雪啊！”
"Bié shuì le, xiàxuě le! Zhēn de, nǐ kàn, shì zhēn xuě a!"
"Wake up, it's snowing! Really, look, it's real snow!"
林
我鼻子差点被气歪了。
Wǒ bízi chàdiǎn bèi qì wāi le.
I was absolutely fuming.
林

grammar: 作为……
as …
Gives a role or identity.
作为一个地地道道的南方人，到北方后的新鲜事太多了，尤其是冬天。
Zuòwéi yí ge dìdìdàodào de nánfāng rén, dào běifāng hòu de xīnxiān shì tài duō le, yóuqí shì dōngtiān.
As a true southerner, Zhang Tian found plenty of surprises in the north, especially in winter.
作为学生，应该好好学习。
Zuòwéi xuésheng, yīnggāi hǎohǎo xuéxí.
As a student, you should study hard.
竟然 / 居然
unexpectedly, actually
Shows surprise.
北方的冬天竟然不下雨，地上居然是干的，一点也不湿。
Běifāng de dōngtiān jìngrán bú xià yǔ, dì shang jūrán shì gān de, yìdiǎn yě bù shī.
Northern winters actually have no rain; the ground is dry, not wet at all.
他竟然忘了我的生日。
Tā jìngrán wàng le wǒ de shēngrì.
He actually forgot my birthday.
一点也不 + adj
not at all …
Total negation.
北方的冬天竟然不下雨，地上居然是干的，一点也不湿。
Běifāng de dōngtiān jìngrán bú xià yǔ, dì shang jūrán shì gān de, yìdiǎn yě bù shī.
Northern winters actually have no rain; the ground is dry, not wet at all.
一点也不冷。
Yìdiǎn yě bù lěng.
Not cold at all.
什么时候才……
when will … ever …?
才 shows impatience.
刚来北方的时候啊，冬天我看着太阳心想，它那么大，什么时候天气才能开始变冷啊？
Gāng lái běifāng de shíhou a, dōngtiān wǒ kànzhe tàiyáng xīnxiǎng, tā nàme dà, shénme shíhou tiānqì cái néng kāishǐ biàn lěng a?
When I first came north, I'd look at the winter sun and think: it's so big, when will it ever get cold?
你什么时候才回来？
Nǐ shénme shíhou cái huílai?
When will you ever come back?
谁想到……
who'd have thought …
Introduces a surprise.
谁想到第一个冬天就给我冻傻了。
Shéi xiǎngdào dì-yī ge dōngtiān jiù gěi wǒ dòng shǎ le.
Who'd have thought the very first winter would freeze me stiff?
谁想到他会来。
Shéi xiǎngdào tā huì lái.
Who'd have thought he'd come?
both … and …
Two actions together.
一群南方同学在外面高兴地又唱又跳，一个同学跑到我房间里，一下子掀开我的被子，激动地对我喊：
Yì qún nánfāng tóngxué zài wàimian gāoxìng de yòu chàng yòu tiào, yí ge tóngxué pǎo dào wǒ fángjiān li, yíxiàzi xiānkāi wǒ de bèizi, jīdòng de duì wǒ hǎn:
A crowd of southern classmates were singing and dancing outside. One of them ran into my room, pulled off my quilt and shouted at me excitedly:
孩子们又哭又笑。
Háizimen yòu kū yòu xiào.
The children laughed and cried.
一下子
all at once
A sudden action.
一群南方同学在外面高兴地又唱又跳，一个同学跑到我房间里，一下子掀开我的被子，激动地对我喊：
Yì qún nánfāng tóngxué zài wàimian gāoxìng de yòu chàng yòu tiào, yí ge tóngxué pǎo dào wǒ fángjiān li, yíxiàzi xiānkāi wǒ de bèizi, jīdòng de duì wǒ hǎn:
A crowd of southern classmates were singing and dancing outside. One of them ran into my room, pulled off my quilt and shouted at me excitedly:
他一下子就明白了。
Tā yíxiàzi jiù míngbai le.
He understood at once.
gaps: 我发现学校旁边小河里的水冻成

roles.林: 林 = Lin Jia, from the north-east
roles.张: 张 = Zhang Tian, from the south

say: Then one day I found the little river next to school had frozen. I was so happy, so excited!
Who'd have thought the very first winter would freeze me stiff?

101.title: Northern China
101.sub: Four true-or-false statements, then a short passage on the north
101.transcriptNote: First four statements to judge, then the passage. Turn on Answers for the true-or-false key. 秦岭 and 淮河 (the Qinling Mountains and the Huai River) are the traditional north–south dividing line.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音并判断句子的正误。
Tīng lùyīn bìng pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false.
请先听四个句子。
Qǐng xiān tīng sì ge jùzi.
First listen to four sentences.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 四个句子 · True or false

q: 北方面积占全国面积的百分之四十，北方人口占全国人口的百分之二十。
Běifāng miànjī zhàn quánguó miànjī de bǎi fēn zhī sìshí, běifāng rénkǒu zhàn quánguó rénkǒu de bǎi fēn zhī èrshí.
The north makes up 40% of China's area and 20% of its population.
qs.why: It's the other way round: about 20% of the area and 40% of the population.

q: 北方冬天天气很冷，很少能看见太阳。
Běifāng dōngtiān tiānqì hěn lěng, hěn shǎo néng kànjiàn tàiyáng.
Northern winters are very cold and you rarely see the sun.
qs.why: Winters are cold, but it's often sunny.

q: 北方人的主食是面食，基本上不吃米饭。
Běifāng rén de zhǔshí shì miànshí, jīběn shang bù chī mǐfàn.
Northerners' staple is wheaten food; they hardly ever eat rice.
qs.why: In the north-east the staple is rice.

q: 北方地区只生产粮食，不生产水果。
Běifāng dìqū zhǐ shēngchǎn liángshí, bù shēngchǎn shuǐguǒ.
The north only produces grain, not fruit.
qs.why: The north also produces a lot of fruit, such as apples and grapes.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 下面请听文章。
Xiàmiàn qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
中国北方。
Zhōngguó běifāng.
Northern China.
北方地区指中国的秦岭、淮河以北。
Běifāng dìqū zhǐ Zhōngguó de Qínlǐng, Huái Hé yǐběi.
The northern region means the part of China north of the Qinling Mountains and the Huai River.
面积大约占全中国的百分之二十，
Miànjī dàyuē zhàn quán Zhōngguó de bǎi fēn zhī èrshí,
Its area is about 20% of China,
人口大约占全中国的百分之四十。
rénkǒu dàyuē zhàn quán Zhōngguó de bǎi fēn zhī sìshí.
and its population about 40%.
北方地区的气候一年四季分明，
Běifāng dìqū de qìhòu yì nián sìjì fēnmíng,
The northern climate has four distinct seasons;
就是说，春、夏、秋、冬四个季节的天气很不一样。
jiùshì shuō, chūn, xià, qiū, dōng sì ge jìjié de tiānqì hěn bù yíyàng.
that is, the weather in spring, summer, autumn and winter is very different.
夏天很热，经常下雨。
Xiàtiān hěn rè, jīngcháng xià yǔ.
Summer is hot, with frequent rain.
冬天呢，天气很冷，不过，经常是晴天。
Dōngtiān ne, tiānqì hěn lěng, búguò, jīngcháng shì qíngtiān.
Winter is very cold, but often sunny.
北方地区的很多省都是生产粮食的大省。
Běifāng dìqū de hěn duō shěng dōu shì shēngchǎn liángshí de dà shěng.
Many northern provinces are major grain producers.
东北地区的主食是大米，华北地区的主食是面食。
Dōngběi dìqū de zhǔshí shì dàmǐ, Huáběi dìqū de zhǔshí shì miànshí.
The staple in the north-east is rice; in north China it's wheaten food.
北方地区也生产很多水果，比如苹果、葡萄等等。
Běifāng dìqū yě shēngchǎn hěn duō shuǐguǒ, bǐrú píngguǒ, pútáo děngděng.
The north also produces a lot of fruit, such as apples and grapes.

vocab: to make up, to account for
grammar: 占……的百分之……
to make up …% of …
占 = account for.
面积大约占全中国的百分之二十，
Miànjī dàyuē zhàn quán Zhōngguó de bǎi fēn zhī èrshí,
Its area is about 20% of China,
女生占全班的百分之六十。
Nǚshēng zhàn quán bān de bǎi fēn zhī liùshí.
Girls make up 60% of the class.
……以北
north of …
以 + direction marks a boundary.
北方地区指中国的秦岭、淮河以北。
Běifāng dìqū zhǐ Zhōngguó de Qínlǐng, Huái Hé yǐběi.
The northern region means the part of China north of the Qinling Mountains and the Huai River.
长江以南。
Cháng Jiāng yǐnán.
South of the Yangtze.
就是说
that is to say
Explains what came before.
就是说，春、夏、秋、冬四个季节的天气很不一样。
jiùshì shuō, chūn, xià, qiū, dōng sì ge jìjié de tiānqì hěn bù yíyàng.
that is, the weather in spring, summer, autumn and winter is very different.
他不来了，就是说我们得自己去。
Tā bù lái le, jiùshì shuō wǒmen de zìjǐ qù.
He's not coming, so we have to go ourselves.
…, but …
A soft contrast.
冬天呢，天气很冷，不过，经常是晴天。
Dōngtiān ne, tiānqì hěn lěng, búguò, jīngcháng shì qíngtiān.
Winter is very cold, but often sunny.
这儿很远，不过很安静。
Zhèr hěn yuǎn, búguò hěn ānjìng.
It's far, but quiet.
gaps: 北方地区指中国的秦岭、淮河

102.title: That fierce Sichuan pepper
102.sub: Two questions, then a northerner tells a Chengdu colleague about his trip
102.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the dialogue. 张 is Secretary Zhang from Changchun in the north-east and 李 is Xiao Li from Chengdu. Who says which line is my reading from context. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
一天，来自成都的小李和来自长春的张秘书闲聊。
Yì tiān, láizì Chéngdū de Xiǎo Lǐ hé láizì Chángchūn de Zhāng mìshū xiánliáo.
One day, Xiao Li from Chengdu and Secretary Zhang from Changchun are chatting.
请听他们的对话，然后回答下面的问题。
Qǐng tīng tāmen de duìhuà, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to their conversation, then answer the questions below.

q: 张秘书是北方人，爱吃米饭吗？文章中哪些地方提到了？
Zhāng mìshū shì běifāng rén, ài chī mǐfàn ma? Wénzhāng zhōng nǎxiē dìfang tídào le?
Secretary Zhang is a northerner. Does he like rice? Where in the text is it mentioned?
ans: 爱吃。他说北方人是爱吃面食，可是也常常吃米饭，他就是特别喜欢吃米饭；在成都饭店里米饭免费，还能加饭，他贼高兴。
Ài chī. Tā shuō běifāng rén shì ài chī miànshí, kěshì yě chángcháng chī mǐfàn, tā jiùshì tèbié xǐhuan chī mǐfàn; zài Chéngdū fàndiàn li mǐfàn miǎnfèi, hái néng jiā fàn, tā zéi gāoxìng.
Yes. He says northerners do love wheaten food but often eat rice too, and he especially loves rice; in Chengdu the rice was free with refills, which made him really happy.

q: 张秘书点的菜里有辣椒吗？为什么他说菜很辣，他吃不了？
Zhāng mìshū diǎn de cài li yǒu làjiāo ma? Wèishénme tā shuō cài hěn là, tā chī bu liǎo?
Was there chilli in the dishes he ordered? Why did he say they were too spicy to eat?
ans: 没有辣椒。可是厨师放了花椒，菜很麻，所以他吃了一口就出汗了。
Méiyǒu làjiāo. Kěshì chúshī fàng le huājiāo, cài hěn má, suǒyǐ tā chī le yì kǒu jiù chūhàn le.
No chilli, but the chef added Sichuan pepper, which made the food numbing, so one mouthful had him sweating.

blocks.label: 对话
blocks.h: 厉害的四川花椒 · The dialogue
lines: 厉害的四川花椒
Lìhài de Sìchuān huājiāo
That fierce Sichuan pepper
哎，小李，你是哪儿的人啊？
Āi, Xiǎo Lǐ, nǐ shì nǎr de rén a?
Hey, Xiao Li, where are you from?
张
成都人。
Chéngdū rén.
Chengdu.
李
成都我去过。有一回我去成都出差办事儿，那是我第一回去南方城市，发现了很多新鲜事。
Chéngdū wǒ qù guo. Yǒu yì huí wǒ qù Chéngdū chūchāi bàn shìr, nà shì wǒ dì-yī huí qù nánfāng chéngshì, fāxiàn le hěn duō xīnxiān shì.
I've been to Chengdu. Once I went there on business. It was my first time in a southern city, and I found lots of things new.
张
是吗？你说我听听。
Shì ma? Nǐ shuō wǒ tīngting.
Really? Tell me.
李
我刚到成都肚子饿了，就去饭店吃饭。点了几个小菜儿，还要了米饭。没想到米饭是免费的。
Wǒ gāng dào Chéngdū dǔzi è le, jiù qù fàndiàn chī fàn. Diǎn le jǐ ge xiǎocàir, hái yào le mǐfàn. Méi xiǎngdào mǐfàn shì miǎnfèi de.
As soon as I got to Chengdu I was hungry, so I went to a restaurant. I ordered a few small dishes and some rice. I didn't expect the rice to be free.
张
对呀，因为我们那儿产米呀，所以米饭经常是免费的。
Duì ya, yīnwèi wǒmen nàr chǎn mǐ ya, suǒyǐ mǐfàn jīngcháng shì miǎnfèi de.
That's right. We grow rice there, so rice is often free.
李
这还不说，顾客还可以要求加饭。我贼高兴。服务员用一个大盆盛饭，觉得特大方。
Zhè hái bù shuō, gùkè hái kěyǐ yāoqiú jiā fàn. Wǒ zéi gāoxìng. Fúwùyuán yòng yí ge dà pén chéng fàn, juéde tè dàfang.
And that's not all: customers can ask for more. I was over the moon. The waiter served the rice in a big basin. So generous.
张
哎，北方人不是都爱吃面食吗？
Āi, běifāng rén bú shì dōu ài chī miànshí ma?
Hang on, don't all northerners love wheaten food?
李
是爱吃面食，可是也常常吃米饭，我就是特别喜欢吃米饭。所以我当时特别高兴。
Shì ài chī miànshí, kěshì yě chángcháng chī mǐfàn, wǒ jiùshì tèbié xǐhuan chī mǐfàn. Suǒyǐ wǒ dāngshí tèbié gāoxìng.
We do, but we often eat rice too, and I especially love rice. So I was really happy.
张
那菜呢？成都小吃那么多，你没点几个好吃的？
Nà cài ne? Chéngdū xiǎochī nàme duō, nǐ méi diǎn jǐ ge hǎochī de?
And the food? There are so many Chengdu snacks. Didn't you order something good?
李
哎呀，你就别提了。我不能吃辣的，所以一点菜我就告诉服务员，千万别放辣椒。
Āiyā, nǐ jiù bié tí le. Wǒ bù néng chī là de, suǒyǐ yì diǎn cài wǒ jiù gàosu fúwùyuán, qiānwàn bié fàng làjiāo.
Oh, don't even ask. I can't eat spicy food, so when I ordered I told the waiter: no chilli, whatever you do.
张
川菜不放辣椒也不好吃啊。
Chuāncài bú fàng làjiāo yě bù hǎochī a.
Sichuan food without chilli isn't good either.
李
人家服务员倒是答应了，说一定不让厨师放辣椒。可是你猜怎么着？
Rénjia fúwùyuán dàoshì dāyìng le, shuō yídìng bú ràng chúshī fàng làjiāo. Kěshì nǐ cāi zěnmezhe?
The waiter agreed all right, and said he'd make sure the chef didn't use chilli. But guess what?
张
厨师忘了，又给你放辣椒了？
Chúshī wàng le, yòu gěi nǐ fàng làjiāo le?
The chef forgot and put chilli in anyway?
李
不是。服务员把菜端上来还挺满意的，跟我说没放辣椒。
Bú shì. Fúwùyuán bǎ cài duān shànglai hái tǐng mǎnyì de, gēn wǒ shuō méi fàng làjiāo.
No. The waiter brought the dishes, looking pleased with himself, and told me there was no chilli.
张
可是我刚吃了一口，辣得就出汗了。那是怎么回事儿啊？我也不明白啊。
Kěshì wǒ gāng chī le yì kǒu, là de jiù chūhàn le. Nà shì zěnme huí shìr a? Wǒ yě bù míngbai a.
But after one mouthful I was sweating from the heat. What was going on? I couldn't work it out.
张
后来我才想明白，虽然没放辣椒，可是还要放花椒，所以菜还是挺麻。你们四川花椒果然厉害呀。
Hòulái wǒ cái xiǎng míngbai, suīrán méi fàng làjiāo, kěshì hái yào fàng huājiāo, suǒyǐ cài háishi tǐng má. Nǐmen Sìchuān huājiāo guǒrán lìhài ya.
Later I figured it out: no chilli, but there was Sichuan pepper, so the food was still numbing. Your Sichuan pepper really is fierce.
张
是啊，川菜里少不了花椒。
Shì a, chuāncài li shǎo bu liǎo huājiāo.
Yes, Sichuan food always has Sichuan pepper.
李
再以后啊，我点菜的时候就跟他们说，既不放辣椒，也不放花椒了。
Zài yǐhòu a, wǒ diǎncài de shíhou jiù gēn tāmen shuō, jì bú fàng làjiāo, yě bú fàng huājiāo le.
After that, whenever I ordered, I told them: no chilli and no Sichuan pepper.
张
