103.title: An unlucky meal
103.sub: Four questions, then a southerner's run-in with a too-friendly northern restaurant owner
103.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the story. 小五 (Xiao Wu) is a southerner who has just moved to Harbin in the north-east; the owner calls him 哥们儿, so he's a man. The owner speaks north-eastern colloquial Chinese: 咋 = 怎么, 咱家 = 我们店. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
小五是南方人，刚搬到哈尔滨时，遇到了很多新鲜事。
Xiǎo Wǔ shì nánfāng rén, gāng bān dào Hā'ěrbīn shí, yùdào le hěn duō xīnxiān shì.
Xiao Wu is a southerner. When he first moved to Harbin, lots of things were new to him.
听听他的一个小故事，然后回答下面的问题。
Tīngting tā de yí ge xiǎo gùshi, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to one of his stories, then answer the questions below.

q: Xiǎo Wǔ zài fàndiàn diǎn le shénme?
What did Xiao Wu order at the restaurant?
ans: A bowl of pork noodle soup.

q: 小五是不是觉得这家饭店的饭很难吃？
Xiǎo Wǔ shì bu shì juéde zhè jiā fàndiàn de fàn hěn nánchī?
Did Xiao Wu think the food was bad?
ans: 不是。他说好吃，只是碗太大，他吃不了。
Bú shì. Tā shuō hǎochī, zhǐshì wǎn tài dà, tā chī bu liǎo.
No. He said it was good; the bowl was just too big for him to finish.

q: 饭店的老板为什么给他加了肉汤，还多放了几滴香油？
Fàndiàn de lǎobǎn wèishénme gěi tā jiā le ròutāng, hái duō fàng le jǐ dī xiāngyóu?
Why did the owner give him more soup and a few more drops of sesame oil?
ans: 老板很热情，以为他剩下面是因为不好吃，希望他吃完。
Lǎobǎn hěn rèqíng, yǐwéi tā shèngxia miàn shì yīnwèi bù hǎochī, xīwàng tā chī wán.
The owner was being hospitable: he thought Xiao Wu left the noodles because they weren't good, and wanted him to finish them.

q: 小五为什么觉得自己很倒霉？
Xiǎo Wǔ wèishénme juéde zìjǐ hěn dǎoméi?
Why does Xiao Wu feel unlucky?
ans: 他吃不下还得假装高兴吃完，老板还请他下次再来；后来半年不敢吃汤面，走路还得绕开那家饭店。
Tā chī bu xià hái de jiǎzhuāng gāoxìng chī wán, lǎobǎn hái qǐng tā xiàcì zài lái; hòulái bànnián bù gǎn chī tāngmiàn, zǒu lù hái de rào kāi nà jiā fàndiàn.
He had to pretend to be happy and force the food down, the owner invited him back, and afterwards he didn't dare eat noodle soup for six months and went out of his way to avoid the restaurant.

blocks.label: 故事
blocks.h: 倒霉的一顿饭 · The story
lines: 倒霉的一顿饭。
Dǎoméi de yí dùn fàn.
An unlucky meal.
我刚搬到哈尔滨的第一年，很不习惯北方人的热情。
Wǒ gāng bān dào Hā'ěrbīn de dì-yī nián, hěn bù xíguàn běifāng rén de rèqíng.
In my first year after moving to Harbin, I really wasn't used to how warm northerners are.
有一回，我自己去吃饭，我要了一碗猪肉汤面。
Yǒu yì huí, wǒ zìjǐ qù chī fàn, wǒ yào le yì wǎn zhūròu tāngmiàn.
Once I went out to eat by myself and ordered a bowl of pork noodle soup.
没想到，上来的竟然是一大碗，感觉像山一样。
Méi xiǎngdào, shànglai de jìngrán shì yí dà wǎn, gǎnjué xiàng shān yíyàng.
To my surprise, what arrived was a huge bowl, like a mountain.
我只吃掉了一小半就想走。
Wǒ zhǐ chīdiào le yì xiǎo bàn jiù xiǎng zǒu.
I'd only eaten a small part of it when I wanted to leave.
谁知道，偏偏被饭店的老板看见了。
Shéi zhīdao, piānpiān bèi fàndiàn de lǎobǎn kànjiàn le.
But wouldn't you know it, the owner saw me.
他一阵风似的走过来，把我拦住，问道：
Tā yí zhèn fēng shìde zǒu guòlái, bǎ wǒ lánzhù, wèndào:
He rushed over like the wind, stopped me and asked:
“咋的了？咱家的面不好吃啊？”
"Zǎ de le? Zán jiā de miàn bù hǎochī a?"
"What's up? Our noodles not good?"
我连忙说：“好吃好吃。”
Wǒ liánmáng shuō: "Hǎochī hǎochī."
I quickly said: "Very good, very good."
老板继续问：“好吃呢，你咋剩这么多呢？”
Lǎobǎn jìxù wèn: "Hǎochī ne, nǐ zǎ shèng zhème duō ne?"
The owner went on: "If they're good, why have you left so much?"
我鼻子差点被气歪，心想：
Wǒ bízi chàdiǎn bèi qì wāi, xīnxiǎng:
I was nearly fuming, and thought:
我买面，吃完吃不完是我的事，又不是不付钱。
Wǒ mǎi miàn, chī wán chī bu wán shì wǒ de shì, yòu bú shì bú fùqián.
I bought the noodles; whether I finish them is my business. It's not as if I'm not paying.
再说了，你的碗那么大，够我全家吃的。
Zàishuō le, nǐ de wǎn nàme dà, gòu wǒ quán jiā chī de.
Besides, your bowl is so big it'd feed my whole family.
我要是都吃完了，还不得撑死呀。
Wǒ yàoshì dōu chī wán le, hái bù děi chēng sǐ ya.
If I ate the lot, I'd burst.
我笑着说：“老板，我真的吃不下了，真吃饱了。”
Wǒ xiàozhe shuō: "Lǎobǎn, wǒ zhēn de chī bu xià le, zhēn chī bǎo le."
I said with a smile: "Boss, I really can't eat any more. I'm honestly full."
没想到，那个老板不听我解释，还继续说：
Méi xiǎngdào, nàge lǎobǎn bù tīng wǒ jiěshì, hái jìxù shuō:
To my surprise, the owner wouldn't listen to my explanation and carried on:
“你要不吃完，就说明咱家面不好吃。你要是觉得好吃就吃完。”
"Nǐ yào bù chī wán, jiù shuōmíng zán jiā miàn bù hǎochī. Nǐ yàoshì juéde hǎochī jiù chī wán."
"If you don't finish it, that means our noodles aren't good. If you think they're good, finish them."
然后，他竟然还让服务员给我加点肉汤，还多放了几滴香油。
Ránhòu, tā jìngrán hái ràng fúwùyuán gěi wǒ jiā diǎn ròutāng, hái duō fàng le jǐ dī xiāngyóu.
Then he actually had the waiter add some more soup, and a few more drops of sesame oil.
我当时就傻了，一句话也说不出来，
Wǒ dāngshí jiù shǎ le, yí jù huà yě shuō bu chūlái,
I was stunned and couldn't say a word,
只好假装高兴的样子吃面。
zhǐhǎo jiǎzhuāng gāoxìng de yàngzi chī miàn.
so I just pretended to be happy and ate the noodles.
我好不容易吃完了面，付了钱，连嘴都不想擦，只想赶快离开。
Wǒ hǎobùróngyì chī wán le miàn, fù le qián, lián zuǐ dōu bù xiǎng cā, zhǐ xiǎng gǎnkuài líkāi.
I finally managed to finish, paid, and didn't even want to wipe my mouth; I just wanted to get out.
谁知道，老板竟然又微笑地对我说：
Shéi zhīdao, lǎobǎn jìngrán yòu wēixiào de duì wǒ shuō:
And then, would you believe it, the owner smiled and said to me:
“哥们儿，下次再过来呀。”
"Gēmenr, xiàcì zài guòlái ya."
"Mate, come again next time."
你说我这个倒霉呀。
Nǐ shuō wǒ zhège dǎoméi ya.
Talk about bad luck.
不知道是我太傻，上了他的当，还是人家太热情，我不习惯。
Bù zhīdao shì wǒ tài shǎ, shàng le tā de dàng, háishi rénjia tài rèqíng, wǒ bù xíguàn.
I don't know whether I was too silly and got taken in, or he was just too hospitable and I wasn't used to it.
反正这件事害得我半年没再敢吃汤面。
Fǎnzhèng zhè jiàn shì hài de wǒ bànnián méi zài gǎn chī tāngmiàn.
Anyway, it put me off noodle soup for six months.
以后走路快到他家饭店的时候，为了躲过这位热心的老板，我都故意绕一大圈。
Yǐhòu zǒu lù kuài dào tā jiā fàndiàn de shíhou, wèile duǒ guo zhè wèi rèxīn de lǎobǎn, wǒ dōu gùyì rào yí dà quān.
After that, whenever I got near his restaurant, I'd deliberately go a long way round to avoid that over-friendly owner.

grammar: 没想到，……
unexpectedly …
Introduces a surprise.
没想到，上来的竟然是一大碗，感觉像山一样。
Méi xiǎngdào, shànglai de jìngrán shì yí dà wǎn, gǎnjué xiàng shān yíyàng.
To my surprise, what arrived was a huge bowl, like a mountain.
没想到他这么年轻。
Méi xiǎngdào tā zhème niánqīng.
I didn't expect him to be so young.
谁知道，偏偏……
who'd have thought, of all things …
A double surprise marker.
谁知道，偏偏被饭店的老板看见了。
Shéi zhīdao, piānpiān bèi fàndiàn de lǎobǎn kànjiàn le.
But wouldn't you know it, the owner saw me.
谁知道，偏偏下雨了。
Shéi zhīdao, piānpiān xià yǔ le.
And of course it rained.
又不是……
it's not as if …
Rhetorical defence.
我买面，吃完吃不完是我的事，又不是不付钱。
Wǒ mǎi miàn, chī wán chī bu wán shì wǒ de shì, yòu bú shì bú fùqián.
I bought the noodles; whether I finish them is my business. It's not as if I'm not paying.
又不是小孩子，你自己去吧。
Yòu bú shì xiǎoháizi, nǐ zìjǐ qù ba.
You're not a child; go yourself.
还不得……
wouldn't I have to …
Rhetorical: it would surely happen.
我要是都吃完了，还不得撑死呀。
Wǒ yàoshì dōu chī wán le, hái bù děi chēng sǐ ya.
If I ate the lot, I'd burst.
不带伞还不得淋湿？
Búdài sǎn hái bù děi línshī?
Without an umbrella, you'd get soaked.
连……都不……
not even …
Stresses an extreme case.
我好不容易吃完了面，付了钱，连嘴都不想擦，只想赶快离开。
Wǒ hǎobùróngyì chī wán le miàn, fù le qián, lián zuǐ dōu bù xiǎng cā, zhǐ xiǎng gǎnkuài líkāi.
I finally managed to finish, paid, and didn't even want to wipe my mouth; I just wanted to get out.
他连饭都不吃。
Tā lián fàn dōu bù chī.
He doesn't even eat.
不知道是……，还是……
not sure whether … or …
Two possibilities.
不知道是我太傻，上了他的当，还是人家太热情，我不习惯。
Bù zhīdao shì wǒ tài shǎ, shàng le tā de dàng, háishi rénjia tài rèqíng, wǒ bù xíguàn.
I don't know whether I was too silly and got taken in, or he was just too hospitable and I wasn't used to it.
不知道是他忘了，还是不想来。
Bù zhīdao shì tā wàng le, háishi bù xiǎng lái.
Not sure if he forgot or doesn't want to come.
害得……
it made … (something bad)
害 + 得 for a bad result.
反正这件事害得我半年没再敢吃汤面。
Fǎnzhèng zhè jiàn shì hài de wǒ bànnián méi zài gǎn chī tāngmiàn.
Anyway, it put me off noodle soup for six months.
害得我等了一个小时。
Hài de wǒ děng le yí ge xiǎoshí.
It kept me waiting an hour.
gaps: 他一阵风似的走过来，把我
say: Talk about bad luck.
If I ate the lot, I'd burst.

104.zh: 南方女孩爱上北方男孩
104.title: A southern girl in love with a northern boy
104.sub: A-Xiang asks for advice; four netizens reply
104.transcriptNote: A-Xiang, a southern girl, has fallen for a boy from Shandong in the north, but her parents object. Listen to her post and four netizens' replies, and decide each one's attitude to the relationship. The answers are my own judgement.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
判断说话人的意思。
Pànduàn shuōhuàrén de yìsi.
Work out what the speakers mean.
南方姑娘阿香爱上了一个北方男孩，阿香的父母都反对他们谈恋爱。
Nánfāng gūniáng Ā Xiāng àishàng le yí ge běifāng nánhái, Ā Xiāng de fùmǔ dōu fǎnduì tāmen tán liàn'ài.
A-Xiang, a southern girl, has fallen in love with a northern boy, but her parents are against it.
先请听阿香的一段话，然后再听四位网友的观点。
Xiān qǐng tīng Ā Xiāng de yí duàn huà, ránhòu zài tīng sì wèi wǎngyǒu de guāndiǎn.
First listen to what A-Xiang says, then to four netizens' views.
你觉得他们的态度是什么？
Nǐ juéde tāmen de tàidu shì shénme?
What do you think their attitudes are?

blocks.label: 阿香
lines: 阿香。
Ā Xiāng.
A-Xiang.
我是一个南方女孩儿，认识了一个山东的男生。
Wǒ shì yí ge nánfāng nǚháir, rènshi le yí ge Shāndōng de nánshēng.
I'm a southern girl, and I've met a boy from Shandong.
我们谈恋爱六个月后，我跟家里人说了，
Wǒmen tán liàn'ài liù ge yuè hòu, wǒ gēn jiā li rén shuō le,
After we'd been going out for six months, I told my family,
家里人马上就不同意了。
jiā li rén mǎshàng jiù bù tóngyì le.
and they disagreed straight away.
说北方男孩子都大男子主义，说南方人和北方人有很大差异，
Shuō běifāng nánháizi dōu dà nánzǐ zhǔyì, shuō nánfāng rén hé běifāng rén yǒu hěn dà chāyì,
They said northern boys are all chauvinists, that southerners and northerners are very different,
说以后我的日子肯定不好过，还给我举了好多例子。
shuō yǐhòu wǒ de rìzi kěndìng bù hǎoguò, hái gěi wǒ jǔ le hǎo duō lìzi.
that my life would definitely be hard, and they gave me lots of examples.
可是我根本不信。南方人真的不能嫁给北方人吗？
Kěshì wǒ gēnběn bú xìn. Nánfāng rén zhēn de bù néng jià gěi běifāng rén ma?
But I don't believe it at all. Can a southern girl really not marry a northerner?
我很爱他，但是又劝不了我妈。怎么办？该怎么办啊？
Wǒ hěn ài tā, dànshì yòu quàn bu liǎo wǒ mā. Zěnme bàn? Gāi zěnme bàn a?
I love him very much, but I can't talk my mum round. What should I do?

blocks.label: 网友一
lines: 网友一。
Wǎngyǒu yī.
Netizen 1.
只有爱是不够的。南方人和北方人生活差异有很多。
Zhǐyǒu ài shì bú gòu de. Nánfāng rén hé běifāng rén shēnghuó chāyì yǒu hěn duō.
Love alone isn't enough. There are many differences between southern and northern lifestyles.
主要还是看你们俩是否能适应对方。
Zhǔyào háishi kàn nǐmen liǎ shìfǒu néng shìyìng duìfāng.
It mainly depends on whether you two can adapt to each other.
结婚后是你们两个一起生活，别人帮不了你们。
Jié hūn hòu shì nǐmen liǎng ge yìqǐ shēnghuó, biérén bāng bu liǎo nǐmen.
After marriage it's you two living together; nobody else can help you.
而且，你结婚后离家这么远，你妈也是舍不得你。
Érqiě, nǐ jié hūn hòu lí jiā zhème yuǎn, nǐ mā yě shì shěbude nǐ.
And if you marry and live so far from home, your mum will miss you.
你说，要是你妈生病了，谁在她旁边照顾她啊？
Nǐ shuō, yàoshì nǐ mā shēng bìng le, shéi zài tā pángbiān zhàogù tā a?
Think about it: if your mum fell ill, who'd be there to look after her?
现在一家就一个孩子，孩子们要对父母好些，
Xiànzài yì jiā jiù yí ge háizi, háizimen yào duì fùmǔ hǎoxiē,
These days families have only one child, and children should be good to their parents.
不能有了男朋友，就忘记了父母。
bù néng yǒu le nánpéngyou, jiù wàngjì le fùmǔ.
You can't forget your parents just because you have a boyfriend.
要记住，没有父母就没有你们。
Yào jìzhù, méiyǒu fùmǔ jiù méiyǒu nǐmen.
Remember, without your parents there'd be no you.

q: Wǎngyǒu yī de tàidu shì shénme?

blocks.label: 网友二
lines: 网友二。
Wǎngyǒu èr.
Netizen 2.
我也是北方人。我老公就不是那样的男人。
Wǒ yě shì běifāng rén. Wǒ lǎogōng jiù bú shì nàyàng de nánrén.
I'm a northerner too. My husband isn't that kind of man.
我周围大男子主义的男人也很少。
Wǒ zhōuwéi dà nánzǐ zhǔyì de nánrén yě hěn shǎo.
There are very few chauvinists around me.
只能说北方的男人很会疼爱老婆。
Zhǐ néng shuō běifāng de nánrén hěn huì téng'ài lǎopo.
If anything, northern men really know how to look after their wives.
当然也有很大男子主义的，不过我觉得很少。
Dāngrán yě yǒu hěn dà nánzǐ zhǔyì de, búguò wǒ juéde hěn shǎo.
Of course there are some real chauvinists, but I think they're rare.

q: Wǎngyǒu èr de tàidu shì shénme?

blocks.label: 网友三
lines: 网友三。
Wǎngyǒu sān.
Netizen 3.
北方人都是大男子主义，只有极少数不大男子主义。
Běifāng rén dōu shì dà nánzǐ zhǔyì, zhǐyǒu jí shǎoshù bú dà nánzǐ zhǔyì.
Northern men are all chauvinists; only a tiny few aren't.
他们在那个环境里长大的，生下来就是大男子主义，他们自己根本认识不到。
Tāmen zài nàge huánjìng li zhǎngdà de, shēng xialai jiùshì dà nánzǐ zhǔyì, tāmen zìjǐ gēnběn rènshi bu dào.
They grew up in that environment. They're chauvinists from birth and don't even realise it.
我是南方人，在北方生活了八年了。
Wǒ shì nánfāng rén, zài běifāng shēnghuó le bā nián le.
I'm a southerner and I've lived in the north for eight years.
我实在不能接受北方男人的大男子主义。
Wǒ shízài bù néng jiēshòu běifāng nánrén de dà nánzǐ zhǔyì.
I really can't accept northern men's chauvinism.
有的男人还打老婆，不爱干净。
Yǒu de nánrén hái dǎ lǎopo, bú ài gānjìng.
Some men even beat their wives and aren't clean.

q: Wǎngyǒu sān de tàidu shì shénme?

blocks.label: 网友四
lines: 网友四。
Wǎngyǒu sì.
Netizen 4.
其实我觉得什么地方都有好的，也有坏的。
Qíshí wǒ juéde shénme dìfang dōu yǒu hǎo de, yě yǒu huài de.
Actually, I think every place has good and bad.
东北的男的或者对老婆特别好，或者根本让人受不了。
Dōngběi de nán de huòzhě duì lǎopo tèbié hǎo, huòzhě gēnběn ràng rén shòu bu liǎo.
North-eastern men are either especially good to their wives or completely unbearable.
虽然他们比较高，比较帅，但也都比较好面子，性格都不好。
Suīrán tāmen bǐjiào gāo, bǐjiào shuài, dàn yě dōu bǐjiào hào miànzi, xìnggé dōu bù hǎo.
They're quite tall and handsome, but they're all rather concerned with face and bad-tempered.
不过我觉得东北男人大部分都是怕老婆的。
Búguò wǒ juéde Dōngběi nánrén dà bùfen dōu shì pà lǎopo de.
But I think most north-eastern men are afraid of their wives.

q: Wǎngyǒu sì de tàidu shì shénme?

grammar: after …
A time clause.
我们谈恋爱六个月后，我跟家里人说了，
Wǒmen tán liàn'ài liù ge yuè hòu, wǒ gēn jiā li rén shuō le,
After we'd been going out for six months, I told my family,
下课后去吃饭。
Xià kè hòu qù chī fàn.
Let's eat after class.
又……不了
and yet can't …
又 adds a frustrating contrast.
我很爱他，但是又劝不了我妈。怎么办？该怎么办啊？
Wǒ hěn ài tā, dànshì yòu quàn bu liǎo wǒ mā. Zěnme bàn? Gāi zěnme bàn a?
I love him very much, but I can't talk my mum round. What should I do?
我想帮他，可又帮不了。
Wǒ xiǎng bāng tā, kě yòu bāng bu liǎo.
I want to help, but I can't.
只有……是不够的
… alone isn't enough
Puts a limit on something.
只有爱是不够的。南方人和北方人生活差异有很多。
Zhǐyǒu ài shì bú gòu de. Nánfāng rén hé běifāng rén shēnghuó chāyì yǒu hěn duō.
Love alone isn't enough. There are many differences between southern and northern lifestyles.
只有钱是不够的。
Zhǐyǒu qián shì bú gòu de.
Money alone isn't enough.
是否
whether
Formal 是不是.
主要还是看你们俩是否能适应对方。
Zhǔyào háishi kàn nǐmen liǎ shìfǒu néng shìyìng duìfāng.
It mainly depends on whether you two can adapt to each other.
不知道他是否同意。
Bù zhīdao tā shìfǒu tóngyì.
I don't know whether he agrees.
没有……就没有……
without …, there'd be no …
Shows a necessary condition.
要记住，没有父母就没有你们。
Yào jìzhù, méiyǒu fùmǔ jiù méiyǒu nǐmen.
Remember, without your parents there'd be no you.
没有你就没有今天的我。
Méiyǒu nǐ jiù méiyǒu jīntiān de wǒ.
Without you, I wouldn't be who I am.
或者……，或者……
either … or …
Two alternatives.
东北的男的或者对老婆特别好，或者根本让人受不了。
Dōngběi de nán de huòzhě duì lǎopo tèbié hǎo, huòzhě gēnběn ràng rén shòu bu liǎo.
North-eastern men are either especially good to their wives or completely unbearable.
或者你来，或者我去。
Huòzhě nǐ lái, huòzhě wǒ qù.
Either you come or I go.
gaps: 主要还是看你们俩是否能
只能说北方的男人很会

105.title: Hometown dialects
105.sub: Students from Wuhan, Beijing and Baoding cheer in their own dialects
105.transcriptNote: Compare how three students say 同学们加油 ("Come on, everyone!") in their home dialects: Wuhan (Hubei, in the south), Beijing, and Baoding (Hebei, in the north). This is a natural, partly improvised recording: fillers are left out, the interviewer is 问, and the students are 武 (Wuhan), 京 (Beijing) and 保 (Baoding). Some words are hard to make out, so the transcript is approximate. The dialect lines are written in standard characters.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 边听边比较 · Listen and compare
lines: 边听边比较。
Biān tīng biān bǐjiào.
Listen and compare.
来自武汉、北京、保定的三位同学用家乡话给大家加油。
Láizì Wǔhàn, Běijīng, Bǎodìng de sān wèi tóngxué yòng jiāxiāng huà gěi dàjiā jiāyóu.
Three students from Wuhan, Beijing and Baoding cheer everyone on in their home dialects.
你能听出他们的发音有什么不同吗？
Nǐ néng tīng chū tāmen de fāyīn yǒu shénme bùtóng ma?
Can you hear how their pronunciation differs?

blocks.label: 武汉
lines: 我是南方人。
Wǒ shì nánfāng rén.
I'm a southerner.
武
好，你是南方人，你来自哪里？
Hǎo, nǐ shì nánfāng rén, nǐ láizì nǎli?
OK, you're a southerner. Where are you from?
问
我来自湖北。
Wǒ láizì Húběi.
I'm from Hubei.
武
湖北。你能不能用你的家乡话说一句：同学们加油？
Húběi. Nǐ néng bù néng yòng nǐ de jiāxiāng huà shuō yí jù: tóngxuémen jiāyóu?
Hubei. Could you say "Come on, everyone!" in your home dialect?
问
同学们加油！
Tóngxuémen jiāyóu!
Come on, everyone! (in Wuhan dialect)
武
这就是你们的家乡话？
Zhè jiùshì nǐmen de jiāxiāng huà?
So that's your home dialect?
问
这就是武汉话。
Zhè jiùshì Wǔhàn huà.
That's Wuhan dialect.
武
武汉话。好的，好。
Wǔhàn huà. Hǎo de, hǎo.
Wuhan dialect. Great, thanks.
问

blocks.label: 北京
lines: 哎，您是北京人，对吗？
Āi, nín shì Běijīng rén, duì ma?
And you're from Beijing, right?
问
对。
Duì.
Yes.
京
那用北京话说一句“同学们加油”，有什么不一样的吗？
Nà yòng Běijīng huà shuō yí jù "tóngxuémen jiāyóu", yǒu shénme bù yíyàng de ma?
So say "Come on, everyone!" in Beijing dialect. Is it any different?
问
会说得比较快。
Huì shuō de bǐjiào kuài.
It's said faster.
京
再说吧，我听听。
Zài shuō ba, wǒ tīngting.
Go on, let me hear.
问
同学们加油！
Tóngxuémen jiāyóu!
Come on, everyone! (in Beijing dialect)
京
再说一遍，没太听清。快点说，还是正常说。
Zài shuō yí biàn, méi tài tīngqīng. Kuài diǎn shuō, háishi zhèngcháng shuō.
Say it again, I didn't quite catch it. Faster, the way you'd normally say it.
问
同学们加油！
Tóngxuémen jiāyóu!
Come on, everyone!
京

blocks.label: 保定
lines: 你家是哪儿的人？
Nǐ jiā shì nǎr de rén?
Where's your family from?
问
我家是河北的。
Wǒ jiā shì Héběi de.
My family's from Hebei.
保
河北的。那你在家里说方言吗？说什么方言呢？
Héběi de. Nà nǐ zài jiā li shuō fāngyán ma? Shuō shénme fāngyán ne?
Hebei. Do you speak dialect at home? Which dialect?
问
就是保定方言，因为我的城市是保定。
Jiùshì Bǎodìng fāngyán, yīnwèi wǒ de chéngshì shì Bǎodìng.
Baoding dialect, because my city is Baoding.
保
保定的，对。那你能不能用保定话说一句“同学们加油”？
Bǎodìng de, duì. Nà nǐ néng bù néng yòng Bǎodìng huà shuō yí jù "tóngxuémen jiāyóu"?
Baoding, right. So could you say "Come on, everyone!" in Baoding dialect?
问
同学们，加油！
Tóngxuémen, jiāyóu!
Come on, everyone! (in Baoding dialect)
保

grammar: 用……说一句
to say a sentence in …
用 + language introduces the medium.
湖北。你能不能用你的家乡话说一句：同学们加油？
Húběi. Nǐ néng bù néng yòng nǐ de jiāxiāng huà shuō yí jù: tóngxuémen jiāyóu?
Hubei. Could you say "Come on, everyone!" in your home dialect?
请用中文说一句。
Qǐng yòng Zhōngwén shuō yí jù.
Please say a sentence in Chinese.
有什么不一样的吗？
is there anything different?
Asks about differences.
那用北京话说一句“同学们加油”，有什么不一样的吗？
Nà yòng Běijīng huà shuō yí jù "tóngxuémen jiāyóu", yǒu shénme bù yíyàng de ma?
So say "Come on, everyone!" in Beijing dialect. Is it any different?
这两个有什么不一样的吗？
Zhè liǎng ge yǒu shénme bù yíyàng de ma?
Are these two any different?
没太听清
didn't quite catch it
太 softens the negative.
再说一遍，没太听清。快点说，还是正常说。
Zài shuō yí biàn, méi tài tīngqīng. Kuài diǎn shuō, háishi zhèngcháng shuō.
Say it again, I didn't quite catch it. Faster, the way you'd normally say it.
对不起，我没太听清。
Duìbuqǐ, wǒ méi tài tīngqīng.
Sorry, I didn't quite catch that.

106.title: Copy the tone of voice
106.sub: Ten short lines from the north–south stories
106.transcriptNote: Pre-speaking practice: listen to each line and copy the speaker's tone: complaining, curious, alarmed, pleading, defiant.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 口语课前练习 · Pre-speaking practice
lines: 口语课前练习。
Kǒuyǔ kè qián liànxí.
Pre-speaking exercises.
听句子并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng jùzi bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the sentences and copy the speakers' tone.
这种事儿偏偏被我碰上了，你说我怎么这么倒霉呀？
Zhè zhǒng shìr piānpiān bèi wǒ pèngshang le, nǐ shuō wǒ zěnme zhème dǎoméi ya?
Of all people, it had to happen to me. Why am I so unlucky?
你遇到什么新鲜事儿了？快说说。
Nǐ yùdào shénme xīnxiān shìr le? Kuài shuōshuo.
What surprising thing happened to you? Go on, tell me.
别提那家饭店了。上次去吃饭，害得我肚子连疼了三天。
Bié tí nà jiā fàndiàn le. Shàngcì qù chī fàn, hài de wǒ dǔzi lián téng le sān tiān.
Don't mention that restaurant. Last time I ate there, my stomach hurt for three days straight.
怎么回事儿啊？怎么地上都是水啊？看，鞋都湿了。
Zěnme huí shìr a? Zěnme dì shang dōu shì shuǐ a? Kàn, xié dōu shī le.
What's going on? Why is there water all over the floor? Look, my shoes are soaked.
不行了不行了，我真不能吃了，再吃我就要撑死了。
Bù xíng le bù xíng le, wǒ zhēn bù néng chī le, zài chī wǒ jiù yào chēng sǐ le.
No more, no more. I really can't eat any more. If I eat another bite I'll burst.
小妹，你太傻了，你一定是上了他的当了。
Xiǎomèi, nǐ tài shǎ le, nǐ yídìng shì shàng le tā de dàng le.
Little sis, you're so naive. He must have tricked you.
服务员，这菜太辣了，我们根本吃不了。
Fúwùyuán, zhè cài tài là le, wǒmen gēnběn chī bu liǎo.
Waiter, this dish is too spicy. We can't eat it at all.
我已经决定去南方了，你们谁也拦不住我。
Wǒ yǐjīng juédìng qù nánfāng le, nǐmen shéi yě lán bu zhù wǒ.
I've made up my mind to go south. None of you can stop me.
妈，我饿死了，给我盛碗汤面吧。
Mā, wǒ è sǐ le, gěi wǒ chéng wǎn tāngmiàn ba.
Mum, I'm starving. Give me a bowl of noodle soup.
哎哟，我得出去活动活动了，坐得我腿都麻了。
Āiyō, wǒ děi chūqu huódòng huódòng le, zuò de wǒ tuǐ dōu má le.
Ouch, I need to go out and move about. I've been sitting so long my legs have gone numb.

grammar: 偏偏被我……
of all people, I had to …
偏偏 stresses bad luck.
这种事儿偏偏被我碰上了，你说我怎么这么倒霉呀？
Zhè zhǒng shìr piānpiān bèi wǒ pèngshang le, nǐ shuō wǒ zěnme zhème dǎoméi ya?
Of all people, it had to happen to me. Why am I so unlucky?
偏偏让我遇到了他。
Piānpiān ràng wǒ yùdào le tā.
Of all people, I had to bump into him.
害得我……
it made me …
A bad result.
别提那家饭店了。上次去吃饭，害得我肚子连疼了三天。
Bié tí nà jiā fàndiàn le. Shàngcì qù chī fàn, hài de wǒ dǔzi lián téng le sān tiān.
Don't mention that restaurant. Last time I ate there, my stomach hurt for three days straight.
害得我没睡好。
Hài de wǒ méi shuì hǎo.
It kept me from sleeping.
连 + V + 了 + time
… in a row
连 = consecutively.
别提那家饭店了。上次去吃饭，害得我肚子连疼了三天。
Bié tí nà jiā fàndiàn le. Shàngcì qù chī fàn, hài de wǒ dǔzi lián téng le sān tiān.
Don't mention that restaurant. Last time I ate there, my stomach hurt for three days straight.
连下了三天雨。
Lián xià le sān tiān yǔ.
It rained three days in a row.
再……就要……了
one more … and …
A warning about what will happen.
不行了不行了，我真不能吃了，再吃我就要撑死了。
Bù xíng le bù xíng le, wǒ zhēn bù néng chī le, zài chī wǒ jiù yào chēng sǐ le.
No more, no more. I really can't eat any more. If I eat another bite I'll burst.
再不走就要迟到了。
Zài bù zǒu jiù yào chídào le.
If we don't go now we'll be late.
谁也……不……
nobody can …
Question word + 也 = no one.
我已经决定去南方了，你们谁也拦不住我。
Wǒ yǐjīng juédìng qù nánfāng le, nǐmen shéi yě lán bu zhù wǒ.
I've made up my mind to go south. None of you can stop me.
谁也不知道。
Shéi yě bù zhīdao.
Nobody knows.
V得我……
made me so …
The result of a long action.
哎哟，我得出去活动活动了，坐得我腿都麻了。
Āiyō, wǒ děi chūqu huódòng huódòng le, zuò de wǒ tuǐ dōu má le.
Ouch, I need to go out and move about. I've been sitting so long my legs have gone numb.
走得我脚都疼了。
Zǒu de wǒ jiǎo dōu téng le.
I've walked so much my feet hurt.
say: Of all people, it had to happen to me. Why am I so unlucky?
No more, no more. I really can't eat any more. If I eat another bite I'll burst.
I've made up my mind to go south. None of you can stop me.

107.title: Ordering food
107.sub: Two friends politely argue over who orders
107.transcriptNote: Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone. 务 is the waiter, 甲 the host and 李 is his friend Lao Li. Who says which line is my reading from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听对话并模仿 · Listen and imitate
lines: 听对话并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng duìhuà bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 请问二位现在点菜吗？
Qǐngwèn èr wèi xiànzài diǎncài ma?
Are you two ready to order?
务
老李，你点吧。
Lǎo Lǐ, nǐ diǎn ba.
Lao Li, you order.
甲
你来吧，你来吧。
Nǐ lái ba, nǐ lái ba.
You do it, you do it.
李
还是你来吧。
Háishi nǐ lái ba.
No, you do it.
甲
你看你，跟我还客气。
Nǐ kàn nǐ, gēn wǒ hái kèqì.
Look at you, standing on ceremony with me.
李
不是客气，不知道你爱吃什么。你好像爱吃辣的吧？
Bú shì kèqì, bù zhīdao nǐ ài chī shénme. Nǐ hǎoxiàng ài chī là de ba?
It's not that. I just don't know what you like. You like spicy food, don't you?
甲
以前不能吃。到了成都后，水平就大大提高了。
Yǐqián bù néng chī. Dào le Chéngdū hòu, shuǐpíng jiù dàdà tígāo le.
I couldn't handle it before. Since moving to Chengdu, my tolerance has gone way up.
李
那好。来一个辣子鸡丁，一个麻婆豆腐，一个辣白菜，一个鱼头酸菜汤，一个……
Nà hǎo. Lái yí ge làzi jīdīng, yí ge mápó dòufu, yí ge là báicài, yí ge yútóu suāncài tāng, yí ge……
Right then. One spicy diced chicken, one mapo tofu, one spicy cabbage, one fish-head and pickled cabbage soup, and one...
甲
够了够了，吃不了这么多，你要撑死我呀。
Gòu le gòu le, chī bu liǎo zhème duō, nǐ yào chēng sǐ wǒ ya.
Enough, enough. We can't eat that much. Are you trying to make me burst?
李
请问你们点什么主食？
Qǐngwèn nǐmen diǎn shénme zhǔshí?
What would you like as a staple?
务
来两碗汤面吧。
Lái liǎng wǎn tāngmiàn ba.
Two bowls of noodle soup.
甲
给我的多放点辣椒。
Gěi wǒ de duō fàng diǎn làjiāo.
Put plenty of chilli in mine.
李
那二位喝点什么？
Nà èr wèi hē diǎn shénme?
And what would you like to drink?
务
先来两瓶啤酒。
Xiān lái liǎng píng píjiǔ.
Two bottles of beer to start.
甲
好，请稍等。
Hǎo, qǐng shāo děng.
Right, just a moment.
务

grammar: 你来吧
you do it
来 replaces a specific verb.
还是你来吧。
Háishi nǐ lái ba.
No, you do it.
我来吧。
Wǒ lái ba.
Let me do it.
跟……还客气
to stand on ceremony with …
还 shows it's unnecessary.
你看你，跟我还客气。
Nǐ kàn nǐ, gēn wǒ hái kèqì.
Look at you, standing on ceremony with me.
跟我还客气什么？
Gēn wǒ hái kèqì shénme?
Why be so formal with me?
来一个……
I'll have a …
Colloquial for ordering.
那好。来一个辣子鸡丁，一个麻婆豆腐，一个辣白菜，一个鱼头酸菜汤，一个……
Nà hǎo. Lái yí ge làzi jīdīng, yí ge mápó dòufu, yí ge là báicài, yí ge yútóu suāncài tāng, yí ge……
Right then. One spicy diced chicken, one mapo tofu, one spicy cabbage, one fish-head and pickled cabbage soup, and one...
来一杯茶。
Lái yì bēi chá.
A cup of tea, please.
你要V死我呀
are you trying to … me to death?
Playful exaggeration.
够了够了，吃不了这么多，你要撑死我呀。
Gòu le gòu le, chī bu liǎo zhème duō, nǐ yào chēng sǐ wǒ ya.
Enough, enough. We can't eat that much. Are you trying to make me burst?
你要累死我呀？
Nǐ yào lèi sǐ wǒ ya?
Are you trying to wear me out?
多放点……
put more …
多 + V before the object means "more".
给我的多放点辣椒。
Gěi wǒ de duō fàng diǎn làjiāo.
Put plenty of chilli in mine.
多放点糖。
Duō fàng diǎn táng.
Put in more sugar.
say: Look at you, standing on ceremony with me.
Enough, enough. We can't eat that much. Are you trying to make me burst?

108.title: My university roommates
108.sub: Lesson 7 reading: six young men from six provinces share a dorm
108.transcriptNote: The first lesson 7 reading. The narrator is from Sichuan; his five roommates come from Beijing, Heilongjiang, Shanghai, Shandong and Guangdong.

blocks.label: 课文
blocks.h: 我的大学室友 · The text
lines: 我的大学室友
Wǒ de dàxué shìyǒu
My university roommates
中国各地的文化差异可真不小，这是我念大学时的深刻体会。
Zhōngguó gèdì de wénhuà chāyì kě zhēn bù xiǎo, zhè shì wǒ niàn dàxué shí de shēnkè tǐhuì.
The cultural differences between parts of China are really big. That's something I learned first-hand at university.
在大学时代，我过的是标准的集体生活。
Zài dàxué shídài, wǒ guò de shì biāozhǔn de jítǐ shēnghuó.
At university I lived a classic communal life.
除了跟同学们一起学习、一起吃饭以外，还一起住在学校的集体宿舍里。
Chúle gēn tóngxuémen yìqǐ xuéxí, yìqǐ chī fàn yǐwài, hái yìqǐ zhù zài xuéxiào de jítǐ sùshè li.
Besides studying and eating with my classmates, I also lived with them in the college dormitory.
那时住的是六人间。
Nà shí zhù de shì liù rén jiān.
We were six to a room.
六个原本根本不认识的人，分别从全国各地考入北京的同一所大学，
Liù ge yuánběn gēnběn bú rènshi de rén, fēnbié cóng quánguó gèdì kǎorù Běijīng de tóngyī suǒ dàxué,
Six people who had never met, from all over the country, had got into the same university in Beijing,
进校后又被分到了同一间宿舍，一住四年。
jìn xiào hòu yòu bèi fēn dào le tóngyī jiān sùshè, yí zhù sì nián.
and after arriving were put in the same room, where we lived for four years.
我们按照年龄大小排序：
Wǒmen ànzhào niánlíng dàxiǎo páixù:
We ranked ourselves by age:
老大是北京本地人，老二是黑龙江人，我是老三，四川人，
Lǎodà shì Běijīng běndìrén, lǎo'èr shì Hēilóngjiāng rén, wǒ shì lǎosān, Sìchuān rén,
Number One was a Beijing local, Number Two from Heilongjiang, I was Number Three, from Sichuan,
老四是上海人，老五是山东人，老六是从广东来的。
lǎosì shì Shànghǎi rén, lǎowǔ shì Shāndōng rén, lǎoliù shì cóng Guǎngdōng lái de.
Number Four from Shanghai, Number Five from Shandong, and Number Six from Guangdong.
我们六个人成天待在一起，成了好哥们儿。
Wǒmen liù ge rén chéngtiān dāi zài yìqǐ, chéng le hǎo gēmenr.
The six of us were together all day and became good mates.

blocks.label: 方言
blocks.h: 方言和表达习惯 · Dialects and habits of speech
lines: 平时我们都说普通话。
Píngshí wǒmen dōu shuō pǔtōnghuà.
Normally we all spoke Mandarin.
如果讲方言，三位北方同学的家乡话，大家都听得懂。
Rúguǒ jiǎng fāngyán, sān wèi běifāng tóngxué de jiāxiāng huà, dàjiā dōu tīngdedǒng.
If we spoke dialect, everyone could understand the three northerners' home dialects.
四川话要是说得慢，勉强也能听明白，
Sìchuān huà yàoshì shuō de màn, miǎnqiǎng yě néng tīng míngbai,
Sichuanese, if spoken slowly, could just about be understood,
但广东话和上海话就完全听不懂了。
dàn Guǎngdōng huà hé Shànghǎi huà jiù wánquán tīng bu dǒng le.
but Cantonese and Shanghainese were completely incomprehensible.
不仅方言的发音不同，我们的表达习惯也不太一样。
Bùjǐn fāngyán de fāyīn bùtóng, wǒmen de biǎodá xíguàn yě bú tài yíyàng.
Not only did our dialects sound different, our ways of expressing things differed too.
三个北方人指路的时候，习惯用东南西北，
Sān ge běifāng rén zhǐlù de shíhou, xíguàn yòng dōng nán xī běi,
When the three northerners gave directions, they used north, south, east and west,
好像方向的概念已经印在他们脑子里了。
hǎoxiàng fāngxiàng de gàiniàn yǐjīng yìn zài tāmen nǎozi li le.
as if a sense of direction was printed in their brains.
可是南方人根本分不清哪儿是东，哪儿是西，更习惯说前后左右。
Kěshì nánfāng rén gēnběn fēn bu qīng nǎr shì dōng, nǎr shì xī, gèng xíguàn shuō qián hòu zuǒ yòu.
But the southerners couldn't tell east from west at all, and were more used to saying front, back, left and right.

blocks.label: 饮食
lines: 学校食堂的菜相当丰富，不同地方的特色菜都吃得到。
Xuéxiào shítáng de cài xiāngdāng fēngfù, bùtóng dìfang de tèsè cài dōu chī de dào.
The canteen food was very varied; you could get specialities from all over.
结果不到半年，我们都胖了。
Jiéguǒ bú dào bànnián, wǒmen dōu pàng le.
Within six months we'd all put on weight.
中国哪儿的菜最好吃？我们争论过这个问题。
Zhōngguó nǎr de cài zuì hǎochī? Wǒmen zhēnglùn guo zhège wèntí.
Where is Chinese food best? We argued about it.
有人说，山东是孔子的家乡，山东菜是八大菜系之首。
Yǒu rén shuō, Shāndōng shì Kǒngzǐ de jiāxiāng, Shāndōng cài shì bā dà càixì zhī shǒu.
Some said Shandong is Confucius's home, and Shandong cuisine is the first of the eight great cuisines.
有人说，川菜在国内是最大的菜系，到处都有川菜馆。
Yǒu rén shuō, chuāncài zài guónèi shì zuì dà de càixì, dàochù dōu yǒu chuāncài guǎn.
Some said Sichuan food is the biggest cuisine in China, with Sichuan restaurants everywhere.
有人说，在国外，广东菜才是中国的代表菜系，
Yǒu rén shuō, zài guówài, Guǎngdōng cài cái shì Zhōngguó de dàibiǎo càixì,
Some said that abroad, Cantonese food is the cuisine that represents China,
世界各国的中餐馆多数是以广东菜为主。
shìjiè gèguó de zhōngcānguǎn duōshù shì yǐ Guǎngdōng cài wéi zhǔ.
and most Chinese restaurants around the world mainly serve Cantonese food.
我们六个人喜欢的口味也不同。
Wǒmen liù ge rén xǐhuan de kǒuwèi yě bùtóng.
The six of us liked different flavours too.
四川人当然吃麻辣的菜最有胃口。
Sìchuān rén dāngrán chī málà de cài zuì yǒu wèikǒu.
The Sichuanese, of course, had the biggest appetite for numbing-spicy food.
广东人吃得很清淡，有喝汤的习惯。
Guǎngdōng rén chī de hěn qīngdàn, yǒu hē tāng de xíguàn.
The Cantonese ate light food and had a habit of drinking soup.
上海来的老四喜欢甜一点的口味。
Shànghǎi lái de lǎosì xǐhuan tián yìdiǎn de kǒuwèi.
Number Four from Shanghai liked things a bit sweet.
而北方的三个喜欢吃各种面食，
Ér běifāng de sān ge xǐhuan chī gè zhǒng miànshí,
The three northerners liked all kinds of wheaten food,
不过，酸甜苦辣，什么口味的菜都能吃。
búguò, suān tián kǔ là, shénme kǒuwèi de cài dōu néng chī.
but sour, sweet, bitter or spicy, they could eat anything.
因为老六，我才知道，广东人竟然是饭前喝汤。
Yīnwèi lǎoliù, wǒ cái zhīdao, Guǎngdōng rén jìngrán shì fàn qián hē tāng.
It was through Number Six that I learned Cantonese people actually drink soup before the meal.
我还以为全国人民都是饭后喝呢。
Wǒ hái yǐwéi quánguó rénmín dōu shì fàn hòu hē ne.
I'd assumed everyone in China drank it after.

blocks.label: 澡堂
lines: 宿舍里没有卫生间，洗澡得去学校的集体澡堂。
Sùshè li méiyǒu wèishēngjiān, xǐzǎo děi qù xuéxiào de jítǐ zǎotáng.
There were no bathrooms in the dorm; to shower we had to go to the college bathhouse.
我还记得大家第一次去时，几个北方的哥们儿很自然地就开始脱衣服，
Wǒ hái jìde dàjiā dì-yī cì qù shí, jǐ ge běifāng de gēmenr hěn zìrán de jiù kāishǐ tuō yīfu,
I remember the first time we went, the northern guys just naturally started undressing,
而我们南方的三个觉得又吃惊又尴尬。
ér wǒmen nánfāng de sān ge juéde yòu chījīng yòu gāngà.
while we three southerners were shocked and embarrassed.
澡堂里面虽然隔出来很多小间，但是竟然没有门儿，连一点隐私都没有。
Zǎotáng lǐmiàn suīrán gé chulai hěn duō xiǎo jiān, dànshì jìngrán méiyǒu ménr, lián yìdiǎn yǐnsī dōu méiyǒu.
The bathhouse was divided into lots of little cubicles, but they actually had no doors, so there was no privacy at all.
吓得我连忙跑了出来。
Xià de wǒ liánmáng pǎo le chulai.
I was so startled I rushed straight out.
不过后来我也渐渐地习惯了集体澡堂。
Búguò hòulái wǒ yě jiànjiàn de xíguàn le jítǐ zǎotáng.
But later I gradually got used to the communal bathhouse.
也是在那时，我才知道世界上还有搓澡巾这玩意儿，
Yě shì zài nà shí, wǒ cái zhīdao shìjiè shang hái yǒu cuōzǎojīn zhè wányìr,
It was also then that I found out there's such a thing as a scrubbing mitt,
而在南方洗澡，使用毛巾。
ér zài nánfāng xǐzǎo, shǐyòng máojīn.
whereas in the south you wash with a towel.
我们讨论过，觉得这种生活习惯上的差异可能与地理环境有关。
Wǒmen tǎolùn guo, juéde zhè zhǒng shēnghuó xíguàn shàng de chāyì kěnéng yǔ dìlǐ huánjìng yǒuguān.
We discussed it and felt these differences in habits might be linked to geography.
北方冬季寒冷，而且缺水，
Běifāng dōngjì hánlěng, érqiě quēshuǐ,
Northern winters are cold and water is scarce,
所以人们养成了隔几天去公共澡堂的习惯，洗澡时需要使劲地搓。
suǒyǐ rénmen yǎngchéng le gé jǐ tiān qù gōnggòng zǎotáng de xíguàn, xǐzǎo shí xūyào shǐjìn de cuō.
so people got into the habit of going to the public baths every few days, and scrubbing hard when they washed.
而南方水资源丰富，天气湿热，得天天洗，
Ér nánfāng shuǐ zīyuán fēngfù, tiānqì shī rè, děi tiāntiān xǐ,
The south has plenty of water and is hot and humid, so people have to wash every day,
不需要搓这么激烈的方式了。
bù xūyào cuō zhème jīliè de fāngshì le.
and don't need such vigorous scrubbing.

blocks.label: 冬天
blocks.h: 南北的冬天 · Winter, north and south
lines: 在北京的第一年，冬天下了好几场雪，我们三个南方人兴奋得不得了。
Zài Běijīng de dì-yī nián, dōngtiān xià le hǎo jǐ chǎng xuě, wǒmen sān ge nánfāng rén xīngfèn de bùdéliǎo.
In our first year in Beijing it snowed several times, and we three southerners were beside ourselves with excitement,
特别是从广东来的老六，因为广东冬季平均温度是十到十五度，从来没见过那么大的雪。
Tèbié shì cóng Guǎngdōng lái de lǎoliù, yīnwèi Guǎngdōng dōngjì píngjūn wēndù shì shí dào shíwǔ dù, cónglái méi jiàn guo nàme dà de xuě.
especially Number Six from Guangdong, where the average winter temperature is 10 to 15 degrees; he'd never seen so much snow.
我也是十八年以来，冬天第一次在室内穿短袖。
Wǒ yě shì shíbā nián yǐlái, dōngtiān dì-yī cì zài shìnèi chuān duǎnxiù.
And for the first time in eighteen years, I wore short sleeves indoors in winter.
暖气太舒服了，可惜四川没有。
Nuǎnqì tài shūfu le, kěxī Sìchuān méiyǒu.
Central heating is wonderful. Pity Sichuan doesn't have it.
小时候，冬天在房间里即使穿着厚厚的棉衣，也冷得发抖。
Xiǎoshíhou, dōngtiān zài fángjiān li jíshǐ chuānzhe hòuhòu de miányī, yě lěng de fādǒu.
As a child, even in a thick padded jacket I'd shiver with cold indoors in winter.
但在北方室友眼里，我们真是大惊小怪。
Dàn zài běifāng shìyǒu yǎn li, wǒmen zhēn shì dà jīng xiǎo guài.
But to our northern roommates, we were making a fuss about nothing.
在东北，冬季气温在零下十五度到零下三十度之间，吹一口气都能结冰。
Zài Dōngběi, dōngjì qìwēn zài língxià shíwǔ dù dào língxià sānshí dù zhījiān, chuī yì kǒu qì dōu néng jiébīng.
In the north-east, winter temperatures are between minus 15 and minus 30; your breath freezes as you blow.
我直到今天还记得老二说这话时的表情。
Wǒ zhídào jīntiān hái jìde lǎo'èr shuō zhè huà shí de biǎoqíng.
I still remember Number Two's face when he said that.
但是毕业后，他去了南方工作。
Dànshì bìyè hòu, tā qù le nánfāng gōngzuò.
But after graduating he went to work in the south.
后来他跟我说：“你们南方的冬天实在太难熬了，
Hòulái tā gēn wǒ shuō: "Nǐmen nánfāng de dōngtiān shízài tài nán'áo le,
Later he told me: "Your southern winters are really hard to bear.
又冷又潮湿，冷空气一直钻到骨头里。你们能长那么大，真不容易。”
yòu lěng yòu cháoshī, lěng kōngqì yìzhí zuān dào gǔtou li. Nǐmen néng zhǎng nàme dà, zhēn bù róngyì."
Cold and damp, the cold gets right into your bones. It's amazing you lot survive to grow up."

blocks.label: 性格
blocks.h: 地区和性格 · Region and character
lines: 人们都说，不同地区的人有不同的性格。
Rénmen dōu shuō, bùtóng dìqū de rén yǒu bùtóng de xìnggé.
People say that people from different regions have different characters.
东北人豪爽直率，山东人可靠实在，
Dōngběi rén háoshuǎng zhíshuài, Shāndōng rén kěkào shízài,
North-easterners are open and straightforward; people from Shandong are reliable and down-to-earth;
北京人很有礼貌，很健谈，也很有优越感，
Běijīng rén hěn yǒu lǐmào, hěn jiàntán, yě hěn yǒu yōuyuègǎn,
Beijingers are polite and talkative, with a sense of superiority;
上海人精明时髦，头脑灵活，
Shànghǎi rén jīngmíng shímáo, tóunǎo línghuó,
Shanghainese are shrewd, fashionable and quick-witted;
四川人能干也能吃苦，广东人很讲究吃，也很会做生意。
Sìchuān rén nénggàn yě néng chī kǔ, Guǎngdōng rén hěn jiǎngjiū chī, yě hěn huì zuòshēngyì.
Sichuanese are capable and can take hardship; Cantonese care a lot about food and are good at business.
跟室友们在一起生活了四年，我觉得这种说法虽然不完全正确，但大体上还是有道理的。
Gēn shìyǒumen zài yìqǐ shēnghuó le sì nián, wǒ juéde zhè zhǒng shuōfǎ suīrán bù wánquán zhèngquè, dàn dàtǐshàng háishi yǒu dàolǐ de.
Having lived with my roommates for four years, I think that while this isn't entirely right, it's broadly true.
中国南北文化差异不小，即使同一地区，不同地方的人也有文化差异。
Zhōngguó nánběi wénhuà chāyì bù xiǎo, jíshǐ tóngyī dìqū, bùtóng dìfang de rén yě yǒu wénhuà chāyì.
The cultural differences between north and south China are big, and even within one region people from different places differ.
这还真不是一两句话能说得完的。
Zhè hái zhēn bú shì yì liǎng jù huà néng shuō de wán de.
It's really not something you can sum up in a sentence or two.

grammar: 除了……以外，还……
besides …, also …
Adds to what's mentioned.
除了跟同学们一起学习、一起吃饭以外，还一起住在学校的集体宿舍里。
Chúle gēn tóngxuémen yìqǐ xuéxí, yìqǐ chī fàn yǐwài, hái yìqǐ zhù zài xuéxiào de jítǐ sùshè li.
Besides studying and eating with my classmates, I also lived with them in the college dormitory.
除了汉语以外，他还会说日语。
Chúle Hànyǔ yǐwài, tā hái huì shuō Rìyǔ.
Besides Chinese, he speaks Japanese too.
按照……排序
to rank by …
按照 = according to.
我们按照年龄大小排序：
Wǒmen ànzhào niánlíng dàxiǎo páixù:
We ranked ourselves by age:
按照时间排序。
Ànzhào shíjiān páixù.
Sort by time.
要是……，勉强也能……
if …, you can just about …
勉强 = barely.
四川话要是说得慢，勉强也能听明白，
Sìchuān huà yàoshì shuō de màn, miǎnqiǎng yě néng tīng míngbai,
Sichuanese, if spoken slowly, could just about be understood,
要是走快点，勉强能赶上。
Yàoshì zǒu kuài diǎn, miǎnqiǎng néng gǎnshàng.
If we walk fast we might just make it.
分不清
can't tell apart
V + 不清 = can't … clearly.
可是南方人根本分不清哪儿是东，哪儿是西，更习惯说前后左右。
Kěshì nánfāng rén gēnběn fēn bu qīng nǎr shì dōng, nǎr shì xī, gèng xíguàn shuō qián hòu zuǒ yòu.
But the southerners couldn't tell east from west at all, and were more used to saying front, back, left and right.
我分不清他们俩。
Wǒ fēn bu qīng tāmen liǎ.
I can't tell the two of them apart.
以……为主
mainly …
以 A 为主 = A is the main part.
世界各国的中餐馆多数是以广东菜为主。
shìjiè gèguó de zhōngcānguǎn duōshù shì yǐ Guǎngdōng cài wéi zhǔ.
and most Chinese restaurants around the world mainly serve Cantonese food.
早饭以面包为主。
Zǎofàn yǐ miànbāo wéi zhǔ.
Breakfast is mainly bread.
both … and …
Two feelings at once.
而我们南方的三个觉得又吃惊又尴尬。
ér wǒmen nánfāng de sān ge juéde yòu chījīng yòu gāngà.
while we three southerners were shocked and embarrassed.
又冷又潮湿。
Yòu lěng yòu cháoshī.
Cold and damp.
连……都没有
not even …
Stresses total lack.
澡堂里面虽然隔出来很多小间，但是竟然没有门儿，连一点隐私都没有。
Zǎotáng lǐmiàn suīrán gé chulai hěn duō xiǎo jiān, dànshì jìngrán méiyǒu ménr, lián yìdiǎn yǐnsī dōu méiyǒu.
The bathhouse was divided into lots of little cubicles, but they actually had no doors, so there was no privacy at all.
连一个人都没有。
Lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu.
There wasn't a single person.
与……有关
to be related to …
Formal.
我们讨论过，觉得这种生活习惯上的差异可能与地理环境有关。
Wǒmen tǎolùn guo, juéde zhè zhǒng shēnghuó xíguàn shàng de chāyì kěnéng yǔ dìlǐ huánjìng yǒuguān.
We discussed it and felt these differences in habits might be linked to geography.
这与天气有关。
Zhè yǔ tiānqì yǒuguān.
This is related to the weather.
even if …, still …
A concessive condition.
小时候，冬天在房间里即使穿着厚厚的棉衣，也冷得发抖。
Xiǎoshíhou, dōngtiān zài fángjiān li jíshǐ chuānzhe hòuhòu de miányī, yě lěng de fādǒu.
As a child, even in a thick padded jacket I'd shiver with cold indoors in winter.
即使下雨，我也去。
Jíshǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě qù.
I'll go even if it rains.
gaps: 已经印在他们脑子里了。
四川人当然吃麻辣的菜最有
但在北方室友眼里，我们真是
say: The cultural differences between parts of China are really big. That's something I learned first-hand at university.
It's really not something you can sum up in a sentence or two.

109.title: North–south differences in China
109.sub: Lesson 7 reading: climate, history, dialects, food and character
109.transcriptNote: The second lesson 7 reading. 南水北调 is the South–North Water Transfer Project. 京剧 is Peking opera and 越剧 is Yue opera from Zhejiang; 梁山伯与祝英台 ("The Butterfly Lovers") is a famous Yue opera.

blocks.label: 课文
blocks.h: 中国的南北差异 · The text
lines: 中国的南北差异
Zhōngguó de nánběi chāyì
North–south differences in China
秦岭淮河一线是中国地理上最重要的南北分界线。
Qínlǐng Huái Hé yí xiàn shì Zhōngguó dìlǐ shàng zuì zhòngyào de nánběi fēnjièxiàn.
The Qinling–Huai River line is the most important geographical north–south dividing line in China.
秦岭位于中国中部，是一条大山脉。
Qínlǐng wèiyú Zhōngguó zhōngbù, shì yì tiáo dà shānmài.
The Qinling is a great mountain range in central China.
淮河位于长江与黄河之间，是中国七大河之一。
Huái Hé wèiyú Cháng Jiāng yǔ Huáng Hé zhījiān, shì Zhōngguó qī dà hé zhī yī.
The Huai River lies between the Yangtze and the Yellow River and is one of China's seven great rivers.
秦岭南北地区不仅在气候、地理环境方面差异很大，
Qínlǐng nánběi dìqū bùjǐn zài qìhòu, dìlǐ huánjìng fāngmiàn chāyì hěn dà,
The regions north and south of the Qinling differ greatly not only in climate and geography;
而且因为历史文化以及政治经济活动不同，
érqiě yīnwèi lìshǐ wénhuà yǐjí zhèngzhì jīngjì huódòng bùtóng,
because their history, culture, politics and economies differ too,
南方人和北方人在语言、习俗，甚至性格、外貌特征方面也有一定的差异。
nánfāng rén hé běifāng rén zài yǔyán, xísú, shènzhì xìnggé, wàimào tèzhēng fāngmiàn yě yǒu yídìng de chāyì.
southerners and northerners also differ to some extent in language, customs, and even character and appearance.

blocks.label: 气候
blocks.h: 气候和供暖 · Climate and heating
lines: 南方气候湿润，不过夏季闷热，冬季潮湿。
Nánfāng qìhòu shīrùn, búguò xiàjì mēnrè, dōngjì cháoshī.
The south is humid: summers are muggy and winters damp.
夏秋季节，南方的降雨量很大，常常发生水灾。
Xià qiū jìjié, nánfāng de jiàngyǔliàng hěn dà, chángcháng fāshēng shuǐzāi.
In summer and autumn the south gets heavy rain, and floods are common.
北方的天气干燥，夏天炎热，冬天寒冷，
Běifāng de tiānqì gānzào, xiàtiān yánrè, dōngtiān hánlěng,
The north is dry, with hot summers and cold winters;
一年四季降雨量不多，常常出现缺水的情况。
yì nián sìjì jiàngyǔliàng bù duō, chángcháng chūxiàn quēshuǐ de qíngkuàng.
there's little rain all year, and water shortages are common.
为了解决这个问题，中国从二零零二年开始建设南水北调工程。
Wèile jiějué zhège wèntí, Zhōngguó cóng èr líng líng èr nián kāishǐ jiànshè Nán Shuǐ Běi Diào gōngchéng.
To solve this, China began building the South–North Water Transfer Project in 2002.
但对这个工程的争议一直存在。
Dàn duì zhège gōngchéng de zhēngyì yìzhí cúnzài.
But the project has always been controversial.
有人认为，工程过于巨大，会造成经济上的浪费，也会带来一些污染。
Yǒu rén rènwéi, gōngchéng guòyú jùdà, huì zàochéng jīngjì shàng de làngfèi, yě huì dàilái yìxiē wūrǎn.
Some think it's too huge, a waste of money, and will cause some pollution.
因为北方的冬天比南方冷，从五十年代起，中国冬季采用集中供暖的方式，
Yīnwèi běifāng de dōngtiān bǐ nánfāng lěng, cóng wǔshí niándài qǐ, Zhōngguó dōngjì cǎiyòng jízhōng gōngnuǎn de fāngshì,
Because northern winters are colder, since the 1950s China has used central heating in winter,
以秦岭、淮河这条线为界，向北方集中供暖。
yǐ Qínlǐng, Huái Hé zhè tiáo xiàn wéi jiè, xiàng běifāng jízhōng gōngnuǎn.
supplying it to the north of the Qinling–Huai line.
但近几年来，中国南方多地冬季持续出现低温天气，
Dàn jìn jǐ nián lái, Zhōngguó nánfāng duō dì dōngjì chíxù chūxiàn dīwēn tiānqì,
But in recent years, many places in the south have had long spells of low winter temperatures,
南方供暖的问题再一次引起了全社会的关注。
nánfāng gōngnuǎn de wèntí zài yí cì yǐnqǐ le quán shèhuì de guānzhù.
and the question of heating the south has once again drawn public attention.

blocks.label: 经济
blocks.h: 资源、经济和历史 · Resources, economy and history
lines: 中国南北自然资源的分布也不同。
Zhōngguó nánběi zìrán zīyuán de fēnbù yě bùtóng.
Natural resources are also distributed differently in north and south.
受其影响，中国北方以重工业为主，而南方轻工业相对发达。
Shòu qí yǐngxiǎng, Zhōngguó běifāng yǐ zhònggōngyè wéi zhǔ, ér nánfāng qīnggōngyè xiāngduì fādá.
As a result, the north is mainly heavy industry, while light industry is relatively developed in the south.
在历史上，中国北方是军事政治中心，而南方的经济文化则相对发达。
Zài lìshǐshàng, Zhōngguó běifāng shì jūnshì zhèngzhì zhōngxīn, ér nánfāng de jīngjì wénhuà zé xiāngduì fādá.
Historically, the north was the military and political centre, while the south was relatively advanced economically and culturally.
在今天，中国的首都仍然在北方，
Zài jīntiān, Zhōngguó de shǒudū réngrán zài běifāng,
Today China's capital is still in the north,
长江中下游一带仍然是中国经济最发达的地区。
Cháng Jiāng zhōng xiàyóu yí dài réngrán shì Zhōngguó jīngjì zuì fādá de dìqū.
and the middle and lower Yangtze is still the most economically developed region.

blocks.label: 语言
lines: 北方交通便利，风俗语言和文化比较统一，
Běifāng jiāotōng biànlì, fēngsú yǔyán hé wénhuà bǐjiào tǒngyī,
The north has good communications, and its customs, language and culture are fairly uniform;
北方人之间没有太大的交流障碍。
běifāng rén zhījiān méiyǒu tài dà de jiāoliú zhàng'ài.
northerners have no great trouble understanding one another.
而南方地理环境复杂，存在五里不同音的现象。
Ér nánfāng dìlǐ huánjìng fùzá, cúnzài wǔ lǐ bù tóng yīn de xiànxiàng.
But the south's geography is complex, and the way people speak changes every few miles.
都是南方人，一个上海人和一个温州人，如果只讲自己的方言，那他们根本无法交流。
Dōu shì nánfāng rén, yí ge Shànghǎi rén hé yí ge Wēnzhōu rén, rúguǒ zhǐ jiǎng zìjǐ de fāngyán, nà tāmen gēnběn wúfǎ jiāoliú.
A Shanghainese and someone from Wenzhou are both southerners, but if each speaks only their own dialect, they can't communicate at all.
汉语有七大方言区，其中六大方言区都在南方。
Hànyǔ yǒu qī dà fāngyán qū, qízhōng liù dà fāngyán qū dōu zài nánfāng.
Chinese has seven major dialect groups, and six of them are in the south.

blocks.label: 饮食性格
blocks.h: 饮食、外貌和性格 · Food, looks and character
lines: 南北方的农业生产结构不同，这造成了饮食习惯的差异。
Nán-běi fāng de nóngyè shēngchǎn jiégòu bùtóng, zhè zàochéng le yǐnshí xíguàn de chāyì.
Different farming patterns in north and south have produced different eating habits.
南方人以米为主食，而北方人以面为主食。
Nánfāng rén yǐ mǐ wéi zhǔshí, ér běifāng rén yǐ miàn wéi zhǔshí.
Southerners eat mainly rice; northerners eat mainly wheat.
受气候、地理环境、食物等的影响，南方人相对瘦小，北方人则相对高大。
Shòu qìhòu, dìlǐ huánjìng, shíwù děng de yǐngxiǎng, nánfāng rén xiāngduì shòuxiǎo, běifāng rén zé xiāngduì gāodà.
Influenced by climate, geography, food and so on, southerners are relatively slight and northerners relatively tall and big.
在自然环境、历史文化和经济发展不同的地方，人的性格差异也比较大。
Zài zìrán huánjìng, lìshǐ wénhuà hé jīngjì fāzhǎn bùtóng de dìfang, rén de xìnggé chāyì yě bǐjiào dà.
Where nature, history, culture and economic development differ, people's characters differ quite a lot too.
南方人性格比较温和，说话比较含蓄，而北方人比较豪爽、直率。
Nánfāng rén xìnggé bǐjiào wēnhé, shuōhuà bǐjiào hánxù, ér běifāng rén bǐjiào háoshuǎng, zhíshuài.
Southerners tend to be mild and indirect; northerners tend to be open and straightforward.
北方人喜欢大块吃肉，大碗喝酒，
Běifāng rén xǐhuan dà kuài chī ròu, dà wǎn hē jiǔ,
Northerners like eating meat in big chunks and drinking from big bowls,
而南方人喜欢把肉切得细细的，用小酒杯慢慢地喝。
ér nánfāng rén xǐhuan bǎ ròu qiè de xìxì de, yòng xiǎo jiǔbēi mànmàn de hē.
while southerners like to cut meat finely and sip from small cups.
北方的女人和男人一样豪爽，而南方的男人像女人一样细心。
Běifāng de nǚrén hé nánrén yíyàng háoshuǎng, ér nánfāng de nánrén xiàng nǚrén yíyàng xìxīn.
Northern women are as open-hearted as the men; southern men are as attentive as the women.
南柔北刚也体现在中国的戏剧文化里。
Nán róu běi gāng yě tǐxiàn zài Zhōngguó de xìjù wénhuà li.
"Soft south, hard north" also shows in Chinese theatre.
北方剧的代表是京剧，它的一个特点是男人扮演女人。
Běifāng jù de dàibiǎo shì jīngjù, tā de yí ge tèdiǎn shì nánrén bànyǎn nǚrén.
The typical northern form is Peking opera, where men play women's roles.
南方剧的代表是越剧，它的特点则是女人扮演男人。
Nánfāng jù de dàibiǎo shì yuèjù, tā de tèdiǎn zé shì nǚrén bànyǎn nánrén.
The typical southern form is Yue opera, where women play men.
在著名的越剧“梁山伯与祝英台”中，梁山伯的扮演者一直都是女的。
Zài zhùmíng de yuèjù "Liáng Shānbó yǔ Zhù Yīngtái" zhōng, Liáng Shānbó de bànyǎn zhě yìzhí dōu shì nǚ de.
In the famous Yue opera "The Butterfly Lovers", Liang Shanbo has always been played by a woman.

blocks.label: 结论
lines: 因为这些差异，有时候光听口音，大体上就可以判断出对方是哪里人。
Yīnwèi zhèxiē chāyì, yǒushíhou guāng tīng kǒuyīn, dàtǐshàng jiù kěyǐ pànduàn chū duìfāng shì nǎli rén.
Because of these differences, sometimes just by the accent you can roughly tell where someone is from.
有时甚至不必开口，光看外貌，就能猜得到对方的家乡在哪儿。
Yǒushí shènzhì búbì kāikǒu, guāng kàn wàimào, jiù néng cāi de dào duìfāng de jiāxiāng zài nǎr.

Wǒ shì zuò fēijī lái de.
I came by plane.
再这样，……
if you do this again, …
A mock warning.
下次再这样，你别来了。
Xiàcì zài zhèyàng, nǐ bié lái le.
If you do this again, don't come.
再这样我就生气了。
Zài zhèyàng wǒ jiù shēngqì le.
Do that again and I'll be cross.
可不行
that won't do at all
可 adds emphasis.
这可不行，你快拿回去。
Zhè kě bù xíng, nǐ kuài ná huíqu.
I can't accept this. Take it back.
这可不行！
Zhè kě bù xíng!
That won't do!
用不着……
there's no need to …
V + 不着 = unnecessary.
你和我用不着这样。
Nǐ hé wǒ yòng bu zháo zhèyàng.
There's no need for this between us.
用不着担心。
Yòng bu zháo dānxīn.
No need to worry.

113.title: Completing sentences
113.sub: Ten sentences built on the gift-giving words
113.transcriptNote: Ten sentences to complete from the recording. The textbook's gaps aren't known here, so every sentence is written in full and the Gap-fill tab blanks out the new words. Several item numbers aren't read aloud. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 根据录音补充句子 · Complete the sentences
lines: 根据录音把句子补充完整。
Gēnjù lùyīn bǎ jùzi bǔchōng wánzhěng.
Complete the sentences according to the recording.
姐姐去美国的签证到现在还没有办下来，她都快急死了。
Jiějie qù Měiguó de qiānzhèng dào xiànzài hái méi yǒu bàn xialai, tā dōu kuài jí sǐ le.
My sister's visa for America still hasn't come through. She's going frantic.
来，我敬大家一杯酒，为我们的友谊干杯！
Lái, wǒ jìng dàjiā yì bēi jiǔ, wèi wǒmen de yǒuyì gānbēi!
Come on, let me propose a toast to everyone. To our friendship!
一路上，他十分小心，细心地照顾他的小狗。
Yí lù shang, tā shífēn xiǎoxīn, xìxīn de zhàogù tā de xiǎogǒu.
All the way, he was very careful and looked after his puppy attentively.
今天我请客，大家一定要吃个痛快，玩个痛快，千万别客气。
Jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè, dàjiā yídìng yào chī ge tòngkuai, wán ge tòngkuai, qiānwàn bié kèqì.
Today's on me. Everyone eat your fill and have a great time. Don't stand on ceremony.
这支钢笔是我从中国带来的，这是我的一点心意，你一定要收下。礼轻情义重嘛。
Zhè zhī gāngbǐ shì wǒ cóng Zhōngguó dàilái de, zhè shì wǒ de yìdiǎn xīnyì, nǐ yídìng yào shōuxia. Lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng ma.
I brought this pen from China. It's a small token of my regard, and you must accept it. It's the thought that counts.
礼品是不是很贵重，没有关系，重要的是礼品代表的情谊深厚。
Lǐpǐn shì bu shì hěn guìzhòng, méiyǒu guānxi, zhòngyào de shì lǐpǐn dàibiǎo de qíngyì shēnhòu.
Whether a gift is valuable doesn't matter. What matters is the deep friendship it stands for.
一看见姐夫，赶紧把事情的经过仔仔细细地讲了一遍，希望姐夫能想出一个解决的办法。
Yí kànjiàn jiěfu, gǎnjǐn bǎ shìqing de jīngguò zǐzǐxìxì de jiǎng le yí biàn, xīwàng jiěfu néng xiǎng chū yí ge jiějué de bànfǎ.
As soon as she saw her brother-in-law, she told him the whole story in detail, hoping he could think of a solution.
这座小城夏天气温较高。暑假的时候，孩子们喜欢到湖边玩水、喂天鹅，非常开心。
Zhè zuò xiǎo chéng xiàtiān qìwēn jiào gāo. Shǔjià de shíhou, háizimen xǐhuan dào húbiān wán shuǐ, wèi tiān'é, fēicháng kāixīn.
This little town is quite hot in summer. In the summer holidays, children love going to the lake to play in the water and feed the swans. They have a great time.
老刘从信封里拿出三百元，对老张说：“老张，你别嫌少，这是我的一点心意。”
Lǎo Liú cóng xìnfēng li ná chū sānbǎi yuán, duì Lǎo Zhāng shuō: "Lǎo Zhāng, nǐ bié xián shǎo, zhè shì wǒ de yìdiǎn xīnyì."
Lao Liu took 300 yuan out of the envelope and said to Lao Zhang: "Lao Zhang, don't think it's too little. It's a small token of my regard."
送礼在中国人日常生活中是不可缺少的一个部分。
Sònglǐ zài Zhōngguórén rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng shì bùkě quēshǎo de yí ge bùfen.
Giving gifts is an indispensable part of everyday Chinese life.
通过礼品，人们表达自己对家人、朋友、同事或者长辈的尊敬和关心。
Tōngguò lǐpǐn, rénmen biǎodá zìjǐ duì jiārén, péngyou, tóngshì huòzhě zhǎngbèi de zūnjìng hé guānxīn.
Through gifts, people express respect and care for family, friends, colleagues or elders.

grammar: 办下来
to get (something) done, to come through
下来 shows completion.
姐姐去美国的签证到现在还没有办下来，她都快急死了。
Jiějie qù Měiguó de qiānzhèng dào xiànzài hái méi yǒu bàn xialai, tā dōu kuài jí sǐ le.
My sister's visa for America still hasn't come through. She's going frantic.
手续办下来了。
Shǒuxù bàn xialai le.
The paperwork has gone through.
为……干杯
to drink to …
为 introduces the purpose.
来，我敬大家一杯酒，为我们的友谊干杯！
Lái, wǒ jìng dàjiā yì bēi jiǔ, wèi wǒmen de yǒuyì gānbēi!
Come on, let me propose a toast to everyone. To our friendship!
为你的健康干杯！
Wèi nǐ de jiànkāng gānbēi!
To your health!
V个痛快
to … to one's heart's content
个 + adjective as a complement.
今天我请客，大家一定要吃个痛快，玩个痛快，千万别客气。
Jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè, dàjiā yídìng yào chī ge tòngkuai, wán ge tòngkuai, qiānwàn bié kèqì.
Today's on me. Everyone eat your fill and have a great time. Don't stand on ceremony.
今天玩个痛快吧。
Jīntiān wán ge tòngkuai ba.
Let's have a great time today.
after all, you see
Makes the reason sound obvious.
这支钢笔是我从中国带来的，这是我的一点心意，你一定要收下。礼轻情义重嘛。
Zhè zhī gāngbǐ shì wǒ cóng Zhōngguó dàilái de, zhè shì wǒ de yìdiǎn xīnyì, nǐ yídìng yào shōuxia. Lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng ma.
I brought this pen from China. It's a small token of my regard, and you must accept it. It's the thought that counts.
他是孩子嘛。
Tā shì háizi ma.
He's a child, after all.
……，没有关系
… doesn't matter
Puts something aside.
礼品是不是很贵重，没有关系，重要的是礼品代表的情谊深厚。
Lǐpǐn shì bu shì hěn guìzhòng, méiyǒu guānxi, zhòngyào de shì lǐpǐn dàibiǎo de qíngyì shēnhòu.
Whether a gift is valuable doesn't matter. What matters is the deep friendship it stands for.
晚一点没有关系。
Wǎn yìdiǎn méiyǒu guānxi.
Being a bit late doesn't matter.
一……就…… / 一看见……，赶紧……
as soon as …
One action follows another at once.
一看见姐夫，赶紧把事情的经过仔仔细细地讲了一遍，希望姐夫能想出一个解决的办法。
Yí kànjiàn jiěfu, gǎnjǐn bǎ shìqing de jīngguò zǐzǐxìxì de jiǎng le yí biàn, xīwàng jiěfu néng xiǎng chū yí ge jiějué de bànfǎ.
As soon as she saw her brother-in-law, she told him the whole story in detail, hoping he could think of a solution.
他一到家就睡了。
Tā yí dào jiā jiù shuì le.
He went to sleep as soon as he got home.
别嫌少
don't think it's too little
嫌 = to complain that.
老刘从信封里拿出三百元，对老张说：“老张，你别嫌少，这是我的一点心意。”
Lǎo Liú cóng xìnfēng li ná chū sānbǎi yuán, duì Lǎo Zhāng shuō: "Lǎo Zhāng, nǐ bié xián shǎo, zhè shì wǒ de yìdiǎn xīnyì."
Lao Liu took 300 yuan out of the envelope and said to Lao Zhang: "Lao Zhang, don't think it's too little. It's a small token of my regard."
别嫌麻烦。
Bié xián máfan.
Don't mind the trouble.
gaps: 重要的是礼品代表的情谊
送礼在中国人日常生活中是不可

114.title: Spot the repeated word
114.sub: Five pairs of sentences, one shared word in each
114.transcriptNote: Each pair repeats one of the lesson 8 words. Turn on Answers to check.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
你将听到五组句子，请找出各组句子中重复出现的词语。
Nǐ jiāng tīngdào wǔ zǔ jùzi, qǐng zhǎo chū gè zǔ jùzi zhōng chóngfù chūxiàn de cíyǔ.
You'll hear five groups of sentences. Find the word repeated in each group.
小刘，你明天去机场送客人，顺路去一下银行帮我办一件事好吗？
Xiǎo Liú, nǐ míngtiān qù jīchǎng sòng kèrén, shùnlù qù yíxià yínháng bāng wǒ bàn yí jiàn shì hǎo ma?
Xiao Liu, when you take the guests to the airport tomorrow, could you drop by the bank on the way and do something for me?
A
今天下班我送你回家吧，正好顺路。
Jīntiān xià bān wǒ sòng nǐ huí jiā ba, zhènghǎo shùnlù.
I'll take you home after work today. It's on my way.
B
你们俩什么时候结婚呀？到时候通知我们一声。
Nǐmen liǎ shénme shíhou jié hūn ya? Dào shíhou tōngzhī wǒmen yì shēng.
When are you two getting married? Let us know when it's time.
A
什么？这个周末要加班吗？没人通知我们呀。
Shénme? Zhège zhōumò yào jiā bān ma? Méi rén tōngzhī wǒmen ya.
What? We have to work this weekend? Nobody told us.
B
这个爱情故事我很早以前就听说过了，确实挺感动人的。
Zhège àiqíng gùshi wǒ hěn zǎo yǐqián jiù tīngshuō guo le, quèshí tǐng gǎndòng rén de.
I heard this love story long ago. It really is very moving.
A
这个姑娘被那个小伙子的善良和诚实感动了，慢慢地爱上了他。
Zhège gūniáng bèi nàge xiǎohuǒzi de shànliáng hé chéngshí gǎndòng le, mànmàn de àishàng le tā.
The girl was moved by the young man's kindness and honesty, and gradually fell in love with him.
B
你刚才说的话代表你个人的价值观，不代表我们的观点。
Nǐ gāngcái shuō de huà dàibiǎo nǐ gèrén de jiàzhíguān, bú dàibiǎo wǒmen de guāndiǎn.
What you just said represents your personal values, not our view.
A
不同国家、不同民族的人有不同的价值观是很正常的。
Bùtóng guójiā, bùtóng mínzú de rén yǒu bùtóng de jiàzhíguān shì hěn zhèngcháng de.
It's perfectly normal for people of different countries and ethnic groups to have different values.
B
儿媳妇儿特别细心，把家里每个人都照顾得很好。
Érxífur tèbié xìxīn, bǎ jiā li měi ge rén dōu zhàogù de hěn hǎo.
My daughter-in-law is especially attentive and looks after everyone in the family very well.
A
这件事很重要，必须找一个细心的人去办。
Zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòngyào, bìxū zhǎo yí ge xìxīn de rén qù bàn.
This matter is important. We must find a careful person to handle it.
B

grammar: 顺路去一下……
to drop in at … on the way
一下 softens the action.
小刘，你明天去机场送客人，顺路去一下银行帮我办一件事好吗？
Xiǎo Liú, nǐ míngtiān qù jīchǎng sòng kèrén, shùnlù qù yíxià yínháng bāng wǒ bàn yí jiàn shì hǎo ma?
Xiao Liu, when you take the guests to the airport tomorrow, could you drop by the bank on the way and do something for me?
顺路去一下超市吧。
Shùnlù qù yíxià chāoshì ba.
Let's drop by the supermarket on the way.
通知……一声
to let … know
一声 = a word.
你们俩什么时候结婚呀？到时候通知我们一声。
Nǐmen liǎ shénme shíhou jié hūn ya? Dào shíhou tōngzhī wǒmen yì shēng.
When are you two getting married? Let us know when it's time.
走的时候说一声。
Zǒu de shíhou shuō yì shēng.
Say when you're leaving.
被……感动了
to be moved by …
A passive with 被.
这个姑娘被那个小伙子的善良和诚实感动了，慢慢地爱上了他。
Zhège gūniáng bèi nàge xiǎohuǒzi de shànliáng hé chéngshí gǎndòng le, mànmàn de àishàng le tā.
The girl was moved by the young man's kindness and honesty, and gradually fell in love with him.
我被这个故事感动了。
Wǒ bèi zhège gùshi gǎndòng le.
I was moved by this story.
V得很好
to do … very well
A complement of degree.
儿媳妇儿特别细心，把家里每个人都照顾得很好。
Érxífur tèbié xìxīn, bǎ jiā li měi ge rén dōu zhàogù de hěn hǎo.
My daughter-in-law is especially attentive and looks after everyone in the family very well.
他汉语说得很好。
Tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
He speaks Chinese very well.
gaps: 今天下班我送你回家吧，正好
你刚才说的话代表你个人的

115.title: Do the two sentences match?
115.sub: Five pairs: same meaning or not?
115.transcriptNote: Each item has two sentences, A and B. Decide whether they mean the same thing, then turn on Answers. The letter B isn't read aloud. The answers are my own judgement. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断意思是否相符 · Same meaning?
lines: 听录音，判断两个句子的意思是否相符。
Tīng lùyīn, pànduàn liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu xiāngfú.
Listen and decide whether the two sentences mean the same.
老刘早就盼望着自己当奶奶这一天了，现在这个梦想终于实现了。
Lǎo Liú zǎojiù pànwàngzhe zìjǐ dāng nǎinai zhè yì tiān le, xiànzài zhège mèngxiǎng zhōngyú shíxiàn le.
Lao Liu had long been looking forward to becoming a grandmother, and now that dream has finally come true.
A
老刘很早就希望自己有一个孙子或孙女，现在她终于成为了奶奶。
Lǎo Liú hěn zǎo jiù xīwàng zìjǐ yǒu yí ge sūnzi huò sūnnǚ, xiànzài tā zhōngyú chéngwéi le nǎinai.
Lao Liu had long hoped for a grandchild, and now she's finally a grandmother.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say she had long hoped to be a grandmother and now is one.

lines: 他们俩什么时候搬的家呀？怎么没跟我们打个招呼？
Tāmen liǎ shénme shíhou bān de jiā ya? Zěnme méi gēn wǒmen dǎ ge zhāohu?
When did those two move? Why didn't they tell us?
A
他们俩搬家没有通知我们。
Tāmen liǎ bān jiā méiyǒu tōngzhī wǒmen.
They moved without telling us.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: 打个招呼 here means to let someone know.

lines: 小丽，我这次出差比较急，没来得及通知你。这个小礼物是求你原谅我的。
Xiǎo Lì, wǒ zhè cì chūchāi bǐjiào jí, méi láidejí tōngzhī nǐ. Zhège xiǎo lǐwù shì qiú nǐ yuánliàng wǒ de.
Xiao Li, this business trip was rather sudden and I didn't have time to tell you. This little gift is to ask your forgiveness.
A
我给小丽买了一个小礼物，因为我出差没和她打招呼，怕她生气。
Wǒ gěi Xiǎo Lì mǎi le yí ge xiǎo lǐwù, yīnwèi wǒ chūchāi méi hé tā dǎ zhāohu, pà tā shēngqì.
I bought Xiao Li a little gift because I went on a business trip without telling her and was afraid she'd be cross.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both explain the gift as an apology for leaving without telling her.

lines: 点了很多菜，我们三个人根本吃不了。
Diǎn le hěn duō cài, wǒmen sān ge rén gēnběn chī bu liǎo.
We ordered so many dishes that the three of us couldn't possibly eat them all.
A
有很多菜我们三个人都不习惯吃。
Yǒu hěn duō cài wǒmen sān ge rén dōu bù xíguàn chī.
There are many dishes the three of us aren't used to eating.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A is about too much food; B is about unfamiliar food.

lines: 我们经理今天有急事，恐怕不能参加今天的活动，所以，派我为代表。
Wǒmen jīnglǐ jīntiān yǒu jíshì, kǒngpà bù néng cānjiā jīntiān de huódòng, suǒyǐ, pài wǒ wèi dàibiǎo.
Our manager has something urgent today and probably can't attend, so he's sent me as his representative.
A
我们公司恐怕不能参加今天的活动了，经理派我通知大家一声。
Wǒmen gōngsī kǒngpà bù néng cānjiā jīntiān de huódòng le, jīnglǐ pài wǒ tōngzhī dàjiā yì shēng.
Our company probably can't take part today; the manager sent me to let everyone know.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: In A only the manager can't come and the speaker attends in his place; in B the whole company is pulling out.

grammar: 早就盼望着……
had long been looking forward to …
早就 = long since.
老刘早就盼望着自己当奶奶这一天了，现在这个梦想终于实现了。
Lǎo Liú zǎojiù pànwàngzhe zìjǐ dāng nǎinai zhè yì tiān le, xiànzài zhège mèngxiǎng zhōngyú shíxiàn le.
Lao Liu had long been looking forward to becoming a grandmother, and now that dream has finally come true.
我早就盼望着放假了。
Wǒ zǎojiù pànwàngzhe fàng jià le.
I've long been looking forward to the holidays.
终于
at last
Something long awaited happens.
老刘早就盼望着自己当奶奶这一天了，现在这个梦想终于实现了。
Lǎo Liú zǎojiù pànwàngzhe zìjǐ dāng nǎinai zhè yì tiān le, xiànzài zhège mèngxiǎng zhōngyú shíxiàn le.
Lao Liu had long been looking forward to becoming a grandmother, and now that dream has finally come true.
他终于来了。
Tā zhōngyú lái le.
He's come at last.
没来得及……
didn't have time to …
来得及 / 来不及 = have / not have time.
小丽，我这次出差比较急，没来得及通知你。这个小礼物是求你原谅我的。
Xiǎo Lì, wǒ zhè cì chūchāi bǐjiào jí, méi láidejí tōngzhī nǐ. Zhège xiǎo lǐwù shì qiú nǐ yuánliàng wǒ de.
Xiao Li, this business trip was rather sudden and I didn't have time to tell you. This little gift is to ask your forgiveness.
我没来得及吃早饭。
Wǒ méi láidejí chī zǎofàn.
I didn't have time for breakfast.
V不了
can't … (all of it)
A potential complement.
点了很多菜，我们三个人根本吃不了。
Diǎn le hěn duō cài, wǒmen sān ge rén gēnběn chī bu liǎo.
We ordered so many dishes that the three of us couldn't possibly eat them all.
这么多，我拿不了。
Zhème duō, wǒ ná bu liǎo.
I can't carry this much.
to send … as …
为 = as.
我们经理今天有急事，恐怕不能参加今天的活动，所以，派我为代表。
Wǒmen jīnglǐ jīntiān yǒu jíshì, kǒngpà bù néng cānjiā jīntiān de huódòng, suǒyǐ, pài wǒ wèi dàibiǎo.
Our manager has something urgent today and probably can't attend, so he's sent me as his representative.
派他为队长。
Pài tā wèi duìzhǎng.
Make him captain.
gaps: 着自己当奶奶这一天了

116.title: Visiting
116.sub: Five questions, then a guest and her hosts go through the gift-giving ritual
116.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the story. Huang Dongna (小黄) visits her colleague Liu Yu (刘姐), a woman, for dinner; 姐夫 is Liu Yu's husband. 黄 is Huang Dongna, 刘 is Liu Yu and 夫 is Liu Yu's husband. Who says which line is my reading from context. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

ans: 给老人、长辈送礼表示尊敬；给朋友送礼为了促进友谊；给帮助过自己的人送礼表示谢意。
Gěi lǎorén, zhǎngbèi sònglǐ biǎoshì zūnjìng; gěi péngyou sònglǐ wèile cùjìn yǒuyì; gěi bāngzhù guo zìjǐ de rén sònglǐ biǎoshì xièyì.
To show respect to the old and to elders, to strengthen friendships, and to thank people who have helped them.

q: 黄东娜给刘宇带来了什么礼物？
Huáng Dōngnà gěi Liú Yǔ dàilái le shénme lǐwù?
What gifts did Huang Dongna bring Liu Yu?
ans: 一些水果、给刘宇的补品，还有两条给姐夫的烟。
Yìxiē shuǐguǒ, gěi Liú Yǔ de bǔpǐn, hái yǒu liǎng tiáo gěi jiěfu de yān.
Some fruit, health supplements for Liu Yu, and two cartons of cigarettes for Liu Yu's husband.

q: 刘宇为什么不想要黄东娜带来的东西？她生气了吗？
Liú Yǔ wèishénme bù xiǎng yào Huáng Dōngnà dàilái de dōngxi? Tā shēngqì le ma?
Why didn't Liu Yu want the things Huang Dongna brought? Was she angry?
ans: 她是在客气，觉得同事之间、朋友之间用不着送礼。她没有真生气，最后还是收下了。
Tā shì zài kèqì, juéde tóngshì zhījiān, péngyou zhījiān yòng bu zháo sònglǐ. Tā méiyǒu zhēn shēngqì, zuìhòu háishi shōuxia le.
She was being polite: she felt friends don't need to bring gifts. She wasn't really angry, and accepted them in the end.

q: 黄东娜对刘宇说，这些东西是她顺路买的。你觉得这是真的吗？
Huáng Dōngnà duì Liú Yǔ shuō, zhèxiē dōngxi shì tā shùnlù mǎi de. Nǐ juéde zhè shì zhēn de ma?
Huang Dongna says she bought these things on the way. Do you think that's true?
ans: 可能不是真的。这是客气话，让对方收礼时不觉得有负担。
Kěnéng bú shì zhēn de. Zhè shì kèqìhuà, ràng duìfāng shōulǐ shí bù juéde yǒu fùdān.
Probably not. It's a polite thing to say so the host doesn't feel burdened by the gift.

q: 请再听一遍录音，找找刘宇是否对黄东娜说了谢谢之类的话。黄东娜呢？
Qǐng zài tīng yí biàn lùyīn, zhǎozhao Liú Yǔ shìfǒu duì Huáng Dōngnà shuō le xièxiè zhīlèi de huà. Huáng Dōngnà ne?
Listen again: does Liu Yu say anything like "thank you" to Huang Dongna? What about Huang Dongna?
ans: 刘宇没有直接说谢谢，只说“你太客气了”“下回可不能买东西了”。黄东娜说了“感谢你们的邀请”和“那先谢谢你们了”。
Liú Yǔ méiyǒu zhíjiē shuō xièxiè, zhǐ shuō "nǐ tài kèqì le" "xià huí kě bù néng mǎi dōngxi le". Huáng Dōngnà shuō le "gǎnxiè nǐmen de yāoqǐng" hé "nà xiān xièxiè nǐmen le".
Liu Yu never says thank you directly, only "you're too kind" and "don't bring anything next time". Huang Dongna says "thank you for inviting me" and "thank you in advance".

blocks.label: 引言
lines: 做客。
Zuò kè.
Visiting.
中国人常说，礼尚往来。
Zhōngguórén cháng shuō, lǐ shàng wǎng lái.
Chinese people often say "courtesy demands reciprocity".
可以说，送礼在中国人日常生活和人际交往中是不可以缺少的一个部分。
Kěyǐ shuō, sònglǐ zài Zhōngguórén rìcháng shēnghuó hé rénjì jiāowǎng zhōng shì bù kěyǐ quēshǎo de yí ge bùfen.
You could say gift-giving is an indispensable part of Chinese daily life and social interaction.
过年过节时，看亲朋好友，平时和同事、邻居来往或者求人办事等，人们都喜欢送礼。
Guò nián guòjié shí, kàn qīnpéng hǎoyǒu, píngshí hé tóngshì, línjū láiwǎng huòzhě qiúrén bànshì děng, rénmen dōu xǐhuan sònglǐ.
At festivals, when visiting family and friends, in everyday dealings with colleagues and neighbours, or when asking for a favour, people like to give gifts.
我们往往通过给老人、长辈送礼来表示自己对对方的尊敬。
Wǒmen wǎngwǎng tōngguò gěi lǎorén, zhǎngbèi sònglǐ lái biǎoshì zìjǐ duì duìfāng de zūnjìng.
We often give gifts to the old and to elders to show our respect.
给朋友送礼，为了促进友谊。
Gěi péngyou sònglǐ, wèile cùjìn yǒuyì.
We give gifts to friends to strengthen friendship.
而给帮助过自己的人送礼，则是为了表示谢意。
Ér gěi bāngzhù guo zìjǐ de rén sònglǐ, zé shì wèile biǎoshì xièyì.
And we give gifts to people who've helped us to say thank you.
送礼可以说是一门学问。中国人对送礼的场合和送礼的方式十分讲究。
Sònglǐ kěyǐ shuō shì yì mén xuéwen. Zhōngguórén duì sònglǐ de chǎnghé hé sònglǐ de fāngshì shífēn jiǎngjiū.
Gift-giving is an art. Chinese people are very particular about the occasion and the manner of giving.

blocks.label: 做客
blocks.h: 到刘宇家 · At Liu Yu's home
lines: 有一天，黄东娜去单位同事刘宇家吃饭。
Yǒu yì tiān, Huáng Dōngnà qù dānwèi tóngshì Liú Yǔ jiā chī fàn.
One day, Huang Dongna went to her colleague Liu Yu's home for dinner.
谁呀？
Shéi ya?
Who is it?
刘
刘宇赶紧过来开门。
Liú Yǔ gǎnjǐn guòlái kāimén.
Liu Yu hurried to open the door.
我，黄东娜。
Wǒ, Huáng Dōngnà.
It's me, Huang Dongna.
黄
进来。
Jìnlái.
Come in.
刘
刘姐。
Liú jiě.
Sister Liu.
黄
快进来。
Kuài jìnlái.
Come on in.
刘
黄东娜一进门就把带来的礼物都从包里拿了出来。
Huáng Dōngnà yí jìnmén jiù bǎ dàilái de lǐwù dōu cóng bāo li ná le chulai.
As soon as she was through the door, Huang Dongna took all the gifts out of her bag.
刘姐，这是我带的一些水果，这是给你的补品，这两条烟是给姐夫的。
Liú jiě, zhè shì wǒ dài de yìxiē shuǐguǒ, zhè shì gěi nǐ de bǔpǐn, zhè liǎng tiáo yān shì gěi jiěfu de.
Sister Liu, here's some fruit I brought, these supplements are for you, and these two cartons of cigarettes are for your husband.
黄
刘宇一边推黄东娜的手，一边说：
Liú Yǔ yì biān tuī Huáng Dōngnà de shǒu, yì biān shuō:
Pushing Huang Dongna's hands away, Liu Yu said:
哎，你来就来嘛，还带这么多东西干什么？你拿回去，我不要。
Āi, nǐ lái jiù lái ma, hái dài zhème duō dōngxi gàn shénme? Nǐ ná huíqu, wǒ bú yào.
Oh, just coming is enough! Why bring all this? Take it back, I don't want it.
刘
都是顺路买的，也不多，就收下吧。
Dōu shì shùnlù mǎi de, yě bù duō, jiù shōuxia ba.
I just picked it up on the way, it's not much. Please accept it.
黄
不行不行，一会儿你都带回去。
Bù xíng bù xíng, yíhuìr nǐ dōu dài huíqu.
No, no, you're taking it all back with you later.
刘
看到刘宇还是不肯收，黄东娜坚持说道：
Kàndào Liú Yǔ háishi bù kěn shōu, Huáng Dōngnà jiānchí shuōdào:
Seeing that Liu Yu still wouldn't accept, Huang Dongna insisted:
那哪儿行呀？我家没人抽烟，我也不用补品。刘姐，你就收下吧。
Nà nǎr xíng ya? Wǒ jiā méi rén chōuyān, wǒ yě búyòng bǔpǐn. Liú jiě, nǐ jiù shōuxia ba.
That won't do. Nobody at my place smokes, and I don't need supplements. Sister Liu, please accept.
黄
你太客气了，根本用不着，咱俩这关系，不用讲究这个。
Nǐ tài kèqì le, gēnběn yòng bu zháo, zánliǎ zhè guānxi, búyòng jiǎngjiū zhège.
You're too kind, there's really no need. With a relationship like ours, we don't need to bother with all this.
刘
刘宇一边接过黄东娜的东西，一边说。
Liú Yǔ yì biān jiē guo Huáng Dōngnà de dōngxi, yì biān shuō.
Liu Yu said this as she took the things from Huang Dongna.
一点心意，你得收下。
Yìdiǎn xīnyì, nǐ děi shōuxia.
It's just a small token. You have to accept it.
黄
那我跟你说，这回我收下了，下回来可不能买东西了，不然我可不让你进门。
Nà wǒ gēn nǐ shuō, zhè huí wǒ shōuxia le, xià huí lái kě bù néng mǎi dōngxi le, bùrán wǒ kě bú ràng nǐ jìnmén.
Then I'm telling you: this time I'll accept, but next time you mustn't buy anything, or I won't let you in.
刘
好，下回不买了。
Hǎo, xià huí bù mǎi le.
OK, I won't next time.
黄

blocks.label: 吃饭
blocks.h: 在饭桌上 · At the table
lines: 刘宇的爱人把饭都准备好了，招呼客人在餐桌旁坐下。
Liú Yǔ de àiren bǎ fàn dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le, zhāohu kèrén zài cānzhuō páng zuòxià.
Liu Yu's husband had dinner ready and invited the guest to sit at the table.
来来，坐吧。小黄，你坐呀。
Lái lái, zuò ba. Xiǎo Huáng, nǐ zuò ya.
Come, come, sit down. Xiao Huang, have a seat.
夫
黄东娜很礼貌地让主人先坐。
Huáng Dōngnà hěn lǐmào de ràng zhǔrén xiān zuò.
Huang Dongna politely let her hosts sit first.
你坐，你坐。
Nǐ zuò, nǐ zuò.
After you, after you.
黄
坐吧，随便坐，不用客气。
Zuò ba, suíbiàn zuò, búyòng kèqì.
Sit, sit anywhere. Don't be formal.
夫
刘宇端着盘子从厨房里走进来，也劝黄东娜先坐下。
Liú Yǔ duānzhe pánzi cóng chúfáng li zǒu jìnlái, yě quàn Huáng Dōngnà xiān zuòxià.
Liu Yu came in from the kitchen carrying a plate, and also urged Huang Dongna to sit down first.
哎呀，小黄，别客气了，快坐下。
Āiyā, Xiǎo Huáng, bié kèqì le, kuài zuòxià.
Oh, Xiao Huang, don't stand on ceremony. Sit down.
刘
过了一会儿，菜都好了，刘宇和她爱人也都坐了下来。
Guò le yíhuìr, cài dōu hǎo le, Liú Yǔ hé tā àiren yě dōu zuò le xialai.
After a while all the food was ready, and Liu Yu and her husband sat down too.
刘姐，你做了这么多好吃的呀，就我们几个人能吃得了吗？
Liú jiě, nǐ zuò le zhème duō hǎochī de ya, jiù wǒmen jǐ ge rén néng chī de liǎo ma?
Sister Liu, you've made so much good food! Can just the few of us eat all this?
黄
你不用管，吃得了吃不了，今儿我高兴，咱们吃个痛快。
Nǐ búyòng guǎn, chī de liǎo chī bu liǎo, jīnr wǒ gāoxìng, zánmen chī ge tòngkuai.
Never mind whether we can finish it. I'm happy today, let's eat our fill.
刘
刘姐、姐夫，我先敬你们一杯。感谢你们的邀请，我祝你们健康幸福。
Liú jiě, jiěfu, wǒ xiān jìng nǐmen yì bēi. Gǎnxiè nǐmen de yāoqǐng, wǒ zhù nǐmen jiànkāng xìngfú.
Sister Liu, brother-in-law, let me drink to you first. Thank you for inviting me. I wish you health and happiness.
黄
好，也祝你一切顺心。
Hǎo, yě zhù nǐ yíqiè shùnxīn.
Thank you, and I hope everything goes well for you too.
夫
刘宇一边给黄东娜夹菜，一边说：
Liú Yǔ yì biān gěi Huáng Dōngnà jiā cài, yì biān shuō:
Putting food on Huang Dongna's plate, Liu Yu said:
小黄，你吃菜呀，多吃点儿。
Xiǎo Huáng, nǐ chī cài ya, duō chī diǎnr.
Xiao Huang, eat up, have some more.
刘
今天的菜都是我爱吃的，而且你做的都特别好吃。
Jīntiān de cài dōu shì wǒ ài chī de, érqiě nǐ zuò de dōu tèbié hǎochī.
Today's dishes are all things I love, and everything you make is delicious.
黄
刘宇听了这话，心里美滋滋的。忽然，她好像想起了什么。
Liú Yǔ tīng le zhè huà, xīn li měizīzī de. Hūrán, tā hǎoxiàng xiǎngqǐ le shénme.
Liu Yu was delighted to hear this. Suddenly she seemed to remember something.
叫我差点给忘了。小黄，你弟弟去加拿大的签证不是办下来了吗？什么时候走？
Jiào wǒ chàdiǎn gěi wàng le. Xiǎo Huáng, nǐ dìdi qù Jiānádà de qiānzhèng bú shì bàn xialai le ma? Shénme shíhou zǒu?
I nearly forgot. Xiao Huang, hasn't your brother's visa for Canada come through? When is he leaving?
刘
一定通知我们一声，叫你姐夫开车送你们到机场。
Yídìng tōngzhī wǒmen yì shēng, jiào nǐ jiěfu kāichē sòng nǐmen dào jīchǎng.
Be sure to let us know. I'll have my husband drive you to the airport.
刘
对，一定和我们打个招呼啊。
Duì, yídìng hé wǒmen dǎ ge zhāohu a.
Yes, be sure to tell us.
夫
那先谢谢你们了。
Nà xiān xièxiè nǐmen le.
Then thank you in advance.
黄

vocab: to ask someone for a favour
grammar: 通过……来表示……
to show … through …
来 links means and purpose.
我们往往通过给老人、长辈送礼来表示自己对对方的尊敬。
Wǒmen wǎngwǎng tōngguò gěi lǎorén, zhǎngbèi sònglǐ lái biǎoshì zìjǐ duì duìfāng de zūnjìng.
We often give gifts to the old and to elders to show our respect.
通过写信来表示感谢。
Tōngguò xiě xìn lái biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
To express thanks by writing a letter.
……，则是为了……
…, on the other hand, is in order to …
则 marks contrast.
而给帮助过自己的人送礼，则是为了表示谢意。
Ér gěi bāngzhù guo zìjǐ de rén sònglǐ, zé shì wèile biǎoshì xièyì.
And we give gifts to people who've helped us to say thank you.
学习是为了工作，运动则是为了健康。
Xuéxí shì wèile gōngzuò, yùndòng zé shì wèile jiànkāng.
Studying is for work; exercise is for health.
as soon as …
One action follows another.
黄东娜一进门就把带来的礼物都从包里拿了出来。
Huáng Dōngnà yí jìnmén jiù bǎ dàilái de lǐwù dōu cóng bāo li ná le chulai.
As soon as she was through the door, Huang Dongna took all the gifts out of her bag.
他一回家就睡了。
Tā yì huí jiā jiù shuì le.
He fell asleep as soon as he got home.
一边……，一边……
while …
Two actions at once.
刘宇一边推黄东娜的手，一边说：
Liú Yǔ yì biān tuī Huáng Dōngnà de shǒu, yì biān shuō:
Pushing Huang Dongna's hands away, Liu Yu said:
他一边吃饭一边看书。
Tā yì biān chī fàn yì biān kànshū.
He reads while he eats.
你来就来嘛
just coming is enough
A polite protest at a gift.
哎，你来就来嘛，还带这么多东西干什么？你拿回去，我不要。
Āi, nǐ lái jiù lái ma, hái dài zhème duō dōngxi gàn shénme? Nǐ ná huíqu, wǒ bú yào.
Oh, just coming is enough! Why bring all this? Take it back, I don't want it.
你来就来，带什么东西？
Nǐ lái jiù lái, dài shénme dōngxi?
Just come, why bring anything?
那哪儿行呀？
how could that be all right?
A rhetorical refusal.
那哪儿行呀？我家没人抽烟，我也不用补品。刘姐，你就收下吧。
Nà nǎr xíng ya? Wǒ jiā méi rén chōuyān, wǒ yě búyòng bǔpǐn. Liú jiě, nǐ jiù shōuxia ba.
That won't do. Nobody at my place smokes, and I don't need supplements. Sister Liu, please accept.
那哪儿行？我请你。
Nà nǎr xíng? Wǒ qǐng nǐ.
No way, it's on me.
不然……
otherwise …
Gives the consequence.
那我跟你说，这回我收下了，下回来可不能买东西了，不然我可不让你进门。
Nà wǒ gēn nǐ shuō, zhè huí wǒ shōuxia le, xià huí lái kě bù néng mǎi dōngxi le, bùrán wǒ kě bú ràng nǐ jìnmén.
Then I'm telling you: this time I'll accept, but next time you mustn't buy anything, or I won't let you in.
快走吧，不然就晚了。
Kuài zǒu ba, bùrán jiù wǎn le.
Hurry, or we'll be late.
V得了 / V不了
can / can't manage to …
Potential complements.
你不用管，吃得了吃不了，今儿我高兴，咱们吃个痛快。
Nǐ búyòng guǎn, chī de liǎo chī bu liǎo, jīnr wǒ gāoxìng, zánmen chī ge tòngkuai.
Never mind whether we can finish it. I'm happy today, let's eat our fill.
这么多事，你做得了吗？
Zhème duōshì, nǐ zuò de liǎo ma?
Can you manage so many things?
差点给忘了
nearly forgot
差点 = almost.
叫我差点给忘了。小黄，你弟弟去加拿大的签证不是办下来了吗？什么时候走？
Jiào wǒ chàdiǎn gěi wàng le. Xiǎo Huáng, nǐ dìdi qù Jiānádà de qiānzhèng bú shì bàn xialai le ma? Shénme shíhou zǒu?
I nearly forgot. Xiao Huang, hasn't your brother's visa for Canada come through? When is he leaving?

Wǒ chàdiǎn wàng le.
