117.title: Chinese social customs
117.sub: Six behaviours: traditionally Chinese or not?
117.transcriptNote: Decide whether each behaviour fits traditional Chinese social customs, then turn on Answers. The answers are my own judgement, based on the lesson 8 texts.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
判断下面的行为是否符合中国人传统的交际习惯。
Pànduàn xiàmiàn de xíngwéi shìfǒu fúhé Zhōngguórén chuántǒng de jiāojì xíguàn.
Decide whether the following behaviours fit traditional Chinese social customs.

q: 别人送给自己礼物的时候，马上打开。
Biérén sònggěi zìjǐ lǐwù de shíhou, mǎshàng dǎkāi.
Opening a gift as soon as someone gives it to you.
qs.why: Traditionally the gift is put aside and opened after the guest leaves.

q: 参加朋友婚礼，只送给他鲜花。
Cānjiā péngyou hūnlǐ, zhǐ sònggěi tā xiānhuā.
Going to a friend's wedding and giving only flowers.
qs.why: At a wedding people usually give money in a red envelope.

q: 在很多人面前送一个人礼物。
Zài hěn duō rén miànqián sòng yí ge rén lǐwù.
Giving one person a gift in front of lots of people.
qs.why: It can embarrass the others, so gifts are usually given privately.

q: 本来是费了好大劲儿挑选的礼物，却谦虚地说，是顺路买的。
Běnlái shì fèi le hǎo dà jìnr tiāoxuǎn de lǐwù, què qiānxū de shuō, shì shùnlù mǎi de.
Saying modestly that a gift you took great trouble to choose was just picked up on the way.
qs.why: Playing down the gift is a typical polite custom, as in the 做客 story.

q: 收到礼物后，马上亲吻送礼物的人以表示感谢。
Shōudào lǐwù hòu, mǎshàng qīnwěn sòng lǐwù de rén yǐ biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
Kissing the giver straight away to say thank you.
qs.why: Kissing to say thanks isn't a Chinese custom.

q: 你结婚的时候，一个朋友送了一千元钱。这个朋友结婚的时候，你也送他一千元钱。
Nǐ jié hūn de shíhou, yí ge péngyou sòng le yìqiān yuán qián. Zhège péngyou jié hūn de shíhou, nǐ yě sòng tā yìqiān yuán qián.
When you got married a friend gave you 1,000 yuan; when that friend marries, you give 1,000 yuan too.
qs.why: This is 礼尚往来: returning a gift of similar value.

grammar: 是否……
whether …
Formal 是不是.
判断下面的行为是否符合中国人传统的交际习惯。
Pànduàn xiàmiàn de xíngwéi shìfǒu fúhé Zhōngguórén chuántǒng de jiāojì xíguàn.
Decide whether the following behaviours fit traditional Chinese social customs.
不知道他是否会来。
Bù zhīdao tā shìfǒu huì lái.
I don't know whether he'll come.
originally …, but …
Contrast with what was true.
本来是费了好大劲儿挑选的礼物，却谦虚地说，是顺路买的。
Běnlái shì fèi le hǎo dà jìnr tiāoxuǎn de lǐwù, què qiānxū de shuō, shì shùnlù mǎi de.
Saying modestly that a gift you took great trouble to choose was just picked up on the way.
本来想去，却没时间。
Běnlái xiǎng qù, què méi shíjiān.
I meant to go, but had no time.
以表示……
in order to show …
以 = so as to.
收到礼物后，马上亲吻送礼物的人以表示感谢。
Shōudào lǐwù hòu, mǎshàng qīnwěn sòng lǐwù de rén yǐ biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
Kissing the giver straight away to say thank you.
送花以表示谢意。
Sòng huā yǐ biǎoshì xièyì.
Give flowers to show thanks.
gaps: 中国人传统的交际习惯。

118.title: Lao Liu's gift
118.sub: Three questions, then a neighbour brings money for a new baby
118.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the story. Mrs Wang (老王太太) has just become a grandmother; her neighbour Lao Liu brings a gift of money. 刘 is Lao Liu and 王 is Mrs Wang. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课堂练习 · In-class listening
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

q: 老刘为什么去找老王太太？
Lǎo Liú wèishénme qù zhǎo Lǎo Wáng tàitai?
Why does Lao Liu go to see Mrs Wang?
ans: 老王太太的儿媳妇生了小孩，老刘去给孩子送钱表示祝贺。
Lǎo Wáng tàitai de érxífu shēng le xiǎohái, Lǎo Liú qù gěi háizi sòng qián biǎoshì zhùhè.
Mrs Wang's daughter-in-law has had a baby, and Lao Liu goes to give money for the baby as congratulations.

q: 老刘最后给了老王太太多少钱？
Lǎo Liú zuìhòu gěi le Lǎo Wáng tàitai duōshǎo qián?
How much money does Lao Liu give Mrs Wang in the end?
ans: 老刘拿来了五百块，老王太太只肯收三百，把二百放回了老刘的口袋里。
Lǎo Liú nálái le wǔ bǎi kuài, Lǎo Wáng tàitai zhǐ kěn shōu sānbǎi, bǎ èrbǎi fàng huí le Lǎo Liú de kǒudài li.
Lao Liu brought 500 yuan; Mrs Wang would only accept 300 and put 200 back in Lao Liu's pocket.

q: 老王太太为什么问老刘的儿子什么时候结婚？
Lǎo Wáng tàitai wèishénme wèn Lǎo Liú de érzi shénme shíhou jié hūn?
Why does Mrs Wang ask when Lao Liu's son is getting married?
ans: 她想到时候也给老刘送礼，还这份人情，这就是礼尚往来。
Tā xiǎng dào shíhou yě gěi Lǎo Liú sònglǐ, hái zhè fèn rénqíng, zhè jiùshì lǐ shàng wǎng lái.
So she can give Lao Liu a gift in return when the time comes. That's 礼尚往来, returning a favour.

blocks.label: 故事
lines: 老刘送礼。
Lǎo Liú sònglǐ.
Lao Liu's gift.
老王太太的儿媳妇生了小孩儿，邻居老刘来到她家。
Lǎo Wáng tàitai de érxífu shēng le xiǎoháir, línjū Lǎo Liú láidào tā jiā.
Mrs Wang's daughter-in-law had a baby, and her neighbour Lao Liu came to see her.
有人吗？
Yǒu rén ma?
Anyone home?
刘
老王太太正在家洗衣服，听见有人来了，赶快放下手中的衣服去开门。
Lǎo Wáng tàitai zhèng zài jiā xǐ yīfu, tīngjiàn yǒu rén lái le, gǎnkuài fàngxià shǒu zhōng de yīfu qù kāimén.
Mrs Wang was doing the washing. Hearing someone at the door, she put down the clothes and went to open it.
谁呀？
Shéi ya?
Who is it?
王
我，老刘。
Wǒ, Lǎo Liú.
Me, Lao Liu.
刘
一听是老刘，老王太太赶快把门打开。
Yì tīng shì Lǎo Liú, Lǎo Wáng tàitai gǎnkuài bǎ mén dǎkāi.
Hearing it was Lao Liu, Mrs Wang quickly opened the door.
是老刘，今天你没去公园呀？快进来，快进来。
Shì Lǎo Liú, jīntiān nǐ méi qù gōngyuán ya? Kuài jìnlái, kuài jìnlái.
Lao Liu! You didn't go to the park today? Come in, come in.
王
老刘正要脱鞋，老王太太说道：
Lǎo Liú zhèng yào tuō xié, Lǎo Wáng tàitai shuōdào:
Lao Liu was about to take off his shoes when Mrs Wang said:
不用脱鞋了，家里乱七八糟的。
Búyòng tuō xié le, jiā li luànqībāzāo de.
No need to take your shoes off. The place is a mess.
王
还是脱了吧，全都是土，别把你家地板给弄脏了。
Háishi tuō le ba, quándōu shì tǔ, bié bǎ nǐ jiā dìbǎn gěi nòngzāng le.
I'd better take them off. They're all dusty. I don't want to dirty your floor.
刘
我说不用脱，不用脱，进屋进屋。
Wǒ shuō búyòng tuō, búyòng tuō, jìn wū jìn wū.
I said no need, no need. Come in, come in.
王
老刘坐在客厅的一把椅子上，喘了口气儿说：
Lǎo Liú zuò zài kètīng de yì bǎ yǐzi shàng, chuǎn le kǒu qìr shuō:
Lao Liu sat down on a chair in the living room, caught his breath and said:
今天没去公园，想来你家看看。就你一个人在家？
Jīntiān méi qù gōngyuán, xiǎng lái nǐ jiā kànkan. Jiù nǐ yí ge rén zài jiā?
I didn't go to the park today. I wanted to come and see you. Just you at home?
刘
是啊，都带孩子去医院了。没什么病，就是检查检查。
Shì a, dōu dài háizi qù yīyuàn le. Méi shénme bìng, jiùshì jiǎnchá jiǎnchá.
Yes, they've all taken the baby to the hospital. Nothing wrong, just a check-up.
王
孩子挺好的吧？
Háizi tǐng hǎo de ba?
The baby's doing well?
刘
挺好挺好，又长了不少。
Tǐng hǎo tǐng hǎo, yòu zhǎng le bù shǎo.
Very well, very well. He's grown a lot.
王
老王太太满足地说。
Lǎo Wáng tàitai mǎnzú de shuō.
Mrs Wang said contentedly.
过了一会儿，老刘从口袋里拿出早就准备好的信封，放到老王太太手里。
Guò le yíhuìr, Lǎo Liú cóng kǒudài li ná chū zǎojiù zhǔnbèi hǎo de xìnfēng, fàng dào Lǎo Wáng tàitai shǒu li.
After a while, Lao Liu took out an envelope he'd prepared and put it in Mrs Wang's hand.
王大姐，这是五百块钱，给孩子的。
Wáng dàjiě, zhè shì wǔbǎi kuài qián, gěi háizi de.
Sister Wang, here's five hundred yuan for the baby.
刘
老王太太很惊讶。
Lǎo Wáng tàitai hěn jīngyà.
Mrs Wang was very surprised.
老刘，你这是干什么？赶快把钱给我拿走，我不要。
Lǎo Liú, nǐ zhè shì gàn shénme? Gǎnkuài bǎ qián gěi wǒ názǒu, wǒ bú yào.
Lao Liu, what are you doing? Take this money away at once. I don't want it.
王
老刘好像早就知道老王太太会这么说，回答道：
Lǎo Liú hǎoxiàng zǎojiù zhīdao Lǎo Wáng tàitai huì zhème shuō, huídá dào:
Lao Liu seemed to have known Mrs Wang would say this, and replied:
又不是给你的，是给孩子的。
Yòu bú shì gěi nǐ de, shì gěi háizi de.
It's not for you, it's for the baby.
刘
那也不要。不行不行，赶快拿走。
Nà yě bú yào. Bù xíng bù xíng, gǎnkuài názǒu.
I still don't want it. No, no, take it away.
王
老王太太好像很生气的样子。
Lǎo Wáng tàitai hǎoxiàng hěn shēngqì de yàngzi.
Mrs Wang looked rather cross.
你嫌少，嫌我小气，是不是？
Nǐ xián shǎo, xián wǒ xiǎoqi, shì bu shì?
You think it's too little, that I'm stingy, is that it?
刘
老刘这么一说，让老王太太拿他没有办法了。
Lǎo Liú zhème yì shuō, ràng Lǎo Wáng tàitai ná tā méiyǒu bànfǎ le.
When Lao Liu put it that way, Mrs Wang didn't know what to do with him.
老刘，咱们都是老邻居了，你太客气了。
Lǎo Liú, zánmen dōu shì lǎo línjū le, nǐ tài kèqì le.
Lao Liu, we're old neighbours. You're too kind.
王
你盼孙子盼了那么长时间，终于当奶奶了，我们也都替你高兴。你就收下吧。
Nǐ pàn sūnzi pàn le nàme cháng shíjiān, zhōngyú dāng nǎinai le, wǒmen yě dōu tì nǐ gāoxìng. Nǐ jiù shōuxia ba.
You waited so long for a grandchild, and now you're finally a grandma. We're all happy for you. Please accept it.
刘
老王太太从信封里拿出二百元，放进老刘的口袋里，说道：
Lǎo Wáng tàitai cóng xìnfēng li ná chū èrbǎi yuán, fàngjìn Lǎo Liú de kǒudài li, shuōdào:
Mrs Wang took two hundred yuan out of the envelope, put it into Lao Liu's pocket, and said:
那我收三百，你拿走二百。
Nà wǒ shōu sānbǎi, nǐ názǒu èrbǎi.
Then I'll take three hundred and you take back two hundred.
王
老刘没想到老王太太会这样说。
Lǎo Liú méi xiǎngdào Lǎo Wáng tàitai huì zhèyàng shuō.
Lao Liu didn't expect Mrs Wang to say this.
哎，这哪儿行？
Āi, zhè nǎr xíng?
Oh, how can that be right?
刘
要不然我一分钱也不收。
Yàoburán wǒ yì fēn qián yě bù shōu.
Otherwise I won't take a penny.
王
你看看你。老刘，你儿子到底什么时候结婚呀？一定和我打个招呼呀。
Nǐ kànkan nǐ. Lǎo Liú, nǐ érzi dàodǐ shénme shíhou jié hūn ya? Yídìng hé wǒ dǎ ge zhāohu ya.
Look at you. Lao Liu, when is your son getting married? Be sure to let me know.
王

grammar: just about to … when …
Something interrupts.
老刘正要脱鞋，老王太太说道：
Lǎo Liú zhèng yào tuō xié, Lǎo Wáng tàitai shuōdào:
Lao Liu was about to take off his shoes when Mrs Wang said:
我正要出门，电话响了。
Wǒ zhèng yào chūmén, diànhuà xiǎng le.
I was just going out when the phone rang.
别把……给弄脏了
don't get … dirty
把 + 给 + V for an unwanted result.
还是脱了吧，全都是土，别把你家地板给弄脏了。
Háishi tuō le ba, quándōu shì tǔ, bié bǎ nǐ jiā dìbǎn gěi nòngzāng le.
I'd better take them off. They're all dusty. I don't want to dirty your floor.
别把书给弄丢了。
Bié bǎ shū gěi nòng diū le.
Don't lose the book.
就你一个人……
just you …
就 = only.
今天没去公园，想来你家看看。就你一个人在家？
Jīntiān méi qù gōngyuán, xiǎng lái nǐ jiā kànkan. Jiù nǐ yí ge rén zài jiā?
I didn't go to the park today. I wanted to come and see you. Just you at home?
就我一个人去。
Jiù wǒ yí ge rén qù.
Only I'm going.
又不是……，是……
it's not …, it's …
Corrects an assumption.
又不是给你的，是给孩子的。
Yòu bú shì gěi nǐ de, shì gěi háizi de.
It's not for you, it's for the baby.
又不是我的错。
Yòu bú shì wǒ de cuò.
It's not my fault.
嫌……，是不是？
you think …, is that it?
A challenging question.
你嫌少，嫌我小气，是不是？
Nǐ xián shǎo, xián wǒ xiǎoqi, shì bu shì?
You think it's too little, that I'm stingy, is that it?
你嫌我烦，是不是？
Nǐ xián wǒ fán, shì bu shì?
You find me annoying, is that it?
拿……没有办法
not to know what to do with …
A fixed phrase.
老刘这么一说，让老王太太拿他没有办法了。
Lǎo Liú zhème yì shuō, ràng Lǎo Wáng tàitai ná tā méiyǒu bànfǎ le.
When Lao Liu put it that way, Mrs Wang didn't know what to do with him.
我拿这孩子没办法。
Wǒ ná zhè háizi méi bànfǎ.
I can't do anything with this child.
盼……盼了……
to have been longing for … for …
The verb repeats before a duration.
你盼孙子盼了那么长时间，终于当奶奶了，我们也都替你高兴。你就收下吧。
Nǐ pàn sūnzi pàn le nàme cháng shíjiān, zhōngyú dāng nǎinai le, wǒmen yě dōu tì nǐ gāoxìng. Nǐ jiù shōuxia ba.
You waited so long for a grandchild, and now you're finally a grandma. We're all happy for you. Please accept it.
我等你等了一个小时。
Wǒ děng nǐ děng le yí ge xiǎoshí.
I waited for you for an hour.
要不然……
otherwise …
Gives the alternative.
要不然我一分钱也不收。
Yàoburán wǒ yì fēn qián yě bù shōu.
Otherwise I won't take a penny.
快走，要不然就迟到了。
Kuài zǒu, yàoburán jiù chídào le.
Hurry, or we'll be late.
gaps: 老刘从口袋里拿出早就准备好的

roles.王: 王 = Mrs Wang, the new grandmother

119.title: A goose feather from a thousand li away
119.sub: Four true-or-false statements, then the story behind the saying
119.transcriptNote: First four statements to judge, then the story. 缅伯高 (Mian Bogao) is the servant sent to the emperor; 长安 (Chang'an) was the Tang capital. The recording says the name with slightly different sounds each time; I've written the usual form. Turn on Answers for the true-or-false key.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音并判断 · True or false
lines: 听录音，并判断句子的正误。
Tīng lùyīn, bìng pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false.
千里送鹅毛，礼轻情义重，是中国人传统的礼品价值观。
Qiān lǐ sòng é máo, lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng, shì Zhōngguórén chuántǒng de lǐpǐn jiàzhíguān.
"A goose feather sent from a thousand li: the gift is light but the feeling is deep" is a traditional Chinese view of gifts.
下面是缅伯高替自己的主人去长安送鹅毛的小故事。
Xiàmiàn shì Miǎn Bógāo tì zìjǐ de zhǔrén qù Cháng'ān sòng é máo de xiǎo gùshi.
Here is the story of Mian Bogao taking a goose feather to Chang'an for his master.
请听录音，并判断下面的句子的意思是否正确。
Qǐng tīng lùyīn, bìng pànduàn xiàmiàn de jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu zhèngquè.
Listen and decide whether the sentences below are correct.
请先听四个句子。
Qǐng xiān tīng sì ge jùzi.
First listen to four sentences.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 四个句子 · True or false

q: 缅伯高是个很不小心的人。
Miǎn Bógāo shì ge hěn bù xiǎoxīn de rén.
Mian Bogao was a very careless person.
qs.why: He was very careful all the way; he only slipped up once.

q: 皇帝看见了缅伯高的礼物，很高兴，因为这是一种很少见的天鹅。
Huángdì kànjiàn le Miǎn Bógāo de lǐwù, hěn gāoxìng, yīnwèi zhè shì yì zhǒng hěn shǎo jiàn de tiān'é.
The emperor was pleased with Mian Bogao's gift because it was a rare swan.
qs.why: The swan flew away; the emperor only got feathers, and was moved by Mian Bogao's honesty.

q: 缅伯高送天鹅的时候，正好是夏天。
Miǎn Bógāo sòng tiān'é de shíhou, zhènghǎo shì xiàtiān.
It was summer when Mian Bogao took the swan.
qs.why: It was the sixth month, and very hot.

q: 因为缅伯高把天鹅照顾得很好，所以皇帝奖给了他很多钱。
Yīnwèi Miǎn Bógāo bǎ tiān'é zhàogù de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ huángdì jiǎng gěi le tā hěn duō qián.
The emperor rewarded him with a lot of money because he'd looked after the swan well.
qs.why: He was rewarded for his honesty, not for looking after the swan.

blocks.label: 故事
blocks.h: 千里送鹅毛，礼轻情义重 · The story
lines: 现在请听文章。
Xiànzài qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
千里送鹅毛，礼轻情义重。
Qiān lǐ sòng é máo, lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng.
A goose feather sent from a thousand li: the gift is light but the feeling is deep.
唐代的时候，有一个大官，得到了一只很不常见的白天鹅。
Tángdài de shíhou, yǒu yí ge dà guān, dédào le yì zhǐ hěn bù chángjiàn de bái tiān'é.
In the Tang dynasty, a high official obtained a very rare white swan.
他想把天鹅送给皇帝，就派人去长安送天鹅。
Tā xiǎng bǎ tiān'é sònggěi huángdì, jiù pài rén qù Cháng'ān sòng tiān'é.
He wanted to give it to the emperor, so he sent someone to take it to Chang'an.
被派去的人叫缅伯高。
Bèi pài qù de rén jiào Miǎn Bógāo.
The man sent was called Mian Bogao.
当时正好是六月，天气很热，气温很高。
Dāngshí zhènghǎo shì liùyuè, tiānqì hěn rè, qìwēn hěn gāo.
It was the sixth month, the weather was hot, and the temperature was high.
缅伯高住的地方离长安非常远。
Miǎn Bógāo zhù de dìfang lí Cháng'ān fēicháng yuǎn.
Mian Bogao lived very far from Chang'an.
一路上，缅伯高十分小心，细心地照顾天鹅。
Yí lù shang, Miǎn Bógāo shífēn xiǎoxīn, xìxīn de zhàogù tiān'é.
All the way, Mian Bogao was very careful and looked after the swan attentively.
可是有一天，在给天鹅喂水的时候，一不小心，天鹅飞走了。
Kěshì yǒu yì tiān, zài gěi tiān'é wèi shuǐ de shíhou, yí bù xiǎoxīn, tiān'é fēizǒu le.
But one day, while giving the swan water, he slipped up and the swan flew away.
缅伯高赶紧冲过去，想追天鹅，可只抓到了几根鹅毛。
Miǎn Bógāo gǎnjǐn chōng guòqu, xiǎng zhuī tiān'é, kě zhǐ zhuā dào le jǐ gēn é máo.
Mian Bogao dashed after it, but only caught a few feathers.
缅伯高捡起这几根鹅毛，没有办法，他只好拿着这几根鹅毛去见皇帝。
Miǎn Bógāo jiǎn qǐ zhè jǐ gēn é máo, méiyǒu bànfǎ, tā zhǐhǎo názhe zhè jǐ gēn é máo qù jiàn huángdì.
He picked up the feathers. There was nothing else for it, so he took them to see the emperor.
缅伯高跪在皇帝面前，双手捧着鹅毛，
Miǎn Bógāo guì zài huángdì miànqián, shuāngshǒu pěngzhe é máo,
Mian Bogao knelt before the emperor, holding the feathers in both hands,
把事情的经过仔细地说了一遍，还说都是自己的错，请求皇帝原谅他的主人。
bǎ shìqing de jīngguò zǐxì de shuō le yí biàn, hái shuō dōu shì zìjǐ de cuò, qǐngqiú huángdì yuánliàng tā de zhǔrén.
told him exactly what had happened, said it was all his own fault, and begged the emperor to forgive his master.
皇帝一听，被缅伯高的诚实感动了，
Huángdì yì tīng, bèi Miǎn Bógāo de chéngshí gǎndòng le,
On hearing this, the emperor was moved by Mian Bogao's honesty.
不但没有生气，反而奖给了他和他的主人很多钱。
búdàn méiyǒu shēngqì, fǎn'ér jiǎng gěi le tā hé tā de zhǔrén hěn duō qián.
Far from being angry, he rewarded him and his master with a lot of money.
后来，人们用“千里送鹅毛，礼轻情义重”这句话来说明，
Hòulái, rénmen yòng "qiān lǐ sòng é máo, lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng" zhè jù huà lái shuōmíng,
Later, people used the saying "a goose feather sent from a thousand li: the gift is light but the feeling is deep" to mean that
礼物虽然不贵重，但它代表的情谊深厚。
lǐwù suīrán bú guìzhòng, dàn tā dàibiǎo de qíngyì shēnhòu.
although a gift may not be valuable, the friendship it stands for is deep.

vocab: the gift is light but the feeling is deep
grammar: to go … on behalf of …
替 = for, in place of.
下面是缅伯高替自己的主人去长安送鹅毛的小故事。
Xiàmiàn shì Miǎn Bógāo tì zìjǐ de zhǔrén qù Cháng'ān sòng é máo de xiǎo gùshi.
Here is the story of Mian Bogao taking a goose feather to Chang'an for his master.
我替你去吧。
Wǒ tì nǐ qù ba.
I'll go for you.
把……送给……
to give … to …
把 brings the object forward.
他想把天鹅送给皇帝，就派人去长安送天鹅。
Tā xiǎng bǎ tiān'é sònggěi huángdì, jiù pài rén qù Cháng'ān sòng tiān'é.
He wanted to give it to the emperor, so he sent someone to take it to Chang'an.
把这本书送给你。
Bǎ zhè běn shū sònggěi nǐ.
I'm giving you this book.
被派去的人
the person who was sent
被 + V + 的 forms a passive modifier.
被派去的人叫缅伯高。
Bèi pài qù de rén jiào Miǎn Bógāo.
The man sent was called Mian Bogao.
被选上的人。
Bèi xuǎn shàng de rén.
The one who was chosen.
一不小心
in a moment of carelessness
Something goes wrong by accident.
可是有一天，在给天鹅喂水的时候，一不小心，天鹅飞走了。
Kěshì yǒu yì tiān, zài gěi tiān'é wèi shuǐ de shíhou, yí bù xiǎoxīn, tiān'é fēizǒu le.
But one day, while giving the swan water, he slipped up and the swan flew away.
一不小心摔倒了。
Yí bù xiǎoxīn shuāidǎo le.
I slipped and fell.
只好……
had no choice but to …
The only option left.
缅伯高捡起这几根鹅毛，没有办法，他只好拿着这几根鹅毛去见皇帝。
Miǎn Bógāo jiǎn qǐ zhè jǐ gēn é máo, méiyǒu bànfǎ, tā zhǐhǎo názhe zhè jǐ gēn é máo qù jiàn huángdì.
He picked up the feathers. There was nothing else for it, so he took them to see the emperor.
没车了，只好走路。
Méi chē le, zhǐhǎo zǒu lù.
No buses left, so we had to walk.
不但没有……，反而……
far from …, on the contrary …
The opposite of what's expected.
不但没有生气，反而奖给了他和他的主人很多钱。
búdàn méiyǒu shēngqì, fǎn'ér jiǎng gěi le tā hé tā de zhǔrén hěn duō qián.
Far from being angry, he rewarded him and his master with a lot of money.
他不但没生气，反而笑了。
Tā búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér xiào le.
Far from being angry, he laughed.
用……来说明……
to use … to show …
来 links means and purpose.
后来，人们用“千里送鹅毛，礼轻情义重”这句话来说明，
Hòulái, rénmen yòng "qiān lǐ sòng é máo, lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng" zhè jù huà lái shuōmíng,
Later, people used the saying "a goose feather sent from a thousand li: the gift is light but the feeling is deep" to mean that
用例子来说明问题。
Yòng lìzi lái shuōmíng wèntí.
Use an example to explain the problem.
gaps: 唐代的时候，有一个大官，得到了一只很不常见的白
say: "A goose feather sent from a thousand li: the gift is light but the feeling is deep" is a traditional Chinese view of gifts.

120.title: What do you think about giving gifts?
120.sub: Three young people interviewed about who they give gifts to, and why
120.transcriptNote: Three young people are interviewed about gift-giving. 问 is the interviewer; 健 is A Jian (25), 圆 is Xiaoyuan (27) and 杰 is Xiaojie (22). This is natural speech: fillers such as 呃 and 嗯 and false starts are left out, so the transcript is lightly tidied. Fill in the table with who each person gives gifts to, what they give, and why, then turn on Answers.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
根据录音把表格补充完整。
Gēnjù lùyīn bǎ biǎogé bǔchōng wánzhěng.
Complete the table according to the recording.
三位年轻人在讲自己对送礼的看法。
Sān wèi niánqīngrén zài jiǎng zìjǐ duì sònglǐ de kànfǎ.
Three young people talk about their views on gift-giving.
听听他们给谁送礼，送什么礼品，为什么送礼，并填写下表。
Tīngting tāmen gěi shéi sònglǐ, sòng shénme lǐpǐn, wèishénme sònglǐ, bìng tiánxiě xià biǎo.
Listen for who they give gifts to, what they give and why, and fill in the table.

blocks.label: 阿健
lines: 阿健，二十五岁。
Ā Jiàn, èrshíwǔ suì.
A Jian, 25.
请问你送过礼吗？
Qǐngwèn nǐ sòng guo lǐ ma?
Have you ever given gifts?
问
送过的啊。
Sòng guo de a.
Yes, I have.
健
那你一般都是给谁送礼？
Nà nǐ yìbān dōu shì gěi shéi sònglǐ?
Who do you usually give gifts to?
问
主要是给自己的家人，还有一些比较亲密的朋友。
Zhǔyào shì gěi zìjǐ de jiārén, hái yǒu yìxiē bǐjiào qīnmì de péngyou.
Mainly my family, and some close friends.
健
好，那你都送给他们什么呢？
Hǎo, nà nǐ dōu sònggěi tāmen shénme ne?
And what do you give them?
问
根据送的每个人的兴趣爱好来决定，一般是这样。
Gēnjù sòng de měi ge rén de xìngqù àihào lái juédìng, yìbān shì zhèyàng.
It depends on each person's interests. That's usually how it is.
健
比如说给家人，像我给我爸妈，一般都是去买一些营养品之类的东西。
Bǐrú shuō gěi jiārén, xiàng wǒ gěi wǒ bà mā, yìbān dōu shì qù mǎi yìxiē yíngyǎngpǐn zhīlèi de dōngxi.
For example, for family, like my mum and dad, I usually buy health supplements and that sort of thing.
健
营养品，是吗？
Yíngyǎngpǐn, shì ma?
Health supplements?
问
如果是给比我小的一些孩子的话，就买一些巧克力啊、饼干啊之类的东西。
Rúguǒ shì gěi bǐ wǒ xiǎo de yìxiē háizi dehuà, jiù mǎi yìxiē qiǎokèlì a, bǐnggān a zhīlèi de dōngxi.
If it's for younger children, I buy chocolate, biscuits, things like that.
健
好，那你认为送礼重要吗？为什么？
Hǎo, nà nǐ rènwéi sònglǐ zhòngyào ma? Wèishénme?
OK. Do you think giving gifts is important? Why?
问
我觉得是挺重要的。因为有很多朋友也都帮助过我，我送礼给他们也是用来表示我的谢意的。
Wǒ juéde shì tǐng zhòngyào de. Yīnwèi yǒu hěn duō péngyou yě dōu bāngzhù guo wǒ, wǒ sònglǐ gěi tāmen yě shì yònglái biǎoshì wǒ de xièyì de.
I think it's quite important. Lots of friends have helped me, and I give them gifts to show my thanks.
健

q: 阿健：给谁送礼？送什么？为什么？
Ā Jiàn: gěi shéi sònglǐ? Sòng shénme? Wèishénme?
A Jian: who to, what, and why?
ans: 给家人和比较亲密的朋友；给父母买营养品，给小孩子买巧克力、饼干；为了表示谢意。
Gěi jiārén hé bǐjiào qīnmì de péngyou; gěi fùmǔ mǎi yíngyǎngpǐn, gěi xiǎoháizi mǎi qiǎokèlì, bǐnggān; wèile biǎoshì xièyì.
Family and close friends; supplements for his parents, chocolate and biscuits for children; to say thank you.

blocks.label: 小圆
lines: 小圆，二十七岁。
Xiǎoyuán, èrshíqī suì.
Xiaoyuan, 27.
你好，我想问一下，你送过礼吗？
Nǐhǎo, wǒ xiǎng wèn yíxià, nǐ sòng guo lǐ ma?
Hi, may I ask, have you ever given gifts?
问
送过。
Sòng guo.
Yes.
圆
那你一般是送给谁呢？
Nà nǐ yìbān shì sònggěi shéi ne?
Who do you usually give them to?
问
朋友吧，然后有的时候也送给老师。
Péngyou ba, ránhòu yǒu de shíhou yě sònggěi lǎoshī.
Friends, and sometimes teachers.
圆
有朋友，有老师。那你一般送什么？
Yǒu péngyou, yǒu lǎoshī. Nà nǐ yìbān sòng shénme?
Friends and teachers. What do you usually give?
问
朋友的话，很多时候就是他们生日或什么的时候，给他们送礼物，
Péngyou dehuà, hěn duō shíhou jiùshì tāmen shēngrì huò shénme de shíhou, gěi tāmen sòng lǐwù,
For friends, usually on their birthdays or similar occasions,
圆
像送个生日贺卡呀，然后女孩子可能送点小首饰啊什么之类的。
xiàng sòng ge shēngrì hèkǎ ya, ránhòu nǚháizi kěnéng sòng diǎn xiǎo shǒushi a shénme zhīlèi de.
like a birthday card, and for girls maybe a little piece of jewellery or something like that.
圆
老师的话，我上次送给老师的是一个书签儿。
Lǎoshī dehuà, wǒ shàngcì sònggěi lǎoshī de shì yí ge shūqiānr.
For teachers, last time I gave my teacher a bookmark.
圆
书签儿，是吗？我问一下，你觉得送礼在我们日常生活当中，它的作用重要吗？为什么？
Shūqiānr, shì ma? Wǒ wèn yíxià, nǐ juéde sònglǐ zài wǒmen rìcháng shēnghuó dāngzhōng, tā de zuòyòng zhòngyào ma? Wèishénme?
A bookmark? Let me ask: do you think gifts play an important role in daily life? Why?
问
还算挺重要的吧，因为毕竟也是一种表达自己想法的一种方式。
Hái suàn tǐng zhòngyào de ba, yīnwèi bìjìng yě shì yì zhǒng biǎodá zìjǐ xiǎngfǎ de yì zhǒng fāngshì.
Fairly important, I'd say, because after all it's a way of expressing your feelings.
圆
可以通过礼物表示说你挺重视这个人的，你对他就是特别的，
Kěyǐ tōngguò lǐwù biǎoshì shuō nǐ tǐng zhòngshì zhège rén de, nǐ duì tā jiùshì tèbié de,
Through a gift you show that you value someone and that they're special to you,
圆
比如说喜欢啊，敬重啊什么之类的，也是一个交流的方式吧。
bǐrú shuō xǐhuan a, jìngzhòng a shénme zhīlèi de, yě shì yí ge jiāoliú de fāngshì ba.
for example liking or respecting them. It's also a way of communicating.
圆

q: 小圆：给谁送礼？送什么？为什么？
Xiǎoyuán: gěi shéi sònglǐ? Sòng shénme? Wèishénme?
Xiaoyuan: who to, what, and why?
ans: 给朋友和老师；朋友过生日时送生日贺卡、小首饰，给老师送过书签儿；为了表达自己的想法，表示重视、喜欢、敬重，也是一种交流方式。

Gěi péngyou hé lǎoshī; péngyou guò shēngrì shí sòng shēngrì hèkǎ, xiǎo shǒushi, gěi lǎoshī sòng guo shūqiānr; wèile biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, biǎoshì zhòngshì, xǐhuan, jìngzhòng, yě shì yì zhǒng jiāoliú fāngshì.

Friends and teachers; birthday cards and little pieces of jewellery for friends, a bookmark for a teacher; to express her feelings and show she values, likes or respects someone; it's also a way of communicating.

blocks.label: 小杰
lines: 小杰，二十二岁。
Xiǎojié, èrshí'èr suì.
Xiaojie, 22.
我问一下，你送过礼吗？
Wǒ wèn yíxià, nǐ sòng guo lǐ ma?
May I ask, have you ever given gifts?
问
当然了，我送过。
Dāngrán le, wǒ sòng guo.
Of course I have.
杰
你送给什么人？
Nǐ sònggěi shénme rén?
Who do you give them to?
问
我送给过很多人，比如说我的朋友，我的父母，我的爷爷奶奶、姥姥姥爷，还有我的老师。
Wǒ sònggěi guo hěn duō rén, bǐrú shuō wǒ de péngyou, wǒ de fùmǔ, wǒ de yéye nǎinai, lǎolao lǎoye, hái yǒu wǒ de lǎoshī.
I've given gifts to lots of people: my friends, my parents, my grandparents on both sides, and my teachers.
杰
那你一般送给他们礼物的时候，都送给他们什么样的礼物呢？
Nà nǐ yìbān sònggěi tāmen lǐwù de shíhou, dōu sònggěi tāmen shénmeyàng de lǐwù ne?
What kind of gifts do you usually give them?
问
这视情况而定。送朋友的话会比较随意，我会根据他的喜好。
Zhè shì qíngkuàng ér dìng. Sòng péngyou dehuà huì bǐjiào suíyì, wǒ huì gēnjù tā de xǐhào.
It depends. For friends it's fairly casual: I go by what they like.
杰
如果他喜欢花儿的话，我会送给他花，因为朋友之间我们会比较了解。
Rúguǒ tā xǐhuan huār dehuà, wǒ huì sònggěi tā huā, yīnwèi péngyou zhījiān wǒmen huì bǐjiào liǎojiě.
If they like flowers, I'll give flowers, because friends know each other quite well.
杰
如果是长辈的话，我会很慎重。比如说会送价格比较贵的钢笔啊，或者是茶叶，
Rúguǒ shì zhǎngbèi dehuà, wǒ huì hěn shènzhòng. Bǐrú shuō huì sòng jiàgé bǐjiào guì de gāngbǐ a, huòzhě shì cháyè,
For elders, I'm very careful. For example, I'd give a fairly expensive pen, or tea,
杰
或者是他喜欢的一些东西，但肯定是比朋友要谨慎得多。
huòzhě shì tā xǐhuan de yìxiē dōngxi, dàn kěndìng shì bǐ péngyou yào jǐnshèn de duō.
or something they like, but definitely much more carefully than for friends.
杰
那你送父母呢？
Nà nǐ sòng fùmǔ ne?
And for your parents?
问
送父母我一般会选择花，或者是对他们身体比较好的东西，比如说茶叶，或者是我自己亲手做的卡片。
Sòng fùmǔ wǒ yìbān huì xuǎnzé huā, huòzhě shì duì tāmen shēntǐ bǐjiào hǎo de dōngxi, bǐrú shuō cháyè, huòzhě shì wǒ zìjǐ qīnshǒu zuò de kǎpiàn.
For my parents I usually choose flowers, or something good for their health like tea, or a card I've made myself.
杰
那你觉得这个送礼在我们的日常生活当中重要吗？为什么呢？
Nà nǐ juéde zhège sònglǐ zài wǒmen de rìcháng shēnghuó dāngzhōng zhòngyào ma? Wèishénme ne?
Do you think giving gifts is important in daily life? Why?
问
我觉得挺重要的。因为人与人之间的交往，面对面的交流是很重要的，
Wǒ juéde tǐng zhòngyào de. Yīnwèi rén yǔ rén zhījiān de jiāowǎng, miànduìmiàn de jiāoliú shì hěn zhòngyào de,
I think it's quite important. In relationships between people, face-to-face communication matters,
杰
但是通过礼物来表达我们的感情，同样很重要。它是另外一种交流方式。
dànshì tōngguò lǐwù lái biǎodá wǒmen de gǎnqíng, tóngyàng hěn zhòngyào. Tā shì lìngwài yì zhǒng jiāoliú fāngshì.
but expressing our feelings through gifts is just as important. It's another way of communicating.
杰
这个礼物是什么，其实不重要。
Zhège lǐwù shì shénme, qíshí bú zhòngyào.
What the gift is doesn't really matter.
杰
重要的是我们要通过这个礼物来表达我们对朋友或者是家长的爱，还有感激之情。
Zhòngyào de shì wǒmen yào tōngguò zhège lǐwù lái biǎodá wǒmen duì péngyou huòzhě shì jiāzhǎng de ài, hái yǒu gǎnjī zhī qíng.
What matters is that through the gift we express our love for our friends or family, and our gratitude.
杰

q: 小杰：给谁送礼？送什么？为什么？
Xiǎojié: gěi shéi sònglǐ? Sòng shénme? Wèishénme?
Xiaojie: who to, what, and why?
ans: 给朋友、父母、爷爷奶奶、姥姥姥爷和老师；朋友喜欢什么就送什么，比如花；长辈送比较贵的钢笔或茶叶；父母送花、茶叶或自己做的卡片；为了表达爱和感激之情，这是另一种交流方式。

Gěi péngyou, fùmǔ, yéye nǎinai, lǎolao lǎoye hé lǎoshī; péngyou xǐhuan shénme jiù sòng shénme, bǐrú huā; zhǎngbèi sòng bǐjiào guì de gāngbǐ huò cháyè; fùmǔ sòng huā, cháyè huò zìjǐ zuò de kǎpiàn; wèile biǎodá ài hé gǎnjī zhī qíng, zhè shì lìng yì zhǒng jiāoliú fāngshì.

Friends, parents, all four grandparents and teachers; for friends whatever they like, such as flowers; for elders an expensive pen or tea; for parents flowers, tea or a homemade card; to express love and gratitude, as another way of communicating.

grammar: 根据……来决定
to decide according to …
根据 = based on.
根据送的每个人的兴趣爱好来决定，一般是这样。
Gēnjù sòng de měi ge rén de xìngqù àihào lái juédìng, yìbān shì zhèyàng.
It depends on each person's interests. That's usually how it is.
根据天气来决定去不去。
Gēnjù tiānqì lái juédìng qù bú qù.
Decide whether to go depending on the weather.
……之类的东西
things like …
Ends a list of examples.
比如说给家人，像我给我爸妈，一般都是去买一些营养品之类的东西。
Bǐrú shuō gěi jiārén, xiàng wǒ gěi wǒ bà mā, yìbān dōu shì qù mǎi yìxiē yíngyǎngpǐn zhīlèi de dōngxi.
For example, for family, like my mum and dad, I usually buy health supplements and that sort of thing.
我喜欢苹果、香蕉之类的水果。
Wǒ xǐhuan píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo zhīlèi de shuǐguǒ.
I like fruit such as apples and bananas.
如果是……的话，就……
if it's …, then …
A condition.
如果是给比我小的一些孩子的话，就买一些巧克力啊、饼干啊之类的东西。
Rúguǒ shì gěi bǐ wǒ xiǎo de yìxiē háizi dehuà, jiù mǎi yìxiē qiǎokèlì a, bǐnggān a zhīlèi de dōngxi.
If it's for younger children, I buy chocolate, biscuits, things like that.
如果是我的话，就不去了。
Rúguǒ shì wǒ dehuà, jiù bú qù le.
If it were me, I wouldn't go.
毕竟
after all
Gives the deciding reason.
还算挺重要的吧，因为毕竟也是一种表达自己想法的一种方式。
Hái suàn tǐng zhòngyào de ba, yīnwèi bìjìng yě shì yì zhǒng biǎodá zìjǐ xiǎngfǎ de yì zhǒng fāngshì.
Fairly important, I'd say, because after all it's a way of expressing your feelings.
他毕竟是孩子。
Tā bìjìng shì háizi.
He's a child, after all.
视情况而定
it depends on the situation
A formal set phrase.
这视情况而定。送朋友的话会比较随意，我会根据他的喜好。
Zhè shì qíngkuàng ér dìng. Sòng péngyou dehuà huì bǐjiào suíyì, wǒ huì gēnjù tā de xǐhào.
It depends. For friends it's fairly casual: I go by what they like.
去不去视情况而定。
Qù bú qù shì qíngkuàng ér dìng.
Whether we go depends on the situation.
比……要……得多
much more … than …
A comparison with degree.
或者是他喜欢的一些东西，但肯定是比朋友要谨慎得多。
huòzhě shì tā xǐhuan de yìxiē dōngxi, dàn kěndìng shì bǐ péngyou yào jǐnshèn de duō.
or something they like, but definitely much more carefully than for friends.
今天比昨天要冷得多。
Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān yào lěng de duō.
Today is much colder than yesterday.
通过……来表达……
to express … through …
来 links means and purpose.
但是通过礼物来表达我们的感情，同样很重要。它是另外一种交流方式。
dànshì tōngguò lǐwù lái biǎodá wǒmen de gǎnqíng, tóngyàng hěn zhòngyào. Tā shì lìngwài yì zhǒng jiāoliú fāngshì.
but expressing our feelings through gifts is just as important. It's another way of communicating.
通过音乐来表达感情。
Tōngguò yīnyuè lái biǎodá gǎnqíng.
To express feelings through music.

grammar: 你来就来嘛
just coming is enough
A polite protest when given a gift.

123.title: The art of giving gifts
123.sub: Lesson 8 reading: a Chinese employee in Paris learns gift etiquette both ways
123.transcriptNote: The first lesson 8 reading. 往而不来，非礼也；来而不往，亦非礼也 is a classical saying from the Book of Rites: "to give and receive nothing back is not proper; to receive and give nothing back is not proper either". 钟 (clock) sounds like 终 (end), and 伞 (umbrella) like 散 (to break up).

blocks.label: 课文
lines: 送礼的学问
Sònglǐ de xuéwen
The art of giving gifts
记得刚被公司派到巴黎工作时，一位法国朋友送给我一份包装得相当漂亮的礼物。
Jìde gāng bèi gōngsī pài dào Bālí gōngzuò shí, yí wèi Fǎguó péngyou sònggěi wǒ yí fèn bāozhuāng de xiāngdāng piàoliang de lǐwù.
I remember when my company first sent me to work in Paris, a French friend gave me a beautifully wrapped present.
当他把礼物递给我时，我很感动，
Dāng tā bǎ lǐwù dìgěi wǒ shí, wǒ hěn gǎndòng,
When he handed it to me I was very touched,
一边说着感谢的话，一边很高兴地把礼物放进包里。
yì biān shuōzhe gǎnxiè de huà, yì biān hěn gāoxìng de bǎ lǐwù fàngjìn bāo li.
and, thanking him, I happily put it in my bag.
过了几天，这位朋友很不好意思地问我是不是不喜欢他的礼物。
Guò le jǐ tiān, zhè wèi péngyou hěn bù hǎoyìsi de wèn wǒ shì bu shì bù xǐhuan tā de lǐwù.
A few days later, this friend asked me rather awkwardly whether I didn't like his present.
我觉得既吃惊又奇怪，连忙解释自己当然很喜欢，并问他为什么这样觉得。
Wǒ juéde jì chījīng yòu qíguài, liánmáng jiěshì zìjǐ dāngrán hěn xǐhuan, bìng wèn tā wèishénme zhèyàng juéde.
I was surprised and puzzled. I quickly explained that of course I liked it, and asked why he thought that.
没想到他说，是因为我没有当面拆开他辛辛苦苦为我挑选的礼物，
Méi xiǎngdào tā shuō, shì yīnwèi wǒ méiyǒu dāngmiàn chāikāi tā xīnxīnkǔkǔ wèi wǒ tiāoxuǎn de lǐwù,
To my surprise he said it was because I hadn't opened in front of him the present he'd taken such trouble to choose for me,
也没有说喜不喜欢，而只是看了一眼就放下了。
yě méiyǒu shuō xǐ bu xǐhuan, ér zhǐshì kàn le yì yǎn jiù fàngxià le.
and hadn't said whether I liked it; I'd just glanced at it and put it away.
我这才意识到，原来是中法文化差异造成了误会。
Wǒ zhè cái yìshidào, yuánlái shì Zhōng-Fǎ wénhuà chāyì zàochéng le wùhuì.
Only then did I realise that the misunderstanding came from a cultural difference between China and France.
跟法国人正好相反，中国人在收到礼物时，不习惯当面拆开，只表示谢意就行了。
Gēn Fǎguórén zhènghǎo xiāngfǎn, Zhōngguórén zài shōudào lǐwù shí, bù xíguàn dāngmiàn chāikāi, zhǐ biǎoshì xièyì jiù xíng le.
Quite the opposite of the French, Chinese people don't usually open a present in front of the giver; they just say thank you.
这样做是想让对方觉得无论是什么礼物，自己都会喜欢。
Zhèyàng zuò shì xiǎng ràng duìfāng juéde wúlùn shì shénme lǐwù, zìjǐ dōu huì xǐhuan.
This is meant to show the giver that whatever the present is, they'll like it.
跟送的礼物比起来，自己更重视的是对方的心意。
Gēn sòng de lǐwù bǐ qilai, zìjǐ gèng zhòngshì de shì duìfāng de xīnyì.
What they value is not the present itself but the thought behind it.

blocks.label: 场合
lines: 在中国，出门做客，求人办事，表示感谢，都免不了送礼。
Zài Zhōngguó, chūmén zuòkè, qiúrén bànshì, biǎoshì gǎnxiè, dōu miǎnbùliǎo sònglǐ.
In China, visiting, asking for a favour or saying thank you all involve giving gifts.
送礼在人际交往中特别重要。
Sònglǐ zài rénjì jiāowǎng zhōng tèbié zhòngyào.
Gifts are especially important in social relationships.
中国人通过送礼来保持人际关系，促进感情。
Zhōngguórén tōngguò sònglǐ lái bǎochí rénjì guānxì, cùjìn gǎnqíng.
Chinese people use gifts to maintain relationships and strengthen feelings.
如何送？何时送？在什么场合送？都有规矩。
Rúhé sòng? Hé shí sòng? Zài shénme chǎnghé sòng? Dōu yǒu guījǔ.
How to give, when to give, on what occasion: there are rules for all of it.
可以说，送礼不仅是一门学问，更是一种艺术。
Kěyǐ shuō, sònglǐ bùjǐn shì yì mén xuéwen, gèng shì yì zhǒng yìshù.
You could say that gift-giving is not just a skill but an art.
在日常生活中最常送的礼物是烟、酒和茶。
Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng zuì cháng sòng de lǐwù shì yān, jiǔ hé chá.
In daily life the most common gifts are cigarettes, alcohol and tea.
但看亲朋好友时，常送些实用的礼物，
Dàn kàn qīnpéng hǎoyǒu shí, cháng sòng xiē shíyòng de lǐwù,
But when visiting family and friends, people often give practical gifts,
比如几斤水果、几盒糕点，甚至几包零食之类。
bǐrú jǐ jīn shuǐguǒ, jǐ hé gāodiǎn, shènzhì jǐ bāo língshí zhīlèi.
such as a few jin of fruit, a few boxes of cakes, or even a few packets of snacks.
年轻人之间也开始流行送鲜花、红酒。
Niánqīngrén zhījiān yě kāishǐ liúxíng sòng xiānhuā, hóngjiǔ.
Among young people, giving flowers and red wine has also become popular.
西方人很少把现金当做礼物。
Xīfāngrén hěn shǎo bǎ xiànjīn dàngzuò lǐwù.
Westerners rarely give cash as a present.
但在中国，春节、结婚、生日这样的场合送红包是很普遍的现象。
Dàn zài Zhōngguó, Chūn Jié, jié hūn, shēngrì zhèyàng de chǎnghé sòng hóngbāo shì hěn pǔbiàn de xiànxiàng.
But in China, giving red envelopes of money at the Spring Festival, weddings and birthdays is very common.
国外生产的营养品、化妆品也是非常受欢迎的礼物。
Guówài shēngchǎn de yíngyǎngpǐn, huàzhuāngpǐn yě shì fēicháng shòu huānyíng de lǐwù.
Health supplements and cosmetics made abroad are also very popular gifts.
这充分说明中国人的生活水平提高了。
Zhè chōngfèn shuōmíng Zhōngguórén de shēnghuó shuǐpíng tígāo le.
This shows clearly that Chinese living standards have risen.
如果从国外往中国带礼物，最好仔细地看看礼物的产地。
Rúguǒ cóng guówài wǎng Zhōngguó dài lǐwù, zuì hǎo zǐxì de kànkan lǐwù de chǎndì.
If you're bringing gifts to China from abroad, it's best to check carefully where they were made.
中国人不一定都会说英语，但人人都知道“中国制造”那三个英文词。
Zhōngguórén bù yídìng dōu huì shuō Yīngyǔ, dàn rénrén dōu zhīdao "Zhōngguó zhìzào" nà sān ge Yīngwén cí.
Not all Chinese people speak English, but everyone knows the three English words "Made in China".
从国外买中国制造的商品，再带回中国当做礼物，这会让人觉得没有诚意。
Cóng guówài mǎi Zhōngguó zhìzào de shāngpǐn, zài dàihuí Zhōngguó dàngzuò lǐwù, zhè huì ràng rén juéde méiyǒu chéngyì.
Buying something made in China abroad and bringing it back to China as a present would seem insincere.

blocks.label: 禁忌
blocks.h: 不能送什么 · What not to give
lines: 中国人一般不会送钟，因为钟与终同音。
Zhōngguórén yìbān bú huì sòng zhōng, yīnwèi zhōng yǔ zhōng tóng yīn.
Chinese people generally don't give clocks, because 钟 (clock) sounds the same as 终 (end).
终意味着结束，而送终的意思是送你离开这个世界。
Zhōng yìwèizhe jiéshù, ér sòng zhōng de yìsi shì sòng nǐ líkāi zhège shìjiè.
终 means the end, and 送终 means to see someone off from this world.
同样，伞与散同音，送雨伞意味着散开。
Tóngyàng, sǎn yǔ sàn tóng yīn, sòng yǔsǎn yìwèizhe sànkāi.
Likewise, 伞 (umbrella) sounds like 散 (to break up), so giving an umbrella suggests parting.
送剪刀也会被认为不吉利，因为它意味着分手、分开。
Sòng jiǎndāo yě huì bèi rènwéi bù jílì, yīnwèi tā yìwèizhe fēnshǒu, fēnkāi.
Giving scissors is also considered unlucky, because they suggest breaking up and separating.
从某种程度上说，这不一定是迷信，而是一种文化习惯。
Cóng mǒu zhǒng chéngdù shàng shuō, zhè bù yídìng shì míxìn, érshì yì zhǒng wénhuà xíguàn.
To some extent this isn't necessarily superstition; it's a cultural habit.
但是如果一个外国人不小心送了这些东西，中国人也能理解和原谅。
Dànshì rúguǒ yí ge wàiguórén bù xiǎoxīn sòng le zhèxiē dōngxi, Zhōngguórén yě néng lǐjiě hé yuánliàng.
But if a foreigner gives one of these by accident, Chinese people will understand and forgive.

blocks.label: 包装
blocks.h: 包装和轻重 · Wrapping and value
lines: 在法国，无论礼物的实际价格是多少，每个人都会把礼物包装得十分漂亮。
Zài Fǎguó, wúlùn lǐwù de shíjì jiàgé shì duōshǎo, měi ge rén dōu huì bǎ lǐwù bāozhuāng de shífēn piàoliang.
In France, whatever a present actually costs, everyone wraps it beautifully.
中国人送礼时也会选择外包装很好看的商品，但一般不会自己再包装一下。
Zhōngguórén sònglǐ shí yě huì xuǎnzé wài bāozhuāng hěn hǎokàn de shāngpǐn, dàn yìbān bú huì zìjǐ zài bāozhuāng yíxià.
Chinese people also choose goods with attractive packaging, but don't usually wrap them again themselves.
基本上送什么东西直接都看得到。
Jīběn shang sòng shénme dōngxi zhíjiē dōu kàn de dào.
Basically, you can see what the gift is straight away.
西方人在送中国人礼物时，有时会让人感到小气。
Xīfāngrén zài sòng Zhōngguórén lǐwù shí, yǒushí huì ràng rén gǎndào xiǎoqi.
When Westerners give Chinese people presents, they sometimes come across as stingy.
其中一个原因就是包装得太漂亮的礼物，往往让人以为价值很高，
Qízhōng yí ge yuányīn jiùshì bāozhuāng de tài piàoliang de lǐwù, wǎngwǎng ràng rén yǐwéi jiàzhí hěn gāo,
One reason is that beautifully wrapped presents often make people think they're very valuable,
而实际上，里面的东西很普通：一本书，一盒巧克力。
ér shíjìshàng, lǐmiàn de dōngxi hěn pǔtōng: yì běn shū, yì hé qiǎokèlì.
when in fact what's inside is ordinary: a book, a box of chocolates.
很多中国人在第一次见面时，往往会送相对重一些的礼物，表示重视和尊敬。
Hěn duō Zhōngguórén zài dì-yī cì jiàn miàn shí, wǎngwǎng huì sòng xiāngduì zhòng yìxiē de lǐwù, biǎoshì zhòngshì hé zūnjìng.
Many Chinese people give a relatively substantial present at a first meeting, to show regard and respect.
等熟悉了以后，礼物的轻重就变得次要了。
Děng shúxī le yǐhòu, lǐwù de qīngzhòng jiù biàn de cìyào le.
Once they know each other well, the value of the present becomes secondary.
还有一点，中国人喜欢红色，不喜欢白色和黑色。
Hái yǒu yìdiǎn, Zhōngguórén xǐhuan hóngsè, bù xǐhuan báisè hé hēisè.
One more thing: Chinese people like red and dislike white and black.
要是在礼物包装上不注意这一点，有可能造成不愉快。
Yàoshì zài lǐwù bāozhuāng shàng bú zhùyì zhè yìdiǎn, yǒu kěnéng zàochéng bù yúkuài.
If you don't pay attention to this when wrapping a present, it could cause unpleasantness.
中国人送礼时经常说“礼轻情义重”，把谦虚视为美德。
Zhōngguórén sònglǐ shí jīngcháng shuō "lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng", bǎ qiānxū shìwèi měidé.
When giving gifts, Chinese people often say "the gift is light but the feeling is deep", seeing modesty as a virtue.
即使送的是一份大大的厚礼，也会非常客气地说，是小小的薄礼。
Jíshǐ sòng de shì yí fèn dàdà de hòulǐ, yě huì fēicháng kèqì de shuō, shì xiǎoxiǎo de bólǐ.
Even when giving a very generous present, they'll politely call it a small, humble gift.
送礼时，把握好礼物的轻重很重要。
Sònglǐ shí, bǎwò hǎo lǐwù de qīngzhòng hěn zhòngyào.
When giving a gift, getting its value right is important.
送得太轻了，对方会觉得你看不起他。
Sòng de tài qīng le, duìfāng huì juéde nǐ kàn bu qǐ tā.
If it's too modest, the other person will feel you look down on them.
但是过于贵重的礼品，可能对方不好意思收，或者担心你有别的目的，
Dànshì guòyú guìzhòng de lǐpǐn, kěnéng duìfāng bù hǎoyìsi shōu, huòzhě dānxīn nǐ yǒu biéde mùdì,
But with an overly valuable gift, the other person may feel awkward accepting it, or worry you have ulterior motives,
或者造成收礼的人心理压力太大，也许会被人家退回来，搞得双方都不好意思。
huòzhě zàochéng shōulǐ de rén xīnlǐ yālì tài dà, yěxǔ huì bèi rénjia tuì huílai, gǎo de shuāngfāng dōu bù hǎoyìsi.
or the recipient may feel too much pressure and send it back, embarrassing both sides.

blocks.label: 礼尚往来
lines: 中国人讲究礼尚往来。
Zhōngguórén jiǎngjiū lǐ shàng wǎng lái.
Chinese people set great store by reciprocity.
往而不来，非礼也；来而不往，亦非礼也。
Wǎng ér bù lái, fēi lǐ yě; lái ér bù wǎng, yì fēi lǐ yě.
To give and receive nothing back is not proper; to receive and give nothing back is not proper either.
别人给自己送了礼，自己也总要找机会送一份价格差不多，甚至价格更高的礼物回去。
Biérén gěi zìjǐ sòng le lǐ, zìjǐ yě zǒng yào zhǎo jīhuì sòng yí fèn jiàgé chàbuduō, shènzhì jiàgé gèng gāo de lǐwù huíqu.
When someone gives you a present, you always look for a chance to give back one of similar or even higher value.
这被称为还礼。不然就失礼了，或者欠下了人情，以后需要用别的方式还回去。
Zhè bèi chēngwéi huánlǐ. Bùrán jiù shīlǐ le, huòzhě qiànxia le rénqíng, yǐhòu xūyào yòng biéde fāngshì hái huíqu.
This is called "returning the gift". Otherwise you'd be impolite, or you'd owe a favour that you'd have to repay some other way later.
对中国人来说，人情是社会交往的敲门砖。
Duì Zhōngguórén lái shuō, rénqíng shì shèhuì jiāowǎng de qiāoménzhuān.
For Chinese people, favours are the stepping stone to social relationships.
人与人之间的感情和关系，可以通过相互送礼建立起来，并渐渐变得稳定。
Rén yǔ rén zhījiān de gǎnqíng hé guānxi, kěyǐ tōngguò xiānghù sònglǐ jiànlì qǐlái, bìng jiànjiàn biàn de wěndìng.
Feelings and relationships between people can be built up through exchanging gifts, and gradually become stable.

grammar: 当……时
when …
Formal 的时候.
当他把礼物递给我时，我很感动，
Dāng tā bǎ lǐwù dìgěi wǒ shí, wǒ hěn gǎndòng,
When he handed it to me I was very touched,
当我到家时，天已经黑了。
Dāng wǒ dào jiā shí, tiān yǐjīng hēi le.
When I got home it was already dark.
both … and …
Two feelings at once.
我觉得既吃惊又奇怪，连忙解释自己当然很喜欢，并问他为什么这样觉得。
Wǒ juéde jì chījīng yòu qíguài, liánmáng jiěshì zìjǐ dāngrán hěn xǐhuan, bìng wèn tā wèishénme zhèyàng juéde.
I was surprised and puzzled. I quickly explained that of course I liked it, and asked why he thought that.
他既聪明又努力。
Tā jì cōngmíng yòu nǔlì.
He's both clever and hard-working.
这才……
only then …
Marks a late realisation.
我这才意识到，原来是中法文化差异造成了误会。
Wǒ zhè cái yìshidào, yuánlái shì Zhōng-Fǎ wénhuà chāyì zàochéng le wùhuì.
Only then did I realise that the misunderstanding came from a cultural difference between China and France.
我这才明白。
Wǒ zhè cái míngbai.
Only then did I understand.
跟……正好相反
exactly the opposite of …
正好 stresses the contrast.
跟法国人正好相反，中国人在收到礼物时，不习惯当面拆开，只表示谢意就行了。
Gēn Fǎguórén zhènghǎo xiāngfǎn, Zhōngguórén zài shōudào lǐwù shí, bù xíguàn dāngmiàn chāikāi, zhǐ biǎoshì xièyì jiù xíng le.
Quite the opposite of the French, Chinese people don't usually open a present in front of the giver; they just say thank you.
他的看法跟我正好相反。
Tā de kànfǎ gēn wǒ zhènghǎo xiāngfǎn.
His view is the exact opposite of mine.
no matter …, …
The result holds in every case.
这样做是想让对方觉得无论是什么礼物，自己都会喜欢。
Zhèyàng zuò shì xiǎng ràng duìfāng juéde wúlùn shì shénme lǐwù, zìjǐ dōu huì xǐhuan.
This is meant to show the giver that whatever the present is, they'll like it.
无论多忙，他都锻炼。
Wúlùn duō máng, tā dōu duànliàn.
However busy he is, he exercises.
跟……比起来
compared with …
Introduces a comparison.
跟送的礼物比起来，自己更重视的是对方的心意。
Gēn sòng de lǐwù bǐ qilai, zìjǐ gèng zhòngshì de shì duìfāng de xīnyì.
What they value is not the present itself but the thought behind it.
跟去年比起来，今年更热。
Gēn qùnián bǐ qilai, jīnnián gèng rè.
It's hotter this year than last.
免不了
can't avoid
V + 不了 = unable to.
在中国，出门做客，求人办事，表示感谢，都免不了送礼。
Zài Zhōngguó, chūmén zuòkè, qiúrén bànshì, biǎoshì gǎnxiè, dōu miǎnbùliǎo sònglǐ.
In China, visiting, asking for a favour or saying thank you all involve giving gifts.
刚开始免不了犯错。
Gāng kāishǐ miǎnbùliǎo fàncuò.
You're bound to make mistakes at first.
把……当做……
to treat … as …
把 + O + 当做 + role.
西方人很少把现金当做礼物。
Xīfāngrén hěn shǎo bǎ xiànjīn dàngzuò lǐwù.
Westerners rarely give cash as a present.
我把他当做朋友。
Wǒ bǎ tā dàngzuò péngyou.
I treat him as a friend.
把……视为……
to regard … as …
Formal 当做.
中国人送礼时经常说“礼轻情义重”，把谦虚视为美德。
Zhōngguórén sònglǐ shí jīngcháng shuō "lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng", bǎ qiānxū shìwèi měidé.
When giving gifts, Chinese people often say "the gift is light but the feeling is deep", seeing modesty as a virtue.
他把工作视为生活的全部。
Tā bǎ gōngzuò shìwèi shēnghuó de quánbù.
He regards work as his whole life.
even if …, still …
A concessive condition.
即使送的是一份大大的厚礼，也会非常客气地说，是小小的薄礼。
Jíshǐ sòng de shì yí fèn dàdà de hòulǐ, yě huì fēicháng kèqì de shuō, shì xiǎoxiǎo de bólǐ.
Even when giving a very generous present, they'll politely call it a small, humble gift.
即使很累，他也不休息。
Jíshǐ hěn lèi, tā yě bù xiūxi.
Even when tired, he doesn't rest.
被称为……
to be called …
A passive naming structure.
这被称为还礼。不然就失礼了，或者欠下了人情，以后需要用别的方式还回去。
Zhè bèi chēngwéi huánlǐ. Bùrán jiù shīlǐ le, huòzhě qiànxia le rénqíng, yǐhòu xūyào yòng biéde fāngshì hái huíqu.
This is called "returning the gift". Otherwise you'd be impolite, or you'd owe a favour that you'd have to repay some other way later.
北京被称为首都。
Běijīng bèi chēngwéi shǒudū.
Beijing is called the capital.
gaps: 一位法国朋友送给我一份
他辛辛苦苦为我挑选的礼物
原来是中法文化差异造成了
出门做客，求人办事，表示感谢，都
送得太轻了，对方会觉得你
对中国人来说，人情是社会交往的
say: You could say that gift-giving is not just a skill but an art.
Chinese people set great store by reciprocity.

124.title: Should red envelopes be abolished?
124.sub: Lesson 8 reading: a debate on giving money as a gift
124.transcriptNote: The second lesson 8 reading, a debate. 甲 argues for abolishing red envelopes and 乙 argues against. Who says which turn is my reading from context.

blocks.label: 引言
blocks.h: 红包应不应该被取消？ · Introduction
lines: 红包应不应该被取消？
Hóngbāo yīng bù yīnggāi bèi qǔxiāo?
Should red envelopes be abolished?
送红包是中国人的一种传统习俗，
Sòng hóngbāo shì Zhōngguórén de yì zhǒng chuántǒng xísú,
Giving red envelopes is a traditional Chinese custom.
是指人们用红纸将一定数量的钱包起来，当做礼物送给别人。
shì zhǐ rénmen yòng hóng zhǐ jiāng yídìng shùliàng de qián bāo qilai, dàngzuò lǐwù sònggěi biérén.
It means wrapping a sum of money in red paper and giving it to someone as a present.
红包内钱的数目代表着祝福和好运。
Hóngbāo nèi qián de shùmù dàibiǎozhe zhùfú hé hǎoyùn.
The amount of money inside stands for blessings and good luck.
数目如果有六，就代表着顺利；数目里有八，就代表着发财；而九代表长久。
Shùmù rúguǒ yǒu liù, jiù dàibiǎozhe shùnlì; shùmù li yǒu bā, jiù dàibiǎozhe fācái; ér jiǔ dàibiǎo chángjiǔ.
A six in the amount means things will go smoothly; an eight means getting rich; and nine means lasting long.
这些都是吉利的数字。
Zhèxiē dōu shì jílì de shùzì.
These are all lucky numbers.
但是不少人认为，红包的负面作用也不小。
Dànshì bù shǎo rén rènwéi, hóngbāo de fùmiàn zuòyòng yě bù xiǎo.
But many people think red envelopes have serious downsides too.
除了给人们带来经济方面的压力以外，还有可能带来腐败。
Chúle gěi rénmen dàilái jīngjì fāngmiàn de yālì yǐwài, hái yǒu kěnéng dàilái fǔbài.
Besides putting financial pressure on people, they can also lead to corruption.
那送红包的习俗应该被取消吗？
Nà sòng hóngbāo de xísú yīnggāi bèi qǔxiāo ma?
So should the custom be abolished?
我们的采访对象有完全不同的观点。
Wǒmen de cǎifǎng duìxiàng yǒu wánquán bùtóng de guāndiǎn.
The people we interviewed have completely opposite views.

blocks.label: 辩论
lines: 我认为送红包这种所谓的传统习俗在今天应该被取消。
Wǒ rènwéi sòng hóngbāo zhè zhǒng suǒwèi de chuántǒng xísú zài jīntiān yīnggāi bèi qǔxiāo.
I think this so-called traditional custom of giving red envelopes should be abolished today.
甲
过去收入水平不高，所以送钱最实用，对方可以根据自己的需要来使用。
Guòqu shōurù shuǐpíng bù gāo, suǒyǐ sòng qián zuì shíyòng, duìfāng kěyǐ gēnjù zìjǐ de xūyào lái shǐyòng.
In the past incomes were low, so money was the most practical gift: people could use it as they needed.
甲
但现在人们基本上什么都不缺。与其直接送钱，不如送一些礼物，更能表达心意。
Dàn xiànzài rénmen jīběn shang shénme dōu bù quē. Yǔqí zhíjiē sòng qián, bùrú sòng yìxiē lǐwù, gèng néng biǎodá xīnyì.
But now people basically lack nothing. Rather than giving money directly, it's better to give a present; it expresses your feelings better.
甲
我不同意这种看法。红包多么有中国特色啊。
Wǒ bù tóngyì zhè zhǒng kànfǎ. Hóngbāo duōme yǒu Zhōngguó tèsè a.
I disagree. Red envelopes are so distinctively Chinese.
乙
对中国人来说，红色代表着热情、愉快和吉利。
Duì Zhōngguórén lái shuō, hóngsè dàibiǎozhe rèqíng, yúkuài hé jílì.
For Chinese people, red stands for warmth, joy and good luck.
乙
春节时给孩子们发压岁钱，表示希望他们平平安安地度过这一年。
Chūn Jié shí gěi háizimen fā yāsuìqián, biǎoshì xīwàng tāmen píngpíng'ān'ān de dùguò zhè yì nián.
Giving children New Year money shows we hope they'll get through the year safe and sound.
乙
给家里的长辈发红包，表示孝顺。在婚礼、生日这样的场合送红包，表示祝福。
Gěi jiā li de zhǎngbèi fā hóngbāo, biǎoshì xiàoshùn. Zài hūnlǐ, shēngrì zhèyàng de chǎnghé sòng hóngbāo, biǎoshì zhùfú.
Giving red envelopes to elders shows filial respect. At weddings and birthdays, they express good wishes.
乙
中国文化的特色不能丢。
Zhōngguó wénhuà de tèsè bù néng diū.
We can't lose what's distinctive about Chinese culture.
乙
你提到压岁钱，这个钱孩子们自己能拿得到吗？
Nǐ tídào yāsuìqián, zhège qián háizimen zìjǐ néng ná de dào ma?
You mention New Year money. Do the children actually get to keep it?
甲
大部分的情况是父母替孩子把钱收下了，用来以后还礼，
Dà bùfen de qíngkuàng shì fùmǔ tì háizi bǎ qián shōuxia le, yònglái yǐhòu huánlǐ,
Most of the time the parents take the money for them and use it to return gifts later,
甲
所以对小孩子来说，压岁钱根本没有任何意义，还不如送给他们玩具和糖果。
suǒyǐ duì xiǎoháizi lái shuō, yāsuìqián gēnběn méiyǒu rènhé yìyì, hái bùrú sònggěi tāmen wánjù hé tángguǒ.
so for small children New Year money means nothing at all. Toys and sweets would be better.
甲
我还是坚持我的看法：表达心意，最好送礼物，不必送钱。
Wǒ háishi jiānchí wǒ de kànfǎ: biǎodá xīnyì, zuì hǎo sòng lǐwù, búbì sòng qián.
I stand by my view: to express your feelings, a present is best. No need for money.
甲
我承认你说的这种情况确实存在。但不可否认的是，孩子在拿到红包的时候是很高兴的。
Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ shuō de zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng quèshí cúnzài. Dàn bùkě fǒurèn de shì, háizi zài nádào hóngbāo de shíhou shì hěn gāoxìng de.
I admit what you describe does happen. But there's no denying that children are very happy when they get a red envelope.
乙
如果他们用压岁钱来购买图书和学习用品，父母肯定也是支持的。
Rúguǒ tāmen yòng yāsuìqián lái gòumǎi túshū hé xuéxí yòngpǐn, fùmǔ kěndìng yě shì zhīchí de.
If they use the money to buy books and school things, parents will certainly support that.
乙
也有父母会替孩子把钱存起来，等到他们念大学时再给他们。
Yě yǒu fùmǔ huì tì háizi bǎ qián cún qǐlái, děngdào tāmen niàn dàxué shí zài gěi tāmen.
Some parents also save the money for their children and give it to them when they go to university.
乙
压岁钱只是红包的一种类型，而且一般都是在长辈和晚辈之间送，钱的多少不一定很重要。
Yāsuìqián zhǐshì hóngbāo de yì zhǒng lèixíng, érqiě yìbān dōu shì zài zhǎngbèi hé wǎnbèi zhījiān sòng, qián de duōshǎo bù yídìng hěn zhòngyào.
New Year money is just one kind of red envelope, and it's usually given by elders to the young, so the amount isn't necessarily important.
甲
但在其他情况下，比方说同事的婚礼、朋友的生日晚会，
Dàn zài qítā qíngkuàng xià, bǐfang shuō tóngshì de hūnlǐ, péngyou de shēngrì wǎnhuì,
But in other situations, such as a colleague's wedding or a friend's birthday party,
甲
如果红包送得太轻了，不但会丢面子，而且可能影响到人际关系。
rúguǒ hóngbāo sòng de tài qīng le, búdàn huì diū miànzi, érqiě kěnéng yǐngxiǎng dào rénjì guānxì.
if your red envelope is too light, you'll not only lose face but may harm the relationship.
甲
想象一下，要是一个月收到好几个婚礼的邀请，你送得起吗？
Xiǎngxiàng yíxià, yàoshì yí ge yuè shōudào hǎo jǐ ge hūnlǐ de yāoqǐng, nǐ sòng de qǐ ma?
Imagine getting several wedding invitations in one month. Could you afford it?
甲
我之所以赞成取消红包，就是因为它不利于人际交往，
Wǒ zhī suǒyǐ zànchéng qǔxiāo hóngbāo, jiùshì yīnwèi tā búlì yú rénjì jiāowǎng,
The reason I support abolishing red envelopes is that they're bad for relationships:
甲
给人一种感觉就是钱的多少在一定程度上可以代表人与人关系的远近。
gěi rén yì zhǒng gǎnjué jiùshì qián de duōshǎo zài yídìng chéngdù shàng kěyǐ dàibiǎo rén yǔ rén guānxi de yuǎnjìn.
they give the impression that the amount of money shows, to some extent, how close people are.
甲
如果真的像你所说的，对方以钱的数量来衡量人际关系的远近，再跟这样的人也没有交往的必要了。
Rúguǒ zhēn de xiàng nǐ suǒ shuō de, duìfāng yǐ qián de shùliàng lái héngliáng rénjì guānxì de yuǎnjìn, zài gēn zhèyàng de rén yě méiyǒu jiāowǎng de bìyào le.
If someone really judges how close you are by the amount of money, as you say, there's no point being friends with them anyway.
乙
真正的朋友一定不会这样。有多大经济实力就送多少钱。
Zhēnzhèng de péngyou yídìng bú huì zhèyàng. Yǒu duō dà jīngjì shílì jiù sòng duōshǎo qián.
Real friends would never do that. You give as much as you can afford.
乙
送红包表示的是一种心意，没有互相比较的必要。
Sòng hóngbāo biǎoshì de shì yì zhǒng xīnyì, méiyǒu hùxiāng bǐjiào de bìyào.
A red envelope expresses a feeling; there's no need to compare.
乙
从理论上讲，你说的对。遗憾的是，现实的情况没那么简单。
Cóng lǐlùn shàng jiǎng, nǐ shuō de duì. Yíhàn de shì, xiànshí de qíngkuàng méi nàme jiǎndān.
In theory you're right. Unfortunately, reality isn't that simple.
甲
有人连生孩子、孩子满月、考上大学都要请客吃饭。
Yǒu rén lián shēng háizi, háizi mǎnyuè, kǎoshang dàxué dōu yào qǐngkè chī fàn.
Some people throw a dinner for everything: having a baby, the baby's first month, getting into university.
甲
如果请客的人是你的领导、重要客户，这个红包送还是不送？
Rúguǒ qǐngkè de rén shì nǐ de lǐngdǎo, zhòngyào kèhù, zhège hóngbāo sòng háishi bú sòng?
If the host is your boss or an important client, do you give a red envelope or not?
甲
我举另一个例子吧。就好像你买一把菜刀，可以用来切菜，也可以用来伤人。
Wǒ jǔ lìng yí ge lìzi ba. Jiù hǎoxiàng nǐ mǎi yì bǎ càidāo, kěyǐ yònglái qiè cài, yě kěyǐ yònglái shāngrén.
Let me give another example. It's like buying a kitchen knife: you can use it to cut vegetables or to hurt someone.
乙
但不能因为菜刀会伤人，就禁止人们使用。
Dàn bù néng yīnwèi càidāo huì shāngrén, jiù jìnzhǐ rénmen shǐyòng.
But you can't ban knives just because they can hurt people.
乙
同样的道理，红包本来代表的是祝福。
Tóngyàng de dàolǐ, hóngbāo běnlái dàibiǎo de shì zhùfú.
By the same logic, a red envelope stands for good wishes.
乙
不能因为有一部分人利用它来干违法的事儿，就主张取消。
Bù néng yīnwèi yǒu yí bùfen rén lìyòng tā lái gàn wéifǎ de shìr, jiù zhǔzhāng qǔxiāo.
You can't call for abolishing it just because some people use it for illegal things.
乙
并不是取消了红包，这些负面现象就会消失了。红包无罪。
Bìng bú shì qǔxiāo le hóngbāo, zhèxiē fùmiàn xiànxiàng jiù huì xiāoshī le. Hóngbāo wú zuì.
Abolishing red envelopes won't make these problems disappear. The red envelope isn't guilty.
乙

grammar: 将……V起来
to … up (formal 把)
将 is a formal 把.
是指人们用红纸将一定数量的钱包起来，当做礼物送给别人。
shì zhǐ rénmen yòng hóng zhǐ jiāng yídìng shùliàng de qián bāo qilai, dàngzuò lǐwù sònggěi biérén.

将书放起来。
Jiāng shū fàng qǐlái.
Put the books away.
除了……以外，还……
besides …, also …
Adds a further point.
除了给人们带来经济方面的压力以外，还有可能带来腐败。

除了英语以外，他还会法语。
Chúle Yīngyǔ yǐwài, tā hái huì Fǎyǔ.

与其……，不如……
rather than …, better to …
Prefers the second option.
但现在人们基本上什么都不缺。与其直接送钱，不如送一些礼物，更能表达心意。
Dàn xiànzài rénmen jīběn shang shénme dōu bù quē. Yǔqí zhíjiē sòng qián, bùrú sòng yìxiē lǐwù, gèng néng biǎodá xīnyì.
But now people basically lack nothing. Rather than giving money directly, it's better to give a present; it expresses your feelings better.
与其在家等，不如出去找。
Yǔqí zài jiā děng, bùrú chūqu zhǎo.
Rather than wait at home, go and look.
多么……啊
how …!
An exclamation.
我不同意这种看法。红包多么有中国特色啊。
Wǒ bù tóngyì zhè zhǒng kànfǎ. Hóngbāo duōme yǒu Zhōngguó tèsè a.
I disagree. Red envelopes are so distinctively Chinese.
多么美的风景啊！
Duōme měide fēngjǐng a!
What beautiful scenery!
还不如……
it would be better to …
还 adds comparison.
所以对小孩子来说，压岁钱根本没有任何意义，还不如送给他们玩具和糖果。
suǒyǐ duì xiǎoháizi lái shuō, yāsuìqián gēnběn méiyǒu rènhé yìyì, hái bùrú sònggěi tāmen wánjù hé tángguǒ.
so for small children New Year money means nothing at all. Toys and sweets would be better.
还不如自己做。
Hái bùrú zìjǐ zuò.
Better to do it yourself.
不可否认的是……
there's no denying that …
Concedes a point.
我承认你说的这种情况确实存在。但不可否认的是，孩子在拿到红包的时候是很高兴的。
Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ shuō de zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng quèshí cúnzài. Dàn bùkě fǒurèn de shì, háizi zài nádào hóngbāo de shíhou shì hěn gāoxìng de.
I admit what you describe does happen. But there's no denying that children are very happy when they get a red envelope.
不可否认的是，他很努力。
Bùkě fǒurèn de shì, tā hěn nǔlì.
There's no denying he works hard.
不但……，而且……
not only …, but also …
Adds a stronger point.
如果红包送得太轻了，不但会丢面子，而且可能影响到人际关系。
rúguǒ hóngbāo sòng de tài qīng le, búdàn huì diū miànzi, érqiě kěnéng yǐngxiǎng dào rénjì guānxì.
if your red envelope is too light, you'll not only lose face but may harm the relationship.
他不但会唱，而且会跳。
Tā búdàn huì chàng, érqiě huì tiào.
He can not only sing but dance.

can afford to …
Potential complement with 起.
想象一下，要是一个月收到好几个婚礼的邀请，你送得起吗？

Rúguǒ zhēn de xiàng nǐ suǒ shuō de, duìfāng yǐ qián de shùliàng lái héngliáng rénjì guānxì de yuǎnjìn, zài gēn zhèyàng de rén yě méiyǒu jiāowǎng de bìyào le.

even …
Stresses an extreme case.
有人连生孩子、孩子满月、考上大学都要请客吃饭。
