Wǒ jiā de qiáng shang guà mǎn le yéye huà de huàr.
The walls at home are covered with paintings by my grandpa.
桌子上放满了书。
Zhuōzi shàng fàng mǎn le shū.
The table is covered with books.
是由……组成的
is made up of …
由 introduces the parts.
对中国人来说，中秋这个日子是由月、饼和家组成的。
Duì Zhōngguórén lái shuō, Zhōngqiū zhège rìzi shì yóu yuè, bǐng hé jiā zǔchéng de.
For Chinese people, the Mid-Autumn Festival is made up of the moon, mooncakes and family.
这个队是由十个人组成的。
Zhège duì shì yóu shí ge rén zǔchéng de.
The team is made up of ten people.
gaps: 退了休以后，我爸每天去公园

130.title: Do the two sentences match?
130.sub: Five pairs: same meaning or not?
130.transcriptNote: Each item has two sentences, A and B. Decide whether they mean the same thing, then turn on Answers. The letter B isn't read aloud. The answers are my own judgement.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断意思是否相符 · Same meaning?
lines: 听录音，判断两个句子的意思是否相符。
Tīng lùyīn, pànduàn liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu xiāngfú.
Listen and decide whether the two sentences mean the same.
刘博士在国外生活过多年，英语说得非常地道。
Liú bóshì zài guówài shēnghuó guo duō nián, Yīngyǔ shuō de fēicháng dìdao.
Dr Liu lived abroad for many years, and his English is very idiomatic.
A
刘博士住在国外，英语当然说得非常好。
Liú bóshì zhù zài guówài, Yīngyǔ dāngrán shuō de fēicháng hǎo.
Dr Liu lives abroad, so of course his English is very good.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A says he lived abroad in the past; B says he lives abroad now.

lines: 随着全球化的速度不断加快，中国与世界的关系越来越密切。
Suízhe quánqiúhuà de sùdù búduàn jiākuài, Zhōngguó yǔ shìjiè de guānxi yuèláiyuè mìqiè.
As globalisation keeps speeding up, China's ties with the world are getting closer.
A
全球化使中国和世界各国的交流和联系不断加强。
Quánqiúhuà shǐ Zhōngguó hé shìjiè gèguó de jiāoliú hé liánxì búduàn jiāqiáng.
Globalisation keeps strengthening exchanges and links between China and other countries.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: Both say globalisation brings China and the world closer.

lines: 中国不仅有古老的文化、美丽的自然风景，还有很多投资机会。这一切吸引着越来越多的外国人来到中国生活。
Zhōngguó bùjǐn yǒu gǔlǎo de wénhuà, měilì de zìrán fēngjǐng, hái yǒu hěn duō tóuzī jīhuì. Zhè yíqiè xīyǐnzhe yuèláiyuè duō de wàiguórén láidào Zhōngguó shēnghuó.
China has not only an ancient culture and beautiful scenery but also many investment opportunities. All this draws more and more foreigners to live in China.
A
中国的吸引力来自大量的投资机会、古老的东方文化以及美丽的自然风景。
Zhōngguó de xīyǐnlì láizì dàliàng de tóuzī jīhuì, gǔlǎo de dōngfāng wénhuà yǐjí měilì de zìrán fēngjǐng.
China's appeal comes from its many investment opportunities, ancient Eastern culture and beautiful scenery.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: The same three attractions are listed in a different order.

lines: 从古至今，中国人都有中秋赏月的习俗。
Cóng gǔ zhì jīn, Zhōngguórén dōu yǒu Zhōngqiū shǎng yuè de xísú.
From ancient times until today, Chinese people have had the custom of admiring the moon at Mid-Autumn.
A
中国人每年到了中秋节都有赏月的习俗。从前是这样，现在不是这样。
Zhōngguórén měinián dào le Zhōngqiū Jié dōu yǒu shǎng yuè de xísú. Cóngqián shì zhèyàng, xiànzài bú shì zhèyàng.
Chinese people used to admire the moon every Mid-Autumn. That was the past; it isn't so now.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A says the custom continues today; B says it no longer does.

lines: 很多北漂一族觉得自己现在的打工生活比原来在家乡时要强得多。
Hěn duō běipiāo yì zú juéde zìjǐ xiànzài de dǎ gōng shēnghuó bǐ yuánlái zài jiāxiāng shí yào qiáng de duō.
Many "Beijing drifters" feel their working life now is much better than it was back home.
A
很多北漂一族不满意现在的打工生活，觉得自己在家乡时的情况更好。
Hěn duō běipiāo yì zú bù mǎnyì xiànzài de dǎ gōng shēnghuó, juéde zìjǐ zài jiāxiāng shí de qíngkuàng gèng hǎo.
Many "Beijing drifters" are unhappy with their working life now and feel things were better back home.
B

q: 两个句子的意思相符吗？
Liǎng ge jùzi de yìsi xiāngfú ma?
Do the two sentences mean the same?
qs.why: A and B say the opposite.

grammar: V过多年
to have … for many years
过 marks past experience.
刘博士在国外生活过多年，英语说得非常地道。
Liú bóshì zài guówài shēnghuó guo duō nián, Yīngyǔ shuō de fēicháng dìdao.
Dr Liu lived abroad for many years, and his English is very idiomatic.
他在中国工作过多年。
Tā zài Zhōngguó gōngzuò guo duō nián.
He worked in China for many years.
as …
One change follows another.
随着全球化的速度不断加快，中国与世界的关系越来越密切。
Suízhe quánqiúhuà de sùdù búduàn jiākuài, Zhōngguó yǔ shìjiè de guānxi yuèláiyuè mìqiè.
As globalisation keeps speeding up, China's ties with the world are getting closer.
随着年龄增长，他更成熟了。
Suízhe niánlíng zēngzhǎng, tā gèng chéngshú le.
He's grown more mature with age.
not only …, but also …
Adds a point.
中国不仅有古老的文化、美丽的自然风景，还有很多投资机会。这一切吸引着越来越多的外国人来到中国生活。
Zhōngguó bùjǐn yǒu gǔlǎo de wénhuà, měilì de zìrán fēngjǐng, hái yǒu hěn duō tóuzī jīhuì. Zhè yíqiè xīyǐnzhe yuèláiyuè duō de wàiguórén láidào Zhōngguó shēnghuó.
China has not only an ancient culture and beautiful scenery but also many investment opportunities. All this draws more and more foreigners to live in China.
他不仅会说，还会写。
Tā bùjǐn huì shuō, hái huì xiě.
He can not only speak but write.
来自……
to come from …
Gives the source.
中国的吸引力来自大量的投资机会、古老的东方文化以及美丽的自然风景。
Zhōngguó de xīyǐnlì láizì dàliàng de tóuzī jīhuì, gǔlǎo de dōngfāng wénhuà yǐjí měilì de zìrán fēngjǐng.
China's appeal comes from its many investment opportunities, ancient Eastern culture and beautiful scenery.
他来自北京。
Tā láizì Běijīng.
He's from Beijing.
比……要强得多
much better than …
要 adds weight to a comparison.
很多北漂一族觉得自己现在的打工生活比原来在家乡时要强得多。
Hěn duō běipiāo yì zú juéde zìjǐ xiànzài de dǎ gōng shēnghuó bǐ yuánlái zài jiāxiāng shí yào qiáng de duō.
Many "Beijing drifters" feel their working life now is much better than it was back home.
这个比那个要好得多。
Zhège bǐ nàge yào hǎo de duō.
This is much better than that.
gaps: 中国与世界的关系越来越
中国人都有中秋赏月的
不满意现在的打工生活

131.title: Studying in France
131.sub: Two Chinese students talk about life in Paris
131.transcriptNote: A short passage, then an interview with two Chinese students in Paris. 问 is the interviewer, 杨 is Yang Yang and 高 is Gao Li. This is natural speech: fillers are left out. Who says which line is my reading from context. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，选择信息 · Listen and choose
lines: 听录音，然后选择信息。
Tīng lùyīn, ránhòu xuǎnzé xìnxī.
Listen, then choose the information.
两位年轻人在谈自己在法国生活的感受。
Liǎng wèi niánqīngrén zài tán zìjǐ zài Fǎguó shēnghuó de gǎnshòu.
Two young people talk about their experience of living in France.
听听他们为什么来法国留学，生活中有什么不适应的地方，
Tīngting tāmen wèishénme lái Fǎguó liú xué, shēnghuó zhòng yǒu shénme bú shìyìng de dìfang,
Listen for why they came to study in France and what they find hard to adjust to,
然后判断录音中提到了下表中的哪些内容。
ránhòu pànduàn lùyīn zhòng tídào le xià biǎo zhòng de nǎxiē nèiróng.
then decide which items in the table are mentioned.

q: 他们为什么来法国留学？
Tāmen wèishénme lái Fǎguó liú xué?
Why did they come to study in France?
ans: 丰富人生经历，为理想而奋斗；了解不同文化、不同价值观；多学知识；学地道的外语；读硕士或博士，回国后好找工作；锻炼独立生活的能力。

Fēngfù rénshēng jīnglì, wèi lǐxiǎng ér fèndòu; liǎojiě bùtóng wénhuà, bùtóng jiàzhíguān; duō xué zhīshí; xué dìdao de wàiyǔ; dú shuòshì huò bóshì, huí guó hòu hǎo zhǎo gōngzuò; duànliàn dúlì shēnghuó de nénglì.

To broaden their experience and pursue their dreams; to understand other cultures and values; to learn more; to learn a foreign language properly; to do a master's or PhD to help find a job back home; and to learn to live independently.

q: 他们在法国生活中有什么不适应的地方？
Tāmen zài Fǎguó shēnghuó zhòng yǒu shénme bú shìyìng de dìfang?
What do they find hard to adjust to?
ans: 杨洋觉得早餐太单一，只能天天吃面包果酱，胖了十斤；高丽吃得还习惯，但过节的时候很想家，尤其是中秋节，在海外感受不到过节的气氛。

Yáng Yáng juéde zǎocān tài dānyī, zhǐ néng tiāntiān chī miànbāo guǒjiàng, pàng le shí jīn; Gāo Lì chī de hái xíguàn, dàn guòjié de shíhou hěn xiǎngjiā, yóuqí shì Zhōngqiū Jié, zài hǎiwài gǎnshòu bú dào guòjié de qìfēn.

Yang Yang finds breakfast too monotonous, eats bread and jam every day and has put on five kilos; Gao Li is used to the food but misses home at festivals, especially Mid-Autumn, because there's no festive atmosphere abroad.

blocks.label: 短文
blocks.h: 中国与世界 · China and the world
lines: 中国与世界。
Zhōngguó yǔ shìjiè.
China and the world.
随着改革开放速度的不断加快，中国与世界的关系越来越密切。
Suízhe gǎigé kāifàng sùdù de búduàn jiākuài, Zhōngguó yǔ shìjiè de guānxi yuèláiyuè mìqiè.
As reform and opening up keep speeding up, China's ties with the world are getting closer.
为了更好地参与到全球化之中，中国努力加强与世界各国经济、教育、环境、安全等各个方面的合作。
Wèile gèng hǎo de cānyù dào quánqiúhuà zhīzhōng, Zhōngguó nǔlì jiāqiáng yǔ shìjiè gèguó jīngjì, jiàoyù, huánjìng, ānquán děng gègè fāngmiàn de hézuò.
To take a fuller part in globalisation, China is working to strengthen cooperation with other countries in the economy, education, the environment, security and more.
今天，越来越多的中国人走出国门，或者是为了旅游参观，或者是为了学习和考察。
Jīntiān, yuèláiyuè duō de Zhōngguórén zǒu chū guómén, huòzhě shì wèile lǚyóu cānguān, huòzhě shì wèile xuéxí hé kǎochá.
Today more and more Chinese people go abroad, whether as tourists or to study and learn.
同时，也有越来越多的外国人来到了中国。
Tóngshí, yě yǒu yuèláiyuè duō de wàiguórén láidào le Zhōngguó.
At the same time, more and more foreigners are coming to China.
中国和世界的距离在不断缩小。
Zhōngguó hé shìjiè de jùlí zài búduàn suōxiǎo.
The distance between China and the world keeps shrinking.
我们采访了两位在巴黎留学的学生。
Wǒmen cǎifǎng le liǎng wèi zài Bālí liú xué de xuésheng.
We interviewed two students studying in Paris.

blocks.label: 采访
lines: 杨洋你好。
Yáng Yáng nǐhǎo.
Hello, Yang Yang.
问
你好。
Nǐhǎo.
Hello.
杨
高丽你好。
Gāo Lì nǐhǎo.
Hello, Gao Li.
问
你好你好。
Nǐhǎo nǐhǎo.
Hello, hello.
高
你们好。你们都是留学生，对吗？
Nǐmen hǎo. Nǐmen dōu shì liúxuéshēng, duì ma?
Hello to you both. You're both overseas students, right?
问
对对。
Duì duì.
Yes.
杨
你们来法国几年了？
Nǐmen lái Fǎguó jǐ nián le?
How long have you been in France?
问
一年。
Yì nián.
One year.
杨
我都快六年了。
Wǒ dōu kuài liù nián le.
Almost six years for me.
高
你们为什么出国留学？
Nǐmen wèishénme chū guó liú xué?
Why did you come abroad to study?
问
就是为了丰富一下我的人生经历，为理想而奋斗嘛。
Jiùshì wèile fēngfù yíxià wǒ de rénshēng jīnglì, wèi lǐxiǎng ér fèndòu ma.
To broaden my life experience and pursue my dreams.
杨
同时能了解不同文化，不同价值观，也能多学到一些知识。
Tóngshí néng liǎojiě bùtóng wénhuà, bùtóng jiàzhíguān, yě néng duō xuédào yìxiē zhīshí.
And to get to know different cultures and values, and learn more.
杨
对，而且我觉得年轻的时候就该多走走，丰富一下自己的经历。
Duì, érqiě wǒ juéde niánqīng de shíhou jiù gāi duō zǒuzou, fēngfù yíxià zìjǐ de jīnglì.
Yes, and I think you should travel while you're young and broaden your experience.
高
而且到国外还能够学到地道的外语，读一个硕士或者博士，
Érqiě dào guówài hái nénggòu xuédào dìdao de wàiyǔ, dú yí ge shuòshì huòzhě bóshì,
And abroad you can learn a foreign language properly and do a master's or PhD;
高
学完回国后找工作会多一个有利条件。另外，还能锻炼独立生活的能力。
xué wán huí guó hòu zhǎo gōngzuò huì duō yí ge yǒulì tiáojiàn. Lìngwài, hái néng duànliàn dúlì shēnghuó de nénglì.
when you go home, that gives you an advantage in finding a job. And you learn to live independently.
高
在法国生活中有没有不适应的地方？
Zài Fǎguó shēnghuó zhòng yǒu méiyǒu bú shìyìng de dìfang?
Is there anything about life in France you find hard to adjust to?
问
我觉得还好，只是觉得在法国早餐太单一。除了牛奶、面包、果酱，你没有太多的选择。
Wǒ juéde háihǎo, zhǐshì juéde zài Fǎguó zǎocān tài dānyī. Chúle niúnǎi, miànbāo, guǒjiàng, nǐ méiyǒu tài duō de xuǎnzé.
It's fine, really. I just find breakfast in France too monotonous. Apart from milk, bread and jam, there's not much choice.
杨
我在中国的时候，一个星期内每天早上吃的东西都不一样。
Wǒ zài Zhōngguó de shíhou, yí ge xīngqī nèi měitiān zǎoshang chī de dōngxi dōu bù yíyàng.
In China, I ate something different every morning of the week.
杨
你早上去市场转一下，什么都有：包子、米粥、面条、豆浆，太多了。
Nǐ zǎoshang qù shìchǎng zhuàn yíxià, shénme dōu yǒu: bāozi, mǐzhōu, miàntiáo, dòujiāng, tài duō le.
Take a stroll round the market in the morning and there's everything: steamed buns, rice porridge, noodles, soy milk. So much.
杨
可惜这些我都不会做，所以只好天天吃面包果酱。
Kěxī zhèxiē wǒ dōu bú huì zuò, suǒyǐ zhǐhǎo tiāntiān chī miànbāo guǒjiàng.
Unfortunately I can't make any of it, so I have to eat bread and jam every day.
杨
结果我自从来到法国以后，一共胖了十斤。
Jiéguǒ wǒ zìcóng láidào Fǎguó yǐhòu, yígòng pàng le shí jīn.
As a result, I've put on ten jin since coming to France.
杨
我一般还都挺适应的。在国内的时候，我就常吃面包果酱。
Wǒ yìbān hái dōu tǐng shìyìng de. Zài guónèi de shíhou, wǒ jiù cháng chī miànbāo guǒjiàng.
I've adjusted quite well generally. Back home I often ate bread and jam.
高
其实我觉得吃的东西没什么，只是在过节的时候很想家，尤其是中秋节。
Qíshí wǒ juéde chī de dōngxi méi shénme, zhǐshì zài guòjié de shíhou hěn xiǎngjiā, yóuqí shì Zhōngqiū Jié.
Actually food isn't a problem for me; I just miss home a lot at festivals, especially Mid-Autumn.
高
来法国之前，每到中秋节，我们都去奶奶家过，家里来的人甚至比春节还多。
Lái Fǎguó zhīqián, měi dào Zhōngqiū Jié, wǒmen dōu qù nǎinai jiā guò, jiā li lái de rén shènzhì bǐ Chūn Jié hái duō.
Before I came to France, every Mid-Autumn we'd go to Grandma's, and even more people came than at Spring Festival.
高
我们坐在院子里一边吃月饼，一边聊天，看看月亮，特别热闹。
Wǒmen zuò zài yuànzi li yì biān chī yuèbǐng, yì biān liáotiān, kànkan yuèliàng, tèbié rènào.
We'd sit in the courtyard eating mooncakes, chatting and looking at the moon. It was so lively.
高
在海外根本感受不到过节的气氛。法国人不过这个节日。
Zài hǎiwài gēnběn gǎnshòu bú dào guòjié de qìfēn. Fǎguórén bú guò zhège jiérì.
Abroad you can't feel the festive atmosphere at all. The French don't celebrate it.
高
但是我每次到了中秋，还是要到中国城去买一盒月饼、几斤葡萄什么的，请几个朋友一起过。
Dànshì wǒ měicì dào le Zhōngqiū, háishi yào dào Zhōngguóchéng qù mǎi yì hé yuèbǐng, jǐ jīn pútao shénme de, qǐng jǐ ge péngyou yìqǐ guò.
But every Mid-Autumn I still go to Chinatown to buy a box of mooncakes and a few jin of grapes, and invite some friends over.
高
不然会觉得那么美的月亮挂在天上，没有人欣赏，实在可惜了。
Bùrán huì juéde nàme měi de yuèliàng guà zài tiān shang, méiyǒu rén xīnshǎng, shízài kěxī le.
Otherwise, with such a beautiful moon hanging in the sky and nobody admiring it, it'd be a real shame.
高

grammar: 或者是为了……，或者是为了……
either to … or to …
Two purposes.
今天，越来越多的中国人走出国门，或者是为了旅游参观，或者是为了学习和考察。
Jīntiān, yuèláiyuè duō de Zhōngguórén zǒu chū guómén, huòzhě shì wèile lǚyóu cānguān, huòzhě shì wèile xuéxí hé kǎochá.
Today more and more Chinese people go abroad, whether as tourists or to study and learn.
或者去北京，或者去上海。
Huòzhě qù Běijīng, huòzhě qù Shànghǎi.
Either Beijing or Shanghai.
为……而奋斗
to strive for …
为 + goal + 而 + V.
就是为了丰富一下我的人生经历，为理想而奋斗嘛。
Jiùshì wèile fēngfù yíxià wǒ de rénshēng jīnglì, wèi lǐxiǎng ér fèndòu ma.
To broaden my life experience and pursue my dreams.
为成功而努力。
Wèi chénggōng ér nǔlì.
Work hard for success.
就该……
ought to …
该 = should.
对，而且我觉得年轻的时候就该多走走，丰富一下自己的经历。
Duì, érqiě wǒ juéde niánqīng de shíhou jiù gāi duō zǒuzou, fēngfù yíxià zìjǐ de jīnglì.
Yes, and I think you should travel while you're young and broaden your experience.
你就该早点睡。
Nǐ jiù gāi zǎo diǎn shuì.
You should go to bed earlier.
除了……，没有……
apart from …, no …
Lists the only options.
我觉得还好，只是觉得在法国早餐太单一。除了牛奶、面包、果酱，你没有太多的选择。
Wǒ juéde háihǎo, zhǐshì juéde zài Fǎguó zǎocān tài dānyī. Chúle niúnǎi, miànbāo, guǒjiàng, nǐ méiyǒu tài duō de xuǎnzé.
It's fine, really. I just find breakfast in France too monotonous. Apart from milk, bread and jam, there's not much choice.
除了他，没人知道。
Chúle tā, méi rén zhīdao.
Nobody knows except him.
自从……以后
ever since …
Marks a starting point.
结果我自从来到法国以后，一共胖了十斤。
Jiéguǒ wǒ zìcóng láidào Fǎguó yǐhòu, yígòng pàng le shí jīn.
As a result, I've put on ten jin since coming to France.
自从搬家以后，他很少来了。
Zìcóng bān jiā yǐhòu, tā hěn shǎo lái le.
He rarely comes since moving.
一边……，一边……
while …
Two actions at once.
我们坐在院子里一边吃月饼，一边聊天，看看月亮，特别热闹。
Wǒmen zuò zài yuànzi li yì biān chī yuèbǐng, yì biān liáotiān, kànkan yuèliàng, tèbié rènào.
We'd sit in the courtyard eating mooncakes, chatting and looking at the moon. It was so lively.
一边走一边说。
Yì biān zǒu yì biān shuō.
Talk while walking.
根本V不到
can't … at all
根本 + negative.
在海外根本感受不到过节的气氛。法国人不过这个节日。
Zài hǎiwài gēnběn gǎnshòu bú dào guòjié de qìfēn. Fǎguórén bú guò zhège jiérì.
Abroad you can't feel the festive atmosphere at all. The French don't celebrate it.
我根本听不到。
Wǒ gēnběn tīng bú dào.
I can't hear at all.
不然……
otherwise …
Gives the consequence.
不然会觉得那么美的月亮挂在天上，没有人欣赏，实在可惜了。
Bùrán huì juéde nàme měi de yuèliàng guà zài tiān shang, méiyǒu rén xīnshǎng, shízài kěxī le.
Otherwise, with such a beautiful moon hanging in the sky and nobody admiring it, it'd be a real shame.
快走，不然要迟到了。
Kuài zǒu, bùrán yào chídào le.
Hurry, or we'll be late.
gaps: 一下我的人生经历，为理想而奋斗嘛。
而且到国外还能够学到
只是觉得在法国早餐太
只是在过节的时候很想家，
在海外根本感受不到过节的
say: Yes, and I think you should travel while you're young and broaden your experience.
Abroad you can't feel the festive atmosphere at all. The French don't celebrate it.

132.title: Foreigners in China
132.sub: Four questions, then a passage on the French and others living in China
132.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the passage. Mary (from Britain) and Laura (from Spain) are both women, so they are 她. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

q: 根据登记记录，二零一四年，在北京生活的法国人有多少？上海呢？
Gēnjù dēngjì jìlù, èr líng yī sì nián, zài Běijīng shēnghuó de Fǎguórén yǒu duōshǎo? Shànghǎi ne?
According to registration records, how many French people lived in Beijing in 2014? And Shanghai?
ans: 北京四千七百九十人，上海一万两千人。
Běijīng sìqiān qībǎi jiǔshí rén, Shànghǎi yíwàn liǎngqiān rén.

q: 在中国生活的法国人大多数集中在哪些城市？请举出三个例子。
Zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó de Fǎguórén dàduōshù jízhōng zài nǎxiē chéngshì? Qǐng jǔ chū sān ge lìzi.
Which cities are most French people in China concentrated in? Give three examples.
ans: 除了北京和上海，还有广州、武汉、成都等一线大城市。
Chúle Běijīng hé Shànghǎi, hái yǒu Guǎngzhōu, Wǔhàn, Chéngdū děng yī xiàn dà chéngshì.
Besides Beijing and Shanghai, big first-tier cities such as Guangzhou, Wuhan and Chengdu.

q: 在中国生活的外国人有哪些群体？
Zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó de wàiguórén yǒu nǎxiē qúntǐ?
What groups of foreigners live in China?
ans: 游客、商人、留学生、外企经理，还有在自己国家找不到合适工作的年轻人。
Yóukè, shāngrén, liúxuéshēng, wàiqǐ jīnglǐ, hái yǒu zài zìjǐ guójiā zhǎo bu dào héshì gōngzuò de niánqīngrén.
Tourists, businesspeople, students, managers of foreign companies, and young people who can't find suitable work in their own countries.

q: 玛丽和罗拉的例子说明了什么？
Mǎlì hé Luólā de lìzi shuōmíng le shénme?
What do the examples of Mary and Laura show?
ans: 说明很多外国年轻人在自己国家找不到工作，来到中国后实现了自己的梦想，生活比以前好得多。
Shuōmíng hěn duō wàiguó niánqīngrén zài zìjǐ guójiā zhǎo bu dào gōngzuò, láidào Zhōngguó hòu shíxiàn le zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng, shēnghuó bǐ yǐqián hǎo de duō.
That many young foreigners who couldn't find work at home have fulfilled their dreams in China and are much better off than before.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 中国与世界。
Zhōngguó yǔ shìjiè.
China and the world.
不仅走出国门的中国人越来越多，在中国的大城市里，外国人也变得越来越常见。
Bùjǐn zǒu chū guómén de Zhōngguórén yuèláiyuè duō, zài Zhōngguó de dà chéngshì li, wàiguórén yě biàn de yuèláiyuè chángjiàn.
Not only are more and more Chinese people going abroad; foreigners are also becoming more and more common in China's big cities.
以法国为例，二零一四年初，登记记录的来北京生活的法国人人数为四千七百九十人，
Yǐ Fǎguó wéi lì, èr líng yī sì nián chū, dēngjì jìlù de lái Běijīng shēnghuó de Fǎguórén rénshù wéi sìqiān qībǎi jiǔshí rén,
Take the French: at the start of 2014, 4,790 French people were registered as living in Beijing,
比二零零四年增加了百分之七十。
bǐ èr líng líng sì nián zēngjiā le bǎi fēn zhī qīshí.
在上海地区生活的法国人人数为一万两千人。
Zài Shànghǎi dìqū shēnghuó de Fǎguórén rénshù wéi yíwàn liǎngqiān rén.
12,000 French people lived in the Shanghai area.
除了北京和上海外，法国人大多集中生活在中国一线大城市：广州、武汉、成都。
Chúle Běijīng hé Shànghǎi wài, Fǎguórén dàduō jízhōng shēnghuó zài Zhōngguó yī xiàn dà chéngshì: Guǎngzhōu, Wǔhàn, Chéngdū.
Apart from Beijing and Shanghai, most French people live in China's big first-tier cities: Guangzhou, Wuhan and Chengdu.
中国的吸引力不仅来自大量的投资机会，
Zhōngguó de xīyǐnlì bùjǐn láizì dàliàng de tóuzī jīhuì,
China's appeal comes not only from its many investment opportunities,
也来自几千年的东方文化以及美丽的自然风景。
yě láizì jǐ qiān nián de dōngfāng wénhuà yǐjí měilì de zìrán fēngjǐng.
but also from its thousands of years of Eastern culture and its beautiful scenery.
中国还代表着世界经济的明天。
Zhōngguó hái dàibiǎozhe shìjiè jīngjì de míngtiān.
China also represents the future of the world economy.
来中国的老外，有游客、商人、留学生，也有外企经理。
Lái Zhōngguó de lǎowài, yǒu yóukè, shāngrén, liúxuéshēng, yě yǒu wàiqǐ jīnglǐ.
Foreigners who come to China include tourists, businesspeople, students and managers of foreign companies.
还有很多年轻人，因为在自己的国家找不到合适的工作，而来到中国，实现自己的梦想。
Hái yǒu hěn duō niánqīngrén, yīnwèi zài zìjǐ de guójiā zhǎo bu dào héshì de gōngzuò, ér láidào Zhōngguó, shíxiàn zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
And many young people, unable to find suitable work in their own countries, come to China to fulfil their dreams.
玛丽就是其中之一。
Mǎlì jiùshì qízhōng zhī yī.
Mary is one of them.
二零零九年，她从英国新闻专业毕业之后，找不到工作。
Èr líng líng jiǔ nián, tā cóng Yīngguó xīnwén zhuānyè bìyè zhīhòu, zhǎo bu dào gōngzuò.
In 2009, after graduating in journalism in Britain, she couldn't find a job.
那年夏天，得到了在北京一家公司实习的机会。
Nà nián xiàtiān, dédào le zài Běijīng yì jiā gōngsī shíxí de jīhuì.
That summer she got an internship at a company in Beijing.
实习结束后，她就被这个公司留下来了。
Shíxí jiéshù hòu, tā jiù bèi zhège gōngsī liú xialai le.
After the internship, the company kept her on.
还有一个西班牙姑娘叫罗拉，今年三十六岁。
Hái yǒu yí ge Xībānyá gūniáng jiào Luólā, jīnnián sānshíliù suì.
There's also a Spanish woman called Laura, who is 36.
她在西班牙工作了六年后失业了。
Tā zài Xībānyá gōngzuò le liù nián hòu shīyè le.
After working in Spain for six years, she lost her job.
去年十月，她来到了北京。
Qùnián shíyuè, tā láidào le Běijīng.
Last October she came to Beijing.
经过了一年的奋斗，罗拉在上海一家公司找到了一份工作。
Jīngguò le yì nián de fèndòu, Luólā zài Shànghǎi yì jiā gōngsī zhǎodào le yí fèn gōngzuò.
After a year of hard work, Laura found a job with a company in Shanghai.
她感到很幸运，因为她不仅找到了工作，
Tā gǎndào hěn xìngyùn, yīnwèi tā bùjǐn zhǎodào le gōngzuò,
She feels very lucky, because she not only found a job
而且得到了一个在西班牙永远也不可能得到的重要职位。
érqiě dédào le yí ge zài Xībānyá yǒngyuǎn yě bù kěnéng dédào de zhòngyào zhíwèi.
but got an important position she could never have got in Spain.
她说，自己目前的生活比起之前在西班牙时要强得多。
Tā shuō, zìjǐ mùqián de shēnghuó bǐqǐ zhīqián zài Xībānyá shí yào qiáng de duō.
She says her life now is much better than it was in Spain.

grammar: not only …, (also) …
Adds a point.
不仅走出国门的中国人越来越多，在中国的大城市里，外国人也变得越来越常见。
Bùjǐn zǒu chū guómén de Zhōngguórén yuèláiyuè duō, zài Zhōngguó de dà chéngshì li, wàiguórén yě biàn de yuèláiyuè chángjiàn.
Not only are more and more Chinese people going abroad; foreigners are also becoming more and more common in China's big cities.
不仅他去，我也去。
Bùjǐn tā qù, wǒ yě qù.
Not only is he going, I am too.
以……为例
to take … as an example
以 A 为 B pattern.
以法国为例，二零一四年初，登记记录的来北京生活的法国人人数为四千七百九十人，
Yǐ Fǎguó wéi lì, èr líng yī sì nián chū, dēngjì jìlù de lái Běijīng shēnghuó de Fǎguórén rénshù wéi sìqiān qībǎi jiǔshí rén,
Take the French: at the start of 2014, 4,790 French people were registered as living in Beijing,
以北京为例，房价很高。
Yǐ Běijīng wéi lì, fángjià hěn gāo.
Take Beijing: housing is expensive.
比……增加了……
increased by … compared with …
Gives a rise.
比二零零四年增加了百分之七十。
bǐ èr líng líng sì nián zēngjiā le bǎi fēn zhī qīshí.
比去年增加了一倍。
Bǐ qùnián zēngjiā le yí bèi.
Doubled compared with last year.
除了……外
apart from …
Excludes something.
除了北京和上海外，法国人大多集中生活在中国一线大城市：广州、武汉、成都。
Chúle Běijīng hé Shànghǎi wài, Fǎguórén dàduō jízhōng shēnghuó zài Zhōngguó yī xiàn dà chéngshì: Guǎngzhōu, Wǔhàn, Chéngdū.
Apart from Beijing and Shanghai, most French people live in China's big first-tier cities: Guangzhou, Wuhan and Chengdu.
除了他外，大家都来了。
Chúle tā wài, dàjiā dōu lái le.
Everyone came except him.
not only …, but also …
Adds a second source.
中国的吸引力不仅来自大量的投资机会，
Zhōngguó de xīyǐnlì bùjǐn láizì dàliàng de tóuzī jīhuì,
China's appeal comes not only from its many investment opportunities,
他不仅聪明，也很努力。
Tā bùjǐn cōngmíng, yě hěn nǔlì.
He's not only clever but hard-working.
because …, (so) …
而 links cause and result.
还有很多年轻人，因为在自己的国家找不到合适的工作，而来到中国，实现自己的梦想。
Hái yǒu hěn duō niánqīngrén, yīnwèi zài zìjǐ de guójiā zhǎo bu dào héshì de gōngzuò, ér láidào Zhōngguó, shíxiàn zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
And many young people, unable to find suitable work in their own countries, come to China to fulfil their dreams.
因为下雨而取消了。
Yīnwèi xià yǔ ér qǔxiāo le.
It was cancelled because of rain.
……之一
one of …
Marks one of a group.
玛丽就是其中之一。
Mǎlì jiùshì qízhōng zhī yī.
Mary is one of them.
他是我的朋友之一。
Tā shì wǒ de péngyou zhī yī.
He's one of my friends.
被……留下来
to be kept on by …
A passive.
实习结束后，她就被这个公司留下来了。
Shíxí jiéshù hòu, tā jiù bèi zhège gōngsī liú xialai le.
After the internship, the company kept her on.
他被老师留下来了。
Tā bèi lǎoshī liú xialai le.
The teacher kept him behind.
比起……要……
compared with …, much more …
A comparison with 要.
她说，自己目前的生活比起之前在西班牙时要强得多。
Tā shuō, zìjǐ mùqián de shēnghuó bǐqǐ zhīqián zài Xībānyá shí yào qiáng de duō.
She says her life now is much better than it was in Spain.
比起去年要好。
Bǐqǐ qùnián yào hǎo.
Better than last year.
gaps: 登记记录的来北京生活的法国人
生活在中国一线大城市
来中国的老外，有游客、商人、留学生，也有
那年夏天，得到了在北京一家公司
她在西班牙工作了六年后
而且得到了一个在西班牙永远也不可能得到的重要
say: China also represents the future of the world economy.

133.title: The Mid-Autumn Festival
133.sub: Four questions, then a short passage on the festival
133.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the passage. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.

q: 中秋节是在每年的哪一天？
Zhōngqiū Jié shì zài měinián de nǎ yì tiān?
What day is the Mid-Autumn Festival each year?
ans: The 15th day of the 8th lunar month.

q: Why is it called the Mid-Autumn Festival?
ans: 因为这时是一年秋季的中期。
Yīnwèi zhè shí shì yì nián qiūjì de zhōngqī.
Because it falls in the middle of autumn.

q: 中国人过中秋节有什么习俗？
Zhōngguórén guò Zhōngqiū Jié yǒu shénme xísú?
What are the customs at Mid-Autumn?
ans: 赏月，吃月饼，全家人团聚。
Shǎng yuè, chī yuèbǐng, quán jiā rén tuánjù.
Admiring the moon, eating mooncakes and getting the family together.

q: 月亮、月饼、家，有什么关系？
Yuèliàng, yuèbǐng, jiā, yǒu shénme guānxi?
How are the moon, mooncakes and family connected?
ans: 它们都是圆的：月亮的圆，月饼的圆，以及家人的团圆。
Tāmen dōu shì yuán de: yuèliàng de yuán, yuèbǐng de yuán, yǐjí jiārén de tuányuán.
They're all round: the round moon, the round mooncake and the family reunion (团圆, "round and together").

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 中秋节。
Zhōngqiū Jié.
The Mid-Autumn Festival.
每年农历八月十五日，是中国第二大传统节日——中秋节。
Měinián nónglì bāyuè shíwǔ rì, shì Zhōngguó dì-èr dà chuántǒng jiérì—— Zhōngqiū Jié.
The 15th day of the 8th lunar month is China's second biggest traditional festival: the Mid-Autumn Festival.
这时是一年秋季的中期，所以被称为中秋。
Zhè shí shì yì nián qiūjì de zhōngqī, suǒyǐ bèi chēngwéi Zhōngqiū.
It's the middle of autumn, so it's called "Mid-Autumn".
中秋节前后，月亮最大、最亮。
Zhōngqiū Jié qiánhòu, yuèliàng zuì dà, zuì liàng.
Around the festival, the moon is at its biggest and brightest.
所以，从古至今，中国人都有赏月和吃月饼的习俗。
Suǒyǐ, cóng gǔ zhì jīn, Zhōngguórén dōu yǒu shǎng yuè hé chī yuèbǐng de xísú.
So, since ancient times, Chinese people have admired the moon and eaten mooncakes.
同时，圆月也代表着团圆，这一天是全家人团聚的日子。
Tóngshí, yuányuè yě dàibiǎozhe tuányuán, zhè yì tiān shì quán jiā rén tuánjù de rìzi.
The full moon also stands for reunion; this is the day when the whole family gets together.
所以有人说，在中国人的心中，中秋这个日子是由月亮、月饼和家组成的。
Suǒyǐ yǒu rén shuō, zài Zhōngguórén de xīnzhōng, Zhōngqiū zhège rìzi shì yóu yuèliàng, yuèbǐng hé jiā zǔchéng de.
So some say that, in Chinese hearts, Mid-Autumn is made up of the moon, mooncakes and family.
中秋就是一个圆，是月亮的圆，月饼的圆，以及家人美好的团圆。
Zhōngqiū jiùshì yí ge yuán, shì yuèliàng de yuán, yuèbǐng de yuán, yǐjí jiārén měihǎo de tuányuán.
Mid-Autumn is a circle: the round moon, the round mooncake, and the happy reunion of the family.

grammar: 被称为……
to be called …
A passive naming structure.
这时是一年秋季的中期，所以被称为中秋。
Zhè shí shì yì nián qiūjì de zhōngqī, suǒyǐ bèi chēngwéi Zhōngqiū.
It's the middle of autumn, so it's called "Mid-Autumn".
他被称为“小老虎”。
Tā bèi chēngwéi "xiǎo lǎohǔ".
He's called "Little Tiger".
从古至今
since ancient times
A fixed phrase.
所以，从古至今，中国人都有赏月和吃月饼的习俗。
Suǒyǐ, cóng gǔ zhì jīn, Zhōngguórén dōu yǒu shǎng yuè hé chī yuèbǐng de xísú.
So, since ancient times, Chinese people have admired the moon and eaten mooncakes.
从古至今都是这样。
Cóng gǔ zhì jīn dōu shì zhèyàng.
It has always been so.
是由……组成的
is made up of …
由 introduces the parts.
所以有人说，在中国人的心中，中秋这个日子是由月亮、月饼和家组成的。
Suǒyǐ yǒu rén shuō, zài Zhōngguórén de xīnzhōng, Zhōngqiū zhège rìzi shì yóu yuèliàng, yuèbǐng hé jiā zǔchéng de.
So some say that, in Chinese hearts, Mid-Autumn is made up of the moon, mooncakes and family.
这个词是由两个字组成的。
Zhège cí shì yóu liǎng ge zì zǔchéng de.
This word is made of two characters.
…, as well as …
Formal "and".
中秋就是一个圆，是月亮的圆，月饼的圆，以及家人美好的团圆。
Zhōngqiū jiùshì yí ge yuán, shì yuèliàng de yuán, yuèbǐng de yuán, yǐjí jiārén měihǎo de tuányuán.
Mid-Autumn is a circle: the round moon, the round mooncake, and the happy reunion of the family.
老师以及学生都来了。
Lǎoshī yǐjí xuésheng dōu lái le.
Teachers and students both came.
say: Mid-Autumn is a circle: the round moon, the round mooncake, and the happy reunion of the family.

134.title: Chang'e flies to the moon
134.sub: Five true-or-false statements, then the Mid-Autumn legend
134.transcriptNote: First the characters and five statements to judge, then the story. Hou Yi (后羿) is the archer hero; Chang'e (嫦娥) is his wife; Peng Meng (逄蒙) is his sly pupil; the Queen Mother of the West (王母娘娘) is a goddess. The recording pronounces 逄蒙 slightly differently each time; I've written the usual form. Turn on Answers for the true-or-false key.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音并判断 · True or false
lines: 听录音，并判断句子的正误。
Tīng lùyīn, bìng pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false.
嫦娥奔月是关于中秋节的一个小故事。
Cháng'é bēn yuè shì guānyú Zhōngqiū Jié de yí ge xiǎo gùshi.
"Chang'e flies to the moon" is a short story about the Mid-Autumn Festival.
请听故事，然后判断下面句子的意思是否正确。
Qǐng tīng gùshi, ránhòu pànduàn xiàmiàn jùzi de yìsi shìfǒu zhèngquè.
Listen to the story, then decide whether the sentences below are correct.

blocks.label: 人物
blocks.h: 故事中的人物 · The characters
lines: 故事中的人物。
Gùshi zhòng de rénwù.
The characters in the story.
后羿：嫦娥的丈夫，力气很大，是个英雄，用弓箭射下了九个太阳。
Hòuyì: Cháng'é de zhàngfū, lìqi hěn dà, shì ge yīngxióng, yòng gōngjiàn shè xia le jiǔ ge tàiyáng.
Hou Yi: Chang'e's husband, very strong, a hero who shot down nine suns with his bow.
逄蒙：后羿的一个学生，很狡猾。
Páng Méng: Hòuyì de yí ge xuésheng, hěn jiǎohuá.
Peng Meng: one of Hou Yi's pupils, very sly.
王母娘娘：天上的女神，奖给了后羿一颗可以变成神仙的药。
Wángmǔ Niángniang: tiān shang de nǚshén, jiǎng gěi le Hòuyì yì kē kěyǐ biànchéng shénxiān de yào.
The Queen Mother: a goddess in heaven who rewarded Hou Yi with a pill that could make him immortal.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 五个句子 · True or false
lines: 请先听五个句子。
Qǐng xiān tīng wǔ ge jùzi.
First listen to five sentences.

q: 后羿射下了十个太阳，救了百姓，人们都很尊敬他。
Hòuyì shè xia le shí ge tàiyáng, jiù le bǎixìng, rénmen dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
Hou Yi shot down ten suns, saved the people, and everyone respected him.
qs.why: He shot down nine of the ten suns.

q: 后羿没有吃药，是因为不想和嫦娥分开。
Hòuyì méiyǒu chī yào, shì yīnwèi bù xiǎng hé Cháng'é fēnkāi.
Hou Yi didn't take the pill because he didn't want to be separated from Chang'e.
qs.why: If he'd taken it, he'd have been parted from his wife for ever.

q: 嫦娥吃了药，是因为不想让逄蒙拿走药。
Cháng'é chī le yào, shì yīnwèi bù xiǎng ràng Páng Méng názǒu yào.
Chang'e took the pill because she didn't want Peng Meng to take it.
qs.why: Peng Meng tried to force her to hand it over.

q: 最后，嫦娥和逄蒙都变成了神仙。
Zuìhòu, Cháng'é hé Páng Méng dōu biànchéng le shénxiān.
In the end, both Chang'e and Peng Meng became immortals.
qs.why: Only Chang'e took the pill and became an immortal.

q: 后羿虽然很生妻子的气，但是很想念她。
Hòuyì suīrán hěn shēng qīzi de qì, dànshì hěn xiǎngniàn tā.
Although Hou Yi was very angry with his wife, he missed her.
qs.why: He wasn't angry; he was heartbroken and missed her.

blocks.label: 故事
lines: 现在请听文章。
Xiànzài qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
嫦娥奔月。
Cháng'é bēn yuè.
Chang'e flies to the moon.
古时候，有一个名叫后羿的英雄。他的力气很大，没有人能比。
Gǔ shíhou, yǒu yí ge míngjiào Hòuyì de yīngxióng. Tā de lìqi hěn dà, méiyǒu rén néng bǐ.
Long ago there was a hero called Hou Yi. He was stronger than anyone.
后羿有个美丽善良的妻子，名叫嫦娥。两个人感情很好，很令人羡慕。
Hòuyì yǒu ge měilì shànliáng de qīzi, míngjiào Cháng'é. Liǎng ge rén gǎnqíng hěn hǎo, hěn lìng rén xiànmù.
Hou Yi had a beautiful, kind wife called Chang'e. They loved each other dearly, and everyone envied them.
有一年，天上出现了十个太阳，热得老百姓无法正常生活。
Yǒu yì nián, tiān shang chūxiàn le shí ge tàiyáng, rè de lǎobǎixìng wúfǎ zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
One year, ten suns appeared in the sky, and it was so hot that ordinary people couldn't live normally.
后羿登上山顶，拉弓射下了九个太阳。
Hòuyì dēngshàng shāndǐng, lā gōng shè xia le jiǔ ge tàiyáng.
Hou Yi climbed to a mountain top, drew his bow and shot down nine suns.
后羿救了百姓，成了百姓心中的大英雄，得到了大家的尊敬。
Hòuyì jiù le bǎixìng, chéng le bǎixìng xīnzhōng de dà yīngxióng, dédào le dàjiā de zūnjìng.
Hou Yi saved the people, became a great hero in their hearts, and won everyone's respect.
全国各地跑来了不少人，想请他当自己的师傅，和他学本事。
Quánguó gèdì pǎo lái le bù shǎo rén, xiǎng qǐng tā dāng zìjǐ de shīfu, hé tā xué běnshi.
Many people came from all over the land, wanting him to be their master and teach them his skills.
其中，有一个十分狡猾的人，逄蒙，也来到了他家。
Qízhōng, yǒu yí ge shífēn jiǎohuá de rén, Páng Méng, yě láidào le tā jiā.
Among them was a very sly man, Peng Meng, who also came to his home.
后羿射下了九个太阳，天上的王母娘娘很欣赏他，奖给了他一颗能变成神仙的药。
Hòuyì shè xia le jiǔ ge tàiyáng, tiān shang de Wángmǔ Niángniang hěn xīnshǎng tā, jiǎng gěi le tā yì kē néng biànchéng shénxiān de yào.
Because Hou Yi shot down nine suns, the Queen Mother in heaven admired him and rewarded him with a pill that would make him immortal.
王母娘娘告诉他，只要吃了药，他就能飞到天上，变成神仙。
Wángmǔ Niángniang gàosu tā, zhǐyào chī le yào, tā jiù néng fēi dào tiān shang, biànchéng shénxiān.
The Queen Mother told him that if he took it, he'd fly up to heaven and become an immortal.
可惜，药只有一颗。如果后羿吃了，他就会和妻子永远分开了。
Kěxī, yào zhǐyǒu yì kē. Rúguǒ Hòuyì chī le, tā jiù huì hé qīzi yǒngyuǎn fēnkāi le.
Unfortunately there was only one pill. If Hou Yi took it, he'd be parted from his wife for ever.
后羿舍不得嫦娥，没有马上吃药，于是把药先交给嫦娥保管。
Hòuyì shěbude Cháng'é, méiyǒu mǎshàng chī yào, yúshì bǎ yào xiān jiāo gěi Cháng'é bǎoguǎn.
Hou Yi couldn't bear to leave Chang'e, so he didn't take it straight away; he gave it to Chang'e to keep safe.
一天，后羿出门了。
Yì tiān, Hòuyì chūmén le.
One day, Hou Yi went out.
他的学生，狡猾的逄蒙，趁这个机会闯了进来，逼嫦娥交出药。
Tā de xuésheng, jiǎohuá de Páng Méng, chèn zhège jīhuì chuǎng le jinlai, bī Cháng'é jiāochū yào.
His pupil, the sly Peng Meng, took the chance to burst in and force Chang'e to hand over the pill.
嫦娥没有办法，只好自己吞下了药。
Cháng'é méiyǒu bànfǎ, zhǐhǎo zìjǐ tūn xia le yào.
Chang'e had no choice but to swallow the pill herself.
吃了药后，嫦娥马上飞上了天。
Chī le yào hòu, Cháng'é mǎshàng fēi shàng le tiān.
As soon as she'd taken it, Chang'e flew up into the sky.
由于嫦娥想着丈夫，不想离他太远，
Yóuyú Cháng'é xiǎngzhe zhàngfū, bù xiǎng lí tā tài yuǎn,
Because she was thinking of her husband and didn't want to be too far from him,
所以就跳上了一朵云，飞到了离地球最近的月亮上。
suǒyǐ jiù tiào shàng le yì duǒ yún, fēi dào le lí dìqiú zuìjìn de yuèliàng shàng.
she jumped onto a cloud and flew to the moon, the place closest to the earth.
后羿回来后，知道了事情的经过，十分伤心。
Hòuyì huílai hòu, zhīdao le shìqing de jīngguò, shífēn shāngxīn.
When Hou Yi came back and learned what had happened, he was heartbroken.
他抬头冲着天，喊嫦娥的名字。
Tā táitóu chòngzhe tiān, hǎn Cháng'é de míngzì.
He looked up at the sky and called Chang'e's name.
此时，他忽然发现，天上的月亮特别圆，特别亮，而且有个影子在动，很像嫦娥。
Cǐshí, tā hūrán fāxiàn, tiān shang de yuèliàng tèbié yuán, tèbié liàng, érqiě yǒu ge yǐngzi zài dòng, hěn xiàng Cháng'é.
Just then he noticed that the moon was especially round and bright, and there was a shadow moving on it that looked just like Chang'e.
他擦去脸上的眼泪，赶紧派人到花园里，摆上桌子，放上一大篮嫦娥最爱吃的水果，
Tā cā qù liǎn shàng de yǎnlèi, gǎnjǐn pài rén dào huāyuán li, bǎi shàng zhuōzi, fàng shàng yí dà lán Cháng'é zuì ài chī de shuǐguǒ,
He wiped away his tears and quickly sent people to the garden to set out a table with a big basket of Chang'e's favourite fruit,
用这种方式来表示自己对嫦娥的爱和思念。
yòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái biǎoshì zìjǐ duì Cháng'é de ài hé sīniàn.
as a way of showing his love and longing for her.

grammar: 名叫……
named …
Introduces a name.
古时候，有一个名叫后羿的英雄。他的力气很大，没有人能比。
Gǔ shíhou, yǒu yí ge míngjiào Hòuyì de yīngxióng. Tā de lìqi hěn dà, méiyǒu rén néng bǐ.
Long ago there was a hero called Hou Yi. He was stronger than anyone.
他有个朋友名叫小王。
Tā yǒu ge péngyou míngjiào xiǎo wáng.
He has a friend called Xiao Wang.
令人 + adj
to make people …
Formal 让人.
后羿有个美丽善良的妻子，名叫嫦娥。两个人感情很好，很令人羡慕。
Hòuyì yǒu ge měilì shànliáng de qīzi, míngjiào Cháng'é. Liǎng ge rén gǎnqíng hěn hǎo, hěn lìng rén xiànmù.
Hou Yi had a beautiful, kind wife called Chang'e. They loved each other dearly, and everyone envied them.
这个消息令人高兴。
Zhège xiāoxī lìng rén gāoxìng.
This news makes people happy.
adj + 得 + result
so … that …
The degree complement shows the result.
有一年，天上出现了十个太阳，热得老百姓无法正常生活。
Yǒu yì nián, tiān shang chūxiàn le shí ge tàiyáng, rè de lǎobǎixìng wúfǎ zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
One year, ten suns appeared in the sky, and it was so hot that ordinary people couldn't live normally.
冷得睡不着。
Lěng de shuì bu zháo.
So cold you can't sleep.
as long as …, …
A sufficient condition.
王母娘娘告诉他，只要吃了药，他就能飞到天上，变成神仙。
Wángmǔ Niángniang gàosu tā, zhǐyào chī le yào, tā jiù néng fēi dào tiān shang, biànchéng shénxiān.
The Queen Mother told him that if he took it, he'd fly up to heaven and become an immortal.
只要努力，就能成功。
Zhǐyào nǔlì, jiù néng chénggōng.
As long as you work hard, you'll succeed.
于是……
so, thereupon
Introduces the result.
后羿舍不得嫦娥，没有马上吃药，于是把药先交给嫦娥保管。
Hòuyì shěbude Cháng'é, méiyǒu mǎshàng chī yào, yúshì bǎ yào xiān jiāo gěi Cháng'é bǎoguǎn.
Hou Yi couldn't bear to leave Chang'e, so he didn't take it straight away; he gave it to Chang'e to keep safe.
天黑了，于是我们回家了。
Tiān hēi le, yúshì wǒmen huí jiā le.
It got dark, so we went home.
趁……机会
to take the chance to …
趁 = while conditions allow.
他的学生，狡猾的逄蒙，趁这个机会闯了进来，逼嫦娥交出药。
Tā de xuésheng, jiǎohuá de Páng Méng, chèn zhège jīhuì chuǎng le jinlai, bī Cháng'é jiāochū yào.
His pupil, the sly Peng Meng, took the chance to burst in and force Chang'e to hand over the pill.
趁年轻多学习。
Chèn niánqīng duō xuéxí.
Study while you're young.
只好……
had no choice but to …
The only option left.
嫦娥没有办法，只好自己吞下了药。
Cháng'é méiyǒu bànfǎ, zhǐhǎo zìjǐ tūn xia le yào.
Chang'e had no choice but to swallow the pill herself.
下雨了，只好在家。
Xià yǔ le, zhǐhǎo zài jiā.
It rained, so we had to stay in.
由于……，所以……
because …, so …
Formal cause and effect.
由于嫦娥想着丈夫，不想离他太远，
Yóuyú Cháng'é xiǎngzhe zhàngfū, bù xiǎng lí tā tài yuǎn,
Because she was thinking of her husband and didn't want to be too far from him,
由于太累，所以早睡了。
Yóuyú tài lèi, suǒyǐ zǎo shuì le.
Too tired, so went to bed early.
用这种方式来……
to … in this way
来 links means and purpose.
用这种方式来表示自己对嫦娥的爱和思念。
yòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái biǎoshì zìjǐ duì Cháng'é de ài hé sīniàn.
as a way of showing his love and longing for her.
用这种方式来学习。
Yòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái xuéxí.
Study this way.
gaps: 两个人感情很好，很令人
嫦娥没有办法，只好自己
say: Long ago there was a hero called Hou Yi. He was stronger than anyone.

135.title: Chinese values
135.sub: Eight behaviours and attitudes: traditionally Chinese or not?
135.transcriptNote: Decide whether each behaviour or attitude fits traditional Chinese habits or values, then turn on Answers. The answers are my own judgement, based on the lesson texts. Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听力课后练习 · After-class listening
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
判断所听到的行为是否符合中国人的生活习惯或价值观。
Pànduàn suǒ tīngdào de xíngwéi shìfǒu fúhé Zhōngguórén de shēnghuó xíguàn huò jiàzhíguān.
Decide whether each behaviour you hear fits Chinese habits or values.

q: 谦虚好学，为实现理想而付出一切。
Qiānxū hàoxué, wèi shíxiàn lǐxiǎng ér fùchū yíqiè.
Modest and eager to learn; giving everything to achieve one's dream.
qs.why: Modesty and love of learning are traditional virtues.

q: Bù jié hūn ér shēngyǎng háizi.
Having and raising children without marrying.
qs.why: Traditionally, marriage comes before children.

q: Lǐ shàng wǎng lái, xǐhuan rènào.
qs.why: Reciprocity and lively family gatherings are typical.

q: 羡慕事业有成的人，希望自己的孩子能成龙成凤。
Xiànmù shìyè yǒu chéng de rén, xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi néng chéng lóng chéng fèng.
Admiring successful people; hoping one's children will become high-flyers.
qs.why: As in 望子成龙, parents hope their children will succeed.

q: 孝敬、节俭、尊敬长辈、重视家庭。
Xiàojìng, jiéjiǎn, zūnjìng zhǎngbèi, zhòngshì jiātíng.
Filial piety, thrift, respect for elders, valuing the family.
qs.why: These are core traditional values.
Traditionally, family hierarchy and duty come before individual freedom.

q: Zǎn qián mǎi fáng, yǎng ér fáng lǎo.
Saving to buy a home; raising children to support you in old age.
qs.why: Both are typical traditional priorities.

q: 享受人生，挣钱是为了消费。
Xiǎngshòu rénshēng, zhèngqián shì wèile xiāofèi.
Enjoying life; earning money in order to spend it.
qs.why: The traditional value is thrift, as in the lesson 4 texts.

vocab: to raise children for support in old age
grammar: to … for the sake of …
为 + goal + 而 + V.
谦虚好学，为实现理想而付出一切。
Qiānxū hàoxué, wèi shíxiàn lǐxiǎng ér fùchū yíqiè.
Modest and eager to learn; giving everything to achieve one's dream.
为家庭而工作。
Wèi jiātíng ér gōngzuò.
Work for the family.
to … without …
而 links a contrast.
不结婚而生养孩子。
Bù jié hūn ér shēngyǎng háizi.
Having and raising children without marrying.
不劳而获。
Bùláo'érhuò.
To gain without working.
希望……能……
to hope … can …
能 adds possibility.
羡慕事业有成的人，希望自己的孩子能成龙成凤。
Xiànmù shìyè yǒu chéng de rén, xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi néng chéng lóng chéng fèng.
Admiring successful people; hoping one's children will become high-flyers.
希望你能来。
Xīwàng nǐ néng lái.
I hope you can come.
……是为了……
… is in order to …
Gives a purpose.
享受人生，挣钱是为了消费。
Xiǎngshòu rénshēng, zhèngqián shì wèile xiāofèi.
Enjoying life; earning money in order to spend it.
学习是为了工作。
Xuéxí shì wèile gōngzuò.
Studying is for work.
gaps: 好学，为实现理想而付出一切。

136.title: Copy the tone of voice
136.sub: Ten short lines about life abroad, festivals and feelings
136.transcriptNote: Pre-speaking practice: listen to each line and copy the speaker's tone: worried, teasing, excited, alarmed, hurt. Item 5 is the famous closing couplet of Li Bai's Tang poem 静夜思 ("Quiet Night Thoughts"): "I raise my head and gaze at the bright moon; I lower it and think of home." Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 口语课前练习 · Pre-speaking practice
lines: 口语课前练习。
Kǒuyǔ kè qián liànxí.
Pre-speaking exercises.
听句子并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng jùzi bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the sentences and copy the speakers' tone.
圆圆，一个人在国外要小心呀，要好好照顾自己，注意安全。
Yuányuan, yí ge rén zài guówài yào xiǎoxīn ya, yào hǎohǎo zhàogù zìjǐ, zhùyì ānquán.

天天吃面条啊？你吃的也太单一了吧。

遇到危险时要大喊：救命啊，救命啊，快来人呐！
Yùdào wēixiǎn shí yào dàhǎn: jiùmìng a, jiùmìng a, kuài lái rén na!
When you're in danger, shout: Help! Help! Somebody come quick!
牛奶和茶我都不喝，你就给我来点热水就行了。
Niúnǎi hé chá wǒ dōu bù hē, nǐ jiù gěi wǒ lái diǎn rèshuǐ jiù xíng le.

对他这么好，他却这样骗我，太伤人心了。
Duì tā zhème hǎo, tā què zhèyàng piàn wǒ, tài shāng rén xīn le.
I've been so good to him, and he lies to me like this. It's so hurtful.
别总是冲着孩子喊，能不能小点声说话？你看把孩子都吓坏了。
Bié zǒngshì chòngzhe háizi hǎn, néng bù néng xiǎo diǎn shēng shuōhuà? Nǐ kàn bǎ háizi dōu xià huài le.

137.title: Chang'e and Peng Meng
137.sub: A dialogue based on the legend: the sly pupil demands the pill
137.transcriptNote: Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone. 嫦 is Chang'e and 逄 is Peng Meng; the other lines are narration. The recording pronounces 逄蒙 slightly differently each time; I've written the usual form.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听对话并模仿 · Listen and imitate

Tīng duìhuà bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone.

Xiàmiàn shì gēnjù Cháng'é bēn yuè de gùshi gǎibiān de yí duàn duìhuà.

Listen, then copy the speakers' tone.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 一天后羿不在家，逄蒙来找嫦娥。
Yì tiān Hòuyì bú zài jiā, Páng Méng lái zhǎo Cháng'é.
One day when Hou Yi was out, Peng Meng came to see Chang'e.
嫦娥觉得很奇怪，说道：
Cháng'é juéde hěn qíguài, shuōdào:
Chang'e thought it strange and said:
你师傅不在家，你来有什么事吗？
Nǐ shīfu bú zài jiā, nǐ lái yǒu shénme shì ma?
Your master isn't home. What do you want?
嫦
嫦娥啊，我知道后羿的成仙药是你在保管。你快把成仙药给我交出来。
Cháng'é a, wǒ zhīdao Hòuyì de chéngxiān yào shì nǐ zài bǎoguǎn. Nǐ kuài bǎ chéngxiān yào gěi wǒ jiāo chulai.
Chang'e, I know you're keeping Hou Yi's immortality pill. Hand it over, quick.
逄
嫦娥没想到逄蒙是个这么狡猾的人，感到非常生气。
Cháng'é méi xiǎngdào Páng Méng shì ge zhème jiǎohuá de rén, gǎndào fēicháng shēngqì.
Chang'e hadn't realised Peng Meng was so sly, and she was furious.
逄蒙！你师傅对你这么好，你怎么敢做出这种事情？你对得起师傅吗？
Páng Méng! Nǐ shīfu duì nǐ zhème hǎo, nǐ zěnme gǎn zuòchū zhè zhǒng shìqing? Nǐ duì de qǐ shīfu ma?
Peng Meng! Your master's been so good to you. How dare you do this? Is this how you repay him?
嫦
哈哈，你以为我真的想当他的学生吗？我是为了药才来的。
Hāhā, nǐ yǐwéi wǒ zhēn de xiǎng dāng tā de xuésheng ma? Wǒ shì wèile yào cái lái de.
Ha ha, do you think I really wanted to be his pupil? I only came for the pill.
逄
你快乖乖地把药拿来，不然我……
Nǐ kuài guāiguāi de bǎ yào nálái, bùrán wǒ……
Be a good girl and bring me the pill, or else I'll...
逄
逄蒙一边说，一边拿出了一把刀冲着嫦娥。
Páng Méng yì biān shuō, yì biān ná chū le yì bǎ dāo chòngzhe Cháng'é.
As he spoke, Peng Meng pulled out a knife and pointed it at Chang'e.
嫦娥非常聪明，骗逄蒙说：
Cháng'é fēicháng cōngmíng, piàn Páng Méng shuō:
Chang'e was very clever, and tricked him:
那好，你等我一下，我马上去给你拿药。
Nà hǎo, nǐ děng wǒ yíxià, wǒ mǎshàng qù gěi nǐ ná yào.
All right, wait a moment. I'll go and get it for you.
嫦
说完，嫦娥赶紧来到自己的房间，把药拿到了逄蒙面前。
Shuō wán, Cháng'é gǎnjǐn láidào zìjǐ de fángjiān, bǎ yào nádào le Páng Méng miànqián.
With that, Chang'e hurried to her room and brought the pill out in front of Peng Meng.
逄蒙非常高兴，刚想去接，嫦娥却说：
Páng Méng fēicháng gāoxìng, gāng xiǎng qù jiē, Cháng'é què shuō:
Peng Meng was delighted, but just as he reached for it, Chang'e said:
逄蒙，你别做梦了，我是不会给你药的。
Páng Méng, nǐ bié zuò mèng le, wǒ shì bú huì gěi nǐ yào de.
Peng Meng, dream on. I'm not giving you the pill.
嫦
嫦娥皱着眉头，一下子把药吞了下去。
Cháng'é zhòuzhe méitóu, yíxiàzi bǎ yào tūn le xiaqu.
Frowning, Chang'e swallowed the pill in one gulp.
逄蒙很惊讶，冲着嫦娥大喊：
Páng Méng hěn jīngyà, chòngzhe Cháng'é dàhǎn:
Peng Meng was stunned and shouted at Chang'e:
嫦娥！你快把药吐出来！药是我的，是我的！
Cháng'é! Nǐ kuài bǎ yào tǔ chulai! Yào shì wǒ de, shì wǒ de!
Chang'e! Spit it out! The pill is mine, it's mine!
逄
逄蒙伸手去抓嫦娥，嫦娥却慢慢地飞向了天空。
Páng Méng shēnshǒu qù zhuā Cháng'é, Cháng'é què mànmàn de fēi xiàng le tiānkōng.
Peng Meng reached out to grab her, but Chang'e slowly floated up into the sky.

grammar: 根据……改编
adapted from …
根据 = based on.
下面是根据嫦娥奔月的故事改编的一段对话。
Xiàmiàn shì gēnjù Cháng'é bēn yuè de gùshi gǎibiān de yí duàn duìhuà.
Here is a dialogue adapted from the story of Chang'e flying to the moon.
这部电影是根据小说改编的。
Zhè bù diànyǐng shì gēnjù xiǎoshuō gǎibiān de.
The film is adapted from a novel.
把……给我交出来
hand … over to me
给我 strengthens a command.
嫦娥啊，我知道后羿的成仙药是你在保管。你快把成仙药给我交出来。
Cháng'é a, wǒ zhīdao Hòuyì de chéngxiān yào shì nǐ zài bǎoguǎn. Nǐ kuài bǎ chéngxiān yào gěi wǒ jiāo chulai.
Chang'e, I know you're keeping Hou Yi's immortality pill. Hand it over, quick.
把钱给我拿出来！
Bǎ qián gěi wǒ ná chulai!
Hand over the money!
你怎么敢……
how dare you …
A furious challenge.
逄蒙！你师傅对你这么好，你怎么敢做出这种事情？你对得起师傅吗？
Páng Méng! Nǐ shīfu duì nǐ zhème hǎo, nǐ zěnme gǎn zuòchū zhè zhǒng shìqing? Nǐ duì de qǐ shīfu ma?
Peng Meng! Your master's been so good to you. How dare you do this? Is this how you repay him?
你怎么敢骗我？
Nǐ zěnme gǎn piàn wǒ?
How dare you lie to me?
你对得起……吗？
is this how you repay …?
Rhetorical reproach.
逄蒙！你师傅对你这么好，你怎么敢做出这种事情？你对得起师傅吗？
Páng Méng! Nǐ shīfu duì nǐ zhème hǎo, nǐ zěnme gǎn zuòchū zhè zhǒng shìqing? Nǐ duì de qǐ shīfu ma?
Peng Meng! Your master's been so good to you. How dare you do this? Is this how you repay him?
你对得起父母吗？
Nǐ duì de qǐ fùmǔ ma?
Is this how you treat your parents?
是为了……才……
only because of …
才 emphasises the reason.
哈哈，你以为我真的想当他的学生吗？我是为了药才来的。
Hāhā, nǐ yǐwéi wǒ zhēn de xiǎng dāng tā de xuésheng ma? Wǒ shì wèile yào cái lái de.
Ha ha, do you think I really wanted to be his pupil? I only came for the pill.
他是为了你才来的。
Tā shì wèile nǐ cái lái de.
He only came because of you.
just as … was about to …, …
An interrupted action.
逄蒙非常高兴，刚想去接，嫦娥却说：
Páng Méng fēicháng gāoxìng, gāng xiǎng qù jiē, Cháng'é què shuō:
Peng Meng was delighted, but just as he reached for it, Chang'e said:
我刚想走，他却来了。
Wǒ gāng xiǎng zǒu, tā què lái le.
Just as I was about to leave, he turned up.
一下子
all at once
A sudden action.
嫦娥皱着眉头，一下子把药吞了下去。
Cháng'é zhòuzhe méitóu, yíxiàzi bǎ yào tūn le xiaqu.
Frowning, Chang'e swallowed the pill in one gulp.
他一下子就明白了。
Tā yíxiàzi jiù míngbai le.
He understood at once.
gaps: 我知道后羿的成仙药是你在
嫦娥没想到逄蒙是个这么
着眉头，一下子把药吞了下去。

138.title: From the study-abroad craze to the emigration wave
138.sub: Lesson 9 reading: why Chinese people go abroad, and why some come back
138.transcriptNote: The first lesson 9 reading. 海归 ("sea turtle", a pun on 海龟) means a returnee from abroad. 好山好水好寂寞，好脏好乱好快活 is a joke rhyme: "abroad: nice mountains, nice water, so lonely; at home: dirty, chaotic, but so much fun".

blocks.label: 课文
blocks.h: 从出国热到移民潮 · The text
lines: 从出国热到移民潮
Cóng chūguó rè dào yímín cháo
From the study-abroad craze to the emigration wave
随着中国经济的高速发展，中国跟世界的距离正在缩小。
Suízhe Zhōngguó jīngjì de gāosù fāzhǎn, Zhōngguó gēn shìjiè de jùlí zhèngzài suōxiǎo.
As China's economy grows rapidly, the distance between China and the world is shrinking.
今天，越来越多的中国人走出国门，选择短期或长期在国外居住。
Jīntiān, yuèláiyuè duō de Zhōngguórén zǒu chū guómén, xuǎnzé duǎnqī huò chángqī zài guówài jūzhù.
Today more and more Chinese people are going abroad and choosing to live there for short or long periods.

blocks.label: 出国热
lines: 八十年代出国的基本上是公派留学生。
Bāshí niándài chū guó de jīběn shang shì gōngpài liúxuéshēng.
In the 1980s, those going abroad were basically state-sponsored students.
他们人数有限，学习非常努力，
Tāmen rénshù yǒuxiàn, xuéxí fēicháng nǔlì,
There were few of them and they studied very hard;
目标就是学好本事，把先进的知识和技术带回去，为中国的发展做贡献。
mùbiāo jiùshì xué hǎo běnshi, bǎ xiānjìn de zhīshí hé jìshù dài huíqu, wèi Zhōngguó de fāzhǎn zuò gòngxiàn.
their goal was to master skills and bring advanced knowledge and technology home to contribute to China's development.
从一九八五年起，中国政府取消了对自费留学的限制，自费学生渐渐增多。
Cóng yī jiǔ bā wǔ nián qǐ, Zhōngguó zhèngfǔ qǔxiāo le duì zìfèi liú xué de xiànzhì, zìfèi xuésheng jiànjiàn zēngduō.
From 1985 the government lifted restrictions on self-funded study abroad, and the number of self-funded students gradually grew.
到了九十年代，终于掀起了出国热。
Dào le jiǔshí niándài, zhōngyú xiānqǐ le chūguó rè.
By the 1990s, a craze for going abroad had finally taken off.
许多人去海外留学、考察、探亲或打工。这种情况一直持续到今天。
Xǔduō rén qù hǎiwài liú xué, kǎochá, tànqīn huò dǎ gōng. Zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng yìzhí chíxù dào jīntiān.
Many people went abroad to study, on study visits, to visit relatives or to work. This has continued to this day.
九十年代的留学生大多数已经在中国接受过高等教育，至少已经念完了本科。
Jiǔshí niándài de liúxuéshēng dàduōshù yǐjīng zài Zhōngguó jiēshòu guo gāoděng jiàoyù, zhìshǎo yǐjīng niàn wán le běnkē.
Most students who went abroad in the 1990s had already had higher education in China, at least a bachelor's degree.
而今天，未成年的小留学生越来越多。
Ér jīntiān, wèichéngnián de xiǎo liúxuéshēng yuèláiyuè duō.
But today there are more and more under-age overseas students.
一些父母觉得送孩子出国，一来可以让他掌握一门外语，摆脱国内糟糕的外语学习环境，
Yìxiē fùmǔ juéde sòng háizi chū guó, yì lái kěyǐ ràng tā zhǎngwò yì mén wàiyǔ, bǎituō guónèi zāogāo de wàiyǔ xuéxí huánjìng,
Some parents feel that sending a child abroad, firstly, lets them master a foreign language and escape poor language-learning conditions at home;
二来可以锻炼一下孩子独立生活的能力，
èr lái kěyǐ duànliàn yíxià háizi dúlì shēnghuó de nénglì,
secondly, helps the child learn to live independently;
三来拿着外国的文凭相对好找工作，
sān lái názhe wàiguó de wénpíng xiāngduì hǎo zhǎo gōngzuò,
thirdly, a foreign diploma makes it relatively easier to find a job;
四来外国的环境和食品更让人放心。
sì lái wàiguó de huánjìng hé shípǐn gèng ràng rén fàngxīn.
and fourthly, the environment and food abroad are more reassuring.

blocks.label: 移民潮
lines: 出国热还没过去，移民又成了热门话题。
Chūguó rè hái méi guòqu, yímín yòu chéng le rèmén huàtí.
The study-abroad craze isn't over yet, and emigration has become a hot topic.
许多人希望通过留学、工作、投资等方式移民到国外。
Xǔduō rén xīwàng tōngguò liú xué, gōngzuò, tóuzī děng fāngshì yímín dào guówài.
Many people hope to emigrate through study, work, investment and so on.
由于在中国双重国籍不被政府允许，移民意味着要放弃中国国籍。
Yóuyú zài Zhōngguó shuāngchóng guójí bú bèi zhèngfǔ yǔnxǔ, yímín yìwèizhe yào fàngqì Zhōngguó guójí.
Because the Chinese government doesn't allow dual nationality, emigrating means giving up Chinese nationality.
这种选择对一部分人有些痛苦。
Zhè zhǒng xuǎnzé duì yí bùfen rén yǒuxiē tòngkǔ.
For some people this choice is rather painful.
对他们来说，移民主要是为了下一代。
Duì tāmen lái shuō, yímín zhǔyào shì wèile xiàyídài.
For them, emigrating is mainly for the next generation.
他们希望子女有更好的生活环境，接受更好的教育，不用承受那么沉重的学业负担。
Tāmen xīwàng zǐnǚ yǒu gèng hǎo de shēnghuó huánjìng, jiēshòu gèng hǎo de jiàoyù, búyòng chéngshòu nàme chénzhòng de xuéyè fùdān.
They want their children to have a better environment and education, without such a heavy academic burden.
选择技术移民的人，往往在国内拥有高学历和一定的社会地位，
Xuǎnzé jìshù yímín de rén, wǎngwǎng zài guónèi yōngyǒu gāo xuélì hé yídìng de shèhuì dìwèi,
People who emigrate as skilled workers often have high qualifications and some social standing at home,
但在新的国家不一定能很快找到与自己的专业相符的工作。
dàn zài xīn de guójiā bù yídìng néng hěn kuài zhǎodào yǔ zìjǐ de zhuānyè xiāngfú de gōngzuò.
but in their new country may not quickly find work that matches their field.
他们要承受相当大的精神压力以及社会地位的变化。
Tāmen yào chéngshòu xiāngdāng dà de jīngshén yālì yǐjí shèhuì dìwèi de biànhuà.
They have to bear considerable stress and a change in social status.
但他们觉得，为了让子女有更好的未来，自己吃一点苦是值得的。
Dàn tāmen juéde, wèile ràng zǐnǚ yǒu gèng hǎo de wèilái, zìjǐ chī yìdiǎn kǔ shì zhíde de.
But they feel that for their children's better future, a little hardship is worth it.
牺牲我一人，幸福后来人。
Xīshēng wǒ yì rén, xìngfú hòulái rén.
Sacrifice myself, and bring happiness to those who come after.
还有一部分人选择移民是为了自己有更好的生活或前途，实现自己的人生理想。
Hái yǒu yí bùfen rén xuǎnzé yímín shì wèile zìjǐ yǒu gèng hǎo de shēnghuó huò qiántú, shíxiàn zìjǐ de rénshēng lǐxiǎng.
Others emigrate for a better life or future for themselves, to realise their own dreams.
他们觉得国外的生活成本没那么高，竞争压力相对小，生活节奏相对慢，
Tāmen juéde guówài de shēnghuó chéngběn méi nàme gāo, jìngzhēng yālì xiāngduì xiǎo, shēnghuó jiézòu xiāngduì màn,
They feel that abroad the cost of living isn't so high, competition is less fierce and life is slower,
医疗保险和社会福利制度更完善，生活质量更好。
yīliáo bǎoxiǎn hé shèhuì fúlì zhìdù gèng wánshàn, shēnghuó zhìliàng gèng hǎo.
health insurance and social welfare are better, and quality of life is higher.
今天，中国的经济实力越来越强，中国游客的购买力也越来越强大。
Jīntiān, Zhōngguó de jīngjì shílì yuèláiyuè qiáng, Zhōngguó yóukè de gòumǎilì yě yuèláiyuè qiángdà.
Today China's economic strength keeps growing, and so does Chinese tourists' purchasing power.
但现在对中国护照免签的国家还不多。
Dàn xiànzài duì Zhōngguó hùzhào miǎnqiān de guójiā hái bù duō.
But few countries yet offer visa-free entry to Chinese passport holders.
中国人去海外出差、旅行、购物时，需要花费大量的时间、精力和金钱申请签证。
Zhōngguórén qù hǎiwài chūchāi, lǚxíng, gòuwù shí, xūyào huāfèi dàliàng de shíjiān, jīnglì hé jīnqián shēnqǐng qiānzhèng.
When Chinese people go abroad on business, to travel or to shop, they spend a lot of time, energy and money applying for visas.
这也促使一些人产生了改变国籍的想法。
Zhè yě cùshǐ yìxiē rén chǎnshēng le gǎibiàn guójí de xiǎngfǎ.
This has also led some people to think of changing nationality.

blocks.label: 海外华人
lines: 据统计，全球现有海外华人约五千万，法国估计有六十多万。
Jù tǒngjì, quánqiú xiànyǒu hǎiwài huárén yuē wǔqiān wàn, Fǎguó gūjì yǒu liùshí duō wàn.
According to statistics, there are about 50 million overseas Chinese worldwide, and an estimated 600,000-plus in France.
他们当中有的事业很成功，有的还在努力奋斗，也有的一事无成。
Tāmen dāngzhōng yǒu de shìyè hěn chénggōng, yǒu de hái zài nǔlì fèndòu, yě yǒu de yí shì wú chéng.
Some of them are very successful, some are still struggling, and some have achieved nothing.
在国外奋斗的人，多数都有一段血泪史。
Zài guówài fèndòu de rén, duōshù dōu yǒu yí duàn xuèlèishǐ.
Most people who struggle abroad have a story of blood and tears.
在国外生活，要融入当地人的生活并不那么容易。
Zài guówài shēnghuó, yào róngrù dāngdì rén de shēnghuó bìng bú nàme róngyì.
Living abroad, fitting into local life isn't that easy.
除了语言问题，还有文化、观念、生活习惯、朋友圈等方面的问题。
Chúle yǔyán wèntí, hái yǒu wénhuà, guānniàn, shēnghuó xíguàn, péngyouquān děng fāngmiàn de wèntí.
Besides language, there are problems of culture, attitudes, habits, social circles and so on.
那种因为远离家乡而引起的孤独感、寂寞感和焦虑感，多数人都会有，
Nà zhǒng yīnwèi yuǎnlí jiāxiāng ér yǐnqǐ de gūdú gǎn, jìmò gǎn hé jiāolǜ gǎn, duōshù rén dōu huì yǒu,
Most people feel the loneliness, isolation and anxiety that come from being far from home;
只不过程度高低不同罢了。
zhǐbùguò chéngdù gāodī bùtóng bàle.
it's just a matter of degree.
如果问他们国内和国外的生活哪个更好，许多人会幽默地回答：
Rúguǒ wèn tāmen guónèi hé guówài de shēnghuó nǎge gèng hǎo, xǔduō rén huì yōumò de huídá:
If you ask them which is better, life at home or abroad, many answer with humour:
国外是好山好水好寂寞，国内是好脏好乱好快活。
Guówài shì hǎo shān hǎo shuǐ hǎo jìmò, guónèi shì hǎo zāng hǎo luàn hǎo kuàihuo.
"Abroad: nice mountains, nice water, so lonely. At home: dirty, chaotic, but so much fun."
每个地方的生活都有好有坏。
Měi ge dìfang de shēnghuó dōu yǒu hǎo yǒu huài.
Life everywhere has its good and bad points.
海外华人努力地融入当地社会，同时，在一定程度上也保持着中国的传统文化。
Hǎiwài huárén nǔlì de róngrù dāngdì shèhuì, tóngshí, zài yídìng chéngdù shàng yě bǎochízhe Zhōngguó de chuántǒng wénhuà.
Overseas Chinese work hard to fit into local society, while to some extent keeping Chinese traditions.
在春节、中秋节这样代表着团圆的日子里，中国城里节日的气氛很浓，
Zài Chūn Jié, Zhōngqiū Jié zhèyàng dàibiǎozhe tuányuán de rìzi li, Zhōngguóchéng li jiérì de qìfēn hěn nóng,
On days of reunion like the Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn, Chinatown is full of festive atmosphere,
出门在外的人对家乡的思念也会更强烈。
chūmén zàiwài de rén duì jiāxiāng de sīniàn yě huì gèng qiángliè.
and people far from home miss it even more.

blocks.label: 海归
lines: 我们看到，今天在中国仍然有许多人千方百计地想出国留学、移民，
Wǒmen kàndào, jīntiān zài Zhōngguó réngrán yǒu xǔduō rén qiān fāng bǎi jì de xiǎng chū guó liú xué, yímín,
We see that in China today many people are still doing everything they can to study abroad or emigrate,
而在海外，不少人选择回国当海归。
ér zài hǎiwài, bù shǎo rén xuǎnzé huí guó dāng hǎiguī.
while abroad, many are choosing to return home as "sea turtles".
受到经济危机的影响，一些毕业生、新移民在海外的就业情况不好，工作和生活也不稳定。
Shòudào jīngjì wēijī de yǐngxiǎng, yìxiē bìyèshēng, xīn yímín zài hǎiwài de jiùyè qíngkuàng bù hǎo, gōngzuò hé shēnghuó yě bù wěndìng.
Affected by the economic crisis, some graduates and new immigrants abroad struggle to find jobs, and their work and life are unstable.
而中国经济持续发展，让中国人感到骄傲。
Ér Zhōngguó jīngjì chíxù fāzhǎn, ràng Zhōngguórén gǎndào jiāo'ào.
Meanwhile China's continuing growth makes Chinese people proud.
政府也鼓励优秀的人才返回中国。
Zhèngfǔ yě gǔlì yōuxiù de réncái fǎnhuí Zhōngguó.
The government also encourages talented people to return to China.

grammar: 从……起
starting from …
Marks a starting point.
从一九八五年起，中国政府取消了对自费留学的限制，自费学生渐渐增多。
Cóng yī jiǔ bā wǔ nián qǐ, Zhōngguó zhèngfǔ qǔxiāo le duì zìfèi liú xué de xiànzhì, zìfèi xuésheng jiànjiàn zēngduō.
From 1985 the government lifted restrictions on self-funded study abroad, and the number of self-funded students gradually grew.
从明天起，我开始锻炼。
Cóng míngtiān qǐ, wǒ kāishǐ duànliàn.
From tomorrow I'll start exercising.
一来……，二来……
firstly …, secondly …
Lists reasons.
一些父母觉得送孩子出国，一来可以让他掌握一门外语，摆脱国内糟糕的外语学习环境，
Yìxiē fùmǔ juéde sòng háizi chū guó, yì lái kěyǐ ràng tā zhǎngwò yì mén wàiyǔ, bǎituō guónèi zāogāo de wàiyǔ xuéxí huánjìng,
Some parents feel that sending a child abroad, firstly, lets them master a foreign language and escape poor language-learning conditions at home;
一来便宜，二来方便。
Yì lái piányi, èr lái fāngbiàn.
Firstly it's cheap; secondly it's convenient.
before … is over, … again
Two things overlap.
出国热还没过去，移民又成了热门话题。
Chūguó rè hái méi guòqu, yímín yòu chéng le rèmén huàtí.
The study-abroad craze isn't over yet, and emigration has become a hot topic.
旧问题还没解决，新问题又来了。
Jiù wèntí hái méi jiějué, xīn wèntí yòu lái le.
Before the old problem's solved, a new one appears.
owing to …
Formal "because".
由于在中国双重国籍不被政府允许，移民意味着要放弃中国国籍。
Yóuyú zài Zhōngguó shuāngchóng guójí bú bèi zhèngfǔ yǔnxǔ, yímín yìwèizhe yào fàngqì Zhōngguó guójí.
Because the Chinese government doesn't allow dual nationality, emigrating means giving up Chinese nationality.
由于下雨，比赛取消了。
Yóuyú xià yǔ, bǐsài qǔxiāo le.
The match was called off owing to rain.
意味着……
to mean …
Gives an implication.
由于在中国双重国籍不被政府允许，移民意味着要放弃中国国籍。
Yóuyú zài Zhōngguó shuāngchóng guójí bú bèi zhèngfǔ yǔnxǔ, yímín yìwèizhe yào fàngqì Zhōngguó guójí.
Because the Chinese government doesn't allow dual nationality, emigrating means giving up Chinese nationality.
毕业意味着工作。
Bìyè yìwèizhe gōngzuò.
Graduating means working.
与……相符
to match …
与 = with (formal).
但在新的国家不一定能很快找到与自己的专业相符的工作。
dàn zài xīn de guójiā bù yídìng néng hěn kuài zhǎodào yǔ zìjǐ de zhuānyè xiāngfú de gōngzuò.
but in their new country may not quickly find work that matches their field.
结果与预期相符。
Jiéguǒ yǔ yùqī xiāngfú.
The result matched expectations.
据统计
according to statistics
Introduces data.
据统计，全球现有海外华人约五千万，法国估计有六十多万。
Jù tǒngjì, quánqiú xiànyǒu hǎiwài huárén yuē wǔqiān wàn, Fǎguó gūjì yǒu liùshí duō wàn.
According to statistics, there are about 50 million overseas Chinese worldwide, and an estimated 600,000-plus in France.
据统计，学生越来越多。
Jù tǒngjì, xuésheng yuèláiyuè duō.
Statistics show there are more and more students.
有的……，有的……，也有的……
some …, some …, and some …
Lists groups.
他们当中有的事业很成功，有的还在努力奋斗，也有的一事无成。
Tāmen dāngzhōng yǒu de shìyè hěn chénggōng, yǒu de hái zài nǔlì fèndòu, yě yǒu de yí shì wú chéng.
Some of them are very successful, some are still struggling, and some have achieved nothing.
有的人喜欢，有的人不喜欢。
Yǒu de rén xǐhuan, yǒu de rén bù xǐhuan.
Some like it; some don't.
只不过……罢了
it's just … that's all
Plays something down.
只不过程度高低不同罢了。
zhǐbùguò chéngdù gāodī bùtóng bàle.
it's just a matter of degree.
我只不过开个玩笑罢了。
Wǒ zhǐbùguò kāi ge wánxiào bàle.
I was only joking.
受到……的影响
affected by …
Shows a cause.
受到经济危机的影响，一些毕业生、新移民在海外的就业情况不好，工作和生活也不稳定。
Shòudào jīngjì wēijī de yǐngxiǎng, yìxiē bìyèshēng, xīn yímín zài hǎiwài de jiùyè qíngkuàng bù hǎo, gōngzuò hé shēnghuó yě bù wěndìng.
Affected by the economic crisis, some graduates and new immigrants abroad struggle to find jobs, and their work and life are unstable.
受到天气的影响，航班推迟了。
Shòudào tiānqì de yǐngxiǎng, hángbān tuīchí le.
The flight was delayed because of the weather.
gaps: 不用承受那么沉重的学业
当地人的生活并不那么容易。
而在海外，不少人选择回国当
say: Life everywhere has its good and bad points.
Sacrifice myself, and bring happiness to those who come after.

139.title: Foreigners in China
139.sub: Lesson 9 reading: who comes to China, why, and what they find hard
139.transcriptNote: The second lesson 9 reading. 入乡随俗 means "when in Rome, do as the Romans do".

blocks.label: 课文
blocks.h: 外国人在中国 · The text
lines: 外国人在中国
Wàiguórén zài Zhōngguó
Foreigners in China
随着全球化的加快以及国际合作日益密切，
Suízhe quánqiúhuà de jiākuài yǐjí guójì hézuò rìyì mìqiè,
As globalisation speeds up and international cooperation becomes ever closer,
到中国来旅行、求学、考察、创业、工作或生活的外国人也越来越多。
dào Zhōngguó lái lǚxíng, qiúxué, kǎochá, chuàngyè, gōngzuò huò shēnghuó de wàiguórén yě yuèláiyuè duō.
more and more foreigners are coming to China to travel, study, visit, start businesses, work or live.
跟十几年前比起来，以前来旅游的是退休的多，现在是年轻人越来越多；
Gēn shí jǐ nián qián bǐ qilai, yǐqián lái lǚyóu de shì tuìxiū de duō, xiànzài shì niánqīngrén yuèláiyuè duō;
Compared with a dozen or so years ago, tourists used to be mostly retired people; now more and more are young;
以前来中国工作的一般性人才多，现在是高级人才越来越多；
yǐqián lái Zhōngguó gōngzuò de yìbānxìng réncái duō, xiànzài shì gāojí réncái yuèláiyuè duō;
foreigners who came to work used to be mostly ordinary staff; now more and more are highly qualified;
以前是短期工作的多，现在是长期工作的越来越多。
yǐqián shì duǎnqī gōngzuò de duō, xiànzài shì chángqī gōngzuò de yuèláiyuè duō.
most used to work short-term; now more and more work long-term.

blocks.label: 留学
blocks.h: 留学和找工作 · Studying and job hunting
lines: 外国人选择到中国留学，一来是为了增加自己的竞争力，二来是为了了解中国。
Wàiguórén xuǎnzé dào Zhōngguó liú xué, yì lái shì wèile zēngjiā zìjǐ de jìngzhēnglì, èr lái shì wèile liǎojiě Zhōngguó.
Foreigners study in China firstly to become more competitive, and secondly to understand China.
他们有的是交换生，但更多的是自费生。
Tāmen yǒude shì jiāohuànshēng, dàn gèng duō de shì zìfèishēng.
Some are exchange students, but more are self-funded.
基本上在中国一二线城市的各个大学里，都看得到说普通话的老外。
Jīběn shang zài Zhōngguó yī-èr xiàn chéngshì de gègè dàxué li, dōu kàn de dào shuō pǔtōnghuà de lǎowài.
In practically every university in China's first- and second-tier cities, you'll see foreigners speaking Mandarin.
其中一些人在学习结束后，选择留在中国。
Qízhōng yìxiē rén zài xuéxí jiéshù hòu, xuǎnzé liú zài Zhōngguó.
Some of them choose to stay in China after their studies.
不过，今天外国人在中国找工作，没有十几年前那么容易了。
Búguò, jīntiān wàiguórén zài Zhōngguó zhǎo gōngzuò, méiyǒu shí jǐ nián qián nàme róngyì le.
But today it's not as easy for foreigners to find work in China as it was a dozen years ago.
他们不仅要跟在中国的五十多万其他外国人竞争，
Tāmen bùjǐn yào gēn zài Zhōngguó de wǔshí duō wàn qítā wàiguórén jìngzhēng,
They not only have to compete with the more than 500,000 other foreigners in China,
而且还要跟许多既年轻又受过高等教育的中国人，尤其是跟海归竞争。
érqiě hái yào gēn xǔduō jì niánqīng yòu shòuguò gāoděng jiàoyù de Zhōngguórén, yóuqí shì gēn hǎiguī jìngzhēng.
but also with many young, highly educated Chinese, especially returnees from abroad.

blocks.label: 创业
blocks.h: 创业和工作 · Business and work
lines: 那些选择在中国创业的外国人，尽管对中国略有了解，
Nàxiē xuǎnzé zài Zhōngguó chuàngyè de wàiguórén, jǐnguǎn duì Zhōngguó lüè yǒu liǎojiě,
Foreigners who start businesses in China, although they know a little about China,
但还是会在创业过程中感受到文化差异，被一些规定和制度搞得很头晕。
dàn háishi huì zài chuàngyè guòchéng zhòng gǎnshòu dào wénhuà chāyì, bèi yìxiē guīdìng hé zhìdù gǎo de hěn tóu yūn.
still come up against cultural differences and get dizzy with rules and regulations.
尽管这样，他们还是认为，在中国创业机会大于麻烦，发展潜力更大。
Jǐnguǎn zhèyàng, tāmen háishi rènwéi, zài Zhōngguó chuàngyè jīhuì dàyú máfan, fāzhǎn qiánlì gèng dà.
Even so, they think that in China the opportunities outweigh the hassle, and the potential is greater.
在中国生活得最舒适的外国人是那些被公司派到中国工作的企业管理者、专业技术人员。
Zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó de zuì shūshì de wàiguórén shì nàxiē bèi gōngsī pài dào Zhōngguó gōngzuò de qǐyè guǎnlǐzhě, zhuānyè jìshù rényuán.
The foreigners who live most comfortably in China are managers and technical specialists sent by their companies.
他们在中国可以获得更高的收入和更大的发展，而且回国后大多都会升职。
Tāmen zài Zhōngguó kěyǐ huòdé gèng gāo de shōurù hé gèng dà de fāzhǎn, érqiě huí guó hòu dàduō dōu huì shēng zhí.
In China they earn more and develop further, and most are promoted when they go home.
还有一些人对中国那些自然条件差、经济不发达的地区更感兴趣。
Hái yǒu yìxiē rén duì Zhōngguó nàxiē zìrán tiáojiàn chà, jīngjì bù fādá de dìqū gèng gǎn xìngqù.
Some are more interested in China's poorer, less developed regions.
他们当志愿者，教农村的孩子们外语、画画和音乐。
Tāmen dāng zhìyuànzhě, jiào nóngcūn de háizimen wàiyǔ, huà huà hé yīnyuè.
They work as volunteers, teaching rural children foreign languages, art and music.
他们说，生活并不仅仅是挣工资。
Tāmen shuō, shēnghuó bìng bù jǐnjǐn shì zhèng gōngzī.
They say life isn't just about earning a wage.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 入乡随俗 · When in Rome
lines: 无论是短期旅游还是长期居住，生活在中国的外国人都会遇到无法入乡随俗的情况。
Wúlùn shì duǎnqī lǚyóu háishi chángqī jūzhù, shēnghuó zài Zhōngguó de wàiguórén dōu huì yùdào wúfǎ rù xiāng suí sú de qíngkuàng.
Whether they're short-term tourists or long-term residents, foreigners in China all meet situations where they can't "do as the Romans do".
他们对有些现象很敏感，如垃圾很少分类、卫生间不卫生、不遵守交通规则、说话声音太大、插队等等。
Tāmen duì yǒuxiē xiànxiàng hěn mǐngǎn, rú lājī hěn shǎo fēnlèi, wèishēngjiān bú wèishēng, bù zūnshǒu jiāotōng guīzé, shuōhuà shēngyīn tài dà, chā duì děngděng.
They're sensitive to certain things, such as rubbish rarely being sorted, unhygienic toilets, ignoring traffic rules, talking loudly, queue-jumping and so on.
另外，食品安全和环境问题，尤其是越来越严重的雾霾，
Lìngwài, shípǐn ānquán hé huánjìng wèntí, yóuqí shì yuèláiyuè yánzhòng de wùmái,
In addition, food safety and environmental problems, especially increasingly serious smog,
让一部分外国人犹豫要不要去中国。
ràng yí bùfen wàiguórén yóuyù yào bú yào qù Zhōngguó.
make some foreigners hesitate about going to China.
对一些已经居住在中国的外国人来说，也让他们感到忧虑。
Duì yìxiē yǐjīng jūzhù zài Zhōngguó de wàiguórén lái shuō, yě ràng tāmen gǎndào yōulǜ.
And for some foreigners already living in China, they are a worry.

146.title: Beijing's hutongs
146.sub: Four questions, then a passage on hutongs and courtyard houses
146.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then the passage. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。

Gēnjù wénzhāng, měinián yǒu duōshǎo yóukè dào Běijīng lǚyóu?

ans: 两个：中国国家大剧院和国家体育场（鸟巢）。
Liǎng ge: Zhōngguó Guójiā Dà Jùyuàn hé Guójiā Tǐyùchǎng(Niǎocháo).

四面建有房间，把院子围在中间的建筑。

q: 为什么有大面积的四合院被拆毁了？
Wèishénme yǒu dà miànjī de sìhéyuàn bèi chāihuǐ le?

ans: 很多胡同和四合院变得十分破旧，居民觉得在老房子里生活很不方便；政府和房地产开发商又不断盖起高楼、建起大道。
Hěn duō hútòng hé sìhéyuàn biàn de shífēn pòjiù, jūmín juéde zài lǎo fángzi li shēnghuó hěn bù fāngbiàn; zhèngfǔ hé fángdìchǎn kāifāshāng yòu búduàn gài qǐ gāolóu, jiàn qǐ dàdào.
Many hutongs and courtyard houses had become very run-down and residents found them inconvenient; meanwhile the government and developers kept putting up tower blocks and building wide roads.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 北京的胡同。
Běijīng de hútòng.
Beijing's hutongs.
北京是中华人民共和国的首都，是中国政治、文化、交通、国际交流中心，也是世界上最大的城市之一。
Běijīng shì zhōnghuárénmíngònghéguó de shǒudū, shì Zhōngguó zhèngzhì, wénhuà, jiāotōng, guójì jiāoliú zhōngxīn, yě shì shìjiè shang zuì dà de chéngshì zhīyī.
Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China, the centre of its politics, culture, transport and international exchange, and one of the world's largest cities.
北京历史悠久，有很多文化古迹，比如故宫、天坛、颐和园等等。
Běijīng lìshǐ yōujiǔ, yǒu hěn duō wénhuà gǔjì, bǐrú Gùgōng, Tiāntán, Yíhéyuán děngděng.
Beijing has a long history and many cultural sites, such as the Forbidden City, the Temple of Heaven and the Summer Palace.
每年有超过一亿四千万人到北京旅游。
Měinián yǒu chāoguò yíyì sìqiān wàn rén dào Běijīng lǚyóu.
Every year over 140 million people visit Beijing.
北京是一座现代化的国际大都市，那里有很多世界著名的当代艺术中心，还有很多现代新建筑。
Běijīng shì yí zuò xiàndàihuà de guójì dàdūshì, nàli yǒu hěn duō shìjiè zhùmíng de dāngdài yìshù zhōngxīn, hái yǒu hěn duō xiàndài xīn jiànzhù.
Beijing is a modern international metropolis, with many world-famous contemporary art centres and many new modern buildings.
如中国国家大剧院、国家体育场鸟巢等，都是新北京现代建筑的代表。
Rú Zhōngguó Guójiā Dà Jùyuàn, Guójiā Tǐyùchǎng Niǎocháo děng, dōu shì xīn Běijīng xiàndài jiànzhù de dàibiǎo.
The National Centre for the Performing Arts and the National Stadium, the Bird's Nest, are among the symbols of new modern Beijing.
说到北京最传统的住房形式，那当然是胡同里的四合院了。
Shuō dào Běijīng zuì chuántǒng de zhùfáng xíngshì, nà dāngrán shì hútòng li de sìhéyuàn le.
As for Beijing's most traditional form of housing, that's of course the courtyard house in the hutongs.
什么是胡同呢？
Shénme shì hútòng ne?
What is a hutong?
在北京，我们能看到一些由东至西的小巷，它们差不多一样宽。这些小巷就被称为胡同。
Zài Běijīng, wǒmen néng kàndào yìxiē yóu dōng zhì xī de xiǎoxiàng, tāmen chàbuduō yíyàng kuān. Zhèxiē xiǎoxiàng jiù bèi chēngwéi hútòng.
In Beijing you can see alleys running from east to west, all about the same width. These alleys are called hutongs.
北京的胡同里，四合院是最吸引人的建筑。
Běijīng de hútòng li, sìhéyuàn shì zuì xīyǐn rén de jiànzhù.
In Beijing's hutongs, the courtyard house is the most attractive building.
四合院，又称四合房，就是一个四面建有房间，把院子围在中间的建筑。
Sìhéyuàn, yòuchēng sìhéfáng, jiùshì yí ge sì miàn jiàn yǒu fángjiān, bǎ yuànzi wéi zài zhōngjiān de jiànzhù.
A courtyard house, also called 四合房, is a building with rooms on all four sides enclosing a courtyard in the middle.
这些四合院年代悠久，讲究人与自然的结合，有着很高的研究和欣赏价值。
Zhèxiē sìhéyuàn niándài yōujiǔ, jiǎngjiū rén yǔ zìrán de jiéhé, yǒuzhe hěn gāo de yánjiū hé xīnshǎng jiàzhí.
These courtyard houses are very old, value harmony between people and nature, and are of great value for study and appreciation.
但是，随着历史的发展，越来越多的胡同和四合院变得十分破旧，
Dànshì, suízhe lìshǐ de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de hútòng hé sìhéyuàn biàn de shífēn pòjiù,
But as history moved on, more and more hutongs and courtyard houses became very run-down,
院内的居民逐渐感到在老房子里生活很不方便。
yuàn nèi de jūmín zhújiàn gǎndào zài lǎo fángzi li shēnghuó hěn bù fāngbiàn.
and residents gradually found living in the old houses very inconvenient.
另外，政府和房地产开发商也不断盖起了高楼，建起了大道。
Lìngwài, zhèngfǔ hé fángdìchǎn kāifāshāng yě búduàn gài qǐ le gāolóu, jiàn qǐ le dàdào.
Also, the government and property developers kept putting up tower blocks and building wide roads.
从此，北京的胡同和四合院开始大面积地被拆毁，很多非常有价值的建筑也被破坏了。
Cóngcǐ, Běijīng de hútòng hé sìhéyuàn kāishǐ dà miànjī de bèi chāihuǐ, hěn duō fēicháng yǒu jiàzhí de jiànzhù yě bèi pòhuài le.
From then on, Beijing's hutongs and courtyard houses began to be demolished on a large scale, and many very valuable buildings were destroyed.

Marks one of a group.
北京是中华人民共和国的首都，是中国政治、文化、交通、国际交流中心，也是世界上最大的城市之一。

他是我最好的朋友之一。
Tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou zhīyī.

说到……，那当然是……了

说到北京最传统的住房形式，那当然是胡同里的四合院了。

When it comes to Chinese food, it has to be dumplings.

在北京，我们能看到一些由东至西的小巷，它们差不多一样宽。这些小巷就被称为胡同。
Zài Běijīng, wǒmen néng kàndào yìxiē yóu dōng zhì xī de xiǎoxiàng, tāmen chàbuduō yíyàng kuān. Zhèxiē xiǎoxiàng jiù bèi chēngwéi hútòng.

他被称为“小老虎”。
Tā bèi chēngwéi "xiǎo lǎohǔ".

又称……

四合院，又称四合房，就是一个四面建有房间，把院子围在中间的建筑。
Sìhéyuàn, yòuchēng sìhéfáng, jiùshì yí ge sì miàn jiàn yǒu fángjiān, bǎ yuànzi wéi zài zhōngjiān de jiànzhù.
A courtyard house, also called 四合房, is a building with rooms on all four sides enclosing a courtyard in the middle.
北京，又称北平。
Běijīng, yòuchēng běipíng.
Beijing, also called Beiping.
把……围在中间

把 + O + V + 在 + place.
四合院，又称四合房，就是一个四面建有房间，把院子围在中间的建筑。
Sìhéyuàn, yòuchēng sìhéfáng, jiùshì yí ge sì miàn jiàn yǒu fángjiān, bǎ yuànzi wéi zài zhōngjiān de jiànzhù.
A courtyard house, also called 四合房, is a building with rooms on all four sides enclosing a courtyard in the middle.
大家把他围在中间。
Dàjiā bǎ tā wéi zài zhōngjiān.

从此

从此，北京的胡同和四合院开始大面积地被拆毁，很多非常有价值的建筑也被破坏了。
Cóngcǐ, Běijīng de hútòng hé sìhéyuàn kāishǐ dà miànjī de bèi chāihuǐ, hěn duō fēicháng yǒu jiàzhí de jiànzhù yě bèi pòhuài le.

从此他再也没来过。
Cóngcǐ tā zài yě méi lái guo.
