147.title: Ju'er Hutong
147.sub: Seven true-or-false statements, then a model of hutong renovation
147.transcriptNote: First seven statements to judge, then the passage. Ju'er Hutong (菊儿胡同) was renovated by Professor Wu Liangyong (吴良镛) of Tsinghua University; the project won the UN World Habitat Award in 1993. Turn on Answers for the true-or-false key.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音并判断 · True or false
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音，并判断句子的正误。
Tīng lùyīn, bìng pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false.
请先听七个句子。
Qǐng xiān tīng qī ge jùzi.
First listen to seven sentences.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 七个句子 · True or false

q: 菊儿胡同全长三百八十四米，是一条位于北京东城区的普通胡同。
Jú'ér Hútòng quánzhǎng sānbǎi bāshísì mǐ, shì yì tiáo wèiyú Běijīng Dōngchéng Qū de pǔtōng hútòng.
Ju'er Hutong is 384 m long and is an ordinary hutong in Dongcheng District, Beijing.
qs.why: It's 438 m long.

q: 清华大学吴良镛教授设计了对菊儿胡同的改造工作。
Qīnghuá Dàxué Wú Liángyōng jiàoshòu shèjì le duì Jú'ér Hútòng de gǎizào gōngzuò.
Professor Wu Liangyong of Tsinghua University designed the renovation of Ju'er Hutong.
qs.why: The passage says so.

q: 改造后的胡同，平房变成了楼房，房子里面有自来水。
Gǎizào hòu de hútòng, píngfáng biànchéng le lóufáng, fángzi lǐmiàn yǒu zìláishuǐ.
After renovation, the single-storey houses became multi-storey buildings with running water.
qs.why: Kitchens and bathrooms were added, with running water at home.

q: 改造后的房子一棵树也没有，但是有一个院子为邻居们共用。
Gǎizào hòu de fángzi yì kē shù yě méiyǒu, dànshì yǒu yí ge yuànzi wèi línjū men gòngyòng.
After renovation there wasn't a single tree, but there was a courtyard shared by the neighbours.
qs.why: The courtyard and trees were kept as far as possible.

q: 改造后的胡同结合了中国南方建筑和北方建筑的特色。
Gǎizào hòu de hútòng jiéhé le Zhōngguó nánfāng jiànzhù hé běifāng jiànzhù de tèsè.
The renovated hutong combines features of southern and northern Chinese architecture.
qs.why: The passage says so.

q: 菊儿胡同的改造工程获得了国际大奖：世界人居奖。
Jú'ér Hútòng de gǎizào gōngchéng huòdé le guójì dàjiǎng: Shìjiè Rénjū Jiǎng.
The Ju'er Hutong renovation won an international award: the World Habitat Award.
qs.why: It won in 1993.

q: 八十年代末、九十年代初，吴良镛教授也改造了很多别的胡同。
Bāshí niándài mò, jiǔshí niándài chū, Wú Liángyōng jiàoshòu yě gǎizào le hěn duō biéde hútòng.
In the late 1980s and early 1990s, Professor Wu also renovated many other hutongs.
qs.why: The passage only mentions Ju'er Hutong.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 下面请听文章。
Xiàmiàn qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
北京的胡同。
Běijīng de hútòng.
Beijing's hutongs.
菊儿胡同。
Jú'ér Hútòng.
Ju'er Hutong.
为了更好地保护老城区，政府一直在努力想办法保护和改造老四合院。
Wèile gèng hǎo de bǎohù lǎochéngqū, zhèngfǔ yìzhí zài nǔlì xiǎng bànfǎ bǎohù hé gǎizào lǎo sìhéyuàn.
To protect the old city better, the government has long been trying to find ways to protect and renovate old courtyard houses.
菊儿胡同就是一个典型的例子。
Jú'ér Hútòng jiùshì yí ge diǎnxíng de lìzi.
Ju'er Hutong is a typical example.
菊儿胡同位于北京市东城区，它全长四百三十八米，是一条很普通却十分有名的老胡同。
Jú'ér Hútòng wèiyú běijīngshì Dōngchéng Qū, tā quánzhǎng sìbǎi sānshíbā mǐ, shì yì tiáo hěn pǔtōng què shífēn yǒumíng de lǎo hútòng.
Ju'er Hutong is in Dongcheng District, Beijing. It's 438 m long: a very ordinary but very famous old hutong.
八十年代末、九十年代初，北京市政府开始改造老居民区。
Bāshí niándài mò, jiǔshí niándài chū, běijīngshì zhèngfǔ kāishǐ gǎizào lǎo jūmínqū.
In the late 1980s and early 1990s, the Beijing government began renovating old residential areas.
清华大学吴良镛教授设计了对菊儿胡同四合院的改建工作。
Qīnghuá Dàxué Wú Liángyōng jiàoshòu shèjì le duì Jú'ér Hútòng sìhéyuàn de gǎijiàn gōngzuò.
Professor Wu Liangyong of Tsinghua University designed the rebuilding of the courtyard houses in Ju'er Hutong.
吴教授将原为四合院的平房改为楼房，增加了厨房、卫生间，让居民在自己家里就能使用到自来水。
Wú jiàoshòu jiāng yuán wèi sìhéyuàn de píngfáng gǎiwéi lóufáng, zēngjiā le chúfáng, wèishēngjiān, ràng jūmín zài zìjǐ jiā li jiù néng shǐyòng dào zìláishuǐ.
Professor Wu turned the single-storey courtyard houses into multi-storey buildings, adding kitchens and bathrooms so residents had running water at home.
同时，原来的院子和树木都尽量保留了下来。院子是居民共有。
Tóngshí, yuánlái de yuànzi hé shùmù dōu jǐnliàng bǎoliú le xialai. Yuànzi shì jūmín gòngyǒu.
At the same time, the original courtyards and trees were kept as far as possible. The courtyards are shared by the residents.
这样，改造后的四合院结合了中国南方和北方建筑的特色。
Zhèyàng, gǎizào hòu de sìhéyuàn jiéhé le Zhōngguó nánfāng hé běifāng jiànzhù de tèsè.
In this way, the renovated courtyard houses combine features of southern and northern Chinese architecture.
它保证了居民生活的私人空间，也保证了老北京人重视和邻居来往走动的生活习惯。
Tā bǎozhèng le jūmín shēnghuó de sīrén kōngjiān, yě bǎozhèng le lǎo Běijīng rén zhòngshì hé línjū láiwǎng zǒudòng de shēnghuó xíguàn.
They guarantee residents' private space, while preserving old Beijingers' habit of visiting and mixing with neighbours.
一九九三年，中国菊儿胡同改造工程获得了世界人居奖。
Yī jiǔ jiǔ sān nián, Zhōngguó Jú'ér Hútòng gǎizào gōngchéng huòdé le Shìjiè Rénjū Jiǎng.
In 1993, the Ju'er Hutong renovation project won the World Habitat Award.

grammar: 为了更好地……
in order to … better
Gives a purpose.
为了更好地保护老城区，政府一直在努力想办法保护和改造老四合院。
Wèile gèng hǎo de bǎohù lǎochéngqū, zhèngfǔ yìzhí zài nǔlì xiǎng bànfǎ bǎohù hé gǎizào lǎo sìhéyuàn.
To protect the old city better, the government has long been trying to find ways to protect and renovate old courtyard houses.
为了更好地学习，他搬家了。
Wèile gèng hǎo de xuéxí, tā bān jiā le.
He moved to study better.
……就是一个典型的例子
… is a typical example
Introduces an example.
菊儿胡同就是一个典型的例子。
Jú'ér Hútòng jiùshì yí ge diǎnxíng de lìzi.
Ju'er Hutong is a typical example.
他就是一个典型的例子。
Tā jiùshì yí ge diǎnxíng de lìzi.
He's a typical example.
very … yet …
却 marks a contrast.
菊儿胡同位于北京市东城区，它全长四百三十八米，是一条很普通却十分有名的老胡同。
Jú'ér Hútòng wèiyú běijīngshì Dōngchéng Qū, tā quánzhǎng sìbǎi sānshíbā mǐ, shì yì tiáo hěn pǔtōng què shífēn yǒumíng de lǎo hútòng.
Ju'er Hutong is in Dongcheng District, Beijing. It's 438 m long: a very ordinary but very famous old hutong.
这家店很小却很有名。
Zhè jiā diàn hěn xiǎo què hěn yǒumíng.
This shop is small but famous.
将……改为……
to turn … into …
将 is formal 把.
吴教授将原为四合院的平房改为楼房，增加了厨房、卫生间，让居民在自己家里就能使用到自来水。
Wú jiàoshòu jiāng yuán wèi sìhéyuàn de píngfáng gǎiwéi lóufáng, zēngjiā le chúfáng, wèishēngjiān, ràng jūmín zài zìjǐ jiā li jiù néng shǐyòng dào zìláishuǐ.
Professor Wu turned the single-storey courtyard houses into multi-storey buildings, adding kitchens and bathrooms so residents had running water at home.
将房间改为书房。
Jiāng fángjiān gǎiwéi shūfáng.
Turn the room into a study.
……，也保证了……
…, while also ensuring …
Gives two results.
它保证了居民生活的私人空间，也保证了老北京人重视和邻居来往走动的生活习惯。
Tā bǎozhèng le jūmín shēnghuó de sīrén kōngjiān, yě bǎozhèng le lǎo Běijīng rén zhòngshì hé línjū láiwǎng zǒudòng de shēnghuó xíguàn.
They guarantee residents' private space, while preserving old Beijingers' habit of visiting and mixing with neighbours.
这样既省钱，也省时间。
Zhèyàng jì shěng qián, yě shěng shíjiān.
This saves money and time.
gaps: 它全长四百三十八米，是一条很
了对菊儿胡同四合院的改建工作。
原来的院子和树木都尽量

148.title: Happy Lao Jiang
148.sub: Three questions, then an Englishman tells how he came to live in a Beijing courtyard
148.transcriptNote: An Englishman, Jiang Senhai (江森海), known to everyone as Lao Jiang, runs a T-shirt shop called 创可贴 ("Plasters") in a hutong and lives in a shared courtyard (大杂院). The questions come first, then his own account. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
在北京一个大杂院里，住着一个英国人。他的中文名字叫江森海，大家都管他叫老姜。
Zài Běijīng yí ge dàzáyuàn li, zhù zhe yí ge yīngguórén. Tā de Zhōngwén míngzì jiào Jiāng Sēnhǎi, dàjiā dōu guǎn tā jiào Lǎo Jiāng.
In a shared courtyard in Beijing lives an Englishman. His Chinese name is Jiang Senhai, and everyone calls him Lao Jiang.
老姜在胡同里开了一家T恤小店，叫做创可贴。
Lǎo Jiāng zài hútòng li kāi le yì jiā T xù xiǎodiàn, jiàozuò Chuàngkětiē.
Lao Jiang has opened a little T-shirt shop in the hutong called 创可贴.
请听老姜的自述《幸福的老姜》，然后回答下面的问题。
Qǐng tīng Lǎo Jiāng de zìshù"xìngfú de Lǎo Jiāng", ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to Lao Jiang's own account, "Happy Lao Jiang", then answer the questions below.

q: 将下面的事件按照时间顺序排列：结婚，来到北京，生孩子，英语外教，住进大杂院。
Jiāng xiàmiàn de shìjiàn ànzhào shíjiān shùnxù páiliè: jié hūn, láidào Běijīng, shēng háizi, Yīngyǔ wàijiào, zhù jìn dàzáyuàn.
Put these events in order: getting married, coming to Beijing, having children, teaching English, moving into the courtyard.
ans: 来到北京，当英语外教，结婚，住进大杂院，生孩子。
Láidào Běijīng, dāng Yīngyǔ wàijiào, jié hūn, zhù jìn dàzáyuàn, shēng háizi.
Came to Beijing, taught English, got married, moved into the courtyard, had children.

q: 老姜为什么留在了北京？
Lǎo Jiāng wèishénme liú zài le Běijīng?
Why did Lao Jiang stay in Beijing?
ans: 他一下子就爱上了北京，特别喜欢逛胡同，觉得胡同就是北京的气氛，北京人也很实在；后来又在北京认识了妻子。
Tā yíxiàzi jiù ài shàng le Běijīng, tèbié xǐhuan guàng hútòng, juéde hútòng jiùshì Běijīng de qìfēn, Běijīng rén yě hěn shízài; hòulái yòu zài Běijīng rènshi le qīzi.
He fell in love with Beijing at once, especially wandering the hutongs, which to him were the atmosphere of Beijing, and he found Beijingers genuine; later he met his wife there.

q: 他为什么觉得自己很幸福？
Tā wèishénme juéde zìjǐ hěn xìngfú?
ans: 他有妻子、三个可爱的女儿和家人；大杂院里邻居关系很好，大妈们帮他们带孩子。他觉得自己什么都有了。
Tā yǒu qīzi, sān ge kě'ài de nǚ'ér hé jiārén; dàzáyuàn li línjū guānxi hěn hǎo, dàmā men bāng tāmen dài háizi. Tā juéde zìjǐ shénme dōu yǒu le.
He has a wife, three lovely daughters and family; the neighbours in the courtyard get on well and the older women help look after the children. He feels he has everything.

blocks.label: 自述
blocks.h: 幸福的老姜 · Lao Jiang's story
lines: 幸福的老姜。
Xìngfú de Lǎo Jiāng.
Happy Lao Jiang.
一九九三年，我二十岁，第一次来到了北京，一下子就爱上了这个地方。
Yī jiǔ jiǔ sān nián, wǒ èr shí suì, dì-yī cì láidào le Běijīng, yíxiàzi jiù ài shàng le zhège dìfang.
In 1993, when I was twenty, I came to Beijing for the first time and fell in love with the place at once.
几个月下来，我还没逛够呢，我身上的钱就全花光了。
Jǐ ge yuè xialai, wǒ hái méi guàng gòu ne, wǒ shēnshàng de qián jiù quán huāguāng le.
A few months later, before I'd had my fill of exploring, all my money was gone.
当时我很穷。那时候北京有两个酒吧，我有时候去那里。
Dāngshí wǒ hěn qióng. Nà shíhou Běijīng yǒu liǎng ge jiǔbā, wǒ yǒushíhou qù nàli.
I was very poor then. Beijing had two bars at the time, and I sometimes went there.
因为我没有钱，所以我就求那里的老外帮我付钱。
Yīnwèi wǒ méiyǒu qián, suǒyǐ wǒ jiù qiú nàli de lǎowài bāng wǒ fùqián.
Because I had no money, I'd ask the foreigners there to pay for me.
后来有人给我介绍了工作，教英语什么的。我就靠教英语来赚生活费。
Hòulái yǒu rén gěi wǒ jièshào le gōngzuò, jiào Yīngyǔ shénme de. Wǒ jiù kào jiào Yīngyǔ lái zhuàn shēnghuófèi.
Then someone found me work, teaching English and so on. I earned my living by teaching English.
不上课的时候，我最喜欢的就是在北京逛胡同。
Bú shàng kè de shíhou, wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jiùshì zài Běijīng guàng hútòng.
When I wasn't teaching, my favourite thing was wandering Beijing's hutongs.
那些小胡同对我来说就是北京的气氛。而且北京人也很实在。
Nàxiē xiǎo hútòng duì wǒ lái shuō jiùshì Běijīng de qìfēn. Érqiě Běijīng rén yě hěn shízài.
To me those little hutongs were the atmosphere of Beijing. And Beijingers are very genuine.
我去了那么多地方，没想到这些胡同这么吸引我。
Wǒ qù le nàme duō dìfang, méi xiǎngdào zhèxiē hútòng zhème xīyǐn wǒ.
I'd been to so many places, but I never expected these hutongs to draw me in like that.
我天天背着相机在胡同里转。
Wǒ tiāntiān bèizhe xiàngjī zài hútòng li zhuǎn.
Every day I wandered round the hutongs with my camera on my back.
后来我在北京认识了一个加拿大姑娘，就是我现在的妻子罗拉。
Hòulái wǒ zài Běijīng rènshi le yí ge Jiānádà gūniáng, jiùshì wǒ xiànzài de qīzi Luólā.
Later I met a Canadian girl in Beijing, Laura, who is now my wife.
我们在一条胡同里结了婚，住进了大杂院，生了三个可爱的女儿。
Wǒmen zài yì tiáo hútòng li jié le hūn, zhù jìn le dàzáyuàn, shēng le sān ge kě'ài de nǚ'ér.
We married in a hutong, moved into a shared courtyard, and had three lovely daughters.
现在老大八岁，老二四岁，老三不到两岁，聪明可爱。
Xiànzài lǎodà bā suì, lǎo'èr sì suì, lǎosān bú dào liǎng suì, cōngmíng kě'ài.
Now the eldest is eight, the second four, and the youngest not yet two. They're clever and adorable.
这么多年，大杂院里邻居之间的关系很好。
Zhème duō nián, dàzáyuàn li línjū zhījiān de guānxi hěn hǎo.
All these years, the neighbours in the courtyard have got on very well.
大妈们都帮我们带孩子。我和老婆都要工作，大妈们就像孩子们的奶奶、姥姥一样。这对我们太好了。
Dàmā men dōu bāng wǒmen dài háizi. Wǒ hé lǎopo dōu yào gōngzuò, dàmā men jiù xiàng háizimen de nǎinai, lǎolao yíyàng. Zhè duì wǒmen tài hǎo le.
The older women all help us look after the children. My wife and I both work, and they're like grandmothers to the kids. It's wonderful for us.
住在胡同里，我们很幸福。
Zhù zài hútòng li, wǒmen hěn xìngfú.
Living in the hutong, we're very happy.
我想，如果我有三百万美金，我也不会比现在幸福。
Wǒ xiǎng, rúguǒ wǒ yǒu sānbǎi wàn měijīn, wǒ yě bú huì bǐ xiànzài xìngfú.
I think that even if I had three million dollars, I wouldn't be any happier than I am now.
因为我什么都有了：我的孩子、老婆和家人。
Yīnwèi wǒ shénme dōu yǒu le: wǒ de háizi, lǎopo hé jiārén.
Because I have everything: my children, my wife and my family.

grammar: to call … …
Colloquial naming.
在北京一个大杂院里，住着一个英国人。他的中文名字叫江森海，大家都管他叫老姜。
Zài Běijīng yí ge dàzáyuàn li, zhù zhe yí ge yīngguórén. Tā de Zhōngwén míngzì jiào Jiāng Sēnhǎi, dàjiā dōu guǎn tā jiào Lǎo Jiāng.
In a shared courtyard in Beijing lives an Englishman. His Chinese name is Jiang Senhai, and everyone calls him Lao Jiang.
我们管他叫小王。
Wǒmen guǎn tā jiào xiǎo wáng.
We call him Xiao Wang.
一下子就……
at once
Something happens immediately.
一九九三年，我二十岁，第一次来到了北京，一下子就爱上了这个地方。
Yī jiǔ jiǔ sān nián, wǒ èr shí suì, dì-yī cì láidào le Běijīng, yíxiàzi jiù ài shàng le zhège dìfang.
In 1993, when I was twenty, I came to Beijing for the first time and fell in love with the place at once.
他一下子就明白了。
Tā yíxiàzi jiù míngbai le.
He understood at once.
before … had even …, … already …
One event overtakes another.
几个月下来，我还没逛够呢，我身上的钱就全花光了。
Jǐ ge yuè xialai, wǒ hái méi guàng gòu ne, wǒ shēnshàng de qián jiù quán huāguāng le.
A few months later, before I'd had my fill of exploring, all my money was gone.
我还没吃完呢，他就走了。
Wǒ hái méi chī wán ne, tā jiù zǒu le.
He left before I'd even finished eating.
to … by means of …
靠 = rely on.
后来有人给我介绍了工作，教英语什么的。我就靠教英语来赚生活费。
Hòulái yǒu rén gěi wǒ jièshào le gōngzuò, jiào Yīngyǔ shénme de. Wǒ jiù kào jiào Yīngyǔ lái zhuàn shēnghuófèi.
Then someone found me work, teaching English and so on. I earned my living by teaching English.
他靠打工来交学费。
Tā kào dǎ gōng lái jiāo xuéfèi.
He pays his fees by working.
对……来说
for, as far as … is concerned
Gives a point of view.
那些小胡同对我来说就是北京的气氛。而且北京人也很实在。
Nàxiē xiǎo hútòng duì wǒ lái shuō jiùshì Běijīng de qìfēn. Érqiě Běijīng rén yě hěn shízài.
To me those little hutongs were the atmosphere of Beijing. And Beijingers are very genuine.
对我来说，这很重要。
Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhè hěn zhòngyào.
For me, this is important.
像……一样
like …
A comparison.
大妈们都帮我们带孩子。我和老婆都要工作，大妈们就像孩子们的奶奶、姥姥一样。这对我们太好了。
Dàmā men dōu bāng wǒmen dài háizi. Wǒ hé lǎopo dōu yào gōngzuò, dàmā men jiù xiàng háizimen de nǎinai, lǎolao yíyàng. Zhè duì wǒmen tài hǎo le.
The older women all help us look after the children. My wife and I both work, and they're like grandmothers to the kids. It's wonderful for us.
他像哥哥一样照顾我。
Tā xiàng gēge yíyàng zhàogù wǒ.
He looks after me like an older brother.
如果……，也不会……
even if …, wouldn't …
A hypothetical.
我想，如果我有三百万美金，我也不会比现在幸福。
Wǒ xiǎng, rúguǒ wǒ yǒu sānbǎi wàn měijīn, wǒ yě bú huì bǐ xiànzài xìngfú.
I think that even if I had three million dollars, I wouldn't be any happier than I am now.
如果再来一次，我也不会改变。
Rúguǒ zài lái yí cì, wǒ yě bú huì gǎibiàn.
Even given another chance, I wouldn't change.
say: Living in the hutong, we're very happy.
Because I have everything: my children, my wife and my family.

149.zh: 城市化下的返乡青年（一）
149.title: Young people going home in an age of urbanisation (1)
149.sub: Three questions, then the story of Chen Tongkui
149.transcriptNote: The questions come first, then part 1 of the story. Chen Tongkui (陈统奎) and his brother Chen Tongkua (陈统夸) are from Boxue Village (博学村) in Hainan. The recording pronounces the names slightly differently each time; I've written the usual forms. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
最近几年出现了这样一帮年轻人：他们从农村来到城市，获得了学业和事业上的成功后，却选择了从城市再返回到家乡。
Zuìjìn jǐ nián chūxiàn le zhèyàng yì bāng niánqīngrén: tāmen cóng nóngcūn láidào chéngshì, huòdé le xuéyè hé shìyè shang de chénggōng hòu, què xuǎnzé le cóng chéngshì zài fǎnhuí dào jiāxiāng.
In recent years a group of young people has emerged: they came from the countryside to the city, and after succeeding in their studies and careers, chose to go back home.
海南省博学村的陈家兄弟陈统奎和陈统夸就是他们中的典型。
Hǎinán Shěng Bóxué Cūn de chén jiā xiōngdì Chén Tǒngkuí hé Chén Tǒngkuā jiùshì tāmen zhōng de diǎnxíng.
The Chen brothers of Boxue Village in Hainan, Chen Tongkui and Chen Tongkua, are typical examples.
请听《城市化下的返乡青年（一）》，然后回答问题。
Qǐng tīng"chéngshìhuà xià de fǎnxiāng qīngnián(yī)", ránhòu huídá wèntí.
Listen to part 1, then answer the questions.

q: 陈统奎是不是因为在上海找不到工作才返回家乡的？
Chén Tǒngkuí shì bu shì yīnwèi zài Shànghǎi zhǎo bu dào gōngzuò cái fǎnhuí jiāxiāng de?
Did Chen Tongkui go home because he couldn't find work in Shanghai?
ans: 不是。他曾是上海一家杂志的记者，是自己辞去工作返回家乡的。
Bú shì. Tā céng shì Shànghǎi yì jiā zázhì de jìzhě, shì zìjǐ cíqù gōngzuò fǎnhuí jiāxiāng de.
No. He was a journalist for a Shanghai magazine and chose to resign and go home.

q: 为什么陈统奎是博学村的骄傲？
Wèishénme Chén Tǒngkuí shì Bóxué Cūn de jiāo'ào?
Why is Chen Tongkui the pride of Boxue Village?
ans: 他是全村第一个考上大学的人。
Tā shì quán cūn dì-yī ge kǎoshang dàxué de rén.
He was the first person in the village to get into university.

q: 为什么陈统奎被感动了？
Wèishénme Chén Tǒngkuí bèi gǎndòng le?
ans: 他去南京上大学前，全村村民聚会为他庆祝，还给他凑学费，送他上火车。
Tā qù nánjīng shàng dàxué qián, quán cūn cūnmín jùhuì wèi tā qìngzhù, huán gěi tā còu xuéfèi, sòng tā shàng huǒchē.
Before he left for university in Nanjing, the whole village held a party for him, chipped in for his fees and saw him off at the train.

blocks.label: 短文
blocks.h: 城市化下的返乡青年（一） · The story, part 1
lines: 城市化下的返乡青年。
Chéngshìhuà xià de fǎnxiāng qīngnián.
Young people going home in an age of urbanisation.
随着中国城市化速度的加快，大量的农村人口来到城市。
Suízhe Zhōngguó chéngshìhuà sùdù de jiākuài, dàliàng de nóngcūn rénkǒu láidào chéngshì.
As China urbanises faster, huge numbers of rural people are moving to the cities.
很多人为了能够留在城市生活，为了实现自己事业上的成功，不惜付出一切代价。
Hěn duō rén wèile nénggòu liú zài chéngshì shēnghuó, wèile shíxiàn zìjǐ shìyè shang de chénggōng, bùxī fùchū yíqiè dàijià.
Many will pay any price to stay in the city and succeed in their careers.
但是，最近几年出现了这样一个年轻人群体。
Dànshì, zuìjìn jǐ nián chūxiàn le zhèyàng yí ge niánqīngrén qúntǐ.
But in recent years a group of young people has emerged
他们在离开家乡，获得了学业和事业上的成功后，却选择从城市再回到家乡。
Tāmen zài líkāi jiāxiāng, huòdé le xuéyè hé shìyè shang de chénggōng hòu, què xuǎnzé cóng chéngshì zài huídào jiāxiāng.
who, after leaving home and succeeding in their studies and careers, chose to return home from the city.
海南省博学村的陈家兄弟，就是他们中的典型。
Hǎinán Shěng Bóxué Cūn de chén jiā xiōngdì, jiùshì tāmen zhōng de diǎnxíng.
The Chen brothers from Boxue Village in Hainan are typical of them.
陈统奎曾是上海一家杂志的记者。
Chén Tǒngkuí céng shì Shànghǎi yì jiā zázhì de jìzhě.
Chen Tongkui was once a journalist for a magazine in Shanghai.
二零零九年，他辞去工作，返回到家乡。
Èr líng líng jiǔ nián, tā cíqù gōngzuò, fǎnhuí dào jiāxiāng.
In 2009 he quit his job and went home.
他的家乡博学村位于海南岛的一个山区，只有三百个村民，年人均收入两千元，十分贫穷落后。
Tā de jiāxiāng Bóxué Cūn wèiyú Hǎinán Dǎo de yí ge shānqū, zhǐyǒu sānbǎi ge cūnmín, nián rénjūn shōurù liǎngqiān yuán, shífēn pínqióng luòhòu.
His home village of Boxue is in a mountainous part of Hainan Island. It has only 300 villagers, an annual income of 2,000 yuan per head, and is very poor and backward.
是什么吸引陈统奎离开舒适的现代化城市生活，而返回到家乡的呢？
Shì shénme xīyǐn Chén Tǒngkuí líkāi shūshì de xiàndàihuà chéngshì shēnghuó, ér fǎnhuí dào jiāxiāng de ne?
What drew Chen Tongkui away from a comfortable modern city life and back home?
二零零一年，陈统奎考上了南京大学。
Èr líng líng yī nián, Chén Tǒngkuí kǎoshang le Nánjīng Dàxué.
In 2001, Chen Tongkui got into Nanjing University.
他是全村第一个考上大学的人，也是全村人的希望和骄傲。
Tā shì quán cūn dì-yī ge kǎoshang dàxué de rén, yě shì quán cūn rén de xīwàng hé jiāo'ào.
He was the first person in the village to go to university, and the hope and pride of the whole village.
在他离开家去南京上大学前，全村村民聚会为他庆祝，还给他凑学费，送他上火车。
Zài tā líkāi jiā qù nánjīng shàng dàxué qián, quán cūn cūnmín jùhuì wèi tā qìngzhù, huán gěi tā còu xuéfèi, sòng tā shàng huǒchē.
Before he left for university in Nanjing, the whole village gathered to celebrate, chipped in for his fees and saw him onto the train.
这些感动了陈统奎，让他永远不能忘记自己的家乡，不能忘记自己是地地道道的农村人。
Zhèxiē gǎndòng le Chén Tǒngkuí, ràng tā yǒngyuǎn bù néng wàngjì zìjǐ de jiāxiāng, bù néng wàngjì zìjǐ shì dìdìdàodào de nóngcūn rén.
This moved Chen Tongkui, and he could never forget his home, or that he was a countryman through and through.

grammar: after …, yet …
却 marks an unexpected choice.
最近几年出现了这样一帮年轻人：他们从农村来到城市，获得了学业和事业上的成功后，却选择了从城市再返回到家乡。
Zuìjìn jǐ nián chūxiàn le zhèyàng yì bāng niánqīngrén: tāmen cóng nóngcūn láidào chéngshì, huòdé le xuéyè hé shìyè shang de chénggōng hòu, què xuǎnzé le cóng chéngshì zài fǎnhuí dào jiāxiāng.
In recent years a group of young people has emerged: they came from the countryside to the city, and after succeeding in their studies and careers, chose to go back home.
他毕业后，却没有找工作。
Tā bìyè hòu, què méiyǒu zhǎo gōngzuò.
After graduating, he didn't look for a job.
不惜付出一切代价
at all costs
不惜 = not hesitating to.
很多人为了能够留在城市生活，为了实现自己事业上的成功，不惜付出一切代价。
Hěn duō rén wèile nénggòu liú zài chéngshì shēnghuó, wèile shíxiàn zìjǐ shìyè shang de chénggōng, bùxī fùchū yíqiè dàijià.
Many will pay any price to stay in the city and succeed in their careers.
他不惜一切代价要赢。
Tā bùxī yíqiè dàijià yào yíng.
He'll win at any cost.
曾是……
was once …
曾 = formerly.
陈统奎曾是上海一家杂志的记者。
Chén Tǒngkuí céng shì Shànghǎi yì jiā zázhì de jìzhě.
Chen Tongkui was once a journalist for a magazine in Shanghai.
他曾是我的老师。
Tā céng shì wǒ de lǎoshī.
He was once my teacher.
是什么……的呢？
what was it that …?
A cleft question.
是什么吸引陈统奎离开舒适的现代化城市生活，而返回到家乡的呢？
Shì shénme xīyǐn Chén Tǒngkuí líkāi shūshì de xiàndàihuà chéngshì shēnghuó, ér fǎnhuí dào jiāxiāng de ne?
What drew Chen Tongkui away from a comfortable modern city life and back home?
是什么让你改变主意的呢？
Shì shénme ràng nǐ gǎibiàn zhǔyi de ne?
What made you change your mind?
让……永远不能忘记……
to make … never forget …
让 = to cause.
这些感动了陈统奎，让他永远不能忘记自己的家乡，不能忘记自己是地地道道的农村人。
Zhèxiē gǎndòng le Chén Tǒngkuí, ràng tā yǒngyuǎn bù néng wàngjì zìjǐ de jiāxiāng, bù néng wàngjì zìjǐ shì dìdìdàodào de nóngcūn rén.
This moved Chen Tongkui, and he could never forget his home, or that he was a countryman through and through.
这件事让我永远不能忘记。
Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ yǒngyuǎn bù néng wàngjì.
I'll never forget this.
gaps: 陈统奎曾是上海一家杂志的
是什么吸引陈统奎离开

150.zh: 城市化下的返乡青年（二）
150.title: Young people going home in an age of urbanisation (2)
150.sub: Two questions, then what the Chen brothers did for their village
150.transcriptNote: Part 2 of the story of the Chen brothers from Boxue Village. The questions come first. The recording pronounces the names slightly differently each time; I've written the usual forms. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
请听《城市化下的返乡青年（二）》，然后回答问题。
Qǐng tīng"chéngshìhuà xià de fǎnxiāng qīngnián(èr)", ránhòu huídá wèntí.
Listen to part 2, then answer the questions.

q: 陈统奎、陈统夸兄弟俩为家乡做了什么？
Chén Tǒngkuí, Chén Tǒngkuā xiōngdì liǎ wèi jiāxiāng zuò le shénme?
What did the Chen brothers do for their home village?
ans: 安装自来水；和一帮人投资修建自行车道，迎接了海南省自行车比赛；组织文化活动，迎接外国艺术家；帮村民把水果运到上海展览。
Ānzhuāng zìláishuǐ; hé yì bāng rén tóuzī xiūjiàn zìxíngchēdào, yíngjiē le Hǎinán Shěng zìxíngchē bǐsài; zǔzhī wénhuà huódòng, yíngjiē wàiguó yìshùjiā; bāng cūnmín bǎ shuǐguǒ yùn dào Shànghǎi zhǎnlǎn.

They installed running water; with others, invested in a cycle path and hosted the Hainan cycling race; organised cultural events and welcomed foreign artists; and helped villagers take their fruit to exhibitions in Shanghai.

q: 现在的博学村怎么样了？
Xiànzài de Bóxué Cūn zěnmeyàng le?
What is Boxue Village like now?
ans: 已经发展成中国的一个榜样村、绿色村；村民收入提高了，政府也在投资和开发。
Yǐjīng fāzhǎn chéng Zhōngguó de yí ge bǎngyàng cūn, lǜsè cūn; cūnmín shōurù tígāo le, zhèngfǔ yě zài tóuzī hé kāifā.
It has become a model village and a green village in China; villagers earn more, and the government is investing in and developing it.

blocks.label: 短文
blocks.h: 城市化下的返乡青年（二） · The story, part 2
lines: 城市化下的返乡青年。
Chéngshìhuà xià de fǎnxiāng qīngnián.
Young people going home in an age of urbanisation.
陈统奎回到家乡后，开始领导村民一起建设家乡。
Chén Tǒngkuí huídào jiāxiāng hòu, kāishǐ lǐngdǎo cūnmín yìqǐ jiànshè jiāxiāng.
After returning home, Chen Tongkui began leading the villagers in developing their village.
他在村里安装了自来水，解决了村民用水难的问题。
Tā zài cūn li ānzhuāng le zìláishuǐ, jiějué le cūnmín yòng shuǐ nán de wèntí.
He installed running water in the village, solving the villagers' water problems.
还和一帮人投资了七万元，修建了一条自行车道，迎接了二零一零年第五届海南省自行车比赛。
Hái hé yì bāng rén tóuzī le qīwàn yuán, xiūjiàn le yì tiáo zìxíngchēdào, yíngjiē le èr líng yī líng nián dì-wǔ jiè Hǎinán Shěng zìxíngchē bǐsài.
With a group of others he invested 70,000 yuan to build a cycle path, and hosted the fifth Hainan cycling race in 2010.
二零一一年，陈统奎的弟弟陈统夸上完大学后，也选择从北京返回到家乡。
Èr líng yī yī nián, Chén Tǒngkuí de dìdi Chén Tǒngkuā shàng wán dàxué hòu, yě xuǎnzé cóng Běijīng fǎnhuí dào jiāxiāng.
In 2011, Chen Tongkui's younger brother Chen Tongkua also chose to come home from Beijing after university.
兄弟俩共同组织各种文化活动，迎接外国艺术家到村子参观，和村民交流。
Xiōngdì liǎ gòngtóng zǔzhī gè zhǒng wénhuà huódòng, yíngjiē wàiguó yìshùjiā dào cūnzi cānguān, hé cūnmín jiāoliú.
The brothers organised all kinds of cultural events together, welcoming foreign artists to visit the village and meet the villagers.
他们还帮助村民把村里的水果一箱一箱地运到上海进行展览。
Tāmen hái bāngzhù cūnmín bǎ cūn li de shuǐguǒ yì xiāng yì xiāng de yùn dào Shànghǎi jìnxíng zhǎnlǎn.
They also helped the villagers take the village's fruit, crate after crate, to Shanghai for exhibitions.
村民们靠卖水果、蔬菜，获得了从来没有过的高收入。
Cūnmín men kào mài shuǐguǒ, shūcài, huòdé le cónglái méiyǒu guo de gāo shōurù.
By selling fruit and vegetables, the villagers earned more than ever before.
以后，越来越多的人开始关心博学村。
Yǐhòu, yuèláiyuè duō de rén kāishǐ guānxīn Bóxué Cūn.
After that, more and more people began to take an interest in Boxue Village.
政府也很支持他们，开始对这个村子进行大量的投资和开发。
Zhèngfǔ yě hěn zhīchí tāmen, kāishǐ duì zhège cūnzi jìnxíng dàliàng de tóuzī hé kāifā.
The government supported them too, and began investing heavily in developing the village.
现在的博学村已经发展成中国的一个榜样村、绿色村。
Xiànzài de Bóxué Cūn yǐjīng fāzhǎn chéng Zhōngguó de yí ge bǎngyàng cūn, lǜsè cūn.
Today Boxue Village has become a model village and a green village for China.

grammar: 领导……一起……
to lead … in doing … together
领导 + people + V.
陈统奎回到家乡后，开始领导村民一起建设家乡。
Chén Tǒngkuí huídào jiāxiāng hòu, kāishǐ lǐngdǎo cūnmín yìqǐ jiànshè jiāxiāng.
After returning home, Chen Tongkui began leading the villagers in developing their village.
他领导大家一起工作。
Tā lǐngdǎo dàjiā yìqǐ gōngzuò.
He leads everyone in working together.
和……投资了……
to invest … with …
和 introduces partners.
还和一帮人投资了七万元，修建了一条自行车道，迎接了二零一零年第五届海南省自行车比赛。
Hái hé yì bāng rén tóuzī le qīwàn yuán, xiūjiàn le yì tiáo zìxíngchēdào, yíngjiē le èr líng yī líng nián dì-wǔ jiè Hǎinán Shěng zìxíngchē bǐsài.
With a group of others he invested 70,000 yuan to build a cycle path, and hosted the fifth Hainan cycling race in 2010.
他和朋友投资了一家店。
Tā hé péngyou tóuzī le yì jiā diàn.
He invested in a shop with friends.
一……一……地
… by …
Repetition shows one at a time.
他们还帮助村民把村里的水果一箱一箱地运到上海进行展览。
Tāmen hái bāngzhù cūnmín bǎ cūn li de shuǐguǒ yì xiāng yì xiāng de yùn dào Shànghǎi jìnxíng zhǎnlǎn.
They also helped the villagers take the village's fruit, crate after crate, to Shanghai for exhibitions.
一个一个地问。
Yí ge yí ge de wèn.
Ask one by one.
靠……获得……
to obtain … by means of …
靠 = rely on.
村民们靠卖水果、蔬菜，获得了从来没有过的高收入。
Cūnmín men kào mài shuǐguǒ, shūcài, huòdé le cónglái méiyǒu guo de gāo shōurù.
By selling fruit and vegetables, the villagers earned more than ever before.
他靠努力获得了成功。
Tā kào nǔlì huòdé le chénggōng.
He succeeded through hard work.
从来没有过的
never before seen
A strong modifier.
村民们靠卖水果、蔬菜，获得了从来没有过的高收入。
Cūnmín men kào mài shuǐguǒ, shūcài, huòdé le cónglái méiyǒu guo de gāo shōurù.
By selling fruit and vegetables, the villagers earned more than ever before.
从来没有过的好机会。
Cónglái méiyǒu guo de hǎo jīhuì.
An unprecedented opportunity.
发展成……
to develop into …
成 shows the result.
现在的博学村已经发展成中国的一个榜样村、绿色村。
Xiànzài de Bóxué Cūn yǐjīng fāzhǎn chéng Zhōngguó de yí ge bǎngyàng cūn, lǜsè cūn.
Today Boxue Village has become a model village and a green village for China.
小村子发展成了大城市。
Xiǎo cūnzi fāzhǎn chéng le dà chéngshì.
The village grew into a city.
gaps: 还和一帮人投资了七万元，
把村里的水果一箱一箱地运到上海进行
已经发展成中国的一个

151.title: Copy the tone of voice
151.sub: Ten short lines about hutongs, villages and leaving home
151.transcriptNote: Pre-speaking practice: listen to each line and copy the speaker's tone: joyful, outraged, proud, pleading, puzzled. Several item numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 口语课前练习 · Pre-speaking practice
lines: 口语课前练习。
Kǒuyǔ kè qián liànxí.
Pre-speaking exercises.
听句子并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng jùzi bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the sentences and copy the speakers' tone.
儿子考上大学了！
Érzi kǎoshang dàxué le!
Our son's got into university!
什么？房地产开发商要在我们胡同旁边建高楼？太过分了，咱们可不能同意。
Shénme? Fángdìchǎn kāifāshāng yào zài wǒmen hútòng pángbiān jiàn gāolóu? Tài guòfèn le, zánmen kě bù néng tóngyì.
What? The developers want to put up a tower block next to our hutong? That's outrageous. We mustn't agree to it.
刘教授设计的房子得的可是国际大奖，不是一般的奖。
Liú jiàoshòu shèjì de fángzi dé de kěshì guójì dàjiǎng, bú shì yìbān de jiǎng.
The house Professor Liu designed won an international award, I'll have you know. Not just any award.
孩子，你去城里好好上学，然后找个好工作，以后别回来了，不用担心家里。
Háizi, nǐ qù chéng li hǎohǎo shàng xué, ránhòu zhǎo ge hǎo gōngzuò, yǐhòu bié huílai le, búyòng dānxīn jiā li.
Son, go to the city and study hard, then get a good job. Don't come back later, and don't worry about home.
北京生活不是挺好的吗？回村子干啥？在这儿能有什么出息？快回去。
Běijīng shēnghuó bú shì tǐng hǎo de ma? Huí cūnzi gàn shá? Zài zhèr néng yǒu shénme chūxi? Kuài huíqu.
Isn't life in Beijing good? Why come back to the village? What future is there here? Go back.
我太喜欢北京了，尤其是北京的胡同四合院。当然，还有北京的小吃。
Wǒ tài xǐhuan Běijīng le, yóuqí shì Běijīng de hútòng sìhéyuàn. Dāngrán, hái yǒu Běijīng de xiǎochī.
I love Beijing so much, especially the hutongs and courtyard houses. And of course the snacks.
你知道吗？有很多老外喜欢住在北京的四合院里，而且一住就是好几年呢。
Nǐ zhīdao ma? Yǒu hěn duō lǎowài xǐhuan zhù zài Běijīng de sìhéyuàn li, érqiě yí zhù jiù shì hǎo jǐ nián ne.
Did you know? Lots of foreigners like living in Beijing courtyard houses, and they stay for years.
老二，真想不明白。你好不容易考出去，又有了稳定的工作，怎么又回来了呢？
Lǎo'èr, zhēn xiǎng bu míngbai. Nǐ hǎobùróngyì kǎo chuqu, yòu yǒu le wěndìng de gōngzuò, zěnme yòu huílai le ne?
Number Two, I just don't get it. You worked so hard to get out, you had a steady job. Why come back?
这间房子也太破了，根本不能住人啊。
Zhè jiān fángzi yě tài pò le, gēnběn bù néng zhù rén a.
This room is far too run-down. Nobody could live here.
我们村近几年变化可大了。家家都有自来水，还安了彩电、冰箱，村民生活比以前好多了。
Wǒmen cūn jìnjǐnián biànhuà kě dà le. Jiā jiā dōu yǒu zìláishuǐ, hái ān le cǎidiàn, bīngxiāng, cūnmín shēnghuó bǐ yǐqián hǎo duō le.
Our village has changed a lot in the last few years. Every home has running water, a colour TV and a fridge. Life is much better than before.

grammar: 太过分了
that's going too far
An indignant exclamation.
什么？房地产开发商要在我们胡同旁边建高楼？太过分了，咱们可不能同意。
Shénme? Fángdìchǎn kāifāshāng yào zài wǒmen hútòng pángbiān jiàn gāolóu? Tài guòfèn le, zánmen kě bù néng tóngyì.
What? The developers want to put up a tower block next to our hutong? That's outrageous. We mustn't agree to it.
你这样做太过分了。
Nǐ zhèyàng zuò tài guòfèn le.
You've gone too far.
可是……
I'll have you know …
可 + 是 stresses a fact.
刘教授设计的房子得的可是国际大奖，不是一般的奖。
Liú jiàoshòu shèjì de fángzi dé de kěshì guójì dàjiǎng, bú shì yìbān de jiǎng.
The house Professor Liu designed won an international award, I'll have you know. Not just any award.
这可是好东西。
Zhè kěshì hǎo dōngxi.
This is good stuff, you know.
不是挺……的吗？
isn't it pretty …?
A rhetorical question.
北京生活不是挺好的吗？回村子干啥？在这儿能有什么出息？快回去。
Běijīng shēnghuó bú shì tǐng hǎo de ma? Huí cūnzi gàn shá? Zài zhèr néng yǒu shénme chūxi? Kuài huíqu.
Isn't life in Beijing good? Why come back to the village? What future is there here? Go back.
这不是挺好的吗？
Zhè bú shì tǐng hǎo de ma?
Isn't this pretty good?
一V就是……
once …, it's for …
Stresses a long duration.
你知道吗？有很多老外喜欢住在北京的四合院里，而且一住就是好几年呢。
Nǐ zhīdao ma? Yǒu hěn duō lǎowài xǐhuan zhù zài Běijīng de sìhéyuàn li, érqiě yí zhù jiù shì hǎo jǐ nián ne.
Did you know? Lots of foreigners like living in Beijing courtyard houses, and they stay for years.
他一睡就是十个小时。
Tā yí shuì jiùshì shí ge xiǎoshí.
Once he's asleep, it's ten hours.
好不容易
with great difficulty
Something was hard to achieve.
老二，真想不明白。你好不容易考出去，又有了稳定的工作，怎么又回来了呢？
Lǎo'èr, zhēn xiǎng bu míngbai. Nǐ hǎobùróngyì kǎo chuqu, yòu yǒu le wěndìng de gōngzuò, zěnme yòu huílai le ne?
Number Two, I just don't get it. You worked so hard to get out, you had a steady job. Why come back?
我好不容易才找到你。
Wǒ hǎobùróngyì cái zhǎodào nǐ.
It took me ages to find you.
也太……了
far too …
也 adds emphasis.
这间房子也太破了，根本不能住人啊。
Zhè jiān fángzi yě tài pò le, gēnběn bù néng zhù rén a.
This room is far too run-down. Nobody could live here.
这也太贵了。
Zhè yě tài guì le.
That's far too expensive.
gaps: 要在我们胡同旁边建高楼？
say: Our son's got into university!
What? The developers want to put up a tower block next to our hutong? That's outrageous. We mustn't agree to it.
Isn't life in Beijing good? Why come back to the village? What future is there here? Go back.

152.title: Opening a restaurant in a hutong
152.sub: A reporter asks a restaurant owner why she came back to the hutong
152.transcriptNote: Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone. 问 is the reporter and 答 is the restaurant owner. This is natural speech, lightly tidied.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听对话并模仿 · Listen and imitate
lines: 听对话并模仿说话人的语气。
Tīng duìhuà bìng mófǎng shuōhuàrén de yǔqì.
Listen to the dialogue and copy the speakers' tone.

blocks.label: 对话
blocks.h: 胡同里的饭店 · The hutong restaurant
lines: 您为什么选择在这条胡同里开饭店呢？
Nín wèishénme xuǎnzé zài zhè tiáo hútòng li kāi fàndiàn ne?
Why did you choose to open a restaurant in this hutong?
问
就是特别喜欢胡同。胡同里生活节奏慢，邻居之间关系也不错。
Jiùshì tèbié xǐhuan hútòng. Hútòng li shēnghuó jiézòu màn, línjū zhījiān guānxi yě búcuò.
I just love hutongs. Life is slow here, and neighbours get on well.
答
其实我小时候也是在胡同里长大的，后来就搬家了。
Qíshí wǒ xiǎoshíhou yě shì zài hútòng li zhǎngdà de, hòulái jiù bān jiā le.
In fact I grew up in a hutong too, but later we moved.
答
现在的胡同和以前有什么不一样吗？
Xiànzài de hútòng hé yǐqián yǒu shénme bù yíyàng ma?
Are hutongs different now from before?
问
变化太大了。我以前住的胡同里，院子都那么旧，没想到可以改造成今天这样。
Biànhuà tài dà le. Wǒ yǐqián zhù de hútòng li, yuànzi dōu nàme jiù, méi xiǎngdào kěyǐ gǎizào chéng jīntiān zhèyàng.
They've changed enormously. In the hutong I used to live in, the courtyards were so old. I never imagined they could be renovated like this.
答
所以我就又回来了。
Suǒyǐ wǒ jiù yòu huílai le.
So I came back.
答
那在胡同里开饭店，您投资又大，能赚钱吗？
Nà zài hútòng li kāi fàndiàn, nín tóuzī yòu dà, néng zhuànqián ma?
But opening a restaurant in a hutong is a big investment. Can you make money?
问
我觉得胡同里的游客大部分应该是老外。
Wǒ juéde hútòng li de yóukè dà bùfen yīnggāi shì lǎowài.
I think most of the tourists in the hutongs are foreigners.
答
然后来胡同里参观的人应该都比较喜欢那种过去的感觉。
Ránhòu lái hútòng li cānguān de rén yīnggāi dōu bǐjiào xǐhuan nà zhǒng guòqu de gǎnjué.
And people who come to see the hutongs probably like that old-time feel.
答
所以我的饭店就是以素菜为主，菜里面很多都是地地道道的老北京菜。
Suǒyǐ wǒ de fàndiàn jiùshì yǐ sùcài wéi zhǔ, cài lǐmiàn hěn duō dōu shì dìdìdàodào de lǎo Běijīng cài.
So my restaurant serves mainly vegetable dishes, and many of them are authentic old Beijing dishes.
答

153.title: The migrating bird
153.sub: A story: Qiusheng, a migrant worker's son in Shanghai, goes home for Spring Festival
153.transcriptNote: A long story from the textbook about the children of migrant workers. 城中村 is an "urban village", an old village swallowed by the city. The recording mispronounces the boy's name in places; it's 秋生 throughout.

blocks.label: 一
lines: 候鸟。
Hòuniǎo.
The migrating bird.
秋生一直觉得自己像只候鸟。
Qiūshēng yìzhí juéde zìjǐ xiàng zhī hòuniǎo.
Qiusheng had always felt like a migrating bird.
小时候在老家跟爷爷奶奶住，
Xiǎoshíhou zài lǎojiā gēn yéye nǎinai zhù,
As a small child he lived with his grandparents back home,
每年春节，都盼着在外地打工的父母带着新衣和糖果回来。
měinián Chūn Jié, dōu pàn zhe zài wàidì dǎ gōng de fùmǔ dài zhe xīn yī hé tángguǒ huílai.
and every Spring Festival he longed for his parents, working far away, to come home with new clothes and sweets.
爷爷奶奶去世以后，秋生便跟着父母住，
Yéye nǎinai qùshì yǐhòu, Qiūshēng biàn gēnzhe fùmǔ zhù,
After his grandparents died, Qiusheng went to live with his parents,
不断地从一个城市搬到另一个。
búduàn de cóng yí ge chéngshì bān dào lìng yí ge.
moving again and again from one city to another.
后来家里多了个弟弟。
Hòulái jiā li duō le ge dìdi.
Later the family gained a little brother.
九岁那年，他们全家终于在上海稳定下来了，
Jiǔ suì nà nián, tāmen quán jiā zhōngyú zài Shànghǎi wěndìng xialai le,
The year he was nine, the whole family finally settled in Shanghai,
住在一个叫幸福村的城中村里，周围都是高楼。
zhù zài yí ge jiào Xìngfú Cūn de chéngzhōngcūn li, zhōuwéi dōu shì gāolóu.
living in an urban village called Happiness Village, surrounded by tower blocks.

blocks.label: 二
lines: 幸福村原来有一大片农田，种着各种蔬菜和果树。
Xìngfú Cūn yuánlái yǒu yí dà piàn nóngtián, zhǒng zhe gè zhǒng shūcài hé guǒshù.
Happiness Village once had a large stretch of farmland, growing all kinds of vegetables and fruit trees.
后来这一带被划进了城区，
Hòulái zhè yídài bèi huà jìn le chéngqū,
Later the area was absorbed into the city,
农田上建起了一座现代化的电子工厂。
nóngtián shàng jiàn qǐ le yí zuò xiàndàihuà de diànzi gōngchǎng.
and a modern electronics factory was built on the farmland.
慢慢地，到这里租房的打工者越来越多，
Mànmàn de, dào zhèli zū fáng de dǎ gōng zhě yuèláiyuè duō,
Gradually, more and more migrant workers came to rent rooms here,
许多本地的农民也靠出租房子为生。
xǔduō běndì de nóngmín yě kào chūzū fángzi wéishēng.
and many local farmers made a living by renting out their houses.
城中村的房子拥挤破旧，道路很窄，环境脏乱，
Chéngzhōngcūn de fángzi yōngjǐ pòjiù, dàolù hěn zhǎi, huánjìng zāngluàn,
The houses in the urban village were crowded and run-down, the streets narrow, the place dirty and messy;
居住人员很杂，治安也比较差。
jūzhù rényuán hěn zá, zhì'ān yě bǐjiào chà.
the residents were a mixed crowd, and public safety was rather poor.

blocks.label: 三
lines: 秋生的母亲就在这家电子工厂打工，
Qiūshēng de mǔqin jiù zài zhè jiā diànzi gōngchǎng dǎ gōng,
Qiusheng's mother worked in that electronics factory;
父亲当清洁工，在附近打扫街道。
fùqin dāng qīngjiégōng, zài fùjìn dǎsǎo jiēdào.
his father was a street cleaner, sweeping the streets nearby.
每天早上天还没亮，秋生的父母就出门了。
Měitiān zǎoshang tiān hái méi liàng, Qiūshēng de fùmǔ jiù chūmén le.
Every morning, before it was light, Qiusheng's parents went out.
秋生熟练地把弟弟叫醒，穿上衣服，
Qiūshēng shúliàn de bǎ dìdi jiàoxǐng, chuānshang yīfu,
Qiusheng would expertly wake his brother and get him dressed,
再把前一晚的剩菜剩饭热一下。
zài bǎ qián yì wǎn de shèngcài shèngfàn rè yíxià.
then heat up the leftovers from the night before.
兄弟俩吃完早饭，锁好门，
Xiōngdì liǎ chī wán zǎofàn, suǒ hǎo mén,
The two brothers ate breakfast and locked the door,
然后一前一后地走路去离家五站地的学校上学。
ránhòu yì qián yí hòu de zǒu lù qù lí jiā wǔ zhàn dì de xuéxiào shàng xué.
then walked, one behind the other, to their school five stops away.
清晨，马路上车还不多，行人们匆匆忙忙地走过。
Qīngchén, mǎlù shang chē hái bù duō, xíngrén men cōngcōng máng máng de zǒuguò.
Early in the morning there weren't many cars yet, and people hurried past.
秋生常常觉得，城里人太严肃，
Qiūshēng chángcháng juéde, chéngli rén tài yánsù,
Qiusheng often felt that city people were too serious,
不像在老家，那儿的人脸上都带着亲切的微笑。
bú xiàng zài lǎojiā, nàr de rén liǎn shàng dōu dài zhe qīnqiè de wēixiào.
not like back home, where people always wore friendly smiles.

blocks.label: 四
lines: 秋生的母亲常说他命好，
Qiūshēng de mǔqin cháng shuō tā mìng hǎo,
Qiusheng's mother often said he was lucky:
虽然念的不是公立学校，而是专门给民工子女办的学校，
suīrán niàn de bú shì gōnglìxuéxiào, érshì zhuānmén gěi míngōng zǐnǚ bàn de xuéxiào,
though he didn't go to a state school but to one set up specially for migrant workers' children,
一到上海就可以念书，已经很不错了。
yí dào Shànghǎi jiù kěyǐ niànshū, yǐjīng hěn búcuò le.
being able to go to school as soon as he got to Shanghai was already pretty good.
邻居老李的儿子也想在上海念书，还没有学校愿意收呢。
Línjū Lǎo Lǐ de érzi yě xiǎng zài Shànghǎi niànshū, hái méi yǒu xuéxiào yuànyì shōu ne.
Their neighbour Old Li's son wanted to go to school in Shanghai too, and no school would take him.
秋生的父亲常常警告他，
Qiūshēng de fùqin chángcháng jǐnggào tā,
Qiusheng's father often warned him
在老家已经没有田了，即使想当农民都当不了了。
zài lǎojiā yǐjīng méiyǒu tián le, jíshǐ xiǎng dāng nóngmín dōu dāng bu liǎo le.
that there was no more land back home; even if he wanted to be a farmer, he couldn't.
秋生只有念书这一条路，
Qiūshēng zhǐyǒu niànshū zhè yì tiáo lù,
Studying was Qiusheng's only way forward;
否则以后只能像他一样扫大街，从早扫到晚，当一辈子临时工。
fǒuzé yǐhòu zhǐ néng xiàng tā yíyàng sǎo dàjiē, cóng zǎo sǎo dào wǎn, dāng yíbèizi línshígōng.
otherwise he'd end up like his father, sweeping the streets from morning till night, a temp worker all his life.

blocks.label: 五
lines: 秋生不怕扫大街。
Qiūshēng bú pà sǎo dàjiē.
Qiusheng wasn't afraid of sweeping streets.
有时候放学早，他会去帮父亲扫地，捡捡垃圾，
Yǒushíhou fàngxué zǎo, tā huì qù bāng fùqin sǎodì, jiǎn jiǎn lājī,
Sometimes, when school finished early, he'd help his father sweep and pick up rubbish,
把可回收的垃圾分类，
bǎ kěhuíshōu de lājī fēnlèi,
sort out the recyclables,
再拖到废品回收站去卖几个钱。
zài tuō dào fèipǐn huíshōu zhàn qù mài jǐ ge qián.
and drag them to the recycling depot to sell for a bit of money.
大部分的钱他会交给母亲，
Dà bùfen de qián tā huì jiāogěi mǔqin,
Most of the money he'd give to his mother,
但有时也会偷偷留下几块钱来买零食。
dàn yǒushí yě huì tōutōu liúxia jǐ kuài qián lái mǎi língshí.
but sometimes he'd secretly keep a few yuan for snacks.
秋生最怕的是父亲送他走。
Qiūshēng zuì pà de shì fùqin sòng tā zǒu.
What Qiusheng feared most was his father sending him away.
有时考得不好，父亲会很生气地说，要送他回乡下去。
Yǒushí kǎo de bù hǎo, fùqin huì hěn shēngqì de shuō, yào sòng tā huí xiāngxia qu.
When his exam results were poor, his father would say angrily that he'd send him back to the countryside.
秋生不想再跟父母分开。
Qiūshēng bù xiǎng zài gēn fùmǔ fēnkāi.
Qiusheng didn't want to be separated from his parents again.

blocks.label: 六
lines: 十二岁了，才念小学四年级，秋生觉得有点抬不起头。
Shí'èr suì le, cái niàn xiǎoxué sì niánjí, Qiūshēng juéde yǒudiǎn tái bu qǐ tóu.
Twelve years old and only in Year 4: Qiusheng felt rather ashamed.
但总的来说，学校让他觉得愉快。
Dàn zǒng de lái shuō, xuéxiào ràng tā juéde yúkuài.
But on the whole, school made him happy.
学校有不少活动，有时还会组织他们去外面参观展览什么的。
Xuéxiào yǒu bù shǎo huódòng, yǒushí hái huì zǔzhī tāmen qù wàimian cānguān zhǎnlǎn shénme de.
There were plenty of activities, and sometimes they were taken out to see exhibitions and so on.
秋生在学校里有不少小伙伴，铁蛋跟他最谈得来。
Qiūshēng zài xuéxiào li yǒu bù shǎo xiǎo huǒbàn, Tiědàn gēn tā zuì tán de lái.
Qiusheng had quite a few friends at school; Tiedan was the one he got on with best.
跟秋生一样，铁蛋也是从乡下来的。
Gēn Qiūshēng yíyàng, Tiědàn yě shì cóng xiāngxia lái de.
Like Qiusheng, Tiedan came from the countryside.
但跟秋生不一样的是，铁蛋觉得上海什么都比老家好，
Dàn gēn Qiūshēng bù yíyàng de shì, Tiědàn juéde Shànghǎi shénme dōu bǐ lǎojiā hǎo,
But unlike Qiusheng, Tiedan thought everything in Shanghai was better than back home:
新鲜，刺激，好玩。
xīnxiān, cìjī, hǎowán.
new, exciting, fun.
而秋生常忍不住想念老家，
Ér Qiūshēng cháng rěnbúzhù xiǎngniàn lǎojiā,
Qiusheng, though, often couldn't help missing home,
想念那种上树抓鸟、下河摸鱼，自由自在、无忧无虑的日子。
xiǎngniàn nà zhǒng shàng shù zhuā niǎo, xià hé mō yú, zìyóuzìzài, wú yōu wú lǜ de rìzi.
missing those days of climbing trees to catch birds and wading in the river for fish, free and carefree.
不上课的时候，秋生会去打打篮球，
Bú shàng kè de shíhou, Qiūshēng huì qù dǎ dǎ lánqiú,
When there were no lessons, Qiusheng would play a bit of basketball,
跟铁蛋在学校旁边的工地上玩泥沙打仗、捉迷藏，
gēn Tiědàn zài xuéxiào pángbiān de gōngdì shang wán níshā dǎzhàng, zhuō mícáng,
have mud fights and play hide-and-seek with Tiedan on the building site next to the school,
或者凑钱去网吧打游戏。
huòzhě còu qián qù wǎngba dǎ yóuxì.
or pool their money to play games at an internet café.
听说校园马上就要被拆迁了，这里会建起一座商业中心。
Tīngshuō xiàoyuán mǎshàng jiù yào bèi chāiqiān le, zhèli huì jiàn qǐ yí zuò shāngyè zhōngxīn.
He heard the school would soon be demolished and a shopping centre built there.
不知道以后还能不能跟铁蛋同校了。
Bù zhīdao yǐhòu hái néng bù néng gēn Tiědàn tóngxiào le.
Who knew whether he'd still be at the same school as Tiedan?
偶尔想到这个，秋生就觉得很失落。
Ǒu'ěr xiǎngdào zhège, Qiūshēng jiù juéde hěn shīluò.
Whenever he thought of this, Qiusheng felt very low.

blocks.label: 七
lines: 春节前两天，秋生兄弟俩跟着父母，带着大大小小的行李和包裹挤火车，
Chūn Jié qián liǎng tiān, Qiūshēng xiōngdì liǎ gēnzhe fùmǔ, dài zhe dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de xínglǐ hé bāoguǒ jǐ huǒchē,
Two days before Spring Festival, Qiusheng and his brother squeezed onto a train with their parents and bags and bundles of every size,
然后换了一次长途汽车，又走路翻过了一座小山，
ránhòu huàn le yí cì chángtú qìchē, yòu zǒu lù fānguò le yí zuò xiǎo shān,
then changed to a long-distance bus, then walked over a hill,
回到了位于山里的老家。
huídào le wèiyú shān li de lǎojiā.
and arrived at their home in the mountains.
这里贫穷而落后。
Zhèli pínqióng ér luòhòu.
It was poor and backward.
许多孩子跑到村口迎接他们。
Xǔduō háizi pǎo dào cūn kǒu yíngjiē tāmen.
Lots of children ran to the village entrance to greet them.
因为是从上海回来的，村里人常常羡慕地围着他们问这问那。
Yīnwèi shì cóng Shànghǎi huílai de, cūn li rén chángcháng xiànmù de wéizhe tāmen wèn zhè wèn nà.
Because they'd come back from Shanghai, the villagers crowded round them enviously, asking about this and that.
秋生却不太开心。
Qiūshēng què bú tài kāixīn.
But Qiusheng wasn't very happy.
他发现自己变了。
Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ biàn le.
He found he had changed.
在上海时，他那么想念小时候在农村的生活，
Zài Shànghǎi shí, tā nàme xiǎngniàn xiǎoshíhou zài nóngcūn de shēnghuó,
In Shanghai he had missed his childhood life in the countryside so much;
现在，他却开始嫌房子破，嫌路上的泥弄脏了新鞋子，
xiànzài, tā què kāishǐ xián fángzi pò, xián lùshàng de ní nòngzāng le xīn xiézi,
now he started to grumble that the houses were shabby, that the mud on the paths dirtied his new shoes,
嫌没有篮球场，也没有网络，觉得很无聊。
xián méiyǒu lánqiúchǎng, yě méiyǒu wǎngluò, juéde hěn wúliáo.
that there was no basketball court and no internet. He was bored.
村里人取笑他：变成上海人了！
Cūn li rén qǔxiào tā: biànchéng Shànghǎi rén le!
The villagers teased him: "You've turned into a Shanghainese!"
不知怎么的，秋生听了有点生气。
Bù zhī zěnme de, Qiūshēng tīng le yǒudiǎn shēngqì.
Somehow, hearing this made Qiusheng a bit angry.

blocks.label: 八
lines: 他觉得自己对家乡是有感情的，
Tā juéde zìjǐ duì jiāxiāng shì yǒu gǎnqíng de,
He felt he did care about his home village,
但他不再是原来那个他了。
dàn tā bú zài shì yuánlái nàge tā le.
but he was no longer the boy he had been.
现在算是上海人吗？好像也不算。
Xiànzài suànshì Shànghǎi rén ma? Hǎoxiàng yě búsuàn.
Did he count as a Shanghainese now? Not really, it seemed.
究竟自己属于哪里呢？
Jiūjìng zìjǐ shǔyú nǎli ne?
Where did he really belong?
这个问题一直困扰着他，他找不到答案。
Zhège wèntí yìzhí kùnrǎo zhe tā, tā zhǎo bu dào dá'àn.
The question kept troubling him, and he couldn't find an answer.
秋生没有目的地在村子里闲逛，
Qiūshēng méiyǒu mùdì de zài cūnzi li xiánguàng,
Qiusheng wandered aimlessly round the village;
转了几个弯，不知不觉地就到了河岸边。
zhuǎn le jǐ ge wān, bù zhī bù jué de jiù dào le hé ànbiān.
after a few turns, without noticing, he reached the riverbank.
抬头一看，正好有一群鸟儿从空中飞过。
Táitóu yí kàn, zhènghǎo yǒu yì qún niǎor cóng kōngzhōng fēiguò.
He looked up just as a flock of birds flew overhead.
秋生有一种感觉始终没变，
Qiūshēng yǒu yì zhǒng gǎnjué shǐzhōng méi biàn,
One feeling of Qiusheng's never changed:
那就是，自己还是一只找家的候鸟。
nà jiùshì, zìjǐ háishi yì zhī zhǎo jiā de hòuniǎo.
he was still a migrating bird looking for home.

grammar: 多了个……
gained a …
多 + 了 = there's one more.
后来家里多了个弟弟。
Hòulái jiā li duō le ge dìdi.
Later the family gained a little brother.
班里多了个新同学。
Bān li duō le ge xīn tóngxué.
The class has a new pupil.
靠……为生
to make a living by …
靠 = rely on.
许多本地的农民也靠出租房子为生。
xǔduō běndì de nóngmín yě kào chūzū fángzi wéishēng.
and many local farmers made a living by renting out their houses.
他靠写作为生。
Tā kào xiězuò wéishēng.
He makes a living by writing.
不是……，而是……
not …, but …
Corrects or contrasts.
虽然念的不是公立学校，而是专门给民工子女办的学校，
suīrán niàn de bú shì gōnglìxuéxiào, érshì zhuānmén gěi míngōng zǐnǚ bàn de xuéxiào,
though he didn't go to a state school but to one set up specially for migrant workers' children,
他不是老师，而是学生。
Tā bú shì lǎoshī, érshì xuésheng.
He's not a teacher but a student.
即使……都……
even if … still …
A strong concession.
在老家已经没有田了，即使想当农民都当不了了。
zài lǎojiā yǐjīng méiyǒu tián le, jíshǐ xiǎng dāng nóngmín dōu dāng bu liǎo le.
that there was no more land back home; even if he wanted to be a farmer, he couldn't.
即使下雨我也去。
Jíshǐ xià yǔ wǒ yě qù.
I'll go even if it rains.
否则
otherwise
Introduces the consequence.
否则以后只能像他一样扫大街，从早扫到晚，当一辈子临时工。
fǒuzé yǐhòu zhǐ néng xiàng tā yíyàng sǎo dàjiē, cóng zǎo sǎo dào wǎn, dāng yíbèizi línshígōng.
otherwise he'd end up like his father, sweeping the streets from morning till night, a temp worker all his life.
快走，否则要迟到了。
Kuài zǒu, fǒuzé yào chídào le.
Hurry, or we'll be late.
从早V到晚
V from morning to night
A time span.
否则以后只能像他一样扫大街，从早扫到晚，当一辈子临时工。
fǒuzé yǐhòu zhǐ néng xiàng tā yíyàng sǎo dàjiē, cóng zǎo sǎo dào wǎn, dāng yíbèizi línshígōng.
otherwise he'd end up like his father, sweeping the streets from morning till night, a temp worker all his life.
他从早忙到晚。
Tā cóng zǎo máng dào wǎn.
He's busy from morning to night.
忍不住
can't help (doing)
Followed by a verb.
而秋生常忍不住想念老家，
Ér Qiūshēng cháng rěnbúzhù xiǎngniàn lǎojiā,
Qiusheng, though, often couldn't help missing home,
她忍不住笑了。
Tā rěnbúzhù xiào le.
She couldn't help laughing.
to find fault with …
嫌 + thing/clause.
现在，他却开始嫌房子破，嫌路上的泥弄脏了新鞋子，
xiànzài, tā què kāishǐ xián fángzi pò, xián lùshàng de ní nòngzāng le xīn xiézi,
now he started to grumble that the houses were shabby, that the mud on the paths dirtied his new shoes,
他嫌菜太咸。
Tā xián cài tài xián.
He thinks the food is too salty.
究竟
exactly, after all
Strengthens a question.
究竟自己属于哪里呢？
Jiūjìng zìjǐ shǔyú nǎli ne?
Where did he really belong?
你究竟想去哪儿？
Nǐ jiūjìng xiǎng qù nǎr?
Where exactly do you want to go?
gaps: 秋生一直觉得自己像只
许多本地的农民也靠出租房子
破旧，道路很窄，环境脏乱
偶尔想到这个，秋生就觉得很
秋生没有目的地在村子里
say: Qiusheng had always felt like a migrating bird.
Did he count as a Shanghainese now? Not really, it seemed.

154.title: The gains and losses of urbanisation
154.sub: A TV interview with Professor Xu, an expert on urbanisation
154.transcriptNote: A studio interview. 主 is the presenter and 徐 is Professor Xu. Near the end the presenter quotes a few lines from 心里话, a modern poem recited by migrant workers' children at the Spring Festival Gala. Those lines are left out here because the poem is copyrighted; the gap is at about 4:57–5:04. Who says which short line is my judgement.

blocks.label: 引子
lines: 城市化的得与失。
Chéngshìhuà de dé yǔ shī.
The gains and losses of urbanisation.
主
每到春节前后，北京、上海这样的大城市就会变成空城。
Měi dào Chūn Jié qiánhòu, Běijīng, Shànghǎi zhèyàng de dà chéngshì jiù huì biànchéng kōng chéng.
Every year around Spring Festival, big cities like Beijing and Shanghai turn into empty cities.
主
地铁不挤了，公交车空了，马路不堵了，停车不用抢车位了，
Dìtiě bù jǐ le, gōngjiāochē kōng le, mǎlù bù dǔ le, tíngchē búyòng qiǎng chēwèi le,
The underground isn't packed, the buses are empty, the roads aren't jammed, and you don't have to fight for a parking space.
主
大街上的行人变少了。这是因为外地人都返回家乡过年了。
dà jiē shang de xíngrén biàn shǎo le. Zhè shì yīnwèi wàidìrén dōu fǎnhuí jiāxiāng guò nián le.
There are fewer people on the streets. That's because people from elsewhere have all gone home for the New Year.
主
据统计，在一线城市，大约百分之四十的人来自外地。
Jù tǒngjì, zài yīxiàn chéngshì, dàyuē bǎi fēn zhī sìshí de rén láizì wàidì.
According to statistics, about 40% of people in first-tier cities come from elsewhere.
主
在一九八零年，中国城市人口只有两亿，三十年后达到了七亿。
Zài yī jiǔ bā líng nián, Zhōngguó chéngshì rénkǒu zhǐyǒu liǎng yì, sānshí nián hòu dádào le qī yì.
In 1980 China's urban population was only 200 million; thirty years later it reached 700 million.
主
也就是说，整整五亿人离开了农村，进入城市。
Yě jiù shì shuō, zhěngzhěng wǔ yì rén líkāi le nóngcūn, jìnrù chéngshì.
In other words, a full 500 million people left the countryside for the cities.
主
有人把这称为人类历史上最大的移民潮。
Yǒu rén bǎ zhè chēngwéi rénlèi lìshǐ shàng zuì dà de yímín cháo.
Some call this the greatest wave of migration in human history.
主
城市化带给了我们什么？
Chéngshìhuà dàigěi le wǒmen shénme?
What has urbanisation brought us?
主
今天我们请到了城市化问题研究专家徐教授跟我们一起讨论。
Jīntiān wǒmen qǐng dào le chéngshìhuà wèntí yánjiū zhuānjiā Xú jiàoshòu gēn wǒmen yìqǐ tǎolùn.
Today we've invited Professor Xu, an expert on urbanisation, to discuss it with us.
主

blocks.label: 收获
blocks.h: 喜：城市化的收获 · The gains
lines: 谢谢各位。今天我受到邀请来到这里，感到非常荣幸。
Xièxiè gèwèi. Jīntiān wǒ shòudào yāoqǐng láidào zhèli, gǎndào fēicháng róngxìng.
Thank you, everyone. I'm very honoured to have been invited here today.
徐
我认为对城市化这个现象要客观地看。
Wǒ rènwéi duì chéngshìhuà zhège xiànxiàng yào kèguān de kàn.
I think we need to look at urbanisation objectively.
徐
那您能否给这几十年的城市化做一个简单的总结？
Nà nín néngfǒu gěi zhè jǐshí nián de chéngshìhuà zuò yí ge jiǎndān de zǒngjié?
Could you give us a brief summary of the last few decades of urbanisation?
主
好的。中国城市化过程中有喜有忧。
Hǎo de. Zhōngguó chéngshìhuà guòchéng zhōng yǒu xǐ yǒu yōu.
Certainly. China's urbanisation has brought both joys and worries.
徐
首先应该肯定它的收获。
Shǒuxiān yīnggāi kěndìng tā de shōuhuò.
First, we should acknowledge what it has achieved.
徐
城市化使中国经济高速增长，提高了就业率以及生活质量。
Chéngshìhuà shǐ Zhōngguó jīngjì gāosù zēngzhǎng, tígāo le jiùyèlǜ yǐjí shēnghuó zhìliàng.
Urbanisation has made China's economy grow fast, and raised employment and the quality of life.
徐
这些年来，中国进行了大规模的基础建设，
Zhèxiē niánlái, Zhōngguó jìnxíng le dàguīmó de jīchǔ jiànshè,
Over these years China has carried out large-scale infrastructure building,
徐
包括污水处理、自来水、电力、机场、高速公路、桥、学校、医院、网络等等。
bāokuò wūshuǐ chǔlǐ, zìláishuǐ, diànlì, jīchǎng, gāosùgōnglù, qiáo, xuéxiào, yīyuàn, wǎngluò děngděng.
including sewage treatment, running water, electricity, airports, motorways, bridges, schools, hospitals, networks and so on.
徐
中国在总体上的变化非常大。
Zhōngguó zài zǒngtǐ shàng de biànhuà fēicháng dà.
Overall, China has changed enormously.
徐
如果没有城市化，今天的环境可能会更糟糕。
Rúguǒ méiyǒu chéngshìhuà, jīntiān de huánjìng kěnéng huì gèng zāogāo.
Without urbanisation, the environment today might be even worse.
徐
另外啊——
Lìngwài a——
Also—
徐
不好意思，打断一下。徐教授，您的意思是说，城市化保护了环境？能不能说得具体一点？
Bù hǎoyìsi, dǎduàn yíxià. Xú jiàoshòu, nín de yìsi shì shuō, chéngshìhuà bǎohù le huánjìng? Néng bù néng shuō de jùtǐ yìdiǎn?
Sorry to interrupt. Professor Xu, you mean urbanisation has protected the environment? Could you be more specific?
主
好的。城市化先把各种资源集中起来，然后根据实际的需求进行分配。
Hǎo de. Chéngshìhuà xiān bǎ gè zhǒng zīyuán jízhōng qǐlái, ránhòu gēnjù shíjì de xūqiú jìnxíng fēnpèi.
Yes. Urbanisation first concentrates all kinds of resources, then distributes them according to real need.
徐
这样呢，就提高了资源的利用率和使用范围，避免了浪费。
Zhèyàng ne, jiù tígāo le zīyuán de lìyòng lǜ hé shǐyòng fànwéi, bìmiǎn le làngfèi.
That raises how efficiently and how widely resources are used, and avoids waste.
徐
这就是对环境保护的一种贡献。
Zhè jiùshì duì huánjìng bǎohù de yì zhǒng gòngxiàn.
That is a contribution to protecting the environment.
徐
好的，请您继续说。
Hǎo de, qǐng nín jìxù shuō.
I see. Please go on.
主
另外，城市化使中国农村和城市的差距逐渐缩小了，也使中国和世界的差距缩小了。
Lìngwài, chéngshìhuà shǐ Zhōngguó nóngcūn hé chéngshì de chājù zhújiàn suōxiǎo le, yě shǐ Zhōngguó hé shìjiè de chājù suōxiǎo le.
Also, urbanisation has gradually narrowed the gap between China's countryside and cities, and between China and the world.
徐
今天，中国的一线城市已经比较发达了。
Jīntiān, Zhōngguó de yīxiàn chéngshì yǐjīng bǐjiào fādá le.
Today, China's first-tier cities are fairly developed.
徐

blocks.label: 代价
blocks.h: 忧：城市化的代价 · The costs
lines: 谢谢徐教授。我还是想回到刚才关于环境的问题上来，因为这方面的批评声音最多也最大。
Xièxiè Xú jiàoshòu. Wǒ háishi xiǎng huídào gāngcái guānyú huánjìng de wèntí shanglai, yīnwèi zhè fāngmiàn de pīpíng shēngyīn zuìduō yě zuì dà.
Thank you, Professor Xu. I'd like to go back to the environment, because that's where the criticism is most frequent and loudest.
主
是这样的。中国城市化确实付出了巨大的代价。
Shì zhèyàng de. Zhōngguó chéngshìhuà quèshí fùchū le jùdà de dàijià.
That's true. China's urbanisation has indeed come at a huge cost.
徐
第一个就是环境的代价。
Dì-yī ge jiùshì huánjìng de dàijià.
The first is the cost to the environment.
徐
在相当长的一段时间内，我们过于强调城市化对经济增长的贡献，
Zài xiāngdāng cháng de yí duàn shíjiān nèi, wǒmen guòyú qiángdiào chéngshìhuà duì jīngjì zēngzhǎng de gòngxiàn,
For quite a long time, we overemphasised urbanisation's contribution to economic growth,
徐
但没有充分地考虑能增长多久，以及增长的目的是什么。
dàn méiyǒu chōngfèn de kǎolǜ néng zēngzhǎng duōjiǔ, yǐjí zēngzhǎng de mùdì shì shénme.
without fully considering how long growth could last, or what growth was for.
徐
今天，污染、破坏环境所造成的后果已经摆在眼前了。
Jīntiān, wūrǎn, pòhuài huánjìng suǒ zàochéng de hòuguǒ yǐjīng bǎi zài yǎnqián le.
Today, the consequences of pollution and environmental damage are right in front of us.
徐
好几代人都得承受这种后果。这是沉重的、深刻的教训。
Hǎo jǐ dài rén dōu děi chéngshòu zhè zhǒng hòuguǒ. Zhè shì chénzhòng de, shēnkè de jiàoxùn.
Several generations will have to bear them. It's a heavy, profound lesson.
徐
在今后的发展中，应该吸取这个教训。所以，现在强调可持续性发展。
Zài jīnhòu de fāzhǎn zhōng, yīnggāi xīqǔ zhège jiàoxùn. Suǒyǐ, xiànzài qiángdiào kěchíxùxìng fāzhǎn.
We must learn from it in future development. That's why sustainable development is stressed now.
徐
第二个代价呢，就是对历史文化的破坏。
Dì-èr ge dàijià ne, jiùshì duì lìshǐ wénhuà de pòhuài.
The second cost is the damage to history and culture.
徐
由于大规模地拆除旧城、建设新城，许多城市几乎成了建设工地。
Yóuyú dàguīmó de chāichú jiù chéng, jiànshè xīnchéng, xǔduō chéngshì jīhū chéng le jiànshè gōngdì.
Because of large-scale demolition of old towns and building of new ones, many cities became almost one big building site.
徐
一些古老的建筑也被拆毁了，没有被保留下来。
Yìxiē gǔlǎo de jiànzhù yě bèi chāihuǐ le, méiyǒu bèi bǎoliú xialai.
Some ancient buildings were demolished too and not preserved.
徐
结果现在大城市的样子都差不多，失去了特色。太遗憾了。
Jiéguǒ xiànzài dà chéngshì de yàngzi dōu chàbuduō, shīqù le tèsè. Tài yíhàn le.
As a result, big cities now all look much the same and have lost their character. It's a great pity.
徐
再一个就是社会代价。
Zài yí ge jiùshì shèhuì dàijià.
Another is the social cost.
徐
年轻人都去城里打工了，农村留守儿童、留守老人的数量很多。
Niánqīngrén dōu qù chéng li dǎ gōng le, nóngcūn liúshǒu értóng, liúshǒu lǎorén de shùliàng hěn duō.
Young people have all gone to work in the cities, so there are many children and elderly people left behind in the countryside.
徐
农民工在城市中仍然会遇到很多问题：
Nóngmíngōng zài chéngshì zhōng réngrán huì yùdào hěn duō wèntí:
Migrant workers still face many problems in the cities:
徐
身份歧视、收入分配不公平、社会保障不完善等等。
Shēnfèn qíshì, shōurù fēnpèi bù gōngpíng, shèhuì bǎozhàng bù wánshàn děngděng.
discrimination because of their status, unfair income distribution, inadequate social security and so on.
徐
他们不愿意在城市花钱，挣了钱都攒着回农村老家盖房子、养老。
Tāmen bú yuànyì zài chéngshì huā qián, zhèng le qián dōu zǎn zhe huí nóngcūn lǎojiā gài fángzi, yǎnglǎo.
They don't like spending money in the city; they save what they earn to build a house back home and retire there.
徐

blocks.label: 子女
blocks.h: 农民工子女 · Migrant workers' children
lines: 农民工子女的想法跟他们的父母就不同了。
Nóngmíngōng zǐnǚ de xiǎngfǎ gēn tāmen de fùmǔ jiù bùtóng le.
Migrant workers' children think differently from their parents, though.
主
是的。这些孩子要么很小就从农村来到城市生活，对乡村的记忆已经很模糊了，
Shì de. Zhèxiē háizi yàome hěn xiǎo jiù cóng nóngcūn láidào chéngshì shēnghuó, duì xiāngcūn de jìyì yǐjīng hěn móhú le,
Yes. These children either came to the city very young, and their memories of the countryside are already vague,
徐
乡村对他们来说完全是陌生的。
xiāngcūn duì tāmen lái shuō wánquán shì mòshēng de.
so the countryside is completely foreign to them.
徐
他们当然更愿意留在城市。
Tāmen dāngrán gèng yuànyì liú zài chéngshì.
Of course they'd rather stay in the city.
徐
在心理上，他们不认为自己是农村人，而是城里人。
Zài xīnlǐ shàng, tāmen bú rènwéi zìjǐ shì nóngcūn rén, érshì chéngli rén.
Psychologically, they don't see themselves as rural people, but as city people.
徐
他们的户口往往还在农村，在城里人面前，他们也很尴尬，
Tāmen de hùkǒu wǎngwǎng hái zài nóngcūn, zài chéngli rén miànqián, tāmen yě hěn gāngà,
But their household registration is often still in the countryside, and in front of city people they feel awkward,
徐
倾向于认为自己是外地人，而不是农村人。
qīngxiàng yú rènwéi zìjǐ shì wàidìrén, ér bú shì nóngcūn rén.
tending to see themselves as outsiders rather than as rural people.
徐
您说的让我想起来，有一年春晚，民工子女们念了一首叫《心里话》的诗。

Jīngjì gāosù zēngzhǎng, jiùyèlǜ hé shēnghuó zhìliàng tígāo; dàguīmó jīchǔ jiànshè; zīyuán jízhōng fēnpèi, bìmiǎn làngfèi; chéngxiāng chājù hé Zhōngguó yǔ shìjiè de chājù suōxiǎo.

Fast economic growth, more jobs and a better quality of life; large-scale infrastructure; resources concentrated and shared out, avoiding waste; narrower gaps between town and country and between China and the world.

161.title: Cai Hou paper
161.sub: Three questions, then how Cai Lun improved papermaking
161.transcriptNote: The questions come first. 蔡伦 (Cai Lun) was an official of the Eastern Han dynasty; 蔡侯纸 ("Marquis Cai's paper") is the name people gave his paper. The recording sometimes mispronounces his name.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
中国东汉以前，人们通常用竹子和丝绸作为记载文字的工具。
Zhōngguó Dōng Hàn yǐqián, rénmen tōngcháng yòng zhúzi hé sīchóu zuòwéi jìzǎi wénzì de gōngjù.
Before the Eastern Han dynasty, people in China usually used bamboo and silk to record writing.
东汉时，有一个叫蔡伦的人，改进了当时的造纸方法，发明出了蔡侯纸。
Dōng Hàn shí, yǒu yí ge jiào Cài Lún de rén, gǎijìn le dāngshí de zàozhǐ fāngfǎ, fāmíng chū le Cài Hóu zhǐ.
In the Eastern Han, a man called Cai Lun improved the papermaking methods of the time and invented "Cai Hou paper".
请听录音，然后回答下面的问题。
Qǐng tīng lùyīn, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen, then answer the questions below.

q: 用竹子和丝绸造纸有什么问题？
Yòng zhúzi hé sīchóu zàozhǐ yǒu shénme wèntí?
What was the problem with making books from bamboo and silk?
ans: 用竹子太重，读起来不方便；用丝绸太贵，普通百姓承受不起。
Yòng zhúzi tài zhòng, dú qǐlái bù fāngbiàn; yòng sīchóu tài guì, pǔtōng bǎixìng chéngshòu bu qǐ.
Bamboo was too heavy and awkward to read; silk was too expensive for ordinary people.

q: 蔡侯纸是用什么做成的？
Cài Hóu zhǐ shì yòng shénme zuò chéng de?
What was Cai Hou paper made from?
ans: 树皮、破布等混合在一起做成的。
Shùpí, pòbù děng hùnhé zài yìqǐ zuò chéng de.
Tree bark, rags and so on, mixed together.

q: 蔡伦在哪一年把自己的发明献给了皇帝？
Cài Lún zài nǎ yì nián bǎ zìjǐ de fāmíng xiàn gěi le huángdì?
In what year did Cai Lun present his invention to the emperor?

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 蔡侯纸。
Cài Hóu zhǐ.
Cai Hou paper.
中国东汉以前，人们通常用竹子和丝绸作为记载文字的工具。
Zhōngguó Dōng Hàn yǐqián, rénmen tōngcháng yòng zhúzi hé sīchóu zuòwéi jìzǎi wénzì de gōngjù.
Before the Eastern Han, people in China usually used bamboo and silk to record writing.
这样造出来的纸，或者太重，读起来非常不方便，
Zhèyàng zào chulai de zhǐ, huòzhě tài zhòng, dú qǐlái fēicháng bù fāngbiàn,
What they made was either too heavy and very awkward to read,
或者太贵，普通百姓承受不起制造的费用。
huòzhě tài guì, pǔtōng bǎixìng chéngshòu bu qǐ zhìzào de fèiyòng.
or too expensive, more than ordinary people could afford.
东汉时，有一个叫蔡伦的人，他平常很喜欢读书。
Dōng Hàn shí, yǒu yí ge jiào Cài Lún de rén, tā píngcháng hěn xǐhuan dú shū.
In the Eastern Han there was a man called Cai Lun who loved reading.
如何制造出一种轻便廉价的书写工具，就成了蔡伦的一个梦想。
Rúhé zhìzào chū yì zhǒng qīngbiàn liánjià de shūxiě gōngjù, jiù chéng le Cài Lún de yí ge mèngxiǎng.
How to make a light, cheap writing material became Cai Lun's dream.
为了实现这个梦想，蔡伦反复地进行实验和研究。
Wèile shíxiàn zhège mèngxiǎng, Cài Lún fǎnfù de jìnxíng shíyàn hé yánjiū.
To make the dream come true, Cai Lun experimented and researched again and again.
最后，他终于找到了一种方法。
Zuìhòu, tā zhōngyú zhǎodào le yì zhǒng fāngfǎ.
In the end, he found a way.
他把树皮、破布等混合在一起，制造出了廉价和实用的纸。
Tā bǎ shùpí, pòbù děng hùnhé zài yìqǐ, zhìzào chū le liánjià hé shíyòng de zhǐ.
He mixed tree bark, rags and other things together and made a cheap, practical paper.
一零五年，蔡伦把发明纸的过程和自己制造的第一张纸给皇帝看。
Yī líng wǔ nián, Cài Lún bǎ fāmíng zhǐ de guòchéng hé zìjǐ zhìzào de dì-yī zhāng zhǐ gěi huángdì kàn.
In 105, Cai Lun showed the emperor how he had invented paper, and the first sheet he had made.
皇帝非常满意，而且奖了蔡伦很多钱。
Huángdì fēicháng mǎnyì, érqiě jiǎng le Cài Lún hěn duō qián.
The emperor was very pleased and rewarded Cai Lun with a lot of money.
从此以后，蔡伦的造纸技术传播开来，受到百姓的欢迎和喜爱。
Cóngcǐ yǐhòu, Cài Lún de zàozhǐ jìshù chuánbō kāilai, shòudào bǎixìng de huānyíng hé xǐ'ài.
From then on, Cai Lun's papermaking technique spread, and ordinary people welcomed and loved it.
为了纪念蔡伦这个伟大的发明，人们就把这种纸叫做蔡侯纸。
Wèile jìniàn Cài Lún zhège wěidà de fāmíng, rénmen jiù bǎ zhè zhǒng zhǐ jiàozuò Cài Hóu zhǐ.
To commemorate Cai Lun's great invention, people called this paper Cai Hou paper.
中国人的这一项发明，对促进世界文明的传播起到了十分重要的作用。
Zhōngguórén de zhè yí xiàng fāmíng, duì cùjìn shìjiè wénmíng de chuánbō qǐdào le shífēn zhòngyào de zuòyòng.
This Chinese invention played a very important part in spreading civilisation around the world.

这就成了我的习惯。

Purpose.

He mixed tree bark, rags and other things together and made a cheap, practical paper.

Bǎ miànfěn hé shuǐ hùnhé zài yìqǐ.
Mix the flour and water.
为了纪念……

Purpose.
为了纪念蔡伦这个伟大的发明，人们就把这种纸叫做蔡侯纸。

为了纪念蔡伦这个伟大的发明，人们就把这种纸叫做蔡侯纸。
Wèile jìniàn Cài Lún zhège wěidà de fāmíng, rénmen jiù bǎ zhè zhǒng zhǐ jiàozuò Cài Hóu zhǐ.

我们把他叫做老王。

162.title: Handwriting or typing?
162.sub: An online forum debate: five netizens on whether handwriting still matters
162.transcriptNote: Two questions, then a short report and five netizens' views. 电写 means writing electronically, i.e. typing. The answers are my own reading.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
网络信息时代下，中国人还像以前一样，在自己发明的纸上写字吗？
Wǎngluò xìnxī shídài xià, Zhōngguórén hái xiàng yǐqián yíyàng, zài zìjǐ fāmíng de zhǐ shàng xiě zì ma?
In the age of the internet, do Chinese people still write on the paper they invented, as they used to?
请听下面的讨论《手写还是电写？》，然后回答下面的问题。
Qǐng tīng xiàmiàn de tǎolùn “Shǒuxiě háishi diànxiě?”, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to the discussion "Handwriting or typing?", then answer the questions.

q: 网上一家论坛发表了什么事？
Wǎng shang yì jiā lùntán fābiǎo le shénme shì?
What did an online forum report?
ans: 重庆一位大学生为了找工作，写了一份四百字的简历，上面错了二十四个字。
Chóngqìng yí wèi dàxuéshēng wèile zhǎo gōngzuò, xiě le yí fèn sìbǎi zì de jiǎnlì, shàngmian cuò le èrshísì ge zì.
A university student in Chongqing wrote a 400-character CV to look for work, with 24 characters wrong.

q: 五位网友中，哪几位支持手写？哪几位支持电写？原因是什么？
Wǔ wèi wǎngyǒu zhōng, nǎ jǐ wèi zhīchí shǒuxiě? Nǎ jǐ wèi zhīchí diànxiě? Yuányīn shì shénme?
Of the five netizens, who supports handwriting and who supports typing? Why?
ans: 网友一、三、五支持手写：汉字是文化，要传下去；手写更亲切；写字能培养认真仔细的态度。网友二、四支持电写：打字快，能交流就行；语言是工具，能用就行。

Wǎngyǒu yī, sān, wǔ zhīchí shǒuxiě: Hànzì shì wénhuà, yào chuán xiaqu; shǒuxiě gèng qīnqiè; xiě zì néng péiyǎng rènzhēn zǐxì de tàidu. Wǎngyǒu èr, sì zhīchí diànxiě: dǎzì kuài, néng jiāoliú jiù xíng; yǔyán shì gōngjù, néng yòng jiù xíng.

1, 3 and 5 support handwriting: characters are culture to be passed on, handwriting feels warmer, and writing teaches care. 2 and 4 support typing: it's faster, and language is a tool, so being usable is enough.

blocks.label: 讨论
blocks.h: 手写还是电写？ · The discussion
lines: 手写还是电写？
Shǒuxiě háishi diànxiě?
Handwriting or typing?
中国人发明了纸，是为了在上面写汉字。
Zhōngguórén fāmíng le zhǐ, shì wèile zài shàngmian xiě Hànzì.
The Chinese invented paper in order to write characters on it.
可是进入到网络信息时代以后，随着电脑和手机的普及，
Kěshì jìnrù dào wǎngluò xìnxī shídài yǐhòu, suízhe diànnǎo hé shǒujī de pǔjí,
But since the internet age arrived, as computers and phones have spread,
高科技电子产品改变了中国人的写字习惯。
gāokējì diànzi chǎnpǐn gǎibiàn le Zhōngguórén de xiě zì xíguàn.
high-tech electronics have changed Chinese people's writing habits.
人们用笔和纸书写汉字的机会越来越少了，大家几乎只用电脑打字。
Rénmen yòng bǐ hé zhǐshū xiě Hànzì de jīhuì yuèláiyuè shǎo le, dàjiā jīhū zhǐ yòng diànnǎo dǎzì.
People have fewer and fewer chances to write characters with pen and paper; almost everyone just types.
全社会汉字书写的水平也明显下降了。
Quán shèhuì Hànzì shūxiě de shuǐpíng yě míngxiǎn xiàjiàng le.
Handwriting standards across society have clearly fallen.
几天前，一个网上论坛就写了这样一件事儿：
Jǐ tiān qián, yí ge wǎng shang lùntán jiù xiě le zhèyàng yí jiàn shìr:
A few days ago, an online forum reported this:
重庆一位大学生为了找工作，写了一份四百字的简历，上面错了二十四个字。
Chóngqìng yí wèi dàxuéshēng wèile zhǎo gōngzuò, xiě le yí fèn sìbǎi zì de jiǎnlì, shàngmian cuò le èrshísì ge zì.
a university student in Chongqing, looking for work, wrote a 400-character CV with 24 characters wrong.
很多人不理解：是现在大学生水平太差，还是用电脑多了，写字太少？
Hěn duō rén bù lǐjiě: shì xiànzài dàxuéshēng shuǐpíng tài chà, háishi yòng diànnǎo duō le, xiě zì tài shǎo?
Many people couldn't understand it: are students today just poor, or do they use computers too much and write too little?
同时，既然现在大家都是用电脑、手机工作，用手写字还重要吗？
Tóngshí, jìrán xiànzài dàjiā dōu shì yòng diànnǎo, shǒujī gōngzuò, yòng shǒu xiě zì hái zhòngyào ma?
And since everyone now works on computers and phones, does handwriting still matter?
下面是几个网友的不同观点。请分析他们是支持手写，还是电写。
Xiàmiàn shì jǐ ge wǎngyǒu de bùtóng guāndiǎn. Qǐng fēnxī tāmen shì zhīchí shǒuxiě, háishi diànxiě.
Here are some netizens' views. Work out whether each supports handwriting or typing.

blocks.label: 网友
blocks.h: 五位网友的观点 · Five views
lines: 网友一：
Wǎngyǒu yī:
Netizen 1:
我们中国人写字不能丢，这是一种文化，需要传下去。
Wǒmen Zhōngguórén xiě zì bù néng diū, zhè shì yì zhǒng wénhuà, xūyào chuán xiaqu.
We Chinese mustn't lose handwriting. It's part of our culture and must be passed on.
时代在进步，也不能把自己的文化丢了。
Shídài zài jìnbù, yě bù néng bǎ zìjǐ de wénhuà diū le.
Times move on, but we can't lose our own culture.
网友二：
Wǎngyǒu èr:
Netizen 2:
电子时代谁还用手写呀？打字比手写不知道快多少倍。
Diànzi shídài shéi hái yòng shǒuxiě ya? Dǎzì bǐ shǒuxiě bù zhīdao kuài duōshǎo bèi.
Who writes by hand in the electronic age? Typing is goodness knows how many times faster.
文字就是用来交流的嘛，能认字就够用了，只要快就行。
Wénzì jiùshì yònglái jiāoliú de ma, néng rènzì jiù gòuyòng le, zhǐyào kuài jiù xíng.
Writing is for communicating. Being able to read is enough, as long as it's fast.
网友三：
Wǎngyǒu sān:
Netizen 3:
我总是觉得电脑打出来的字比用手写出来的少了点什么，就是没有手写的那么亲切。
Wǒ zǒngshì juéde diànnǎo dǎ chulai de zì bǐ yòng shǒu xiě chulai de shǎo le diǎn shénme, jiùshì méiyǒu shǒuxiě de nàme qīnqiè.
I always feel typed characters lack something compared with handwritten ones. They're just not as warm.
网友四：
Wǎngyǒu sì:
Netizen 4:
我想以后用手写字肯定会慢慢变成一种纯粹的个人爱好。
Wǒ xiǎng yǐhòu yòng shǒu xiě zì kěndìng huì mànmàn biànchéng yì zhǒng chúncuì de gèrén àihào.
I think handwriting will gradually become a purely personal hobby.
语言是工具，对大多数人来说，能用就行了。
Yǔyán shì gōngjù, duì dàduōshù rén lái shuō, néng yòng jiù xíng le.
Language is a tool; for most people, as long as it works, that's enough.
网友五：
Wǎngyǒu wǔ:
Netizen 5:
其实汉字不只是一种交流工具，代表了我们五千年的中华文化。
Qíshí Hànzì bù zhǐshì yì zhǒng jiāoliú gōngjù, dàibiǎo le wǒmen wǔqiān nián de Zhōnghuá wénhuà.
In fact, Chinese characters aren't just a tool for communicating; they represent our 5,000 years of Chinese culture.
养成书写的好习惯，能让人学会做事认真、仔细、不马虎的生活态度，
Yǎngchéng shūxiě de hǎo xíguàn, néng ràng rén xuéhuì zuòshì rènzhēn, zǐxì, bù mǎhu de shēnghuó tàidu,

只要……就行

文字就是用来交流的嘛，能认字就够用了，只要快就行。
Wénzì jiùshì yònglái jiāoliú de ma, néng rènzì jiù gòuyòng le, zhǐyào kuài jiù xíng.
Writing is for communicating. Being able to read is enough, as long as it's fast.
只要你来就行。
Zhǐyào nǐ lái jiù xíng.

比……少了点什么

少了点什么 = something's missing.
我总是觉得电脑打出来的字比用手写出来的少了点什么，就是没有手写的那么亲切。
Wǒ zǒngshì juéde diànnǎo dǎ chulai de zì bǐ yòng shǒu xiě chulai de shǎo le diǎn shénme, jiùshì méiyǒu shǒuxiě de nàme qīnqiè.

Zhège cài shǎo le diǎn shénme.

not just …

其实汉字不只是一种交流工具，代表了我们五千年的中华文化。
Qíshí Hànzì bù zhǐshì yì zhǒng jiāoliú gōngjù, dàibiǎo le wǒmen wǔqiān nián de Zhōnghuá wénhuà.

good for …

163.title: The internet and China
163.sub: Four statements to judge true or false, then a short passage
163.transcriptNote: Listen to the four statements, then the passage, and decide whether each is true. Each numbered statement may contain more than one sentence. The answers are my own reading of the passage. The statements' figures differ slightly from the passage's on purpose.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断句子的正误 · True or false?
lines: 听力课堂练习。
Tīnglì kètáng liànxí.
In-class listening exercises.
听录音，并判断句子的正误。
Tīng lùyīn, bìng pànduàn jùzi de zhèngwù.
Listen and decide whether the sentences are true or false.
请先听四个句子。
Qǐng xiān tīng sì ge jùzi.
First listen to four sentences.

q: 一九九七年，中国的网络用户是六十二万。到二零一六年八月末，互联网用户已有七亿多。
Yī jiǔ jiǔ qī nián, Zhōngguó de wǎngluò yònghù shì liùshí'èr wàn. Dào èr líng yī liù nián bā yuè mò, hùliánwǎng yònghù yǐ yǒu qī yì duō.
In 1997 China had 620,000 internet users; by the end of August 2016 it had over 700 million.
qs.why: The passage gives 620,000 in 1997 and 710 million in August 2016.

q: 二零一六年，互联网普及率几乎为百分之七十一。中国网民手机上网使用率约为百分之九十三。
Èr líng yī liù nián, hùliánwǎng pǔjí lǜ jīhū wèi bǎi fēn zhī qīshíyī. Zhōngguó wǎngmín shǒujī shàngwǎng shǐyòng lǜ yuē wèi bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshísān.
In 2016 internet penetration was nearly 71%, and about 93% of Chinese internet users went online by phone.
qs.why: The passage gives penetration as 51.7%, not 71%. The phone figure (92.5%) is about right.

q: 中国年轻人是使用网络的最大群体。
Zhōngguó niánqīngrén shì shǐyòng wǎngluò de zuì dà qúntǐ.
Young people are the largest group of internet users in China.
qs.why: The passage says nothing about which age group uses the internet most.

q: 互联网缩短了中国与世界的距离。
Hùliánwǎng suōduǎn le Zhōngguó yǔ shìjiè de jùlí.
The internet has brought China and the world closer.
qs.why: The passage says Chinese people can talk directly with people abroad and learn more about world events.

blocks.label: 短文
blocks.h: 互联网和中国 · The passage
lines: 现在请听文章。
Xiànzài qǐng tīng wénzhāng.
Now listen to the passage.
互联网和中国。
Hùliánwǎng hé Zhōngguó.
The internet and China.
有人统计，一九九七年，中国的网络用户是六十二万。
Yǒu rén tǒngjì, yī jiǔ jiǔ qī nián, Zhōngguó de wǎngluò yònghù shì liùshí'èr wàn.
According to one count, China had 620,000 internet users in 1997.
到了二零一六年八月末，互联网用户已有七点一亿，
Dào le èr líng yī liù nián bā yuè mò, hùliánwǎng yònghù yǐ yǒu qī diǎn yī yì,
By the end of August 2016 there were 710 million;
互联网普及率为百分之五十一点七，网民手机上网使用率为百分之九十二点五。
hùliánwǎng pǔjí lǜ wèi bǎi fēn zhī wǔshíyī diǎn qī, wǎngmín shǒujī shàngwǎng shǐyòng lǜ wèi bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí'èr diǎn wǔ.
internet penetration was 51.7%, and 92.5% of users went online by phone.
过去近二十年里，中国人的生活方式、价值观不断地被互联网影响和改变着。
Guòqu jìn èrshí nián li, Zhōngguórén de shēnghuó fāngshì, jiàzhíguān búduàn de bèi hùliánwǎng yǐngxiǎng hé gǎibiàn zhe.
Over the past twenty years or so, Chinese people's way of life and values have been constantly influenced and changed by the internet.
通过互联网，中国人也开始使用网络提供的各种工具，
Tōngguò hùliánwǎng, Zhōngguórén yě kāishǐ shǐyòng wǎngluò tígōng de gè zhǒng gōngjù,
Through the internet, Chinese people have started using all kinds of online tools,
如搜索引擎、视频、购物、教育、娱乐、社交网站等等。
rú sōusuǒ yǐnqíng, shìpín, gòuwù, jiàoyù, yúlè, shèjiāo wǎngzhàn děngděng.
such as search engines, video, shopping, education, entertainment and social networks.
通过互联网，中国人能够直接与住在国外的人交流，
Tōngguò hùliánwǎng, Zhōngguórén nénggòu zhíjiē yǔ zhù zài guówài de rén jiāoliú,
Through the internet, Chinese people can talk directly with people living abroad,
也能够更多地了解世界上发生的事情。
yě nénggòu gèng duō de liǎojiě shìjiè shang fāshēng de shìqing.
and learn more about what's happening in the world.

grammar: 到……末
by the end of …
末 = end.
一九九七年，中国的网络用户是六十二万。到二零一六年八月末，互联网用户已有七亿多。
Yī jiǔ jiǔ qī nián, Zhōngguó de wǎngluò yònghù shì liùshí'èr wàn. Dào èr líng yī liù nián bā yuè mò, hùliánwǎng yònghù yǐ yǒu qī yì duō.
In 1997 China had 620,000 internet users; by the end of August 2016 it had over 700 million.
到年末，他会回来。
Dào niánmò, tā huì huílai.
He'll be back by the end of the year.
被……影响
to be influenced by …
Passive 被.
过去近二十年里，中国人的生活方式、价值观不断地被互联网影响和改变着。
Guòqu jìn èrshí nián li, Zhōngguórén de shēnghuó fāngshì, jiàzhíguān búduàn de bèi hùliánwǎng yǐngxiǎng hé gǎibiàn zhe.
Over the past twenty years or so, Chinese people's way of life and values have been constantly influenced and changed by the internet.
他被朋友影响了。
Tā bèi péngyou yǐngxiǎng le.
He was influenced by his friends.
V着
ongoing state

过去近二十年里，中国人的生活方式、价值观不断地被互联网影响和改变着。
Guòqu jìn èrshí nián li, Zhōngguórén de shēnghuó fāngshì, jiàzhíguān búduàn de bèi hùliánwǎng yǐngxiǎng hé gǎibiàn zhe.
Over the past twenty years or so, Chinese people's way of life and values have been constantly influenced and changed by the internet.
世界在变化着。
Shìjiè zài biànhuà zhe.
The world keeps changing.
such as …
Formal 比如.
如搜索引擎、视频、购物、教育、娱乐、社交网站等等。
rú sōusuǒ yǐnqíng, shìpín, gòuwù, jiàoyù, yúlè, shèjiāo wǎngzhàn děngděng.
such as search engines, video, shopping, education, entertainment and social networks.
水果，如苹果、香蕉。
Shuǐguǒ, rú píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo.
Fruit, such as apples and bananas.
与……交流
to communicate with …

通过互联网，中国人能够直接与住在国外的人交流，
Tōngguò hùliánwǎng, Zhōngguórén nénggòu zhíjiē yǔ zhù zài guówài de rén jiāoliú,
Through the internet, Chinese people can talk directly with people living abroad,
与朋友交流。
Yǔ péngyou jiāoliú.
Talk with friends.
