164.title: Why do you go online?
164.sub: Two short interviews: a student, and Teacher Yang and her son
164.transcriptNote: Fill in the table from two unscripted interviews. 问 is the interviewer, 学 the student and 杨 Teacher Yang. Fillers and repeated words are trimmed, and a few short turns that overlap are my best guess at who said what. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 根据录音把表格补充完整 · Complete the table
lines: 根据录音把表格补充完整。
Gēnjù lùyīn bǎ biǎogé bǔchōng wánzhěng.
Complete the table from the recording.

blocks.label: 学生
blocks.h: 采访一：一位学生 · Interview 1: a student
lines: 同学你好，我想问你一个问题。
Tóngxué nǐhǎo, wǒ xiǎng wèn nǐ yí ge wèntí.
Hi, can I ask you a question?
问
请你讲一讲你平时为什么上网，或者可以说上网做些什么。
Qǐng nǐ jiǎng yì jiǎng nǐ píngshí wèishénme shàngwǎng, huòzhě kěyǐ shuō shàngwǎng zuò xiē shénme.
Tell me why you usually go online, or what you do online.
问
第一，我平时上网一般看一些信息，查一些资料。
Dì-yī, wǒ píngshí shàngwǎng yìbān kàn yìxiē xìnxī, chá yìxiē zīliào.
First, I usually go online to read news and look things up.
学
除此之外，还有就是打发时间，比如说看个视频，听个音乐，或者是说刷个微博。
Chúcǐzhīwài, hái yǒu jiùshì dǎfā shíjiān, bǐrú shuō kàn ge shìpín, tīng ge yīnyuè, huòzhě shì shuō shuā ge Wēibó.
Apart from that, to pass the time: watching a video, listening to music, or scrolling through Weibo.
学
好。
Hǎo.
OK.
问
获得一些更多的信息，然后了解一下国内和法国这边都发生了一些什么事情。
Huòdé yìxiē gèng duō de xìnxī, ránhòu liǎojiě yíxià guónèi hé Fǎguó zhèbian dōu fāshēng le yìxiē shénme shìqing.
To get more information, and find out what's happening in China and here in France.
学
那也就是说是打发时间，还有一个是查一些资料。
Nà yě jiù shì shuō shì dǎfā shíjiān, hái yǒu yí ge shì chá yìxiē zīliào.
So that's passing the time, and looking things up.
问
查一些资料。对。
Chá yìxiē zīliào. Duì.
Looking things up. Yes.
学
好，还有一个问题想问你，就是你是从什么时候开始上网的？
Hǎo, hái yǒu yí ge wèntí xiǎng wèn nǐ, jiùshì nǐ shì cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ shàngwǎng de?
Right, another question: when did you start going online?
问
高一，高中一年级开始上网的。
Gāoyī, gāozhōng yī niánjí kāishǐ shàngwǎng de.
In Year 10, the first year of high school.
学
高中一年级就开始上网了。那那个时候为什么上网呢？
Gāozhōng yī niánjí jiù kāishǐ shàngwǎng le. Nà nàge shíhou wèishénme shàngwǎng ne?
As early as the first year of high school. Why did you go online then?
问
那个时候上网就是纯粹地查资料。在学校老师需要让你查一些东西。
Nàge shíhou shàngwǎng jiùshì chúncuì de chá zīliào. Zài xuéxiào lǎoshī xūyào ràng nǐ chá yìxiē dōngxi.
Back then it was purely to look things up; teachers at school would ask us to research things.
学
然后那个时候还跟国外的、在美国的朋友聊些天，倒一下时差，练习一下英语。
Ránhòu nàge shíhou hái gēn guówài de, zài Měiguó de péngyou liáo xiē tiān, dǎo yíxià shíchā, liànxí yíxià Yīngyǔ.
And I chatted with friends abroad, in America, worked around the time difference, and practised my English.
学
那我还问你一下，还有一个问题，就是你觉得现在如果让你不上网，一天不上网的话，或者一个星期不上网的话，会怎么样？
Nà wǒ hái wèn nǐ yíxià, hái yǒu yí ge wèntí, jiùshì nǐ juéde xiànzài rúguǒ ràng nǐ bú shàngwǎng, yì tiān bú shàngwǎng dehuà, huòzhě yí ge xīngqī bú shàngwǎng dehuà, huì zěnmeyàng?
One more question: if you couldn't go online now, for a day or even a week, what would happen?
问
很难受，很难受。
Hěn nánshòu, hěn nánshòu.
I'd feel awful, really awful.
学
为什么呢？
Wèishénme ne?
Why?
问
因为有网瘾。
Yīnwèi yǒu wǎngyǐn.
Because I'm addicted to the internet.
学
有网瘾是什么意思？
Yǒu wǎngyǐn shì shénme yìsi?
What does being addicted mean?
问
就是一天不上网，然后就一直想着这件事情，然后就很难受。
Jiùshì yì tiān bú shàngwǎng, ránhòu jiù yìzhí xiǎngzhe zhè jiàn shìqing, ránhòu jiù hěn nánshòu.
If I don't go online for a day, I keep thinking about it, and I feel awful.
学
谢谢，谢谢你。
Xièxiè, xièxiè nǐ.
Thank you, thanks.
问

blocks.label: 老师
blocks.h: 采访二：杨老师 · Interview 2: Teacher Yang
lines: 老师您好，您贵姓？
Lǎoshī nínhǎo, nín guìxìng?
Hello, what's your surname?
问
我姓杨。
Wǒ xìng yáng.
Yang.
杨
杨老师您好。想问一下，您平时上网吗？
Yáng lǎoshī nínhǎo. Xiǎng wèn yíxià, nín píngshí shàngwǎng ma?
Hello, Teacher Yang. Do you usually go online?
问
上网，但是很少，很少上网。
Shàngwǎng, dànshì hěn shǎo, hěn shǎo shàngwǎng.
Yes, but very rarely.
杨
那您上网一般都做一些什么呢？
Nà nín shàngwǎng yìbān dōu zuò yìxiē shénme ne?
What do you usually do online?
问
上网就是说查看一下邮件呢，因为要工作嘛。
Shàngwǎng jiùshì shuō chákàn yíxià yóujiàn ne, yīnwèi yào gōngzuò ma.
I check my email, because of work.
杨
工作如果没有及时看邮件的话，就会影响大事儿，影响工作。
Gōngzuò rúguǒ méiyǒu jíshí kàn yóujiàn dehuà, jiù huì yǐngxiǎng dàshìr, yǐngxiǎng gōngzuò.
If I don't check email in time, it could affect something important, affect my work.
杨
每天都上，对吗？
Měitiān dōu shàng, duì ma?
So you go online every day?
问
周末的时候我一般能不上就不上。
Zhōumò de shíhou wǒ yìbān néng bú shàng jiù bú shàng.
At weekends I avoid it if I can.
杨
为什么呢？
Wèishénme ne?
Why?
问
因为一看到有工作的信件，就觉得这个星期就完了。
Yīnwèi yí kàndào yǒu gōngzuò de xìnjiàn, jiù juéde zhège xīngqī jiù wán le.
Because as soon as I see work emails, I feel my week's over.
杨
那您觉得这个网络给我们的生活带来的更多的是好还是不好呢？您个人什么观点？
Nà nín juéde zhège wǎngluò gěi wǒmen de shēnghuó dàilái de gèng duō de shì hǎo háishi bù hǎo ne? Nín gèrén shénme guāndiǎn?
Do you think the internet has brought more good or more bad to our lives? What's your view?
问
网络肯定是带来好的了。比如说跟家里的人做一些联络的时候会比较方便。
Wǎngluò kěndìng shì dàilái hǎo de le. Bǐrú shuō gēn jiā li de rén zuò yìxiē liánluò de shíhou huì bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
It has definitely brought good. For example, keeping in touch with family is easier.
杨
但是不好的时候就觉得说，每天好像都在被它压迫着。
Dànshì bù hǎo de shíhou jiù juéde shuō, měitiān hǎoxiàng dōu zài bèi tā yāpò zhe.
But the bad part is that every day you feel under pressure from it.
杨
好像那个邮件不打开，万一有什么事情要找我，我又没有及时回邮件，或者是没有及时完成工作，总是有这种担心的。
Hǎoxiàng nàge yóujiàn bù dǎkāi, wànyī yǒu shénme shìqing yào zhǎo wǒ, wǒ yòu méiyǒu jíshí huí yóujiàn, huòzhě shì méiyǒu jíshí wánchéng gōngzuò, zǒngshì yǒu zhè zhǒng dānxīn de.
If I don't open my email, what if someone needs me and I haven't replied in time, or haven't finished my work in time? I always have that worry.
杨
要是没有这个担心的话，肯定就不上网了。
Yàoshì méiyǒu zhège dānxīn dehuà, kěndìng jiù bú shàngwǎng le.
Without that worry, I definitely wouldn't go online.
杨
那我再问您一下，您有孩子吗？
Nà wǒ zài wèn nín yíxià, nín yǒu háizi ma?
May I ask: do you have children?
问
有。
Yǒu.
Yes.
杨
您家孩子上网吗？他多大了？
Nín jiā háizi shàngwǎng ma? Tā duō dà le?
Does your child go online? How old is he?
问
我们家孩子十一岁了。
Wǒmen jiā háizi shíyī suì le.
My son is eleven.
杨
十一岁就开始上网了，很早就上网了。那他上网一般做些什么呢？
Shíyī suì jiù kāishǐ shàngwǎng le, hěn zǎo jiù shàngwǎng le. Nà tā shàngwǎng yìbān zuò xiē shénme ne?
Online at eleven, that's early. What does he usually do online?
问
他一般是在网上学画画，或者是在网上看一些做手工的东西，然后他就跟着人家学做。
Tā yìbān shì zài wǎng shang xué huà huà, huòzhě shì zài wǎng shang kàn yìxiē zuò shǒugōng de dōngxi, ránhòu tā jiù gēnzhe rénjia xué zuò.
He usually learns to draw online, or watches craft videos and copies them.
杨
或者是有的时候他看一些笑话。一般就做这种事情。
Huòzhě shì yǒu de shíhou tā kàn yìxiē xiàohuà. Yìbān jiù zuò zhè zhǒng shìqing.
Or sometimes he reads jokes. That's what he does.
杨
您限制他上网吗？
Nín xiànzhì tā shàngwǎng ma?
Do you limit his time online?
问
我不限制他，他一般自己还是比较自由。
Wǒ bú xiànzhì tā, tā yìbān zìjǐ háishi bǐjiào zìyóu.
No, I don't. He's fairly free.
杨
你不害怕网络会对他有一些不好的影响吗？
Nǐ bú hàipà wǎngluò huì duì tā yǒu yìxiē bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng ma?
Aren't you afraid the internet will be a bad influence on him?

当然也害怕。不过我是告诉他说，你就只看你感兴趣的那个东西。

Of course I'm afraid of that. But I tell him to look only at the things he's interested in:
杨
比如说你要是玩的东西，或者是做手工的东西，或者学画画的，或者你要是查一些资料的东西。

杨
其他的事情跟你没关系，你也不用看。

问

q: What does the student do online?
ans: 看信息、查资料；打发时间：看视频、听音乐、刷微博；了解国内和法国发生的事情。
Kàn xìnxī, chá zīliào; dǎfā shíjiān: kàn shìpín, tīng yīnyuè, shuā wēibó; liǎojiě guónèi hé Fǎguó fāshēng de shìqing.
Reads news and looks things up; passes the time with videos, music and Weibo; keeps up with events in China and France.

q: 学生从什么时候开始上网？那时为什么上网？
Xuésheng cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ shàngwǎng? Nà shí wèishénme shàngwǎng?
When did the student start going online, and why?
ans: 高中一年级；查老师要求的资料，跟美国的朋友聊天、练习英语。
Gāozhōng yī niánjí; chá lǎoshī yāoqiú de zīliào, gēn Měiguó de péngyou liáotiān, liànxí Yīngyǔ.
In the first year of high school: to research things for teachers, and to chat with friends in America and practise English.

q: How does the student feel without the internet?
杨老师上网做什么？周末上网吗？
Yáng lǎoshī shàngwǎng zuò shénme? Zhōumò shàngwǎng ma?
What does Teacher Yang do online? Does she go online at weekends?
ans: 查看工作邮件；周末能不上就不上。
Chákàn gōngzuò yóujiàn; zhōumò néng bú shàng jiù bú shàng.
She checks work email; she avoids it at weekends if she can.

q: 杨老师觉得网络好还是不好？
Yáng lǎoshī juéde wǎngluò hǎo háishi bù hǎo?
Does Teacher Yang think the internet is good or bad?
ans: 好处：跟家人联络方便；不好：每天被它压迫着，总担心没及时回邮件、完成工作。
Hǎochù: gēn jiārén liánluò fāngbiàn; bù hǎo: měitiān bèi tā yāpò zhe, zǒng dānxīn méi jíshí huí yóujiàn, wánchéng gōngzuò.
Good: easy to keep in touch with family. Bad: she feels under pressure every day, always worried she hasn't replied or finished work in time.

q: 杨老师的孩子上网做什么？她限制吗？
Yáng lǎoshī de háizi shàngwǎng zuò shénme? Tā xiànzhì ma?
What does her son do online? Does she limit him?
ans: 学画画、看做手工的东西、看笑话；不限制，只让他看感兴趣的东西。
Xué huà huà, kàn zuò shǒugōng de dōngxi, kànxiàohuà; bú xiànzhì, zhǐ ràng tā kàn gǎn xìngqù de dōngxi.
Learns drawing, watches crafts and reads jokes. She doesn't limit him but tells him to look only at what he's interested in.

vocab: to deal with the time difference

Apart from that, to pass the time: watching a video, listening to music, or scrolling through Weibo.

Chúcǐzhīwài, wǒ hái huì shuō Fǎyǔ.
Besides that, I speak French too.
V个N
casually V a N
个 makes it light.
除此之外，还有就是打发时间，比如说看个视频，听个音乐，或者是说刷个微博。
Chúcǐzhīwài, hái yǒu jiùshì dǎfā shíjiān, bǐrú shuō kàn ge shìpín, tīng ge yīnyuè, huòzhě shì shuō shuā ge Wēibó.
Apart from that, to pass the time: watching a video, listening to music, or scrolling through Weibo.
喝个茶吧。
Hē ge chá ba.
Have a cup of tea.

if …

那我还问你一下，还有一个问题，就是你觉得现在如果让你不上网，一天不上网的话，或者一个星期不上网的话，会怎么样？

One more question: if you couldn't go online now, for a day or even a week, what would happen?
下雨的话我不去。
Xià yǔ dehuà wǒ bú qù.
If it rains I won't go.
能不V就不V
to avoid V-ing if possible
A set pattern.
周末的时候我一般能不上就不上。
Zhōumò de shíhou wǒ yìbān néng bú shàng jiù bú shàng.

Néng bú qù jiù bú qù.

Yīnwèi yí kàndào yǒu gōngzuò de xìnjiàn, jiù juéde zhège xīngqī jiù wán le.

我一到家就睡觉。
Wǒ yí dào jiā jiù shuì jiào.
I sleep as soon as I get home.
被……V着

Passive + 着.

165.title: Fact or not?
165.sub: Five statements about typing, search engines, time zones and addiction
165.transcriptNote: Decide whether each statement fits the facts. The answers are my own judgement based on general knowledge. Item numbers the recording swallows are filled in by order.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 判断是否符合事实 · Fact or not?
lines: 听力课后练习。
Tīnglì kè hòu liànxí.
After-class listening exercises.
判断所听到的情况是否符合事实。
Pànduàn suǒ tīngdào de qíngkuàng shìfǒu fúhé shìshí.
Decide whether what you hear fits the facts.
在电脑上打字比在纸上用手写字快，所以越来越多的人选择用电脑打字。
Zài diànnǎo shàng dǎzì bǐ zài zhǐ shàng yòng shǒu xiě zì kuài, suǒyǐ yuèláiyuè duō de rén xuǎnzé yòng diànnǎo dǎzì.
Typing on a computer is faster than writing by hand, so more and more people choose to type.

qs.why: Typing is generally faster for most people, and it is increasingly common.

lines: 我们上网的时候，可以选择使用不同的搜索引擎来查找信息。
Wǒmen shàngwǎng de shíhou, kěyǐ xuǎnzé shǐyòng bùtóng de sōusuǒ yǐnqíng lái cházhǎo xìnxī.
When we go online, we can choose different search engines to look for information.

qs.why: There are many search engines to choose from.

lines: 中国和法国之间只有五个小时的时差。
Zhōngguó hé Fǎguó zhījiān zhǐyǒu wǔ ge xiǎoshí de shíchā.
There are only five hours' time difference between China and France.

qs.why: The difference is seven hours in winter and six in summer.

lines: 在法国，互联网已经得到了普及，所以网络服务都是免费的。
Zài Fǎguó, hùliánwǎng yǐjīng dédào le pǔjí, suǒyǐ wǎngluò fúwù dōu shì miǎnfèi de.
In France the internet is widespread, so all internet services are free.

qs.why: Being widespread doesn't make it free; internet access and many services cost money.

lines: 常喝酒会产生酒瘾，常吸烟会产生烟瘾，常上网会产生网瘾。
Cháng hējiǔ huì chǎnshēng jiǔyǐn, cháng xīyān huì chǎnshēng yānyǐn, cháng shàngwǎng huì chǎnshēng wǎngyǐn.
Drinking often can lead to alcohol addiction, smoking often to nicotine addiction, and going online often to internet addiction.

qs.why: Habits like these can all become addictions.

grammar: A比B快

在电脑上打字比在纸上用手写字快，所以越来越多的人选择用电脑打字。

甲
是啊。以前我也上不了网，不会打字。
Shì a. Yǐqián wǒ yě shàng bu liǎo wǎng, bú huì dǎzì.
Yes. I couldn't go online before either, because I couldn't type.
乙
后来就出来了这么个工具，不知道谁发明的，可比以前方便多了。
Hòulái jiù chulai le zhème ge gōngjù, bù zhīdao shéi fāmíng de, kěbǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
Then this thing came out. Who knows who invented it, but it's so much easier than before.
乙
有空你也教教我。
Yǒukòng nǐ yě jiāojiao wǒ.
Teach me when you've got time.
甲
行。
Xíng.
Will do.
乙

grammar: 对……挺明白的
to know a lot about …
对 + topic.
听说你对上网这些还挺明白的。
Tīngshuō nǐ duì shàngwǎng zhèxiē hái tǐng míngbai de.
I hear you know quite a lot about the internet and all that.
他对电脑挺明白的。
Tā duì diànnǎo tǐng míngbai de.
He knows a lot about computers.
连……都不……
can't even …
Emphasis.
我可不行，连字儿都不会打。
Wǒ kě bù xíng, lián zìr dōu bú huì dǎ.
Not me. I can't even type.
他连饭都不会做。
Tā lián fàn dōu bú huì zuò.
He can't even cook.
只要……就……
as long as …
Minimum condition.
你只要对着手机一说话，手机就能找到你想要的信息，可快了。
Nǐ zhǐyào duìzhe shǒujī yì shuōhuà, shǒujī jiù néng zhǎodào nǐ xiǎng yào de xìnxī, kě kuài le.
You just talk to your phone and it finds what you want. It's so quick.
只要努力就能成功。
Zhǐyào nǔlì jiù néng chénggōng.
Work hard and you'll succeed.
光……就行了

You just talk?

Guāng kàn bù xíng, yào duō liàn.
Watching isn't enough; you have to practise.

much more … than before

后来就出来了这么个工具，不知道谁发明的，可比以前方便多了。

Xiànzài kěbǐ yǐqián hǎo duō le.

168.zh: 电子时代：电子书与纸书
168.title: The electronic age: e-books and paper books
168.sub: An essay: will e-books replace paper books, and does it matter?
168.transcriptNote: A reading passage from the textbook. 丝帛 (silk cloth) is how I've written a word the recording makes sound like 丝布. "iPad" is said in English.

blocks.label: 一
blocks.h: 纸书的享受 · The pleasure of paper books
lines: 电子时代：电子书与纸书。
Diànzi shídài: diànzishū yǔ zhǐshū.
The electronic age: e-books and paper books.
泡上一杯茶，手捧一本书，闻着墨香，摸着纸张，
Pào shàng yì bēi chá, shǒu pěng yì běn shū, wén zhe mòxiāng, mō zhe zhǐzhāng,
Make a cup of tea, hold a book in your hands, smell the ink and feel the paper:
对读书人来说，这大概就是最放松、最享受的时刻了。
duì dúshūrén lái shuō, zhè dàgài jiùshì zuì fàngsōng, zuì xiǎngshòu de shíkè le.
for a reader, this is probably the most relaxing, enjoyable moment there is.
虽然现在我们仍然可以享受跟纸书的亲密接触，
Suīrán xiànzài wǒmen réngrán kěyǐ xiǎngshòu gēn zhǐshū de qīnmì jiēchù,
Although we can still enjoy close contact with paper books today,
但是，在这个充满了电子产品的时代，纸书会不会离我们越来越远？
dànshì, zài zhège chōngmǎn le diànzi chǎnpǐn de shídài, zhǐshū huì bú huì lí wǒmen yuèláiyuè yuǎn?
in this age full of electronic devices, will paper books drift further and further away from us?
这种担心不无道理。
Zhè zhǒng dānxīn bù wú dàolǐ.
The worry isn't unfounded.
看看网站上、论坛上小说的点击量或者下载量，
Kànkan wǎngzhàn shàng, lùntán shàng xiǎoshuō de diǎnjīliàng huòzhě xiàzàiliàng,
Look at how often novels are clicked on or downloaded on websites and forums,
看看无处不在的智能手机、电子书，再看看笨重的书本，
kànkan wú chù bú zài de zhìnéng shǒujī, diànzishū, zài kànkan bènzhòng de shūběn,
at smartphones and e-readers everywhere, then at bulky printed books,
悲观的人们叹气：纸书离开我们，只不过是个时间问题罢了。
bēiguān de rénmen tànqì: zhǐshū líkāi wǒmen, zhǐbùguò shì ge shíjiān wèntí bàle.
and pessimists sigh: it's only a matter of time before paper books leave us.
而乐观的人们相信，纸书是不会被电子书完全取代的。
Ér lèguān de rénmen xiāngxìn, zhǐshū shì bú huì bèi diànzishū wánquán qǔdài de.
Optimists, though, believe paper books will never be completely replaced by e-books,
因为用手翻书、拿着笔在书上写写画画的感觉，跟看电子书完全不同。
Yīnwèi yòng shǒu fān shū, názhe bǐ zài shū shàng xiě xiě huàhuà de gǎnjué, gēn kàn diànzishū wánquán bùtóng.
because turning pages by hand and scribbling in a book with a pen feels completely different from reading an e-book.

blocks.label: 二
lines: 纸书到底好在哪里？
Zhǐshū dàodǐ hǎo zài nǎli?
What's so good about paper books?
纸本派的回答通常是：看纸书更有感觉，
Zhǐběn pài de huídá tōngcháng shì: kàn zhǐshū gèng yǒu gǎnjué,
The paper camp usually answers: reading paper books feels better;
喜欢那种指尖轻轻翻动书页的声音，
xǐhuan nà zhǒng zhǐjiān qīngqīng fāndòng shūyè de shēngyīn,
they love the sound of pages turning lightly under their fingertips,
喜欢纸书上飘来的淡淡的墨香，
xǐhuan zhǐshū shàng piāo lái de dàndàn de mòxiāng,
they love the faint smell of ink drifting from a paper book;
或者是看电子书眼睛疼，看电子书容易走神儿。
huòzhě shì kàn diànzishū yǎnjing téng, kàn diànzishū róngyì zǒushénr.
or e-books hurt their eyes, or make it easy to lose concentration.
更详细的解释，好像就没有了。
Gèng xiángxì de jiěshì, hǎoxiàng jiù méiyǒu le.
Any more detailed explanation seems to be lacking.
支持纸书的人们认为，电子书虽然可以打发许多零碎的时间，
Zhīchí zhǐshū de rénmen rènwéi, diànzishū suīrán kěyǐ dǎfā xǔduō língsuì de shíjiān,
Supporters of paper books think that although e-books can fill many odd moments,
但是它常常令人无法集中精力阅读。
dànshì tā chángcháng lìng rén wúfǎ jízhōng jīnglì yuèdú.
they often make it impossible to concentrate on reading.
电子书常常会链接到相关文章，便于查找和分享，
Diànzishū chángcháng huì liànjiē dào xiāngguān wénzhāng, biànyú cházhǎo hé fēnxiǎng,
E-books often link to related articles, which makes it easy to look things up and share them,
但也会令人忍不住点开一个又一个链接，
dàn yě huì lìng rén rěnbúzhù diǎn kāi yí ge yòu yí ge liànjiē,
but it also makes you click on link after link,
读着读着，不知不觉地就偏题了。
dú zhe dú zhe, bùzhībùjué de jiù piāntí le.
and as you read, before you know it, you've wandered off the subject.
在现阶段，要是一个孩子埋头读书，是会被表扬的；
Zài xiàn jiēduàn, yàoshì yí ge háizi máitóu dú shū, shì huì bèi biǎoyáng de;
At present, a child buried in a book will be praised;
要是成天捧着iPad，恐怕是要挨骂的吧。
yàoshì chéngtiān pěngzhe iPad, kǒngpà shì yào ái mà de ba.
one glued to an iPad all day will probably get told off.

blocks.label: 三
lines: 如果你再问：电子书到底好在哪儿？
Rúguǒ nǐ zài wèn: diànzishū dàodǐ hǎo zài nǎr?
And if you ask what's so good about e-books,
科技派的回答是：轻便，容易随身带；
Kējì pài de huídá shì: qīngbiàn, róngyì suíshēn dài;
the tech camp answers: they're light and easy to carry;
既有文字，又有音频和视频，内容丰富；
jìyǒu wénzì, yòu yǒu yīnpín hé shìpín, nèiróng fēngfù;
they have text plus audio and video, so the content is rich;
便于搜索；传播速度快，能及时读到国外的新书；
biànyú sōusuǒ; chuánbō sùdù kuài, néng jíshí dú dào guówài de xīn shū;
they're easy to search; they spread fast, so you can read new books from abroad straight away;
容量大，一个手机就可以装个图书馆。
róngliàng dà, yí ge shǒujī jiù kěyǐ zhuāng ge túshūguǎn.
they hold a lot: one phone can carry a whole library.
确实，古代只有皇帝有那么多钱、那么大的权力，
Quèshí, gǔdài zhǐyǒu huángdì yǒu nàme duō qián, nàme dà de quánlì,
It's true: in ancient times only the emperor had the money and power
可以让几百人替他抄出几部《史记》，
kěyǐ ràng jǐ bǎi rén tì tā chāo chū jǐ bù “Shǐjì”,
to have hundreds of people copy out several sets of the Records of the Grand Historian for him,
如果装起来需要成堆的箱子。
rúguǒ zhuāng qǐlái xūyào chéng duī de xiāngzi.
which would fill piles of boxes.
但今天，你只需要一个小小的移动硬盘。
Dàn jīntiān, nǐ zhǐ xūyào yí ge xiǎoxiǎo de yídòng yìngpán.
Today you only need one small portable hard drive.

blocks.label: 四
lines: 电子书是否威胁了纸书的存在？纸质书还能活多久？
Diànzishū shìfǒu wēixié le zhǐshū de cúnzài? Zhǐzhì shū hái néng huó duōjiǔ?
Do e-books threaten the existence of paper books? How long can printed books survive?
这样的问题一直被反复议论，没有停歇过。
Zhèyàng de wèntí yìzhí bèi fǎnfù yìlùn, méiyǒu tíngxiē guo.
Questions like these have been debated again and again without pause.
我却觉得无所谓。
Wǒ què juéde wúsuǒwèi.
But I don't think it matters.
无论是纸还是电脑，反正都只是记载文字的工具。
Wúlùn shì zhǐ háishi diànnǎo, fǎnzhèng dōu zhǐshì jìzǎi wénzì de gōngjù.
Paper or computer, both are just tools for recording writing.
几千年来，我们的祖先先后使用过龟甲、青铜器、竹子、丝帛等工具来记载文字。
Jǐ qiān nián lái, wǒmen de zǔxiān xiānhòu shǐyòng guo guījiǎ, qīngtóngqì, zhúzi, sībó děng gōngjù lái jìzǎi wénzì.
Over thousands of years, our ancestors have used tortoise shells, bronzes, bamboo, silk and more to record writing.
既然是工具，当然是越方便越好。
Jìrán shì gōngjù, dāngrán shì yuè fāngbiàn yuè hǎo.
Since they're tools, the more convenient the better.
至少目前，电子书的出现给我们提供了一种阅读方式。
Zhìshǎo mùqián, diànzishū de chūxiàn gěi wǒmen tígōng le yì zhǒng yuèdú fāngshì.
At least for now, e-books have given us another way to read.
至于以后怎么样，还是顺其自然吧。
Zhìyú yǐhòu zěnmeyàng, háishi shùn qí zìrán ba.
As for what happens later, let's let nature take its course.
回想起二十多年前，电脑刚刚开始普及的时候，
Huí xiǎngqǐ èrshí duō nián qián, diànnǎo gānggāng kāishǐ pǔjí de shíhou,
Think back twenty-odd years, when computers were just becoming common:
不少读书人很不愿意使用电脑，
bù shǎo dúshūrén hěn bú yuànyì shǐyòng diànnǎo,
many book lovers were very reluctant to use them;
觉得对着屏幕没有写作的兴趣，就爱那种笔尖在纸上写字的感觉。
juéde duìzhe píngmù méiyǒu xiězuò de xìngqù, jiù ài nà zhǒng bǐjiān zài zhǐ shàng xiě zì de gǎnjué.
they felt no urge to write in front of a screen, and loved the feel of a pen nib on paper.
到了今天，应该没有哪个作家不使用电脑写作吧。
Dào le jīntiān, yīnggāi méiyǒu nǎge zuòjiā bù shǐyòng diànnǎo xiězuò ba.
Today there's probably no writer who doesn't write on a computer.

blocks.label: 五
blocks.h: 阅读的习惯 · The reading habit
lines: 在我看来，阅读是一种习惯，是通过文字获得知识。
Zài wǒ kànlái, yuèdú shì yì zhǒng xíguàn, shì tōngguò wénzì huòdé zhīshí.
In my view, reading is a habit: gaining knowledge through the written word.
阅读的内容容易获得，才是养成阅读习惯的前提。
Yuèdú de nèiróng róngyì huòdé, cái shì yǎngchéng yuèdú xíguàn de qiántí.
Easy access to reading material is the precondition for forming the habit.
至于内容是印在纸上，还是出现在屏幕上，并不特别重要。
Zhìyú nèiróng shì yìn zài zhǐ shàng, háishi chūxiàn zài píngmù shàng, bìng bú tèbié zhòngyào.
Whether the content is printed on paper or appears on a screen isn't especially important.
如果你有读书的习惯，无论使用哪种阅读工具，你都会读下去。
Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu dú shū de xíguàn, wúlùn shǐyòng nǎ zhǒng yuèdú gōngjù, nǐ dōu huì dú xiaqu.
If you have the reading habit, you'll keep reading whatever tool you use.
一本好的作品，只有容易让读者读到，才更有意义。
Yì běn hǎo de zuòpǐn, zhǐyǒu róngyì ràng dúzhě dú dào, cái gèng yǒu yìyì.
A good work only has more meaning if readers can get hold of it easily.
今天，信息的传递变得更快、更方便了，这是现代科技带给人类的贡献。
Jīntiān, xìnxī de chuándì biàn de gèng kuài, gèng fāngbiàn le, zhè shì xiàndài kējì dàigěi rénlèi de gòngxiàn.
Today information travels faster and more conveniently: that's modern technology's contribution to humanity.
电子书传播迅速，范围广，并且越来越廉价，这是它最大的优势。
Diànzishū chuánbō xùnsù, fànwéi guǎng, bìngqiě yuèláiyuè liánjià, zhè shì tā zuì dà de yōushì.
E-books spread quickly and widely and keep getting cheaper: that's their greatest advantage.
我想，今天这个时代，阅读的习惯也许会比纸书时代更普遍。
Wǒ xiǎng, jīntiān zhège shídài, yuèdú de xíguàn yěxǔ huì bǐ zhǐshū shídài gèng pǔbiàn.
I think that in this era, the reading habit may become even more widespread than in the age of paper.
人们都使用智能手机，
Rénmen dōu shǐyòng zhìnéng shǒujī,
Everyone uses a smartphone;
不管是乘车还是上厕所，还是偶尔歇一会儿，这些零碎的时间都可以被阅读填满。
bùguǎn shì chéngchē háishi shàng cèsuǒ, háishi ǒu'ěr xiē yíhuìr, zhèxiē língsuì de shíjiān dōu kěyǐ bèi yuèdú tiánmǎn.
whether on a bus, on the toilet, or taking a short break, those odd moments can be filled with reading.
不过有一点是电子书取代不了的，至少在目前：
Búguò yǒu yìdiǎn shì diànzishū qǔdài bu liǎo de, zhìshǎo zài mùqián:
But there's one thing e-books can't replace, at least for now:
堆满了书的书房里，其实已经落满了灰尘，
Duīmǎn le shū de shūfáng li, qíshí yǐjīng luò mǎn le huīchén,
a study piled high with books, even if they're actually covered in dust —
拍张照片上传到网络上，还是一件挺有面子的事。
pāi zhāng zhàopiān shàng chuán dào wǎngluò shàng, háishi yí jiàn tǐng yǒu miànzi de shì.
a photo of it posted online still makes you look good.

q: 纸本派认为纸书好在哪里？
Zhǐběn pài rènwéi zhǐshū hǎo zài nǎli?
What does the paper camp like about paper books?
ans: 更有感觉：喜欢翻书页的声音和墨香；看电子书眼睛疼，容易走神儿。
Gèng yǒu gǎnjué: xǐhuan fān shūyè de shēngyīn hé mòxiāng; kàn diànzishū yǎnjing téng, róngyì zǒushénr.
They feel better: the sound of pages and the smell of ink; e-books hurt the eyes and are distracting.

q: 科技派认为电子书好在哪里？
Kējì pài rènwéi diànzishū hǎo zài nǎli?
What does the tech camp like about e-books?
ans: 轻便，好带；有文字、音频和视频；便于搜索；传播快；容量大。
Qīngbiàn, hǎo dài; yǒu wénzì, yīnpín hé shìpín; biànyú sōusuǒ; chuánbō kuài; róngliàng dà.
Light and portable; text, audio and video; easy to search; spread fast; hold a lot.
无所谓：纸和电脑都只是工具，越方便越好；重要的是阅读的习惯。
Wúsuǒwèi: zhǐ hé diànnǎo dōu zhǐshì gōngjù, yuè fāngbiàn yuè hǎo; zhòngyào de shì yuèdú de xíguàn.
It doesn't matter: paper and computers are just tools, and the more convenient the better; the habit of reading is what counts.

vocab: to let things take their course
to look good, to have face
grammar: 不无道理
not without reason
Double negative = has some reason.
这种担心不无道理。
Zhè zhǒng dānxīn bù wú dàolǐ.
The worry isn't unfounded.
他的话不无道理。
Tā dehuà bù wú dàolǐ.
He has a point.
只不过是……罢了
it's only …
Plays something down.
悲观的人们叹气：纸书离开我们，只不过是个时间问题罢了。
bēiguān de rénmen tànqì: zhǐshū líkāi wǒmen, zhǐbùguò shì ge shíjiān wèntí bàle.
and pessimists sigh: it's only a matter of time before paper books leave us.
我只不过是开个玩笑罢了。
Wǒ zhǐbùguò shì kāi ge wánxiào bàle.
I was only joking.
到底
after all, exactly
Strengthens a question.
纸书到底好在哪里？
Zhǐshū dàodǐ hǎo zài nǎli?
What's so good about paper books?
你到底去不去？
Nǐ dàodǐ qù bú qù?
Are you going or not?
令人……
to make one …
Formal 让人.
但是它常常令人无法集中精力阅读。
dànshì tā chángcháng lìng rén wúfǎ jízhōng jīnglì yuèdú.
they often make it impossible to concentrate on reading.
这件事令人高兴。
Zhè jiàn shì lìng rén gāoxìng.
This is pleasing.
V着V着
while V-ing (something happens)
Repeated V着.
读着读着，不知不觉地就偏题了。
dú zhe dú zhe, bùzhībùjué de jiù piāntí le.
and as you read, before you know it, you've wandered off the subject.
走着走着就迷路了。
Zǒu zhe zǒu zhe jiù mílù le.
I got lost while walking.
both … and …
Two features.
既有文字，又有音频和视频，内容丰富；
jìyǒu wénzì, yòu yǒu yīnpín hé shìpín, nèiróng fēngfù;
they have text plus audio and video, so the content is rich;
他既聪明又努力。

He's clever and hardworking.
无论……，反正……
whatever …, anyway …
Unconditional.
无论是纸还是电脑，反正都只是记载文字的工具。
Wúlùn shì zhǐ háishi diànnǎo, fǎnzhèng dōu zhǐshì jìzǎi wénzì de gōngjù.
Paper or computer, both are just tools for recording writing.
无论你去不去，反正我去。
Wúlùn nǐ qù bú qù, fǎnzhèng wǒ qù.
I'm going whether you go or not.
the more … the more …
Proportional.
既然是工具，当然是越方便越好。
Jìrán shì gōngjù, dāngrán shì yuè fāngbiàn yuè hǎo.
Since they're tools, the more convenient the better.
越多越好。
Yuè duō yuè hǎo.
The more the better.
至于……
as for …
Changes topic.
至于以后怎么样，还是顺其自然吧。
Zhìyú yǐhòu zěnmeyàng, háishi shùn qí zìrán ba.
As for what happens later, let's let nature take its course.
至于他，我不知道。
Zhìyú tā, wǒ bù zhīdao.
As for him, I don't know.
only if … then …
Necessary condition.
一本好的作品，只有容易让读者读到，才更有意义。
Yì běn hǎo de zuòpǐn, zhǐyǒu róngyì ràng dúzhě dú dào, cái gèng yǒu yìyì.
A good work only has more meaning if readers can get hold of it easily.
只有努力才能成功。
Zhǐyǒu nǔlì cái néng chénggōng.
Only hard work brings success.

但是它常常令人无法集中
要是一个孩子埋头读书，是会被

169.title: Papermaking
169.sub: From knotted cords to paper: how writing materials changed, and Cai Lun's four steps
169.transcriptNote: A reading passage from the textbook. 丝帛 (silk cloth) is how I've written a word the recording makes sound like 丝布. The last line, about a "paperless age", is cut short in the recording.

blocks.label: 一
lines: 造纸术。
Zàozhǐshù.
Papermaking.
今天，在纸上写字或者在电脑上打字，是再平常不过的事儿了。
Jīntiān, zài zhǐ shàng xiě zì huòzhě zài diànnǎo shàng dǎzì, shì zài píngcháng búguò de shìr le.
Today, writing on paper or typing on a computer couldn't be more ordinary.
但在很久很久以前，记录信息可没这么方便。
Dàn zài hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐqián, jìlù xìnxī kě méi zhème fāngbiàn.
But long, long ago, recording information wasn't so easy.
最初，我们的祖先主要依靠结绳记事，即在一条绳子上打结，
Zuìchū, wǒmen de zǔxiān zhǔyào yīkào jiéshéng jìshì, jí zài yì tiáo shéngzi shàng dǎ jié,
At first our ancestors mainly kept records by tying knots in a cord,
根据结的大小和多少，来说明事情的重要性和数目。
gēnjù jié de dàxiǎo hé duōshǎo, lái shuōmíng shìqing de zhòngyàoxìng hé shùmù.
using the size and number of knots to show how important things were and how many.
发明了文字以后，祖先把文字刻在龟甲或动物的骨头上。
Fāmíng le wénzì yǐhòu, zǔxiān bǎ wénzì kè zài guījiǎ huò dòngwù de gǔtou shàng.
After writing was invented, they carved characters on tortoise shells or animal bones.
后来，文字又被刻在笨重的青铜器上。
Hòulái, wénzì yòu bèi kè zài bènzhòng de qīngtóngqì shàng.
Later, writing was carved on heavy bronzes.
再后来，人们开始使用竹片和木片来书写。
Zài hòulái, rénmen kāishǐ shǐyòng zhúpiàn hé mùpiàn lái shūxiě.
Later still, people began writing on strips of bamboo and wood.
它们作为记载文字的材料，在中国有一千多年的历史。
Tāmen zuòwéi jìzǎi wénzì de cáiliào, zài Zhōngguó yǒu yìqiān duō nián de lìshǐ.
As writing materials, these were used in China for over a thousand years.
但这种书写材料容量小，体积大，重量也大，
Dàn zhè zhǒng shūxiě cáiliào róngliàng xiǎo, tǐjī dà, zhòngliàng yě dà,
But they held little, took up a lot of space and were heavy:
皇帝阅读时需要好几个人来抬书。
huángdì yuèdú shí xūyào hǎo jǐ ge rén lái tái shū.
when the emperor read, it took several people to carry the books.
后来的羊皮、丝帛等书写材料非常轻，但价格昂贵，老百姓根本用不起。
Hòulái de yángpí, sībó děng shūxiě cáiliào fēicháng qīng, dàn jiàgé ángguì, lǎobǎixìng gēnběn yòng bu qǐ.
Later materials like sheepskin and silk were very light but expensive; ordinary people couldn't afford them at all.
这时，寻找一种既经济又实用的新的书写材料，就成了整个社会发展的需求。
Zhè shí, xúnzhǎo yì zhǒng jì jīngjì yòu shíyòng de xīn de shūxiě cáiliào, jiù chéng le zhěnggè shèhuì fāzhǎn de xūqiú.
At that point, finding a new writing material that was both cheap and practical became a need for the whole of society.

blocks.label: 二
blocks.h: 纸的出现 · The arrival of paper
lines: 纸的出现，改变了人类书写材料的历史，是一项非常伟大的发明。
Zhǐ de chūxiàn, gǎibiàn le rénlèi shūxiě cáiliào de lìshǐ, shì yí xiàng fēicháng wěidà de fāmíng.
The arrival of paper changed the history of writing materials; it was a truly great invention.
即使在今天，纸仍然是我们最重要的书写材料。
Jíshǐ zài jīntiān, zhǐ réngrán shì wǒmen zuì zhòngyào de shūxiě cáiliào.
Even today, paper is still our most important writing material.
一般认为，造纸术是由中国东汉的蔡伦发明的。
Yìbān rènwéi, zàozhǐshù shì yóu Zhōngguó Dōng Hàn de Cài Lún fāmíng de.
Papermaking is generally thought to have been invented by Cai Lun in the Eastern Han.
但是也有证据说，造纸术早就存在，
Dànshì yě yǒu zhèngjù shuō, zàozhǐshù zǎojiù cúnzài,
But there is also evidence that papermaking existed earlier,
蔡伦只是经过反复实验，改进了造纸术，
Cài Lún zhǐshì jīngguò fǎnfù shíyàn, gǎijìn le zàozhǐshù,
and that Cai Lun, through repeated experiments, only improved it,
使造纸的成功率更高，成本更低。
shǐ zàozhǐ de chénggōng lǜ gèng gāo, chéngběn gèng dī.
making it more reliable and cheaper.

blocks.label: 三
lines: 蔡伦的造纸术主要分为四个步骤。
Cài Lún de zàozhǐshù zhǔyào fēnwéi sì ge bùzhòu.
Cai Lun's papermaking had four main steps.
第一步，砍下竹子或撕下树皮，
Dìyībù, kǎn xià zhúzi huò sī xià shùpí,
Step one: cut bamboo or strip off bark,
再把一些破旧的渔网等植物原料混合在一起，泡在水中，让它们充分地吸水。
zài bǎ yìxiē pòjiù de yúwǎng děng zhíwù yuánliào hùnhé zài yìqǐ, pào zài shuǐ zhōng, ràng tāmen chōngfèn de xīshuǐ.
mix it with old fishing nets and other plant materials, and soak it in water until it's thoroughly soaked.
第二步，把这些原料煮烂。
Dì-èr bù, bǎ zhèxiē yuánliào zhǔ làn.
Step two: boil the materials until soft.
第三步，等煮好的原料变冷后，倒出来，
Dì-sān bù, děng zhǔ hǎo de yuánliào biàn lěng hòu, dào chulai,
Step three: when the boiled materials have cooled, pour them out,
用木板把原料压成薄片，再放上重石压紧，将水压出。
yòng mùbǎn bǎ yuánliào yā chéng báopiàn, zài fàng shàng zhòng shí yā jǐn, jiāng shuǐ yā chū.
press them into thin sheets with a board, then weigh them down with heavy stones to squeeze the water out.
最后，把湿纸晒干，就成了纸张。
Zuìhòu, bǎ shī zhǐ shài gān, jiù chéng le zhǐzhāng.
Finally, dry the wet sheets in the sun, and you have paper.

blocks.label: 四
blocks.h: 从奢侈品到普及 · From luxury to everyday
lines: 纸最初出现时，还是昂贵的奢侈品，皇帝用它来奖励人。
Zhǐ zuìchū chūxiàn shí, háishi ángguì de shēchǐpǐn, huángdì yòng tā lái jiǎnglì rén.
When paper first appeared it was still an expensive luxury, which the emperor used as a reward.
后来，经过劳动人民不断地改进，造纸术日益成熟。
Hòulái, jīngguò láodòng rénmín búduàn de gǎijìn, zàozhǐshù rìyì chéngshú.
Later, as working people kept improving it, papermaking matured.
从此以后，纸才渐渐地普及开来。
Cóngcǐ yǐhòu, zhǐ cái jiànjiàn de pǔjí kāilai.
Only from then on did paper gradually become widespread.
说到纸，不得不提一下印刷术的发明。
Shuō dào zhǐ, bùdébù tí yíxià yìnshuāshù de fāmíng.
Speaking of paper, we have to mention the invention of printing.
它使古人摆脱了手抄的辛苦，大大提高了信息传播的效率。
Tā shǐ gǔrén bǎituō le shǒu chāo de xīnkǔ, dàdà tígāo le xìnxī chuánbō de xiàolǜ.
It freed people from the toil of copying by hand and greatly increased how efficiently information spread.
中国古代四大发明中的两个，造纸术和印刷术，都跟信息传播有关，
Zhōngguó gǔdài sì dà fāmíng zhōng de liǎng ge, zàozhǐshù hé yìnshuāshù, dōu gēn xìnxī chuánbō yǒuguān,
Two of ancient China's Four Great Inventions, papermaking and printing, both concern spreading information,
体现了古代中国人对信息的强烈需求。
tǐxiàn le gǔdài Zhōngguórén duì xìnxī de qiángliè xūqiú.
which shows how strongly the ancient Chinese needed information.
这两个发明对推动人类文明的发展起了巨大作用。
Zhè liǎng ge fāmíng duì tuīdòng rénlèi wénmíng de fāzhǎn qǐ le jùdà zuòyòng.
These two inventions played a huge part in advancing human civilisation.
下一个时代，也许是无纸时代。
Xià yí ge shídài, yěxǔ shì wú zhǐ shídài.
The next age may be a paperless one.

q: 纸出现以前，人们用什么记录信息？
Zhǐ chūxiàn yǐqián, rénmen yòng shénme jìlù xìnxī?
Before paper, what did people record information with?
ans: 结绳记事；龟甲、动物骨头；青铜器；竹片、木片；羊皮、丝帛。
Jiéshéng jìshì; guījiǎ, dòngwù gǔtou; qīngtóngqì; zhúpiàn, mùpiàn; yángpí, sībó.
Knotted cords; tortoise shells and animal bones; bronzes; bamboo and wooden strips; sheepskin and silk.

q: 竹片、木片和羊皮、丝帛各有什么问题？
Zhúpiàn, mùpiàn hé yángpí, sībó gè yǒu shénme wèntí?
What were the problems with bamboo and wood, and with sheepskin and silk?
ans: 竹片、木片容量小、体积大、重量大；羊皮、丝帛价格昂贵，老百姓用不起。
Zhúpiàn, mùpiàn róngliàng xiǎo, tǐjī dà, zhòngliàng dà; yángpí, sībó jiàgé ángguì, lǎobǎixìng yòng bu qǐ.
Bamboo and wood held little and were bulky and heavy; sheepskin and silk were too expensive for ordinary people.

q: 蔡伦造纸的四个步骤是什么？
Cài Lún zàozhǐ de sì ge bùzhòu shì shénme?
What were Cai Lun's four steps?
ans: 一、把竹子、树皮、渔网等原料混合，泡在水中；二、煮烂；三、冷后倒出，用木板压成薄片，用重石压出水；四、晒干。
Yī, bǎ zhúzi, shùpí, yúwǎng děng yuánliào hùnhé, pào zài shuǐ zhōng; èr, zhǔ làn; sān, lěng hòu dào chū, yòng mùbǎn yā chéng báopiàn, yòng zhòng shí yā chūshuǐ; sì, shài gān.
1. Mix bamboo, bark, nets and so on and soak them; 2. boil until soft; 3. cool, pour out, press into sheets with a board and squeeze out the water with stones; 4. dry in the sun.

170.title: Lili's after-school classes
170.sub: Lesson 12 · 求职 Job hunting: listening review. Lili on the classes she took as a child
170.transcriptNote: Lesson 12 begins with a listening review. 问 is the interviewer and 丽 is Lili. Natural speech, lightly tidied. The answer is my own summary.

blocks.label: 说明
lines: 第十二课。
Dì-shí'èr kè.
Lesson 12.
求职。
Qiúzhí.
Job hunting.
听说部分。
Tīng-shuō bùfen.
Listening and speaking.
听力复习。
Tīnglì fùxí.
Listening review.
听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the question.

q: 丽丽小的时候参加过补习班、特长班吗？如果参加过，她学过什么？如果没参加过，说说为什么。
Lìli xiǎo de shíhou cānjiā guo bǔxíbān, tècháng bān ma? Rúguǒ cānjiā guo, tā xué guo shénme? Rúguǒ méi cānjiā guo, shuōshuo wèishénme.
Did Lili go to cram school or special-skills classes as a child? If so, what did she learn? If not, why not?
ans: 参加过。四五岁时学过钢琴，是自己想学的，很感兴趣；也报过画画班，是父母看周围小伙伴都报了才让她去的，她不喜欢，没认真学，没有成功。

Cānjiā guo. Sì-wǔ suì shí xué guo gāngqín, shì zìjǐ xiǎng xué de, hěn gǎn xìngqù; yě bào guo huàhuà bān, shì fùmǔ kàn zhōuwéi xiǎo huǒbàn dōu bào le cái ràng tā qù de, tā bù xǐhuan, méi rènzhēn xué, méiyǒu chénggōng.

Yes. At four or five she learned piano, which she wanted to do and enjoyed. She also went to an art class because her parents saw her friends doing it; she didn't like it, didn't take it seriously, and it didn't work out.

blocks.label: 采访
blocks.h: 丽丽的兴趣班 · The interview
lines: 讲一讲你参加补习班的情况，还记得吗？
Jiǎng yì jiǎng nǐ cānjiā bǔxíbān de qíngkuàng, hái jìde ma?
Tell me about the extra classes you went to. Do you remember?
问
记得。
Jìde.
Yes.
丽
什么时候开始参加补习班？
Shénme shíhou kāishǐ cānjiā bǔxíbān?
When did you start?
问
如果说补习班，如果算上很小的时候的兴趣班的时候，那我很小的时候学过钢琴。
Rúguǒ shuō bǔxíbān, rúguǒ suàn shàng hěn xiǎo de shíhou de xìngqù bān de shíhou, nà wǒ hěn xiǎo de shíhou xué guo gāngqín.

丽
很小，小到什么时候？
Hěn xiǎo, xiǎo dào shénme shíhou?

问
那应该是四五岁的时候。
Nà yīnggāi shì sì-wǔ suì de shíhou.
Four or five, I think.
丽
学钢琴啊。学钢琴是你想学吗？
Xué gāngqín a. Xué gāngqín shì nǐ xiǎng xué ma?
Piano! Did you want to learn it?
问
钢琴是我自己想学的，所以那个对我兴趣还比较大。
Gāngqín shì wǒ zìjǐ xiǎng xué de, suǒyǐ nàge duì wǒ xìngqù hái bǐjiào dà.
Piano was my own choice, so I was quite interested in it.
丽
但是也报过画画班，至少在我父母看来就没有成功。
Dànshì yě bào guo huàhuà bān, zhìshǎo zài wǒ fùmǔ kànlái jiù méiyǒu chénggōng.
But I was also signed up for an art class, which, in my parents' eyes at least, was a failure.
丽
画画班是你想学的吗？
Huàhuà bān shì nǐ xiǎng xué de ma?
Did you want to do art?
问
不是。
Bú shì.
No.
丽

Nà shì jiāzhǎng ràng nǐ xué?
So your parents made you?
问
嗯，对。因为当时看着周围两个小伙伴都报了这个班，
ǹg, duì. Yīnwèi dāngshí kànzhe zhōuwéi liǎng ge xiǎo huǒbàn dōu bào le zhège bān,
Yes. At the time two of my friends had signed up for it,
丽
我父母呢也觉得我也应该报一个，那我也就跟着去了。
wǒ fùmǔ ne yě juéde wǒ yě yīnggāi bào yí ge, nà wǒ yě jiù gēnzhe qù le.
so my parents thought I should too, and I just went along.

Jiéguǒ wǒ zài nàli méiyǒu rènzhēn duìdài, yīnwèi bù xǐhuan.

丽

171.title: Jiang Huanchen's extra classes
171.sub: A first-year pupil from the northeast tells a reporter about her summer classes
171.transcriptNote: 记 is the reporter and 江 is Jiang Huanchen, a little girl from northeast China. Her speech is fast and childish, and a few of her words are unclear; the line about her mother saying she must stick with it is my best guess. The answers are my own reading.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
东北小女孩江欢晨在和记者谈自己参加补习班和特长班的情况。
Dōngběi xiǎo nǚhái Jiāng Huānchén zài hé jìzhě tán zìjǐ cānjiā bǔxíbān hé tècháng bān de qíngkuàng.
Jiang Huanchen, a little girl from the northeast, is telling a reporter about her cram and special-skills classes.
听她们的谈话，然后回答下面的问题。
Tīng tāmen de tánhuà, ránhòu huídá xiàmiàn de wèntí.
Listen to them, then answer the questions.

q: 江欢晨喜欢去补习班或特长班吗？为什么？
Jiāng Huānchén xǐhuan qù bǔxíbān huò tècháng bān ma? Wèishénme?
Does Jiang Huanchen like going to these classes? Why?
ans: 不喜欢。什么都不想补，都是爸爸妈妈让她补的；而且天天上课，没有一天休息。
Bù xǐhuan. Shénme dōu bù xiǎng bǔ, dōu shì bàba māma ràng tā bǔ de; érqiě tiāntiān shàng kè, méiyǒu yì tiān xiūxi.
No. She doesn't want to do any of them; her parents make her. She has classes every day without a day off.

q: 她的妈妈为什么让她学钢琴？
Tā de māma wèishénme ràng tā xué gāngqín?
Why does her mother make her learn piano?
ans: 爸爸妈妈想让她学钢琴，觉得必须坚持学下来，以后生活会好的。
Bàba māma xiǎng ràng tā xué gāngqín, juéde bìxū jiānchí xué xialai, yǐhòu shēnghuó huì hǎo de.
Her parents want her to learn it and think she must stick with it, because life will be better later.

blocks.label: 采访
blocks.h: 江欢晨的补习班 · The interview
lines: 你叫什么名啊？
Nǐ jiào shénme míng a?
What's your name?
记
江欢晨。
Jiāng Huānchén.
Jiang Huanchen.
江
你上几年级了？
Nǐ shàng jǐ niánjí le?
What year are you in?
记
一年。
Yì nián.
One.
江
一年级啊。你今年夏天补课了吗？
Yī niánjí a. Nǐ jīnnián xiàtiān bǔ kè le ma?
Year one! Did you have extra classes this summer?
记
补了。
Bǔ le.
Yes.
江
补什么课了？
Bǔ shénme kè le?
What classes?
记
英语、乐理、钢琴。
Yīngyǔ, yuèlǐ, gāngqín.
English, music theory and piano.
江
英语、乐理、钢琴是你自己想补的，还是妈妈爸爸让补的？
Yīngyǔ, yuèlǐ, gāngqín shì nǐ zìjǐ xiǎng bǔ de, háishi māma bàba ràng bǔ de?
Did you want to do English, music theory and piano, or did Mum and Dad make you?
记
我妈让我补的是英语，然后我爸我妈让我补的是钢琴和乐理。
Wǒ mā ràng wǒ bǔ de shì Yīngyǔ, ránhòu wǒ bà wǒ mā ràng wǒ bǔ de shì gāngqín hé yuèlǐ.
Mum made me do English, and Dad and Mum made me do piano and music theory.
江
钢琴和乐理。那你自己想补英语吗？
Gāngqín hé yuèlǐ. Nà nǐ zìjǐ xiǎng bǔ Yīngyǔ ma?
Piano and music theory. Do you want to do English?
记
不想，什么都不想。
Bù xiǎng, shénme dōu bù xiǎng.
No. I don't want to do any of it.
江
他们让你补的。那他们为什么让你补啊？
Tāmen ràng nǐ bǔ de. Nà tāmen wèishénme ràng nǐ bǔ a?
They make you. So why do they make you?
记
我英语不好。钢琴，他们还想让我学钢琴。
Wǒ Yīngyǔ bù hǎo. Gāngqín, tāmen hái xiǎng ràng wǒ xué gāngqín.
My English isn't good. And piano, they want me to learn piano.
江
他们让你学钢琴。那你自己喜欢弹钢琴吗？
Tāmen ràng nǐ xué gāngqín. Nà nǐ zìjǐ xǐhuan dàn gāngqín ma?
They want you to learn piano. Do you like playing it?
记
不喜欢。
Bù xǐhuan.
No.
江
那你们班补课的孩子多吗？
Nà nǐmen bān bǔ kè de háizi duō ma?
Do many children in your class have extra lessons?
记
补英语的多。
Bǔ Yīngyǔ de duō.
Lots do English.
江
英语多少个孩子？
Yīngyǔ duōshǎo ge háizi?
How many do English?
记
英语全都补，所有的孩子都补。钢琴院里谁也不补，只有我补。
Yīngyǔ quándōu bǔ, suǒyǒu de háizi dōu bǔ. Gāngqín yuàn li shéi yě bù bǔ, zhǐyǒu wǒ bǔ.
Everyone does English, all the children. Piano: nobody in our compound does it, only me.
江
那他们都学不学钢琴？不学。那你要是不学，你跟妈妈说不学不行吗？
Nà tāmen dōu xué bù xué gāngqín? Bù xué. Nà nǐ yàoshì bù xué, nǐ gēn māma shuō bù xué bù xíng ma?
So they don't learn piano? No. If you don't want to, can't you tell Mum you won't?
记
不行。
Bù xíng.
No.
江
为什么？
Wèishénme?
Why?
记
我跟她说了，不行，必须要学下来，以后生活会好的。
Wǒ gēn tā shuō le, bù xíng, bìxū yào xué xialai, yǐhòu shēnghuó huì hǎo de.
I told her. She said no, I have to stick with it, and life will be better later.
江
我再问问你，你哪天补英语，哪天补钢琴呢？
Wǒ zài wèn wèn nǐ, nǐ nǎ tiān bǔ Yīngyǔ, nǎ tiān bǔ gāngqín ne?
Let me ask again: which days do you do English, and which piano?
记
礼拜五，然后礼拜三和礼拜天。
Lǐbài wǔ, ránhòu lǐbài sān hé lǐbài tiān.
Friday, then Wednesday and Sunday.
江
那你有没有不补课的时候，不去学习的时候啊？星期一到星期五，有没有自己在家什么也不去、不学的时候？
Nà nǐ yǒu méiyǒu bù bǔ kè de shíhou, bú qù xuéxí de shíhou a? Xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, yǒu méiyǒu zìjǐ zài jiā shénme yě bú qù, bù xué de shíhou?
Is there ever a time with no classes? Monday to Friday, any time you just stay home and don't study?
记
没有，天天都补。
Méiyǒu, tiāntiān dōu bǔ.
No, I have classes every day.
江
没有一天休息的？
Méiyǒu yì tiān xiūxi de?
Not one day off?
记
早上歇了，晚上就上课；早上上课，就晚上歇着。
Zǎoshang xiē le, wǎnshang jiù shàng kè; zǎoshang shàng kè, jiù wǎnshang xiēzhe.
If I rest in the morning, I have class in the evening; if I have class in the morning, I rest in the evening.
江
那你累不累呢？
Nà nǐ lèi bú lèi ne?
Are you tired?
记
累。
Lèi.
Yes.
江

grammar: … or …?
Alternative question.
英语、乐理、钢琴是你自己想补的，还是妈妈爸爸让补的？
Yīngyǔ, yuèlǐ, gāngqín shì nǐ zìjǐ xiǎng bǔ de, háishi māma bàba ràng bǔ de?
Did you want to do English, music theory and piano, or did Mum and Dad make you?
你喝茶还是喝咖啡？

Tea or coffee?

英语全都补，所有的孩子都补。钢琴院里谁也不补，只有我补。
Yīngyǔ quándōu bǔ, suǒyǒu de háizi dōu bǔ. Gāngqín yuàn li shéi yě bù bǔ, zhǐyǒu wǒ bǔ.

Asks about occurrence.

Nà nǐ yǒu méiyǒu bù bǔ kè de shíhou, bú qù xuéxí de shíhou a? Xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, yǒu méiyǒu zìjǐ zài jiā shénme yě bú qù, bù xué de shíhou?
Is there ever a time with no classes? Monday to Friday, any time you just stay home and don't study?
你有没有不开心的时候？

没有一天……
not a single day …
Emphatic.
没有一天休息的？
Méiyǒu yì tiān xiūxi de?

172.title: Southerners on the north
172.sub: Two southerners say what they like most and least about northern China
172.transcriptNote: 问 is the interviewer; 甲 is from Hangzhou in Zhejiang and 乙 from Changsha. Natural speech, lightly tidied. The answers are my own summaries.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，回答问题 · Listen and answer
lines: 听录音，回答问题。
Tīng lùyīn, huídá wèntí.
Listen and answer the questions.
甲来自杭州，乙来自长沙，他们都是南方人，但是在北方生活过。
Jiǎ láizì Hángzhōu, yǐ láizì Chángshā, tāmen dōu shì nánfāng rén, dànshì zài běifāng shēnghuó guo.
A is from Hangzhou and B from Changsha. Both are southerners but have lived in the north.
请说说他们最喜欢北方的哪些方面，最不喜欢北方的哪些方面。
Qǐng shuōshuo tāmen zuì xǐhuan běifāng de nǎxiē fāngmiàn, zuì bù xǐhuan běifāng de nǎxiē fāngmiàn.
Say what they like most and least about the north.

q: 他们最喜欢北方的什么？
Tāmen zuì xǐhuan běifāng de shénme?
What do they like most about the north?
ans: 甲：北京的太阳、阳光，因为杭州雨水很多；乙：北方的暖气，因为家乡冬天很冷但没有暖气。
Jiǎ: Běijīng de tàiyáng, yángguāng, yīnwèi Hángzhōu yǔshuǐ hěn duō; yǐ: běifāng de nuǎnqì, yīnwèi jiāxiāng dōngtiān hěn lěng dàn méiyǒu nuǎnqì.
A: Beijing's sunshine, because Hangzhou is so rainy. B: the central heating, because winters at home are cold with no heating.

q: 他们最不喜欢北方的什么？
Tāmen zuì bù xǐhuan běifāng de shénme?
ans: 甲：污染太严重，人太多；乙：北方的食物，口味太单调、太枯燥，不像长沙菜又辣又咸。
Jiǎ: wūrǎn tài yánzhòng, rén tài duō; yǐ: běifāng de shíwù, kǒuwèi tài dāndiào, tài kūzào, bú xiàng Chángshā cài yòu là yòu xián.
A: the bad pollution and the crowds. B: northern food, which tastes bland and dull compared with spicy, salty Changsha food.

blocks.label: 喜欢
blocks.h: 最喜欢北方的什么？ · What they like
lines: 你是哪的人？
Nǐ shì nǎ de rén?
Where are you from?
问
我老家是浙江的。
Wǒ lǎojiā shì Zhèjiāng de.
My home is in Zhejiang.
甲
那你算南方人还是北方人？
Nà nǐ suàn nánfāng rén háishi běifāng rén?
So are you a southerner or a northerner?
问
南方啊。
Nánfāng a.
Southerner.
甲
我是长沙人，我长沙生长沙长。
Wǒ shì Chángshā rén, wǒ Chángshā shēng Chángshā zhǎng.
I'm from Changsha, born and bred.
乙
你算南方人北方人？
Nǐ suàn nánfāng rén běifāng rén?
Southerner or northerner?
问
南方人，肯定是。
Nánfāng rén, kěndìng shì.
Southerner, definitely.
乙
你们两位都是南方人。我现在想问一个问题，你们最喜欢北方的什么？
Nǐmen liǎng wèi dōu shì nánfāng rén. Wǒ xiànzài xiǎng wèn yí ge wèntí, nǐmen zuì xǐhuan běifāng de shénme?
You're both southerners. My question is: what do you like most about the north?
问
可以是一个东西呀，或者是一种情况啊，或一个方面。
Kěyǐ shì yí ge dōngxi ya, huòzhě shì yì zhǒng qíngkuàng a, huò yí ge fāngmiàn.
It can be a thing, a situation, or an aspect.
问
是这样，因为我在北京生活了十年，然后呢，我对北京……其实我最喜欢的是北京的太阳。
Shì zhèyàng, yīnwèi wǒ zài Běijīng shēnghuó le shí nián, ránhòu ne, wǒ duì Běijīng…… qíshí wǒ zuì xǐhuan de shì Běijīng de tàiyáng.
Well, I lived in Beijing for ten years, and what I actually like most about Beijing is the sun.
甲
因为我是从那个浙江那个杭州那边过来的，所以就是那边的雨水很多。
Yīnwèi wǒ shì cóng nàge Zhèjiāng nàge Hángzhōu nàbiān guòlái de, suǒyǐ jiùshì nàbiān de yǔshuǐ hěn duō.
I come from Hangzhou in Zhejiang, where it rains a lot.
甲
然后北京呢一年四季下雨真的很少，所以我觉得我最喜欢的是北方的这个阳光。
Ránhòu Běijīng ne yì nián sìjì xià yǔ zhēn de hěn shǎo, suǒyǐ wǒ juéde wǒ zuì xǐhuan de shì běifāng de zhège yángguāng.
In Beijing it really rarely rains all year, so what I like most is the northern sunshine.
甲
你呢？
Nǐ ne?
And you?
问
我最喜欢北方的暖气。
Wǒ zuì xǐhuan běifāng de nuǎnqì.
I like the northern central heating best.
乙
为什么呢？
Wèishénme ne?
Why?
问
因为冬天南方……实际在我们家乡呢，既不是特别南的地方，但是呢又算南方，
Yīnwèi dōngtiān nánfāng…… shíjì zài wǒmen jiāxiāng ne, jì bú shì tèbié nán de dìfang, dànshì ne yòu suàn nánfāng,
Because in winter the south… actually my hometown isn't that far south, but it still counts as the south,
乙
实际冬天也非常冷，但是没有暖气，所以不太舒服。
shíjì dōngtiān yě fēicháng lěng, dànshì méiyǒu nuǎnqì, suǒyǐ bú tài shūfu.
and it's actually very cold in winter, but there's no heating, so it's not very comfortable.
乙

blocks.label: 不喜欢
blocks.h: 最不喜欢北方的什么？ · What they dislike
lines: 下一个问题呢，是你最不喜欢北方的什么？
Xià yí ge wèntí ne, shì nǐ zuì bù xǐhuan běifāng de shénme?
Next question: what do you like least about the north?
问
这个问题比较简单，因为在北京大家都知道最大的问题就是污染的问题。我觉得这是最大的问题。
Zhège wèntí bǐjiào jiǎndān, yīnwèi zài Běijīng dàjiā dōu zhīdao zuì dà de wèntí jiùshì wūrǎn de wèntí. Wǒ juéde zhè shì zuì dà de wèntí.
That's easy. As everyone knows, the biggest problem in Beijing is pollution. I think that's the biggest problem.
甲
其次呢，在北京第二个问题是人太多，北京太大……
Qícì ne, zài Běijīng dì-èr ge wèntí shì rén tài duō, Běijīng tài dà……
Second, in Beijing there are too many people, Beijing is too big…
甲
不是北京，是北方啊。
Bú shì Běijīng, shì běifāng a.
Not Beijing, the north.
问
北方啊，因为我对北方其他的那个城市了解并不多。
Běifāng a, yīnwèi wǒ duì běifāng qítā de nàge chéngshì liǎojiě bìngbù duō.
The north, well, I don't know other northern cities very well.
甲
我在北京生活了十年的话，我就感觉最明显就是北京这个地方那个污染太严重，然后就是那个人太多。
Wǒ zài Běijīng shēnghuó le shí nián dehuà, wǒ jiù gǎnjué zuì míngxiǎn jiùshì Běijīng zhège dìfang nàge wūrǎn tài yánzhòng, ránhòu jiùshì nàge rén tài duō.
Having lived in Beijing for ten years, what I notice most is that the pollution is really bad, and there are too many people.
甲
那你呢？对北方的话，你有没有在北方生活过？
Nà nǐ ne? Duì běifāng dehuà, nǐ yǒu méiyǒu zài běifāng shēnghuó guo?
And you? Have you lived in the north?
问
没有长期生活过，可能偶尔有这种……偶尔的印象。
Méiyǒu chángqī shēnghuó guo, kěnéng ǒu'ěr yǒu zhè zhǒng…… ǒu'ěr de yìnxiàng.
Not for long; I just have the odd impression.
乙
北方，包括北方人哪，包括北方的都可以的，最不喜欢的是什么？
Běifāng, bāokuò běifāng rén nǎ, bāokuò běifāng de dōu kěyǐ de, zuì bù xǐhuan de shì shénme?
The north, including northerners, anything northern. What do you like least?
问
最不喜欢的，我想我最不适应的是北方的食物啊，
Zuì bù xǐhuan de, wǒ xiǎng wǒ zuì bú shìyìng de shì běifāng de shíwù a,
What I like least, what I'm least used to, is northern food,
乙
因为它的口味我觉得太……或者甚至于是太枯燥了一点，我觉得。
yīnwèi tā de kǒuwèi wǒ juéde tài…… huòzhě shènzhìyú shì tài kūzào le yìdiǎn, wǒ juéde.
because the flavours are too… even a bit dull, I think.
乙
那你再说一下家乡是哪里？
Nà nǐ zàishuō yíxià jiāxiāng shì nǎli?
Tell me again where your hometown is?
问
家乡是长沙。
Jiāxiāng shì Chángshā.
Changsha.
乙
长沙的口味是什么？
Chángshā de kǒuwèi shì shénme?
What's Changsha food like?
问
长沙的口味偏辣，然后比较重。
Chángshā de kǒuwèi piān là, ránhòu bǐjiào zhòng.
Changsha food is on the spicy side and fairly strong.
乙
口味比较咸，对吗？
Kǒuwèi bǐjiào xián, duì ma?
Quite salty?
问
对，咸辣，然后色香味俱全。
Duì, xián là, ránhòu sè xiāng wèi jù quán.
Yes, salty and spicy, and it looks, smells and tastes great.
乙
就是说你觉得菜没味儿，对吗？
Jiùshì shuō nǐ juéde cài méi wèir, duì ma?
So you think the food has no flavour?
问
对。
Duì.
Right.
乙
嗯，好的。
ǹg, hǎo de.
OK, good.
问

173.title: Ms Gong on renovating courtyard houses
173.sub: Should Beijing's hutongs be demolished or renovated?
173.transcriptNote: 问 is the interviewer and 龚 is Ms Gong. Natural speech with fillers trimmed. The summary of her views is my own reading.

blocks.label: 说明
blocks.h: 听录音，总结大意 · Summarise the main ideas
lines: 听录音，总结大意。
Tīng lùyīn, zǒngjié dàyì.
Listen and summarise the main ideas.
龚女士在谈自己对改造四合院的看法。
Gōng nǚshì zài tán zìjǐ duì gǎizào sìhéyuàn de kànfǎ.
Ms Gong is talking about her views on renovating courtyard houses.
请听录音，然后总结一下她的主要观点。
Qǐng tīng lùyīn, ránhòu zǒngjié yíxià tā de zhǔyào guāndiǎn.
Listen, then sum up her main points.

q: 龚女士的主要观点是什么？
Gōng nǚshì de zhǔyào guāndiǎn shì shénme?
What are Ms Gong's main points?
ans: 她和身边知识圈的人都非常反对拆毁胡同，觉得很可惜、很遗憾；她认为胡同有很大的保存价值；只要稍微改造一下，胡同还是很适合住人的，改造后的四合院很传统，很有特色。

Tā hé shēnbiān zhīshi quān de rén dōu fēicháng fǎnduì chāihuǐ hútòng, juéde hěn kěxī, hěn yíhàn; tā rènwéi hútòng yǒu hěn dà de bǎocún jiàzhí; zhǐyào shāowēi gǎizào yíxià, hútòng háishi hěn shìhé zhù rén de, gǎizào hòu de sìhéyuàn hěn chuántǒng, hěn yǒu tèsè.

She and the educated people she knows strongly oppose demolishing the hutongs and find it a great pity. She thinks they are very worth preserving, and that with a little renovation they're perfectly liveable; renovated courtyard houses are traditional and full of character.

blocks.label: 采访
blocks.h: 胡同该不该拆？ · The interview
lines: 那你有没有去过北京的胡同？
Nà nǐ yǒu méiyǒu qù guo Běijīng de hútòng?
Have you been to Beijing's hutongs?
问
当然，去过很多次啊。
Dāngrán, qù guo hěn duōcì a.
Of course, many times.
龚
你给我讲一下，就是说你了不了解北京人他对这些胡同里边的一些建筑被拆毁——
Nǐ gěi wǒ jiǎng yíxià, jiùshì shuō nǐ liǎo bu liǎojiě Běijīng rén tā duì zhèxiē hútòng lǐbiān de yìxiē jiànzhù bèi chāihuǐ——
Tell me: do you know what Beijingers think about buildings in the hutongs being demolished —
问
有的时候是胡同，有的是四合院，有的是大杂院——拆毁的这个看法，你了解吗？
Yǒu de shíhou shì hútòng, yǒude shì sìhéyuàn, yǒude shì dàzáyuàn—— chāihuǐ de zhège kànfǎ, nǐ liǎojiě ma?
sometimes hutongs, sometimes courtyard houses, sometimes shared courtyards? Do you know their views?
问
我遇到的都是那个知识圈的人。
Wǒ yùdào de dōu shì nàge zhīshi quān de rén.
The people I meet are all from educated circles.
龚
那他们意见应该很大了，还是反对的？
Nà tāmen yìjiàn yīnggāi hěn dà le, háishi fǎnduì de?
So they must have strong opinions. Are they against it?
问
当然反对，非常反对。
Dāngrán fǎnduì, fēicháng fǎnduì.
Of course. Very much against.
龚
应该说，因为北京现在现存的比较好的胡同其实很少，
Yīnggāi shuō, yīnwèi Běijīng xiànzài xiàncún de bǐjiào hǎo de hútòng qíshí hěn shǎo,
You see, there are actually very few good hutongs left in Beijing now,
龚
所以大家都会聊起以前北京有很多特别好的胡同，现在都被拆掉了，所以大家都觉得非常可惜。
suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu huì liáo qǐ yǐqián Běijīng yǒu hěn duō tèbié hǎo de hútòng, xiànzài dōu bèi chāi diào le, suǒyǐ dàjiā dōu juéde fēicháng kěxī.
so people talk about how Beijing used to have lots of really good hutongs that have all been pulled down, and everyone thinks it's a great shame.
龚
很遗憾。
Hěn yíhàn.
A real pity.
问
很遗憾。
Hěn yíhàn.
A real pity.
龚
但是我听说北京市民有的说，那个胡同里边的，现在有很多的四合院，或者原来有很多四合院，其实没法住人了，
Dànshì wǒ tīngshuō Běijīng shìmín yǒu de shuō, nàge hútòng lǐbiān de, xiànzài yǒu hěn duō de sìhéyuàn, huòzhě yuánlái yǒu hěn duō sìhéyuàn, qíshí méifǎ zhù rén le,
But I've heard some Beijingers say that many of the courtyard houses in the hutongs are actually unfit to live in,
问
所以才需要改建，所以说有必要给它拆了。这你了解吗？
suǒyǐ cái xūyào gǎijiàn, suǒyǐ shuō yǒu bìyào gěi tā chāi le. Zhè nǐ liǎojiě ma?
so they need rebuilding, so it's necessary to pull them down. Do you know about that?
问
这方面我具体的倒是没有深入地去了解过。
Zhè fāngmiàn wǒ jùtǐ de dàoshì méiyǒu shēnrù de qù liǎojiě guo.
I haven't looked into that in any depth.
龚
但是我觉得，胡同的话，它还是有很大的保存价值的。
Dànshì wǒ juéde, hútòng dehuà, tā háishi yǒu hěn dà de bǎocún jiàzhí de.
But I think the hutongs are very much worth preserving.
龚
另外我觉得胡同的话，其实只要稍微改造一下，应该还是很适合住人的。
Lìngwài wǒ juéde hútòng dehuà, qíshí zhǐyào shāowēi gǎizào yíxià, yīnggāi háishi hěn shìhé zhù rén de.
And I think if they're just renovated a little, they're actually very good to live in.
龚
因为我进去参观过一些胡同，那些住在里面的家庭，我觉得很好啊，很有感觉。
Yīnwèi wǒ jìnqù cānguān guo yìxiē hútòng, nàxiē zhù zài lǐmiàn de jiātíng, wǒ juéde hěn hǎo a, hěn yǒu gǎnjué.
I've been inside some, visited the families living there, and I thought they were lovely, really atmospheric.
龚
改造后的胡同是吗？
Gǎizào hòu de hútòng shì ma?
Renovated hutongs, you mean?
问
改造后的。
Gǎizào hòu de.
Renovated ones.
龚
那里边住人了吗？
Nà lǐbian zhù rén le ma?
Do people live in them?
问
住的，住的。有一些当然作为办公的或者什么的，也有一些自己家住的那种。
Zhù de, zhù de. Yǒu yìxiē dāngrán zuòwéi bàngōng de huòzhě shénme de, yě yǒu yìxiē zìjǐ jiā zhù de nà zhǒng.
Yes, they do. Some are offices or whatever, of course, but some are family homes.
龚
我觉得很好啊，很有感觉的。
Wǒ juéde hěn hǎo a, hěn yǒu gǎnjué de.
I think they're lovely, really atmospheric.
龚
什么感觉？
Shénme gǎnjué?
What kind of atmosphere?
问
就是那种很传统啊，而且它里面装修啊，就整个装饰都非常的……就是有中国的那种传统，对，非常有特色。
Jiùshì nà zhǒng hěn chuántǒng a, érqiě tā lǐmiàn zhuāngxiū a, jiù zhěnggè zhuāngshì dōu fēicháng de…… jiùshì yǒu Zhōngguó de nà zhǒng chuántǒng, duì, fēicháng yǒu tèsè.
Very traditional. And the interior decoration, the whole look is very… very Chinese and traditional. Yes, full of character.
龚

so people talk about how Beijing used to have lots of really good hutongs that have all been pulled down, and everyone thinks it's a great shame.

174.title: Job hunting and employment
174.sub: A radio interview with Ms Li from a careers centre about graduate jobs
174.transcriptNote: 主 is the presenter and 李 is Ms Li from the city's university careers centre. Who says a couple of the follow-up lines is my judgement. 海归 ("sea turtles") are Chinese returning from study abroad.

blocks.label: 引子
blocks.h: 就业压力 · The pressure to find work
lines: 求职与就业。
Qiúzhí yǔ jiùyè.
Job hunting and employment.
主
每年夏季，中国都有大量的毕业生进入就业市场，寻找发展机会。
Měinián xiàjì, Zhōngguó dōu yǒu dàliàng de bìyèshēng jìnrù jiùyè shìchǎng, xúnzhǎo fāzhǎn jīhuì.
Every summer, huge numbers of graduates in China enter the job market looking for opportunities.
主
从二零一四年起，每年的大学应届毕业生就已经超过了七百万。
Cóng èr líng yī sì nián qǐ, měinián de dàxué yīngjiè bìyèshēng jiù yǐjīng chāoguò le qībǎi wàn.
Since 2014, the number of new university graduates each year has exceeded seven million.
主
加上受到金融危机的影响，毕业生面临着巨大的就业压力和挑战。
Jiāshàng shòudào jīnróng wēijī de yǐngxiǎng, bìyèshēng miànlín zhe jùdà de jiùyè yālì hé tiǎozhàn.
Add the effects of the financial crisis, and graduates face enormous pressure and challenges in finding work.
主
我们来采访一下本市大学生就业指导中心的李老师。
Wǒmen lái cǎifǎng yíxià běnshì dàxuéshēng jiùyè zhǐdǎo zhōngxīn de Lǐ lǎoshī.
We're talking to Ms Li from the city's university careers centre.
主
李老师您好。能否请您简单地介绍一下，我市大学毕业生就业的情况？
Lǐ lǎoshī nínhǎo. Néngfǒu qǐng nín jiǎndān de jièshào yíxià, wǒ shì dàxué bìyèshēng jiùyè de qíngkuàng?
Hello, Ms Li. Could you briefly describe the employment situation for graduates in our city?
主
好的。本市有八所大学，去年共有九千多名应届毕业生。
Hǎo de. Běnshì yǒu bā suǒ dàxué, qùnián gòngyǒu jiǔqiān duō míng yīngjiè bìyèshēng.
Certainly. The city has eight universities, and last year there were over nine thousand graduates.
李
毕业后主要有三种选择：考研、出国和就业。
Bìyè hòu zhǔyào yǒu sān zhǒng xuǎnzé: kǎoyán, chū guó hé jiùyè.
After graduating they have three main choices: postgraduate study, going abroad, or getting a job.
李
选择就业的这部分人当中，据统计，只有百分之二十五能马上签下合同被录用。
Xuǎnzé jiùyè de zhè bùfen rén dāngzhōng, jù tǒngjì, zhǐyǒu bǎi fēn zhī èrshíwǔ néng mǎshàng qiān xià hétóng bèi lùyòng.
Of those who look for jobs, statistics show only 25% sign a contract and are hired straight away.
李
所以有人说，毕业等于失业。
Suǒyǐ yǒu rén shuō, bìyè děngyú shīyè.
So some people say graduating means unemployment.
李

blocks.label: 市场
blocks.h: 就业市场 · The job market
lines: 为什么就业率不高？
Wèishénme jiùyèlǜ bù gāo?
Why is the employment rate low?
主
这个问题要从两方面来看。先说说就业市场。
Zhège wèntí yào cóng liǎng fāngmiàn lái kàn. Xiān shuōshuo jiùyè shìchǎng.
We need to look at it from two sides. First, the job market.
李
在连续十年保持高速增长后，中国经济正在逐渐放慢脚步。
Zài liánxù shí nián bǎochí gāosù zēngzhǎng hòu, Zhōngguó jīngjì zhèngzài zhújiàn fàngmàn jiǎobù.
After ten straight years of rapid growth, China's economy is gradually slowing down.
李
大学毕业生数量一直在增加，就业市场出现了供大于求的情况。
Dàxué bìyèshēng shùliàng yìzhí zài zēngjiā, jiùyè shìchǎng chūxiàn le gōng dà yú qiú de qíngkuàng.
The number of graduates keeps rising, so supply in the job market now exceeds demand.
李
而且很多职位要求有经验，但毕业生往往没有任何工作经验。
Érqiě hěn duō zhíwèi yāoqiú yǒu jīngyàn, dàn bìyèshēng wǎngwǎng méiyǒu rènhé gōngzuò jīngyàn.
And many jobs require experience, which graduates often don't have at all.
李
每年还有从国外回来的海归，外国的文凭比较有竞争力。
Měinián hái yǒu cóng guówài huílai de hǎiguī, wàiguó de wénpíng bǐjiào yǒu jìngzhēnglì.
Every year there are also returnees from abroad, whose foreign degrees are quite competitive.
李

blocks.label: 毕业生
blocks.h: 毕业生自身的原因 · The graduates themselves
lines: 除了就业市场不太乐观以外，还有什么原因造成了工作难找？
Chúle jiùyè shìchǎng bú tài lèguān yǐwài, hái yǒu shénme yuányīn zàochéng le gōngzuò nán zhǎo?
Apart from the gloomy job market, what else makes jobs hard to find?
主
我们再说说这些毕业生。
Wǒmen zài shuōshuo zhèxiē bìyèshēng.
Let's talk about the graduates.
李
中国各个地区间，例如城市与农村、东部与西部，存在着不小的差异，这是客观的事实。
Zhōngguó gègè dìqū jiān, lìrú chéngshì yǔ nóngcūn, dōngbù yǔ xībù, cúnzài zhe bù xiǎo de chāyì, zhè shì kèguān de shìshí.
Between China's regions, such as town and country, east and west, there are big differences. That's an objective fact.
李
尽管西部地区、农村私营企业对毕业生有很大需求，
Jǐnguǎn xībù dìqū, nóngcūn sīyíng qǐyè duì bìyèshēng yǒu hěn dà xūqiú,
Although private firms in the west and in the countryside badly need graduates,
李
但很少有学生愿意去这些地方接受锻炼。
dàn hěn shǎo yǒu xuésheng yuànyì qù zhèxiē dìfang jiēshòu duànliàn.
few students are willing to go and gain experience there.
李
大部分的毕业生希望去一二线城市，他们也更愿意去国企、政府部门和外企。
Dà bùfen de bìyèshēng xīwàng qù yī-èr xiàn chéngshì, tāmen yě gèng yuànyì qù guóqǐ, zhèngfǔ bùmén hé wàiqǐ.
Most graduates want to go to first- and second-tier cities, and prefer state firms, government departments and foreign companies.
李
薪水、稳定性和发展前景，是毕业生求职时考虑的三个主要方面，是吗？
Xīnshui, wěndìngxìng hé fāzhǎn qiánjǐng, shì bìyèshēng qiúzhí shí kǎolǜ de sān ge zhǔyào fāngmiàn, shì ma?
Pay, stability and career prospects are the three main things graduates consider, aren't they?
主
是这样的。据统计，最近三年毕业的大学生平均月收入为三千七百二十六元。
Shì zhèyàng de. Jù tǒngjì, zuìjìn sān nián bìyè de dàxuéshēng píngjūn yuè shōurù wèi sānqiān qībǎi èrshíliù yuán.
That's right. Statistics show that graduates of the last three years earn 3,726 yuan a month on average.
李
我认为这个数字有点乐观。实际上，这几年毕业生的薪水在不断下降。
Wǒ rènwéi zhège shùzì yǒudiǎn lèguān. Shíjìshàng, zhè jǐ nián bìyèshēng de xīnshui zài búduàn xiàjiàng.
I think that figure is a bit optimistic. In fact, graduate pay has kept falling in recent years.
李
你想想，大学四年的学费加生活费，对大多数家庭来说，却是笔不小的投入。
Nǐ xiǎngxiang, dàxué sì nián de xuéfèi jiā shēnghuófèi, duì dàduōshù jiātíng lái shuō, quèshì bǐ bù xiǎo de tóurù.
Think about it: four years of fees and living costs is a big investment for most families.
李
既然投入了，当然都期望有收获。
Jìrán tóurù le, dāngrán dōu qīwàng yǒu shōuhuò.
Having invested, of course they expect a return.
李
如果一个大学生的收入连一个高中生的都赶不上，在别人眼中就是无能。
Rúguǒ yí ge dàxuéshēng de shōurù lián yí ge gāozhōngshēng de dōu gǎn bu shàng, zài biérén yǎnzhōng jiùshì wúnéng.
If a graduate earns less than a school-leaver, people see them as useless.
李
这给毕业生造成了一定的心理压力。
Zhè gěi bìyèshēng zàochéng le yídìng de xīnlǐ yālì.
That puts graduates under some psychological pressure.
李
直接的表现就是，刚毕业就想找个高薪的职位。
Zhíjiē de biǎoxiàn jiùshì, gāng bìyè jiù xiǎng zhǎo ge gāoxīn de zhíwèi.
The direct result is that they want a well-paid job straight after graduating.
李
但是，如果他们的能力与期望不相符，就找不到满意的工作。
Dànshì, rúguǒ tāmen de nénglì yǔ qīwàng bù xiāngfú, jiù zhǎo bu dào mǎnyì de gōngzuò.
But if their abilities don't match their expectations, they can't find a satisfying job.
李
另外，一般刚毕业的高中生，在刚到企业时，愿意去干辛苦的工作，一切从零开始，慢慢学习成长。
Lìngwài, yìbān gāng bìyè de gāozhōngshēng, zài gāng dào qǐyè shí, yuànyì qù gàn xīnkǔ de gōngzuò, yíqiè cóng líng kāishǐ, mànmàn xuéxí chéngzhǎng.
Also, school-leavers who join a firm are usually willing to do hard work, start from scratch, and learn and grow gradually.
李
而大学生则很少有人愿意吃苦。
Ér dàxuéshēng zé hěn shǎo yǒu rén yuànyì chī kǔ.
But few graduates are willing to put up with hardship.
李
他们提出的工资要求一般都要高于高中毕业生，所以很难被企业录用。
Tāmen tíchū de gōngzī yāoqiú yìbān dōu yào gāoyú gāozhōng bìyèshēng, suǒyǐ hěn nán bèi qǐyè lùyòng.
The pay they ask for is generally higher than school-leavers', so firms are reluctant to hire them.
李
这就是我们常说的眼高手低：眼里只有好工作，但工作能力又不够。
Zhè jiùshì wǒmen cháng shuō de yǎn gāo shǒu dī: yǎn li zhǐyǒu hǎo gōngzuò, dàn gōngzuò nénglì yòu bú gòu.
That's what we call "high eyes, low hands": they only have eyes for good jobs but lack the ability.
李

blocks.label: 途径
blocks.h: 找工作的途径 · Ways to find work
lines: 李老师，毕业生找工作有哪些途径呢？
Lǐ lǎoshī, bìyèshēng zhǎo gōngzuò yǒu nǎxiē tújìng ne?
Ms Li, how do graduates look for work?
主
主要依靠网络。他们在网上投简历，还有就是参加各种招聘会。
Zhǔyào yīkào wǎngluò. Tāmen zài wǎng shang tóu jiǎnlì, hái yǒu jiùshì cānjiā gè zhǒng zhāopìnhuì.
Mainly online: they send CVs over the internet, and also go to all kinds of job fairs.
李
学校也会向一些用人单位推荐优秀毕业生。
Xuéxiào yě huì xiàng yìxiē yòngrén dānwèi tuījiàn yōuxiù bìyèshēng.
Universities also recommend outstanding graduates to employers.
李
恐怕靠关系的也不少吧？
Kǒngpà kào guānxi de yě bù shǎo ba?
I suppose plenty rely on connections?
主
社会上有一种看法是，找工作的最好途径，其实仍然是关系、朋友、家庭的人脉，比四处投简历更重要。
Shèhuì shang yǒu yì zhǒng kànfǎ shì, zhǎo gōngzuò de zuì hǎo tújìng, qíshí réngrán shì guānxi, péngyou, jiātíng de rénmài, bǐ sì chù tóu jiǎnlì gèng zhòngyào.
There's a widespread view that the best way to find a job is still connections, friends and family networks, which matter more than sending CVs everywhere.
主
不可否认，为了找工作，请客送礼的现象很普遍，尤其是在中小城市。
Bù kě fǒurèn, wèile zhǎo gōngzuò, qǐngkè sònglǐ de xiànxiàng hěn pǔbiàn, yóuqí shì zài zhōng-xiǎo chéngshì.
It can't be denied that treating people to meals and giving gifts to get a job is very common, especially in small and medium-sized cities.
李
现在的大学生考公务员的还多吗？
Xiànzài de dàxuéshēng kǎo gōngwùyuán de hái duō ma?
Do many graduates still take the civil service exams?
主
比例还是比较高的。
Bǐlì háishi bǐjiào gāo de.
Quite a high proportion.
李
公务员的工作稳定，福利完善，工作环境好，这是吸引大学生的重要因素。
Gōngwùyuán de gōngzuò wěndìng, fúlì wánshàn, gōngzuò huánjìng hǎo, zhè shì xīyǐn dàxuéshēng de zhòngyào yīnsù.
Civil service jobs are stable, with good benefits and a good working environment; that's what attracts graduates.
李

blocks.label: 专业
blocks.h: 哪些专业好找工作？ · Which subjects get jobs?
lines: 哪些专业的就业情况比较好？
Nǎxiē zhuānyè de jiùyè qíngkuàng bǐjiào hǎo?
Which subjects have the best job prospects?
主
理科比文科好找工作。
Lǐkē bǐ wénkē hǎo zhǎo gōngzuò.
Science and engineering graduates find jobs more easily than arts graduates.
李
根据最新的中国大学生就业报告，就业率较高、就业待遇较好的专业是建筑、矿产资源、工业工程、汽车服务工程等理科专业。
Gēnjù zuìxīn de Zhōngguó dàxuéshēng jiùyè bàogào, jiùyèlǜ jiào gāo, jiùyè dàiyù jiào hǎo de zhuānyè shì jiànzhù, kuàngchǎn zīyuán, gōngyè gōngchéng, qìchē fúwù gōngchéng děng lǐkē zhuānyè.

According to the latest report on Chinese graduate employment, the subjects with the highest employment rates and best pay are architecture, mineral resources, industrial engineering, automotive service engineering and other science subjects.
李
文科类的专业，比如哲学、社会学等，就业率比较低。
Wénkē lèi de zhuānyè, bǐrú zhéxué, shèhuìxué děng, jiùyèlǜ bǐjiào dī.
Arts subjects such as philosophy and sociology have lower employment rates.
李
出现这种重理轻文的就业现象，最主要原因是中国正处于经济发展的阶段，对技术性人员需求比较大。
Chūxiàn zhè zhǒng zhòng lǐ qīng wén de jiùyè xiànxiàng, zuì zhǔyào yuányīn shì Zhōngguó zhèng chǔyú jīngjì fāzhǎn de jiēduàn, duì jìshùxìng rényuán xūqiú bǐjiào dà.
The main reason for this bias towards science is that China is at a stage of economic development, with strong demand for technical staff.
李
因此，理科人才在大中小企业、工厂中很受欢迎。
Yīncǐ, lǐkē réncái zài dà-zhōng-xiǎo qǐyè, gōngchǎng zhōng hěn shòu huānyíng.
So science graduates are very welcome in firms of all sizes and in factories.
李
老百姓不是有这样一句话吗？学好数理化，走遍天下都不怕。
Lǎobǎixìng bú shì yǒu zhèyàng yí jù huà ma? Xué hǎo shù lǐ huà, zǒubiàn tiānxià dōu bú pà.
Isn't there a popular saying: "Master maths, physics and chemistry, and you can go anywhere without fear"?
主
这么多年了，观念好像一直没有改变。
Zhème duō nián le, guānniàn hǎoxiàng yìzhí méiyǒu gǎibiàn.
After all these years, the idea doesn't seem to have changed.
主

blocks.label: 政府
lines: 那为了帮助毕业生就业，政府给了他们哪些方面的支持？
Nà wèile bāngzhù bìyèshēng jiùyè, zhèngfǔ gěi le tāmen nǎxiē fāngmiàn de zhīchí?
What support has the government given to help graduates find work?
主
政府和各地教育部门也做了不少工作。
Zhèngfǔ hé gèdì jiàoyù bùmén yě zuò le bù shǎo gōngzuò.
The government and local education departments have done a lot.
李
比方说，邀请企业家、投资人和金融部门工作人员，
Bǐfang shuō, yāoqǐng qǐyèjiā, tóuzīrén hé jīnróng bùmén gōngzuò rényuán,
For example, they invite entrepreneurs, investors and finance staff
李
为大学毕业生提供就业咨询、创业培训、贷款、担保等多方面服务。
wèi dàxué bìyèshēng tígōng jiùyè zīxún, chuàngyè péixùn, dàikuǎn, dānbǎo děng duōfāngmiàn fúwù.
to offer graduates career advice, start-up training, loans, guarantees and other services.
李
同时，也组织高校毕业生招聘会。
Tóngshí, yě zǔzhī gāoxiào bìyèshēng zhāopìnhuì.
They also organise job fairs for graduates.
李
甚至，对于用人单位，政府也给了直接的支持。
Shènzhì, duìyú yòngrén dānwèi, zhèngfǔ yě gěi le zhíjiē de zhīchí.
The government even gives employers direct support.
李
比如，在一部分地区，企业如果录用大学应届毕业生，就可以享受一定的社会保险补助。
Bǐrú, zài yí bùfen dìqū, qǐyè rúguǒ lùyòng dàxué yīngjiè bìyèshēng, jiù kěyǐ xiǎngshòu yídìng de shèhuì bǎoxiǎn bǔzhù.
For example, in some areas, firms that hire new graduates receive social insurance subsidies.
李
另外，为了鼓励毕业生离开沿海地区，到西部地区去做贡献，政府也提供就业补助。
Lìngwài, wèile gǔlì bìyèshēng líkāi yánhǎi dìqū, dào xībù dìqū qù zuò gòngxiàn, zhèngfǔ yě tígōng jiùyè bǔzhù.
And to encourage graduates to leave the coast and contribute in the west, the government provides employment subsidies.
李
李老师，感谢您在百忙之中抽出时间接受采访，谢谢。
Lǐ lǎoshī, gǎnxiè nín zài bǎi máng zhī zhōng chōuchū shíjiān jiēshòu cǎifǎng, xièxiè.
Ms Li, thank you for taking time out of your busy schedule for this interview.
主

q: 毕业生就业难有哪些原因？
Bìyèshēng jiùyè nán yǒu nǎxiē yuányīn?
Why is it hard for graduates to find work?
ans: 市场：经济放慢，毕业生太多，供大于求；职位要求经验；海归有竞争力。毕业生：不愿去西部和农村，期望太高，不愿吃苦，眼高手低。
Shìchǎng: jīngjì fàngmàn, bìyèshēng tài duō, gōng dà yú qiú; zhíwèi yāoqiú jīngyàn; hǎiguī yǒu jìngzhēnglì. Bìyèshēng: búyuàn qù xībù hé nóngcūn, qīwàng tài gāo, búyuàn chī kǔ, yǎn gāo shǒu dī.

The market: a slowing economy, too many graduates, jobs needing experience, competition from returnees. The graduates: unwilling to go west or to the countryside, expectations too high, unwilling to work hard.

q: 毕业生找工作有哪些途径？
Bìyèshēng zhǎo gōngzuò yǒu nǎxiē tújìng?
How do graduates look for work?
ans: 网上投简历，参加招聘会，学校推荐，也有人靠关系。
Wǎng shang tóu jiǎnlì, cānjiā zhāopìnhuì, xuéxiào tuījiàn, yě yǒu rén kào guānxi.
Sending CVs online, job fairs, university recommendations, and some through connections.

q: What support does the government provide?
ans: 就业咨询、创业培训、贷款、担保；招聘会；企业录用毕业生可享受社会保险补助；去西部有就业补助。
Jiùyè zīxún, chuàngyè péixùn, dàikuǎn, dānbǎo; zhāopìnhuì; qǐyè lùyòng bìyèshēng kě xiǎngshòu shèhuì bǎoxiǎn bǔzhù; qù xībù yǒu jiùyè bǔzhù.
Career advice, start-up training, loans and guarantees; job fairs; social insurance subsidies for firms that hire graduates; employment subsidies for going west.

grammar: 从……起
since …
Starting point.
从二零一四年起，每年的大学应届毕业生就已经超过了七百万。
Cóng èr líng yī sì nián qǐ, měinián de dàxué yīngjiè bìyèshēng jiù yǐjīng chāoguò le qībǎi wàn.
Since 2014, the number of new university graduates each year has exceeded seven million.
从明天起，我要早起。
Cóng míngtiān qǐ, wǒ yào zǎoqǐ.
From tomorrow I'll get up early.
加上……
add to that …
Adds a factor.
加上受到金融危机的影响，毕业生面临着巨大的就业压力和挑战。
Jiāshàng shòudào jīnróng wēijī de yǐngxiǎng, bìyèshēng miànlín zhe jùdà de jiùyè yālì hé tiǎozhàn.
Add the effects of the financial crisis, and graduates face enormous pressure and challenges in finding work.
加上下雨，路很堵。
Jiāshàng xià yǔ, lù hěn dǔ.
Add the rain, and the roads were jammed.
面临着……
to be facing …
面临 + challenge.
加上受到金融危机的影响，毕业生面临着巨大的就业压力和挑战。
Jiāshàng shòudào jīnróng wēijī de yǐngxiǎng, bìyèshēng miànlín zhe jùdà de jiùyè yālì hé tiǎozhàn.
Add the effects of the financial crisis, and graduates face enormous pressure and challenges in finding work.
我们面临着困难。
Wǒmen miànlín zhe kùnnan.
We face difficulties.
能否……
could you …
