items.zh: 坐车去还是走路去都一样。
items.en: Going by bus or on foot, it's all the same.
items.py: Zuò chē qù háishi zǒu lù qù dōu yíyàng.
items.g: ……都一样 · it's all the same

items.zh: 每个月这么大的花销，我家可承受不了。
items.en: Such big expenses every month: my family really can't cope with that.
items.py: Měi ge yuè zhème dà de huāxiao, wǒ jiā kě chéngshòu bu liǎo.
items.g: 可 + V + 不了 · really can't …

items.zh: 这么多作业，我可做不完。
items.en: With this much homework I really can't finish it.
items.py: Zhème duō zuòyè, wǒ kě zuò bù wán.
items.g: 可 + V + 不了 · really can't …

items.zh: 儿子刚结婚一年就离婚，全家都觉得很丢脸。
items.en: The son got divorced just a year after marrying, and the whole family felt ashamed.
items.py: Érzi gāng jié hūn yì nián jiù líhūn, quán jiā dōu juéde hěn diū liǎn.
items.g: 刚……就…… · only just … and already …

items.zh: 他刚来北京一个月就找到了工作。
items.en: He'd only been in Beijing a month when he found a job.
items.py: Tā gāng lái Běijīng yí ge yuè jiù zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
items.g: 刚……就…… · only just … and already …

items.zh: 很多人认为，把父母送进养老院是件很丢脸的事情。
items.en: Many people think putting your parents in an old people's home is something to be ashamed of.
items.py: Hěn duō rén rènwéi, bǎ fùmǔ sòngjìn yǎnglǎoyuàn shì jiàn hěn diū liǎn de shìqing.
items.g: 把 + 父母 + 送进 + place · to put (someone) into …

items.zh: 他把孩子送进了最好的幼儿园。
items.en: He got his child into the best kindergarten.
items.py: Tā bǎ háizi sòngjìn le zuì hǎo de yòu'éryuán.
items.g: 把 + 父母 + 送进 + place · to put (someone) into …

items.zh: 想给孩子一个好的生活，自己就不得不做出一些牺牲。
items.en: If you want to give your child a good life, you have to make some sacrifices yourself.
items.py: Xiǎng gěi háizi yí ge hǎo de shēnghuó, zìjǐ jiù bùdébù zuòchū yìxiē xīshēng.
items.g: 不得不 + V · to have no choice but to …

items.zh: 下雨了，我们不得不回家。
items.en: It started raining, so we had to go home.
items.py: Xià yǔ le, wǒmen bùdébù huí jiā.
items.g: 不得不 + V · to have no choice but to …

items.zh: 为了孩子，父母得放弃一些自己喜欢的事情。
items.en: For their children's sake, parents have to give up some things they enjoy.
items.py: Wèile háizi, fùmǔ děi fàngqì yìxiē zìjǐ xǐhuan de shìqing.
items.g: 得 (děi) + V · must, have to

items.zh: 太晚了，我得走了。
items.en: It's late. I have to go.
items.py: Tài wǎn le, wǒ de zǒu le.
items.g: 得 (děi) + V · must, have to

items.zh: 他因为工作太忙而顾不上家里的事。
items.en: He has no time for family matters because work is so busy.
items.py: Tā yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng ér gù bu shàng jiā li de shì.
items.g: 因为……而…… · because of … (and so) …

items.zh: 我们马上就要搬家了，要搬到离我婆婆家比较近的地方。
items.en: We're moving soon, to a place quite close to my mother-in-law's.
items.py: Wǒmen mǎshàng jiù yào bān jiā le, yào bān dào lí wǒ pópo jiā bǐjiào jìn de dìfang.
items.g: 离 + place + 比较近 · quite close to …

items.zh: 我家离学校很近。
items.en: My home is very close to the school.
items.py: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.
items.g: 离 + place + 比较近 · quite close to …

items.zh: 你想靠他们给你养老，那是在做梦。
items.en: You want them to look after you in old age? Dream on.
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng kào tāmen gěi nǐ yǎnglǎo, nà shì zài zuò mèng.
items.g: ……，那是在做梦 · that's just wishful thinking

items.zh: 你想不努力就考上大学，那是在做梦。
items.en: You want to get into university without working hard? Dream on.
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng bù nǔlì jiù kǎoshang dàxué, nà shì zài zuò mèng.
items.g: ……，那是在做梦 · that's just wishful thinking

items.zh: 我们要和婆婆住在一起了，所以很快我们就要搬家了。
items.en: We're going to live with my mother-in-law, so we're moving soon.
items.py: Wǒmen yào hé pópo zhù zài yìqǐ le, suǒyǐ hěn kuài wǒmen jiù yào bān jiā le.

items.zh: 你做了一个靠他们给你养老的梦。
items.en: You had a dream about them looking after you in old age.
items.py: Nǐ zuò le yí ge kào tāmen gěi nǐ yǎnglǎo de mèng.

items.zh: 孙红生了个女孩，她总在婆婆面前抬不起头。
items.en: Sun Hong had a girl, and she always feels ashamed in front of her mother-in-law.
items.py: Sūn Hóng shēng le ge nǚhái, tā zǒng zài pópo miànqián tái bu qǐ tóu.

items.zh: 还是二人世界的生活才自由。
items.en: Life as a couple is the only truly free life.
items.py: Háishi èr rén shìjiè de shēnghuó cái zìyóu.
items.g: 还是……才…… · after all, only … is really …

items.zh: 还是在家吃饭才舒服。
items.en: After all, eating at home is the most comfortable.
items.py: Háishi zài jiā chī fàn cái shūfu.
items.g: 还是……才…… · after all, only … is really …

items.zh: 到老了，你们多孤独呀，你们会后悔的。
items.en: When you're old, you'll be so lonely. You'll regret it.
items.py: Dào lǎo le, nǐmen duō gūdú ya, nǐmen huì hòuhuǐ de.
items.g: 多 + adj + 呀 · how …!

items.zh: 你看，今天的天气多好呀！
items.en: Look, what lovely weather today!
items.py: Nǐ kàn, jīntiān de tiānqì duō hǎo ya!
items.g: 多 + adj + 呀 · how …!

items.zh: 其实你看，人家有小孩的家庭不是也挺幸福的吗？
items.en: Actually, look: aren't families with children pretty happy too?
items.py: Qíshí nǐ kàn, rénjia yǒu xiǎohái de jiātíng bú shì yě tǐng xìngfú de ma?
items.g: 不是……吗？ · isn't it …?

items.zh: 你不是说今天不上班吗？
items.en: Didn't you say you weren't working today?
items.py: Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān bú shàng bān ma?
items.g: 不是……吗？ · isn't it …?

items.zh: 他忙得连吃饭的时间都没有。
items.en: He's so busy he doesn't even have time to eat.
items.py: Tā máng de lián chī fàn de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
items.g: 连……都…… · even …

items.zh: 光房租就要三千块。
items.en: The rent alone costs three thousand.
items.py: Guāng fángzū jiù yào sān qiān kuài.
items.g: 光……就…… · … alone already …

items.zh: 要是明天下雨，那我们就不去了。
items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
items.py: Yàoshì míngtiān xià yǔ, nà wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
items.g: 要是……，那…… · if …, then …

items.zh: 下面是一些人对此的看法。你觉得他们的态度是什么？
items.en: Here are some people's views on this. What do you think their attitude is?
items.py: Xiàmiàn shì yìxiē rén duì cǐ de kànfǎ. Nǐ juéde tāmen de tàidu shì shénme?

items.zh: 现在的孩子都靠父母，根本谈不上养儿防老。
items.en: Children these days all depend on their parents. Raising kids to look after you in old age? Forget it.
items.py: Xiànzài de háizi dōu kào fùmǔ, gēnběn tán bu shàng yǎng ér fáng lǎo.

items.zh: 这样做与咱们传宗接代的观念不符。
items.en: Doing this goes against our idea of carrying on the family line.
items.py: Zhèyàng zuò yǔ zánmen chuánzōng-jiēdài de guānniàn bù fú.

items.zh: 丁克们不用像其他父母那样，付出那么大的辛苦。
items.en: DINKs don't have to work as hard as other parents do.
items.py: Dīngkèmen búyòng xiàng qítā fùmǔ nàyàng, fùchū nàme dà de xīnkǔ.
items.g: 像……那样 · like …

items.zh: 我想像他那样说一口地道的汉语。
items.en: I want to speak authentic Chinese the way he does.
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng xiàng tā nàyàng shuō yì kǒu dìdao de Hànyǔ.
items.g: 像……那样 · like …

items.zh: 他的想法被大家接受了。
items.en: His idea was accepted by everyone.
items.py: Tā de xiǎngfǎ bèi dàjiā jiēshòu le.
items.g: 被 + (person) + V · passive

items.zh: 丁克一族往往不被家里老人理解和接受，被认为太自私。
items.en: DINKs are often not understood or accepted by the older people in the family, and they're seen as too selfish.
items.py: Dīngkè yì zú wǎngwǎng bú bèi jiā li lǎorén lǐjiě hé jiēshòu, bèi rènwéi tài zìsī.
items.g: 不被……理解和接受 · not understood or accepted by …

items.zh: 他的决定不被父母理解。
items.en: His decision isn't understood by his parents.
items.py: Tā de juédìng bú bèi fùmǔ lǐjiě.
items.g: 不被……理解和接受 · not understood or accepted by …

items.zh: 不生小孩的夫妻生活质量往往很高，他们很自由。
items.en: Couples without children often have a high quality of life, and they're free.
items.py: Bù shēng xiǎohái de fūqī shēnghuó zhìliàng wǎngwǎng hěn gāo, tāmen hěn zìyóu.
items.g: 往往 · usually, tends to

items.zh: 年轻人往往不喜欢早起。
items.en: Young people tend not to like getting up early.
items.py: Niánqīngrén wǎngwǎng bù xǐhuan zǎoqǐ.
items.g: 往往 · usually, tends to

items.zh: 你不用因为工作放弃学习。
items.en: You don't need to give up studying because of work.
items.py: Nǐ búyòng yīnwèi gōngzuò fàngqì xuéxí.
items.g: 不用因为……放弃…… · don't need to give up … because of …

items.zh: 丁克们一生没有儿女，也许有一天会觉得很遗憾。
items.en: DINKs have no children all their lives, and one day they may deeply regret it.
items.py: Dīngkèmen yìshēng méiyǒu érnǚ, yěxǔ yǒu yì tiān huì juéde hěn yíhàn.

items.zh: 老丁克们没有儿女，有些人会觉得很孤独，生病没有人照顾。
items.en: Older DINKs have no children. Some feel very lonely, and when they're ill nobody looks after them.
items.py: Lǎo dīngkèmen méiyǒu érnǚ, yǒuxiē rén huì juéde hěn gūdú, shēng bìng méiyǒu rén zhàogù.

items.zh: 有很多丁克觉得自己很丢脸，很抬不起头。
items.en: Many DINKs feel ashamed and can't hold their heads up.
items.py: Yǒu hěn duō dīngkè juéde zìjǐ hěn diū liǎn, hěn tái bu qǐ tóu.

items.zh: 首先，一部分人认为，养孩子是一件非常辛苦的事情。
items.en: First, some people think raising children is very hard work,
items.py: Shǒuxiān, yí bùfen rén rènwéi, yǎng háizi shì yí jiàn fēicháng xīnkǔ de shìqing.
items.g: 首先……，其次……，第三……，最后…… · first …, second …, third …, finally …

items.zh: 首先要努力学习，其次要多练习。
items.en: First you need to study hard, and second you need to practise a lot.
items.py: Shǒuxiān yào nǔlì xuéxí, qícì yào duō liànxí.
items.g: 首先……，其次……，第三……，最后…… · first …, second …, third …, finally …

items.zh: 你想吃什么就吃什么。
items.en: Eat whatever you like.
items.py: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.
items.g: 想 + V + 哪儿 + 就 + V + 哪儿 · wherever you like

items.zh: 而现在，这种家庭已经开始被人们理解和接受。
items.en: Now, though, families like this are starting to be understood and accepted,
items.py: Ér xiànzài, zhè zhǒng jiātíng yǐjīng kāishǐ bèi rénmen lǐjiě hé jiēshòu.
items.g: 被人们理解和接受 · to be understood and accepted by people

items.zh: 他的意见被大家接受了。
items.en: His suggestion was accepted by everyone.
items.py: Tā de yìjiàn bèi dàjiā jiēshòu le.
items.g: 被人们理解和接受 · to be understood and accepted by people

items.zh: 这么贵，还不如自己做。
items.en: It's so expensive, you might as well make it yourself.
items.py: Zhème guì, hái bùrú zìjǐ zuò.
items.g: ……，还不如…… · … then it's better to …

items.zh: 也有越来越多的夫妻加入了丁克一族。
items.en: and more and more couples are joining the DINKs.
items.py: yě yǒu yuèláiyuè duō de fūqī jiārù le dīngkè yì zú.
items.g: 越来越多的 + N · more and more …

items.zh: 越来越多的人喜欢在网上买东西。
items.en: More and more people like shopping online.
items.py: Yuèláiyuè duō de rén xǐhuan zài wǎng shang mǎi dōngxi.
items.g: 越来越多的 + N · more and more …

items.zh: 害怕自己的孩子将来会太辛苦，承受不住竞争的压力。
items.en: and they're afraid their children will have too hard a time in future and won't be able to bear the pressure of competition.
items.py: hàipà zìjǐ de háizi jiānglái huì tài xīnkǔ, chéngshòu bu zhù jìngzhēng de yālì.
items.g: 害怕 + clause · to be afraid that …

items.zh: 我害怕他不同意。
items.en: I'm afraid he won't agree.
items.py: Wǒ hàipà tā bùtóng yì.
items.g: 害怕 + clause · to be afraid that …

items.zh: 我们认为，原因主要有以下几个方面。
items.en: In our view, the reasons fall mainly into the following areas.
items.py: Wǒmen rènwéi, yuányīn zhǔyào yǒu yǐxià jǐ ge fāngmiàn.

items.zh: 其次，还有一部分人不愿意让孩子影响自己的工作。
items.en: Second, some people don't want children to affect their work.
items.py: Qícì, hái yǒu yí bùfen rén bú yuànyì ràng háizi yǐngxiǎng zìjǐ de gōngzuò.

items.zh: 是挺棒的。看来刘思也没白辛苦。
items.en: He's great. Looks like all Liu Si's hard work paid off.
items.py: Shì tǐng bàng de. Kànlái Liú Sī yě méi bái xīnkǔ.
items.g: 没白 + V · not … for nothing

items.zh: 这次考得不错，没白努力。
items.en: The exam went well. The hard work wasn't for nothing.
items.py: Zhè cì kǎo de búcuò, méi bái nǔlì.
items.g: 没白 + V · not … for nothing

items.zh: 我们现在的生活很舒适，生活质量算是高的了。
items.en: Our life now is comfortable. Our quality of life is pretty high.
items.py: Wǒmen xiànzài de shēnghuó hěn shūshì, shēnghuó zhìliàng suànshì gāo de le.
items.g: 算是……的了 · can be counted as …

items.zh: 他的汉语在我们班算是好的了。
items.en: His Chinese counts as good in our class.
items.py: Tā de Hànyǔ zài wǒmen bān suànshì hǎo de le.
items.g: 算是……的了 · can be counted as …

items.zh: 连我爸妈都为这事儿和我不高兴，觉得特丢脸，特抬不起头。
items.en: Even my own parents were upset with me about it. They felt really ashamed and couldn't hold their heads up.
items.py: lián wǒ bà mā dōu wèi zhè shìr hé wǒ bù gāoxìng, juéde tè diū liǎn, tè tái bu qǐ tóu.
items.g: 连……都…… · even …

items.zh: 这个问题连老师都不知道。
items.en: Even the teacher doesn't know the answer to this.
items.py: Zhège wèntí lián lǎoshī dōu bù zhīdao.
items.g: 连……都…… · even …

items.zh: 这孩子太调皮了，妈妈拿他没办法。
items.en: This child is so naughty that his mum can't do a thing with him.
items.py: Zhè háizi tài tiáopí le, māma ná tā méi bànfǎ.
items.g: 拿 + person + 没办法 · can't do anything with someone

items.zh: 老了还不是一样被送进养老院，还谈什么养儿防老呀？
items.en: They still end up in old people's homes when they're old. So what's all this about raising children for your old age?
items.py: Lǎo le hái bú shì yíyàng bèi sòngjìn yǎnglǎoyuàn, hái tán shénme yǎng ér fáng lǎo ya?
items.g: 还不是一样…… · it's still the same … anyway

items.zh: 你现在不学，以后还不是一样要学？
items.en: If you don't learn it now, won't you still have to learn it later?
items.py: Nǐ xiànzài bù xué, yǐhòu hái bú shì yíyàng yào xué?
items.g: 还不是一样…… · it's still the same … anyway

items.zh: 连饭都吃不上，还谈什么旅游？
items.en: You can't even afford to eat. What's the point of talking about travel?
items.py: Lián fàn dōu chī bu shàng, hái tán shénme lǚyóu?
items.g: 还谈什么…… · what's the point of talking about …

items.zh: 不让你拿退休金给他养媳妇儿、养孙子就不错了。
items.en: if they don't make you spend your pension on their wife and kids, you're doing well.
items.py: bú ràng nǐ ná tuìxiūjīn gěi tā yǎng xífur, yǎng sūnzi jiù búcuò le.
items.g: ……就不错了 · it's good enough if …

items.zh: 他能来就不错了。
items.en: It's good enough that he can come at all.
items.py: Tā néng lái jiù búcuò le.
items.g: ……就不错了 · it's good enough if …

items.zh: 你周围有没有会说法语的人？
items.en: Do you know anyone who speaks French?
items.py: Nǐ zhōuwéi yǒu méiyǒu huì shuō Fǎyǔ de rén?
items.g: 周围有没有……？ · is there … around you?

items.zh: 他主张孩子应该多运动。
items.en: He believes children should get more exercise.
items.py: Tā zhǔzhāng háizi yīnggāi duō yùndòng.
items.g: 主张 + idea · to advocate, to be in favour of

items.zh: 退休以后，他们过得很开心。
items.en: They've been very happy since they retired.
items.py: Tuìxiū yǐhòu, tāmen guò de hěn kāixīn.
items.g: 过得 + 很/特别 + adj · to live a … life

items.zh: 明天是周末，不用上班。
items.en: Tomorrow's the weekend, so there's no need to go to work.
items.py: Míngtiān shì zhōumò, búyòng shàng bān.
items.g: 不用 + V · don't have to …

items.zh: 啊，他们管狗是不是叫孩子呀？
items.en: Ah, do they call the dogs their kids?
items.py: A, tāmen guǎn gǒu shì bu shì jiào háizi ya?
items.g: 管 A 叫 B · to call A B

items.zh: 我们管他叫老王。
items.en: We call him Lao Wang.
items.py: Wǒmen guǎn tā jiào Lǎo Wáng.
items.g: 管 A 叫 B · to call A B

items.zh: 小军在和记者谈他的一个丁克同事。
items.en: Xiaojun is talking to a reporter about a DINK colleague.
items.py: Xiǎo Jūn zài hé jìzhě tán tā de yí ge dīngkè tóngshì.

items.zh: 请你介绍这个同事的生活情况。
items.en: Describe this colleague's life.
items.py: Qǐng nǐ jièshào zhège tóngshì de shēnghuó qíngkuàng.

items.zh: 但他们家里呢，是养两条狗。
items.en: But they keep two dogs at home.
items.py: Dàn tāmen jiā li ne, shì yǎng liǎng tiáo gǒu.

items.zh: 然后周末就活动很多，很丰富。
items.en: And at weekends they did lots of things. Their life was very full.
items.py: Ránhòu zhōumò jiù huódòng hěn duō, hěn fēngfù.

items.zh: 叫。对，他们叫宝宝。
items.en: They do. Yes, they call them "baby".
items.py: Jiào. Duì, tāmen jiào bǎobao.

items.zh: 那狗……让狗管他们叫爸爸妈妈，是这个意思吗？

items.zh: 我成了房奴后，生活质量大大下降，比租房时的日子苦多了。
items.en: since becoming one my quality of life has dropped sharply. It's much harder than when I rented.
items.py: wǒ chéng le fángnú hòu, shēnghuó zhìliàng dàdà xiàjiàng, bǐ zū fáng shí de rìzi kǔ duō le.

items.zh: 想办法解决。
items.en: Finding a way to deal with something.
items.py: Xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué.
items.g: 想办法 + V · to find a way to …

items.zh: 我们得想办法帮他。
items.en: We have to find a way to help him.
items.py: Wǒmen děi xiǎng bànfǎ bāng tā.
items.g: 想办法 + V · to find a way to …

items.zh: 和银行借钱买东西。
items.en: Borrowing money from a bank to buy something.
items.py: Hé yínháng jiè qián mǎi dōngxi.
items.g: 和 + 银行/别人 + 借钱 · to borrow money from …

items.zh: 我想跟朋友借点儿钱。
items.en: I'd like to borrow some money from a friend.
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng gēn péngyou jiè diǎnr qián.
items.g: 和 + 银行/别人 + 借钱 · to borrow money from …

items.zh: 为了还房贷而生活压力很大的人。
items.en: Someone under great pressure because of mortgage repayments.
items.py: Wèile huán fángdài ér shēnghuó yālì hěn dà de rén.
items.g: 为了……而…… · for the sake of …

items.zh: 他为了买房而拼命工作。
items.en: He works himself to the bone to buy a flat.
items.py: Tā wèile mǎi fáng ér pīnmìng gōngzuò.
items.g: 为了……而…… · for the sake of …

items.zh: 别人的情况很好，自己也希望能够和别人一样。
items.en: Someone else is doing well, and you wish you could be like them.
items.py: Biérén de qíngkuàng hěn hǎo, zìjǐ yě xīwàng nénggòu hé biérén yíyàng.
items.g: 和……一样 · the same as …

items.zh: 我想和你一样会说汉语。
items.en: I want to speak Chinese like you.
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ yíyàng huì shuō Hànyǔ.
items.g: 和……一样 · the same as …

items.zh: 很认真、很辛苦地做。
items.en: Doing something very seriously and with a lot of effort.
items.py: Hěn rènzhēn, hěn xīnkǔ de zuò.
items.g: adj + 地 + V · -ly (how something is done)

items.zh: 他很高兴地说："我买房了！"。
items.en: He said happily: "I've bought a flat!"
items.py: Tā hěn gāoxìng de shuō:"wǒ mǎi fáng le!".
items.g: adj + 地 + V · -ly (how something is done)

items.zh: 到处和别人借钱。
items.en: Borrowing money from people everywhere.
items.py: Dàochù hé biérén jiè qián.

items.zh: 住在别人的房子里，每个月给房东交房租。
items.en: Living in someone else's home and paying the landlord rent every month.
items.py: Zhù zài biérén de fángzi li, měi ge yuè gěi fángdōng jiāo fángzū.

items.zh: 觉得买房子不值得，或者买不起。
items.en: Thinking buying a flat isn't worth it, or can't afford one.
items.py: Juéde mǎi fáng zi bù zhíde, huòzhě mǎi bu qǐ.
items.g: V + 不起 · can't afford to …

items.zh: 这么贵的车，我买不起。
items.en: I can't afford such an expensive car.
items.py: Zhème guì de chē, wǒ mǎi bu qǐ.
items.g: V + 不起 · can't afford to …

items.zh: 成为这个群体后，既幸福又有压力。
items.en: After joining this group you're both happy and under pressure.
items.py: Chéngwéi zhège qúntǐ hòu, jì xìngfú yòu yǒu yālì.
items.g: 既……又…… · both … and …

items.zh: 这个工作既轻松又有意思。
items.en: This job is both easy and interesting.
items.py: Zhège gōngzuò jì qīngsōng yòu yǒuyìsi.
items.g: 既……又…… · both … and …

items.zh: 因为房租上涨而经常搬家。
items.en: Moving often because the rent keeps going up.
items.py: Yīnwèi fángzū shàngzhǎng ér jīngcháng bān jiā.
items.g: 因为……而…… · because of …

items.zh: 他因为加班而没时间陪父母。
items.en: He has no time for his parents because of overtime.
items.py: Tā yīnwèi jiā bān ér méi shíjiān péi fùmǔ.
items.g: 因为……而…… · because of …

items.zh: 令人羡慕的高工资。
items.en: Enviably high wages.
items.py: Lìng rén xiànmù de gāo gōngzī.
items.g: 令人 + feeling · to make one …

items.zh: 这是一个令人高兴的消息。
items.en: This is good news.
items.py: Zhè shì yí ge lìng rén gāoxìng de xiāoxī.
items.g: 令人 + feeling · to make one …

items.zh: 他把灯打开了。
items.en: He turned on the light.
items.py: Tā bǎ dēng dǎkāi le.
items.g: 把 + O + V + result · to do something to … with a result

items.zh: 需要承受还房贷的巨大压力。
items.en: Having to bear the huge pressure of mortgage repayments.
items.py: Xūyào chéngshòu huán fángdài de jùdà yālì.

items.zh: 害怕房租涨价。
items.en: Afraid the rent will go up.
items.py: Hàipà fángzū zhǎng jià.

items.zh: 招聘信息多，工作机会多。
items.en: Lots of job adverts and job opportunities.
items.py: Zhāopìn xìnxī duō, gōngzuò jīhuì duō.

items.zh: 谁不想去旅游？
items.en: Who doesn't want to travel?
items.py: Shéi bù xiǎng qù lǚyóu?
items.g: 谁不想……？ · who doesn't want …?

items.zh: 现在工作越来越难找了。
items.en: Jobs are getting harder and harder to find.
items.py: Xiànzài gōngzuò yuèláiyuè nán zhǎo le.
items.g: 越来越难 + V · harder and harder to …

items.zh: 无论我怎么努力，也挣不来那么多钱。
items.en: However hard I work, I can't earn that much money.
items.py: wúlùn wǒ zěnme nǔlì, yě zhēng bù lái nàme duō qián.
items.g: 无论……，也/都…… · no matter …, still …

items.zh: 无论多忙，他都每天给妈妈打电话。
items.en: However busy he is, he calls his mum every day.
items.py: Wúlùn duō máng, tā dōu měitiān gěi māma dǎ diànhuà.
items.g: 无论……，也/都…… · no matter …, still …

items.zh: 既然你不喜欢，那么就别买了。
items.en: Since you don't like it, don't buy it.
items.py: Jìrán nǐ bù xǐhuan, nàme jiù bié mǎi le.
items.g: 既然……，那么…… · since …, then …

items.zh: 一两张账单，我还可以想办法应付应付。
items.en: One or two bills I can somehow manage,
items.py: Yì liǎng zhāng zhàngdān, wǒ hái kěyǐ xiǎng bànfǎ yìngfu yìngfu.
items.g: V + V (应付应付) · do … a bit

items.zh: 周末我想休息休息。
items.en: At the weekend I want to rest a bit.
items.py: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng xiūxi xiūxi.
items.g: V + V (应付应付) · do … a bit

items.zh: 孩子的教育是让很多父母头疼的问题。
items.en: Children's education is a headache for many parents.
items.py: Háizi de jiàoyù shì ràng hěn duō fùmǔ tóuténg de wèntí.
items.g: 是让……头疼的问题 · a problem that gives … a headache

items.zh: 可是你让我一下子交这么多账单，那我实在是承受不了。
items.en: but if you make me pay this many bills all at once, I really can't cope.
items.py: kěshì nǐ ràng wǒ yíxiàzi jiāo zhème duō zhàngdān, nà wǒ shízài shì chéngshòu bu liǎo.

items.zh: 一线城市的新商品房，我是买不起的。
items.en: I can't afford a new flat in a first-tier city.
items.py: Yīxiàn chéngshì de xīn shāngpǐnfáng, wǒ shì mǎi bu qǐ de.

items.zh: 刚谈恋爱的那段日子，心里总是感觉美滋滋的。
items.en: In those early days of being in love, I always felt on top of the world.
items.py: Gāng tán liàn'ài de nà duàn rìzi, xīn li zǒngshì gǎnjué měizīzī de.

items.zh: 成天想着和女朋友见面、逛街、看电影儿，根本没有心思学习。
items.en: All I thought about was seeing my girlfriend, going shopping and to the cinema. I had no mind for studying at all.
items.py: chéngtiān xiǎngzhe hé nǚpéngyou jiàn miàn, guàng jiē, kàn diànyǐng ér, gēnběn méiyǒu xīnsi xuéxí.

items.zh: 房价不断上涨，蚁族们只好蜗居。
items.en: House prices keep going up, so the "ant tribe" have to squeeze into tiny rooms.
items.py: Fángjià búduàn shàngzhǎng, yǐzú men zhǐhǎo wōjū.
items.g: 不断 + V · keep …ing

items.zh: 他的汉语水平不断提高。
items.en: His Chinese keeps improving.
items.py: Tā de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng búduàn tígāo.
items.g: 不断 + V · keep …ing

items.zh: 发工资后的第一件事，当然是付账单了。我压力大着呢。
items.en: The first thing after payday is, of course, paying the bills. I'm under a lot of pressure.
items.py: Fā gōngzī hòu de dì-yī jiàn shì, dāngrán shì fù zhàngdān le. Wǒ yālì dà zhe ne.
items.g: adj + 着呢 · really … (spoken)

items.zh: 这个房子贵着呢！
items.en: This flat is really expensive!
items.py: Zhège fángzi guì zhe ne!
items.g: adj + 着呢 · really … (spoken)

items.zh: 等了一个小时，车总算来了。
items.en: After an hour's wait, the bus finally came.
items.py: Děng le yí ge xiǎoshí, chē zǒngsuàn lái le.
items.g: 总算 · at last

items.zh: 最近这家商店的很多东西在打折呢，值得去看看。
items.en: Lots of things in this shop are on sale lately. It's worth a look.
items.py: Zuìjìn zhè jiā shāngdiàn de hěn duō dōngxi zài dǎzhé ne, zhíde qù kànkan.
items.g: 值得 + V · worth …ing

items.zh: 这本书值得一读。
items.en: This book is worth reading.
items.py: Zhè běn shū zhíde yì dú.
items.g: 值得 + V · worth …ing

items.zh: 你向银行贷了这么多钱，究竟什么时候才能还完啊？
items.en: You've borrowed so much from the bank. When on earth will you pay it all back?
items.py: Nǐ xiàng yínháng dài le zhème duō qián, jiūjìng shénme shíhou cái néng hái wán a?
items.g: 究竟 + question · … on earth?

items.zh: 你究竟想去哪儿？
items.en: Where on earth do you want to go?
items.py: Nǐ jiūjìng xiǎng qù nǎr?
items.g: 究竟 + question · … on earth?

items.zh: 每天都收到这么多账单，我实在没心思去逛街了。
items.en: I get so many bills every day that I'm really not in the mood to go shopping.
items.py: Měitiān dōu shōudào zhème duō zhàngdān, wǒ shízài méi xīnsi qù guàng jiē le.

items.zh: 第一次领工资，心里有一种说不出来的感觉。
items.en: Getting my first pay packet, I had a feeling I can't put into words.
items.py: Dì-yī cì lǐng gōngzī, xīn li yǒu yì zhǒng shuō bu chūlái de gǎnjué.

items.zh: 一线城市的商品房价格又上涨了。
items.en: Flat prices in first-tier cities have gone up again.
items.py: Yīxiàn chéngshì de shāngpǐnfáng jiàgé yòu shàngzhǎng le.

items.zh: 我好不容易才找到他的家。
items.en: I had a hard time finding his house.
items.py: Wǒ hǎobù róngyì cái zhǎodào tā de jiā.
items.g: 好不容易 + V · to manage with great difficulty

items.zh: 买了房不只是买了房，你还得买保险，付各种账单。
items.en: Buying a flat isn't just buying a flat. You also have to buy insurance and pay all sorts of bills.
items.py: Mǎi le fáng bù zhǐshì mǎi le fáng, nǐ hái de mǎi bǎoxiǎn, fù gè zhǒng zhàngdān.
items.g: 不只是……，还…… · not just …, also …

items.zh: 学汉语不只是学说话，还要学写字。
items.en: Learning Chinese isn't just learning to speak; you have to learn to write too.
items.py: Xué Hànyǔ bù zhǐshì xué shuōhuà, hái yào xué xiě zì.
items.g: 不只是……，还…… · not just …, also …

items.zh: 一想到考试，我就紧张。
items.en: Whenever I think about the exam, I get nervous.
items.py: Yì xiǎngdào kǎoshì, wǒ jiù jǐnzhāng.
items.g: 一想到……，就/还是…… · whenever (I) think of …

items.zh: 他们通过网上的方式交房租。
items.en: They pay their rent online.
items.py: Tāmen tōngguò wǎng shang de fāngshì jiāo fángzū.
items.g: 通过……的方式 · by way of …

items.zh: 他从工资中拿出一部分给父母。
items.en: He gives part of his wages to his parents.
items.py: Tā cóng gōngzī zhōng ná chū yí bùfen gěi fùmǔ.
items.g: 从……中拿出 · to take out of …

items.zh: 能有一套属于自己的房子，是每个中国老百姓心中的梦想。
items.en: Having a home of one's own is the dream of every ordinary Chinese person.
items.py: Néng yǒu yí tào shǔyú zìjǐ de fángzi, shì měi ge Zhōngguó lǎobǎixìng xīnzhōng de mèngxiǎng.

items.zh: 辛苦一点儿也值得了，至少有了一个自己的窝嘛。
items.en: A bit of hardship is worth it. At least I've got a nest of my own.
items.py: Xīnkǔ yì diǎnr yě zhíde le, zhìshǎo yǒu le yí ge zìjǐ de wō ma.

items.zh: 每个中国人都希望能有一套属于自己的房子。
items.en: Every Chinese person hopes to have a home of their own.
items.py: Měi ge Zhōngguórén dōu xīwàng néng yǒu yí tào shǔyú zìjǐ de fángzi.

items.zh: 这套房子不到四十万，可是我还得贷款。
items.en: This flat costs less than 400,000, but I still have to take out a loan.
items.py: Zhè tào fángzi bú dào sì shí wàn, kěshì wǒ hái de dàikuǎn.

items.zh: 买了房以后，你还会有很大的压力。
items.en: After buying a flat you'll be under a lot of pressure.
items.py: Mǎi le fáng yǐhòu, nǐ hái huì yǒu hěn dà de yālì.

items.zh: 再忙也要吃饭。
items.en: However busy you are, you still have to eat.
items.py: Zài máng yě yào chī fàn.
items.g: 再 + adj + 都/也…… · however …

items.zh: 谁先到谁买票。
items.en: Whoever gets there first buys the tickets.
items.py: Shéi xiān dào shéi mǎi piào.
items.g: 谁……谁就…… · whoever …

items.zh: 孩子，我们愿意拿出三十万帮你把首付付了。
items.en: Son, we're willing to put up 300,000 to help you pay the deposit.
items.py: Háizi, wǒmen yuànyì ná chū sānshí wàn bāng nǐ bǎ shǒufù fù le.
items.g: 把 + O + V + 了 · to get … done

items.zh: 我已经把房租交了。
items.en: I've already paid the rent.
items.py: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ fángzū jiāo le.
items.g: 把 + O + V + 了 · to get … done

items.zh: 再过十年，双方父母都不在了，这样一家就有三套房。
items.en: Another ten years on, both sets of parents are gone, so one family has three flats.
items.py: Zài guo shí nián, shuāngfāng fùmǔ dōu bú zài le, zhèyàng yì jiā jiù yǒu sān tào fáng.
items.g: 再过 + time · in another …

items.zh: 再过两个月，我就毕业了。
items.en: In two more months I'll graduate.
items.py: Zài guo liǎng ge yuè, wǒ jiù bìyè le.
items.g: 再过 + time · in another …

items.zh: 你看他们的房子是有了，可是没有睡过一个好觉。
items.en: They've got their flat, all right, but they've never had a good night's sleep.
items.py: Nǐ kàn tāmen de fángzi shì yǒu le, kěshì méiyǒu shuì guo yí ge hǎo jiào.
items.g: 是……，可是…… · it's … all right, but …

items.zh: 房子是大，可是离公司太远。
items.en: The flat is big all right, but it's too far from work.
items.py: Fángzi shì dà, kěshì lí gōngsī tài yuǎn.
items.g: 是……，可是…… · it's … all right, but …

items.zh: 再说了，有了房子，你结婚找女朋友也容易得多了。
items.en: Besides, with a flat it's much easier to find a girlfriend and get married.
items.py: Zàishuō le, yǒu le fángzi, nǐ jié hūn zhǎo nǚpéngyou yě róngyì de duō le.
items.g: V + 得多 · much more …

items.zh: 今天比昨天冷得多。
items.en: Today is much colder than yesterday.
items.py: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng de duō.
items.g: V + 得多 · much more …

items.zh: 现在房价是最高的时候，以后会降的，先别太急。
items.en: House prices are at their peak now. They'll come down later. Don't rush.
items.py: Xiànzài fángjià shì zuìgāo de shíhou, yǐhòu huì jiàng de, xiān bié tài jí.

items.zh: 所以房子是不会永远上涨的。现在花那么多钱，不值得。
items.en: So prices won't go up forever. Spending that much now isn't worth it.
items.py: Suǒyǐ fángzi shì bú huì yǒngyuǎn shàngzhǎng de. Xiànzài huā nàme duō qián, bù zhíde.

items.zh: 自从他工作以后，就很少回家了。
items.en: Since he started working, he hardly ever comes home.
items.py: Zìcóng tā gōngzuò yǐhòu, jiù hěn shǎo huí jiā le.
items.g: 自从……后 · ever since …

items.zh: 他为这件事而烦恼。
items.en: He's worried about this.
items.py: Tā wèi zhè jiàn shì ér fánnǎo.
items.g: 为……而…… · because of …

items.zh: 贵是贵，总比没有好。
items.en: It's expensive, but it's better than nothing.
items.py: Guì shì guì, zǒng bǐ méiyǒu hǎo.
items.g: 总比……好 · it's still better than …

items.zh: 现在不当房奴，以后房价涨得更高，你想当也当不上了。
items.en: If you don't become a mortgage slave now, prices will rise even higher, and later you won't be able to even if you want to.
items.py: Xiànzài bù dāng fángnú, yǐhòu fángjià zhǎng de gèng gāo, nǐ xiǎng dāng yě dāng bú shàng le.
items.g: V + 也 + V + 不上 · even if you want to, you can't

items.zh: 现在不报名，以后想去也去不上了。
items.en: If you don't sign up now, you won't get in later even if you want to.
items.py: Xiànzài bú bàomíng, yǐhòu xiǎng qù yě qù bú shàng le.
items.g: V + 也 + V + 不上 · even if you want to, you can't

items.zh: 他一回家就睡觉。
items.en: He goes to sleep as soon as he gets home.
items.py: Tā yì huí jiā jiù shuì jiào.
items.g: 一……就…… · as soon as …

items.zh: 我要是早买就好了，会涨得更多。
items.en: If only I'd bought earlier, it would have gone up even more.
items.py: Wǒ yàoshì zǎo mǎi jiù hǎo le, huì zhǎng de gèng duō.
items.g: 要是……就好了 · if only …

items.zh: 要是我会说汉语就好了。
items.en: If only I could speak Chinese.
items.py: Yàoshì wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ jiù hǎo le.
items.g: 要是……就好了 · if only …

items.zh: 装修、家具、账单、保险，样样都需要钱，我实在承受不起了。
items.en: decoration, furniture, bills, insurance: everything costs money. I really can't afford it.

items.py: Nǐ hēchá háishi hē kāfēi?

items.zh: 我最喜欢的是夏天。

items.en: Year one! Did you have extra classes this summer?
